pairs.source: The once-idyllic island paradise of Azsuna is being invaded - the Legion rains death from above, Queen Azshara's naga rise from the depths below, and the cursed ghosts of the island's former inhabitants stir. All seem drawn to a relic of great power hidden deep within the elven ruins.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳岛本是一座美好的世外桃源，但最近却遭到了各种势力的入侵——燃烧军团从天而降，艾萨拉女王的纳迦从海底崛起，被诅咒的幽灵在岛上徘徊。这一切似乎都是被岛上的精灵废墟中所隐藏的一件强大古物所引来的。

pairs.source: The ancient forest of Val'sharah is the home of the demi-god Cenarius and the birthplace of druidism. Malfurion Stormrage has returned to these sacred woods to commune with his great mentor and reclaim the Tears of Elune.
pairs.text: 古老的瓦尔莎拉森林是半神塞纳留斯的家园，同时也是德鲁伊教的诞生之地。玛法里奥·怒风已回到这片神圣的森林中与他的导师沟通，并寻找艾露恩之泪。

pairs.source: King Genn Greymane is preparing to take the mighty Skyfire to the bluffs of Stormheim to locate the Aegis of Aggramar. However, this land serves as the capital of an ancient vrykul clan whose leader also seeks the power of the Aegis and will stop at nothing to take its power for himself.
pairs.text: 吉恩·格雷迈恩国王登上了强大的天火号飞船驶向风暴峡湾以寻找阿格拉玛之盾。然而，这片土地也是一支古代维库氏族的首都，他们的领袖正不择手段地想要把圣盾据为己有。

pairs.source: Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner has prepared her personal fleet to set off to the bluffs of Stormheim to locate the Aegis of Aggramar. However, this land serves as the capital of an ancient vrykul clan whose leader also seeks the power of the Aegis and will stop at nothing to take its power for himself.
pairs.text: 大酋长希尔瓦娜斯·风行者率领她的私人舰队前往了风暴峡湾。然而，这片土地也是一支古代维库氏族的首都，他们的领袖正不择手段地想要把圣盾据为己有。

pairs.source: One of the last great frontiers of the Broken Isles, Highmountain dominates the northern horizon with its jagged peak. Its treacherous slopes are home to both noble tauren tribes and the brutish subterranean drogbar, whose uneasy peace will be tested by the relentless march of the Legion.
pairs.text: 作为破碎群岛上最后的处女地之一，至高岭用它险峻的山峰守护着群岛北方的地平线。崎岖的山地中居住着高贵的牛头人和野蛮的地下种族卓格巴尔。两个种族间脆弱的和平很快就将因为燃烧军团的入侵而受到考验。

pairs.source: After 10,000 years in isolation, the Nightborne elves have lowered the magical barrier protecting the city of Suramar, allowing Gul'dan access to a font of incredible power - the Nightwell. Following a failed attempt to overthrow Grand Magistrix Elisande, a small group of Nightborne exiles seek to awaken the power of their ancient lands and free Suramar from the Legion's grasp.
pairs.text: 经过一万年的自我封闭之后，夜之子精灵终于放开了保护苏拉玛城的魔法护盾，让古尔丹长驱直入，获取惊人的力量之源——暗夜井。试图推翻大魔导师艾利桑德的政变失败后，一小撮夜之子流亡者想要唤醒这片古老土地的力量，将苏拉玛从燃烧军团的掌控中解脱出来。

pairs.source: Perhaps it is your imperfections... that which grants you free will... that allows you to persevere against all cosmically calculated odds. You prevail where the Titan's own perfect creations have failed.
pairs.text: 也许正是这种不完美，才使你们获得了自由的意志，并因此有能力改变那些看起来不可避免的必然命运。泰坦所创造的许多完美生命体都遭遇了失败，而你们仍能继续前行。

pairs.source: You were a true man of the people, Liam.  Unlike any Royal I ever met.  We'll make them pay for this.
pairs.text: 你是人民真正的英雄，利亚姆。不像其他的贵族，我们将让他们付出代价。

pairs.source: May the Light bless the spirits of our ancestors, for they've chosen to allow my son to rest upon this holy ground.
pairs.text: 愿圣光祝福我们先祖的灵魂，他们挑选了我的儿子安息在这片应允的神圣土地上。

pairs.source: It is here, surrounded by the heroes and patriots of Gilneas where he belongs.
pairs.text: 他属于这里，这片被吉尔尼斯的英雄和爱国者所环绕的土地。

pairs.source: We'll return, Liam.  I swear this to you.
pairs.text: 我们一定会回来的，利亚姆，我向你发誓。

pairs.source: Gilneas will remember your courage forever, Liam.
pairs.text: 吉尔尼斯会铭记你的勇气，利亚姆。

pairs.source: I apologize for the deception, but it was necessary.
pairs.text: 很抱歉騙了你，但是我必須這麼做。

pairs.source: In thousands of years, we have never seen one of your kind.
pairs.text: 数千年来，我们从未遇见过你这样的人。

pairs.source: It was imperative that I first measure the bearing of your heart.
pairs.text: 所以我得先探明你的心意，这非常重要。

pairs.source: Come ride with me, little one. There is something I wish you to see.
pairs.text: 跟我来，小家伙。我想给你看一样东西。

pairs.source: We're gonna turn this place into a sinkhole, heh.
pairs.text: 我们要把这地方炸成个大坑，呵呵。

pairs.source: Run, slicky! I dook up your like fer breakfast!
pairs.text: 跑吧跑吧，光板儿！要是被我抓住，我就把你吞进肚子里去！

pairs.source: I am Anduin Wrynn, Prince of Stormwind. I won't die here. Not like this!
pairs.text: 我安度因·乌瑞恩是暴风城的王子。我绝不能死在这里。绝不！

pairs.source: It's working! The wound is closing!
We risked everything, but we did it. Shen-zin Su will be okay.
pairs.text: 我们孤注一掷，但成功了。神真子会好起来的。

pairs.source: Our story begins long ago in the days of the monstrous Emperor Tian.
pairs.text: 我们的故事发生在很久很久之前，荒暴无道的皇帝阗在位的时候。

pairs.source: The Emperor was in need of trusted messengers and deliverymen.
pairs.text: 这位皇帝需要一些可靠的信使和转运人。

pairs.source: So he took a strange, diminutive cave creature he found and warped it with the powers of the Vale.
pairs.text: 他找来了一个古怪的洞穴小生物，并用锦绣谷的力量改造了它。
他所创造出来的，就是“土地精”。

pairs.source: Let us talk about the nature of power. In my hands I hold a sword. I ask you: Who wields the power?
pairs.text: 我们来谈谈力量的本质。我的手里握着一把剑。我问你：是谁支配着力量？

pairs.source: I do, for I wield the sword!
A grummle can carry five times their own weight. They never sweat. They have an outstanding sense of smell.
pairs.text: 一个土地精可以负担相当于其本身体重五倍的重物。他们从不流汗，还有着超凡的嗅觉。

pairs.source: And their skulls are harder than granite. Curiously, they all appear to be related.
pairs.text: 他们的脑袋比花岗岩还要坚硬。而最奇怪的是，他们好像统统都是亲戚。

pairs.source: Ancient Pandaren heroes freed the grummles from slavery.
pairs.text: 古代熊猫人英雄们解放了被奴役的土地精。

pairs.source: The Yaungol warlord shows his face! Come, let's finish this!
pairs.text: 野牛人督军露脸了！来吧，让我们做个了结！

pairs.source: Today they still act as traders, messengers, guides, and pack bearers for expeditions high up in Kun-Lai summit.
pairs.text: 直到今天，他们依然在高耸入云的昆莱山上扮演着商人、信使、向导和送货人的角色。

pairs.source: They are a very superstitious people, who often take on the names of their favorite charms, or "Luckydos."
pairs.text: 他们是非常迷信的种族，经常以他们最喜爱的护身符——或者叫“幸运符”为名。

pairs.source: The grummle suspicious of any luck they cannot smell, so it behooves one to meet new grummles with a pocketful of dung.
pairs.text: 土地精质疑一切他们闻不到的运气，所以带上一口袋粪去见陌生的土地精是个不错的选择。

pairs.source: Many thousands of years ago, the mogu held all the power. They ruled this land with fists of iron. But as their empire grew, they needed a way to police and control it.
pairs.text: 几千年前，魔古族掌握着所有的力量，他们残暴地统治着这片土地。但是随着帝国的不断发展壮大，他们需要维持秩序并加以控制。

pairs.source: They used the powers of the Vale, and their own flesh-warping magics, to twist and shape a race of ferocious lizards into a living weapon. They created an army. An army of Saurok. Bloodthirsty savages created to enforce the will of the emperor.
pairs.text: 他们利用山谷的力量以及他们独有的血肉塑造魔法，将一种凶猛的蜥蜴改造成了具有生命的武器。他们打造了一支军队，一支蜥蜴人大军。这是一群嗜血的怪兽，他们的作用就是巩固皇权。

pairs.source: Ah, but there is a problem with creating a living weapon. Do you see?
pairs.text: 呃，但是创造一种有生命的武器会出现一个问题，你知道吗？
现在是谁在支配着力量？

pairs.source: The heartless saurok, even with their tiny lizard brains, soon realized the truth of their position. They killed the enemies of the mogu.
pairs.text: 凶残的蜥蜴人虽然头脑并不发达，但还是很快意识到他们的真实处境。它们先残杀魔古的敌人。

pairs.source: Then they killed the subjects of the mogu.
pairs.text: 接着，他们屠戮魔古的臣民。

pairs.source: Soon, they started killing the mogu themselves.
pairs.text: 很快，他们便开始残杀魔古。

pairs.source: The mogu emperor then ordered all of the saurok to be purged. He tried to wipe out their entire race, to no avail. They still plague Pandaria to this day.
pairs.text: 于是魔古皇帝下令铲除蜥蜴人。他想将整个蜥蜴人种族铲除，却无济于事。他们至今仍在潘达利亚肆虐。

pairs.source: So you see - power is easily taken, but should not be lightly given.
pairs.text: 明白了吧——力量得来容易，却不可轻易给予。

pairs.source: The Sha of Hatred is inside that mantid structure... I suspect it was drawn to a powerful host there.
pairs.text: 恨之煞就在那个螳螂妖建筑里……我猜想它是被一个强大的寄主吸引过去的。

pairs.source: To get in, we will need specially tuned crystals from some of the mantid leaders in the area.
pairs.text: 要想进去，得从这儿的螳螂妖头领身上找到经过特殊转化的水晶。

pairs.source: Kill them.  Take the crystals.  Should be simple enough.
pairs.text: 杀掉他们，夺取水晶。就这么简单。

pairs.source: My, my. Hello, stranger! Sampled my dream brew, have we? Its visions are hard to interpret - half truth, half illusion. Who's to say which is which?
pairs.text: 啊，你好，陌生人！洄梦仙酒味道如何？酒不醉人人自醉，雾里看花花非花。半梦半醒，谁是谁非？

pairs.source: It came from the wall, sir.
I know where it CAME from, what was it?
pairs.text: 我知道是从哪儿传来的，可那到底是什么？

pairs.source: You three! $n! Assist Captain Oakenshield in the front!
pairs.text: 你們三個！$n！協助前面的守衛隊長橡木盾！

pairs.source: Greentill! Blacksoil! Cover our left flank! I don't want any surprises!
pairs.text: 绿耕！黑土！掩护我们的左侧！我可不想遭到偷袭！

pairs.source: Leven, take the right side! You're on your own!
pairs.text: 莱文，你去右侧！靠你自己了！

pairs.source: Everyone else! If you can hold a weapon, protect the village! Don't let them past this line! You...
pairs.text: 其他人！如果你们拿得动武器，就去保护村庄！别让他们越过防线！你们……

pairs.source: Does it matter who we are? We are here to help you.
pairs.text: 何必管我们是谁？我们是来帮你的。

pairs.source: Hey! Gimme one o' them pitchforks!
You were surrendering? Why? Because these invaders can break down a wall?
pairs.text: 你投降了？为什么？因为这群入侵者能摧毁一道长城？别忘了你还有另一道长城…是由那些管这里叫做家的人…比肩铸成的。

pairs.source: You have got another wall... and it's made up of the people who call this place HOME.
pairs.text: 别忘了你还有另一道长城…是由那些管这里叫做家的人…比肩铸成的。

pairs.source: Any one of us would lay down our life to protect this land.
pairs.text: 我们任何人都甘愿放弃生命，以守护这片土地。

pairs.source: This land, it belongs to us...
And we are not about to let that change.
You are too late! The Thunder King will rise and take dis land from you.
pairs.text: 太迟了！雷电之王将会崛起，从你手上夺取这片土地。

pairs.source: How did they find us? Ready your weapons - we've got to get out of this canyon!
pairs.text: 他们是怎么发现我们的？拿起武器——我们必须冲出这条峡谷！

pairs.source: Oh... I seem to have lost my sword.
When the Sundering ripped apart the continents of Azeroth, we pandaren thought that the rest of the world had been utterly destroyed.
pairs.text: 当分裂之力将艾泽拉斯大陆撕扯开来时，我们熊猫人以为世界其它地区都遭到了彻底毁灭。

pairs.source: But as the centuries passed, one young explorer decided to see what was out there. His name was Liu Lang. And he set out to discover the world... on the back of a turtle!
pairs.text: 然而在几个世纪之后，有位名叫刘浪的年轻探险家决定出去看看。他开始了对世界的探索……而他骑的竟是一只海龟！

pairs.source: We celebrate his bravery with statue and song, but if you were actually there on the beach that very day - well, I'm sure he looked quite silly, indeed.
pairs.text: 我们用雕像和歌谣赞美他的英雄气魄，可如果你在他出海的那天守在岸边——我相信，你会觉得他当时的样子傻得很。

pairs.source: Oh, how the pandaren laughed at him. But Liu Lang was more clever than anyone thought. Sea turtles always return to the beach where they were born. And so, despite the mists that envelop our land, he always had a way home.
pairs.text: 噢，那些熊猫人不遗余力地嘲笑他。可是刘浪比人们想象得要聪明。海龟总能回到自己出生的岸边。于是，尽管迷雾笼罩着我们的土地，刘浪总能安然返家。

pairs.source: Every few years, he returned - with tales of mysterious cities in the sand, nomadic people living on endless grassy plains, a great empire under the ice, and a magical kingdom gilded in gold.
pairs.text: 他每隔几年便回来——讲述旅途中的奇遇：沙漠中的神秘城市，无边草原上的游牧民族，寒冰之下的伟大帝国，还有黄金镀成的神奇王国。

pairs.source: Each time he returned, more and more pandaren answered Liu Lang's call, and joined him on his growing turtle. They were the bravest among us: The explorers. The adventurers.
pairs.text: 他每次回来，都有更多的熊猫人响应刘浪的召唤，爬到那日渐拥挤的龟背上，与他同行。他们是勇敢的探险家，是冒险王。

pairs.source: And that is the lesson of Liu Lang, my friend. Everyone always laughs at the explorer. They always laugh... until he returns.
pairs.text: 那就是刘浪给我们的启示，朋友。人们总爱嘲笑探险家。他们笑啊，笑啊……等他回来就不笑了。

pairs.source: Great events often have humble beginnings. Consider: a quiet pond. Still. The water is like a sheet of glass.
pairs.text: 于无声之处起波澜。比如说，一个宁静的池塘。水面平滑如镜。

pairs.source: Until I throw a stone. Such a small thing - but soon, ripples engulf the whole of the lake!
pairs.text: 直到我丢进一块石子。如此微不足道——但瞬间，涟漪就会袭遍整个水面！

pairs.source: The jinyu also have humble origins. Once primitive creatures, they were fortunate enough to live near the enchanted pools within the Vale.
pairs.text: 锦鱼人也有着卑微的出身。本来只是一种原始生物，但有幸能生长在谷内含有魔法的池塘附近。

pairs.source: The magic of the pools expanded their minds and grew their bodies, until they became one of the great ancient cultures of Pandaria.
pairs.text: 池塘的魔力滋养着他们的心智、壮大着他们的躯体，把他们变成了潘达利亚最伟大的古老生物之一。

pairs.source: The wisest of the jinyu are very wise indeed - they can speak to the rivers the way you and I would consult our elders.
pairs.text: 锦鱼人中的智者确实非常睿智——他们与河流交流的方式，只有我族的长者才能知晓一二。

pairs.source: In the whispering waters, they can hear the future.
pairs.text: 在水流的低语声中，他们能听见未来。

pairs.source: The jinyu and their waterspeakers stand at the very heart of the greatest events in Pandaria's history.
pairs.text: 锦鱼人水语者们，在潘达利亚历史上的重要事件中，都扮演着核心角色。

pairs.source: Their visions built empires, freed slaves, and warned our Last Emperor of the Sundering that shattered Azeroth ten thousand years ago.
pairs.text: 他们的真知灼见筑起了帝国，解救了奴隶，还在一万年前艾泽拉斯大分裂来临之前，向末代皇帝发出了警告。

pairs.source: Think about it: the smallest voice can change the world. Consider that, friend, the next time you decide to start throwing stones!
pairs.text: 想想看——哪怕是最微弱的声音也能改变世界。下次当你决定掷出石子时，考虑一下吧，朋友。

pairs.source: Oh, my student - you wish to study the mantid? Be warned: the pandaren frontier is littered with the graves of former pupils.
pairs.text: 噢，我的弟子——你想要了解螳螂妖？我提醒你，边境前线上到处都是我原先弟子的坟冢。

pairs.source: Every generation, the mantid swarm the Serpent's Spine wall in great numbers. They murder many pandaren, so we kill many times their number in return. Yet each generation, they attack once more. Why do they do this?
pairs.text: 螳螂妖世代都汇集大军涌上蟠龙脊。它们杀死许多熊猫人，于是我们加倍奉还。可它们的后代又会卷土重来。为何要如此？

pairs.source: Our ancient writings indicate that the mantid have always been here. They predate even the mogu. Where did they come from?
pairs.text: 古书上说，螳螂妖一直都在这里。它们甚至比魔古族出现得还要早。它们是哪儿来的？

pairs.source: Perhaps, if you were to befriend the mantid, and earn a reputation among them, they would teach you their secrets. But I warn you:
pairs.text: 如果你能和螳螂妖交上朋友，赢取了信任，那他们会告诉你螳螂妖的秘密。可我提醒你：

pairs.source: Nobody has ever befriended the mantid.
pairs.text: 从来没人和螳螂妖交过朋友。

pairs.source: Here is what the pandaren do know: By massacring our people, by slaughtering tens of thousands of pandaren, generation after generation, they have taught us the value of life. A precious but fleeting gift. Easily snuffed out... in an instant.
pairs.text: 我们熊猫人只知道——螳螂妖屠杀我们的族人，一代又一代地杀害了无数的熊猫人，它们让我们懂得了生命的价值。人生苦短，稍纵即逝，一不留神……灰飞烟灭。

pairs.source: This is what the mantid have taught us.
pairs.text: 这就是螳螂妖教会我们的东西。

pairs.source: What do you fear most in this world? Have you conquered your fear... or has your fear conquered you?
pairs.text: 你在这个世界上最怕什么？你是否能战胜恐惧，还是被恐惧征服？

pairs.source: In the ancient days before the sundering of the world, the mogu emperors ruled over Pandaria. My people were made slaves, and they were afraid.
pairs.text: 在世界崩裂之前的古老时代，魔古族皇帝统治着潘达利亚。我们的族人被当成奴隶，而且畏惧不已。

pairs.source: The mogu were masters of pain and torture, of dark magics and brutal weapons. No pandaren, hozen, or jinyu could resist the power they held. And my people were afraid.
pairs.text: 魔古族是痛苦与折磨的高手，还精于使用黑暗魔法和恐怖武器。任何熊猫人、猢狲和锦鱼人都无力与之对抗。恐惧笼罩着熊猫人。

pairs.source: It was the mogu who built the Serpent's Spine. The most unlucky of slaves were sent to aid in its construction and defense, to be fodder for the mantid. And my people were afraid.
pairs.text: 是魔古族建造了蟠龙脊。运气最差的奴隶从事建造和防御工作，充当抵挡螳螂妖的炮灰。我的族人害怕极了。

pairs.source: As the empire grew, the mogu began to experiment with the secrets of the Vale. They crafted terrible weapons of living flesh and stone. And my people were afraid.
pairs.text: 帝国羽翼渐丰，魔古族窥探谷中的秘密，进行实验。他们用活人的血肉和石头造出了可怕的武器。我的族人惶恐不已。

pairs.source: In their hubris, the mogu never foresaw that their downfall lay in wait, not among their enemies, but among the oppressed. The day that one slave stood...
pairs.text: 而狂妄的魔古族万万没想到，最后推翻它们统治的，并非敌人，而是受压迫的民众。没想到会有一天，奴隶会挺身而起……

pairs.source: Fire! It is the most magical of elements. It warms us, it cooks our food. It is the hearthfire that makes a house a home. In the right hands, fire can shape iron into swords or plowshares. Left uncontrolled, fire could destroy a city.
pairs.text: 火是最有魔力的元素。它能带来温暖，烹制食物。是它把一座房屋变成了一个家。如果善加利用，火能把钢铁铸成刀剑或犁头。但若放任不管，大火也能烧毁整座城市。

pairs.source: Fire is the instrument of change.

Long ago, a group of sturdy nomad hunters wandered the world. By a stroke of fate, they were here in Pandaria when the Sundering split apart the continents of Azeroth. The wanderers found themselves trapped in the Townlong Steppes, a harsh and dangerous land.
pairs.text: 很久以前，一群强健的游牧猎手在世界各处游荡。命运和他们开了个玩笑——在艾泽拉斯大分裂发生时，他们刚好来到潘达利亚。这群游荡者被困在了螳螂高原这片荒芜而危险的土地。

pairs.source: Those noble hunters found a way to survive on their own. Fire was the key. They drew up oil from the ground. They used it to heat their homes, cook their food, and burn their enemies. They grew STRONG.
pairs.text: 那些高尚的猎手想出了自给自足的办法。其中火是关键。他们从地下掘油，用火来温暖房屋，烧饭做菜，烧灼敌人。他们变得强大起来了。

pairs.source: From the flames of fate, the yaungol were born. They survive beyond the wall, for they refuse to submit to any law but their own.
pairs.text: 命运之火熊熊燃烧，野牛人诞生了。他们定居在长城之外，拒绝臣服于除自己之外的任何律法。

pairs.source: Has fate been cruel to the yaungol? You may as well ask if fire is good or bad.
pairs.text: 命运对野牛人是否不公？这就等于是问火究竟是好还是坏。

pairs.source: Fate is like fire; it can shape or destroy us.
pairs.text: 命运就像火焰——既能塑造我们，也能毁灭我们。

pairs.source: All that matters is what you do with it.
pairs.text: 关键在于，你如何利用它。

pairs.source: Ah! You wish to learn of our last and greatest emperor, Shaohao? My friend, I do not have the time here to recount all of his adventures, but his actions ten thousand years ago resonate to this very day.
pairs.text: 啊！你想打听我们最伟大的末代帝王少昊？朋友，我可没时间陪你追溯他一生中的冒险奇遇，可他在万年以前采取的行动，直到今天仍然影响深远。

pairs.source: We know that he purged his doubts in the Jade Forest. That he cleansed himself of despair in the Krasarang Wilds. That he overcame his fear in Townlong Steppes. And that he defeated anger, hatred, and violence high in the mountains of Kun-Lai.
pairs.text: 我们知道，他在翡翠林中荡除了自己的疑虑，在卡桑琅丛林里消除了自己的绝望，在螳螂高原上战胜了自己的恐惧，在昆莱山的巅峰击败了自己的愤怒、仇恨和暴力。

pairs.source: This is known; and there are temples to mark these most sacred of places.
pairs.text: 人们为纪念这些圣地而建造了寺院。

pairs.source: But I want you to imagine standing in this very valley on the day he returned from his journey. Imagine being here when the gates opened for him. By then our emperor was a creature of pure light: No doubts, no fears, no hatred...
pairs.text: 但请你想象一下，他归返的那一天，置身于这个山谷中。那一刻，大门为他缓缓开启，我们的皇帝成为了焕发纯净之光的造物——胸中无疑无惧亦无恨……

pairs.source: It is said that all the trees in the vale blossomed as he entered, and continue to blossom to this day.
pairs.text: 据说，当时山谷中所有的林木都花开满枝，群芳争艳，一直盛开到今天。

pairs.source: Would that we could all live like our most sacred emperor. That we could put aside all our burdens and exist in harmony with the cosmos. THAT, I believe, was his message to us... before he became one with the land, and hid Pandaria away from the terror of the Sundering.
pairs.text: 但愿我们所有人都能像圣祖皇帝那样生活。像他那样卸下肩头的重担，和宇宙相生共存。我相信，这就是在他化归大地，使潘达利亚免受灾变侵袭之前……想要传达给我们的。
谢谢你，尊敬的皇帝陛下。

pairs.source: One day, a father grew tired of his young cub's misbehavior.  "You act just like a hozen!" the father scolded. Still, his son misbehaved.
pairs.text: 有一天，一位父亲厌倦了幼子的顽劣。“你简直像只猢狲！”父亲斥责道。可那孩子还是我行我素。

pairs.source: To teach him a lesson, the father dragged the cub out to the forest, to watch how the hozen live. "Do you see what the hozen are like?" he asked. "Do you want to live like that?"
pairs.text: 为了教训他，父亲把儿子拽到林子里，让他看看猢狲是如何生活的。“你知道猢狲是什么样了吧？你想像它们那样生活吗？”

pairs.source: The hozen are quite lively indeed. A short-lived race, few hozen survive past their 20th birthday. Their leaders are all 14 or 15. How mature were you at 14 years old? Meditate on that!
pairs.text: 猢狲很是活泼好动。可那是个短命的种族，很少有猢狲能活过二十岁。它们的领袖也只是十四或十五岁。你十四岁时有多成熟？好好想想吧！

pairs.source: Afterwards, the father asked his cub what he had learned.
pairs.text: 然后，父亲问儿子学到了什么。

pairs.source: "I learned that we work and toil on our little farm, but that the hozen have the whole world as their garden," the cub said. "I learned that we squint by the light of a single candle, but that the hozen enjoy the light of the stars. I learned that I go to school every day, but that the hozen learn by doing."
pairs.text: 儿子答道：“我学到的是，我们终日在那一亩三分地上劳作，可猢狲却把整个世界当成自己的花园。我们以寥落的烛光照明，可猢狲却能尽享漫天星光。我每天都要上学读书，可猢狲却在实践中掌握本领。”

pairs.source: And the cub concluded, "I should very much like to live like a hozen!"
pairs.text: 最后儿子总结道，“我还是乐得做只猢狲！”

pairs.source: Who then, was the wiser? The father or the cub?
pairs.text: 那么是谁更聪明？是父亲，还是儿子？

pairs.source: That, my friend, is for you to decide.
pairs.text: 这个问题就要让你自己去回答了。

pairs.source: Think you can take me in battle?  Most girls hate snakes, but I think they're cute!
pairs.text: 你可以让我加入战斗吗？大多数小女孩讨厌蛇，但我觉得蛇很可爱！

pairs.source: Think you can take me in battle?  Most girls hate snakes, but I think they're cute!
pairs.text: 你可以让我加入战斗吗？大多数小女孩讨厌蛇，但我觉得蛇很可爱！

pairs.source: Ah, if it isn't my favorite master assassin! I was hoping I would find you here in Pandaria.
pairs.text: 啊，这不是我最仰慕的刺客大师吗！我一直希望能在潘达利亚找到你呢。

pairs.source: My father, Deathwing, tried to destroy the whole of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 我的父亲死亡之翼，曾经想摧毁整个艾泽拉斯。

pairs.source: He was misguided, of course, but he was right about one thing: Our world is... so fragile.
pairs.text: 没错，他是误入歧途，可他却说对了一件事——我们的世界……确实脆弱不堪。

pairs.source: We are a point of light in a universe of shadow. A candle in a tempest.
pairs.text: 我们是晦暗宇宙中的一点光亮。是飘摇在暴风雨中的烛光。

pairs.source: Sometimes I think it was the very precariousness of our world that drove my father to madness.
pairs.text: 有时我会想，正是我们这个世界的动荡，逼疯了我的父亲。

pairs.source: Now, to my point: I believe we are headed towards a reckoning. And no, I am not talking about the current conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.
pairs.text: 现在，言归正传——我觉得一场末世浩劫正在酝酿。不，我说的不是联盟和部落之间的冲突。

pairs.source: Believe me - what Garrosh Hellscream achieved in Theramore is nothing compared to the horrors that are even now bearing down on our fragile home.
pairs.text: 相信我——加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮在塞拉摩的所作所为，跟现在降临于我们脆弱家园的浩劫相比，根本算不了什么。

pairs.source: But the war deeply troubles me. Do you see my concern?
pairs.text: 可战争深深困扰着我。你理解我的顾虑吗？

pairs.source: A divided Azeroth cannot possibly stand against the darkness.
pairs.text: 四分五裂的艾泽拉斯根本无力对抗黑暗。

pairs.source: This war has to end. Soon. Before it consumes our strength!
pairs.text: 这场战争必须尽快结束。否则，它会耗尽我们的力量！

pairs.source: I want you to know that your Alliance has my full and unwavering support in this campaign.
pairs.text: 请你相信，联盟在这场战役中，能得到我毫无保留、坚定不移的支持。

pairs.source: You can rest assured that my loyalties lie with your Horde.
pairs.text: 你大可放心，我的忠诚与部落同在。

pairs.source: How do we bring a swift and decisive end to the conflict? I believe the answer lies with heroes like you.
pairs.text: 我们该如何迅速果断地平息这场冲突？相信答案就在你们这些英雄心里。

pairs.source: We must ensure that you are up to the task... and then equip you accordingly.
pairs.text: 我们必须确定你能够执行这项任务……并把你武装起来。

pairs.source: Two hundred ships at my disposal, yet the one carrying my SON goes missing!
pairs.text: 我有两百多艘船，唯独载着我儿子的那艘……不见了！

pairs.source: I am sorry, but I cannot go back just yet.
pairs.text: 我很抱歉，可我暂时还不能回去。

pairs.source: I've decided to search for the Vale... Vale... Vale...
pairs.text: 我决心去寻找那座溪谷……溪谷……溪谷……

pairs.source: STORM the shores, and PAINT THIS NEW CONTINENT RED!!
pairs.text: 抢占那片海滩，将那岛屿染成红色！

pairs.source: Ah, another stranger from beyond the mists.
pairs.text: 啊，又一个来自迷雾之外的旅行者。

pairs.source: Ten thousand years ago, the last Pandaren Emperor came seeking my advice. He, too, was filled with conflict. Let us see if you are correct, Taran. Let us see how this stranger deals with turmoil of the soul.
pairs.text: 一万年前，末代熊猫人皇帝曾向我讨教治国之道。他也是一个充满矛盾的人。让我们看看你是否正确，踏岚。看看这个陌生人如何应对灵魂的骚动。

pairs.source: We can agree it is noble to fight for a righteous cause: to defend home or family. But what of vengeance? What of anger? I sense these emotions run deep in this one.
pairs.text: 我们赞同为正义事业而战是光荣的：如保卫家园或家人。可复仇呢？愤怒呢？我能在此人内心深处感觉到这些情绪。

pairs.source: Well spoken, Zhi. The strangers from beyond the mists have no shortage of passions, but let us see if they indeed control them. Beyond anger lies hatred, the wellspring of all misery. What is this? Your hatred has a face!
pairs.text: 说得好，智。来自迷雾之外的陌生人们虽然不缺乏热情，但我们得看看他们的自制力。愤怒出自仇恨，仇恨乃万苦之源。看，这就是你心中仇恨的模样！

pairs.source: This one has indeed proven mastery over anger. Between the young cub's words and the actions of this hero, I think I understand. Those from beyond the mists are hardened by battle. They are scarred, yes, but they have learned much. I trust them.
pairs.text: 这个凡人证明了自己驾驭愤怒的能力。通过后辈们的话语和这位英雄的举动，我想我已经明白了。那些来自迷雾之外的人久经战火磨砺。他们伤痕累累，但已有所觉悟。我相信他们。

pairs.source: It is decided. The Vale of Eternal Blossoms shall remain open. The transgressions of the outsiders have been great... but I see in them the capability to right what has been wronged.
pairs.text: 我决定了，锦绣谷将继续对外来者开放。他们确实犯下了很大的罪孽……但是，我从他们身上看到了纠正错误的能力。

pairs.source: I will consult the others. Meet me at the gates.
pairs.text: 我要征求其他人的意见。大门口见。

pairs.source: Da remains of da Thunder King were taken to da Isle of Reckoning.
pairs.text: 雷电之王的遗骸已被带去末劫岛了。
我们举行了古老的仪式……

pairs.source: Even now, da true emperor of Pandaria lives and breathes once more.
pairs.text: 现在，潘达利亚的真命天子要再次降临这个世界了。

pairs.source: Woe to da pandaren usurpers! The mogu will rule dis land again, and we Zandalari will have a new homeland...
pairs.text: 向熊猫人篡位者致哀吧！魔古族将再度崛起，赞达拉也将得到新的家园……

pairs.source: Da Thunder King shall live again...
The storm long spent there rests...
But blood of brother kingdom keeps...
By Zandalari blood he will be taken...
pairs.text: 赞达拉的鲜血将带他归返……

pairs.source: To Zandalari voice he will awaken...
pairs.text: 赞达拉的声音将使他苏醒……

pairs.source: Children of Pandaria. The mists have fallen. For good or for ill, our land is open to all.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚的子民们，迷雾已经散去。无论如何，这片土地都将对外开放。

pairs.source: Let us draw ourselves together to rebuild this sacred place, the first step toward healing a war-torn world.
pairs.text: 让我们团结一致，重建这片神圣的土地，向治愈这个破碎的世界迈出第一步。

pairs.source: I have faith in our friends from beyond the mists.
pairs.text: 我信任来自迷雾之外的朋友们。

pairs.source: Their strength is an inspiration... and sorely needed. We must trust that their hearts are pure.
pairs.text: 嗯……这股力量是种鼓舞……至关重要。要相信他们的心是纯洁的。

pairs.source: We've been flying in this mist for hours, General. The crew grows... uneasy.
pairs.text: 我们在迷雾中航行了好几个小时了，将军。船员们感觉很不好……

pairs.source: Back to your post, soldier! We'll find this land, or die trying.
pairs.text: 坚守岗位，士兵！就算死也要找到那片陆地。

pairs.source: Enemy ship, starboard! Ready the guns! Fire at will!
pairs.text: 右舷发现敌舰！炮火准备！自由射击！

pairs.source: Uhh, somethin' ain't right, General... We're losin' altitude! Fast!
pairs.text: 呃，情况不对，将军……我们下降得……很快！

pairs.source: Thanks to your actions, the Hozen fear your people. Indulge me a moment...
pairs.text: 多亏了你，猢狲开始忌惮你的族人了。暂且等我一下——

pairs.source: Ah! Here we are. Over 14,000 years ago, this entire land was ruled by a terrible race of warlords called "the mogu."
pairs.text: 啊！好了。在一万四千多年以前，这整片大陆由一个名叫“魔古”的可怕督军部族统治。

pairs.source: The mogu ruled through fear. And fear kept them in power... until the first Pandaren monks taught my people courage.
pairs.text: 魔古族用恐惧统治臣民，用恐惧维持强权……直到第一代熊猫人武僧激发了人民的勇气。
于是魔古族的政权被推翻了。

pairs.source: You see, those who lead through fear only stay in power while those they govern lack courage.
pairs.text: 你看，凭恐惧统治的帝王，只能在臣民缺乏勇气时才能永掌大权。

pairs.source: The hozen are many things, but they are not cowards - not for long. If you don't wish to fight them, you must... inspire them!
pairs.text: 猢狲有许多特点，但并不懦弱——至少不会一直懦弱。如果你不想和他们交战，就必须……激励他们！

pairs.source: I will help you, but first I would like to learn a little more about your people. Will you journey with me for a little while?
pairs.text: 我会帮助你，可我想先对你的族人有所了解。你愿意花点时间随我走走吗？

pairs.source: What is the source of YOUR power? Think carefully before you answer. Many adventurers point to their weapons, or their equipment, or to tomes of arcane might.
pairs.text: 你的力量源自哪里？回答前好好想想。很多人都归因于他们手中的武器、身上的装备，或是奥术力量宝典。

pairs.source: Long ago, when my people were slaves of the mogu empire, we were forbidden from carrying any weapon at all. We were not fighters. And no one believed we could fight the mogu without magic and steel.
pairs.text: 很久以前，我的族人还是魔古帝国的奴隶，他们被禁止携带武器。他们不是战士，既无魔法也无钢铁，没人相信他们能对抗魔古族。

pairs.source: Until Kang, the First of First Dawn, opened our eyes.
pairs.text: 直到曙光之拳——康，拨开了我们的双眼。

pairs.source: One day, the beloved monk issued a challenge to his fellow slaves. "Hit me!" he called out.
pairs.text: 有一天，这位饱受爱戴的武僧向他的奴隶同伴们发起了挑战。“过来打我！”他命令道。

pairs.source: Surprised, the beleaguered Pandaren slaves tried to strike Kang. One by one they failed, for he intercepted their blows like a dancer and sidestepped their attacks like a reed in the wind.
pairs.text: 奴隶们非常诧异，尝试着攻击康，结果无一例外地失败了。他如舞者般格挡着他们的拳脚，如风中芦苇般闪避着他们的攻击。

pairs.source: "Our backs are hardened by the whips of the mogu," he told them. "Our arms are powerful from building their fortresses. Our minds are sharp from working alongside our enemy. You think the mogu are stronger? I say we are their strength!"
pairs.text: “我们的脊背因鞭打而变得硬实，”他告诉他们，“我们的手臂因建造堡垒而变得强壮。我们的头脑因与敌共处而变得敏锐。你们以为魔古族更强大？我想说，我们才是他们的力量！”

pairs.source: The farmers, the bricklayers, the shepherds and the smiths... they all bowed before Kang. "Teach us," they said. "Teach us to fight."
pairs.text: 那些农夫、砖瓦工、牧羊人和铁匠纷纷跪拜说道，“康，教教我们如何战斗吧。”

pairs.source: And when they rose... they rose as warriors.
pairs.text: 而当他们起身时……他们已成为战士。

pairs.source: Your voice. Your hands. THESE are the tools of true heroes. Use them well... and you can change the world.
pairs.text: 你的声音。你的双手。这些成就了真正的英雄。善加利用……你便能改变世界。

pairs.source: Do you like my snakes? I get the feeling they don't like you!
pairs.text: 你喜欢我的蛇吗？我感觉它们不喜欢你！

pairs.source: Do you like my snakes? I get the feeling they don't like you!
pairs.text: 你喜欢我的蛇吗？我感觉它们不喜欢你！

pairs.source: Death to all who dare challenge my empire!
pairs.text: 胆敢挑战我帝国的人都只有死路一条！

pairs.source: Such is the fate of those who question authority.
pairs.text: 质疑权威的人就是这个下场。

pairs.source: Do you have a few moments to spare?

pairs.text: 我的蛇很漂亮对吧？……对吧？

pairs.source: You never stood a chance against me and my lovely snakes!
pairs.text: 在我和我可爱的毒蛇面前，你毫无半点儿机会！

pairs.source: No way! I will get you next time!
Try this guy on for size!
I'm going to knock you out cold!
I told you, sugar. You aren't hot enough to handle me!
pairs.text: 我提醒过你了，宝贝儿。就你那点热量，还不足以对付我！

pairs.source: Take a break and chill, sweetie. You'll get your turn again soon.
pairs.text: 歇会，降降温吧，宝贝儿。很快就又轮到你了。

pairs.source: We're snowballing out of control! You don't stand a chance now!
pairs.text: 雪球失控碾压！你现在没机会了！

pairs.source: You handle the cold better than I thought.
Your pet is a cold, ruthless killer!
pairs.text: 你的宠物是个冰冷无情的杀手！

pairs.source: I won't let you get away with that!
pairs.text: 这事决不会就这么算了！

pairs.source: We read you. Comin' in hot.
Nightwind, report! What's going on down there?
pairs.text: 夜风，报告！下面发生了什么事？

pairs.source: Horde troops are swimming toward your position. Open fire at once.
pairs.text: 部落士兵从船骸游向你所在的位置。立即开火。

pairs.source: You don't think they'll hesitate to strangle you with their bare hands? GUN THEM DOWN!
pairs.text: 你难道不知道，他们现在恨不得徒手掐死你？击毙他们！

pairs.source: No sign of the flagship, and no sign of Admiral Taylor or Prince Anduin.
pairs.text: 没有旗舰的线索，也没有上将泰勒或安度因王子的踪迹。

pairs.source: Admiral - I think they mean to surrender. They're not armed - They're just trying not to drown!
pairs.text: 上将——我想他们是要投降。他们手无寸铁——只是不想淹死！

pairs.source: That's not right... this is a massacre... they were unarmed - ugh! I don't... I don't feel well...
pairs.text: 不……这简直是屠杀……他们手无寸铁——呃！我不太……不太舒服……

pairs.source: You beasts! What sort of madness is this?
pairs.text: 你们这群畜生！你们疯了吗？

pairs.source: Men, stand down - this is one of the natives.
pairs.text: 弟兄们，放下武器——这是个当地人。

pairs.source: We are from the Alliance, and mean you no harm. Tell me, what was that shadow you drew out of me?
pairs.text: 我们来自联盟，没有恶意。告诉我，你刚才从我体内逐出的黑影是什么？

pairs.source: This is not the place to explain. In short, your own doubts have been made manifest, as a consequence of your actions.
pairs.text: 这儿不是作详细解释的地方。简单说吧，由于你的所作所为，源自你自身的疑惑现形了。

pairs.source: You don't understand - we're fighting a war here-
pairs.text: 你不明白——我们是在这里打仗——

pairs.source: Oh, I understand perfectly. I have eyes. But Pandaria is not like whatever land you came from; it lives and breathes. You should be careful what kind of energy you bring here. Now put those weapons away!
pairs.text: 噢，我明白得很。我有眼睛。可潘达利亚跟其它地方不一样，它有生命，会呼吸。你应该小心控制自己带来的能量。现在，丢掉那些武器！

pairs.source: What is - no - NO! They had an airbase, a hidden airbase... my ship - my - Hellscream will have my head!
pairs.text: 怎么——不——不！他们有空军基地，秘密空军基地……我的船——我的——地狱咆哮会要了我的脑袋的！

pairs.source: You! Bear-creature. What kind of sorcery was this?
pairs.text: 你！熊——什么的。这是什么巫术？

pairs.source: We bring only our honor and the desire to crush our enemies. Have your kind been aiding the Alliance?
pairs.text: 我们只是渴望胜利的荣耀，渴望粉碎敌人。你们一直在帮助联盟吗？

pairs.source: Stranger - your own doubts have been made manifest. Pandaria is not like whatever land you come from; it lives and breathes. You should be careful what kind of energy you bring here.
pairs.text: 陌生人——你自身的疑惑现形了。潘达利亚跟其它地方有所不同，它有生命，会呼吸。你应该小心控制自己带来的能量。

pairs.source: It is not our desire to get wrapped up in your bloodshed. Now have your men lower their weapons, or you will face TWO enemies on this continent.
pairs.text: 我们才不想卷入这场血腥杀戮。现在，请让你的人放下武器，否则你在这里就要面对两拨敌人了。

pairs.source: Your doubts and hatreds have wrought havoc all throughout these ruins. Clean up after yourselves and meet me in the village below - I will do my best to explain.
pairs.text: 你们的疑惑和仇恨在这片遗迹间引发了浩劫。自己收拾残局吧，然后到下方的村里来——我会尽力解释给你们听。

pairs.source: You scum will NOT destroy this land as you defiled Kalimdor!
pairs.text: 渣滓们，休想像玷污卡利姆多那样毁掉这片土地！

pairs.source: Admiral, we're seeing a significant native presence here. Ornate structures-
pairs.text: 上将，我们看见了充满当地风格的景色。华丽的建筑群——

pairs.source: Cut the chatter, people. Eyes on the target!
pairs.text: 别啰嗦了，伙计们。瞄准目标！

pairs.source: Cut the chatter, people. Eyes on the target!
pairs.text: 别啰嗦了，伙计们。瞄准目标！

pairs.source: You heard the admiral. Concentrate fire on the Horde base. Begin your attack runs.
pairs.text: 听从上将命令，准备攻击，集中火力对付部落基地。

pairs.source: Use your torpedo rockets on those ships.
pairs.text: 用火箭鱼雷轰击那些舰船。

pairs.source: Any sign of the flagship down there?
Any sign of the flagship down there?
Negative, Admiral. No sign of Captain Taylor OR his flagship.
pairs.text: 没有，上将。未能发现泰勒上尉及其坐舰的线索。

pairs.source: Heavy enemy fire... Sully, pull up!
pairs.text: 敌人攻势猛烈……苏利，提升高度！

pairs.source: We're not gonna make it! I'm comin' ta see you soon, pappy!
pairs.text: 我们肯定搞不定的！我马上就来见你了，老爹！

pairs.source: Pay 'em back! Hit them with everything you've got!
Pay 'em back! Hit them with everything you've got!
That's enough - all wings, report back. Prepare for ground assault.
pairs.text: 够了——全军回报。准备地面进攻。

pairs.source: That's enough - all wings, report back. Prepare for ground assault.
pairs.text: 够了——全军回报。准备地面进攻。

pairs.source: The flagship's last reported position was below. Can you see anything?
pairs.text: 旗舰最后报告的位置就在下方。你能看见什么吗？

pairs.source: Fog... nothing but dense fog... wait! Land - starboard! I see ships.
pairs.text: 雾……只有浓雾……等等！右转舵！我看见船了。

pairs.source: I say, it looks like I've racked up another win!
Ah, but were you expecting this?
It seems I'll be enjoying an expedient win this fine day!
pairs.text: 今天可真是个好日子啊，我都赢得不好意思了！

pairs.source: Now's as good a time as any, I suppose.
pairs.text: 这可真是个大好机会啊。

pairs.source: I knew I made the right choice when I took this up!
pairs.text: 我就知道自己的选择是对的！

pairs.source: Maybe I can still get my old farm back...
pairs.text: 也许我还能把自己的旧农场给找回来……

pairs.source: I've found it sometimes helps to change things up a bit.
pairs.text: 我发现，有时适当地做些改变是好的。

pairs.source: If only my wife were here to see this. I'm going to win!
pairs.text: 要是我妻子能看到这一切该多好啊。我要赢了！

pairs.source: There's plenty more where that came from!
I won't go easy on you!
Mommy! Mommy! The mean tamer didn't let me win!
pairs.text: 妈咪！妈咪！这个小气的驯兽员不肯让我赢！

pairs.source: W-why did you k-kill my bunny...
pairs.text: 你为——为什么要杀——杀死我的小兔子……

pairs.source: I do hope you're prepared to feed your pets to mine as a treat.
pairs.text: 希望你已经做好准备，让你的宠物变成我宠物的盘中餐。

pairs.source: I did warn you of the dangers of these woods.
pairs.text: 我已经提醒过你，在这片树林里危机四伏。

pairs.source: No matter. A single life for a victory is well worth the sacrifice.
pairs.text: 不要紧。为了胜利，牺牲区区一条性命是值得的。

pairs.source: Avast, land lubbers be attackin'! Man the harpoons!
pairs.text: 停，陆地上的傻大个们发起攻击了！准备鱼叉！

pairs.source: Why'd you go and have to do that? ...hic!
pairs.text: 你为什么非得那么做？……嗝儿！

pairs.source: Now that...that is fightin'! Whoever's controllin' these pets sure ish somethin'! ...hic!
pairs.text: 现在……动真格的了！不管是谁在控制着这些宠物，肯定是……嗝儿！

pairs.source: Now that is what Zunta be talkin' about!
You be da victor today. Enjoy it.
pairs.text: 今天你是赢家。享受胜利吧。

pairs.source: How about you try dis one on for size?
Good, good. Zunta give you a treat later.
pairs.text: 很好，很好。祖塔晚点再款待你。

pairs.source: Why you so mean to Zunta, eh?
pairs.text: 干嘛对祖塔这么刻薄啊？

pairs.source: Battle is upon us. Crush them!
I won't give you the pleasure.
Not important. I will stop at nothing to win!
pairs.text: 无关紧要。什么都别想阻止我胜利的步伐！

pairs.source: Do not be fooled by my calmness. I will defeat you.
pairs.text: 别被我的平静给骗了。我会打败你。

pairs.source: Well done. You've beaten me when few have had the luxury.
pairs.text: 干得好。几乎没人享受过击败我的殊荣。

pairs.source: You're gonna hurt like you never hurt before when I'm through with ya.
pairs.text: 在我干掉你之前，我要让你尝尝前所未有的痛苦。

pairs.source: I never see nobody fight like you be fightin'.
pairs.text: 我从没见过像你这样战斗的人。

pairs.source: I bet you never saw dis one comin'.
pairs.text: 我敢说，你绝对没想到过这个。

pairs.source: Look at da little one hurtin'!
Looks like dis one has a bit of a sting!
pairs.text: 看来这个会让人感到刺痛！

pairs.source: I'm warning you, I will not falter under your assault.
pairs.text: 我警告你，你的攻击不会让我动摇半步。

pairs.source: Fighting the strength of the land is inevitably futile.
pairs.text: 与大地的力量抗争，注定是徒劳无功的。
你在对抗不可阻挡的力量。

pairs.source: No! No kill! Fight this one instead!
Good tiny thing! You kill other tiny thing!
pairs.text: 优秀的小东西！杀死另一个小东西！

pairs.source: Why you no fight? I said fight!
Looks like I left you earthbound!
pairs.text: 看来你被束缚在地面上了！

pairs.source: We've been shot out of the sky!
pairs.text: 我们被射到九天之外了！
一个美丽的生命消逝了。

pairs.source: You never stood a chance against my augmented team!
pairs.text: 你在我强大的战队面前毫无机会！

pairs.source: No letting up. Full speed ahead!
That's nothing a good spit shine won't fix.
pairs.text: 没什么难题是解决不了的。

pairs.source: You think I'm scared of you? I faced Onyxia!
pairs.text: 你以为我会怕你？我面对过奥妮克希亚！

pairs.source: I hope a dragon eats you!
That's what happens when you go into the whelp pits!
pairs.text: 进入巢穴就会遇到那样的事情！

pairs.source: You cannot possibly comprehend the forces stacked against you.
pairs.text: 你根本无法理解自己面对的是什么力量。

pairs.source: Perhaps now you're ready to see things my way?
pairs.text: 也许你现在准备按我的方式看待事物了？

pairs.source: You only delay us. We cannot be stopped.
pairs.text: 你只会拖慢我们，但无法阻止我们。

pairs.source: Have you ever seen such a magnificent being?
pairs.text: 你见过这么壮观的东西吗？

pairs.source: Those are Horde vessels... General quarters! Get our birds in the air. Clear the decks. Stations, people. Let's go to war!
pairs.text: 那是部落的船。全船战备部署！各就各位，准备战斗。打起精神来，弟兄们。大战一场！

pairs.source: Give up now while you still have the chance!
Your impudence will be your undoing. Mark my words!
pairs.text: 你的傲慢将为你招致毁灭。记住我说的话！

pairs.source: Not to worry, I'll make this quick.
That wasn't so bad, was it?
Perhaps I need to increase the dosage to prevent such quick deaths.
pairs.text: 也许我该加大剂量，避免如此快速地死亡。

pairs.source: Don't be so sure of yourself.
I'll show you firsthand the strength of undeath.
pairs.text: 我会直接让你看看亡灵的力量。

pairs.source: No! We will not be defeated!
Are ye sure that ye want to face the might of dragons?
pairs.text: 你确定想要面对巨龙之力吗？

pairs.source: Now it's time to show my brother who the real master tamer is!
pairs.text: 是时候让我兄弟看看，谁才是真正的驯宠大师！
你只是走运罢了，仅此而已。

pairs.source: Now that's what I'm talkin' about!
No! I just finished raising that one!

pairs.text: 希望你喜欢失败的滋味！

pairs.source: I knew the swamp was the right choice!
pairs.text: 我就知道沼泽是个正确的选择！

pairs.source: Perhaps it was wrong of me to venture here.
pairs.text: 也许我到这里来探险是错误的。
沼泽中埋藏着许多秘密。

pairs.source: This is looking bleak for me.
By the hammer of me father, I shall defeat ye!
pairs.text: 以吾父黑锤之名，我要打败你！

pairs.source: That's the stuff, boys. We did it!
pairs.text: 干得好，兄弟们！我们办到了！

pairs.source: You won't be deterrin' me. Not today. I'll keep trainin'!
pairs.text: 你阻止不了我。为时尚早。我会继续训练！

pairs.source: I will show you no mercy.
Just as I thought. You never stood a chance.
pairs.text: 不出所料。你完全没机会。
你将因自己的恶行而受到惩罚。

pairs.source: Now that's what I'm talking about! Woohoo!
Maybe I should've gone with more weapons...
pairs.text: 也许我该准备更多武器的……

pairs.source: Hey! I spent some serious gold on that!
pairs.text: 嘿！我在它身上可是花了大价钱的！

pairs.source: I bet if I keep winning, I'll get invited to fight in Stormwind one day!
pairs.text: 我敢说，要是我一直赢下去的话，哪天也许会被邀请去暴风城作战！

pairs.source: These creatures have suffered enough. I will not let you defeat them!
pairs.text: 这些家伙已经吃尽苦头了。我不会让你得逞！

pairs.source: The spirits smile upon my victory!
pairs.text: 灵魂在对我的胜利微笑！

pairs.source: Ancestors forgive me. I have failed...
Come rest. You will need your strength later in the battle.
pairs.text: 休息一下吧。保存体力，应对接下来的战斗。

pairs.source: Your spirit reunites with your ancestors, little one.
pairs.text: 你的灵魂与先祖同在，小家伙。

pairs.source: These old bones have much knowledge to impart.
pairs.text: 这些老骨头有不少学问要传授。

pairs.source: You will do better, next time.
It has been an honor, outlander.
Perhaps this will test your skills.
pairs.text: 也许这会考验你的技能。

pairs.source: I will crush you beneath the onslaught of my team!
pairs.text: 我队伍的攻势会把你粉碎！

pairs.source: I hope you now understand that there is no defeating me.
pairs.text: 希望你现在能认清现实，你是不可能打败我的。

pairs.source: No matter. Nobody can stop me in the end.
pairs.text: 不要紧。最后谁也阻止不了我。

pairs.source: I'll take that gold now, if you would be so kind.
pairs.text: 要是你如此慷慨，我就把这金币收下了。

pairs.source: So...how about we forget about our little wager and carry on with our busy lives?
pairs.text: 那么……不如我们先别打赌了，继续过我们忙碌的生活吧？

pairs.source: Trying to pull a fast one on me, are you? I think not!
pairs.text: 想骗我是吧？没那么容易！

pairs.source: You can forfeit if you'd like.
Remember your training, Helena...you've got this.
pairs.text: 记住你的训练，海伦娜……这对你有益。

pairs.source: Well, practice makes perfect I suppose.
Come back before you get hurt!
pairs.text: 趁你还没受伤，赶快回来！

pairs.source: Nice! I'm on my way to victory!
You're going to regret this, I assure you.
pairs.text: 你一定会后悔的，我保证。

pairs.source: This is a most...unfortunate turn of events.
pairs.text: 情势发生了……最悲惨的转变。

pairs.source: Don't worry, it'll all be over soon.
You dare challenge me? I'll show you the true power of the Horde!
pairs.text: 你竟敢挑战我？我要让你见识部落真正的力量！

pairs.source: Consider yourself fortunate that I was so merciful.
pairs.text: 你可真走运，我竟然如此心慈手软。

pairs.source: NO! You miserable wretch! I do not lose!
pairs.text: 不！你这卑鄙的可怜虫！我是不会输的！

pairs.source: I will not rest until I defeat you!
pairs.text: 在我打败你之前，我决不会懈怠！

pairs.source: Me save this one for later.
By the might of King Varian's throne, I shall defeat you!
pairs.text: 以瓦里安国王的王权之力，我要打败你！

pairs.source: Another victory for the Alliance military!
pairs.text: 联盟军队的又一场大捷！

pairs.source: I was warned about you. I should have heeded that warning.
pairs.text: 有人警告过我要小心你。我真不该大意。

pairs.source: I'm not through with you yet!
By the grace of Prince Anduin I shall achieve victory this day.
pairs.text: 承蒙安度因王子的恩惠，我将在今天迎来胜利。

pairs.source: I wish you the best of luck.
Do not lament. Continue your training, and you shall achieve greatness.
pairs.text: 别难过。继续训练，你一定能成就大业。

pairs.source: Well done. I applaud your skills as a tactician.
pairs.text: 干得好。我要为你的战术喝彩。

pairs.source: Live to fight another day, and prosper.
All is as it should be.
Time to lay down da beatdown!
My pets are all hand-grown! You don't stand a chance!
pairs.text: 我的宠物都是我亲手养大的！你毫无半点机会！

pairs.source: I knew I could count on my team to win!
pairs.text: 我就知道我的队伍赢定了！
我的整支队伍都被消灭了！

pairs.source: If you think I'm out for the count, think again!
pairs.text: 要是你以为我已经落败，那就大错特错了！

pairs.source: We're really plowing through your team now!
pairs.text: 我们现在可真要攻破你的队伍了！

pairs.source: Let us see who is the greater tamer.
pairs.text: 让我们看看谁才是更厉害的驯宠师。

pairs.source: The day is mine. Well fought.
pairs.text: 今天我是主角。打得漂亮。

pairs.source: You are a worthy foe. The day is yours.
pairs.text: 你是个强大的对手。今天是属于你的。

pairs.source: A smart fighter knows when retreat is the best option.
pairs.text: 聪明的斗士知道该在什么时候抽身退出。

pairs.source: Capitalizing on your enemy's weaknesses is key.
pairs.text: 利用敌人的弱点，是制胜要诀。

pairs.source: Sometimes even the finest make mistakes.
pairs.text: 有时即便是精英也会犯错。

pairs.source: You have not earned the right to defeat me, tamer.
pairs.text: 你还没资格击败我，驯宠师。

pairs.source: I hope you learn from your defeat.
pairs.text: 希望你能从自己的失败中吸取教训。

pairs.source: Clearly, I was wrong about you.
pairs.text: 显然，我对你的评价是错误的。

pairs.source: You ought to rejoice that you even came close to defeating one of my pets.
pairs.text: 你应该感到高兴，因为你差点打败了我其中一只宠物。

pairs.source: Only a matter of time, now.
Do not expect to defeat me.
Well done! Congratulations on your victory.
pairs.text: 干得好！恭喜你大获全胜。

pairs.source: Do not expect mercy, tamer. I will show none.
pairs.text: 别妄想我会手下留情，驯宠师。我不会手软。
真了不起。太出乎我的意料了。

pairs.source: Let's get this show on the road!
Nobody can beat a dwarf in his element!
pairs.text: 没人能击败一个意气风发的矮人！

pairs.source: Woah! Woah! Take it easy! You win!
pairs.text: 哇哦！哇哦！放轻松！你赢了！

pairs.source: I've still got plenty of tricks up my sleeve!
pairs.text: 我还有许多招数没使出来呢！

pairs.source: He was just a wee pebble...
Thank you. My pets are stronger than ever now.
pairs.text: 谢谢你。我的宠物变得比以往更加强大了。

pairs.source: Rest, so that you may do battle again soon.
pairs.text: 好好休息，以便尽早整装再战。

pairs.source: Ah. The taste of victory is sweet.
At least my pet died fighting valorously.
pairs.text: 至少我的宠物是英勇战死的。

pairs.source: Show them the true meaning of pain.
pairs.text: 让他们瞧瞧痛苦的真正含义。

pairs.source: You never stood a chance, whelp.
pairs.text: 你从无半点机会，小崽子。

pairs.source: How? I cannot lose! I am imbued with the power of twilight!
pairs.text: 怎么？我决不会输！我体内充满了暮光之力！

pairs.source: The time of your reckoning is upon us.
pairs.text: 我们迎来了对你进行清算的时刻。

pairs.source: Do not fear defeat. It is a catalyst for later triumph.
pairs.text: 不要惧怕失败。那是酝酿成功的催化剂。

pairs.source: I had thought my victory was certain. Clearly the Makers had other plans.
pairs.text: 我以为自己赢定了。可造物主显然另有安排。

pairs.source: Your time has not yet come.
A mere blip in the eyes of the Makers.
pairs.text: 只是造物主眼中的微小尘埃。

pairs.source: I've been wondering when I would be fighting you.
pairs.text: 我一直在想，什么时候才能与你对决。

pairs.source: The lake told me it would be so!
I must have misunderstood the water's wisdom.
pairs.text: 我一定是误解了水流的智慧。

pairs.source: Much hides just beneath the surface.
Another victim claimed by the unending tide.
pairs.text: 被无尽潮水夺去的又一条生命。

pairs.source: Yer gonna be swimmin' with the murlocs when we're through!
pairs.text: 等这一切结束之后，你就要跟鱼人一起游泳了！

pairs.source: Another victory for me captain's log!
pairs.text: 在我船长的日记里又增添了新的胜利篇章！
对于旱鸭子来说，算是不错了。

pairs.source: What a fight! If ye ever decide that yer done with the battlin' game, maybe you could join me crew!
pairs.text: 打得漂亮！要是你什么时候决定不再玩战斗游戏了，也许可以加入我的队伍！
让他们见识下我们的厉害！……嗝儿！

pairs.source: Not so fast, matey. Yer on my turf!
pairs.text: 没这么快，伙计。这是我的地盘！

pairs.source: Keep on 'em, mateys. We've got 'em on the run!
pairs.text: 再接再厉，伙计们。他们四散奔逃了！

pairs.source: All hands on deck! We're losin' men fast!
pairs.text: 全员都到甲板上集合！我们正迅速损兵折将！
你会像虫子一样被我碾死！

pairs.source: Me become powerful tamer, then me become da Gordok King!
pairs.text: 我先成为强大的驯宠师，然后就会成为戈多克大王！

pairs.source: You no ogre! How you win?
pairs.text: 你不是食人魔！怎么会赢？
谁也别想跟格鲁克捣乱！

pairs.source: Stupid tiny thing kill my tiny thing. RAAAAAAAAR!
pairs.text: 愚蠢的小东西杀死了我的小东西。啊啊！

pairs.source: You ready to go or what?
I don't have all day, pal!
Fight's over, hot stuff. Better luck next time.
pairs.text: 战斗结束了，宝贝儿。祝你下次好运。

pairs.source: Wait until the guys back in Everlook hear about this!
pairs.text: 一直等到永望镇的同伴们听见这个消息！
对菜鸟来说……你可真不赖。

pairs.source: Yeah, yeah, you won. Big deal.
pairs.text: 是的，是的，你赢了。真了不起。

pairs.source: Any tamer worth their weight in gold comes prepared!
pairs.text: 任何身价不菲的驯宠师都会有备而来！

pairs.source: Don't worry, I'm sure the next one will do great!
pairs.text: 别担心，我相信下一个会做得更好！

pairs.source: You will find no solace here.
pairs.text: 你在这里不会找到丝毫慰藉。

pairs.source: The damned demonstrate their superiority once more.
pairs.text: 那些该死的家伙再一次展示了自己的优越性。

pairs.source: The dead shall have their day yet.
Not to worry. I'm far from finished with you.
Do you honestly think death can stop me? I am death itself!
pairs.text: 你真以为死亡能阻止得了我吗？我就是死亡的化身！

pairs.source: Come, and face the impeccable tactics of a blood knight!
pairs.text: 来吧，面对血骑士的完美战术吧！

pairs.source: None can withstand the onslaught of a blood knight.
pairs.text: 没人能抵挡血骑士的猛攻。

pairs.source: Clearly a different approach is required.
A true fighter never enters a battle unprepared.
pairs.text: 真正的斗士决不会鲁莽应战。

pairs.source: The balance swings in your favor, tamer.
pairs.text: 胜利的天平倾向了你那一边，驯宠师。

pairs.source: By the Light, I will defeat you!
It was an honor fighting you.
pairs.text: 与你交战，令我倍感荣幸。

pairs.source: The other tamers were right about you.
pairs.text: 其他驯宠师对你的评价真是精确。

pairs.source: My victory is close at hand.
For the glory of the Alliance!
We will fight to the last!
pairs.text: 我们会战斗到最后一刻！
希望这是一场光荣的战斗。

pairs.source: May your pets be ready for this battle.
pairs.text: 愿你的宠物已经做好了战斗的准备。

pairs.source: Thank you for the opportunity to demonstrate my skills.
pairs.text: 感谢你为我提供了展示技能的机会。
又有一只宠物加入了战斗。

pairs.source: I will not let you defeat me.
The battle sways in my favor.
Victory may be mine this day.

pairs.text: 我会为你的失败而哀悼。

pairs.source: Don't do that! That makes me lose!
You think you stand a chance? I think not!
pairs.text: 你以为自己有机会？我可不这么想！

pairs.source: You're going to wish you never fought me, I promise!
pairs.text: 你一定会后悔与我交手的，我保证！

pairs.source: Were my pets too much for you to handle, tamer?
pairs.text: 我的宠物是不是太难对付了，驯宠师？

pairs.source: A diligent farmer never loses hope when her crop's in danger.
pairs.text: 当庄稼陷入危险时，勤恳的农夫从不会放弃希望。

pairs.source: Nice try, but you're going to need more than that!
pairs.text: 干得不错，可那还远远不够！

pairs.source: What's the problem, can't handle a simple farmer's pets?
pairs.text: 出什么问题了，连个淳朴农夫的宠物都解决不了吗？

pairs.source: You're going to have to do better than that to beat me.
pairs.text: 你得再加把劲才能打败我。

pairs.source: You're really playing to win, huh?
pairs.text: 你真是志在必得啊，对吧？

pairs.source: Prepare yourself, tamer. I come for victory.
pairs.text: 做好准备，驯宠师。我是为胜利而来。

pairs.source: You do not intimidate me, tamer.
Come back when you're better prepared.
pairs.text: 等你准备充分再回来吧。

pairs.source: Perhaps you will have better luck in our next encounter.
pairs.text: 也许我们下一次交手时，你会交好运。

pairs.source: You fight with the grace of a master tamer. Well done.
pairs.text: 你的一招一式犹如大师级驯宠师。干得好。

pairs.source: I will not allow you the pleasure.
You will not defeat me so easily.
To defeat an opponent in battle is to validate your strategy.
pairs.text: 在战斗中击败对手，是对战术最好的检验。

pairs.source: It seems my strategy is superior.
pairs.text: 看来我的战略无人能及。

pairs.source: Do not be afraid to lose one battle if the war is won.
pairs.text: 如果胜局已定，就不必惧怕区区一场战斗的失败。

pairs.source: I see. You are more formidable than I had thought.
pairs.text: 我明白了。你我想象中要强大得多。

pairs.source: I've endured horrors you cannot possibly comprehend. Defeating you will be simple.
pairs.text: 我经历过你们无法想象的恐惧。击败你们就是小菜一碟。

pairs.source: I did not doubt my victory for a moment.
pairs.text: 我片刻也没怀疑过自己的胜利。

pairs.source: I will not stand for this!

pairs.text: 我严重低估了你的实力。

pairs.source: You will have to try harder than that to defeat me.
pairs.text: 你得再加把劲，才能击败我。

pairs.source: You do not stand a chance. I will defeat you!
pairs.text: 你半点机会都没有。我会打败你！

pairs.source: You are no match for me.
No more playing around. I will crush you!

pairs.text: 你的胜利到此为止，驯宠师。

pairs.source: Few are able to keep their balance in battle against me. Let us see if you are any different.
pairs.text: 很少有人能在与我交战时维持平衡。让我们瞧瞧你是否与众不同。

pairs.source: As I expected. You are not yet skilled enough to defeat me.
pairs.text: 如我所料。你还没本事打败我。

pairs.source: Do not fret. You are one of many I've defeated.
pairs.text: 别担心。你只是我的手下败将之一。

pairs.source: What a wonderful display of technique!

pairs.text: 你的胜利受之无愧，驯宠师。

pairs.source: You may flee the battle if you so wish.
pairs.text: 要是你这么想逃跑，那就请便。

pairs.source: Perhaps you do stand a chance against me.
Well done. But do you have the determination to carry through?
pairs.text: 干得好。可你有决心继续下去吗？

pairs.source: So we finally meet to do battle.
pairs.text: 我们终于要面对面交手了。

pairs.source: I already know of my coming victory.
pairs.text: 我已经预见到了自己的胜利。

pairs.source: Caught like a fish out of water!

pairs.text: 你真是位了不起的驯宠师！

pairs.source: You cannot defeat me with such brute force.
pairs.text: 光靠蛮力可击败不了我。

pairs.source: We will overwhelm you before you can react.
pairs.text: 我们会在你做出反应前将你粉碎。

pairs.source: My pets claim yet another victim.
pairs.text: 我的宠物们又夺取了一条性命。

pairs.source: There are plenty more where that came from!
The true master has emerged victorious.
All a part of my plan.
pairs.text: 一切都在我的计划之内。

pairs.source: I have lost to your mastery.
pairs.text: 我已经败给了你的战技。

pairs.source: I do not understand. How could I lose?
pairs.text: 我想不明白。我怎么会输？

pairs.source: Rest, so that the battle may continue to flow in our favor.
pairs.text: 休息一下，好让战局继续朝有利于我们的方向发展。

pairs.source: You cannot defeat the shifting sands of this land.
pairs.text: 你无法击败这片土地上的流沙。

pairs.source: Another death hidden under the desert sand.
pairs.text: 被黄沙掩埋的又一具枯骨。

pairs.source: The battle shifts in my favor once more.
pairs.text: 胜利的天平再一次倾向了我。

pairs.source: Perhaps this battle will not be as easy as I thought...
pairs.text: 也许这场战斗并不像我想的那么容易……

pairs.source: Go Emeralda! Show them the folly of their ways!
pairs.text: 去吧，艾美拉达！让他们明白自己的愚蠢！

pairs.source: Spike, show dem what you can do!
pairs.text: 长钉，让他们瞧瞧你的厉害！
石皮，让他们瞧瞧你的力量！

pairs.source: Willow, it's your turn to soar!

pairs.text: 来吧烈焰，让我们烧焦他们！
面对奥卓姆斯的愤怒吧！

pairs.source: Perhaps Subject 142 will be more successful than Subject 141.
pairs.text: 也许142号要比141号成功得多。

pairs.source: Plaguebringer, show them the power of the plague!
pairs.text: 瘟疫使者，让他们见识下瘟疫的力量！
面对欧比斯东的怒火吧！

pairs.source: Ignious, burn 'em up for me, won't you?
pairs.text: 伊格尼斯，替我烧死他们，没问题吧？

pairs.source: Stompy, show this tamer what you can do!
pairs.text: 斯多皮，让这位驯宠师看看你的本事！

pairs.source: Chomps, it is your turn to demonstrate your power.
pairs.text: 嚼嚼，该你展示自己的力量了。

pairs.source: Arcanus, show them our endless power!
pairs.text: 阿卡努斯，让他们见识下我们无尽的力量！

pairs.source: Stitch, would you please show our upcoming tamer how we like to battle?
pairs.text: 斯蒂奇，你愿不愿意让我们这位准驯宠师瞧瞧，我们是如何战斗的？
撕肉者现在要将你杀死。

pairs.source: Grizzle, the pride of Ironforge, come onto the field!
pairs.text: 灰毛，铁炉堡的骄傲，前来应战吧！

pairs.source: Dor the Wall, please join us on the battlefield.
pairs.text: 铁壁龟，请来战场上加入我们。
咩咩，来面对这位敌人吧。

pairs.source: Leave no trace of them, Amythel. Destroy them!
pairs.text: 让他们灰飞烟灭，阿米瑟尔。消灭他们！

pairs.source: You stand no chance against the might of Pyth.
pairs.text: 你在匹兹的力量面前毫无机会。

pairs.source: Skimmer, old friend, it is your turn to battle.
pairs.text: 掠影者，我的老朋友，该你出战了。

pairs.source: Please enjoy the rest of your time at the Faire. Or did you want another round...?
pairs.text: 祝你在马戏团玩得愉快。或者你还想再来一局……？

pairs.source: They ARE the Faire's finest, after all.
pairs.text: 它们毕竟是马戏团的精英嘛。

pairs.source: Alrighty! I think we are going to need to call in some air support for this one.
pairs.text: 好吧！看来我们得呼叫空中支援了。

pairs.source: Demolishers? Nothing a little gnomish enginuity can't overcome. Send in the copters!
pairs.text: 歼灭者？没有侏儒技术搞不定的东西。呼叫直升机！

pairs.source: Hmm. These Demolishers seem to have a serious weakness to rockets. Send in the copters!
pairs.text: 唔。这些歼灭者在火箭弹面前有着致命的弱点。呼叫直升机！

pairs.source: Orcs are dangerous but mounted orcs are more so. Release the hounds!
pairs.text: 兽人很危险，而上了坐骑的兽人更危险。放狗！

pairs.source: Wolves in captivity? We should "rescue" these poor animals.
pairs.text: 被囚禁的狼？我们要“解救”这些可怜的动物。

pairs.source: You know, I have often thought of making a mechano-pup. We should study these wolves more closely.
pairs.text: 你瞧，我一直想造一条机械狗。我们应该好好研究下这些狼。

pairs.source: Ah! This will give me a chance to test out my Tunnel-Tron Mk V! Hold on tight!
pairs.text: 啊！我正好可以趁机测试一下我的Mk V型掘地机器人！抓紧了！

pairs.source: Time to get you inside the fortress. Hold on tight!
pairs.text: 该把你送进要塞去了。抓紧了！

pairs.source: Time to test my new "Fly-Diggy Wing" upgrade! Hang on!
pairs.text: 该测试一下我最新的“飞速掘地翼”升级版了！抓紧！

pairs.source: Hmm. Telemetry seems to be off.
pairs.text: 唔。遥测功能好像关闭了。
提醒自己：造一个示波器。

pairs.source: Was that a wall? That sounded like a wall.
pairs.text: 那是不是一堵墙？听上去像。

pairs.source: This would be a lot easier if I could see.
Goblin bombs. They have one major weakness: Other Bombs. I'll be right back.
pairs.text: 地精炸弹。它们有一个最大的弱点：其他炸弹。我稍后回来。

pairs.source: More Goblin Bombs? It seems like only yesturday I was getting rid of a pile of goblin bombs. Wait here a moment.
pairs.text: 又是地精炸弹？我昨天好像才搞定一堆地精炸弹。在这儿等我一会儿。

pairs.source: Goblins sure do love their bombs. Let's go ahead and show them how a gnome makes a bomb. I'll be right back.
pairs.text: 地精显然很爱炸弹。我们继续前进，让他们看看侏儒是怎么造炸弹的吧。我稍后回来。

pairs.source: ... I've seen the fear in your eyes, Jubeka.
pairs.text: …… 我在你眼里看到了恐惧，裘碧卡。

pairs.source: What is it you wished to show me...?
Gul'dan destroyed this world in his bid for power... you're concerned I will do the same to Azeroth.
pairs.text: 古尔丹为了追求力量毁了这个世界……你担心我会对艾泽拉斯做出同样的事情。

pairs.source: What...? No! I.. I have... no idea...
No! Stay back...! You... you're dangerous. I remain content summoning demons, but you...
pairs.text: 不！别过来……！你……你太危险了。我只要召唤召唤恶魔就满足了，可你……

pairs.source: There are two sides to the blade of demonology...
pairs.text: 恶魔学识就是一把双刃剑……

pairs.source: ... the threats that besiege us from the outside...
pairs.text: …… 我们既要面对外部威胁……

pairs.source: ... and those that threaten us from within.
I chose you as my companion for a reason.
pairs.text: 我选你做我的同伴并非无的放矢。

pairs.source: ... If I fail, I need you to banish me forever.
pairs.text: …… 一旦我失败了，我要你把我永远放逐。

pairs.source: And what depraved reason is that...?
pairs.text: 你究竟有什么邪恶的目的……？

pairs.source: I tire of your evasive babble, doomguard. Explain to me why you and your kind are drawn to sacrificial magics.
pairs.text: 我厌倦了你的喋喋不休，末日守卫。告诉我你和你的同类为何如此执迷于献祭法术。

pairs.source: My contract is to fight for you, not to reveal the Legion's secrets, mortal.
pairs.text: 我的契约只让我为你而战，而非向你透漏军团的秘密，凡人。

pairs.source: Do not attempt to deceive me, demon!
Your kind far predates Sargeras's betrayal. What WERE you?
pairs.text: 早在萨格拉斯背叛之前你们就已经存在了。你们究竟是什么？

pairs.source: This knowledge is useless... what are you trying to achieve, Kanrethad?
pairs.text: 这种知识毫无用处……你究竟想要什么，坎雷萨德？

pairs.source: STAY OUT OF THIS! The demon will answer, NOW!
pairs.text: 这不关你的事！这个恶魔必须回答我，马上！

pairs.source: What an odd demand. Not even my own kind care about our origins. Why should you?
pairs.text: 多么奇怪的要求。即使是我的同类都很少关心我们的起源。你为什么想知道？

pairs.source: If you do not care then there is no harm telling me.
pairs.text: 既然你不关心，那告诉我又有什么关系？

pairs.source: ... before Sargeras freed us, we were the Titan's hounds. Forever enslaved to police the use of arcane magics.
pairs.text: ……在萨格拉斯释放我们之前，我们只是泰坦的走狗，被永远奴役着，监督奥术能量的使用。

pairs.source: Sacrificial magic was considered the greatest violation of life and we were attuned to instantly punish those who delved into such... delicious sorcery.
pairs.text: 献祭法术在当时被视作是对生命最严重的亵渎，任何想要深入研究这种……美妙的法术的生物，都会立即受到惩罚。

pairs.source: You have your petty secret, Kanrethad. Now, I demand knowledge from you... why do you care?
pairs.text: 你也有你的小秘密，坎雷萨德。现在，我必须要问你……你为什么在意这些？

pairs.source: I don't believe that is part of our contract. We are done here.
pairs.text: 我想我们的契约里不包括这个。到此为止吧。

pairs.source: Such strange creatures. Why do they remain so long after the Legion has left?
pairs.text: 多么奇怪的生物。燃烧军团都离开了，它们为什么还一直留在这里？

pairs.source: ...there's a slight flaw in that supposition.
The observers were in the service of Illidan... not the Legion.
pairs.text: 眼魔曾是伊利丹的仆从……而非燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Well, he's gone too... so why are they still around?
pairs.text: 好吧，可他也死了……它们为什么还留在这里？

pairs.source: Well, I've spent weeks trying to understand how to summon one of these things. If you know something I don't, I'd appreciate it if you'd share it with us "lesser" mortals.
pairs.text: 好吧，我花了几个星期的时间，想要弄明白怎么召唤这些家伙。如果你知道什么诀窍又愿意跟我们这些“下等”凡人分享的话，我会十分感激的。

pairs.source: What's the problem? You handled the binding of the fel imps and voidlords effortlessly.
pairs.text: 怎么了？你束缚邪能小鬼和空灵领主时可是游刃有余啊。

pairs.source: They were trivial by comparison! These things are never in the same place.
pairs.text: 相比之下，它们根本不算什么！它们根本就不是一个档次的。

pairs.source: There's something... strange about them... something out of place...
pairs.text: 它们有点……奇怪……有些不对劲……

pairs.source: Champion, may I have a word with you? In private... ?
pairs.text: 这位勇士，我能和你…… 私下谈谈吗？

pairs.source: You are a hero of the Horde. Your deeds in Northrend and during the Cataclysm are the stuff of legend. For this reason, I trust in your discretion.
pairs.text: 你是部落的英雄。你在诺森德和大灾变中的事迹堪称传奇。因此，我相信你的判断力。

pairs.source: I am a ranger, not a politician. But like it or not, the mantle of leadership has fallen on my shoulders.
pairs.text: 我是个游侠，而非政客。可无论如何，领袖的重担已落在我的肩头。

pairs.source: My people, who have suffered through so many challenges and betrayals, look to me to secure their future.
pairs.text: 我的人民，经历了太多的挑战与背叛，希望我能保证他们的未来。

pairs.source: We Sin'dorei were driven to the Horde by the bigotry and distrust of the Alliance.
pairs.text: 我们辛多雷是被联盟的偏见与猜忌逼入部落的。

pairs.source: Now, I look at our Warchief, and I begin to see the very same racism. He is willing to throw away our lives for his agenda.
pairs.text: 而现在，我在部落的酋长身上，看到了同样的歧视。他随意将我们当做炮灰。

pairs.source: Know this: I won't stand idle if the Horde interests conflict with those of my people. I may reconsider old Alliances.
pairs.text: 记住：我不会坐视部落与血精灵之间的利益冲突。我或许会重新考虑与联盟的关系。

pairs.source: Keep your eyes open, champion. We are all in this together... for now.
pairs.text: 睁大眼睛，勇士。我们是同一阵线的……目前是。

pairs.source: My father isn't asking you to pledge the Kirin-Tor to the Alliance-
pairs.text: 我父亲并不是要求你带领肯瑞托加入联盟——

pairs.source: Anduin, I know exactly what he's asking. Oh - look who's arrived.
pairs.text: 安度因，我知道他想要什么。噢，看看谁来了。

pairs.source: Nobody dislikes Garrosh more than me. I wrestle with my anger every day.
pairs.text: 没人比我更恨加尔鲁什。愤怒每天都折磨着我。

pairs.source: Come with me - look around you a moment.
In the aftermath of Theramore, my first instinct was to decimate Orgrimmar - to kill every man woman and child in the city.
pairs.text: 塞拉摩陷落以后，我的第一反应就是要血洗奥格瑞玛——把城里的男女老幼全都杀光。

pairs.source: I'm not proud.  Since then, Kalecgos and I have talked at length about power, and how it should be used.
pairs.text: 我很惭愧。后来，我和卡雷苟斯就力量的使用进行了一次长谈。

pairs.source: The Kirin-Tor has a legacy of abuse. Kel'thuzad turned his knowledge of the arcane arts toward Necromancy.
pairs.text: 肯瑞托向来不乏滥用力量之徒。克尔苏加德把魔法知识用在了死灵法术上。

pairs.source: Kael'thas Sunstrider was also a student here, another of our fold who betrayed us.
pairs.text: 另一个背叛我们的人，凯尔萨斯·逐日者也曾在这里学习。

pairs.source: Anduin, you know more than anyone, it's important to separate the Horde from its people.
pairs.text: 安度因，你比别人更清楚，应该将部落及其人民区别开来。

pairs.source: Every day I ask myself: "What's the right thing to do?"
pairs.text: 我每天都自问：“什么才是对的？”

pairs.source: The Sunreavers still operate within this city. Alliance and Horde work together.
pairs.text: 夺日者也在这里活动。联盟和部落相互合作。

pairs.source: As long as we stay above the war, then there's hope for the world as a whole.
pairs.text: 如果我们穷兵黩武，整个世界的希望就将破灭。

pairs.source: I see our city as a beacon of light, showing the way.
pairs.text: 我将这座城市视为一盏指路的明灯。

pairs.source: If we can trust one another here, then there's hope for the rest of the world.
pairs.text: 只有对彼此充满信任，这份希望才能留存。

pairs.source: I see our city as a beacon of light, showing the way.
pairs.text: 我将这座城市视为一盏指路的明灯。

pairs.source: If we can trust one another here, then there's hope for the rest of the world.
pairs.text: 只有对彼此充满信任，这份希望才能留存。

pairs.source: I understand. I'll talk to my father.
pairs.text: 我明白。我会跟父亲谈的。

pairs.source: For years it has languished, slowly growing in strength...
pairs.text: 多年来，它饱受煎熬，慢慢积蓄力量。

pairs.source: This... is amazing... an untapped store of raw arcane energy.
pairs.text: 这……太神奇了……一种未被开发原始奥术能量。

pairs.source: Imagine what we could summon with just a fraction of this power!
pairs.text: 想想吧，只要有一小部分这种力量，我们能召唤出什么样的恶魔来啊！

pairs.source: Summon... ha, imagine what we could become if fused with power of this magnitude...
pairs.text: 召唤……呵呵，应该想象一下有了这样的力量，我们能够变成什么……

pairs.source: The powers of this room are not unlike the original Well of Eternity in Azeroth.
pairs.text: 这股力量和艾泽拉斯永恒之井最初的那股力量并无二致。

pairs.source: So this is how Illidan bound so many demons to his will...
pairs.text: 所以，伊利丹就是靠这种办法役使了大量的恶魔……

pairs.source: Yes. The payment for the demons' service was to drink from the energy of this place.
pairs.text: 是的。作为酬劳，这些恶魔能够啜饮这个地方的能量。

pairs.source: By feeding upon this place's power, they were broken free from their addiction to the Legion's magic.
pairs.text: 在这股能量的滋养下，它们能够摆脱对燃烧军团魔法的依赖。

pairs.source: I believe this is the original power source he intended to offer the blood elves to free them from their addiction to the Sunwell... but for some reason he didn't let them near it...
pairs.text: 依我所见，他之所以追寻这股原始能量，是想要利用它来帮助血精灵们摆脱对太阳井的依赖……但由于某些原因，他没有让血精灵接触它……

pairs.source: What?? You have no proof of such a claim.
pairs.text: 什么？？你这种说法毫无根据。

pairs.source: Didn't you notice? The demons under Illidan's command were free of the entropic, fel-green corruption that pervades the Legion.
pairs.text: 你难道没有发现吗？伊利丹手下的恶魔并不像燃烧军团那样被熵化，被绿色的魔能腐蚀。

pairs.source: ... why do you talk so much, Kanrethad?
pairs.text: ……你为什么要说这么多，坎雷萨德？

pairs.source: I was there... at the end...
pairs.text: 在那时……我亲眼目睹了这一切……

pairs.source: ... oh dear, are you going to regale me with yet another of your horrible stories?
pairs.text: ……噢，拜托，你该不是又要跟我讲你那些恐怖故事了吧？

pairs.source: I think I liked you better when your jaw was missing.
pairs.text: 我想我更喜欢变成哑巴的你。

pairs.source: Did you hear that?! Those Ashtongue dogs are coming. Let's hurry up and start the ritual!
pairs.text: 你听到了吗？！那些灰舌恶狗要过来了。我们快点开始仪式吧！

pairs.source: Very well. We'll return later after the crystal is fully charged.
pairs.text: 很好。等水晶完全充能完毕，我们再回来。

pairs.source: Your interference has cost me a great warrior, young prince. You'll pay with your life.
pairs.text: 你害我损失了一个好战士，小王子。你将为此付出代价。

pairs.source: That is where you are wrong, Garrosh.

The mogu made the Divine Bell to create chaos, but the pandaren created a special mallet to turn the echoes of that chaos into perfect harmony. That mallet was hidden for thousands of years, until now.
pairs.text: 魔古族用圣钟制造混乱，而熊猫人制作了一个特殊的钟杵，能化混乱为祥和。它被埋藏了数千年，直到今天。

pairs.source: I will not let you do this, Garrosh.
Jaina! What's happening in Dalaran? Has there been an attack?
pairs.text: 吉安娜！达拉然出什么事了？被袭击了吗？

pairs.source: The Kirin Tor was betrayed from within. I've handled the situation.
pairs.text: 肯瑞托内部出了叛徒。我已经控制了局势。

pairs.source: I've purged the Horde from Dalaran. You have what you wanted, Your Majesty: The Kirin Tor belongs to the Alliance.
pairs.text: 我将部落逐出了达拉然。你的目的达到了，陛下：肯瑞托将属于联盟。

pairs.source: I know what I said. My trust was misplaced.
pairs.text: 我记得我说的话。可我信错了人。

pairs.source: What of the Sin'dorei - the Sunreavers?
Those that surrendered are being taken to the Violet Hold. I make no guarantees about those who chose to fight.
pairs.text: 投降的人将被送去紫罗兰监狱。而选择对抗的人，我不保证他们的性命。

pairs.source: Jaina, you need to talk to me before you act-
pairs.text: 你在行动前应该和我谈谈——

pairs.source: How I run the Kirin Tor is my business.
pairs.text: 怎么管理肯瑞托是我的事。

pairs.source: I was trying to negotiate with the Sin'dorei. I was opening discussions to bring them into the Alliance! By attacking their people, you've forced their hand-
pairs.text: 我一直在与辛多雷谈判。我们正在商讨辛多雷重返联盟的可能性！你在这种时候攻击他们的人，这只会——

pairs.source: You've driven them back to the Horde.
pairs.text: 你把他们又推向了部落。

pairs.source: You're fooling yourself. Once Horde, always Horde. I see that now. I'm mobilizing the Kirin Tor.
pairs.text: 这是自欺欺人。一入部落，再难回头。我现在明白了。我正在动员肯瑞托。

pairs.source: Jaina. We've got to work together on this. The Alliance must act as one.
pairs.text: 吉安娜。我们得合作。联盟必须团结一致。

pairs.source: Don't get soft on me, Varian.
Garrosh attacked my son...? Where is he?
pairs.text: 加尔鲁什袭击了我的儿子……？他人呢？

pairs.source: Anduin, what were you thinking? I should've sent you back to Stormwind!
pairs.text: 安度因，你到底在想什么？我真该把你送回暴风城！

pairs.source: He's alive, but his bones are shattered.
pairs.text: 他还活着，可全身的骨头都碎了。

pairs.source: Send for Velen. Bring him here at once!
Thanks to this hero, a few of us made it out of there. Many more have been sent to the Violet Hold.
pairs.text: 多亏这位英雄，我们逃了出来。还有许多人被送去了紫罗兰监狱。

pairs.source: Anar'alash denal! Will someone tell me WHAT is going on in Dalaran?
pairs.text: Anar’alash denal！谁来告诉我达拉然怎么了？

pairs.source: Proudmoore! She's gone and expelled the Sunreavers from the city. She's purging the Horde from the Kirin Tor!
pairs.text: 普罗德摩尔！她将夺日者逐出了城市。她要将部落赶出肯瑞托！

pairs.source: She's gone too far. I'm certain the Alliance can move their war mages through the city at will. That human ... witch!
pairs.text: 她太过分了。联盟的战斗法师肯定横行达拉然了。那个人类……巫婆！

pairs.source: When will they learn? When will they see that the Horde exists BECAUSE of the Alliance? Because of their prejudice and their bigotry!? They force us ever closer to Hellscream's Horde.
pairs.text: 他们何时才能明白，才能看清？正是联盟的偏见与猜忌促成了部落！？他们把我们推向了地狱咆哮的部落。

pairs.source: Hal'duron, summon the rangers. Rommath, assemble the Blood Magi, and add the Sunreavers' strength to your own.
pairs.text: 哈杜伦，召集游侠。罗曼斯，集结血法师，让夺日者也加入你们。

pairs.source: We Sin'dorei will take our future into our own hands.
pairs.text: 我们辛多雷要亲手掌握自己的未来。

pairs.source: And get this damn thing out of my sight! Hellscream bought his treasure with the blood of my people. I hope it destroys him.
pairs.text: 把这该死的玩意拿走！地狱咆哮用血精灵的鲜血换取他的宝物。真希望这钟把他毁了。

pairs.source: My Lord. YOU would make a fine Warchief.
pairs.text: 大人。你会是个好酋长的。

pairs.source: My Lord. YOU would make a fine Warchief.
pairs.text: 大人。你会是个好酋长的。

pairs.source: It may come to that. Bring me my blades. The next move is mine.
pairs.text: 或许如此。把我的剑拿来。该我行动了。

pairs.source: Yes, Warlord. The traps are set. The Divine Bell will be safe within this crypt, ready for the day that the Thunder King returns.
pairs.text: 是的，大人。陷阱已经设下。圣钟将安全地留在墓穴里，等待雷电之王的归来。

pairs.source: We have but to evacuate the workers and the rest of our warriors.
pairs.text: 我们只需撤走工人和剩余的战士即可。

pairs.source: Very well, then. May the ghosts of our brothers guard this place for all eternity.
pairs.text: 那好吧。愿兄弟们的鬼魂永远庇佑此地。

pairs.source: There is no time. The Shado-Pan trackers are too close. They cannot learn the location of the Bell.
pairs.text: 没有时间了。影踪派追过来了。不能让他们发现圣钟的下落。

pairs.source: Their sacrifice will not be in vain.
pairs.text: 他们不会就这样白白牺牲的。
你也不会白死的，阿瓦图。

pairs.source: Seeker of Chaos... Summoner of Demons... Wielder of Shadows...
pairs.text: 混沌的追随者……恶魔的召唤者……暗影的掌控者……

pairs.source: The existence of your kind has not escaped our notice, $c.
pairs.text: 你们的存在逃不出我们的注意，$c。

pairs.source: Like Illidan, you constantly struggle to bend the all consuming chaos to your will.
pairs.text: 就像伊利丹，你总是努力想要掌控那消磨心志的混沌之力。

pairs.source: You walk the line between absolute power and total corruption.
pairs.text: 你是在绝对的强权和彻底的堕落间走钢丝。

pairs.source: As Azeroth has fought the legion and survived, you have faced the darkness within yourself and controlled it.
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯击退了燃烧军团，你也战胜了你内心的黑暗并控制了它。

pairs.source: Perhaps you can succeed where Illidan failed... perhaps you can accept the disorder of this universe.
pairs.text: 或许你能做到伊利丹没能做到的事……或许你能接受这个宇宙的无序。

pairs.source: Your kind can tread where we cannot. Your kind can survive where others might perish.
pairs.text: 你们可以达到我们无法企及的领域。你们可以在九死一生的恶劣环境下顽强生存。

pairs.source: The artifact that Kanrethad attempted to create is incomplete.
pairs.text: 坎雷萨德试图制造的神器并不完整。

pairs.source: It grants the ability to perform magic on a grand scale... but they quickly lose the ability to control that power.
pairs.text: 它能赋予凡人大规模施法的能力……可他们很快就会无法控制那股力量。

pairs.source: I will unlock the crystal's power, but only you can decide how it is to be used.
pairs.text: 我可以解开水晶的力量，可只有你才能决定如何使用它。

pairs.source: A bell cast from the makers' flesh, shaped by stars' fire, and bound by the breath of darkest shadow.
pairs.text: 一口以血肉为坯，以星辰之火锻造，以大地之血熔接而成的大钟。

pairs.source: This bell, when rung, could shake the world and call to the heavens.
pairs.text: 这口钟响起时，足以震动世界，上达天听。

pairs.source: Taken to war, the bell's cacophonous tones stirred the hearts of Lei Shen's warriors.
pairs.text: 在战场上，那钟声能让雷神的战士们热血沸腾。

pairs.source: It fueled their hatred and anger, lending them strength on the field of battle.
pairs.text: 它能催化恨意和怒火，让战士们在战场上获得力量。

pairs.source: The bell's screaming voice struck fear and doubt into the hearts of the Emperor's enemies, sending them fleeing in his path.
pairs.text: 圣钟的尖啸还能在皇帝的敌人心中植入恐惧和猜忌，让他们望风而逃。

pairs.source: Awed by its power, the Thunder King described the instrument as "the voice of the gods," and named it the Divine Bell.
pairs.text: 雷电之王对它的力量敬畏不已，称它为“众神之声”，并将它命名为圣钟。

pairs.source: Eventually, the Thunder King fell, and the Bell changed hands. Many tried to use its power. Some tried to silence its sound. All failed.
pairs.text: 后来，雷电之王陨落，圣钟几易其手。许多人觊觎它的力量。也有人想让它永远沉寂。可他们都失败了。

pairs.source: Finally, the Korune spellweavers laid claim to their instrument and hid it away. Since then, the Bell has been lost to history.
pairs.text: 最终，寇茹织法者夺回了圣钟，把它藏了起来。从此，圣钟就失落在了历史的长河之中。

pairs.source: The Kirin-Tor has a legacy of abuse. Kel'thuzad turned his knowledge of the arcane arts toward Necromancy.
pairs.text: 肯瑞托向来不乏滥用力量之徒。克尔苏加德把魔法知识用在了死灵法术上。

pairs.source: Things are rarely what they seem, Tyrande. And my son tells me this is a sacred place.
pairs.text: 事情不能只看表面，泰兰德。而且我儿子说这是个圣地。

pairs.source: They're defending a fixed position. I'm not going to play their game. We'll draw them out.
pairs.text: 对方早有准备。不能被他们牵着走，得把他们引出来。

pairs.source: We have them cornered inside the temple. We should strike now!
pairs.text: 我们把他们堵在了寺院里。应该立刻进攻！

pairs.source: All the more reason to purify it.
The High King. Varian Wrynn - Leader of the Alliance.
pairs.text: 联盟的领袖——国王瓦里安·乌瑞恩。

pairs.source: Did you know, he was once a gladiator? Oh yes, I've been doing my research.
pairs.text: 你知道吗？他曾做过角斗士。没错，我调查过。

pairs.source: Suffering from amnesia, he fought for his life in Horde arenas.
pairs.text: 当时失忆的他，在部落竞技场里厮杀求生。

pairs.source: There, he earned the name "Lo'Gosh," or "Ghost Wolf."
pairs.text: 在那里，他叫“洛戈什”，外号“幽魂之狼”。

pairs.source: He IS a fighter. But... is he a leader?
pairs.text: 他战技超群。可他…能当领袖吗？

pairs.source: Think about it! His enemies took advantage of my father's Cataclysm.
pairs.text: 想想吧！他的敌人利用了我父亲引发的大灾变。

pairs.source: Horde soldiers thundered across the realm in the wake of the devastation.
pairs.text: 部落的军队在浩劫之后席卷大地。

pairs.source: Varian Wrynn didn't use the disaster to gain a military advantage.
pairs.text: 瓦里安·乌瑞恩却没有利用灾难赢得军事优势。

pairs.source: Is this because he is weak...? Or because he is principled?
pairs.text: 这是因为他软弱……？还是因为太讲原则？

pairs.source: Here's the bigger question: Can principles win a war?
pairs.text: 更大的问题是：原则能赢得战争吗？

pairs.source: Make no mistake. Pandaria will challenge your King.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚对你们的国王无疑将是个挑战。

pairs.source: Let us see what he is truly made of.
Let us see if your Alliance has what it takes to rule Azeroth.
pairs.text: 让我们看看联盟是否能够统治艾泽拉斯。

pairs.source: Garrosh Hellscream! Warchief of the Horde.
pairs.text: 加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮！部落酋长。

pairs.source: He did not always command such power.
On Draenor, he was a miserable wretch. The actions of his father hung heavy on his heart.
pairs.text: 在德拉诺，他就是个可怜虫。他父亲的过去总是纠缠着他。

pairs.source: I understand you, Garrosh. I know what it is like to bear the weight of your father's deeds.
pairs.text: 我明白，加尔鲁什。我知道背负父亲的罪孽是什么感觉。

pairs.source: A warrior like Garrosh comes to power with something to prove.
pairs.text: 让加尔鲁什这样的战士上台本身就说明了——

pairs.source: Your Horde finds itself at a turning point. This war will define you.
pairs.text: 部落正面临转折。这场战争将定义你们。

pairs.source: Is it an instrument of vengeance, hellbent to carve out a future for its people?
pairs.text: 它究竟是为了人民的未来而拼搏的复仇工具？

pairs.source: Is it a refuge for those who need shelter, a commonwealth of the downtrodden, built for mutual support?
pairs.text: 还是为了团结互助而建立起来的，庇护受压迫者的牢固同盟？

pairs.source: Or is it an alliance of convenience, a confederacy of unlikely partners free to pursue their own agendas?
pairs.text: 或者说，仅仅是一个权宜之计，由一群各怀目标的盟友临时拼凑而成？

pairs.source: This is my question to you: What is the SOUL of the Horde?
pairs.text: 所以我想问你：部落的灵魂是什么？

pairs.source: We will find the answers here in Pandaria.
pairs.text: 我们将在潘达利亚寻找答案。

pairs.source: Show me what your Horde is made of, Champion!
pairs.text: 让我看看部落的实力吧，勇士！

pairs.source: Prove to me that your Horde is worthy of ruling over Azeroth.
pairs.text: 向我证明，部落有资格统治艾泽拉斯。

pairs.source: You have proven to be an exemplary hero. A champion for your cause.
pairs.text: 你的确是一个英雄楷模。是联盟事业的勇士。

pairs.source: You have proven to be an exemplary hero. A champion for your cause.
pairs.text: 你已經證明自己是個超卓非凡的英雄。掌握命運的勇士。

pairs.source: Do you recall our earlier conversation?
pairs.text: 还记得我们之前的谈话吗？

pairs.source: We discussed the merits of your High King. I have been observing him closely.
pairs.text: 我们分析了你的国王。我一直在密切关注他。

pairs.source: It is true: he has the spirit of the wolf. And he fights like a wolf.
pairs.text: 他的确有着狼的灵魂。他能像狼一样战斗。

pairs.source: Having seen him in action, I now know what that means.
pairs.text: 看了他的作为，我明白了一件事。

pairs.source: Your King is calling his pack to him, assembling an Alliance in the truest sense of the word.
pairs.text: 你的国王召唤狼群，组成了“联盟”，赋予这个词真正的涵义。

pairs.source: His journey is long. He has only taken the first steps.
pairs.text: 他的路还很长。他刚迈出第一步。

pairs.source: But with heroes like you in his pack, there is little your Alliance cannot accomplish.
pairs.text: 然而，有你这样的英雄在，联盟就没有什么做不成的事。

pairs.source: Your dedication to your cause deserves to be rewarded.
pairs.text: 你对这份事业的贡献配得上这份奖励。

pairs.source: Like you, I continue to refine my skills here in Pandaria. I think you will appreciate the outcome.
pairs.text: 和你一样，我也在潘达利亚锻炼自己。相信结果会让你满意的。

pairs.source: Stay vigilant, hero. The return of the Thunder King is both a threat... and an opportunity!
pairs.text: 小心，英雄。雷电之王的回归既是威胁……也是机遇！

pairs.source: You have proven to be an exemplary hero. A champion for your cause.
pairs.text: 你的确是一个英雄楷模。是部落事业的勇士。

pairs.source: You have proven to be an exemplary hero. A champion for your cause.
pairs.text: 你已經證明自己是個超卓非凡的英雄。掌握命運的勇士。

pairs.source: Do you recall our earlier conversation?
pairs.text: 还记得我们之前的谈话吗？

pairs.source: We spoke of your Warchief. His inner conflicts and his outer conquests.
pairs.text: 我们谈了你的酋长。他内心的矛盾和外在的征服欲。

pairs.source: I asked you: Who is the soul of the Horde?
pairs.text: 我问过你：部落的灵魂是什么？

pairs.source: Your efforts on Pandaria's southern shores and elsewhere have given me my answer.
pairs.text: 你在潘达利亚南岸和其他地方的努力已经给了我答案。

pairs.source: YOU are the soul of the Horde.
Your actions in the coming weeks will come to define your people.
pairs.text: 你在不久的未来定义你的人民。

pairs.source: I want to make sure that you are properly equipped for the trials ahead.
pairs.text: 我想让你为未来的试炼做好准备。

pairs.source: Welcome back, hero of the Alliance! How fares the battle along the coast?
pairs.text: 欢迎回来，联盟的英雄！沿海的战斗进行得如何？

pairs.source: Have you killed him? Bloodhilt served the Horde in Southern Barrens. You've avenged a great many lives today, champion.
