pairs.text: 你杀掉他了吗？血柄曾在南贫瘠之地为部落效命。你为许多人报了仇，勇士。

pairs.source: Welcome back, champion of the Horde! How fares the battle along the coast?
pairs.text: 欢迎回来，部落的英雄！沿海的战斗进行得如何？

pairs.source: So, General Twinbraid is dead? He was a pivotal figure in the Alliance push through Southern Barrens. Impressive work.
pairs.text: 那么，双辫将军死了吗？他是联盟在南贫瘠之地行动的关键人物。你干得很好。

pairs.source: There once was a jibby nib mallet all shiny and divine.
pairs.text: 那把细细的钟杵曾经闪亮而神圣。

pairs.source: But the ookin' bell it was meant for could never be mine.
pairs.text: 但它只是用来敲钟的，我才不想要呢。

pairs.source: The mogu had stolen the bell, what is a hozen to do?
pairs.text: 可是魔古族偷走了那口钟，我一个猢狲应该怎么办？

pairs.source: Think of the horror if those dookers stole the mallet too.
pairs.text: 我想那些混蛋肯定还要偷钟杵。

pairs.source: Mogu are not bright, they fail to see things for what they are.
pairs.text: 魔古族不聪明，他们看不清事物存在的原因。

pairs.source: The Monkey King broke the mallet and sent the pieces afar.
pairs.text: 美猴王折断了钟杵，把碎片藏得远远的。

pairs.source: My Hozen took the pieces and scattered them across the lands,
pairs.text: 我的猢狲们带着这些碎片，去往大陆各地。

pairs.source: Disguised as "nifty nibs", never to fall into mogu hands.
pairs.text: 它们被伪装成“漂亮的小东西”，从未落入魔古族之手。

pairs.source: The head, the handle, these two must be made as one.
pairs.text: 只要把钟杵的头和柄合起来，它就又完整了。

pairs.source: Combined with evil's ointment, the bell's evil can be undone.
pairs.text: 再配上一点药膏，就能驱除这口钟的邪恶。

pairs.source: If "Garrosh" has the bell than there is only one thing to do,
pairs.text: 如果“加尔鲁什”拥有了这口钟，那我们只能做一件事情了。

pairs.source: I'll send for my hozen friends, the mallet must be made anew.
pairs.text: 我会召集我的猢狲朋友们，重铸这把钟杵。

pairs.source: Here goes nothing. My research did not have nice things to say about this Jade Warlord. Be ready for battle.
pairs.text: 但愿能成功。根据我的调查，这个青玉战神不是什么好东西。准备好战斗吧。

pairs.source: Let's give someone else a chance to do some damage!
pairs.text: 让我们给其他人一点机会，让他们也搞点破坏！

pairs.source: Did you really think all of your pets would survive?
pairs.text: 你真以为你所有的宠物都能活下来？

pairs.source: No!  That was my favorite pet!
pairs.text: 不！那可是我最喜爱的宠物！

pairs.source: My King, I promise you. The Kirin-Tor will come down on Garrosh so hard his ancestors will reel. Blood will pay for blood!
pairs.text: 国王，我保证。肯瑞托一定会让加尔鲁什受到最严厉的惩罚。血债必须血偿！

pairs.source: I will end Garrosh for this. His Horde already crumbles beneath him. We will deliver the final blow.
pairs.text: 我会亲自跟加尔鲁什做个了断。他的部落业已分崩离析。我们将作出致命一击。

pairs.source: Champion, you and Anduin thwarted the Warchief today and won the Alliance a critical victory.
pairs.text: 勇士，今天你和安度因挫败了部落酋长，为联盟赢得了关键的胜利。

pairs.source: But please, leave me now. I must tend to my son... and prepare for our next battle.
pairs.text: 现在请你走吧，英雄。我要照顾我儿子……并准备下一场战斗了。

pairs.source: Alright, we have the handle, the head, and the ointment like you asked for. Can you re-assemble the mallet?
pairs.text: 好了，我们现在拿到了你要的杵柄，杵头和药膏。你能帮我们将钟杵组合起来吗？

pairs.source: Ayup! Silly youngin, just put rod in hole. And the mallet shall again be whole.
pairs.text: 没错！笨小子，杵柄入杵头，钟杵重现世。

pairs.source: Good as nibby new! But listen to the Monkey King. You only have enough ointment for one true swing.
pairs.text: 就和新的一样！听好美猴王说的话。你的药膏只够敲一次钟。

pairs.source: Only one swing? Are we sure this will work? Is there any way to get more ointment?
pairs.text: 只能敲一次？一次真的就够了吗？我们有办法多找到一些药膏吗？

pairs.source: The Monkey King was there, the last time this mallet struck true. Tears came to eyes, and harmony was felt through and through. But no more ointment was ever made, for the mogu came with their raid. Use what you have, be grateful it is there. For the bell is a dangerous weapon, so handle with care.
pairs.text: 上一次钟杵敲响圣钟的时候，美猴王就在旁边。美猴王热泪盈眶，但内心无比平静。在那之后，圣钟被魔古人夺走，再也没有人做过药膏了。心存感激，你手上的药膏就是最后的药膏。圣钟是危险的武器，一定要小心处理。

pairs.source: The charges are placed. Hero - you may have the honor.
pairs.text: 起爆器到位了。英雄——这份殊荣属于你。

pairs.source: The unworthy have not yet learned of my power.
pairs.text: 那些废物还没见识过我的力量。

pairs.source: War-God Al'chukla, add my strength to your own.
pairs.text: 战神阿尔图克拉，接纳我的力量。

pairs.source: Make a demonstration of these invaders, such that all nations tremble before me.
pairs.text: 让这些入侵者看看我的厉害，让万民在我面前颤栗。

pairs.source: Shan Bu, secure the inner courtyard. None should look upon my works and live.
pairs.text: 山怖，守住内庭。绝不能让活人见到我的造物。

pairs.source: It is said the God King Rastakhan, ruler of the Zandalari, lords over his mighty kingdom from a throne carved of solid gold.
pairs.text: 据说赞达拉的统治者，神王拉斯塔哈在黄金宝座上统治着自己强大的帝国。

pairs.source: Years ago, as he sat on this opulent seat of power, he was visited by his most trusted prophet: Zul.
pairs.text: 多年前，他就在这个辉煌的宝座上，接见了黑暗先知：祖尔。

pairs.source: Zul warned King Rastakhan of a terrible Cataclysm. For Zul had seen a vision of a great armored dragon clenching the world in his ferocious jaws.
pairs.text: 祖尔向拉斯塔哈警告了可怕的大灾变。因为祖尔预见到一头装甲巨龙用可怕的巨颚撕裂了世界。

pairs.source: Months later Zul returned, bearing more grim news from his visions. He saw a legion of serpents pouring forth from a gaping fissure that tore open the floor of the ocean.
pairs.text: 几个月之后，祖尔又带回了更可怕的预言。他看见大群蛟龙从张开的裂隙中汹涌而出，撕裂了海床。
拉斯塔哈还是无动于衷。

pairs.source: Finally, mere months before the Cataclysm, Zul returned. Tearing his clothes and throwing his staff to the ground, Zul spoke of earthquakes and tidal waves.
pairs.text: 最后，在大灾变发生的几个月前，祖尔又回来了。他撕碎衣裳，扔掉法杖，预言了地震与海啸的到来。

pairs.source: He described the golden capital of Zandalar slowly sinking beneath the waves in the aftermath of the Cataclysm, its once-great people drowning as their mighty works slipped forever beneath the sea.
pairs.text: 他描述了赞达拉的黄金都城将在大灾变后慢慢沉入海底，昔日伟大的人民随着自己的杰作永远葬身海底。

pairs.source: King Rastakhan tired of Zul and his troubling nightmares. To be rid of the prophet, he granted Zul the use of his largest ships, so that he and his followers could seek a new land if his visions came to pass.
pairs.text: 拉斯塔哈厌烦了祖尔和他的噩梦。为了摆脱先知，他让祖尔乘上自己最大的船只，好让他和他的追随者在预言实现时去寻找新大陆。

pairs.source: And his visions DID come to pass.

When Deathwing rose from the Maelstrom, dark, angry waves crashed into the Zandalari capital. The spine of the land broke in two, and soon, the city and all its riches began to slide into the hungry sea.
pairs.text: 当死亡之翼冲出大漩涡，黑暗的怒涛涌入赞达拉的都城。大地之脊一分为二，很快，这座城市和它所有的财富一同沉入大海。

pairs.source: The Zandalari people turned to their King for help, but there was only one Zandalari equipped to help them: The prophet Zul. The prophet, and the mighty warfleet he had assembled while his King sat idle.
pairs.text: 赞达拉人向他们的君王求助，可只有一个人能帮他们：先知祖尔。这位先知在他的国王麻木不仁时，已经召集了一支强大的舰队。

pairs.source: You see, the TRUE power of kings and emperors stems from the power to aid their people.
pairs.text: 现在你该明白了，君王们真正的力量源于帮助自己的人民。

pairs.source: The moment they fail, they cede their power to the one who can.
pairs.text: 当他们玩忽职守时，就将权利让给了有能力的人。

pairs.source: The mogu tell a legend about Lei Shen, the Thunder King.
pairs.text: 魔古族中流传着雷电之王雷神的传说。

pairs.source: His followers fell to their knees before him. "We will call you 'The Lightning King,'" they said.
pairs.text: 他的追随者向他跪下，并说：“我们将称您为‘闪电之王’。”

pairs.source: It is said that he tore out the very heart of the mogu God. And from that hateful act he gained power over wind and storm.
pairs.text: 据说他挖出了魔古之神的心脏。这骇人听闻的暴行令野心勃勃的雷神获得了风暴的力量。

pairs.source: But Lei Shen did not agree.
"Lightning strikes in an instant and is over in a flash," he said.
pairs.text: “闪电的力量转瞬即逝，”他说道。

pairs.source: "But thunder. Thunder! Thunder proclaims the coming of the storm."
pairs.text: “可雷电。雷电！它预示着风暴的来临。”

pairs.source: "Thunder quakes the skies long before the lightning strikes, and thunder echoes in the hills long after lightning's power is spent."
pairs.text: “在闪电到来之前，雷电已经撼动苍穹；当闪电消散之后，雷电依然振动群山。”

pairs.source: "It is thunder that sends animals cowering and fills the hearts of peasants with dread. Let thunder be my herald, so that my power is felt throughout the land."
pairs.text: “是雷电令百兽瑟缩，是雷电令农夫恐惧。就让雷电成为我的先驱，让我的力量传遍大地。”

pairs.source: Oh my friend - that awful sound. For a hundred hundred generations the crash of thunder filled the hearts of pandaren with terror.
pairs.text: 噢，我的朋友——那可怕的声音。数百年来，雷电可怕的巨响一直在熊猫人心中回荡。

pairs.source: It is said that after the revolution, the Red Crane of Hope placed the rainbow in the sky, so that pandaren would know not to fear the storms any longer.
pairs.text: 据说在熊猫人发动起义之后，希望的化身朱鹤在天空挂上了彩虹，好让熊猫人不再害怕风暴。

pairs.source: I do not see any rainbows today. Do you?
pairs.text: 我今天却没看见彩虹。你呢？

pairs.source: Fathers and sons. Mothers and daughters. As parents, we pass our legacy on to our children.
pairs.text: 父传子，母教女。作为父母，我们会将自己的遗产传给孩子。

pairs.source: What values do we choose to instill in our progeny?
pairs.text: 我们该给后代灌输怎样的价值观呢？

pairs.source: What will our children learn from our mistakes?
pairs.text: 孩子会从我们的错误中学到什么？

pairs.source: What sort of world will we create and leave behind for our daughters and sons?
pairs.text: 我们该给子孙后代创造并留下一个怎样的世界？

pairs.source: Parents place their children on a path, but they do not always know where the road will take them.
pairs.text: 父母将孩子送上人生的道路，却不知道他们会走向何方。

pairs.source: The mogu were children as well. Children of the titans. They were once a legion of stone, heartless and obedient.
pairs.text: 魔古族也是孩子。泰坦的孩子。他们曾是一支岩石大军，没有思想，只懂服从。

pairs.source: By the titans' command, they fought the terrible servants of the old gods. They shaped the mountains and carved the rivers of the land.
pairs.text: 他们按泰坦的指令与古神的可怕仆从战斗。他们垒起高山，挖开河流。

pairs.source: And they created a magical cradle of life in a hidden valley that we now call the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
pairs.text: 他们在今天被我们称为锦绣谷的隐秘山谷建立了生命的魔法摇篮。

pairs.source: But eventually the titans fell silent. And their creations were cursed with flesh.
pairs.text: 可是，泰坦逐渐沉寂，他们的造物受到血肉的诅咒。

pairs.source: The mogu grew restless. Many generations later, when Thunder King united them, they seized upon their legacy!
pairs.text: 魔古族变得残暴。多年之后，雷电之王统一了他们，他们获得了自己的遗产！

pairs.source: I truly believe now that the mogu thought they were doing the work of the titans. They fought against the mantid and used the powers of the Vale to create new life.
pairs.text: 我现在真的相信魔古族以为自己在完成泰坦的工作。他们与螳螂妖斗争，并使用锦绣谷的力量创造新生命。

pairs.source: Parents cannot always be assured of the legacy they will leave behind.
pairs.text: 父母并不能确保自己总能留下好的遗产。

pairs.source: How especially true this is, when the parents are gods. And their children - monsters.
pairs.text: 尤其是，当父母本身是神，而他们的孩子却是怪物时。

pairs.source: The Thunder King! What a magnificent individual.
pairs.text: 雷电之王！多么强大的存在！

pairs.source: Could you imagine what his empire would be like today if it had not been overthrown and hidden by the pandaren?
pairs.text: 要不是被熊猫人推翻并掩盖起来，他的帝国到今天会变成什么样子呢？

pairs.source: I couldn't imagine a crueler tyrant. He enslaved this entire continent.
pairs.text: 我想不出比他更残暴的君主了。他奴役了整个大陆。

pairs.source: Benevolence is a luxury for the strong, young prince. No great empire was ever built with kindness.
pairs.text: 对强者而言，仁慈是种奢望。没有哪个伟大的帝国是靠仁慈建立的。

pairs.source: ...I'm not so sure about that. But I can tell you: no great empire has ever stood the test of time by crushing its own citizens.
pairs.text: ……我不知道。但我得说：没有哪个压榨人民的“伟大帝国”能经得起时间的考验。

pairs.source: Remember, the mogu were overthrown! THAT should be the lesson of the Thunder King. It's your move, by the way.
pairs.text: 记住，魔古族被推翻了！雷电之王应该吸取教训。现在轮到你了。

pairs.source: I worry you may be too soft to wear your kingdom's crown, Prince Anduin. You would do well to learn some of your father's hardness.
pairs.text: 我很担心你太过软弱，不足以接过那个王冠，安度因王子。你该好好学学你父亲的强硬。

pairs.source: Are you lecturing me? You're what - two years old?
pairs.text: 你是在对我说教吗？你才多大——两岁？

pairs.source: Two in DRAGON years. It is your move.
...Why did you play that piece just now?
It's a Pandaren board game. The object is for both players to win.
pairs.text: 这是一种熊猫人的棋盘游戏。目标是双赢。

pairs.source: That's ridiculous! Why would you even play!?
pairs.text: 简直荒唐！那有什么好玩的！？

pairs.source: Champion, return now to the Isle of the Thunder King. I will meet you at the forge, where together we will create an instrument of legendary power.
pairs.text: 勇士，我们现在快回雷神岛去吧。我在熔炉那里等你，我们将共同制作一件传奇武器。

pairs.source: To what end? What are you two working towards?
pairs.text: 为什么？你们俩有什么目的？

pairs.source: Using a mogu weapon forge whose powers you barely understand?
pairs.text: 就靠一座你们根本不了解的魔古武器熔炉？

pairs.source: My dear prince, you and I share the same goals. We only differ in our level of commitment.
pairs.text: 我亲爱的王子，我们的目标是一致的，只是投入程度不同。

pairs.source: Come, hero! Let us shape a new Azeroth together!
pairs.text: 来吧，英雄！我们将打造全新的艾泽拉斯！

pairs.source: Champion, I know that our people are at war, but if you blindly trust this black dragon in the pursuit of power, are you any better than your warchief? Please - just be careful.
pairs.text: 勇士，我知道我们正在交战，可如果你盲目信任这头追逐力量的黑龙，那你又能比你的酋长强多少呢？请你三思。

pairs.source: My friend, if you blindly trust a black dragon in the search for greater power, are you any better than Garrosh Hellscream? Please - just be careful.
pairs.text: 我的朋友，如果你盲目信任这头追逐力量的黑龙，那你又能比加尔鲁什强多少呢？请你三思。

pairs.source: I can't believe you're still alive.
pairs.text: 难以置信，你居然还活着。

pairs.source: Remind me to tell you the story about my friend here and what we accomplished together at Ravenholdt. Good times!
pairs.text: 记得提醒我以后告诉你我们在拉文霍德庄园的事迹。那可真是一段好时光！

pairs.source: What did I tell you? Few mortals possess such courage and tenacity.
pairs.text: 我怎么说的来着？如此勇敢而坚毅的凡人实属罕见。

pairs.source: Meet me atop Mason's Folly, where we met before!
pairs.text: 老规矩，到石匠之愚上来见我！

pairs.source: I keep no secrets! You are welcome to accompany us, Anduin Wrynn. If your injury permits.
pairs.text: 我向来坦荡！如果伤势允许，你可以一起来，安度因·乌瑞恩。

pairs.source: I implore my Horde friend here not to push you off of the cliff.
pairs.text: 但我得请求我的部落朋友别把你推下悬崖。

pairs.source: Truly a splendor! Have you ever seen such a view, Prince Anduin?
pairs.text: 真壮观！你见过这样的景色吗，安度因王子？

pairs.source: It's about to get even more awe-inspiring.
Champion! Behold the fruits of your labors!
pairs.text: 勇士！看看你的劳动成果吧！

pairs.source: At the dawn of the world, when the mortal races were young, they did not yet possess the secrets of fire.
pairs.text: 在世界破晓之初，凡人种族还很年轻，他们尚未掌握火的秘密。

pairs.source: They shivered in the cold and the rain until - in one instant - lightning tore the sky!
pairs.text: 他们在凄风冷雨中颤栗，突然——闪电撕裂了天空！

pairs.source: It rent a tree asunder and set it aflame.
pairs.text: 它劈倒了一棵树并将它点燃。

pairs.source: The mortals gathered around the fire in awe and wonder. It could cook their food and warm their homes. They seized it! And protected it!
pairs.text: 凡人敬畏而惊奇地聚拢到火堆周围，用它烹煮、取暖。他们获取了它！小心呵护！

pairs.source: They fed the fire every hour of every day. Hot coals were carried from one primitive camp to the next. Do you see? In a single flash of light, civilization was born.
pairs.text: 火焰日以继夜地燃烧。红热的炭火在营地间传递。你明白了吗？只是一道闪电，文明由此诞生。

pairs.source: Truly, lightning is a gift of the Gods.
pairs.text: 闪电无疑是诸神赐下的礼物。

pairs.source: The mogu, ah! The mogu! Their minds were so small! They were built to serve, and when they lost their masters, they served themselves.
pairs.text: 魔古族，啊！魔古族！这些蠢货天生就是下人！当失去了主人，他们就转而侍奉自己。

pairs.source: But they could have been so much more.
pairs.text: 可他们原本可以更加伟大。

pairs.source: They built an empire, when they could have built a new world.
pairs.text: 他们本可以创造新世界，然而只建立起一个帝国。

pairs.source: We will do better, champion. Behold! The Crown of Heaven! My gift to you.
pairs.text: 我们能做得更好。看！苍穹之冠！这是我的礼物。

pairs.source: You are the ember. You are the spark! You are the fire that will spread across the world. You will awaken Azeroth's potential!
pairs.text: 你就是那余烬！你就是那火星！你将成为燎原的烈焰。你将唤醒艾泽拉斯的潜力！

pairs.source: We know now that the mogu share their roots with the Titans. But many mysteries remain. Why were they here? Why Pandaria?
pairs.text: 我们已经知道魔古族源自泰坦。可还有许多谜团。他们为何来此？为何来到潘达利亚？

pairs.source: What were the mogu sent here to guard? Or destroy? We are missing the final puzzle pieces, and YOU will help me find them!
pairs.text: 魔古族被派来守护什么？或是摧毁什么？我们还缺少关键线索，你得帮我找到它！

pairs.source: The crown I have given you will be as your third eye. It will tie us together. I will see what you see. Together we will lay the secrets of the Titans bare.
pairs.text: 这顶冠冕将成为你的第三只眼。它将我们连为一体。你将成为我的耳目。我们要一起揭开泰坦之谜。

pairs.source: I will be watching you closely, hero!
pairs.text: 我会密切关注你的，英雄！

pairs.source: Champion... I would think twice before putting that thing on your head.
pairs.text: 勇士……如果我是你，一定会三思而行。

pairs.source: According to this runestone, the mogu were Titan constructs, soulless creatures built of stone. We suspected as much.
pairs.text: 根据这块符文石，魔古是泰坦创造的，没有灵魂的岩石生物。我猜也是。

pairs.source: You've found another stone! What have we learned? The "curse of flesh" made the mogu mortal. Ah - but later, they found a way to reverse the process. A clever race.
pairs.text: 你又找到一块石头！上面写了什么？“血肉诅咒”将魔古变成凡人。啊——可他们找到了逆转诅咒的方法。聪明。

pairs.source: The mogu served a Titan keeper. His name was "Ra." In the mogu tongue, "Ra-den" means "Master Ra." Fascinating! I must know more!
pairs.text: 魔古族侍奉一位名叫“莱”的泰坦守护者。在魔古语中，“莱登”即意为“主宰莱”。太神奇了！我需要更多信息！

pairs.source: According to this, the mogu and their master were sent to Pandaria. They were pursuing a great darkness - ah, the fragment is incomplete. We must find others.
pairs.text: 这里提到，魔古族和他们的主人被派来潘达利亚追踪巨大的黑暗——啊，这块碎片不完整。我们得找到剩余部分。

pairs.source: Here, there is mention of an Old God. "Y'Shaarj." A beast with seven heads, who breathed darkness. I suspect that thing was the source of the sha that haunts Pandaria to this day.
pairs.text: 这里提到了一位古神，“亚煞极”。这头野兽有七个头颅，能够吞吐黑暗。我怀疑如今困扰潘达利亚的煞魔就是这个家伙的手笔。

pairs.source: This runestone speaks of a "Cradle of Life." A place where the Titans could create new creatures. Oh - of course - the Vale of Eternal Blossoms! It was a living laboratory, much like Un'goro Crater or Sholazar Basin.
pairs.text: 这里提到了“生命的摇篮”。那是泰坦创造新物种的地方。噢，那一定是锦绣谷！它是一座生物实验室，就像安戈洛环形山或索拉查盆地。

pairs.source: We're beginning to put the pieces together, champion. The mogu were created and sent here to guard the Vale for their Titan masters. Guard it from what? Were the Old Gods still a threat?
pairs.text: 我们正在拼凑线索，勇士。魔古族是由泰坦创造并被派来守卫锦绣谷的。他们要守卫什么呢？古神是否仍是一个威胁呢？

pairs.source: Here, this fragment speaks of "The Winged Legions of Y'Shaarj." Servants of an Old God? Could this mean the mantid?
pairs.text: 嘿，这块碎片提到了“亚煞极的飞翼军团。”那是古神的仆人吗？会不会是螳螂妖呢？

pairs.source: This runestone is more recent than the others. Something about "The sleeping keeper." I think it's referring to Ra-Den. But why was he asleep?
pairs.text: 这块符文石比较新。它提到了“沉睡的守护者”。我猜这是指莱登。可他为何会沉睡呢？

pairs.source: You've found another piece of the puzzle! This was carved by the mogu. They were frustrated - a thousand years with no orders from their master, and their bodies had turned to flesh. The mogu began to argue among themselves.
pairs.text: 你又找到了这个谜题的新线索！它是魔古族所刻。他们很沮丧——主人已经一千年没有下达指令了，他们的身体也变成了血肉之躯。他们发生了内讧。

pairs.source: Hmmm. This runestone speaks of mogu savagery. They fell apart into warrior clans. But one King was more ambitious than the others - Lei Shen. The Thunder King. When the Titan Keeper fell silent, Lei Shen decided to speak for him.
pairs.text: 嗯。这里记录了魔古族早期的历史。他们分裂成数个部落。可有一位王者特别野心勃勃——雷电之王，雷神。泰坦守护者沉寂之后，雷神决心代他发号施令。

pairs.source: Ah! The final piece of the puzzle. The Thunder King took on the powers of Ra-Den, the very essence of a Titan. He united the mogu into an empire and tried to continue the Titans' work. Of course he saw himself as a God!
pairs.text: 啊！最后一块拼图也齐了。雷电之王窃取了莱登的力量，那是泰坦的精华。他统一魔古帝国，并试图继续泰坦的工作。显然他将自己看成了神！

pairs.source: Quickly, return to me at the Veiled Stair. We should talk face-to-face.
pairs.text: 快，回雾纱栈道来找我。我们得当面谈谈。

pairs.source: I have been looking forward to your return, champion.
pairs.text: 我一直在等待你的归来，勇士。

pairs.source: The Thunder King took within himself the powers of a Titan keeper. We must take them back!
pairs.text: 雷电之王窃取了泰坦守护者的力量。我们得将它夺回来！

pairs.source: Bring me his cruel, black heart. We will be doing the Pandaren a favor, and the powers that we liberate will once again be put to the service of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 将他的黑暗之核带给我。这不仅能帮熊猫人一把，解放出的力量也将再次造福艾泽拉斯。

pairs.source: A chill just went up my spine!
Something tells me our friend has returned triumphant.
pairs.text: 我猜我们的朋友已经凯旋而归了。

pairs.source: Ahhh - the heart of a King. The powers of a God.
What are you doing? You're not seriously going to eat that-
pairs.text: 你在干什么？你不会真的想吃它——

pairs.source: It is filled with Titan magic, the very language of creation...
pairs.text: 它充满了泰坦的魔力，那是创造的语言——

pairs.source: Oh - I see them - a million, million worlds - glittering in their perfection - but one above all others - oh -
pairs.text: 噢——我看见了——数百万个世界——闪烁着完美的光芒——其中一颗特别璀璨——噢——

pairs.source: WE HAVE FALLEN. WE MUST REBUILD THE FINAL TITAN. DO NOT FORGET.
pairs.text: 噢——我等已经陨落。我们必须挽救最后的泰坦。牢记这一点。

pairs.source: What are you trying to pull?
It is gone. I don't remember any of it. Oh! None of them remember. The irony!
pairs.text: 结束了。我全都忘了。噢！他们也不记得了。真讽刺！

pairs.source: What are you talking about? I don't trust you.
pairs.text: 你在说什么？我不相信你。

pairs.source: Champion, I need time to... "digest" what I have learned.  But soon, we will take action.
pairs.text: 勇士，我需要时间来……“消化”这些信息。但我们很快就会行动的。

pairs.source: Good to see you again adventurer.  Are you ready to begin?
pairs.text: 很高兴再次见到你，冒险者。你做好出发的准备了吗？

pairs.source: Thank you for your help, adventurer.  We will assist you as best we can in fending off the mogu.
pairs.text: 感谢你的帮助，冒险者。我们会尽力帮你挡住魔古族的。

pairs.source: BEHOLD! I have truly mastered the fel energies of this world! The demonic power I now command... It is indescribable, unlimited, OMNIPOTENT!
pairs.text: 看呐！我真的掌握了这个世界的魔能！现在，我掌握着恶魔之力……它难以名状，无穷无尽，无所不能！

pairs.source: You think I've gone too far? There is no such thing. The Black Harvest will enslave the most powerful demons, draw on their power, and destroy all who oppose us, in this world, and on Azeroth! Do YOU mean to stop me, little one?
pairs.text: 你觉得我走火入魔了？没有这回事。黑暗收割议会将奴役最强大的恶魔，抽取他们的力量，并摧毁一切反抗者，无论是在这个世界，还是在艾泽拉斯！你真的想阻止我吗，小家伙？
我的力量超出你的想象！

pairs.source: Hah. Your feeble attacks are entertaining. Would you like to see one of my new pets?
pairs.text: 哈。你虚弱无力的攻击简直令我发笑。想看看我的新宠物吗？

pairs.source: I'd like to see you try.
pairs.text: 我喜欢看你徒劳的挣扎。

pairs.source: The Annihilan are incredibly destructive creatures. Their sheer strength and power is absolutely unrivaled.
pairs.text: 安尼赫兰是极具毁灭性的生物。他们那排山倒海般的力量无人能挡。
什么？！这下你可惹怒我了。

pairs.source: Deathwing had unstoppable power. And now, it is MINE.
pairs.text: 死亡之翼曾拥有无可匹敌的力量。现在，它属于我了。

pairs.source: You cannot stop your final Cataclysm!
pairs.text: 你休想抗拒末日的降临！

pairs.source: This may seem meager at first, but give it a moment. Soon, the pain will be unbearable.
pairs.text: 这刚开始可能不算什么，但只要等一段时间，疼痛就会变得难以忍受。

pairs.source: The anguish will creep up on you.
pairs.text: 痛苦将悄悄降临到你身上。

pairs.source: Destructive forces corrupt you from the inside.
pairs.text: 毁灭之力将从内部侵蚀你。

pairs.source: Plant a seed and watch it grow...
pairs.text: 埋下一颗种子，然后看着它成长……

pairs.source: I wonder what this seed will grow into?
pairs.text: 我很好奇这颗种子会长成什么？

pairs.source: I give you the gift of destruction!
pairs.text: 我将赐予你毁灭的礼物！

pairs.source: Terrible destruction awaits you when this seed erupts.
pairs.text: 当这颗种子发芽时，可怕的毁灭将等着你。

pairs.source: Chaotic magic always has the potential for unexpected results.
pairs.text: 混乱魔法总是有可能导致出人意料的后果。

pairs.source: Archimonde's use of the ered'ruin was brilliant. Their command of the dark energies is unparalleled.
pairs.text: 阿克蒙德聪明地利用了埃雷杜因。他们对黑暗能量的掌控无人能及。

pairs.source: The ered'ruin have had no master since Archimonde's death. Now I shall be that master.
pairs.text: 自从阿克蒙德死后，埃雷杜因就失去了主人。现在，我将成为他们的新主人。

pairs.source: While not the most powerful combatants, a pack of felhounds still has many uses.
pairs.text: 虽然不是最强大的战士，但一群地狱犬还是很有用的。

pairs.source: The felhounds are always hungry for magic to devour.
pairs.text: 地狱犬总是渴望能吞噬更多的魔法。

pairs.source: If two imps are better than one imp, what's better than two imps? SIXTY IMPS.
pairs.text: 如果说两个小鬼就是比一个要强，那什么能比两个小鬼更强呢？那就是六个小鬼。

pairs.source: Even the smallest demon can be valuable, in large enough numbers.
pairs.text: 哪怕是最小的恶魔，只要数量够多，也是非常宝贵的助力。

pairs.source: This is only what you once asked me to do if it came to this, Kanrethad. You brought this on yourself.
pairs.text: 我只是按照你之前的要求罢了，坎雷萨德。事情发展到这一步都是你自找的。

pairs.source: $n, thank you for your help. While the world will not know, you've saved them more than they're aware. Kanrethad had to be stopped. I'll see to it that he stays banished.
pairs.text: $n，感谢你的帮助。虽然全世界或许都不会知道，但你又默默地拯救了他们一次。我们必须阻止坎雷萨德。我会确保他被放逐后无法再回来。

pairs.source: Kanrethad enveloped himself with so much fel energy that it corrupted him totally. But a small taste of his power should not be harmful. Go ahead.
pairs.text: 坎雷萨德周围的邪能太过充沛，他已经被彻底腐蚀了。但稍微尝试一下他的力量并无大碍。去吧。

pairs.source: Now go, and use what you've learned. If you ever wish to have the fel energy purged from you, or reabsorb some of Kanrethad's, talk to me. I'll be at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley, keeping him banished.
pairs.text: 去吧，好好利用你所学到的一切。如果你想净化体内的邪能，或者重新吸收坎雷萨德的力量，就跟我谈谈。我会待在影月谷的诅咒祭坛，确保他被放逐。

pairs.source: Hah ha ha... You thought you could defeat me? NOTHING can kill me now, puny mortal!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈……你以为自己能击败我？现在，没有什么能杀死我了，卑微的凡人！

pairs.source: And now, your sad tale comes to an end.
pairs.text: 现在，你的可悲传说即将落幕。

pairs.source: The Celestial Blacksmith is near death!
pairs.text: 天界工匠已经濒临死亡！

pairs.source: The Celestial Defender is near death!
pairs.text: 天界防御者已经濒临死亡！

pairs.source: Hah ha ha... You thought you could defeat me? NOTHING can kill me now, puny mortal!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈……你以为自己能击败我？现在，没有什么能杀死我了，卑微的凡人！

pairs.source: Step forward! Witness the gift of the Thunder King!
pairs.text: 站出来！见证雷电之王的恩赐吧！

pairs.source: I was chosen. My blood burns with his power!
pairs.text: 我是他的选民。我的鲜血中燃烧着他的力量！

pairs.source: Too much... the spirits cannot contain his might...
pairs.text: 太强了……万灵控制不了他的力量……

pairs.source: You will be punished! Your life a lesson in futility!
pairs.text: 你将受到严惩！你的生命将成为徒劳的教训！

pairs.source: Bar the gates. The Zandalari have failed to hold the wall.
pairs.text: 堵上大门。赞达拉守不住城墙了。

pairs.source: The wall is wired up and ready to go - the honor is all yours!
pairs.text: 炸药已经全部到位——这份殊荣属于你！

pairs.source: Bar the gates. The Zandalari have failed to hold the wall.
pairs.text: 堵上大门。赞达拉守不住城墙了。

pairs.source: The forge is safe, and we must take our leave.  Good luck on your quest, adventurer.
pairs.text: 熔炉已经安全了，我们得走了。祝你好运，冒险者。

pairs.source: No - stop. Stop this at once!

pairs.text: 是的，我们来给延极矿充能吧！
是的，我们来给延极矿充能吧！

pairs.source: Forgemaster Vul'kon equips his Staff and begins to channel the powers of lightning!
pairs.text: 掌炉者沃空装备上他的法杖并开始引导闪电之力！

pairs.source: Forgemaster Vul'kon equips his Hammer and begins to swing with great force!
pairs.text: 掌炉者沃空装备上他的战锤并开始用力挥舞！

pairs.source: Are you ready for me to start up the Thunder Forge?  Things could get a bit hairy.
pairs.text: 你做好帮我开启雷霆熔炉的准备了吗？这可能有点危险。

pairs.source: Once upon a time - moments ago, in fact - a great king sought the help from a trio of powerful dwarves: The Council of Three Hammers.
pairs.text: 从前——其实也没过多久——有位伟大的国王向三位强大的矮人，也就是三锤议会求助。

pairs.source: The king's scouts had discovered that Zandalari trolls threatened the dwarven capital.
pairs.text: 国王的密探发现，赞达拉巨魔正威胁着矮人的主城。

pairs.source: Surely, the king thought, if he helped them with their troll problem, they would give him more troops for his campaign against the Horde.
pairs.text: 国王想当然地认为，只要帮他们化解巨魔危机，他们就会派出军队帮他对抗部落。

pairs.source: But what the king did not realize is that the dwarves did not trust one another!
pairs.text: 可国王没有想到，矮人们竟然对彼此毫不信任！

pairs.source: "We cannot help you," said the Bronzebeard dwarf, "For if we turn our back on the Dark Irons, they will defeat the Wildhammer and take over Ironforge!"
pairs.text: “我们帮不了你，”铜须矮人说，“如果我们不盯紧黑铁矮人，他们就会击败蛮锤矮人并占据铁炉堡！”

pairs.source: "We cannot help you," said the Wildhammer dwarf. "For if we turn our back on the Dark Irons, they will defeat the Bronzebeard and take over Ironforge!"
pairs.text: “我们帮不了你，”蛮锤矮人说，“如果我们不盯紧黑铁矮人，他们就会击败铜须矮人并占据铁炉堡！”

pairs.source: The king was furious. "If none of you help, then Ironforge will fall under siege!"
pairs.text: 国王很生气，”如果你们都不帮忙，铁炉堡就会被攻陷！”

pairs.source: Only one dwarf offered to help the king. "We will lend you our strength," said Moira, of the Dark Iron. "We will trust our dwarven brothers, and we will show them what loyalty means!"
pairs.text: 只有一位矮人愿意帮忙：“我们愿意出力，”黑铁矮人茉艾拉说，“我们信任其他矮人兄弟，还要让他们看看什么叫忠诚！”

pairs.source: And so Moira and the High King set out into the snow to save the city, leaving the others to think about their actions.
pairs.text: 于是茉艾拉和国王深入雪山去拯救铁炉堡，留下其他人反思自己的行为。

pairs.source: What happens next? I must know!
pairs.text: 后来怎么样了？我必须知道！

pairs.source: The High King, his champions, and the Dark Iron dwarves worked together to save Ironforge.
pairs.text: 国王率领他的勇士，和黑铁矮人齐心协力拯救了铁炉堡。

pairs.source: The other dwarven leaders were ashamed of their behavior, and vowed never again to allow fear or distrust to cloud their judgment.
pairs.text: 其他矮人首领为自己的行为感到羞愧，发誓再也不让恐惧或猜忌影响自己的判断。

pairs.source: And so it was a human king who helped to unite the dwarven clans so long divided.
pairs.text: 就这样，一位人类国王将分裂已久的矮人部族团结了起来。

pairs.source: Free to trust one another, all three dwarven leaders pledged their full strength to the Alliance cause.
pairs.text: 彼此信赖的三位矮人首领承诺，要为联盟大业献出全部力量。

pairs.source: Meanwhile, in the city of Orgrimmar, Warchief Garrosh Hellscream sent goblin dig teams all across the continent of Pandaria.
pairs.text: 而此时，在奥格瑞玛，酋长加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮向潘达利亚各地派出了大量地精挖掘队。

pairs.source: He promised gold and riches to any who could discover for him the hidden secrets of this land that fill Pandaria with such a dark and powerful energy.
pairs.text: 他许诺，谁能为他解开这片土地中那股强大的黑暗力量背后的秘密，就能得到黄金和财富。

pairs.source: To my surprise, his people have found something! Right here, in the sacred vale! What will happen now?
pairs.text: 令我惊讶的是，他的人真有了发现！就在这圣谷之中！那后来呢？

pairs.source: The story is still being written...
So! Even as the Alliance binds itself ever closer together, the Horde is ripping itself apart.
pairs.text: 所以，当联盟前所未有地团结一致时，部落却正在分崩离析。

pairs.source: My friend, something is about to give. I wish I could experience the next chapter of the story, but alas, I am just the storyteller.
pairs.text: 朋友，大事将要发生。我很想亲身体验接下来的故事，但是，很可惜，我只是个说故事的人。

pairs.source: You, brave hero - you are strong enough to leap into the center of events as they transpire.
pairs.text: 而你，勇敢的英雄——你很强大，足以搅动时代的狂澜。

pairs.source: Go now! Go to Durotar! Make your mark as history unfurls around you!
pairs.text: 快去吧！去杜隆塔尔！在历史上留下你的印记！

pairs.source: Ah, here we are. Oh - oh, these old bones are tired. More than you can imagine.
pairs.text: 啊，到了。唉，我这把老骨头可累惨了，绝对超出你的想象。

pairs.source: You surprised me. I expected a hero such as yourself to balk at the task of carrying an old man up a mountain. Most are too proud.
pairs.text: 你令我吃惊。我以为你这样的英雄会对扶老人上山的任务不屑一顾。他们就是太骄傲。

pairs.source: I was going to teach you a lesson but instead, it is you who have taught me. You see, when I was young... when I was young... when I was young...
pairs.text: 我本想给你上一课，结果却是你给我上了一课。你知道，在我年轻那会儿……在我年轻那会儿……在我年轻那会儿……

pairs.source: The realm you see all around you was mine to command.
pairs.text: 你目光所及之处皆为我的领土。

pairs.source: I conquered my doubts, my fears, my anger... I buried all of it within the land.
pairs.text: 我征服了自己的疑虑、恐惧和愤怒……将它们埋入地底。

pairs.source: But I held on to one vice. The one sha I never conquered. PRIDE.
pairs.text: 但我仍有一个缺点，而且从未能征服它。那就是骄傲。

pairs.source: My pride cloaked this land in mists! I thought we were better than the rest of the world.
pairs.text: 骄傲令这片土地陷入迷雾！我们自以为比外面的世界更优越。

pairs.source: I thought we could solve our own problems. But for ten thousand years, we stagnated, our doubts and fears buried in the land, rising up to fester whenever we allowed them.
pairs.text: 我觉得我们能解决自己的问题。但一万年过去了，我们停滞不前，地下的疑虑和恐惧一有机会，就会出来作祟。

pairs.source: Pride. It is the most insidious of sha. It is good until it is bad. And then it is more dangerous than all the others combined.
pairs.text: 骄傲，它是最阴险的。所谓成也骄傲，败也骄傲，它比其他所有煞魔加起来还要危险。

pairs.source: Beware of pride! Be humble! The world is plunging into chaos. Old enemies must work together. Proud races must admit they need help.
pairs.text: 警惕骄傲，保持谦卑！世界日渐混乱，宿敌当前必须同心协力。骄傲的种族要承认自己需要帮助。

pairs.source: Things are going to get worse before they get better. Only by working together can we overcome the darkness.
pairs.text: 黎明前的天空总是格外黑暗。只有精诚团结，我们才能战胜这黑暗。

pairs.source: All that stands in our way... is pride.
pairs.text: 而最大的阻碍……就是骄傲。

pairs.source: Tauren! What have your people done? You have dredged open a scar within our sacred Vale!
pairs.text: 牛头人！你们的人都干了些什么？你们在我们神圣的山谷中挖出了一条丑陋的疤痕！

pairs.source: Lord Zhu, please understand - the orc "Warchief" who ordered the deed no longer speaks for the whole of the Horde. Many voices are rising up against him.
pairs.text: 祝掌门，请你理解——下达这个命令的兽人“酋长”已经不能再代表整个部落。许多人已经起来反对他了。

pairs.source: Your politics are no concern of mine. Your Horde has disrespected the sanctity of this place. You are no longer welcome here - leave at once!
pairs.text: 我不关心你们的内政。你们部落亵渎了这片圣地。这里不再欢迎你们了——给我立刻离开这里！

pairs.source: Give us time, Lord Zhu. Give us the opportunity to bring Hellscream to justice.
pairs.text: 请给我们一点时间，祝掌门。请给我们一个将地狱咆哮绳之以法的机会。

pairs.source: Sunwalker, I respect your people. You have aided us in our campaign against the Sha and the Thunder King. Otherwise, I would've already ordered the Shado-Pan to purge this entire shrine. But my patience is at an end. The Horde must leave.
pairs.text: 烈日行者，我很尊重你们的人民。你们在我们与煞魔和雷电之王的战役中出力甚多。否则，我已经直接命令影踪派肃清整座双月殿了。但我的耐心是有限的。部落必须离开这里。

pairs.source: Please. Give us time to make this right.
pairs.text: 拜托，请给我们一点时间来纠正错误。

pairs.source: Taran Zhu stares grimly into the distance.
pairs.text: 祝踏岚冷酷地看向远处。

pairs.source: Very well. You have until season's end. No longer.
pairs.text: 很好。你们的时间就到这一季结束前为止。不能再久了。

pairs.source: We pandaren are no strangers to dealing with tyrants. The coming battle will try your souls. May the celestials guide your actions.
pairs.text: 我们熊猫人对于推翻暴君并不陌生。即将到来的战争将考验你们的灵魂。愿至尊天神指引你们的道路。

pairs.source: Look at us three. Back to da sands of old Durotar! It be just like old times.
pairs.text: 看看我们三个。又回到了杜隆塔尔的沙滩！就像从前一样。

pairs.source: Not quite, old friend. Times have changed. The line between friend and foe is not so clear.
pairs.text: 不一样了，老朋友。时代不同了。敌友间的界限已不再清晰。

pairs.source: Dey come! Hellscream tink his own people gonna roll right over.
pairs.text: 他们来了！地狱咆哮以为他的人能横扫一切。

pairs.source: Time ta show dis Warchief da fury of da Darkspear!
pairs.text: 就让酋长看看暗矛部族的怒火吧！

pairs.source: Hold! Let dem run away. Hellscream will execute dem as cowards if they go back. Sen'jin Village is safe!
pairs.text: 住手！别追了。如果他们敢回去，地狱咆哮会把他们当作懦夫处死的。森金村安全了！

pairs.source: Regroup! We press da advantage. Before the Warchief fortifies Razor Hill, we take it for da revolution, an' close off da road to da Barrens.
pairs.text: 集合！我们得先发制人，抢在酋长增兵剃刀岭之前先占领它，并阻断通往贫瘠之地的交通！

pairs.source: Anyone who can still fight, come wit' me!
pairs.text: 还能继续战斗的人，跟我来！

pairs.source: Wait Vol'jin. Horde is spilling Horde blood. It is tearing me apart.
pairs.text: 等等，沃金。部落正在自相残杀。这简直让我崩溃。

pairs.source: I know. I trust you to lead the siege. I am needed elsewhere.
pairs.text: 我知道。你负责指挥进攻。我有其他的事要做。

pairs.source: I refuse to believe that all of my brethren support Garrosh.
pairs.text: 我不信所有的兽人都支持加尔鲁什。

pairs.source: You set one foot in Orgrimmar, Hellscream gonna bury a knife in ya neck!
pairs.text: 只要你一踏进奥格瑞玛，地狱咆哮就会割断你的脖子！

pairs.source: I am going to Orgrimmar, alone. Eitrigg, Saurfang, surely they are standing against Garrosh. I must find others.
pairs.text: 我要独自前往奥格瑞玛，伊崔格，萨鲁法尔肯定都反对加尔鲁什。我还得去找其他人。

pairs.source: I won't hear ya say such tings.
It has to be said, Vol'jin. If we do not make it through this - I want you to know. You have always been my friend. My brother.
pairs.text: 我一定要说。万一我们失败了——我希望你明白：你始终是我的朋友，我的兄弟。

pairs.source: Darkspear, with me! We ride! No sleep 'til Orgrimmar!
pairs.text: 暗矛巨魔，跟我来！日夜兼程赶往奥格瑞玛！

pairs.source: My, you are strong! When I was young, I might have doubted that we could do this. But now, I have no doubts at all.
pairs.text: 啊，你真强壮！我年轻时，准会怀疑我们能否做到。可现在我不再怀疑了。

pairs.source: Such wind! Such cold! Once, it would have filled these old bones with despair. But on this day, I am filled with hope.
pairs.text: 这风真冷啊！过去，它曾让我这把老骨头感到绝望。但是今天，我却满怀希望。

pairs.source: Heh, do not get angry with the elements. Violence is their nature. I conquered my own anger long, long ago.
pairs.text: 呵呵，别对元素发怒。狂暴是它们的天性。我早已征服了自己的愤怒。

pairs.source: Such a patient one! When I was young, I would have hated this task. Nowadays, I am filled with love.
pairs.text: 你很有耐心！年轻的时候，我最恨这种事。而现在，我感到了满满的关爱。

pairs.source: Do not fear the heights, as I did when I was young. Fear can drive us to terrible deeds. Ah, but I see that like me, you have learned the lessons of courage!
pairs.text: 别像我年轻时那样恐高。恐惧会驱使我们做出可怕的事情。啊，但我看得出来，你和我一样，都学会了勇敢！

pairs.source: Great Jade Serpent! Hear our plea.
pairs.text: 青龙！请聆听我们的祈求。

pairs.source: My champion and I seek the blessing of your wisdom.
pairs.text: 我和我的勇士希望得到智慧的祝福。

pairs.source: To do what is right, no matter the cost. That is wisdom.
pairs.text: 为了大义而不惜代价。这就是智慧。

pairs.source: When is it ever wise not to act for the greater good?
pairs.text: 面对大义而无所作为，何时成了智慧？

pairs.source: I shall tear this world apart!
pairs.text: 我要将这世界撕成碎片！

pairs.source: It is a risk I have to take. But if I am killed, please watch over Aggra and my boy.
pairs.text: 我必须这么做。但是，如果我死了，请照顾好阿格娜和我儿子。

pairs.source: Look mon, Alliance filth washed up from Theramore. Kill it!
pairs.text: 看呐，伙计，又是从塞拉摩来的联盟渣滓。干掉它！

pairs.source: The Jade Serpent is the incarnation of wisdom in Pandaria. Let's see what she has to say.
pairs.text: 青龙是潘达利亚的智慧化身。我们来看看她会怎么说吧。

pairs.source: Intruders have been spotted! Defend the Thunder Forge!
pairs.text: 发现入侵者！守住雷霆熔炉！

pairs.source: The Thunder Forge is ours!  We will defend it with our lives!
pairs.text: 雷霆熔炉是我们的！我们要用生命来捍卫它！

pairs.source: I will meet you at each of the four shrines, champion.
pairs.text: 我会在祭坛那里等你的，勇士。

pairs.source: Remember, we must visit all four, but we only need to complete ONE of the four challenges.
pairs.text: 记住，我们要拜访所有四个祭坛，但只要完成一个挑战就够了。

pairs.source: Choose the challenge most appropriate for your unique talents.
pairs.text: 所以，选择最适合你天赋的挑战吧。

pairs.source: Tell me again about the King and the Council...
pairs.text: 再跟我说说国王与议会的故事吧……

pairs.source: Tell me again about the King and the Council...
pairs.text: 再跟我说说国王与议会的故事吧……

pairs.source: Tell me again about the Warchief and the Darkness...
pairs.text: 再跟我说说酋长与黑暗的故事吧……

pairs.source: Tell me again about the Warchief and the Darkness...
pairs.text: 再跟我说说酋长与黑暗的故事吧……

pairs.source: My work is not quite finished. This cloak will grant you the power of the celestials.
pairs.text: 我还没有全部完成。这件斗篷能带给你至尊天神的力量。

pairs.source: Very soon we will be able to augment your cloak with my own formidable draconic powers.
pairs.text: 用不了多久，我们就能用我强大的巨龙之力强化你的斗篷了。

pairs.source: Continue to aid your allies in the war effort. I will contact you shortly!
pairs.text: 继续帮助你的盟友作战吧。我稍后再联络你！

pairs.source: Seer Hao Pham Roo hands you the end of his climbing rope. Tie it to the next Rope Anchor and help him up the mountain!
pairs.text: 先知昊梵舟将爬绳的一端交到你手中。将它绑在下一个绳锚上，帮助昊梵舟爬上山顶！

pairs.source: Will you help an old man retrace the steps of the last emperor?
pairs.text: 你愿意帮助一位老人重走末代皇帝之路吗？

pairs.source: I am ready to help you walk the path.
pairs.text: 我准备好了，我们出发吧。

pairs.source: I am ready to help you walk the path.
pairs.text: 我准备好了，我们出发吧。

pairs.source: Zephyr increases your movement speed - share this effect with Seer Hao Pham Roo by walking beside him.
pairs.text: 微风提高了你的移动速度——走到先知昊梵舟身边，与他分享此效果。

pairs.source: Zephyr increases your movement speed - share this effect with Seer Hao Pham Roo by walking beside him.
pairs.text: 微风提高了你的移动速度——走到先知昊梵舟身边，与他分享此效果。

pairs.source: Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 铁狼之子哈托克！我来取你的脑袋了。

pairs.source: Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 哈托克，鐵狼之子！我來取你的人頭了。

pairs.source: Hold still pup. At this range it wouldn't take much to pierce that armor.
pairs.text: 别动，小崽子。距离这么近，我们不费吹灰之力就能刺穿你的护甲。
贾纳尔，我们抓住一个杜隆坦的探子。

pairs.source: More vermin come to infest our sacred grounds.
pairs.text: 又是一条来玷污我们神圣土地的害虫。

pairs.source: Durotan must have sent $Ghim:her; for a reason.
pairs.text: 杜隆坦派$G他:她;来，肯定是有原因的。

pairs.source: Bah. Let me show you what I think of my brother's "message".
pairs.text: 呸。我就让你看看我对我哥哥这个“口信”的看法吧。

pairs.source: Hold still demon. At this range it wouldn't take much to pierce that armor.
pairs.text: 别动，恶魔。距离这么近，我们不费吹灰之力就能刺穿你的护甲。

pairs.source: Ga'nar, we caught Durotan's green orc tracker that has been tracking us.
pairs.text: 贾纳尔，我们抓住一个杜隆坦派来跟踪我们的绿皮兽人探子。

pairs.source: More corrupted filth. As if this scorpar infestation were not enough.
pairs.text: 又一个被腐蚀的渣滓。这些蝎魔已经够我们头疼的了。

pairs.source: That green skin of yours marks you as the aberration you are. You are no more orc than the filth at the bottom of this pit.
pairs.text: 你那绿皮肤已经表明你就是个怪物。你比这坑底的那些渣滓也好不到哪儿去。

pairs.source: Ga'nar's impatience could tear the Frostwolves apart. It is just like my brother to put his own needs above the clan.
pairs.text: 贾纳尔的莽撞会导致氏族分裂。他已经把个人追求置于氏族利益之上了。

pairs.source: Ga'nar! It is about time you returned. What grisly trophies are these?
pairs.text: 贾纳尔！你也该回来了。这些是什么东西？

pairs.source: I have slain the sons of the Iron Wolf. He drowns in the blood of his own.
pairs.text: 我杀了铁狼的儿子们。凶手必须血债血偿。

pairs.source: Your fool crusade left us exposed to attack. Many died.
pairs.text: 你这次愚蠢的出击让我们伤亡惨重。

pairs.source: You are no Chieftain of mine, brother. By my rights as second son, by the justice I have dealt today, I declare mak'gora.
pairs.text: 我不承认，兄弟。凭我作为次子的权利，凭我今天所伸张的正义，我要与你决斗。

pairs.source: You must not do this! You are family!
pairs.text: 你们不能这么做——你们是亲人！

pairs.source: Family looks to its own! Only I cared to avenge our father's death!
pairs.text: 家人就该互相照顾！只有我还想着为父亲报仇！

pairs.source: Vengeance neither feeds nor protects our clan. Do you not see why father chose me as his heir when our eldest brother went missing?
pairs.text: 复仇对我们氏族毫无益处。这就是父亲选我继任酋长的原因。

pairs.source: Father chose wrong. This clan needs strength!
pairs.text: 父亲选错了人。氏族需要力量。

pairs.source: Her presence defiles Frostwolf honor. The other clans will spit upon us.
pairs.text: 她的存在玷污了霜狼的荣耀。其他氏族会唾弃我们的。

pairs.source: Those who cannot stand... deserve... to... die! [PH - Targets Draka and is about to charge.]
pairs.text: 那些连站都站不起来的人……都该……去死！

pairs.source: Vengeance does not make our clan strong.
pairs.text: 复仇并不能让氏族变得强大。

pairs.source: Rise up, brother. I need you. This clan needs you.
pairs.text: 站起来，兄弟。我需要你。氏族需要你。

pairs.source: The strength that comes from protecting the ones you love.
pairs.text: 为了保护挚爱的人，我们才会迸发出无限的力量。

pairs.source: We are a family, Ga'nar. Family stands together.
pairs.text: 我们是一家人，贾纳尔。一家人就该团结一致。

pairs.source: THAT is what makes the Frostwolves strong.
pairs.text: 这才是令霜狼强大的关键。

pairs.source: Come stand with us, brother. Join your forces with us. There is much work to be done.
pairs.text: 来跟我们并肩作战吧，兄弟。让我们齐心协力。我们还有很多事要做。

pairs.source: I lost? How could this be?
Yes, brother. I would welcome you with open arms.
pairs.text: 是的，兄弟。我会张开双臂欢迎你的。

pairs.source: Still alive, pup? I guess I won't have to save you after all. Come, we should talk.
pairs.text: 还活着呢，小崽子？看来我是不用去救你了。过来，我们得谈谈。

pairs.source: I am proud, but I admit you bested me, brother. I wish to learn more of your strength. We shall rejoin you.
pairs.text: 我向来很骄傲，可我承认你击败了我，哥哥。我想学习你的力量。我们会回来的。

pairs.source: Give me money for cool things
pairs.text: 给我点钱，我给你看个好东西！

pairs.source: Your father MAY be able to identify what's left of your tiny skull.
pairs.text: 你父亲或许还能认出你的小脑瓜。

pairs.source: Brothers! Today, we do what Durotan will not!
pairs.text: 兄弟们！今天，我们做到了杜隆坦做不到的事！

pairs.source: The scorpar are at bay and our mounts are ready, old friend.
pairs.text: 蝎魔已经无路可退，而我们的坐骑也已经准备好了，老朋友。

pairs.source: Today, we take vengeance on the beast who killed Garad!
pairs.text: 今天，我们要向那个杀害加拉达的畜生复仇！

pairs.source: Forward, brothers and sisters! Cut through the camp and rally at the Savage Crag!
pairs.text: 兄弟姐妹们，前进！杀过这片营地，在蛮荒峭壁汇合！

pairs.source: Bro, my pet is going to incinerate you!
pairs.text: 老兄，让我的宠物把你烧成灰吧！

pairs.source: My menagerie will eat the flesh from your bones.
pairs.text: 我的兽群将畅享你的血肉。

pairs.source: You'll ride the loaner. Hrah hah hah!
pairs.text: 所以你得骑那头驮犬。哈哈哈！

pairs.source: You have earned a place in this raid. And since you haven't yet bonded with a frostwolf of your own...
pairs.text: 你已经在这次袭击中赢得了一席之地。鉴于你还没有属于自己的霜狼……

pairs.source: Let's see how you like the newest addition to the Warchief's arsenal... the Iron Star!
pairs.text: 这是酋长的最新武器：钢铁之星，大家喜欢吗？！

pairs.source: Oh, look. You're the ones that smashed up my Juggernaut.
pairs.text: 噢，看看谁来了。就是你们毁了我的战蝎。
阿格隆！让他们看看谁才是老大！

pairs.source: Drek'Thar! I don't know what you are doing up there but it is angering the goren to no end.
pairs.text: 德雷克塔尔！你到底干了什么，这些鬣蜥人都发疯了。

pairs.source: Be careful. This place is sacred, not safe. What I am about to do could get a lot of unwanted attention.
pairs.text: 小心点。这片土地是神圣的，可并不安全。我接下来的行动可能会引来一些不速之客。

pairs.source: Great spirits of the wind, heed my call! Share with me the source of your pain.
pairs.text: 伟大的狂风之灵，请响应我的召唤！告诉我你的苦痛源自何处。

pairs.source: I will try to use my totems to assist you if the need arises.
pairs.text: 有必要时，我会用我的图腾协助你的。

pairs.source: I came to ask the elements for aid in the coming battle.
pairs.text: 战争在即，我来向元素求助。

pairs.source: But among the burning, biting winds of the mountains I heard the cry of the fury, Exurotus.
pairs.text: 可在山间炽烈而刺骨的狂风中，我听到了霜火之怒的哭号。

pairs.source: Beaten, half consumed, and shattered by ancient magics, the fury is the prisoner of the magnaron Kron.
pairs.text: 霜火之怒被名叫克鲁恩的玛戈隆囚禁。它的力量折损大半，身躯四分五裂。

pairs.source: The fury has been fragmented, its pieces scattered on the wind or consumed by scavengers.
pairs.text: 霜火之怒已被粉碎，它的残骸散落在风中，任由食腐鸟啄食。

pairs.source: Akama! Why not raze their town? Why give them another chance?
pairs.text: 阿卡玛！为什么不捣毁他们的城镇？为什么还要给他们机会？

pairs.source: The word of an orc is garbage. They're only buying time.
pairs.text: 兽人根本不可信。他们只是在拖延时间。

pairs.source: Enough talk of battle, Hogo. Finally, Shadowmoon enjoys peace.
pairs.text: 别再谈什么战争了，霍戈。影月谷终于可以迎来和平了。

pairs.source: I hear a spirit. A powerful one! Keep those goren at bay for just a little longer.
pairs.text: 我听到了一个元素之灵的声音。它非常强大！挡住那些鬣蜥人，我还需要一点时间。

pairs.source: Buy me just a few more moments.
pairs.text: 再给我多争取一点时间。

pairs.source: Stay down, shaman. Catch your breath. This champion can forge ahead and we will catch up when you are ready.
pairs.text: 别动，萨满。喘口气吧。让这位勇士继续前进，我们等你准备好之后再追上去。

pairs.source: Spirits of the wind, lend us your speed.
pairs.text: 狂风之灵，请赐予我们风一样的速度。

pairs.source: The Thunderlord are fools for the most part, but they understand combat with giants.
pairs.text: 雷神兽人多半都没什么脑子，但他们懂得如何与巨人战斗。

pairs.source: They are also notorious for etching down their favorite tactics on armbands. I assume they are either bragging or failing to remember.
pairs.text: 众所周知，他们喜欢把自己最得意的战术刻在臂甲上。我很好奇，他们到底是为了炫耀，还是纯粹因为记不住？

pairs.source: Spirits save me but it is cold. My lungs feel like they are on fire.
pairs.text: 万灵拯救了我，可这里太冷了。我的肺里好像有火在烧。

pairs.source: There it is. The carcass. I... I don't think I can go with you in there. My arm will not stop shaking and it is as if the land itself is screaming in my mind.
pairs.text: 我们到了。就是这片废墟。我……我恐怕不能跟你一起进去了。我的手臂在止不住地颤抖，这片土地仿佛都在我的脑海中咆哮。

pairs.source: Our work is vital to the world.
Ah, of course! My old friend from the Jade Forest!
pairs.text: 啊！我来自翡翠林的老朋友！

pairs.source: Wait wait wait - let me make sure I get the story right.
pairs.text: 等等，等等——我可不能把故事搞错了。

pairs.source: Pandaren will tell this tale for generations!
pairs.text: 这个传奇将在熊猫人中代代相传！

pairs.source: An outsider, from beyond the mists!
pairs.text: 一个来自迷雾之外的陌生人！
一定要用“征服”这个词吗？

pairs.source: Mantid and mogu alike were brought low by the hero's fury.
pairs.text: 用怒火折服了螳螂妖和魔古族。

pairs.source: Their power and wisdom seized for a greater glory!
pairs.text: 凭力量和智慧攫取了更光辉的荣耀！

pairs.source: When war came to Pandaria's shores, our hero was ready.
pairs.text: 当战火降临，我们的英雄早有准备。

pairs.source: A faction standard-bearer, beloved by the people and feared by their foes.
pairs.text: 这位万众爱戴的英勇先驱，让敌人望风披靡。

pairs.source: Even the mighty Thunder King fell before our champion's might.
pairs.text: 就连雷电之王，都倒在这位勇士的脚下。

pairs.source: One by one the secrets of an ancient empire were laid bare.
pairs.text: 雷神那古老帝国的秘密也被一一破解。

pairs.source: Yes, knowledge uncovered for the benefit of the world.
pairs.text: 发现了令全世界受益的知识。

pairs.source: POWER acquired for WAR and CONQUEST!
pairs.text: 获得了战争与征服的力量！

pairs.source: Let us stop for a moment - what kind of hero are we talking about?
pairs.text: 等等，不太对劲——这是我所说的那个英雄吗？

pairs.source: An agent of destruction, forged by my will to forever change the face of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 我亲手造就的毁灭使者，他将永远改变艾泽拉斯的面貌。

pairs.source: My friend, please think carefully about the legacy you will leave behind.
pairs.text: 我的朋友，请认真考虑要为后人留下什么。

pairs.source: Behold! Latent titan power, imbued with my own draconic essence, tempered by the wisdom of the pandaren celestials.
pairs.text: 看呐！它暗藏泰坦之力，注入了我的巨龙精华，由睿智的熊猫人天神淬炼。

pairs.source: Overwhleming power. Use it to heal or destroy! To protect or annihilate!
pairs.text: 它无所不能。守护还是毁灭，尽在你的掌握！

pairs.source: Come to me, champion! Collect your well-earned reward!
pairs.text: 过来，勇士！来接受你应得的奖励吧！

pairs.source: There is only one way to find out.
pairs.text: 要想知道，只有一个办法。

pairs.source: A pandaren legend is born! Sing praises to our new hero, $n!
pairs.text: 熊猫人的传奇诞生了！赞颂我们的新英雄，$n吧！

pairs.source: Nonsense. I had that handled. Cool as a cucumber.
pairs.text: 胡扯。我已经搞定了，游刃有余。

pairs.source: I knew it. You should've stayed back at the garrison, Archmage.
pairs.text: 我就知道。你应该留在要塞里的，大法师。

pairs.source: I will crush it! (The Pale are the key.)
pairs.text: 我要碾碎它！（白鬼才是关键。）

pairs.source: Unlike you, your minions are adorable.
pairs.text: 不像你，你的宠物都很可爱。

pairs.source: I have been programmed to gloat.  Ha ha.  Ha ha.  Ha ha.
pairs.text: 我被加入了幸灾乐祸的程序。哈哈。哈哈。哈哈。

pairs.source: If I had emotions, I still wouldn't feel sad about that.
pairs.text: 如果我有感情——那我也不会为你感到难过的。

pairs.source: My olfactory sensors detect a burning odor.
pairs.text: 我的嗅觉感应器检测到一股烧焦的味道。

pairs.source: Too bad.  Now for a real pet.
pairs.text: 真糟糕。现在，来见识下真正的宠物吧。

pairs.source: An opportunity presents itself! I believe the Timeless Isle holds the key to unlocking the full potential of your cloak.
pairs.text: 大好的机会送上门来了！我敢肯定，激发你斗篷潜力的关键就在永恒岛。

pairs.source: An island, lost in time, where the sun never sets. What could it mean?
pairs.text: 一座失落在时间长河中，永不日落的海岛。这意味着什么呢？

pairs.source: ...Ours for the taking! Hero, meet me at the Timeless Isle.
pairs.text: 全是我们的！英雄，来永恒岛找我吧。

pairs.source: I should very much like to see this island for myself. Perhaps I will see you there?
pairs.text: 我很想亲眼看看这座岛。或许我们还会在那里相见？

pairs.source: You are what you drink, $n -- I hope you have been drinking something strong.
pairs.text: 你就像你喝的酒，$n——呃，但愿你喝的是烈酒吧。

pairs.source: You fought well, but your tactics are all wrong.  Have a drink and and rethink them.
pairs.text: 你打得很好，但你的战术完全错了。来喝一杯，好好想想吧。

pairs.source: Look at this, I have been beaten!  I'm going to have to brew up some ideas for next time.
pairs.text: 你看看，我可被打惨了！下次我得好好想几个计划。

pairs.source: Why did he fight?  To die, apparently.
pairs.text: 他为什么要打比赛？很显然，就是为了找死。

pairs.source: The wind blows in my favor.
Maybe, uh, maybe you're ready for a lesson in chaos?
pairs.text: 你，呃，做好学习混沌之道的准备了吗？

pairs.source: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could win, you didn't stop to think if you should.
pairs.text: 你太过执着于输赢，却没有停下来想想是否应该这么做。

pairs.source: Gee, the lack of humility before nature that's being displayed here, uh... staggers me.
pairs.text: 喔唷，你还真是不懂得敬畏自然啊，呃……我真是太吃惊了。

pairs.source: What's so great about victory? It's a violent, penetrative act that scars what it explores. What you call victory... well, nevermind.
pairs.text: 胜利好在什么地方？那是一种让人刻骨铭心的暴力行为。你所说的胜利……呃，还是算了。

pairs.source: Your pet had its shot, and nature selected it for extinction.
pairs.text: 你的宠物完全是活该，自然已经决定了它的灭绝。

pairs.source: I'm, I'm simply saying that life, uh... didn't find a way.
pairs.text: 我，我只是说生命，呃……是找不到出路的。

pairs.source: What have you got on that team of yours, King Mukla?
pairs.text: 你队伍里那是什么啊，穆克拉？

pairs.source: You now face Patience!  Wisdom!  Knowledge!  What virtues do you possess, $n?
pairs.text: 你将要面对耐心！智慧！还有知识！你又有哪些优点呢，$n？

pairs.source: Today you have lost -- but what have you learned?
pairs.text: 今天你失败了——可你从中学到了什么呢？

pairs.source: You have taught me much, $r.  It seems the master has again become the student.
pairs.text: 你教会了我很多，$r。看来老师又变成学生了。

pairs.source: The autumn leaves must fall to make room for spring blossoms.
Defeat is merely a lesson masked by disappointment.
pairs.text: 失败只是一个被失望所掩盖的教训。

pairs.source: Like the stream meeting the cliff, there is beauty in the fall, if you know where to look.
pairs.text: 如同溪流遭遇悬崖就会变成美丽的瀑布，只要你懂得该从何处着眼。

pairs.source: To die would be a wonderfully grand adventure.
pairs.text: 死亡将是一场神奇的大冒险。

pairs.source: When one virtue is lost, cling to those that remain.
pairs.text: 如果你失去了一项美德，就必须牢牢把握剩余的那些。

pairs.source: Oh, I hope you like surprises.
You're lucky it was just your pets... this time.
pairs.text: 算你走运，这次还只是你的宠物……

pairs.source: In the Celestial Tournament, either you win or you die.
pairs.text: 在天神比武大会上，向来都是你死我活的。

pairs.source: Take the right opponent out and it's all downhill from there.
Oh, was that one of your favorites?  My bad.
pairs.text: 噢，那是你最喜欢的宠物？我很抱歉。

pairs.source: This is so easy it would be boring -- if it weren't so much fun.
pairs.text: 要不是本身很有意思的话，这么轻松的战斗就会很无聊。

pairs.source: You bastard, my pet may never walk again!
pairs.text: 你这混蛋，我的宠物恐怕再也不能走路了！

pairs.source: The things we love destroy us every time, $c, remember that.
pairs.text: 我们所珍爱的东西总会毁掉我们自己，$c，记住这句话。

pairs.source: Keep killing my pets and you may find a dash of poison in your drink tonight.
pairs.text: 你要再敢伤害我的宠物，你今晚的酒杯里就会多出一滴毒药了。

pairs.source: Yer lucky Gizmo couldn't be here, but I'll still wipe the floor with ye, $c.
pairs.text: 算你走运，吉兹莫来不了了，可我照样能把你打得落花流水，$c。
这场胜利是送给你的，吉兹莫！

pairs.source: Ach, so much for being good with animals. Now how do these bandages work?
pairs.text: 哎，我指挥动物的本事也就这样了。这些绷带该怎么用？

pairs.source: Ha!  That worked better than I thought!
pairs.text: 哈！这比我想象中还要管用！

pairs.source: Oh, sorry, that fella's gunna need some tender lovin' later.
pairs.text: 噢，抱歉，你待会儿恐怕要好好安慰安慰那家伙了。

pairs.source: Fer a moment there, I thought we were in trouble.
pairs.text: 有那么一瞬间，我还以为我们要有大麻烦了。

pairs.source: Oi, you'll pay for that one you will!
pairs.text: 喂，你会为此付出代价的！

pairs.source: Do not be fooled by their diminutive size, $n, they are disciplined and quick.
pairs.text: 别被他们娇小的体型给骗了，$n，他们可都是训练有素，行动敏捷的家伙。

pairs.source: Impatience is the road to defeat, you must learn to master your timing.
pairs.text: 莽撞是失败的根源，你必须学会控制节奏。

pairs.source: It requires a cunning strategist indeed to defeat my monks.  Well done, $n.
pairs.text: 要想击败我的武僧们真的需要高明的战术。干得好，$n。

pairs.source: Can you survive with what remains?
pairs.text: 你还能靠剩下的宠物反败为胜吗？

pairs.source: He fought and died with honor.
pairs.text: 他为荣誉而战，也为荣誉而死。

pairs.source: When one Shado-Pan falls, another steps forward to take his place.
pairs.text: 当一名影踪派成员倒下时，总会有更多战友站出来顶上他的位置。

pairs.source: As water cracks stone, so shall we be your undoing.
pairs.text: 就像水滴能令石穿，我们也将成为你的终结者。

pairs.source: The rivers foretold of this triumph.
pairs.text: 河流早就预言了这场胜利。

pairs.source: The rivers foretold of this defeat.
pairs.text: 河流早就预言了这场失败。

pairs.source: And so they are washed away with little trace of what once was.
pairs.text: 他们连同那一点可怜的痕迹都被一起冲刷掉了。

pairs.source: The stone thinks itself unmovable until the ground is washed away beneath it.
pairs.text: 岩石总以为自己不可撼动，直到它身下的大地被一起冲走。

pairs.source: My companion is dispersed.  She will flow back to me when the time is right.
pairs.text: 我的同伴被打散了。但她一定会在适当的时候卷土重来的。

pairs.source: The river does not stop from a single stone.
pairs.text: 一块孤岩阻挡不了汹涌澎湃的河流。

pairs.source: The ebbs and flows of battle are to be expected.
pairs.text: 战斗中总是免不了会有高潮和低谷。

pairs.source: Dragons are dangerous at any size, as I'm sure you'll find out.
pairs.text: 龙无论大小都是非常危险的，我一定会让你明白这一点的。

pairs.source: If I can win a battle like that, I may have a chance against the Celestials.
pairs.text: 如果我能赢得这样的战斗，那我或许就有机会战胜至尊天神了。

pairs.source: Well done, $n.  You picked your friends wisely and led them with honor.
pairs.text: 干得好，$n。你明智地选择了自己的战友，并出色地领导了它们。

pairs.source: As I warned you before, dragons are known for their deadly attacks.
pairs.text: 我早就警告过你，龙是以其致命的攻击而著称的。

pairs.source: Even the strongest ally can fall to draconic magic.
pairs.text: 哪怕是最强大的盟友也会倒在龙族魔法之下。

pairs.source: A glass cannon sometimes breaks before it can fire.
pairs.text: 玻璃做的火炮常常在开火前就会碎裂。

pairs.source: You have strength I didn't see at first.
pairs.text: 你的力量超出了我的预料。

pairs.source: It will be difficult to recover from such a loss.
pairs.text: 这真是个难以弥补的损失。

pairs.source: Do not despair the damage that was done here.
pairs.text: 不要因为这儿的满目疮痍而绝望。

pairs.source: A long time ago, this land was beset by the shadows of doubt, of fear, and hatred.
pairs.text: 很久很久以前，这片土地曾为猜忌、恐惧和仇恨的阴影所笼罩。

pairs.source: One by one, I overcame them - and buried them deep within the earth.
pairs.text: 我将其逐一制服——并深深埋入地下。

pairs.source: For ten thousand years ... as the veil of mists kept Pandaria hidden from prying eyes.
pairs.text: 一万年以来……浓雾保护着潘达利亚不受外敌的觊觎。

pairs.source: When the Cataclysm struck, I decided the time had come to part the mists ... and help heal our broken world.
pairs.text: 当大灾变降临时，我意识到散去迷雾的时刻到了……我们要协助治愈这个破碎的世界。

pairs.source: But as your war-fleets crashed upon our shores, all of my old doubts and fears rose up, to torment the land once again.
pairs.text: 可当你们的舰队抵达我们的海岸，我昔日的猜忌和恐惧再次袭来，又一次在这片土地上肆虐。

pairs.source: You triumphed over the darkness I had locked away.
pairs.text: 你战胜了那被封印已久的黑暗。

pairs.source: You have shown Pandaria the power of a true hero.
pairs.text: 向潘达利亚展示了一个真英雄的力量。

pairs.source: But the question still remains... why do we fight?
pairs.text: 但你是否仍有困惑：吾辈何以为战？

pairs.source: Face your fears. Calm your hatreds.
Find peace within yourself, so that you may share it with the world around you.
pairs.text: 只有当自己静心忍性，才能做到万物归心，宠辱不惊。

pairs.source: These are the greatest treasures in life.
pairs.text: 这些才是生命宝贵的真谛。

pairs.source: Surely they... are worth fighting for.
I have been apprising the lorewalker of your deeds, champion. Are you ready to hear your tale?
pairs.text: 我已经向游学者叙述了你的事迹，勇士。想听听你的故事吗？

pairs.source: Dear Emperor. It is done. The darkness that you once struggled against has been purged from Pandaria - forever.
pairs.text: 亲爱的皇上，我们来了。那些曾让您苦苦挣扎的邪恶和黑暗已经永远地远离了潘达利亚。

pairs.source: But the cost... such a terrible cost.
pairs.text: 可这代价…这惨痛的代价…

pairs.source: These outsiders have brought chaos to this land. Can we trust them to set it right?
pairs.text: 这些外来者给这片土地带来了混乱。我们能够相信他们吗？

pairs.source: I trust you have learned: To fight out of fear or anger is to fight a war that never ends.
pairs.text: 我相信你已经领悟了：若因恐惧和愤怒而战，则此战永无休止。

pairs.source: Alright, boys. Let's show 'em how Blackfuse Company fights.
pairs.text: 好吧，伙计们，让他们看看黑索公司的战斗力！
见证我充满荣耀的命运吧！啊哈哈哈！

pairs.source: I am sure they are trying, Kavan. Be nice.
pairs.text: 他们已经很努力了，卡凡。礼貌点。

pairs.source: Ah, our first enemy! Illusionary Rippers are but simple warriors. Now, let us do this!
pairs.text: 第一个敌人！幻影撕裂者只是普通战士。来干掉他们吧！

pairs.source: Illusionary Flamecallers! Watch your feet, everyone. Do not stand in the lava.
pairs.text: 幻影召焰者！各位，注意脚下！别站在岩浆里！

pairs.source: I am down. Let us try again!
pairs.text: 我失败了！……我们再试一次吧！

pairs.source: Oh no, did you forget to heal yourself?
pairs.text: 哦不！你忘记给自己治疗了吗？

pairs.source: The illusions will not hold back, this time. Their attacks will be relentless. Be prepared to use your strongest healing spells.
pairs.text: 这次，幻影是不会后退的。它们会连续攻击。准备使用你最强的治疗手段吧。

pairs.source: Ahh, Illusionary Tunnelers! Speedy and I have faced these foes before. Beware, they may burrow into the ground and then suddenly pop up under a new target, and CHOMP! Hah ha hah ha.
pairs.text: 啊，幻影隧道工。我和飞毛腿对付过这种敌人。小心，它们会钻洞，然后突然从新目标脚下冒出来狂啃！哈哈！

pairs.source: Argh... please... take care... of Speedy!
There is no end in sight to these illusions, but we shall hold out as long as we can.
pairs.text: 这些幻影是无穷无尽的，但我们要尽力守住！

pairs.source: Hah ha! Wonderful job, everyone! Friend, see Rotun about beginning the next trial.
pairs.text: 哈哈！干得好，各位！朋友，去找罗敦开启下一轮试炼吧。

pairs.source: Long ago, the Jade Serpent instructed me to purify my spirit and become one with the land, my doubts were vanquished.
pairs.text: 很久以前，睿智的青龙教会我净化自己的灵魂并与大地融为一体，我的疑虑就此被打消了。

pairs.source: When my journey began, I was reckless in my strength. The White Tiger taught me control. My hatred, anger, and violence were vanquished.
pairs.text: 当旅程开始时，我只会鲁莽地运用自己的力量。白虎教我学会控制，从而征服了我的仇恨、愤怒和暴虐。

pairs.source: The Red Crane saw hope in me, and instructed me to look inward. Despite my visage of despair, I found this hope, and the despair was vanquished.
pairs.text: 朱鹤看到了我内心的希望，并且教我学会自省。透过绝望的表象，我发现了希望，并由此征服了绝望。

pairs.source: In the face of great fear, the Black Ox taught me fortitude. Through terror and darkness it persevered. The fear was vanquished.
pairs.text: 在巨大的恐惧面前，玄牛教我懂得坚毅，让我在恐怖与黑暗的时代不屈不挠，征服恐惧。

pairs.source: You have walked the trial of wisdom, and learned of the path of the Jade Serpent. May you learn from this lesson, as I did.
pairs.text: 你通过了智慧的试炼，并领悟了青龙之道。愿你能像我一样，有所收获。

pairs.source: You have walked the trial of strength, and learned of the path of the White Tiger. May you remember this lesson, always.
pairs.text: 你通过了力量的试炼，并领悟了白虎之道。愿你永远记住这一课。

pairs.source: You have walked the trial of hope, and learned of the path of the Red Crane. May it guide your footsteps through time.
pairs.text: 你通过了希望的试炼，并领悟了朱鹤之道。愿它永远指引你的脚步。

pairs.source: You have walked the trial of fortitude, and learned of the path of the Black Ox. May it bless your passage.
pairs.text: 你通过了坚毅的试炼，并领悟了玄牛之道。愿它永远护佑你的道路。

pairs.source: Help! Get these things off of me!
What are you standing in?! Get out of the fire!
pairs.text: 你往哪儿站呢？！离火焰远点儿！

pairs.source: Illusionary Rippers approaching. They should pose little challenge; they are but mindless grunts.
pairs.text: 幻影撕裂者来了。它们算不上挑战，只是些没脑子的蛮兵。

pairs.source: Prepare your defenses. That is an Illusionary Conqueror! When they become enraged, they gain great strength, and nothing can stop them.
pairs.text: 准备防御。那是幻影征服者！它们暴怒时，会造成极高的伤害，无人能挡！

pairs.source: A new enemy, Illusionary Flamecallers. They cast fireballs and spew lava. Use the lava to your advantage; it will burn the other illusions.
pairs.text: 有新的敌人来了，幻影召焰者。它们会施放火球术并喷吐岩浆。好好利用这些岩浆，它们能烧死其他幻影！

pairs.source: Beware! Illusionary Wind-Guards can use their wings to knock you back. When they do, they will likely switch to attacking me instead.
pairs.text: 小心，幻影风卫士会用翅膀击退你，然后再转过头来攻击我！

pairs.source: Illusionary Ambushers! Get their attention, quick. And get them away from me, so they cannot hit me with their devastating bananas!
pairs.text: 幻影伏击者！快吸引它们的主意，让它们离我远点，别让那些危险的香蕉击中我！

pairs.source: Illusionary Foragers are attacking. Do not let their cute faces fool you. They can work together to cause terrible devastation.
pairs.text: 幻影抢劫者进攻了！别让它们可爱的样子骗了，它们能合力造成极高的伤害。

pairs.source: Ahh, I cannot heal through that much damage! Did you forget to equip your heaviest armor?!
pairs.text: 啊，我治疗不了那么高的伤害！你忘记换坦克装了吗？

pairs.source: I am down. Maybe I should bring more healing herbs for next time.
pairs.text: 我失败了！或许下次我应该穿上治疗装备？

pairs.source: Greetings. I am Sikari, master of jade lightning, chi, and healing mists. For this trial, you must protect me from the incoming illusions, while I heal you and dispatch our foes.
pairs.text: 你好。我是司佳丽，碎玉闪电、真气与治疗之雾的大师。在试炼中，你得保护我，挡住涌来的幻影。而我会治疗你并对付我们敌人。

pairs.source: Greetings, again. Our next trial will be more challenging. Prepare to defend me.
pairs.text: 你好啊。我们的下一场试炼更具挑战性。准备保护我！

pairs.source: Once again, you must defend me. Rotun, give us a challenge this time.
pairs.text: 这次，你还是要保护我。嘿，罗敦，来场真正的挑战吧！

pairs.source: While our end is inevitable, let us try to take as many of them down with us as we can. Be ready.
pairs.text: 虽然失败无法避免，但是我们还是要尽力杀敌。做好准备！

pairs.source: Rest well, honored mother. You will be avenged.
pairs.text: 安息吧，光荣的母亲。我们会为你复仇的。

pairs.source: Rest well, honored mother. You will be avenged.
pairs.text: 安息吧，光荣的母亲。我们会为你复仇的。

pairs.source: It's all fun and games until...
Eye, what are you looking at?
Razuun, you stay here. I have other plans for... what is that?
pairs.text: 拉索恩，你留下。我还有计划……那是什么？

pairs.source: All I require is its limitless power.
pairs.text: 我只想要它无尽的力量。

pairs.source: It will be done, Lord Gul'dan.
You know what needs to be done, champion.
Meet me in the Veiled Stair when the deed is done - assuming you're still alive when this is over.
pairs.text: 等事情了结之后，就来雾纱栈道找我——如果你那时还活着的话。

pairs.source: Oi! That was a fun ride!
Heroes, I salute you. There's something right foul in these chambers below the city.
pairs.text: 英雄们，向你们致敬。这些地下大厅里有着某种非常邪恶的东西。

pairs.source: Ooh, that looks dangerous. Get in there, boys, and show em' what we're made of.
pairs.text: 呼，它看起来很危险，冲上去，小伙子们，让他们看看我们的本事。

pairs.source: A right deadly machine, that is. Best watch yer step down here, heroes.
pairs.text: 真是个暴躁的家伙。你们最好小心点，英雄们。

pairs.source: Oh, ho ho... Hey now. What do we have here?
pairs.text: 嘿，看看我们找到什么了？

pairs.source: So Garrosh thinks he can cheat ol' Grizzle out of a payday, huh?!
pairs.text: 加尔鲁什还以为他能赖掉格里兹尔的帐，嗯？

pairs.source: Go get it boys, that contraption's got nothin' on real goblin engineering!
pairs.text: 干掉它，在正版地精工程学面前，那玩意儿不堪一击！

pairs.source: Ahhhh! Or maybe it does. I better, um, go check on the others.
pairs.text: 看来还有点本事。我最好……呃……去看看其他人。

pairs.source: I like shorts! They're perfect for this weather!
pairs.text: 我喜欢穿短裤！它最适合这里的天气！

pairs.source: I like shorts! They're perfect for this weather!
pairs.text: 我喜欢穿短裤！它最适合这里的天气！

pairs.source: Rise, old friends. The time has come for the next step of my plan.
pairs.text: 来吧，老伙计们。应该执行下一步计划了。

pairs.source: Teron'gor, infiltrate the Auchenai and take control of Auchindoun. Bleed them dry.
pairs.text: 塔隆戈尔，你要渗透进奥金尼并控制奥金顿。去榨干他们的鲜血。

pairs.source: Cho'gall, we'll finish your Frostfire business together.
pairs.text: 古加尔，你在霜火岭的任务先停下来。

pairs.source: I'm sending you to Nagrand to subjugate the naaru in Oshu'gun.
pairs.text: 我打算派你去纳格兰，收服沃舒古的纳鲁。

pairs.source: Your attack on Karabor was cowardly and unwarranted.
pairs.text: 你对卡拉波的袭击是卑鄙且毫无理由的。

pairs.source: What's more, we thoroughly outclassed your orcs on the battlefield.
pairs.text: 更重要的是，我们在战场上完胜了你们兽人。

pairs.source: I would be within my rights to behead you and raze this town...
pairs.text: 我完全有权利砍下你的脑袋，并毁掉这座城镇……

pairs.source: ...but not today.  Today, we show mercy.  Pack up your machines of war and leave this place.
pairs.text: ……但不是今天。今天，我们就饶你一次。带上你们的战争机器，滚出这片土地。

pairs.source: Teron'gor, we'll finish your Shadowmoon business together.
pairs.text: 塔隆戈尔，我们将一起完成你在影月谷的任务。

pairs.source: I'm sending you to Talador. Infiltrate the Auchenai. Take control of Auchindoun. Bleed it dry.
pairs.text: 我打算派你去塔拉多。你要渗透进奥金尼，控制住奥金顿，让它流干最后一滴血。

pairs.source: Cho'gall, I'm sending you to Nagrand.
pairs.text: 古加尔，我打算派你去纳格兰。

pairs.source: You'll subjugate the fallen naaru inside Oshu'gun.
pairs.text: 你要去降服沃舒古的堕落纳鲁。

pairs.source: Giselda, you stay here. I have other plans for... what is behind me?
pairs.text: 吉塞尔达，你留下。我还有计划要……我身后的是什么？

pairs.source: Send word to the rest of the pack: The sons of the Iron Wolf have been found. Lok'tar ogar!
pairs.text: 快去告诉其他人：我们找到铁狼之子了。Lok'tar ogar！

pairs.source: Your father will mourn, as I have mourned.
pairs.text: 你父亲会像我过去那样痛不欲生。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde approaches. No sudden movements.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正在靠近。别乱动。

pairs.source: Throm-Ka, Commander Vorka. The Shadowmoon clan is honored by your presence.
pairs.text: Throm-Ka，指挥官沃尔卡。你的到来让影月氏族深感荣幸。

pairs.source: Shaman, women... <spits>. I have no time for seers and mystics.
pairs.text: 萨满，女人……<吐口水>。我没功夫理会先知和神棍。

pairs.source: Where are your true warriors? Or, is what they say about the Shadowmoon true?
pairs.text: 你们的战士都上哪儿去了？难道有关影月氏族的那些传闻都是真的？

pairs.source: That you're a mass of cravens hiding behind your magic?
pairs.text: 你们就是一群躲在魔法后头的懦夫？

pairs.source: Step aside, brothers. We must speak with Hellscream.
pairs.text: 请让开，兄弟们。我们必须和地狱咆哮谈谈。

pairs.source: No one may enter the city. Not even you, Shaman.
pairs.text: 谁都不准进入城市。包括你，萨满。

pairs.source: No one may enter the city. Not even you, Shaman.
pairs.text: 谁都不准进入城市。包括你，萨满。

pairs.source: Thrall? Varok? What business do you have here?
pairs.text: 萨尔？萨鲁法尔？你们来干什么？

pairs.source: Strength and Honor, General. We come to speak with Garrosh. There may yet be hope for peace.
pairs.text: 力量和荣誉，将军。我们是来找加尔鲁什谈判的。这样或许还有一线和平的希望。

pairs.source: Kor'kron! You are needed at the front!
You know I can make no guarantee of your safety... or Garrosh's response.
pairs.text: 你们知道的，我无法保证你们的安全……以及加尔鲁什的反应。
懦夫？我让你看看谁才是懦夫！

pairs.source: Hold. I would not spill your blood today, Hara.
pairs.text: 住手。我今天可不是来跟你动手的，哈拉。

pairs.source: You Shadowmoon are proud and still have the warriors' spirit!
pairs.text: 你们影月氏族确实继承了骄傲的战士精神！

pairs.source: Very well, Vorka, son of Vorash. The Shadowmoon clan will join this Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 很好，沃拉什之子沃尔卡。影月氏族会加入钢铁部落的。

pairs.source: Gather your clan. Soon the Iron Horde will crush Karabor once and for all!
pairs.text: 去召集你的氏族。钢铁部落很快就将彻底碾碎卡拉波！

pairs.source: Our paths diverge here. Good luck, champion.
pairs.text: 我们就在这里分道扬镳吧。祝你好运，勇士。

pairs.source: Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 铁狼之子哈托克！我是来取你的脑袋的。

pairs.source: Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 哈托克，鐵狼之子！我來取你的人頭了。

pairs.source: Well look here boys, the mongrel son of Garad has returned from the grave.
pairs.text: 看呐，小伙子们，加拉达的野杂种起死回生了。

pairs.source: Hrah hrah hrah! You should have stayed dead, Ga'nar. You would have lived longer.
pairs.text: 哈哈哈！你应该继续装死的。那你还能多活几天。

pairs.source: Had Garrad just joined the Iron Horde like he was told you would still have your precious daddy to save you today.
pairs.text: 要是加拉达肯乖乖加入钢铁部落，那你的好爸爸今天或许还能救你一命。

pairs.source: Chose your last words carefully Hatock. There is no Thunderlord that can stand against me.
pairs.text: 说话小心点，哈托克。在我面前，雷神兽人全都不堪一击。

pairs.source: Yes, your wolves are very formidable in battle when in the open. But let us see how you do in the shadow of a gronn.
pairs.text: 你的狼崽子们在开阔地是很厉害，看看他们遇到戈隆还有什么能耐。

pairs.source: Keep a grip on those chains.
His arm is loosening! Tighten that slack before he puts you all against a wall.
pairs.text: 他的胳膊松脱了！快拉紧，否则他会把你们都打到墙上去。

pairs.source: We have a schedule to keep.
Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 铁狼之子哈托克！我来取你的脑袋了。

pairs.source: Hatock, son of the Iron Wolf! I come for your head.
pairs.text: 哈托克，鐵狼之子！我來取你的人頭了。

pairs.source: What is wrong Ga'nar? Afraid of a bit of Gronn?
pairs.text: 怎么啦，贾纳尔？居然害怕一头戈隆？

pairs.source: I thought you Frostwolves were supposed to be skilled?
pairs.text: 我还以为你们霜狼兽人都是高手呢？

pairs.source: Not so easy to fight a Thunderlord, is it?
pairs.text: 想跟雷神氏族作对可没那么容易。

pairs.source: You mongrels are no match for my blade!
pairs.text: 在我的刀剑之下，你们这些杂种不堪一击！

pairs.source: If you had just joined the Iron Horde I wouldn't have to kill you now.
pairs.text: 如果你们加入钢铁部落，我就放你一马。

pairs.source: Hatock! You cannot hide from me!
Frostwolves! Fan out and harry the Thunderlord. For vengeance!
pairs.text: 霜狼们！去干掉那些雷神兽人。为了复仇！

pairs.source: Honored brothers and sisters! Today we achieved what Durotan would not even dare to try.
pairs.text: 光荣的兄弟姐妹们！今天，我们取得了杜隆坦想都不敢想的成就！

pairs.source: Make no mistake. We are at war. And we need a Warchief!
pairs.text: 显然，这是一场战争。我们需要一位酋长！

pairs.source: Those of you bold enough to stand with me - come! We will show the world the might of the Frostwolves!
pairs.text: 有种的就跟着我干！我们会向整个世界展现霜狼氏族的力量！

pairs.source: The Prophet foresaw a time in our future when our people would come into grave danger.
pairs.text: 先知早就预见到，我们的人民将会在未来遭遇严重的危机。

pairs.source: This shrine holds the power to save us from destruction.
pairs.text: 这个祭坛里蕴藏着能拯救我们免于毁灭的力量。

pairs.source: I pray that the day of judgment shall never come. Power like this can only come at great cost.
pairs.text: 我一直祈祷这个审判日永远不要到来。使用这样的力量势必要付出极大的代价。

pairs.source: Activation of The Arbitum requires an incredible amount of energy - energy of a kind that can't be found on this world.
pairs.text: 激活审判祭坛需要难以想象的庞大能量——一种不存在于这个世界的能量。

pairs.source: Luckily, Iris Crystals do not originate from Draenor. We think three should be enough to supply the energy we need.
pairs.text: 幸运的是，彩虹水晶并非产自德拉诺。我觉得三块水晶已经足以供应我们所需的能量。

pairs.source: Five Iris Crystals have fallen from the skies around Shadowmoon Valley.
pairs.text: 五块彩虹水晶从天而降，散落于影月谷各地。

pairs.source: Unfortunately, it looks like the Shadowmoon are collecting them as well. We cannot allow them to succeed.
pairs.text: 不幸的是，影月氏族似乎也在收集它们。我们绝不能让他们成功。

pairs.source: This is the Prophet's vision of what will come to pass.
pairs.text: 先知对此的预言也终将实现。

pairs.source: Do you know the workings of our magic, traveler?
pairs.text: 你明白我们的魔法原理吗，旅行者？

pairs.source: See this hammer? In my hands, it strikes with magical force against enemies. But used by an inexperienced trainee, it is no more than a blunt rock.
pairs.text: 看到这把锤子了吗？在我手中，它就能以魔法之力打击敌人。但在一个新兵手里，它不过是一块钝石头。

pairs.source: The Arbitum is only as powerful as the one who uses it.
pairs.text: 审判祭坛的威力取决于它的使用者。

pairs.source: In the right hands, it restores hope for this world. In the wrong ones, it is a weapon of absolute destruction.
pairs.text: 在正确的人手中，它是挽救这个世界的希望。在错误的人手中，它就是灭绝一切的武器。

pairs.source: Spirits of the water, I seek your guidance. Spirits of the earth, I seek your strength.
pairs.text: 流水之灵，我需要你的指引。大地之灵，我需要你的力量。

pairs.source: I... I hear the voice of a Fury!
pairs.text: 我……我听到了愤怒的声音！

pairs.source: Fly with me, hero. We will assist them from above!
pairs.text: 跟我来，英雄。我们得从空中支援他们！

pairs.source: The purifying light of the naaru is both our hammer AND shield.
pairs.text: 纳鲁的净化之光既是我们的战锤又是我们的护盾。

pairs.source: They are at the very temple gates - fly closer! Hurry!
pairs.text: 他们就在神殿大门口——飞近点！快！

pairs.source: Circle back. We must clear the steps.
pairs.text: 飞回去。我们得肃清台阶上的敌人。
大主教阿卡玛！小心你的侧翼！

pairs.source: Never again will you orcish hordes darken the light of Karabor!
pairs.text: 你们这些兽人再也别想玷污卡拉波的光辉！

pairs.source: Press onward. By the light of the Naaru!
pairs.text: 前进。以纳鲁之光的名义！

pairs.source: Spirits of fire, I seek ferocity- aaaaaah!
pairs.text: 火焰之灵，我需要你的……啊啊啊！

pairs.source: Hear it faster! We are getting swarmed down here.
pairs.text: 快一点！我们快被围死了。

pairs.source: Rulkan was Ner'zhul's most trusted advisor for many years. Ner'zhul's strength and ambition guided our lives, but Rulkan's wisdom and vision inspired our spirits.
pairs.text: 多年来，鲁尔坎一直是耐奥祖最信赖的顾问。耐奥祖的力量和雄心引领着我们的肉体，但鲁尔坎的智慧和预言鼓舞着我们的精神。

pairs.source: Ner'zhul's methods are brutal and direct. He cuts his enemies down by force.$B$BRulkan is clever and wise. She will turn an enemy's own blade against them.
pairs.text: 耐奥祖的风格粗暴而直接。他会用暴力打倒敌人。$B$B而鲁尔坎聪明又睿智，最擅长以彼之道还施彼身。

pairs.source: The Shadowmoon Clan is no longer. Even if physical remnants remain, its spirit is corrupted.
pairs.text: 影月氏族完了。虽然它的躯壳还在，但它的灵魂已经堕落了。

pairs.source: We are here in self-exile. We refused to tap the magic of Ner'zhul's Dark Star.
pairs.text: 我们是自我放逐来到这里的。我们都不愿意接受耐奥祖的黑暗之星的魔力。

pairs.source: It is unclear what will happen to us from here, but one thing is certain. My loyalty to Chieftess Rulkan is absolute.
pairs.text: 我们今后的命运还不明朗，但有一点是肯定的，我对女酋长鲁尔坎绝对忠诚。

pairs.source: Draka, help me up. We shou- hrraarh!
pairs.text: 德拉卡，帮帮我。我们得……啊啊！

pairs.source: Do not forget, child, one of us is blind and unable to call upon the spirits like he used to.
pairs.text: 别忘了，孩子，我们中有一个盲人，而且已经不能像过去一样召唤万灵了。

pairs.source: Bah! That should just come close to making it a fair fight. On your feet, old man.
pairs.text: 呸！那只是让这一战更加公平而已。站起来，老家伙。

pairs.source: What hope is there against a foe that can consume the very elements?
pairs.text: 面对连元素本身都能吞噬的敌人，我们还能有什么希望？

pairs.source: You taught me long ago that the elements have always been there for us. Now it is our turn to be there for them. Victory or death, we owe it to them to try.
pairs.text: 很久之前，你教导我说元素永远与我们同在。而现在，该轮到我们与它们同在了。非胜即死，我们必须尝试一下，这是我们欠它们的。

pairs.source: $C! You have freed my children and made me whole. Accept my boon and bring the full fury of Frostfire to your enemies.
pairs.text: $C！你解放了我的孩子们，让我重塑了身躯。接受我的恩赐，将霜火的愤怒倾泻到你的敌人头上吧。

pairs.source: Shaman, you alone were strong enough to hear my call. You were wise enough to know what needed to be done. Give me your totem.
pairs.text: 萨满，你很强大，竟然能听到我的呼唤。你也很睿智，知道应该做些什么。把你的图腾给我。

pairs.source: Feel the flames of the fury!

Exurotus was always believed to be a legend. A story told from shaman to shaman as a symbol of a true elemental spirit.$b$bTo see something so revered in shackles is an affront to orcs, to shamanism, and to me.
pairs.text: 人们一直以为艾索洛托斯只是个传说，一个萨满之间世代相传的故事，是元素真灵的象征。$b$b看到自己世代尊崇的存在竟然被镣铐所束缚，这是对所有兽人，对萨满教，对我的侮辱。

pairs.source: The stench of tortured stone fills the air, Draka. What do you see?
pairs.text: 空气中弥漫着岩石的焦糊味，德拉卡。你看见了什么？

pairs.source: I can feel hundreds of goren burrowing through the earth. This will not be easy.
pairs.text: 我能感觉到，有无数鬣蜥人正在地下潜伏。这可不容易。

pairs.source: Goren... lots of goren. We will distract them in order to sneak you into the Ice Forge.
pairs.text: 这么多……鬣蜥人。我们得引开他们，让你潜入寒冰熔炉。

pairs.source: What you suggest should be good enough to bring down a forger, but only for a few seconds at a time.
pairs.text: 你提出的方法应该足以打倒匠灵了，但每次只能持续几秒钟。

pairs.source: Spirits of the wind! Heed my call! We have need of your wisdom.
pairs.text: 清风之灵，响应我的召唤！我们需要你的智慧。

pairs.source: This is not a place Frostwolves tread. Be mindful of what shadows you step in.
pairs.text: 这不是霜狼该来的地方。小心你脚下的阴影。

pairs.source: I am sworn by duty. If we are needed, we will be there. Come, Vindicators!
pairs.text: 我曾发誓坚守职责。哪里有需要，我们就会出现在那里。守备官们，都过来！

pairs.source: Hmmm... yes, you make a compelling point. Come, vindicators!
pairs.text: 唔……没错，你的说法很有道理。守备官们，都过来！

pairs.source: Come, child. Find safe refuge in my totem.
pairs.text: 来吧，孩子。到我的图腾中寻找庇护吧。

pairs.source: So many? Very well. When the Prophet calls, the rangari answer. Follow me, men! Velen requests our aid!
pairs.text: 这么多？很好。只要是先知的召唤，游侠们必然响应。跟我来，伙计们！维伦需要我们的帮助。

pairs.source: I place my trust in Velen's wisdom. He is, after all, the Prophet of my people. Follow me, men!
pairs.text: 我相信维伦的智慧。他毕竟是我们的先知。跟我来，伙计们！

pairs.source: It is done? Good. Once this battle is over, we will have to begin repairing Karabor's proper shield defenses.
pairs.text: 完成了？很好。等这场战斗结束，我们就可以开始修复卡拉波的常规防御护盾了。

pairs.source: You are a friend of the anchorites, visitor. I will see you back at the rallying point.
pairs.text: 从今往后，你就是学者之友，外来者。我们集合点再见。

pairs.source: Carry this symbol of my gratitude into battle, and its fire shall join with your own to burn your enemies to ash.
pairs.text: 请带上它继续战斗吧，它象征着我对你的感激之情。让它的火焰与你一起将你敌人烧成灰烬吧。

pairs.source: We are the only ones close enough to collect these pieces and unleash the fury.
pairs.text: 我们是唯一能够收集这些碎片并释放它的人。

pairs.source: Your security is lax, Chieftain. I caught these Rangari spies within your gates.
pairs.text: 你的警卫太松懈了，酋长。我在村子里抓住了这些间谍。

pairs.source: They are too late. The prisoners are already on their way to Anguish Fortress.
pairs.text: 他们已经迟了。俘虏都被送去痛楚堡垒了。

pairs.source: Their blood will summon forth the Dark Star, and make me as a God among the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 他们的鲜血将召唤出黑暗之星，并使我成为钢铁部落的神！

pairs.source: The Warchief honors deeds, not words, shadowcaster.
pairs.text: 酋长看重的是行动，而非言语，暗影法师。

pairs.source: Seal the exits! No draenei scum leaves this village alive!
pairs.text: 封锁出口！不要让这些德莱尼活着离开！

pairs.source: Enough! You scheming draenei can keep your precious temple... for now.
pairs.text: 够了！就让你们这些狡猾的德莱尼暂且留着那座神殿吧。

pairs.source: I will move ahead and prepare a staging area for our counter-attack.
pairs.text: 我得到前面去，为反击部队开辟一处集结点。
