pairs.source: These orcs have violated the sanctity of Karabor. Their attack ends NOW!
pairs.text: 这些兽人亵渎了卡拉波的圣洁。他们的攻击到此为止了！

pairs.source: May the Light guide our path!
pairs.text: 愿圣光指引我们的道路！

pairs.source: Arepheon! Provide us with cover fire!
pairs.text: 阿瑞菲奥！火力掩护我们！

pairs.source: Akama, Taalo! Show them the might of the draenei!
pairs.text: 阿卡玛，塔尔洛！让他们看看德莱尼的力量！

pairs.source: Yes... Very good. Around Shadowmoon Valley are four arkonite crystals, ancient wreckage from our vessel.
pairs.text: 是的……很好。影月谷周围有四块阿肯尼特水晶，那是从我们飞船上落下来的古老残片。

pairs.source: I thought we would never need their power, but the time has come. Take my staff, and gather their energy for me.
pairs.text: 我还以为我们永远不会用到它们的力量，但这一天还是来了。拿上我的法杖，为我去收集它们的能量。

pairs.source: All right, give me one moment...
There are still enemies among us. EVERYONE TO ARMS!
pairs.text: 这里还有敌人。所有人，拿起武器！

pairs.source: You must defeat Commander Vorka. There he is, at the very gates of Karabor.
pairs.text: 你必须击败指挥官沃尔卡。他就在那儿，卡拉波的大门前。

pairs.source: With pleasure. Vindicators, follow me into the fray!
pairs.text: 那是我的荣幸！守备官们，跟我上战场！

pairs.source: In your blind rage you rush to face my ogres alone.
pairs.text: 你竟敢独自来挑战食人魔。

pairs.source: They will end you, little lone wolf.
pairs.text: 他们会结果了你，小独狼。

pairs.source: Your conquered clan will fill my slave pens...
pairs.text: 你的族人会塞满我的奴隶围栏……

pairs.source: I'll drown you in the blood of your little army!
pairs.text: 我要让你的杂牌军血流成河！

pairs.source: I will get these orcs to safety and meet with you outside.
pairs.text: 他们就交给我吧，我们在外面碰头。

pairs.source: Get me lose and I will speak with your wolf chief.
pairs.text: 放开我，我要跟你们的狼主谈谈。

pairs.source: I... feel... better! You've done the right thing! Now I shall go see what your wolf chief has to say.
pairs.text: 我……感觉……好多了！你做出了正确的选择！现在，我可以去听听你们的狼主有什么话说了。

pairs.source: The siege is broken! Come, brothers and sisters - drive these orcs from Karabor!
pairs.text: 包围圈被打破了！来吧，兄弟姐妹们——把这些兽人赶出卡拉波！

pairs.source: You will not die today, champion!
You will not die today, champion!
Let the Light heal your wounds!
Let the Light heal your wounds!
Thank you, $n. I will meet you back at Twilight Glade.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，$n。我们在暮光林地见。

pairs.source: Thank you, $n. I will meet you back at Twilight Glade.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，$n。我们在暮光林地见。

pairs.source: No, Ga'nar. We are surrounded and exposed. We must fortify.
pairs.text: 不，贾纳尔。我们现在孤立无援，只能固守。

pairs.source: There is much to be done. Taalo, see that the troops are healed and rested.
pairs.text: 我们还有很多事要做，塔尔洛，先保证部队得到妥善治疗和充分休息吧。

pairs.source: Gah! He tried to stab me! I told you we couldn't trust the Laughing Skulls.
pairs.text: 嘿！他想要捅我！我早就跟你说了，我们不能相信嘲颅兽人。

pairs.source: Limbflayer forgot to be nice. I saw pretty orc. I wanted to see if she could dance. Sorry. Sorry.
pairs.text: 断肢忘了要保持礼貌。我看见了漂亮兽人。我想看看她会不会跳舞。抱歉抱歉。

pairs.source: I have come to hunt the Iron Horde. I could destroy what remains of your ruined village, or perhaps we could assist one another.
pairs.text: 我是来追杀钢铁部落的。我可以毁掉你们残存的村庄，或许我们也可以互相帮助。

pairs.source: You have proven yourself loyal to my clan. Capable of great things.
pairs.text: 你证明了对我氏族的忠诚，有做大事的能力。

pairs.source: Our hold on Bladespire is tenuous, and some of my best warriors have raced off with my reckless brother.
pairs.text: 我们对刀塔堡垒的控制很薄弱，我最好的几个战士又跟着我那鲁莽的兄弟走了。

pairs.source: I was impressed by your skill in our battle against Dorogg the Ruthless.
pairs.text: 你在与多罗戈一战中展现出的技巧让我记忆犹新。

pairs.source: I would be honored if you continued to fight by our side.
pairs.text: 要是你能继续与我们并肩战斗，那将是我的荣幸。

pairs.source: I will block the temple against any more damage.
pairs.text: 我会守护神殿，让它远离伤害。

pairs.source: Go, $n. I will hold the temple gates!
pairs.text: 快去吧，$n！我来守住神殿大门！

pairs.source: Lemme just get her warmed up...
This way. There is a safe spot up ahead, just outside the Iron Horde's facilities.
pairs.text: 这边走。前面有一个安全点，就在钢铁部落的设备外面。

pairs.source: I s'pose priority number one is to take care o' that nasty giant cannon.
pairs.text: 我认为首要任务就是去对付那个该死的巨型火炮。
有谁提到“巨型火炮”了吗？

pairs.source: Soon enough. Our first priority is to find Yrel. She is out there somewhere.
pairs.text: 我们很快就会行动的，但首要任务还是找到伊瑞尔。她就在这附近。

pairs.source: D'kaan, you and our champion did some scouting earlier. What did you find?
pairs.text: 达坎，你和我们的勇士已经出去侦察过了。你们发现了什么？

pairs.source: I see. Well then, we will just have to...
pairs.text: 我明白了。好吧，那我们只能……

pairs.source: I'll dispatch artificers to secure the crystals to the north.
pairs.text: 我会派技师去保护北边的水晶的。

pairs.source: And what of Ner'zhul? Will we let him take our people without retribution?
pairs.text: 那耐奥祖怎么办？我们就任由这个掳掠我们同胞的罪犯逍遥法外吗？

pairs.source: Patience, Maraad. A rescue will require planning - do not rush into danger until we know where our people are.
pairs.text: 耐心点，玛尔拉德。营救行动需要好好计划一番——在搞清楚族人的下落之前，千万不要贸然犯险。

pairs.source: We made the wrong choice once before. I won't let it happen again. I can't leave our people to die.
pairs.text: 我们已经选错了一次。我不会让悲剧再次重演的。我不能任由我们的人民死去。

pairs.source: I will keep an eye on him, teacher.
When the Iron Horde came, they gave our clan a choice. Join them, or die.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落要求我们做出选择：加入，或者灭亡。

pairs.source: My husband Ner'zhul chose to save our people. He joined the Iron Horde, but they asked of him a heavy price.
pairs.text: 我丈夫耐奥祖为了拯救氏族，加入了钢铁部落，但必须付出沉重的代价。

pairs.source: So Ner'zhul turned to the silent void. He broke the ancient laws, and drew upon the dark star.
pairs.text: 耐奥祖只能求助于寂静的虚空。他打破古老的律法，使用了黑暗之星的力量。

pairs.source: I pleaded with him to stop, but he would not turn back.
pairs.text: 我求他住手，但他拒绝回头。

pairs.source: By breaking this stone, he forswore all loyalty to our ancestors.
pairs.text: 他打破了这块岩石，背弃了先祖。

pairs.source: I can ask only one thing of you now, stranger.
pairs.text: 我现在只能求你一件事，陌生人。

pairs.source: You must do what I cannot. Stop Ner'zhul. End his madness before it is too late.
pairs.text: 你必须阻止耐奥祖。阻止他的疯狂行为，否则就迟了。

pairs.source: What good are stars and visions against steel and powder? Make a worthy offering, or your people shall die.
pairs.text: 在钢铁和火药面前，星象和预知有什么用？拿出点真本事，否则你的族人都得死。

pairs.source: The Shadowmoon fortress is sealed to outsiders, but this keystone will allow entry. Good luck, hero.
pairs.text: 影月堡垒从不对外人开放，但这块钥石能让你进去。祝你好运，英雄。

pairs.source: Ner'zhul! Your army is scattered, your fortress in ruins.
pairs.text: 耐奥祖！你的部队完了，你的堡垒也完了。

pairs.source: Your "dark star" has fallen, and now serves the draenei. You are a disgrace!
pairs.text: 你的“黑暗之星”成了德莱尼的帮凶。你这废物！

pairs.source: We would still serve the Iron Horde, Hellscream. Our magic is-
pairs.text: 我们还可以为钢铁部落效劳，地狱咆哮。我们的魔法——

pairs.source: YOU HAVE NO PLACE IN MY IRON HORDE! Go back to your little village, Ner'zhul.  You can watch the stars while the Iron Tide washes over you.
pairs.text: 我的钢铁部落没有你的位置！滚回你的小村子去，耐奥祖。你就数着星星，等钢铁狂潮来湮没你吧。

pairs.source: Go back to your little village, Ner'zhul.  You can watch the stars while the Iron Tide washes over you.
pairs.text: 滚回你的小村子去吧，耐奥祖。你可以数着星星，等钢铁狂潮来湮没你。

pairs.source: Korhol, Zhakta, Trokar... move in from all sides. Gargrak, hold for now.
pairs.text: 考霍尔、扎克塔、卓卡……包抄过来。贾拉克，留在原地。

pairs.source: ZHAKTA NO!... you will be avenged!
pairs.text: 扎克塔，不！……我们会为你复仇！

pairs.source: Dammit all. Gargrak, go now... kill the blind shaman.
pairs.text: 该死。贾拉克，上……杀掉那个瞎眼萨满。
撤退！我们会回来报仇的！

pairs.source: Kalandrios, I would like to witness the Ritual of Binding again.
pairs.text: 卡拉迪奥斯，我想再看一次融合仪式。

pairs.source: Kalandrios, I would like to witness the Ritual of Binding again.
pairs.text: 卡拉迪奥斯，我想再看一次融合仪式。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde are moving toward the Temple of Karabor. The attack has beg--
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正在向卡拉波神殿方向移动。攻击已经开——

pairs.source: It seems the elements of Draenor do not respond to me as they do on Azeroth...
pairs.text: 我觉得德拉诺的元素并不像艾泽拉斯的那样回应我……

pairs.source: Go on ahead. Durotan awaits. I must catch my breath.
pairs.text: 继续前进吧，杜隆坦在等你。让我喘口气。

pairs.source: There is no time to waste! We strike NOW!
pairs.text: 不能再浪费时间了！我们得马上进攻！

pairs.source: Dorogg has fallen! Stay close, Frostwolves - the citadel is not yet ours.
pairs.text: 多罗戈倒下了！保持警惕，霜狼们，我们还没攻下堡垒。

pairs.source: Carry the light, brothers and sisters!
pairs.text: 兄弟姐妹们，圣光与你们同在！

pairs.source: That was barely a scratch! I should recover quickly.
pairs.text: 不过是点小擦伤罢了！我很快就会恢复的。

pairs.source: It is up to you, champion. I will stay here and help with the wounded slaves you rescued.
pairs.text: 全靠你了，勇士。我会留下来照顾得救的奴隶们。
德雷克塔尔，老伙计。你还活着！

pairs.source: I know your eyes don't work, shaman, but this one has green skin.
pairs.text: 我知道你眼睛不好使，萨满，这家伙可是个绿皮。

pairs.source: Hmph. Yes. Ga'nar is already causing trouble.
pairs.text: 唔，没错。贾纳尔已经惹出麻烦了。

pairs.source: Very well, strangers. You have earned the trust of our shaman. I will not turn away the help.
pairs.text: 好吧，陌生人。你们赢得了萨满的信任。如果你们真的愿意帮忙，我也不会拒绝。

pairs.source: I can barely stand. But for the actions of these heroes, I would be dead.
pairs.text: 我差点就撑不住了。要不是这些英雄相救，我早死了。

pairs.source: These are champions from a faraway realm, pledged to fight the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 这些是来自远方的勇士，也是钢铁部落的死敌。

pairs.source: I do not need eyes to see it; they are noble of heart. They saved our kin -- including your brother.
pairs.text: 我不用看也知道；他们都是高尚的人。他们救了我们的族人——包括你兄弟。

pairs.source: Come, friends. If you wish to fight with our clan, we welcome you to receive our blessings.
pairs.text: 来吧，朋友们。既然要与我们并肩作战，就来接受霜狼的祝福吧。

pairs.source: Reach out to the Shamanstone. Embrace the wisdom of this land and the ancestors that came before us.
pairs.text: 伸手触摸萨满之石。拥抱这片土地和我们先祖的智慧吧。
战士们！今天是个转折点。

pairs.source: We will claim Bladespire Citadel as our own.
pairs.text: 今天，我们将占领刀塔堡垒！

pairs.source: Fight as one. We win this - together!
pairs.text: 让我们并肩作战，共同赢得胜利！

pairs.source: Ga'nar is a great fighter, but he is impatient. He has taken some of our best warriors with him.
pairs.text: 贾纳尔是个好战士，但太过莽撞。他带走了我们最好的一批战士。

pairs.source: He never listens. His ruthlessness may cost us.
pairs.text: 他从不听人劝。他的鲁莽会葬送我们。

pairs.source: Here - Gormaul Tower. This will be our foothold. Leave none alive! LOK'TAR OGAR!
pairs.text: 我们到了——戈莫尔岗哨。它将成为我们的据点。不留活口！LOK'TAR OGAR！

pairs.source: The Bladespire ogres threw me into that hellhole. I'll notch my axe with their skulls until vengeance is mine!
pairs.text: 刀塔食人魔把我关在那鬼地方。我要报仇！用他们的脑壳磨亮我的斧子！

pairs.source: Bladespire Citadel! I will have my vengeance on those ogres, even if I have to tear it down stone by stone.
pairs.text: 刀塔堡垒！我要向那些食人魔复仇，哪怕将其夷为平地也在所不惜。

pairs.source: My friends, you have earned a hero's welcome. Follow us to the Frostwolf Chieftain.
pairs.text: 朋友们，你们获得了英雄般的礼遇。我们去见霜狼酋长。

pairs.source: My eyes may not work, but the familiar chill of the air is comforting.
pairs.text: 虽然看不见，但这熟悉的寒意让我舒心。

pairs.source: Ah yes. Garad's youngest: a noble soul named Durotan.
pairs.text: 没错。加拉达的幼子：可敬的杜隆坦。

pairs.source: Wise beyond his years, but still young. I fear he has been thrust into the Gronn's jaws - our people are in great danger.
pairs.text: 他很年轻，却睿智过人。我担心他已经成了戈隆的眼中钉——氏族正面临威胁。
你刚才提到了霜狼酋长……

pairs.source: Fomic ore is tougher than hardened steel. You will need my goren-toothed pick axe to cut through the rock.
pairs.text: 弗米克矿石比最坚硬的精钢还要硬。你要用我的鬣蜥人利齿矿工锄才能挖开它。

pairs.source: The spirits were kind to guide you to me at this moment.
pairs.text: 感谢万灵在这一刻将你带到我身边来。

pairs.source: It is done! The blade is forged.
You now stand before Na'Shra! Weaponsmith of the Frostwolf Clan. For your service, I give you mine.
pairs.text: 现在站在你面前的人是纳什拉！霜狼氏族的武器锻造师。为了感谢你的帮助，我愿意向你效忠。

pairs.source: You are hurt. Your flesh is pale.
The stench of a boar beast. Beware its tusks... Charge!
pairs.text: 野猪的臭味。小心它的獠牙……冲啊！

pairs.source: The tower is ours! Regroup and press on!
pairs.text: 岗哨归我们了！重新整队，前进！

pairs.source: I will ride ahead. Frostwolves, hold the tower. Igrimar, with me!
pairs.text: 我得到前面去。霜狼们，守住岗哨。伊戈利玛，跟我来！

pairs.source: I will forestall any counterattacks by the enemy. Lok'tar ogar!
pairs.text: 我来拦住敌人的反击。 Lok'tar ogar！

pairs.source: Stand down, Warlord. It is over.
No slave fights with the will of one who is free.
pairs.text: 奴隶不会有自由人的战斗意志。

pairs.source: The Thunderlords retreat! They are making their way through Thunder Pass to the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 雷神氏族撤退了！他们沿着雷霆小径往钢铁部落那儿去了。

pairs.source: They are going to retaliate. We must be ready.
pairs.text: 他们还会回来的。我们得做好准备。

pairs.source: No, I will never be okay with this.
Come! To Thunder Pass. We are outnumbered 50 to 1. They don't stand a chance!
pairs.text: 来吧！去雷霆小径。敌我人数是五十比一。他们毫无机会！

pairs.source: Thank you, child. I can always count on you.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，孩子。我就知道你能靠得住。

pairs.source: There! Is this what you seek, Prophet?
pairs.text: 给！这就是你要找到的东西吗，先知？
克鲁恩来了！勇士，跟我来。

pairs.source: If I try to release Exurotus it is sure to bring Kron down on us.
pairs.text: 如果我试图释放埃克索图斯，它肯定会引来克鲁恩。

pairs.source: Frostwolves! The Iron Horde is coming. As we speak, they march on Thunder Pass.
pairs.text: 霜狼们！钢铁部落来了。眼下，他们正涌向雷霆小径。

pairs.source: But the Frostwolf clan is reunited! Together, we can protect this land!
pairs.text: 但霜狼氏族已经统一！我们将携手保卫家园！

pairs.source: You know me, brother. I'm always ready to fight.
pairs.text: 我随时都能战斗，你是知道的。

pairs.source: Hold your position, Frostwolves! Let them come to you!
pairs.text: 霜狼们，坚守阵地！把他们放过来打！

pairs.source: Axes up! Here they come again!
Drek'Thar's in trouble. Ga'nar, get out there and lend him a hand.
pairs.text: 德雷克塔尔有麻烦了。贾纳尔，去帮他一把。

pairs.source: Fall back! Prepare for the next attack!
Hero, approach my totem for aid!
pairs.text: 英雄，靠近我的图腾接受援助！

pairs.source: Frostwolves! Stand strong! The battle is nearly done!
pairs.text: 霜狼们！坚持住！战斗就要结束了！

pairs.source: Drek'Thar! How much time do you need?
pairs.text: 德雷克塔尔！你还要多久？

pairs.source: We are counting on you, shaman!
I do. Something big is coming.
pairs.text: 听到了。有个大家伙过来了。

pairs.source: All Frostwolves - charge ahead! Take that thing down!
pairs.text: 霜狼们——冲锋！打倒那家伙！

pairs.source: Draka, make your way to the cave the scout spotted. I will meet the commander at the coastal village.
pairs.text: 德拉卡！你去斥候发现的那座山洞看看。我到海边的村子去跟指挥官汇合。

pairs.source: Champion, we will meet you ahead when you are done with your mission.
pairs.text: 勇士，等你完成自己的任务之后，就到前面去找我们吧。
让它离德雷克塔尔远点！

pairs.source: Exurotus is too weak. The most I can do is free him of his bonds. Death will claim him shortly afterward.
pairs.text: 艾索洛托斯太虚弱了。我最多只能帮他解开束缚。但他很快就会死的。

pairs.source: There must be something you can do.
The fury is dying. We don't have much time.
pairs.text: 它就快死了，我们没有时间了。

pairs.source: There might be something. Exurotus, I offer my spirit as host to your own. Join with me, so that your fire may not be quenched.
pairs.text: 有个办法。艾索洛托斯，寄宿在我的灵魂中，与我融合。你的火焰或许就不会熄灭。

pairs.source: Drek'Thar, what has it done to you?
pairs.text: 德雷克塔尔，它对你做了什么？

pairs.source: He has become one with the fury. Their spirits are now merged.
pairs.text: 他和霜火之怒融合了。他们的灵魂合而为一了。

pairs.source: I... I can see. I can see the shift of the elements, the movement of the spirits through the land. It is glorious.
pairs.text: 我……看到了。我看到元素的变迁，万灵在土地上迁徙。太……太壮观了。

pairs.source: The ogres will suffer for what they've done!
pairs.text: 食人魔将为他们的所作所为付出代价！
我们要守护自己的边疆！
我们要守护自己的边疆！
什么都好，千万别是鲜花！

pairs.source: So the wolves have come to play with the skulls? I will speak with Durotan but I will not hold out hope. His wolves are soft and lack conviction.
pairs.text: 这么说，霜狼想要跟嘲颅一起玩玩？我得跟杜隆坦谈谈，但我对此不抱希望。他的狼都很软弱，而且缺乏信念。

pairs.source: Ahhh!!!!! Finish it! Just let me die!
No excuses, Kor'gall. We are at WAR with another world. Motivate your people, get a mining pick yourself, I do not care. You WILL meet your quota or find your clan the target of our next weapon test.
pairs.text: 别找借口，考戈尔。我们正在与另一个世界作战。我不管你是去鼓动你的人民，还是拿起矿锄自己干。但你必须完成分派给你的定额，否则你的氏族就将成为我们下一次武器试射的目标。

pairs.source: Here, let me make some adjustments.
Durotan? Draka? What are YOU doing here?
pairs.text: 杜隆坦？德拉卡？你们在这儿干什么？

pairs.source: Orgrim Doomhammer! You will be made to answer for your attack on my people!
pairs.text: 奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤！你必须为你对我的人民发动的袭击付出代价！

pairs.source: Stay your hand, hero. I want him alive.
pairs.text: 住手，英雄。我要让他活着。

pairs.source: I have not forgotten or forgiven that. But Orgrim was once an honorable orc, and my closest friend. I owe it to him to at least try to help him regain some of his honor.
pairs.text: 我不是想忘记或宽恕他的罪行。但奥格瑞姆曾是一个高尚的兽人，是我最好的朋友。我至少应该给他一个重拾荣耀的机会。

pairs.source: Always sentimental, Durotan. I am as loyal to my people as you are to yours. Do not presume that I walk this path willingly. Some things are more important than honor.
pairs.text: 你还是这么多愁善感，杜隆坦。和你一样，我也要忠于我的人民。别以为我是自愿走上这条路的。有些事比荣誉更重要。

pairs.source: Husband? It was his forces that killed your brother.
pairs.text: 丈夫？是他的军队杀害了你的兄弟。

pairs.source: So much for subtlety. Those Laughing Skull are going to get us all killed.
pairs.text: 所谓的妙计也不过如此。嘲颅氏族的那些家伙会把我们都害死的。

pairs.source: Hmph. I remember ogre architecture being more formidable.
pairs.text: 唔。我记得食人魔的建筑应该要比这坚固得多。

pairs.source: I issued no such order. I wanted your people to join us and protect this world from the threat of those beyond the portal.
pairs.text: 我没下过这种命令。我是想让你的人民加入我们，共同抵抗来自传送门另一边的威胁。

pairs.source: Not long ago, we were orcs of many clans, quibbling over scraps in a world that was ours for the taking.
pairs.text: 不久之前，我们还是分属不同氏族的兽人，为了一点残羹冷炙争斗不休，忽视了本该属于我们的世界。

pairs.source: Now, as one clan, no enemy can hope to stand against the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 而现在，作为一个统一的氏族，没有敌人能够阻挡钢铁部落！

pairs.source: We will crush their bones beneath our boots.  We will burn their cities to ash!
pairs.text: 我们将踏碎他们的尸骨。我们要烧毁他们的城市！

pairs.source: The iron tide washes over them!
pairs.text: 钢铁狂潮将会湮没他们！

pairs.source: The doom that is coming will destroy us all. These outsiders will bring a wave of fire and death down upon us if the orcs do not act as one to destroy them first.
pairs.text: 即将降临的灾难将毁灭我们所有人。如果兽人们不能齐心协力，先发制人，这些外来者就会把烈火和死亡倾泻到我们头上。

pairs.source: Because I have witnessed it! Every night! Every night for many months now. My dreams become nightmares, and in those nightmares I watch helplessly as the land corrupts beneath our feet and the sky is turned to fire.
pairs.text: 因为我亲眼见证过这一幕！每个晚上！许多个月以来，夜夜如此。我的梦境变成梦魇，在那些噩梦中，我无助地看着我们脚下的大地被腐蚀，天空化为火海。

pairs.source: Say what you will, but this is the doom that is coming. And it is these creatures from beyond the portal that will bring it.
pairs.text: 不管你们怎么想，但末日即将来领。而这些来自传送门另一头的生物，就是造成灾难的罪魁祸首。

pairs.source: And how can you be so certain of such a fate?
I have never known the great Doomhammer to be afraid of anything.
pairs.text: 我可从来不知道伟大的毁灭之锤也有害怕的时候。

pairs.source: Cho'gall! I sent you here to enslave this thing.
pairs.text: 古加尔！我是派你来奴役这个家伙的。

pairs.source: Yes! Let us free ALL of the skulls! Remind them how to laugh! Burn all of the slavers to ash and ruin!
pairs.text: 好了！让我们解放所有的嘲颅兽人吧！让他们想起该怎么笑！把这些奴隶贩子都烧成灰烬！

pairs.source: Hero, meet us at Twilight Glade. We must save the prisoners.
pairs.text: 英雄，到暮光林地去找我吧。我们必须救出那些俘虏。

pairs.source: Burn burn burn burn torch and burn and cinder and burn and FIRE!
Thank you, champion. I have always felt my fate and that of the Dark Star are intertwined.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，勇士。我早就预感我的命运会与黑暗之星发生交集。

pairs.source: Light. Pure light. Hope in times of despair, brightness in our darkest hour!
pairs.text: 圣光。纯粹的圣光。绝望时代的希望，我们黑暗中的光明！

pairs.source: Ner'zhul's ritual... begins! We are out of time!
pairs.text: 耐奥祖的仪式……开始了！我们要没时间了！

pairs.source: We must stop the Shadowmoon Chieftain.
pairs.text: 我们必须阻止影月酋长。

pairs.source: What needs to be done, child.
Hurry, champion. I will get there as soon as I can.
pairs.text: 快，勇士。我会尽快赶来的。

pairs.source: Do whatever you can to delay Ner'zhul...
Prophet! What have you done to yourself!?

pairs.text: 嘲颅！嘲颅！哈哈哈哈哈哈！
嘲颅！嘲颅！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

pairs.source: Yrel! We will spill some orcish blood...
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔！我们要让兽人血债血偿……

pairs.source: I am your Chieftain; you and your warriors will fall back in line.
pairs.text: 我是酋长；我命令你立即把你的人撤回来。

pairs.source: OUR - FATHER - would BE - ASHAMED - of WHAT - YOU'VE - BECOME!
pairs.text: 你现在这副样子，真让父亲蒙羞！

pairs.source: Our strength comes from working together.
pairs.text: 我们的力量来自团结一致。

pairs.source: Yrel, walk with us a moment...
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔，跟我们一起走走吧……

pairs.source: I... already told you... all that I know...
The Iron Horde will not hesitate to use that cannon on our base. We should find a more tactical location.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落会毫不犹豫地用那门火炮对准我们的营地。我们得换个地方。

pairs.source: Yes, everyone appears to be alright.
Very well. We will set up camp ahead, and deal with this cannon.
pairs.text: 很好。我们得在前面扎营，然后再来对付这门火炮。

pairs.source: Everybody in the Tank. Yrel is being held as a slave in the Stonemaul ogres' slave camp.
pairs.text: 各位。伊瑞尔正被关押在石槌食人魔的奴隶营地里。

pairs.source: Yrel might already be free if it weren't for the actions of one deceitful rangari.
pairs.text: 要不是某个谎话连篇的游侠，伊瑞尔没准已经得救了。

pairs.source: I did what I thought was right, Vindicator. The missing girl seems to be distracting you from our mission.
pairs.text: 我做了我认为正确的选择，守备官。那个失踪的女孩让你无法专注于我们的任务。

pairs.source: Yeah, what's so special about this girl anyway?
pairs.text: 没错，这个女孩到底有什么特别的？

pairs.source: I lost her once. I will not lose her again.
pairs.text: 我曾失去过她一次。我不能再失去她了。

pairs.source: Now THAT'S somethin' I can get behind.
Besides, the ogres're sellin' slaves to the Iron Horde. Stoppin' ta beat 'em up fer a bit is well within the scope o' our mission.
pairs.text: 而且，食人魔在向钢铁部落出售奴隶。在任务范围内教训他们一下也挺不错的。

pairs.source: You all is gonna get smashed.
Oh no, ogre, that's where you have it wrong. You see, we are the ones that will be doing the smashing today. Thaelin?
pairs.text: 噢，食人魔，那你可就错了。你瞧，今天，我们才是揍人的一方。塞林？

pairs.source: Now is our chance! Forward, Thaelin, with speed!
pairs.text: 我们机会来了！塞林，全速前进！

pairs.source: Stay silent, all of you! Ogre, if you so much as GRUNT, I will personally beat the Light out of you.
pairs.text: 你们都给我安静点儿！食人魔，你要是再嘟嘟囔囔的，我就亲手揍扁你。

pairs.source: We can set up over there.
Ok'mokk didn't make no sounds at all. You don' need ta smash Ok'mokk.
pairs.text: 奥克默克再也不出声了，别打奥克默克。

pairs.source: Ach, I have a feelin' yer gonna get smashed anyway.
pairs.text: 哎，我预感你肯定要挨揍了。

pairs.source: A direct attack. A bold decision.
pairs.text: 直接攻击。一个大胆的决定。

pairs.source: Form up, everyone. We are headed to Smokebelcher Depot.
pairs.text: 所有人，集合整队。我们要向硝烟仓栈进发了。

pairs.source: Form up, everyone. We are headed to the Planteau. [TEMP NAME]
pairs.text: 所有人，集合整队。我们要向高地进发了。

pairs.source: Room for one more on that elekk?
pairs.text: 那头雷象还能多载一个人吗？

pairs.source: Yrel, did you learn anything about the Goliath Cannon before your capture?
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔，你在被捕之前，侦察到什么有关巨灵火炮的情报吗？

pairs.source: A bit. The one you destroyed was merely a prototype. The actual cannons are built in the foundry, to the north.
pairs.text: 我查到了一点。你们摧毁的那门火炮只是一个样品。北边的军工厂里正在建造实战用的火炮。

pairs.source: I overheard one of the orcish leaders discussing a plan to use them on Shattrath.
pairs.text: 我偷听到一个兽人头目说，他们打算用这些火炮去攻打沙塔斯。

pairs.source: Shattrath? Ha! Even that big ol' hunk o' metal couldn't hit Shattrath from here.
pairs.text: 沙塔斯？哈！就算是那个大铁疙瘩也不可能从这里打到沙塔斯啊。

pairs.source: They could if it was loaded onta' a boat.
pairs.text: 如果它们被装上船，那就不一定了。

pairs.source: I suspected the same thing. They must plan to load the cannons onto barges at the Naval Base, in the northeast.
pairs.text: 我也是这么想的。他们肯定是打算把那些炮装到东北边的海军基地里那些战舰上。

pairs.source: Our small group would never survive an attack on the Naval Base. Too fortified.
pairs.text: 我们这支小队不可能去突袭海军基地。那里的守卫太森严了。

pairs.source: We will continue attacking their supply lines.
pairs.text: 我们应该继续骚扰他们的补给线。

pairs.source: D'kaan, how long have you been scouting out here in Gorgrond?
pairs.text: 达坎，你在戈尔隆德游历多久了？

pairs.source: A very long time. Longer than you've been alive, probably by two or threefold.
pairs.text: 很久，比你活过的年头还要长，可能是它的两、三倍。

pairs.source: A rangari who is not lonely is not doing his job.
pairs.text: 耐不住寂寞的游侠不是好游侠。

pairs.source: Sounds like a crap job to me. Life ain't worth livin' if y'don't have lads and a lass t'come home to.
pairs.text: 听起来完全不合适我。如果家里没有老婆孩子等着，这种生活毫无意义。

pairs.source: Do you have a wife, Hansel?

pairs.text: 哎……她被黑石兽人抓走了。

pairs.source: That's half o'why I'm here: ta look after Thaelin, and ta get me wife back.
pairs.text: 那也是我来这里的原因之一：来保护塞林，还有找回我的妻子。

pairs.source: We will find your wife, Hansel. And we will leave a wake of bodies behind us. The orcs will pay with blood for what they did to our families.
pairs.text: 我们会找到你妻子的，汉瑟尔。我们还要把这里杀个血流成河。兽人将为他们对我们亲人的所作所为付出血的代价。

pairs.source: Y'know, that's the darkest, coldest, most inspirin' thing I've ever heard from the lips of a paladin.
pairs.text: 知道吗，这是我从一个圣骑士嘴里听到的最黑暗、最冷酷、最振奋人心的话。

pairs.source: Our work here is done. Next, we head to Smokebelcher Depot.
pairs.text: 我们在这里的任务已经完成了。接下来，我们该去硝烟仓栈了。

pairs.source: Our work here is done. Next, we head to the Planteau.
pairs.text: 我们在这里的任务已经完成了。接下来，我们该去硝烟仓栈了。

pairs.source: Thaelin, are you doing alright in there?
Quite fine, ma'am. Just happy to be out o' combat and back in me Tank.
pairs.text: 很好，女士。我很高兴能远离战场，回到我的坦克里。

pairs.source: <sigh> This land is plagued by war. Do you think you'll return to the safety of home after our mission is done?
pairs.text: <叹气>这片土地上到处都是肆虐的战火。你觉得我们完成任务后，还能安全回家吗？

pairs.source: I dunno how much you've heard about Azeroth, ma'am, but we've got our fair share of war, too.
pairs.text: 我不知道你对艾泽拉斯了解多少，女士，但我们那儿也不太平。

pairs.source: Once I've found me Ellie, I know I'll be headed back ta Searin' Gorge.
pairs.text: 我只知道等我找到我的艾利，我就回灼热峡谷去。

pairs.source: What about you, lassie? Will ye go home?
pairs.text: 你呢，丫头？你打算回家吗？

pairs.source: With Velen gone, I feel like I don't have a home anymore.
pairs.text: 维伦去世后，我觉得我已经没有家了。

pairs.source: We are draenei, Yrel. Being without a home is in our nature.
pairs.text: 我们是德莱尼，伊瑞尔。我们天生就无家可归。

pairs.source: I was thinking I might go through the portal with you, my love.
pairs.text: 我在想是不是该跟你到传送门的另一边去，亲爱的。

pairs.source: Yes, Yrel. You will have a home on Azeroth.
pairs.text: 当然，伊瑞尔。艾泽拉斯将成为你的新家。

pairs.source: But first, we will make these orcs suffer for what they did to you. Their sins cannot be forgiven.
pairs.text: 但首先，我们要让这些兽人为他们对你所做的一切付出代价。他们的罪行不可饶恕。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde's supply lines are now cut, however temporarily. We have forged our alliance with the Shapers.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的补给线已经被切断了，但这只是暂时的。我们得跟塑造者们结盟。

pairs.source: There will never be a better time than this. Let us head to the Naval Base and exact our vengeance on the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 眼下就是最好的时机。让我们到海军基地那儿去，向钢铁部落复仇吧！
我们的计划是什么，玛尔拉德？

pairs.source: We will slay as many of the vile things as we can. We will burn their homes and show them fear.
pairs.text: 我们要尽力多干掉一些恶棍，烧毁他们的家园，让他们尝到恐惧的滋味。

pairs.source: I will make them feel the pain I felt when I lost you, Yrel.
pairs.text: 我要让他们感受到我失去你时的那种痛苦，伊瑞尔。

pairs.source: ...but perhaps you are taking your vengeance too far. Have you forgotten what the Prophet taught us?
pairs.text: ……但你似乎太过执着于复仇了。你忘了先知对我们的教导了吗？

pairs.source: The prophet is DEAD, Yrel. Look what his teachings did for him.
pairs.text: 先知已经死了，伊瑞尔。看看他的教导给他带来了什么吧。

pairs.source: The Light's left ye. Even I can see that.
pairs.text: 圣光正在远离你。连我都看出来了。

pairs.source: I carry no particular love for the Light, but I agree. You need to remember what you stand for, Vindicator.
pairs.text: 我并不怎么热爱圣光，可我同意他们的话。你不能忘了自己的立场，守备官。

pairs.source: Are any of you more holy than me? I am the LEADER of this expedition, and I will not be questioned any further!
pairs.text: 你们有谁比我更神圣？我是这支队伍的领袖，我不想再听到任何质疑！

pairs.source: The Light has not left me, Thaelin. No... the Light has finally shown me its true form.
pairs.text: 圣光并未远离我，塞林。不……圣光已经向我展现了它的真容。

pairs.source: I saw the naaru's vengeance in the Purge of Grommar. I was there as K'ara herself unleashed holy death upon the filthy hordes.
pairs.text: 我在清洗格罗玛尔的战斗中见识到了纳鲁的复仇。我看到卡拉亲自将神圣的死亡播撒到那群肮脏的乌合之众头上。
玛尔拉德，亲爱的，已经够了。

pairs.source: You have been through too much, Maraad. Your thirst for vengeance will only lead to our death.
pairs.text: 你经历了太多悲剧，玛尔拉德。你对复仇的执念只会害死我们大家。

pairs.source: Rest now. I will lead our attack on the Naval Base.
pairs.text: 休息一下吧。让我来指挥对海军基地的突袭。

pairs.source: Thank you, Yrel. I don't know what's coming over me.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，伊瑞尔。我不知道自己是怎么了。

pairs.source: It is no matter. These souls are mine. My power grows.
pairs.text: 没关系。这些灵魂都归我了。我的力量正在增长。

pairs.source: Auchindoun will be mine! I will devour every last soul and bathe the ashes in hellfire!
pairs.text: 奥金顿将属于我！我要吞掉所有的灵魂，沐浴在地狱火的灰烬之中！
是的，图拉妮。这下你明白了。

pairs.source: Your efforts were valiant. I did not think the anchorites could power the defenses with only one of the crystals.
pairs.text: 你的努力是徒劳的。学者们不可能仅仅靠一块水晶来为防御工事供能。

pairs.source: But nothing will stop my plan, nor that of my masters. And the only things in our way...
pairs.text: 但什么都不能阻止我的计划，或者我的主人。而我们唯一的障碍……
守护者！消灭这些入侵者！

pairs.source: Wow! Thanks! I can find my way out of here now. I'm sure I won't get captured again. See ya!
pairs.text: 哇！谢谢！到了这里，我就能自己出去了。我肯定不会再被抓住了。再见！

pairs.source: I fear that even with the Heart intact, Auchindoun's defenses may not be enough. The Shadow Council has eyes everywhere.
pairs.text: 我担心就算奥金顿之心恢复完整，那里的防御也还是不够。暗影议会的耳目向来无孔不入。

pairs.source: Confound these wards! No matter how much I call upon the light to purge them it is as if the wards themselves thwart my ability to unmake them.
pairs.text: 解除这些结界！无论我怎么召唤圣光来净化它们，这些结界似乎总能抵消我的解除技能。
准备好面对瑞梵妮了吗？
准备好面对瑞梵妮了吗？

pairs.source: Child! Leave now. Those wards were there for your protection. You should not be here.
pairs.text: 孩子！快走。那些结界是保护你的。你不应该来这儿。

pairs.source: Yes. And she will never be yours.
pairs.text: 是的。她永远不会属于你。

pairs.source: Tuulani, go to Telmor and meet with Soulbinder Aedraa. She has retrieved the final fragment and brought it there.
pairs.text: 图拉妮，你去泰尔莫找缚魂者艾德拉。她已经取回了最后一块水晶并将它带去了那里。

pairs.source: De slaves are ready for ye boss.
pairs.text: 奴隶已经准备好了，头儿。

pairs.source: Good, their wretched spirits will serve me better than their weak bodies ever could!
pairs.text: 很好，相比那孱弱的躯体，他们可悲的灵魂对我更有用！

pairs.source: Ahhhh... Yes, now the Soulgrinder hums with power! With this, we shall be unstoppable!
pairs.text: 啊……没错，磨魂者开始散发出能量了！有了它，我们必将百战百胜！

pairs.source: Looks like there's only one way out, hero. UP!
pairs.text: 看来那就是唯一的出路了，英雄。快上去！

pairs.source: You do not understand the Great Work.
pairs.text: 你们无法理解这伟大的工程。

pairs.source: You cannot defy the Great Work.
pairs.text: 你们别想破坏我们的工程。

pairs.source: This is the way of things. You cannot stop it.
pairs.text: 这是万物演化之道。你们休想阻挠。

pairs.source: You do not understand... You cannot know...
I must return to the spirit world to continue my research. Guard this room and make sure that NO ONE touches the portal!
pairs.text: 我必须返回灵魂世界来继续我的研究。守好这个房间，绝对不能让任何人触碰传送门！

pairs.source: Come forth, Soulgrinder! Devour the souls that we have brought for you!
pairs.text: 来吧，磨魂者！来享用我们为你准备的灵魂吧！

pairs.source: Axes down, brothers! Don't you recognize your own clan?
pairs.text: 住手，兄弟们！都认不出自己的同胞了吗？

pairs.source: What do you make of it, Thrall?
It reeks of hatred and dust, Choluna. I don't like having it here at the garrison.
pairs.text: 它充斥着怨恨和尘土，楚伦娜。我不想将它留在要塞里。

pairs.source: I'd like it even less in the hands of the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 但我更不想让它落在钢铁部落手里。

pairs.source: Perhaps. First, we must find out what purpose it serves for Blackhand.
pairs.text: 或许吧。但首先，我们要搞清楚它对黑手有什么用。

pairs.source: Choluna, step up our operation in Gorgrond. Whatever the Iron Horde are planning, I want to be ready.
pairs.text: 楚伦娜，我们要加快在戈尔隆德的行动了。无论钢铁部落有什么阴谋，我们都应做好准备。

pairs.source: And what are you supposed to be?
This is Frostwolf territory, but you may claim this plateau as your own. Consider it a reward for rescuing my people.
pairs.text: 这里是霜狼的土地，但作为拯救我族人的奖赏，这片土地就归你们了。

pairs.source: Thank you, chieftain. We will establish a foothold immediately.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，酋长。我们这就动手修建要塞。

pairs.source: Even our wyverns are not prepared for this type of cold.
pairs.text: 就连我们的双足飞龙都受不了这种严寒的天气。

pairs.source: Even our wyverns are not prepared for this type of cold.
pairs.text: 就连我们的双足飞龙都受不了这种严寒的天气。

pairs.source: It looks as though we will not have allies in the skies for this one.
pairs.text: 这里的天空似乎都特别不友好。

pairs.source: It looks as though we will not have allies in the skies for this one.
pairs.text: 这里的天空似乎都特别不友好。

pairs.source: We are going to have to find a better way to shield our wyvern from the cold.
pairs.text: 我们得想一个更好的办法，来帮助我们的双足飞龙保暖。

pairs.source: We are going to have to find a better way to shield our wyvern from the cold.
pairs.text: 我们得想一个更好的办法，来帮助我们的双足飞龙保暖。

pairs.source: It would seem we need to rely on the local rylak for air travel.
pairs.text: 看来我们得依靠当地的双头飞龙来飞行了。

pairs.source: It would seem we need to rely on the local rylak for air travel.
pairs.text: 看来我们得依靠当地的双头飞龙来飞行了。

pairs.source: What do you make of it, Yrel?
It reeks of hatred and dust, Omnuron. I don't like this.
pairs.text: 它充斥和怨恨和尘土，欧穆隆。我不喜欢它。

pairs.source: This terrain is ideal for a stronghold.
I can open up a portal to Orgrimmar only briefly. Reinforcements are standing by, I hope?
pairs.text: 我可以打开一道通往奥格瑞玛的传送门，但维持不了多久。那边援军应该已经整装待发了吧？

pairs.source: ... You're entrusting a goblin to be your foreman?
Gazlowe, here, oversaw the construction of Orgrimmar.
pairs.text: 加兹鲁维主持修建了奥格瑞玛。
奥格瑞玛！永不陷落之城！
它最近不是刚被攻陷吗？

pairs.source: Yeah yeah, okay, one little sacking.
Omnuron, step up our operation in Gorgrond. Whatever the Iron Horde are planning, I want to be ready.
pairs.text: 欧穆隆，要加快我们在戈尔隆德的行动了。无论钢铁部落有什么阴谋，我们都得做好准备。

pairs.source: What is this -- Wise-ear! You are alive!
pairs.text: 这是什么——慧耳！你还活着！

pairs.source: Lead us to Durotan, old friend.
pairs.text: 老朋友，带我们去找杜隆坦！

pairs.source: Wor'gol is the winter home of the Frostwolf Clan.
pairs.text: 沃高尔是霜狼氏族的冬季家园。

pairs.source: Durotan walks a cliff's edge, pinned between the Thunderlord orcs and Bladespire ogres.
pairs.text: 杜隆坦就像在走钢丝，周旋于雷神兽人和刀塔食人魔之间。

pairs.source: Ga'nar seemed bent on dealing out retribution to both.
pairs.text: 而贾纳尔似乎已决心向这两者复仇了。

pairs.source: Ah yes! I worry about Durotan's brother. Always quick to fight. His need for vengeance will make him more reckless than ever.
pairs.text: 啊，没错！我很担心他。他总是那么急躁。对复仇的渴望会让他更加鲁莽。

pairs.source: What is THAT? I see a fortress of stone!
pairs.text: 那是什么？一座岩石堡垒！

pairs.source: Bladespire Citadel. Once a far-flung outpost of the ogre empire.
pairs.text: 那是刀塔堡垒。它曾是食人魔帝国的边境哨所。

pairs.source: If our people are to have any hope to survive, we must rout the ogres from their stronghold.
pairs.text: 如果氏族想要生存下去，就必须赶走堡垒里的食人魔。

pairs.source: This is Durotan's goal. He will not ask for it, but we will need your help!
pairs.text: 这是杜隆坦的目标。他不会开口求助，但我们需要你！

pairs.source: Ga'nar did not wait for the muster call. His blood burns too hot.
pairs.text: 贾纳尔已经等不及了。他实在是太冲动了。

pairs.source: Go! Win us a great victory. Tell my husband I will defend the town until he returns.
pairs.text: 去吧！打场胜仗回来。告诉我丈夫，我会守住村子，等他回来的。

pairs.source: The Legion won't give up so easily. Auchindoun is too valuable to them.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团是不会轻易放弃的。奥金顿对他们来说太有价值了。

pairs.source: Teron'gor! The Light comes for you!
pairs.text: 塔隆戈尔！圣光来制裁你了！

pairs.source: The Legion will not stop here. They desire Auchindoun too much.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团绝不会止步于此。他们太渴望得到奥金顿了。

pairs.source: Nyami. Tuulani. We ride for Light's Rest immediately.
pairs.text: 尼娅米，图拉妮。我们得立刻赶去圣光之眠。

pairs.source: The vanguard is falling. We will not let their great sacrifice be in vain!
pairs.text: 先锋军倒下了。我们决不能让他们的巨大牺牲白白浪费！

pairs.source: Your sacrifices will not be forgotten, Netherwane.
pairs.text: 你的牺牲会被人们所铭记的，奈瑟维。

pairs.source: Archmage, let me stay behind. It was my sworn duty to watch over this portal.
pairs.text: 大法师，让我留下断后吧。看守这座传送门本就是我的职责。

pairs.source: I shared that duty with you, Dar'toon.  We will meet the enemy together.
pairs.text: 我与你分担了那项使命，达图恩。我们也将共同迎敌。

pairs.source: They will sing songs of your heroism, Dar'toon.
pairs.text: 你的英勇事迹将被人们所传唱，达图恩。

pairs.source: Just get me free, stranger. I could kill a hundred of these pigs with this shovel alone.
pairs.text: 放我出来，陌生人。我可以用这把铲子杀死几百头蠢猪。

pairs.source: Prepare to heroically CTRL-E through the portal with me!
pairs.text: 准备跟我一起勇敢地跨过传送门！

pairs.source: I'll lead the wounded to safety. Cover our escape!
pairs.text: 我把伤员送到安全的地方去。掩护我们！
无论你是谁……总之谢谢你。
无论你是谁……总之谢谢你。

pairs.source: They were bleeding us dry. I don't think we had much longer...
pairs.text: 他们想让我们的鲜血流干。我觉得我们坚持不了多久了……

pairs.source: They were bleeding us dry. I don't think we had much longer...
pairs.text: 他们想让我们的鲜血流干。我觉得我们坚持不了多久了……
无论你是谁……总之谢谢你。
无论你是谁……总之谢谢你。

pairs.source: They were bleeding us dry. I don't think we had much longer...
pairs.text: 他们想让我们的鲜血流干。我觉得我们坚持不了多久了……

pairs.source: They were bleeding us dry. I don't think we had much longer...
pairs.text: 他们想让我们的鲜血流干。我觉得我们坚持不了多久了……

pairs.source: Blessings to you, stranger. Because of you, I will see daylight once more.
pairs.text: 祝福你，陌生人。多亏了你，我才能重见天日。

pairs.source: Thank you, stranger! I was supposed to be their next meal...
pairs.text: 谢谢你，陌生人！我差点就变成了他们的盘中餐……

pairs.source: Thank you, hero. I can fight my way out of here on my own.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，英雄。到了这里，我就能自己杀出去了。

pairs.source: We must deny Teron'gor entrance to Auchindoun. Come, let us meet at Retribution Point and discuss how to bring the fight to the enemy.
pairs.text: 我们决不能让塔隆戈尔进入奥金顿。来吧，我会在惩戒岗哨等你，我们得讨论一下如何才能打败敌人。

pairs.source: You have *cough* restored this dying orc's honor, champion. Farewell. And farewell, Snowpaw, my old friend...
pairs.text: 你*咳嗽*恢复了这位垂死兽人的荣光，勇士。再见了。还有雪足，我的老朋友，再见……

pairs.source: Thank you, hero. Your deeds will be remembered.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，英雄。你的英勇事迹将被人们所铭记。

pairs.source: You wouldn't last ten seconds against me, draenei.
pairs.text: 在我面前，你连十秒钟都撑不过去，德莱尼。

pairs.source: Two on one? Now, you speak my language!
That's not very sportsmanlike, Bladefist. Why don't we settle this in the arena?
pairs.text: 真是没有竞技精神啊，刃拳。我们为什么不去竞技场解决这场纷争呢？

pairs.source: Hold everything! Now, they speak my language!
pairs.text: 都住手！他们的话很合我胃口！

pairs.source: But I'm afraid you're not much more than a warm-up, draenei. Doesn't anyone else feel like dying today?
pairs.text: 但我恐怕你也只能让我热热身了，德莱尼。今天就没有其他人要来送死了吗？

pairs.source: Return to Khadgar, champion! We will buy you the time you need!
pairs.text: 回去找卡德加吧，勇士！我们会帮你争取时间的！

pairs.source: I feel the flames dying down. What is happening, exarch?
pairs.text: 我感觉烈焰正在熄灭。出什么事了，大主教？

pairs.source: We have a visitor. Perhaps... a savior.
pairs.text: 我们有客人了。也许……还是我们的救星。

pairs.source: We are freed! Follow me, shaman. We will escape through the hills.
pairs.text: 我们自由了！跟我走，萨满。我们得翻山逃跑。

pairs.source: He is right. The Iron Horde will move against us. We must be ready.
pairs.text: 他说的对。钢铁部落会来的。我们得做好准备。

pairs.source: No, I will never be okay with this.
You take care of the lieutenants, champion. Bladefist is mine.
pairs.text: 你去对付那些尉官，勇士。刃拳就交给我吧。

pairs.source: Cutting down unarmed prisoners? Why not fight a real battle?
pairs.text: 竟然屠杀手无寸铁的囚犯？为什么不来一场真正的战斗呢？

pairs.source: Master Velen, I have never led soldiers before. Are you sure--
pairs.text: 可维伦大师，我从没带过兵。你确定——

pairs.source: You are capable of more than you know, Yrel.
pairs.text: 你的能力超出了你的想象，伊瑞尔。

pairs.source: Now go. The Rangari follow your orders. Find the prisoners.
pairs.text: 去吧。游侠们会听从你的指挥。去找到那些俘虏。

pairs.source: Just be ready when our ships arrive at Karabor.
pairs.text: 我们的战舰即将抵达卡拉波，做好准备。

pairs.source: What is this? Oh, no... no...
...The protector... still answers her call... you'll have to defeat it!
pairs.text: ……守护者……仍然听从她的命令……你必须击败它！

pairs.source: Are YOU, Tuulani, and your outsider friends.
pairs.text: 就是你，图拉妮，还有你的外来者朋友。

pairs.source: Try as you might, this place is doomed. It is only a matter of time...
pairs.text: 尽管去尝试吧，但这个地方已经完了。毁灭只是时间问题……

pairs.source: Yes! Yes! The crystal hums... just a bit of focus and...
pairs.text: 很好！很好！水晶开始共鸣……只需要调整一下焦距并且……

pairs.source: Now, let's see how THEY like being cut open!
pairs.text: 现在，让我们看看他们被活剐时的表情吧！

pairs.source: Now, let's see how THEY like being cut open!
pairs.text: 现在，让我们看看他们被活剐时的表情吧！

pairs.source: I thought I was going to die here.
pairs.text: 我还以为我要死在这儿了。

pairs.source: I thought I was going to die here.
pairs.text: 我还以为我要死在这儿了。

pairs.source: You have no idea how long I've been waiting to do this.
pairs.text: 你不会明白我等这一刻等了多久。

pairs.source: You have no idea how long I've been waiting to do this.
pairs.text: 你不会明白我等这一刻等了多久。
我会为你报仇的，塔诺什。
我会为你报仇的，塔诺什。

pairs.source: May your spirit find rest with those of your people's ancestors.
pairs.text: 愿你的灵魂与先祖一同安息。

pairs.source: May your spirit find rest with those of your people's ancestors.
pairs.text: 愿你的灵魂与先祖一同安息。

pairs.source: Make them suffer, like I suffered.
pairs.text: 让他们也尝尝我所受的痛苦。

pairs.source: Make them suffer, like I suffered.
pairs.text: 让他们也尝尝我所受的痛苦。

pairs.source: I've never held a weapon before.
pairs.text: 我之前从来都没拿过武器。

pairs.source: I've never held a weapon before.
pairs.text: 我之前从来都没拿过武器。

pairs.source: You give my people hope, stranger.
pairs.text: 你给我的族人带来了希望，陌生人。

pairs.source: You give my people hope, stranger.
pairs.text: 你给我的族人带来了希望，陌生人。

pairs.source: Dagg tanks you, friend! <Dagg lets out a guttural chuckle.>
pairs.text: 达戈谢谢你，朋友！<达戈发出一阵粗哑的笑声。>

pairs.source: Dunno how dem orcs keep catchin' me. <Dagg snickers disarmingly.>
pairs.text: 我也不知道是怎么被那些兽人抓住的。<达戈窘迫地笑了笑。>

pairs.source:
Gonna have to ask demself, "Did Dagg get catched or did Dagg catched dem?"

Big hero been blowin' Dagg's cover! But you special, Dagg t'inks. Dagg is master of dis guys and want to join you.

Dagg is unanimous in dis.
pairs.text:
你自己去问他们吧，“到底是他们抓住了达戈还是达戈抓住了他们？”

大英雄识破了达戈的伪装！但达戈觉得，你是特别的。达戈是伪装大师，达戈想要加入你。

达戈没有意见。
是否与达戈达成协议？（要塞追随者）
是否与达戈达成协议？（要塞追随者）

pairs.source: Don' blow Dagg's cover!$B$BDey never question a tree.$B$BDagg is unanimous in dis.
pairs.text: 不要拆穿达戈的身份！$B$B人们是不会询问一棵树的意见的。$B$B达戈没有意见。

pairs.source:
Don' let dem see us talkin'!

Dey never question a two-head.

Dagg is unanimous in dis.
pairs.text:
别让他们看见我们在说话！

人们从来不向两个脑袋的家伙询问意见。

达戈没有意见。

pairs.source: I am afraid I must depart and rejoin our pack at Wor'gol. Aka'Magosh.
pairs.text: 我恐怕必须离开了，请到沃高尔与我们的队伍汇合吧。Aka'Magosh。

pairs.source: This acolyte and I will retrieve the rest of our group. Do everything in your power to stop that orc from opening that portal!
pairs.text: 我和这位助祭去召集其他队友。你一定竭尽全力阻止那个兽人开启传送门！
我们会带着援军回来的。

pairs.source: No... NO! This cannot be the fate of my people!
pairs.text: 不……不！这绝不会是德莱尼的命运！

pairs.source: Ner'zhul leads us to this destiny. To save Karabor, we must stop him.
pairs.text: 是耐奥祖导演了这场悲剧。为了拯救卡拉波，我们必须阻止他。

pairs.source: Meet me back at Twilight Glade, champion. We have much to do.
pairs.text: 回暮光林地来找我吧，勇士。我们有许多事要做。

pairs.source: Good people of Fort Wrynn, our commander has finalized construction on a new building!
pairs.text: 乌瑞恩堡的居民们，你们的指挥官又建成了一座新建筑！

pairs.source: We're going to need to work together to get it up to full production. See to it our commander is not kept waiting!
pairs.text: 我们得齐心协力才能让产量达到最大。别让指挥官久等了！

pairs.source: Yo everybody, listen up. Thanks to our commander we got a new building up!
pairs.text: 哟，各位，听好了。感谢我们的指挥官，我们又建好了一座新建筑！

pairs.source: We gotta get this new structure up to snuff pronto, alright? Get to it yesterday!
pairs.text: 我们得赶快把这座新建筑造好，明白吗？工期昨天就该到了！

pairs.source: You can handle things from here, I'm sure. Well done!
pairs.text: 我相信你能搞定接下来的事。干得好！

pairs.source: You won't be needin' me, you're in charge after all.
pairs.text: 你已经不需要我了，毕竟你才是这里的头儿。

pairs.source: I'll take this draenei back to Khadgar. Stop that orc from opening that portal!
pairs.text: 我带这个德莱尼回去见卡德加。你一定要阻止那个兽人开启传送门！
我们会带着援军回来的。

pairs.source: Power fluctuator active. Rebooting core systems. Please wait.
pairs.text: 能量缓冲器激活。正在重启核心系统。请等待。

pairs.source: Alright, Pleasure-Bot 8000. Get back to work!
pairs.text: 好了，欢乐机器人8000。快回去干活！
好了，欢乐机器人8000。执行X47G5号指令！

pairs.source: Ah, sweet freedom! You won't regret this, commander. I'll make you the finest armaments in all of Draenor!
pairs.text: 啊，甜蜜的自由！你不会后悔的，指挥官。我会为你制造出全德拉诺最好的武器！

pairs.source: Let's see what we have to work with.
pairs.text: 来看看我们有些什么材料。

pairs.source: The forge is the soul of the foundry. This one's small but with the right equipment I can enhance it.
pairs.text: 熔炉是铸造厂的灵魂。这个熔炉有点小，但只要有合适的设备，我就能改进它。

pairs.source: These look good, with some modifications I should be able to load them into the cannons for a burst shot.
pairs.text: 这些看起来还不错，只要稍稍改装一下，我就可以把它们装进火炮里发射了。

pairs.source: Shhh! Don't let dem see us talkin' or you'll blow my cover!
pairs.text: 嘘！别让他们看见我们说话，否则你会拆穿我的伪装的！

pairs.source: I'll see if I can get this thing goin'. Khadgar, buy me some time!
pairs.text: 我来看看，能不能让这个家伙动起来。卡德加，帮我争取点时间！

pairs.source: We will do what we can, Thaelin.
$n, keep these orcs off of us!
Tank coming over the rise! Look out!
These controls don't make SENSE. Remind me never ta drive a tank built by an orc.
pairs.text: 这些控制板完全没有条理！下次记得提醒我，再也别驾驶兽人造的坦克了。

pairs.source: Hold strong, everyone. Here they come!
pairs.text: 坚持住，各位。他们过来了！

pairs.source: They're bringin' up explosives! $n, destroy those carts before they get close!
pairs.text: 他们带着炸弹！$n，炸掉那些车，别让它们靠近！

pairs.source: Don't you give up yet, paladin.
That's it! I've got 'er runnin'! Let's finish this.
pairs.text: 成了！我把它发动起来了！让我们结束这一切吧。

pairs.source: Ahh ha ha haaa! Nice shot!
Very well, but don't take long. I will require both of you later, and you will need to be alive.
pairs.text: 很好，但别太久了。我稍后还要用到你们俩，你们一定要活下来。

pairs.source: I am forming a small party to scout the enemy's fortifications.
pairs.text: 我正打算组建一支小队去侦察敌人的防御工事。

pairs.source: I am forming a small party to scout the enemy's fortifications.
pairs.text: 我正打算组建一支小队去侦察敌人的防御工事。

pairs.source: Thrall, take command of the remaining survivors and meet us up ahead.
pairs.text: 萨尔，你来率领剩余的幸存者，到前面去跟我们汇合。

pairs.source: Thrall, take command of the remaining survivors and meet us up ahead.
pairs.text: 萨尔，你来率领剩余的幸存者，到前面去跟我们汇合。

pairs.source: Maraad, take command of the remaining survivors and meet us up ahead.
pairs.text: 玛尔拉德，你来率领剩余的幸存者，到前面去跟我们汇合。

pairs.source: Maraad, take command of the remaining survivors and meet us up ahead.
pairs.text: 玛尔拉德，你来率领剩余的幸存者，到前面去跟我们汇合。
我们会完成这个任务的。

pairs.source: Ancestors help us... look at that!
I know what I must do.
Look what dragged itself through my jungle. Fresh meat!
pairs.text: 看看是什么穿过我的丛林送上门来了。新鲜的肉！

pairs.source: We won't go without a fight, Deadeye.
pairs.text: 我们是不会不战而退的，死眼。

pairs.source: It looks like you could use a hand.
Yay! Thank you thank you thank you SO much!
pairs.text: 耶！谢谢！谢谢！谢谢！太谢谢你了！

pairs.source: I thought everyone forgot about me. Thank you, $Gkind mister:kind lady;!
pairs.text: 我还以为大家都把我忘了呢，谢谢你，好心的$G先生:女士;！

pairs.source: Wow, did you fight off all the orcs? You're strong!
pairs.text: 哇，你把那些兽人都打跑了？你真厉害！

pairs.source: With luck, the small ones will now flee, and we can begin construction.
pairs.text: 如果顺利的话，那些小东西现在应该都逃跑了，我们可以开始建造了。

pairs.source: We won't go without a fight, Deadeye.
pairs.text: 我们是不会不战而退的，死眼。

pairs.source: This slaver and torturer knows nothing of honor.
pairs.text: 这个奴隶贩子和虐待狂完全不懂荣誉为何物。
我们不可能一直躲在这里。

pairs.source: Step into my arena and die with honor.
pairs.text: 走进我的竞技场，带着荣耀战死沙场吧。

pairs.source: You have entered my arena, strangers. You will either leave it as victors, or as corpses.
pairs.text: 你们已经进入了我的竞技场，陌生人。要想出去的话，你们要么作为胜利者离开，要么变成尸体躺着出去。

pairs.source: Such is the way of the SHATTERED HAND.
A combat arena. This may be a trap, but at least we will die with honor.
pairs.text: 一座竞技场。这可能是个陷阱，但至少我们可以光荣地战死。

pairs.source: Hurry, Yrel. Your hammer's might will help us greatly.
pairs.text: 快，伊瑞尔。你的战锤对我们的帮助很大。

pairs.source: I'll move forward and scout their gates while you're taking out those catapults. Lok'tar ogar!
pairs.text: 我到前面去侦察一下城门，你来对付这些投石车。 Lok'tar ogar！

pairs.source: Damn these ogres and their magic! I can't find a way to bring the barrier down so we're just going to have to sneak in around it.
pairs.text: 该死的食人魔，该死的魔法！我没法破解这道屏障，我们只能悄悄绕过去了。

pairs.source: I'll go first and clear the way, meet me on the other side.
pairs.text: 我会先走一步，肃清前面的道路，我们在另一边见吧。

pairs.source: Blood and thunder, what a battle!
pairs.text: 鲜血与雷鸣，真是一场激烈的大战！
我们来杀几个食人魔吧！

pairs.source: Fly with me, hero. We will assist them from above!
pairs.text: 跟我来，英雄。我们得从空中支援他们！

pairs.source: The purifying light of the naaru is both our hammer AND shield.
pairs.text: 纳鲁的净化之光既是我们的战锤又是我们的护盾。

pairs.source: They are at the very temple gates - fly closer! Hurry!
pairs.text: 他们就在神殿大门口——飞近点！快！

pairs.source: Circle back. We must clear the steps.
pairs.text: 飞回去。我们得肃清台阶上的敌人。
大主教阿卡玛！小心你的侧翼！

pairs.source: Never again will you orcish hordes darken the light of Karabor!
pairs.text: 你们这些兽人再也别想玷污卡拉波的光辉！

pairs.source: Press onward. By the light of the naaru!
pairs.text: 前进。以纳鲁之光的名义！

pairs.source: Carry the light, brothers and sisters!
pairs.text: 兄弟姐妹们，圣光与你们同在！

pairs.source: We've done all we can from up here...
We did it! We broke the blockade!
pairs.text: 成功了！我们打破了封锁！

pairs.source: We've broken the main siege. We should meet with our forces on the ground.
pairs.text: 我们击溃了围攻的主力！回地面跟部队汇合吧。

pairs.source: These are the last of our forces. We'll stay here to hold the temple gates.
pairs.text: 这些就是我们仅剩的部队了。我们要留在这里死守神殿的大门。

pairs.source: Champion, I need you to fight your way to the harbor.
pairs.text: 勇士，我需要你冲到港口那里去。

pairs.source: I'll approach the enemy from the south. Light of the naaru, guide you.
pairs.text: 我来对付南边来的敌人。愿纳鲁之光指引着你。

pairs.source: Champion, the naaru has come to aid us. We must defend it while it gathers power!
pairs.text: 勇士，纳鲁来帮助我们了。我们得在它聚集力量时保护它！

pairs.source: We've done it! Now to put an end to this assault...
pairs.text: 我们成功了！是时候结束这场袭击了……

pairs.source: Witness the TRUE power of the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 看看钢铁部落的真正力量吧！

pairs.source: ENOUGH. Play time is over. I will deal with you myself.
pairs.text: 够了。游戏结束。我要亲手宰了你。

pairs.source: Up there! The fleet commander shows himself.
pairs.text: 在上面！舰队的指挥官出现了。

pairs.source: It is done. Victory is ours!
pairs.text: 结束了。胜利是我们的了！

pairs.source: Hero, you fought fearlessly. For that, please accept my thanks.
pairs.text: 英雄，感谢你的英勇无畏。请接受我的谢意。

pairs.source: If you are hearing this message, it means that I am no more - but Karabor is safe.
pairs.text: 当你听到这段信息，说明我已经死了——但卡拉波得救了。

pairs.source: The naaru that we draenei revere are creatures of pure light.
pairs.text: 德莱尼崇拜的纳鲁是纯粹的圣光生物。

pairs.source: But if their death is near, they lose their essence, collapsing into creatures of shadow.
pairs.text: 但在临死时，它们的精华会流失，并塌缩成暗影生物。

pairs.source: When we draenei first arrived on this world, naaru accompanied us. But they could not stop our vessel from crashing.
pairs.text: 自从德莱尼刚来到这个世界，纳鲁就陪伴着我们。但它们无法阻止飞船的坠毁。

pairs.source: The "Dark Star" that appeared in the skies above Draenor that terrible night was no celestial body.
pairs.text: 在那个可怕的夜晚，出现在德拉诺天空中的“黑暗之星”并不是什么神祇……

pairs.source: It was a fallen naaru, ejected from our vessel in moments of panic and terror. Its name was K'ara.
pairs.text: 那是一个堕落的纳鲁，在混乱和恐惧中冲出了我们的飞船。它叫做卡拉。

pairs.source: What was once a creature of faith and beauty became a dark and hungering God, a living font of darkness.
pairs.text: 一个曾经忠诚而美丽的生物变成了黑暗而饥渴的神，一个黑暗的活化身。

pairs.source: We owed K'ara a great debt. Without the naaru's aid, my people would never have escaped our homeworld of Argus.
pairs.text: 我们欠卡拉太多了。没有祂的帮助，我的人民不可能逃出阿古斯。

pairs.source: To see K'ara's transformation into shadow was a heavy burden to bear. When the naaru returned to us... I did what I had to do.
pairs.text: 看着卡拉转化成暗影生物一直让我难以释怀。当祂归来时……我做了应该做的事。

pairs.source: Remember, life is the light, and light is life itself. They may be exchanged, but nothing is ever lost.
pairs.text: 记住……生命即圣光……圣光即生命。它们可以互相转换并保持守恒。

pairs.source: Tank ya, mon. Dese Warsong be trixie an' got de drop on ol' J'wan.
pairs.text: 谢了，伙计。这些战歌兽人太狡猾了，居然伏击老贾瓦。

pairs.source: I'm off ta Samedi's realm. I be seein' ya.
pairs.text: 我要去萨米迪的国度了。我们回头见。

pairs.source: I 'preciate da blessin', mon. De Lord of de Grave smile upon ya.
pairs.text: 谢谢你的祝福，伙计。愿死神永远不会来找你的麻烦。

pairs.source: Dey's someting in Oshu'gun pullin' on me soul. I gonna hava look.
pairs.text: 沃舒古里有什么东西让我魂不守舍。我得去看看。
这是怎么了？我已经死了！

pairs.source: I gonna haunt dese Warsong foreva. Stay away from de voodoo.
pairs.text: 我要追杀这些战歌兽人直到永远。别靠近那些巫术。

pairs.source: Furies of the Throne of Elements, we answer your call. How may we serve?
pairs.text: 元素王座的愤怒之灵，我们响应你们的召唤，有什么可以效劳的吗？

pairs.source: Commander! When I heard the ogre's death cry I came as soon as I could. Did everything go well?
pairs.text: 指挥官！我一听到食人魔垂死的哀号就尽快赶来了。一切都还顺利吗？

pairs.source: And the Raven Mother spoke to me: Krikka, you are my dear child. You shall seek out my other wayward children and bring them back to the nest.
pairs.text: 鸦母还告诉我：科卡，你是我亲爱的孩子。你要找回我其他任性的孩子，将他们带回鸦巢。

pairs.source: When all of the flock have gathered the end shall come. The world will be torn asunder in a great catastrophe! Fear not, for the Raven Mother will save us!
pairs.text: 当鸦群团聚之时，末日就将降临。世界将在灾难中四分五裂！不要恐惧，因为鸦母会拯救我们！

pairs.source: The Raven Mother will come from the heavens for her children. We will rise upon her great ebon wings to take our rightful place in her dark kingdom!
pairs.text: 鸦母会从天空降下，来拯救她的孩子。我们将乘着她漆黑的翅膀，在她的黑暗国度中占据一席之地！

pairs.source: Until that time comes give your praise to the Raven Mother! Look after her great kin for guidance and strength. May she cast her shadow upon you!
pairs.text: 到那时，你们一定会尽情赞美鸦母的！她用教诲和力量眷顾她高贵的子嗣。愿她的阴影笼罩你们！

pairs.source: Scribe! Did you get all of that?
pairs.text: 抄写员！你都记下来了吗？

pairs.source: With the keystone, you will be able to pass through, alone. Once inside, deactivate their shields and we will join you.
pairs.text: 有了钥石，你就可以通过了，但只能你一个人去。你进去之后，就关闭他们的护盾，让我们跟你汇合。

pairs.source: Ared would not want to see me standing here crying like this. Let's go to this armory of yours.
pairs.text: 艾瑞德肯定不想看到我站在这里哭成这样。让我们去你的军械库吧。

pairs.source: This looks amazing! If only Ared was alive to see this, he would be so proud!
pairs.text: 这真是太棒了！要是艾瑞德能活着见到它，他一定会很骄傲的！

pairs.source: The docks. Run to the docks. Run. RUN!
Don't be a fool, Ga'nar - Run! We will fight another day.
pairs.text: 别蠢了，贾纳尔——快跑！我们改天再战。

pairs.source: Keep moving. I see the ships ahead.
pairs.text: 继续跑。我看见船了，就在前面。

pairs.source: Their entire army is behind us.
pairs.text: 他们的整支大军都跟在我们后头。

pairs.source: Their entire army is behind us.
pairs.text: 他们的整支大军都跟在我们后头。

pairs.source: Head for the ships at the end of the road.
There is no place to run, outsiders. This is MY world. We will find you!
pairs.text: 你们无路可逃了。这是我的世界。我们会找到你们的！

pairs.source: We Frostwolves will be waiting for you, Hellscream! You, your ogres, your whole Iron Horde... You're as good as dead!
pairs.text: 霜狼氏族会等着你的，地狱咆哮！你，你的食人魔，你的整个钢铁部落……你们死定了！

pairs.source: Ignore his threats. We will go to Shadowmoon for reinforcements. This time, the draenei will triumph.
pairs.text: 别理会他的威胁。我们得去影月谷增援。这一次，德莱尼必将胜利。

pairs.source: Let's get underway then. We will need to build a stronghold if we hope to end the Iron Horde threat. And we're going to need help from the natives.
pairs.text: 那就让我们出发吧。要想终结钢铁部落的威胁，我们得建造一座要塞。同时，我们还需要当地人的帮助。

pairs.source: To the home of the Frostwolves!
I'll move forward and scout their gates while you're taking out those catapults. Dioniss aca.
pairs.text: 我到前面去侦察一下城门，你来对付这些投石车。Dioniss aca。

pairs.source: That magical barrier is too strong for our explosives to break open. I can't find a way to bring it down so we're going to have to sneak in around it.
pairs.text: 这道魔法屏障太强大了，我们的炸药炸不开它。我也没有办法关闭它，所以我们得想办法绕过屏障，然后溜进去。

pairs.source: I'll go first and clear the way, meet me on the other side.
pairs.text: 我会先走一步，肃清前面的道路，我们在另一边见吧。

pairs.source: That danged army should be here any minute. Let's move!
pairs.text: 那支该死的军队随时可能抵达这里。我们走！

pairs.source: By the light, what a battle!
pairs.text: 圣光在上，真是场激烈的战斗！

pairs.source: There is no turning back. We press on, through the very jaws of the beast.
pairs.text: 已经没有回头路了。我们只能继续前进，从那头野兽的嘴巴里穿过去。

pairs.source: Who knew the draenei held such... delicious treasures in their temple?
pairs.text: 谁能想到，德莱尼会在他们的神殿里面藏着这么……美味的宝物呢？

pairs.source: Do you dare challenge me, defenders of Auchindoun?!
pairs.text: 你们敢挑战我吗，奥金顿的守护者们？！

pairs.source: Sever my bonds... and the portal falls...
pairs.text: 粉碎我身上的枷锁……传送门就会崩溃……

pairs.source: Such decadence... it will all burn.
pairs.text: 如此堕落……它将化为火海。

pairs.source: Grommash will pay for his arrogance.
pairs.text: 格罗玛什将为他的傲慢付出代价。

pairs.source: The legion comes for you.... We will feast on these souls.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团已经降临……我们将痛快享用这些灵魂。

pairs.source: Do not delay, mortal. I can feel the life-essence of your armies fading. There will be time for regret later...
pairs.text: 别拖拉了，凡人。我能感觉到你们部队的生命力正在减弱。你以后会后悔的……

pairs.source: Gul'dan, such foolishness. This gift... so much more than you could ever know....
pairs.text: 古尔丹，多么愚蠢。这份恩赐……比你想象中更强大……

pairs.source: And now, all shall bow before me!
pairs.text: 而现在，万物都将臣服于我！

pairs.source: The bonds weaken. Freedom will be mine!
pairs.text: 束缚被削弱了。我就要自由了！

pairs.source: Giving away our position. The fool brought a genesaur down on us.
pairs.text: 这个蠢货暴露了我们的位置，还引来了一头原祖荆兽。

pairs.source: What do we have here? A hero? Gorgrond is no place for heroes, my friend.
pairs.text: 这是谁呀？一个英雄？戈尔隆德可不是逞英雄的地方，我的朋友。
他们点燃了阿卡拉兹鸦巢！

pairs.source: I swear, by the spirit of my father, I WILL MAKE THEM PAY.
pairs.text: 我用我父亲的灵魂发誓，我要让他们付出代价。

pairs.source: I'd say we made an impact.
pairs.text: 我就说我们会发挥作用的。

pairs.source: Looks like we arrived just in time.
pairs.text: 看来我们来的正是时候。

pairs.source: Free at last! Join me in the ogre mound when you are done, and we shall slay the ogre chieftain together.
pairs.text: 终于自由了！你完成之后，就到食人魔的高地上来，我们要一起干掉食人魔酋长。

pairs.source: Bring them to me alive, Roltall. They will fetch an excellent price.
pairs.text: 活捉他们，罗托尔。他们可以卖个好价钱。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde have landed upon these shores. It is our task to make them regret it.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落已经登上了这片海滩。而我们的任务就是让他们后悔这么做。

pairs.source: We cannot stay here long. Soon, the entirety of the Iron Horde will be upon us.
pairs.text: 我们不能在这里久留。很快，整个钢铁部落都会来追杀我们的。

pairs.source: $n, our champion, will stay back and disrupt the enemy camp. The rest of us will seek safe passage through the jungle.
pairs.text: 我们的勇士$n，将留下来骚扰敌人的营地。其他人就去找穿越丛林的安全路径。

pairs.source: Exarch, have your soulbinders meet me at my camp. I intend to stop Teron'gor before he unleashes more demons.
pairs.text: 大主教，让你的缚魂者们到我的营地来见我。我要在塔隆戈尔放出更多恶魔前阻止他。

pairs.source: We must stop Teron'gor before this world falls... as so many others have.
pairs.text: 我们必须在德拉诺像其他世界那样陨落之前阻止塔隆戈尔。

pairs.source: Don't worry, $n. We've got your back!
pairs.text: 别担心，$n。我们会掩护你的！

pairs.source: Come on, we need to get going pronto!

pairs.text: 你来的正是时候！过来，加兹维茨。

pairs.source: Supervising of course. Now, get moving!
pairs.text: 当然是监督你啦。现在，快行动起来吧！

pairs.source: This cave will serve us well.
pairs.text: 这座洞穴会对我们很有用的。

pairs.source: Now - kill your hundred, or die trying!
pairs.text: 现在——去杀掉一百个对手，拼命的时候到了！

pairs.source: Sorry, but we don't have that kind of time.
pairs.text: 抱歉，但我们没那个时间。

pairs.source: Hmph. I only counted ninety-nine kills, wizard.
pairs.text: 哼，我只数到九十九，巫师。

pairs.source: Then I guess we owe you one.
pairs.text: 那我想我们还欠你一次。

pairs.source: Quickly! Into the cave, before they thaw.
pairs.text: 快！到洞里去，趁他们还没融化。

pairs.source: We've done all we can from up here...
After them! Don't let them get away!
pairs.text: 追上他们！别让他们跑了！

pairs.source: I am pleased. I could watch you rats fight for hours.
pairs.text: 我很高兴，可以看着你们这些老鼠打上几个小时了。

pairs.source: Exarch Maladaar, take Qiana with you and scout the cave.
pairs.text: 大主教玛拉达尔，让奇娅娜跟你一起去侦察那座洞穴吧。

pairs.source: $n - I have a special job for you.
Lady Liadrin, take Olin with you and scout the cave.
pairs.text: 女伯爵莉亚德琳，让欧林跟你一起去侦察那座洞穴吧。

pairs.source: Your scurrying is at an end, rats.
Yes... step closer! I will bury you alive for the glory of the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 是的……靠近点！我要活埋了你，为了钢铁部落的荣耀！

pairs.source: I've seen it in my dreams... these strangers from other worlds would burn everything we've fought for.
pairs.text: 我在梦里见过……这些来自异世界的陌生人将把我们为之奋斗的一切化为火海。

pairs.source: But it is orc blood that runs in the veins of Draenor!
pairs.text: 但德拉诺的血管里流淌着兽人的鲜血！

pairs.source: Go forth, Iron Horde!  Make corpses of our enemies.
pairs.text: 前进，钢铁部落！把我们的敌人变成尸体。
你的力量？（那是我的力量！）

pairs.source: You will obey, disciple. Hand over its reins.
pairs.text: 你会屈服的，学徒。交出它的控制权。

pairs.source: I think not. (We're done taking orders from you!)
pairs.text: 我不这么认为。（我们不会再听命于你了！）

pairs.source: We've learned much from K'ure. (We're writing a book.)
pairs.text: 我们从克乌雷那里学到了很多。（我们正在写一本书。）

pairs.source: Run away, old man. (Soon Highmaul will burn. Then, the world!)
pairs.text: 跑吧，老东西。（悬槌很快就会化为火海。接下来，就轮到整个世界了！）

pairs.source: Those Iron cowards were using us as conduits to power their portal. They will regret that.
pairs.text: 那些钢铁部落的杂种把我们当成导管来为他们的传送门供能。我会让他们后悔的。
暗影议会感谢你的帮助。

pairs.source: Seek out Gul'dan if you truly wish to stop the Iron Horde. (Gul'dan! Gul'dan powers the portal!)
pairs.text: 如果你真的想阻止钢铁部落，就去找到古尔丹。（古尔丹！古尔丹在为传送门供应能量！）
古尔丹！古尔丹在为传送门供应能量！

pairs.source: I admit, even in Socrethar's madness, there was a hint of truth.
pairs.text: 我承认，索克雷萨虽然疯狂，但他的话也有那么一丝道理。

pairs.source: He questioned our complacency. Perhaps we have been too content, too SAFE, hiding here on Draenor.
pairs.text: 他质疑了我们的自满情绪。或许我们确实是太满足、太保守了，一味躲藏在德拉诺。

pairs.source: A call is coming, hero. I feel it, large and looming, just beyond the horizon. When the time  comes, the draenei must answer.
pairs.text: 时代的召唤已经临近，英雄。我能感觉到，它就在地平线的另一边，声势浩大、若隐若现。当它来临时，德莱尼必须做出响应。

pairs.source: Today, we have defeated one of Gul'dan's strongest allies.
pairs.text: 今天，我们击败了古尔丹最强大的盟友之一。

pairs.source: Without their leader, the Sargerei will crumble. The Auchenai will soon be able to reclaim their city.
pairs.text: 没有了他们的领导者，萨格雷就会分崩离析。奥金尼很快就能夺回他们的城市。

pairs.source: For now, we can consider this a monumental victory. Thank you, hero.
pairs.text: 我们可以暂时将它看做一场里程碑式的胜利。谢谢你，英雄。

pairs.source: Our only course of action is to retreat. Everyone, with me!
pairs.text: 我们唯一可行的方案就是撤退。所有人，跟我来！

pairs.source: Seal the gates! Protect the palace! Highmaul will never fall to the likes you.
pairs.text: 关上大门！保护宫殿。悬槌绝不会毁在你们这种人手里。

pairs.source: You thought to imprison us, Mar'gok? (You could never control us!)
pairs.text: 你以为你能囚禁我们，马尔高克？（你别想控制我们！）

pairs.source: Destroy them all. Raze this city to the ground! (The stones will be ours! All shall fall to darkness!)
pairs.text: 摧毁他们！把这座城市夷为平地！（岩石将属于我们！一切都将归于黑暗！）

pairs.source: Operations in Tanaan go well. The Citadel is almost complete.
pairs.text: 塔纳安的行动一切顺利。堡垒就快建成了。

pairs.source: I am keeping a close eye on the Highmaul ogres, Warchief. So far, they remain... obedient.
pairs.text: 酋长，我一直在密切关注悬槌食人魔。到目前为止，他们一直很……恭顺。

pairs.source: Alliance and Horde forces strike at the Foundry, but they are nothing I cannot handle.
pairs.text: 联盟和部落的队伍袭击了铸造厂，但我完全能够应付。

pairs.source: Again, Blackhand? All I hear are excuses.
pairs.text: 又来了，黑手？我已经听够借口了。

pairs.source: Azuka! How goes the search for the alpha?
pairs.text: 阿祖卡！寻找巨灵的行动怎么样了？

pairs.source: Well, Warchief. We need only the Heart of Gorgorek to give it life.
pairs.text: 一切顺利，酋长。只要拿到高格里克之心，我们就能让它复活了。

pairs.source: Good. I will have you deal with the other-worlders as well. Or... do you lack the bloodlust of your forefathers?
pairs.text: 很好。我还打算让你去对付那些异界人。你有没有丢掉你先辈们的血性呢？

pairs.source: My blade skills surpass those of my sires, Warchief. I can clean up Blackhand's mess.
pairs.text: 我的剑术已经超过了我的祖先，酋长。我完全有能力帮黑手收拾他的烂摊子。

pairs.source: Hrahh... I will slice off your tongue for that!
pairs.text: 哼……小心我割掉你的舌头！

pairs.source: Ahahaha... bold words from my newest Warlord. Very well!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈……真是大胆，不愧是我最年轻的督军。非常好。

pairs.source: Carry forth your ancestral blade. Bathe it in the blood of our enemies. Show me its legendary power.
pairs.text: 拔出你祖传的利刃。让它饱饮敌人的鲜血吧。让我看看它的传奇力量。

pairs.source: Prove yourself, Azuka, and I shall esteem you among my Warlords.
pairs.text: 证明你自己，阿祖卡，我就会将你和其他督军一视同仁。

pairs.source: Don't worry, little mouse. I haven't forgotten about you. I'll take care of you... later.
pairs.text: 别担心，小老鼠。我还没忘了你呢。我等一会儿……就来对付你。

pairs.source: Hang tight, $Gsir:my lady;. I'm here to help you.
pairs.text: 别泄气，$G先生:女士;。我是来帮你的。

pairs.source: Don't worry about me. I know my way around here.
pairs.text: 别担心我。我认识这附近的路。

pairs.source: I'll poke around here. See if you can find anything elsewhere in the camp.
pairs.text: 我在这附近转转。看看你能不能在营地的其他地方有所发现。

pairs.source: What do you know about Grommash Hellscream's plans?
pairs.text: 你对格罗玛什·地狱咆哮的计划知道些什么？

pairs.source: What do you know about Grommash Hellscream's plans?
pairs.text: 你对格罗玛什·地狱咆哮的计划知道些什么？

pairs.source: Grommash Hellscream met with his Warlords - Blackhand, Kargath Bladefist, Kilrogg Deadeye, and Azuka Bladefury. I'd watch out for Azuka... it seems she is charged with destroying the Alliance forces here on Draenor.
pairs.text: 加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮在跟他的督军们——黑手、卡加斯·刃拳、基尔罗格·死眼和阿祖卡·刃怒开会。我会注意阿祖卡的……她似乎将负责消灭联盟在德拉诺的部队。

pairs.source: <Written on a nearby piece of paper:$B$BWe have uncovered Gorgorek the Worldrender, an ancient magnaron frozen in the stone pools of Gorgrond.$B$BThe Warsong elders believe this magnaron was a once-powerful alpha, with the ability to command lesser beings of its own kind.$B$BAncient clan records suggest that the beast can be awakened.>
pairs.text: <附近的一张纸片上写着：$B$B我们发现了裂世者高格里克，这头上古玛戈隆被冻结在戈尔隆德的一个岩池里。$B$B战歌氏族的长老们相信这头玛戈隆曾是强大的毁灭者首领，能够号令同类的低级生物。$B$B古老的氏族文献上说，这头野兽是可以被唤醒的。>

pairs.source: <Written on a nearby piece of paper:$B$BWe have uncovered Gorgorek the Worldrender, an ancient magnaron frozen in the stone pools of Gorgrond.$B$BThe Warsong elders believe this magnaron was a once-powerful alpha, with the ability to command lesser beings of its own kind.$B$BAncient clan records suggest that the beast can be awakened.>
pairs.text: <附近的一张纸片上写着：$B$B我们发现了裂世者高格里克，这头上古玛戈隆被冻结在戈尔隆德的一个岩池里。$B$B战歌氏族的长老们相信这头玛戈隆曾是强大的毁灭者首领，能够号令同类的低级生物。$B$B古老的氏族文献上说，这头野兽是可以被唤醒的。>

pairs.source: <Scraps of paper surround the map of Blackrock Foundry. They look like manufacturing orders for war machines.>
pairs.text: <黑石铸造厂的地图周围都是碎纸片。看起来像是战争机器的制造订单。>

pairs.source: <Scraps of paper surround the map of Blackrock Foundry. They look like manufacturing orders for war machines.>
pairs.text: <黑石铸造厂的地图周围都是碎纸片。看起来像是战争机器的制造订单。>

pairs.source: <This map bears many markings within Tanaan Jungle, including drawings of fortifications and troop movements. Hellscream seems quite interested in that region.>
pairs.text: <这张地图上的塔纳安丛林里画着许多记号，包括防御工事的位置和军队的行军路线。地狱咆哮似乎对这一地区非常感兴趣。>

pairs.source: <This map bears many markings within Tanaan Jungle, including drawings of fortifications and troop movements. Hellscream seems quite interested in that region.>
pairs.text: <这张地图上的塔纳安丛林里画着许多记号，包括防御工事的位置和军队的行军路线。地狱咆哮似乎对这一地区非常感兴趣。>

pairs.source: Kajassa got ya, mon. I be here ta help ya.
pairs.text: 卡加莎可找到你了，伙计。我是来帮你的。

pairs.source: Shhhh... keep dem eyes an' ears open.
pairs.text: 嘘……让他们都睁大眼睛，竖起耳朵。

pairs.source: I've heard of Warlord Bladefury. She is a masta a da blade, undefeated across da orc clans. Those who underestimate her, die.
pairs.text: 我听说过督军刃怒。她是位剑圣，在兽人氏族中未有败绩。那些低估了她的人，都死了。

pairs.source: She be ambitious, clever, an' cruel. Now dat she has risen ta Warlord, we had betta watch our backs.
pairs.text: 她野心勃勃，聪敏过人，而且非常残酷。既然她已经成为督军，我们最好小心一点。

pairs.source: I have heard of Warlord Bladefury. She is a master of the blade. Many underestimate her, but she is undefeated across the orc clans.
pairs.text: 我听说过督军刃怒。她是位剑圣。许多人最初都轻视了她，可她在兽人氏族中却是百战百胜。

pairs.source: She is ambitious, clever, and cruel. Now that she has risen to power, I fear we must face her soon.
pairs.text: 她野心勃勃，聪敏过人，而且非常残酷。既然她已经上台，我们恐怕很快就会面对她了。

pairs.source: Is everyone in their places? Good, let us begin!
pairs.text: 所有人都到位了吗？很好，让我们开始吧！

pairs.source: It was written in the "Tome of the Falling Sands", "Time waits for no one". The Raven Mother knew we would have one who is not of the flock here for the ritual! Oh, You are truly blessed!
pairs.text: 这在“坠沙圣典”和“时不我待”中有明确记载。鸦母早就知道会有一个不属于鸦群的外人参加仪式！噢，你真是受眷顾的幸运儿！

pairs.source: What good are a handful of slaves against the Blackrock war machine?
pairs.text: 在黑石氏族的战争机器面前，一小撮奴隶能有什么作为？

pairs.source: Khadgar! Get us out of here!
So it is true. The heart CAN infuse life into these creatures.
pairs.text: 所以这是真的。这颗心脏能为这些生物注入生命力。

pairs.source: Ah, hero... I knew you would come. You are just in time to witness the heart's power.
pairs.text: 啊，英雄……我就知道你会来的。你来得正是时候，来见证恐惧之心的力量吧。

pairs.source: This magnaron walked Draenor before the first orc took breath. And now, it... and an endless army of these destroyers... bend to MY will!
pairs.text: 在第一个兽人诞生之前，这头玛戈隆的身影就已经出现在了德拉诺的土地上。现在，它……以及无穷无尽的毁灭者大军……都将服从于我的意志！

pairs.source: Follow me, $n. She's up this way.
But first... I think I need to wash my hands. I will meet you back at your camp.
pairs.text: 但首先……我得去洗个手。我会在你的营地里等你的。

pairs.source: Argghh! Looks like we'll have to deal with that gronn.
pairs.text: 啊！看来我们得先对付那头戈隆了。

pairs.source: Well, at least we took care of that thing. Come on, hero. We'd better report this back to headquarters.
pairs.text: 好吧，至少我们解决了那个玩意儿。来吧，英雄。我们最好尽快回总部报告。

pairs.source: What progress do you have to report? This better not be like last time!
pairs.text: 你想要报告什么？最好不要像上次那样！

pairs.source: We have learned how to dominate the minds of gronn.
pairs.text: 我们知道如何控制戈隆的精神了。

pairs.source: Good. Finish your work and bring them to me.
pairs.text: 很好，完成你的工作，将他们带来我这里。

pairs.source: Many leagues of deadly land yet stand between us and the Blackrock.
pairs.text: 从这里到黑石铸造厂，依然有着一大段的危险地带。

pairs.source: We should have brought an army to fight the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 我们应该带一支部队来打击钢铁部落！

pairs.source: Ha! Your size makes you weak, giant.
pairs.text: 哈！你的个头只会拖累你，巨人。
他们抓走了图卡玛下士！

pairs.source: Commander, our aerial squadron has weakened the magnaron, but we're pinned out here. We need your help to assault the main compound.
pairs.text: 指挥官，我们的空军中队已经削弱了那头玛戈隆，可我们也被拖在这儿了。我们需要你帮忙去突袭那座主建筑。

pairs.source: I don't like da look a' dis ting, hero.
pairs.text: 我不喜欢这玩意儿的样子，英雄。

pairs.source: Ah, welcome, Vindicator Yrel. I see you have come for Maladaar's trial.
pairs.text: 啊，欢迎，守备官伊瑞尔。我知道你是来接受玛拉达尔的试炼的。

pairs.source: The spirits sense your purpose. They already grow eager to challenge you.
pairs.text: 英灵们都感受到了你的决心。他们已经等不及要挑战你了。

pairs.source: It is my honor to face the heroes of the ancient past. They will not find me lacking.
pairs.text: 能面对古代的英雄们是我的荣幸。我不会让他们失望的。

pairs.source: Yrel, this is how I always wished to see you. Do not let me down.
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔，我一直都期待看到这样的你。别让我失望。

pairs.source: Greetings, teacher. Let me show you what I have learned in my travels.
pairs.text: 你好，老师。请看看我在旅途中学到的东西吧。

pairs.source: You have exceeded all my hopes, Yrel. You may proceed.
pairs.text: 你已经超出了我的期望，伊瑞尔。你可以继续前进了。

pairs.source: Now, to lay Maraad's ashes to rest.
pairs.text: 现在，该去让玛尔拉德安息了。

pairs.source: Yrel... how you have grown since last we met. But... is it enough? Are you worthy of leading our people?
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔……你比我们上次见面时成长了很多。但这……是否足够？你能不能领导我们的人民？

pairs.source: Now, it is my turn to test your strength.
pairs.text: 现在，就让我来考验一下你的力量吧。

pairs.source: When you face a more powerful foe, will you stand strong?
pairs.text: 当你面对更强大的敌人时，还能保持坚定吗？

pairs.source: Do not fear, for I will stand!
pairs.text: 别怕，我一定会坚持到底的！

pairs.source: When our people look to you, will you be ready to command?
pairs.text: 当我们的人民都指望着你时，你做好发号施令的准备了吗？

pairs.source: I shall not let them down!
When all hope is lost, will you... still... fight?
pairs.text: 当所有的希望都消失时，你还能……继续……战斗吗？

pairs.source: When you look inside yourself and see only darkness, can you still find the Light?
pairs.text: 当你审视内心，却只有一片黑暗时，你还能继续追随圣光吗？

pairs.source: Because... in this world... we are never...
pairs.text: 因为……在这个世界……我们永远不会……

pairs.source: Yrel... it is true. The student has surpassed the teacher. You are ready.
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔……看来是真的。学生已经超越了老师。你已经做好了准备。

pairs.source: If only Prophet Velen could see you now... he would be proud.
pairs.text: 如果先知维伦能看到你现在的样子该多好……他会为你骄傲的。

pairs.source: Rise, Yrel. It is your charge to unite the draenei. Prepare them for what's to come.
pairs.text: 站起来吧，伊瑞尔。团结德莱尼的任务就交给你了。让他们做好迎接挑战的准备吧。

pairs.source: Maraad, my friend... be at peace.
pairs.text: 玛尔拉德，我的朋友……安息吧。

pairs.source: Thank you, hero. I will meet up with you later. I just need a moment to pay my respects to the ancestors.
pairs.text: 谢谢你，英雄。我稍后再来找你。我需要一些时间来向先祖致敬。

pairs.source: One final trial awaits, Yrel. US!
pairs.text: 只剩最后一个试炼了，伊瑞尔。就是我们！

pairs.source: You have chosen your champion. Now, let us begin!
pairs.text: 你已经选择了你的勇士。现在，让我们开始吧！

pairs.source: Yrel, today, you have completed the trials of the exarch.
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔，今天，你完成了大主教的试炼。

pairs.source: You have proven courage, kindness, faith, and strength... pillars upon which our society has arisen.
pairs.text: 你已经证明了自己的勇气、仁慈、信仰和力量……它们正是支撑我们民族的脊梁。

pairs.source: However, we measure a leader not only by her merit, but also by the character of her companions.
pairs.text: 但是，在衡量一位领袖时，我们看的并不仅仅是她本人的表现，还有她朋友们的表现。

pairs.source: Champion, we have watched you throughout this trial.
pairs.text: 勇士，你也同样接受了考验。

pairs.source: We saw your bravery in Frostfire, your persistence in Nagrand, and your loyalty in Auchindoun.
pairs.text: 在霜火岭，我们看到了你的勇气；在纳格兰，我们看到了你的执着；在奥金顿，我们看到了你的忠诚。

pairs.source: Your dedication to Lady Yrel proves to us that she is worthy. We did not choose the next Exarch. YOU did.
pairs.text: 你对伊瑞尔女士的忠诚向我们证明了她有这个能力。不是我们，而是你选出了新的大主教。

pairs.source: Yrel, do not forget that an exceptional leader inspires greatness in others. Trust in your people, and trust in yourself.
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔，别忘了，一个优秀的领袖能带领人民走向伟大。相信你的人民，相信你自己。

pairs.source: Gaze upon the source of your demise, heroes.
pairs.text: 看清楚你们的送葬者吧，英雄们。

pairs.source: This magnaron walked Draenor before the first orc took breath.  And now it bends to my will.
pairs.text: 这头玛戈隆在第一个兽人出现前就行走于德拉诺。而现在，它将服从于我的意志。

pairs.source: It will crush your armies and your pitiful fortress.  But first, it will crush YOU!
pairs.text: 它将摧毁你的部队和你那微不足道的要塞。但首先，它将摧毁你！

pairs.source: The beast is defeated, but we cannot rest yet. One enemy still remains.
pairs.text: 那头野兽被击败了，可我们还不能休息。我们还有一个敌人。

pairs.source: I am needed near the gates. Warchief Hellscream has been spotted on the battlefield.
pairs.text: 大门那边需要我。有人在战场上看见了地狱咆哮酋长。

pairs.source: Find Bladefury. Bring me her head!
pairs.text: 去找到刃怒，把她的脑袋带来给我！

pairs.source: Taz'dingo! Well fought, mon. But we ain't leavin' until da she-orc be dead.
pairs.text: 漂亮！打得好，伙计。可在那个女兽人死掉之前，我们是不会离开的。

pairs.source: I be needed near da main gate. Dey say Grommash has joined da battle.
pairs.text: 大门那边需要我。他们说格罗玛什也加入了战斗。

pairs.source: Take care a  Bladefury. Bring me her head!
pairs.text: 刃怒就交给你了，把她的脑袋带来给我！

pairs.source: I grow tired of our games, little mouse. It's time to finish this.
pairs.text: 我已经玩够了，小老鼠。是时候结束这一切了。

pairs.source: My blade thirsts for your blood!
pairs.text: 我的剑渴望着你的鲜血！

pairs.source: No... noooo... Warchief... I have... failed you...
The battle is finished! We've routed the Iron Horde and pushed them back to the gates!
pairs.text: 战斗结束了！我们击溃了钢铁部落，把他们赶回大门里去了！

pairs.source: The Iron Horde is never beaten! I will NEVER surrender!
pairs.text: 钢铁部落是不会失败的！我绝不投降！

pairs.source: I will remember this day, heroes. I will remember your names and your faces, and when the time comes, I will carve you limb from limb.
pairs.text: 我会记住这一天的，英雄们。我会记住你们的名字和你们的脸孔，总有一天，我要将你们碎尸万段！

pairs.source: The entrance to the main vestibule opens!
The barrier behind Exarch Hataaru slides open!
pairs.text: 大主教哈塔鲁背后的屏障打开了！

pairs.source: The teleporter to the central platform is now active!
pairs.text: 通向中央平台的传送器已经激活！

pairs.source: Thanks, pal! You're a life saver!
pairs.text: 谢了，伙计！你真是我的救星！

pairs.source: Keep your wits about you, commander.
The battle is heating up. We must push forward!
pairs.text: 战斗已经趋于白热化。我们必须继续推进！

pairs.source: This is our chance to send the Iron Horde scattering. Steel yourself. We must hold the front line!
pairs.text: 这是我们打散钢铁部落的机会。坚强点，我们必须守住前线！

pairs.source: Good luck $r, I am going to find a nice warm fire!
pairs.text: 祝你好运，$r。我得去找个温暖的篝火烤一烤了！

pairs.source: Good luck, $r. Don't waste time, ever!
pairs.text: 祝你好运，$r。不要浪费时间！

pairs.source: If you dare challenge me, I will be waiting in Tanaan Jungle. You will find only death beyond these gates.
pairs.text: 如果你们敢来挑战我，我就在塔纳安丛林等着。这些大门之后，就是你们的葬身之地。

pairs.source: Give up, Grommash! Look around you. You are beaten!
pairs.text: 放弃吧，格罗玛什！看看周围，你失败了！

pairs.source: Very well, Grommash... then we will come for you.
pairs.text: 很好，格罗玛什……我们会来找你的。

pairs.source: Congratulations, hero. This victory is ours.
pairs.text: 祝贺你，英雄。我们胜利了。

pairs.source: Commander, our rylak riders have weakened da magnaron, but we're pinned outside. We need ya help ta break inta da main compound.
pairs.text: 指挥官，我们的双头飞龙骑兵削弱了那头玛戈隆，可我们也被拖在外面了。我们需要你帮忙攻入主建筑。

pairs.source: The battle is finished. We've pushed the Iron Horde army back to the gates.
pairs.text: 战斗结束了。我们将钢铁部落的大军赶回大门里去了。

pairs.source: Lay down your weapons, Grommash! Look around you. You are lost.
pairs.text: 放下武器，格罗玛什！看看周围吧，你已经失败了。

pairs.source: Wait then, Grommash. Wait, because we are coming for you.
pairs.text: 那你就等着吧，格罗玛什。我们会来找你的。

pairs.source: Thank you, hero.  Today, we taste victory! Lok'tar ogar!
pairs.text: 谢谢你，英雄。今天，我们品尝到了甘美的胜利！Lok'tar ogar！

pairs.source: My next pet won't be so easy!
pairs.text: 我的下一个宠物可没这么好对付了！

pairs.source: All's fair in tiny monkeys and war.
pairs.text: 小猴子和战争一样，都是不择手段的！

pairs.source: What? How?? I will have my revenge, you liver-scented codswallup!
pairs.text: 什么？怎么可能？？我会报仇的，你这个胡言乱语的臭猪肝！

pairs.source: A fitting conclusion to yet another epic battle, featuring me!
pairs.text: 又一场毫无悬念的史诗大战，由我倾力奉献！

pairs.source: Prepare for the smiting of a lifetime!
pairs.text: 准备接受终生难忘的沉重打击吧！

pairs.source: Ah, lucky for you I was not paying attention this time!
pairs.text: 啊，算你走运，这次我没留神！

pairs.source: As powerful as I am, I cannot be everywhere at once.
pairs.text: 即使像我这么强大的法师，也一样分身乏术。

pairs.source: But you, commander, are my greatest resource. Between the skill of your allies and the might of your garrison, there is not a stronghold that can withstand you.
pairs.text: 可你，指挥官，你是我最大的依仗。在你的盟友们超高的本领和你要塞的强大实力面前，任何堡垒都不堪一击。

pairs.source: Under your leadership, the full might of the Alliance expeditionary force will engage the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 在你的领导下，联盟远征军将全力对抗钢铁部落。

pairs.source: Under your command, the Horde's greatest warriors will engage Grommash and his army.
pairs.text: 在你的领导下，部落最伟大的战士将全力对抗格罗玛什和他的大军。

pairs.source: But I will be concentrating on the single greatest threat to the safety of Azeroth:
pairs.text: 而我将集中精力对付艾泽拉斯最大的威胁：
古尔丹，那个黑暗的化身。

pairs.source: In all my years, Gul'dan is the craftiest, most diabolical foe I have ever encountered. I hold myself accountable for his release.
pairs.text: 古尔丹是我这辈子遇到过的最狡诈、最残忍的敌人。我应该对他的逃跑负责。

pairs.source: We MUST find and eliminate Gul'dan and his nascent Shadow Council network.
pairs.text: 我们必须找到并消灭古尔丹，以及他那还处在萌芽状态的暗影议会。

pairs.source: With your help, I can track him down. I will ask a great deal of you. I will task you to the very edge of your abilities.
pairs.text: 有了你的帮助，我就能找到他。我需要你帮我一个大忙。这个任务可能已经逼近了你的能力极限。

pairs.source: But I will also help you as much as I am able. Together we will create for you an artifact of legendary power.
pairs.text: 但我也会尽力帮助你。我们会一起为你制作一件拥有传奇力量的神器。

pairs.source: With a core forged from the heart of Draenor's sun, this ring is a foundation upon which we will build a wonder.
pairs.text: 有了用德拉诺的太阳之心熔铸而成的核心，我们将在这枚戒指的基础上创造一个奇迹。

pairs.source: ...there! It is done. Now to find Gul'dan.
pairs.text: ……好了！完成了。现在，去找古尔丹吧。

pairs.source: Once we locate Gul'dan, we may have to move quickly...
pairs.text: 一旦我们发现古尔丹的下落，就必须尽快行动……

pairs.source: My eyes are open: Van shalach, om aeschis, khaz'tolim!
pairs.text: 让我睁开双眼：Van shalach, om aeschis, khaz'tolim！

pairs.source: Come on, come on... Where are you...

pairs.text: 小心！他正在反制我的法术。

pairs.source: Champion, killing Teron'gor must've shaken him up. That's good. But now he knows we're getting closer.
pairs.text: 勇士，塔隆戈尔的死肯定给了他当头一棒。这很好。但现在，他已经知道我们在找他了。

pairs.source: We'll track you from the air!
pairs.text: 我们会从空中跟着你的！

pairs.source: The trail will not be easy to follow. Start by heading east.
pairs.text: 这些踪迹并不容易追踪。先往东边走吧。

pairs.source: Follow the trail of time anomalies like this.
pairs.text: 跟着这种时空异常的痕迹走。
