pairs.source: Here! It looks like Garrosh came down this way alone after he first arrived on Draenor. But where was Kairoz?
pairs.text: 就是这里！看来加尔鲁什在抵达德拉诺之后就往这边走了。可凯诺兹呢？

pairs.source: Look at Garrosh. His hands are bound. But he's alone. When did he and Kairoz part ways?
pairs.text: 你们看加尔鲁什。他的双手被绑着。但他只有一个人。他什么时候和凯诺兹分开的？

pairs.source: Hmmm... That ogre shouldn't be here. Something strange must've happened up on this ridge.
pairs.text: 唔……那个食人魔不应该出现在这里。这座山上肯定发生了什么诡异的事。

pairs.source: That's Kairoz in disguise. Garrosh killed him! But where was the body?
pairs.text: 那是伪装后的凯诺兹。加尔鲁什杀了他！可尸体去哪儿了？

pairs.source: I know now how to defeat Gul'dan's magic and reveal the Shadow Council. But we'll need more power.
pairs.text: 我现在知道该怎么击败古尔丹的魔法并找出暗影议会了。但我们需要更多的能量。

pairs.source: We will have to tear artifacts from the very heart of the Ogre Empire.
pairs.text: 我们得去食人魔帝国的核心地带夺取神器。

pairs.source: I can help you. Let us augment the power of that ring of yours...
pairs.text: 我可以帮你。让我们强化你那枚戒指的力量吧……

pairs.source: Hold out your hand, and step into the light!
pairs.text: 伸出你的手，走进这片光芒里去吧！

pairs.source: I'm sorry, I should've mentioned that you would be... slightly killed.
pairs.text: 我很抱歉，我忘了告诉你这会让你……不省人事。

pairs.source: Marvelous... we have everything we need!
pairs.text: 太好了……我们需要的东西已经齐了！

pairs.source: Gul'dan will NOT be able to hide from my gaze this time.
pairs.text: 这次，古尔丹再也没办法逃过我的眼睛了。

pairs.source: We have him where we want him!
pairs.text: 我们一定要把他关进监狱！

pairs.source: My eyes are open: Val'mir, khar abra, mal ozymius...
pairs.text: 让我睁开双眼：Val'mir, khar abra, mal ozymius……

pairs.source: Come, come, come... I will find you...
pairs.text: 来吧，来吧，来吧……我会找到你的……

pairs.source: You! The human mage from Tanaan...
pairs.text: 是你！塔纳安的那个人类法师……

pairs.source: I've been inquiring about you, "Khadgar." It would seem we have a history.
pairs.text: 我打听过你，“卡德加”。我们之间似乎有些故事。

pairs.source: Then you know how this ends. Give yourself up.
pairs.text: 那你也应该明白自己的下场。投降吧。

pairs.source: Your clumsy magic works both ways. I have also found you.
pairs.text: 你那笨拙的魔法是把双刃剑。我也同样找到了你。

pairs.source: Foolish mage. Your death will be excruciatingly slow. I only wish I could be there to enjoy it.
pairs.text: 愚蠢的法师。你就在折磨中慢慢等死吧。我真想过去亲眼欣赏一下。

pairs.source: Be still, Khadgar. Garona's dagger was enchanted.
pairs.text: 别动，卡德加。迦罗娜的匕首上附加了魔法。

pairs.source: This wound is grisly. You should see a priest.
pairs.text: 伤口很严重。你应该去看看牧师。

pairs.source: No - no priest. Cordana, stitch me up.
pairs.text: 不——不用找牧师。科达娜，帮我缝好伤口。

pairs.source: Come, this way. This will only hurt - well, quite a bit actually.
pairs.text: 来吧，这边走。我只是有点疼——好吧，是非常疼。

pairs.source: The power once reserved for the Sorcerer Kings, I place in your hands.
pairs.text: 这原本只属于巫师之王的力量，现在我将它交到你的手中。
歐尼沃斯，艾維特拉德！阿克農，托塔勒斯！

pairs.source: These are dangerous forces you're working with, archmage.
Our friend needs them. The hardest trials are yet to come.
pairs.text: 我们的朋友需要它们。最艰苦的考验还在后面。

pairs.source: I'll be keeping my eyes on you.
Good luck, champion. Be careful in that foundry!
pairs.text: 祝你好运，勇士。在那个铸造厂里要小心一点！

pairs.source: This magic is extremely reliable and - maybe a tiny bit fatal. Hold still, I said!
pairs.text: 这个魔法非常可靠，而且——可能有点致命。我说了，别动！

pairs.source: I draw my strength, from the HEART of Draenor...
pairs.text: 我要从德拉诺之心抽取力量了……

pairs.source: They assault your foundry. They murder your allies. Mine is the only way.
pairs.text: 他们突袭了你的铸造厂。他们杀害了你的盟友。我才是你唯一的出路。

pairs.source: I maintain a pair of goblin jumper cables for just such an emergency. Are you well, commander?
pairs.text: 我专门为这种紧急情况准备了一对地精起搏器。你还好吗，指挥官？

pairs.source: Come with me. Gul'dan will not give up control of his pet without a fight.
pairs.text: 跟我来。不好好打上一场，古尔丹是不会放弃控制他的宠物的。

pairs.source: Just kill me and be done with it, archmage.
pairs.text: 杀了我，了结这一切吧，大法师。

pairs.source: I'm not here to kill you, assassin.
Where is your master? Tell me!
pairs.text: 你的主子在哪儿？告诉我！
还是你先去吧。古尔丹在哪儿！？

pairs.source: Khadgar, stop! What's the difference between this and torture?
pairs.text: 卡德加，住手！这和严刑拷打有什么两样？

pairs.source: I don't even know what you're fighting for anymore.
pairs.text: 我甚至都不知道你是在为什么而战了。

pairs.source: You - you're right. Gul'dan has butchered her mind already.
pairs.text: 你——你说的对。古尔丹已经给她洗脑了。

pairs.source: I am sorry, Garona. We will find another way.
pairs.text: 我很抱歉，迦罗娜。我们得另想办法了。

pairs.source: If she is searching for this "Heart of Gorgorek," then we must find it before her. I will notify you as soon as I learn more.
pairs.text: 如果她正在找“高格里克之心”，那我们必须抢在她前头找到它。一旦收到更多消息，我会立即通知你的。

pairs.source: Commander, this will be a protracted campaign. I should have more information for you in a week's time.
pairs.text: 指挥官，这将是一场持久战。等到下周，我应该就能向你提供更多情报了。

pairs.source: If she and da Iron Horde be searchin' for dis "Heart a Gorgorek," den we must find it first. I will send for ya when I hear more.
pairs.text: 如果她和钢铁部落正在找“高格里克之心”，那我们必须抢先找到它。一旦收到更多消息，我会立即通知你的。

pairs.source: Commander, dis will be a long campaign. I will have more information for ya in a week's time.
pairs.text: 指挥官，这将是一场持久战。等到下周，我应该就能向你提供更多情报了。

pairs.source: It looks like everyone is in position. Ka'alu, give the signal and get us out of here!
pairs.text: 看来所有人都到位了。卡鲁，发出信号吧，带我们离开这儿！

pairs.source: There are still Iron Horde in the northern courtyard.
pairs.text: 北部庭院里还有钢铁部落的余孽。

pairs.source: Gro the Uncreator, I call to you!
pairs.text: 破坏者格洛，请倾听我的呼唤！

pairs.source: The spirits of the Laughing Skull have spoken. We must join together to fight our common enemy, the Iron Horde!
pairs.text: 嘲颅兽人的万灵已经说了，我们必须携手对付共同的敌人——钢铁部落！

pairs.source: Yes! It is working! The spirits were right!
pairs.text: 太好了！成功了！万灵说得对！

pairs.source: Ahhh, there it is. There's MY artifact. How foolish of me to trust Brak with something so valuable.
pairs.text: 啊，就是它，这是我的神器。我真蠢，居然把这么珍贵的东西交给布拉克。

pairs.source: It's a shame that you're too late to stop me. Surrender the artifact, and I will allow you to escape with your lives.
pairs.text: 可惜你们来迟一步，已经无法再阻止我了。交出神器，我就饶你们一命。

pairs.source: Hahahaha, so be it! IRON HORDE, ADVANCE!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈哈，随便吧！钢铁部落，前进！

pairs.source: See what weapons I have in my arsenal!
pairs.text: 见识一下我军械库里的武器吧！

pairs.source: You will never withstand the might of Goc!
pairs.text: 你们休想抵抗苟克的力量！

pairs.source: ARGH... UNBELIEVEABLE! You will DIE for your insolence! I'LL TEAR YOU LIMB FROM LIMB!
pairs.text: 嗷……难以置信！你们将为自己的傲慢付出生命的代价！我要将你们大卸八块！

pairs.source: NO! I will DIE before I let you take what is mine! YOU... WILL NOT... WIN... THIS... WAR! AAARRRRGHH!
pairs.text: 不！除非我死，否则你们休想拿走属于我的东西！你们休想……赢得……这场战争！

pairs.source: Hahaha! Not so confident now, are we?! Face me on even ground, cowards!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈！现在没这么自信了，是吧？！堂堂正正地面对我吧，懦夫们！

pairs.source: The Laughing Skull will rise again!
It is done! As for you, I think it is fitting that one of my tools dispatches the others...
pairs.text: 成功了！至于你们，我想可以让我的工具之一来对付……

pairs.source: You trust your eyes too much, fool.
pairs.text: 你太相信你的眼睛了，蠢货。

pairs.source: The Light prevails, because WE stand against the darkness.
pairs.text: 圣光必胜……因为有我们在对抗黑暗。

pairs.source: Go ahead, Ga'nar. Take the clan. Slay your own brother in cold blood. See who follows you then.
pairs.text: 那去啊，贾纳尔。带上整个氏族。冷血杀死自己的兄弟。看看有谁会追随你。

pairs.source: You think THIS is what father wanted?
pairs.text: 你以为这就是父亲的愿望？
我的图腾可以增强你的实力！

pairs.source: Stand nearby to use my totem's strength.
pairs.text: 留在附近，使用我图腾的力量。

pairs.source: Stand beside my totem to gain its power.
pairs.text: 站到我的图腾旁以获取它的力量。

pairs.source: My wolves will tear your pets apart!
pairs.text: 我的狼会把你的宠物撕成碎片的！

pairs.source: Come! You have your orders. I ride for Tanaan.
pairs.text: 好了！你们已经清楚自己的命令了。我要去塔纳安了。

pairs.source: I only hope my people will understand.
pairs.text: 我只希望我的人民能理解这一点。

pairs.source: Oh, this should be interesting.  You don't mind if I take notes, do you?
pairs.text: 噢，这应该会很有趣的。你不介意我做个笔记吧？

pairs.source: It's easy to see why objects such as these would have been highly prized by their cultures!  Er, sorry about your pets.
pairs.text: 这就不难看出，为什么这些东西会如此受到其所属文化的推崇了！呃，我为你宠物感到很抱歉。

pairs.source: Very interesting results.  Thanks for helping me test them out!
pairs.text: 非常有趣的结果。谢谢你帮我进行测试！

pairs.source: Well, what can you expect from something that's been buried in the ground for a millennium?
pairs.text: 呃，对于这些在地下埋了一千年的东西，你还能指望些什么呢？

pairs.source: In its native culture, that pet might have been revered as a martyr.
pairs.text: 在其本土文化中，那个宠物可能会被当做殉道者崇拜。

pairs.source: Huh, I kinda thought that might happen.
Fortunately, Gyraxle can repair anything.  Even himself.
pairs.text: 幸好吉拉克斯什么都能修，包括他自己。

pairs.source: Now, was that result the device performing as expected, or did it just explode?
pairs.text: 那么，这是这台机器正常的反应吗，还是它只是爆炸了？

pairs.source: All in the name of science.
I've got bandages in my field kit if you need some...
pairs.text: 如果你需要的话，我的野外分析箱里有绷带……

pairs.source: You have to respect the ingenuity of such an ancient device.
pairs.text: 你必须尊重这些古代遗迹的精巧设计。

pairs.source: I'll add a special thanks to your pet when I publish this research.
pairs.text: 在我发表这个研究成果时，我会特别感谢你的宠物的。

pairs.source: Oh my pets did so good.  They're going to get so many extra snuggles for that.
pairs.text: 噢，我的宠物表现太出色了。我要好好抱抱它们。

pairs.source: Oh, that's okay I guess.  Doodle will need a new eye though.
pairs.text: 噢，我觉得这还不错。就是多多需要一只新眼睛了。

pairs.source: Don't worry, I'll kiss the boo-boo all better.
pairs.text: 别担心，我亲亲伤口就不疼了。

pairs.source: Soup will make you all better!
pairs.text: 热汤会让你们好起来的！

pairs.source: She's not dead, she's just sleeping.
We'll put the rainbow bandage on that.
pairs.text: 我们要给她绑上彩色的绷带。

pairs.source: You can make your pet all better, right?
pairs.text: 你会让你的宠物好起来的，对吧？

pairs.source: You are lucky my wolves are not yet full grown, or else you would have been the meal.
pairs.text: 算你走运，我的狼还没有完全长大，否则你就要变成它们的盘中餐了。

pairs.source: Only defeat truly exposes our weaknesses.  This loss will improve their training.
pairs.text: 只有失败才能暴露出我们的弱点。这场失利能提高它们的训练水平。

pairs.source: That one did not lack courage.
That one won't make that mistake again.
pairs.text: 它以后就不会再犯这种错误了。

pairs.source: That one will need some healing.
Why are your pets so weak?
An easy kill.  My wolves will learn nothing.
pairs.text: 轻轻松松。我的狼都没学到什么。

pairs.source: I remain the greatest warlord in all of Nagrand!
pairs.text: 我还是全纳格兰最强的督军！

pairs.source: What?  How is this possible?  You must have cheated!
pairs.text: 什么？这怎么可能？你肯定作弊了！

pairs.source: What is one death when I have an army of three?
pairs.text: 这点损失不过是九牛一毛。

pairs.source: My gladiators fight to the death!
pairs.text: 我的角斗士们会战斗到最后一刻！

pairs.source: I told you to kill, not die!
pairs.text: 我是让你杀敌，不是让你送死！
哈哈，软弱的$r就用软弱的宠物。

pairs.source: This is why Tarr is the greatest warlord in all of Nagrand!
pairs.text: 所以说，塔尔才是全纳格兰最强的督军！

pairs.source: I may be small, but if you hurt my pets, I'll hurt you.
pairs.text: 虽然我个子小，可你要敢伤害我的宠物，我就跟你拼命。

pairs.source: Thanks $gMister:Lady;!  I bet 100 coppers on this fight.
pairs.text: 谢谢，$g先生:女士;！我愿意出一百个铜板的赌注。

pairs.source: This is just like the time my home town was overrun by demons.
pairs.text: 此刻简直就像我的家乡被恶魔攻占时一样。

pairs.source: It's okay, they're used to dying.
pairs.text: 没事，它们已经习惯死亡了。

pairs.source: Not the first time someone has hunted that one to the ends of the earth.
pairs.text: 那家伙已经不是第一次被人追到天涯海角了。

pairs.source: Easy now!  I paid a pretty copper for that one.
pairs.text: 行行好吧！我可在它身上花了一大把铜板呢。

pairs.source: I'll sell ya a Stone of Jordan if you promise not to do that again.
pairs.text: 如果你答应不再那么做，我可以卖给你一个乔丹之石。

pairs.source: Bad luck just runs in my family.
pairs.text: 我们家族的人一向都这么倒霉。

pairs.source: Don't throw that one away, it can still be fixed up.
That's right!  My pets are from the mean streets of Caldeum.
pairs.text: 这就对了！我的宠物可是在卡尔蒂姆严酷的街头锻炼出来的。

pairs.source: That's a bit of bad luck there, $gMister:Lady;.
pairs.text: 你只是运气不好，$g先生:女士;。

pairs.source: Our hopes lie in what these pets will become.  They are sacred to us.
pairs.text: 我们的希望就在这些宠物身上。对我们来说，它们是神圣的。

pairs.source: We are Arakkoa.  We are not broken by a single defeat.
pairs.text: 我们是鸦人。我们是不会被一次失败所打倒的。
安苏，请庇护你的子孙吧！

pairs.source: Doom and gloom!  Dooooooooom and glooooooom!
The curse of Sethe is upon us.
The strength of the Arakkoa is with us.
pairs.text: 鸦人的力量与我们同在。

pairs.source: The raven god blesses us today.
pairs.text: 今天，我们受到了鸦神的祝福。

pairs.source: Pay attention, $n.  Strength is often found where you least expect it.
pairs.text: 注意了，$n。力量总是藏在你最意想不到的地方。

pairs.source: I hope you have learned something today.
pairs.text: 希望你今天能有所收获。

pairs.source: I hope you have learned something today.
pairs.text: 希望你今天能有所收获。

pairs.source: I am sad for the loss, but glad for your victory.
pairs.text: 我为失败而难过，也为你的胜利感到高兴。

pairs.source: Fear not, a simple healing spell will set that to rights.
pairs.text: 别怕，一个简单的治疗法术就能治好它。

pairs.source: The Light has not yet taken her.  She simply rests.
pairs.text: 圣光并没有带走她。她只是休眠了。

pairs.source: The moth is drawn to the flame, it seems.
pairs.text: 看来飞蛾总是喜欢扑火。

pairs.source: It is folly to underestimate the stength of nature.
pairs.text: 低估自然的力量是愚蠢的行为。

pairs.source: The moth is delicate, but not without defenses.
pairs.text: 飞蛾很柔弱，但并不是毫无防备。

pairs.source: Do not dispair, both you and your pet can learn from this.
pairs.text: 不要绝望，你和你的宠物会从中获得启迪。

pairs.source: A tender lesson learned too late.
pairs.text: 一个迟到的、温柔的教训。

pairs.source: The darkness... it flows within me. It seeps from every vein.
pairs.text: 黑暗……在我体内流淌，从每一条血管渗出。

pairs.source: Come, strangers! Cross into the realm of the Shadow Lands! I shall deliver you to your death.
pairs.text: 来吧，陌生人！进入暗影的领域！我要将你们送入坟墓。

pairs.source: Any bites yet?  I have found that patience (and beer) really helps bring in the big catch!
pairs.text: 有鱼咬钩了吗？我发现耐心（还有啤酒）有助于钓到大鱼！

pairs.source: Did you bring a cooler?  Don't EVER go fishing without a cooler!
pairs.text: 你带冰镇饮料来了吗？出去钓鱼怎能不带冰镇饮料？！

pairs.source: Any bites yet?  I have found that patience (and beer) really helps bring in the big catch!
pairs.text: 有鱼咬钩了吗？我发现耐心（还有啤酒）有助于钓到大鱼！

pairs.source: *HIC!*  Was that a dolphin?!  *HIC!*  I love dolphins!
pairs.text: *嗝儿！*那是海豚吗？！*嗝儿！*我爱海豚！

pairs.source: Seriously?  I think I would actually just throw that one back.
pairs.text: 真的？我想我刚刚才把它扔回海里去了。

pairs.source: I will be back later, save me a beer!
pairs.text: 我马上就回来，给我留一杯啤酒！

pairs.source: The Exarchs are charged with leading the draenei people. We represent and uphold the values of our society.
pairs.text: 大主教的职责就是领导德莱尼人民。我们代表并维护着德莱尼社会的价值观。

pairs.source: It's been years since I've been out in the field like this.$B$B<The stately archmage takes a deep breath.>$B$BThere's nothing like the smell of clean air and danger.
pairs.text: 我已经好几年没来过这样的野外了。$B$B<威严的大法师深吸了一口气。>$B$B再也没有比清新的空气和危险更迷人的味道了。

pairs.source: If it were up to me, I'd be the one to carry out this mission. But Archmage Khadgar insisted that you would have a more delicate touch.
pairs.text: 如果要我说，这个任务应该交给我来负责。可大法师卡德加坚持说你会带来惊喜。

pairs.source: I still bear old wounds from the demons' first coming to Azeroth. I remember the horror, the madness, and the stillness that descended upon a city destroyed.$B$BI will do anything in my power to prevent that from happening again.
pairs.text: 我身上还有恶魔第一次入侵艾泽拉斯时造成的伤口。我还记得那种笼罩在被毁灭的城市上空的恐怖、疯狂和寂静。$B$B我会尽我所能防止这种惨剧重演。

pairs.source: I cannot fathom why anyone would pledge themselves to the Legion.$B$BThere are those who lust for power, and do not know how to wield it.
pairs.text: 我不明白为什么会有人投靠燃烧军团。$B$B那都是些渴望力量，又不懂得如何运用它的家伙。

pairs.source: The Sargerei village is like a beehive.$B$BDisturb its denizens, and we will get stung. Destroy it in flames, and we will destroy the precious honeycomb as well.$B$BThe only way to retrieve the information we seek is through sublety.
pairs.text: 萨格雷的村庄就像一个蜂窝。$B$B要是我们惊动了里面的居民，一定会被叮得满头包。可如果烧掉它，又会损失宝贵的蜂蜜。$B$B唯一的办法就是通过潜入来获取我们需要的信息。

pairs.source: Exarch Othaar's betrayal was sudden. How could a leader of the draenei turn his back on the Light, and embrace the enemies who persecuted his entire race?
pairs.text: 大主教奥萨尔的背叛非常突然。一位德莱尼的领袖怎么会就此背弃圣光，投靠了曾迫害过他整个民族的敌人呢？

pairs.source: His new allies have given him a new name, and a new identity - "Socrethar." He is a powerful enemy, and I fear what he is capable of.
pairs.text: 他的新盟友给了他新的名字，和新的身份——“索克雷萨”。他是个强大的敌人，我很担心他能做到哪一步。

pairs.source: Have you heard of me, $n? I am Modera, archmage of the Council of Six, which rules the Kirin Tor and Dalaran.$B$BI could wipe out this entire village if I chose.$B$BBut that is not why we are here. As I have learned through the years, sometimes you need honey to catch a fly.
pairs.text: 你听说过我吗，$n？我是隶属于六人议会的大法师茉德拉，肯瑞托和达拉然的统治者之一。$B$B如果我愿意，我可以彻底夷平这座村庄。$B$B可那不是我们来这里的原因。根据我多年来学到的经验，有时你只需要一点蜂蜜就能引来苍蝇。

pairs.source: Ah, hero... I knew you would come. Gaze upon the source of your demise!
pairs.text: 啊，英雄……我就知道你会来的。看清楚你们的送葬者吧！

pairs.source: Now, I will leave you a taste of the Iron Horde's new power!
pairs.text: 现在，我就让你尝尝钢铁部落的新力量！

pairs.source: How about we see who is on the other side of these anomalous shenanigans?
pairs.text: 不如让我们来看看，这些诡异的恶作剧背后究竟是谁在捣鬼吧？

pairs.source: Wow! It worked. And we haven't been temporally inverted.
pairs.text: 哇！它成功了。我们的时空也没有发生逆转。

pairs.source: I'm sorry, Cenarius. I believed in your cause, but I couldn't bring myself to turn against...
pairs.text: 我很抱歉，塞纳留斯。我相信你是出于正义的目的，可我没法说服自己去反对……

pairs.source: You've done me a great service today, Farondis.
pairs.text: 你今天帮了我一个大忙，法罗迪斯。

pairs.source: What a shame that you won't LIVE to reap the benefits of my gratitude.
pairs.text: 可惜你不能活着接受我的褒奖了。

pairs.source: This whole valley is filled with plotters and schemers.
pairs.text: 这座山谷中充斥着阴谋家和背叛者。

pairs.source: Cavorting with Cenarius behind my back? I will NOT tolerate dissent!
pairs.text: 背着我跟塞纳留斯眉来眼去？我绝不容忍任何有异心的家伙！

pairs.source: Here it is, my Prince: The Tidestone of Golganneth, one of the seven Stones of Creation, and treasured relic of the kaldorei.
pairs.text: 就是它了，王子殿下：高戈奈斯潮汐之石，七大创世之柱之一，卡多雷的珍贵圣物。

pairs.source: Commander, Morthis Whisperwing from the Druids of the Talon was looking for you. He can be found beneath the great tree to the south.
pairs.text: 指挥官，猛禽德鲁伊莫希斯·轻翼正在找你。他就在南边的那棵大树底下。

pairs.source: You must all be taught a lesson.
Ten thousand years ago, I found myself mixed up with a rebel alliance of sorts.
pairs.text: 一万年前，我跟一群反抗军同盟走到了一起。

pairs.source: This was during the pinnacle of Queen Azshara's power over the elves. Her abuse of magic had grown dangerously strong.
pairs.text: 那时艾萨拉女王的权势在精灵中达到了顶峰。她滥用魔法的行为也越来越肆无忌惮。

pairs.source: We plotted to use the Tidestone of Golganneth against the queen.
pairs.text: 我们密谋使用高戈奈斯潮汐之石对付女王。

pairs.source: Cenarius. I can wield the Tidestone, but I must warn you: we risk destroying the entire Well of Eternity!
pairs.text: 塞纳留斯，我可以操纵潮汐之石，但我必须警告你：我们可能会摧毁整个永恒之井！

pairs.source: That, my friend, is precisely the plan.
pairs.text: 我的朋友，这正是我们的计划。

pairs.source: Fah! We need simply to do away with Queen Azshara herself, not the very source of our people's power.
pairs.text: 不行！我们只要推翻艾萨拉女王就行了，不需要摧毁我们人民的力量之源。

pairs.source: I agree. We are firing a cannon at sparrows.
pairs.text: 我同意。我们有点小题大做了。

pairs.source: We are fighting the greatest danger our world has ever seen!
pairs.text: 我们正在对抗这个世界前所未有的巨大威胁！

pairs.source: Even now, Queen Azshara colludes with demons. She puts our world at risk.
pairs.text: 此时此刻，艾萨拉女王已经与恶魔勾结了起来。她将我们的世界置于了危险之中。

pairs.source: Very well. Prince Farondis, you can secure the Tidestone of Golganneth?
pairs.text: 很好。法罗迪斯王子，你能拿到高戈奈斯潮汐之石吗？

pairs.source: I shall have it arranged, Cenarius.
pairs.text: 我会安排好的，塞纳留斯。

pairs.source: This is a fortified high-security bastion. Only a fool would go into there without an army.$b$bI mean... good luck, Champion.$b$b<Khadgar gives you a comforting pat on the shoulder.>
pairs.text: 那是一座守卫森严的堡垒。只有蠢货才会孤身闯入那里。$b$b我是说……祝你好运，勇士。$b$b<卡德加安慰性地拍了拍你的肩膀。>

pairs.source: Come with me. This is exactly what I need to undo Gul'dan's hold on Garona.
pairs.text: 跟我来。它能帮助我解除古尔丹对迦罗娜的精神控制。

pairs.source: We're using the tools of our enemy against them.
pairs.text: 这是用敌人的武器来对付他们自己！

pairs.source: Not 'til my dying breath. I will end your torment, Garona.
pairs.text: 除非我死。我会结束你的痛苦，迦罗娜。

pairs.source: Om na ka om, Fel na om kal...
Awaken, Garona. You are free at last.
Come with me, Garona. Together we will plan for Gul'dan's downfall.
pairs.text: 来吧，迦罗娜。我们研究一下怎么打倒古尔丹。

pairs.source: Archmage. That is dark magic you're working with.
pairs.text: 大法师。你摆弄的是黑暗魔法。

pairs.source: You are using the tools of our enemy!
pairs.text: 你使用的是敌人的武器！

pairs.source: Give me that orb, Khadgar. I will destroy that hideous thing.
pairs.text: 把那颗珠子给我，卡德加。我来摧毁这件邪物。

pairs.source: Haven't you given up already, mage?
Gul'dan... he's not in my head anymore...
pairs.text: 古尔丹……从我的脑海中消失了……

pairs.source: I owe everything to you! To both of you!
pairs.text: 你是我的大恩人！你们俩都是！

pairs.source: I will do whatever it takes to stop Gul'dan. Wherever you lead, I will follow... commander!
pairs.text: 我会不惜一切阻止古尔丹。你的命令就是我的意愿……指挥官。

pairs.source: Ha ha ha haaa... my wrath is coming.
pairs.text: 哈哈哈哈哈……我的怒火即将降临。

pairs.source: Your pet will recover with time.
pairs.text: 你的宠物会慢慢恢复的。

pairs.source: Your pet will recover with time.
pairs.text: 你的宠物会慢慢恢复的。

pairs.source: Let's see how you handle a different threat.
pairs.text: 让我们看看你是怎么应对其它威胁的吧。

pairs.source: Let's see how you handle a different threat.
pairs.text: 让我们看看你是怎么应对其它威胁的吧。

pairs.source: We don't want you dead. We need a shipwright.
pairs.text: 我们不要你的命。我们需要一名造船师。

pairs.source: You found him. If you wish me dead, put a hammer in my hands and let's make a fight of it.
pairs.text: 我就是。如果你们想要我的命，就让我们真刀真枪地干上一场。

pairs.source: Forget the Tidestone, brothers. Let the lizards and the lowborn have their crystal.
pairs.text: 别管潮汐之石了，兄弟们。让他们留着那块水晶吧。

pairs.source: We will feast on the dragons instead!
You pull the Ashbringer out of the ground, holding it up triumphantly. A moment later, Balanazzar appears in front of you.
pairs.text: 你将灰烬使者从地下拔了出来，高高举起。过了一会儿，巴纳扎尔出现在了你面前。

pairs.source: Paladins of Azeroth, you've gathered to mourn the loss of Highlord Tirion Fordring. Many of you looked to him as an ideal, the paragon of what we all strive to be.
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯的圣骑士们，你们来此悼念大领主提里奥·弗丁的逝世。你们大多都视他为偶像和学习的榜样。

pairs.source: No, friend. We have a common enemy and need your skills.
pairs.text: 不，朋友。我们有共同的敌人，这就需要你的技术。

pairs.source: Welcome, commander! Khadgar tells me you've accomplished so many great things...
pairs.text: 欢迎，指挥官！卡德加说你已经完成了许多壮举……

pairs.source: Take your knee, champion. It is a rare and special privilege to be blessed by a Naaru.
pairs.text: 跪下吧，指挥官。接受来自纳鲁的祝福可是一个罕有的特权。

pairs.source: Blessed are the torchbearers, who bring the light to darkness.
pairs.text: 先行的人有福了，因他们让光明照入黑暗。

pairs.source: Blessed are the valorous, who stand fast in an unjust world.
pairs.text: 勇敢的人有福了，因他们在不义的世界中坚如磐石。

pairs.source: Champion. A great darkness has taken root on Draenor.
pairs.text: 勇士。黑暗之种已在德拉诺生根发芽。

pairs.source: The righteous will flock to your banner. You must not falter.
pairs.text: 义人们必将汇聚于你的旗帜下。不要动摇。

pairs.source: Go now, with the Light's blessing. Take the fight to our enemies.
pairs.text: 去吧，带着圣光的祝福，战胜我们的敌人。

pairs.source: The fate of two worlds hangs in the balance...
Did you hear anything? Did the Naaru speak to you?
pairs.text: 你听到什么声音了吗？是纳鲁在对你说话吗？

pairs.source: Commander, whatever you should do next, know that you have the full support of the draenei people.
pairs.text: 指挥官，无论你打算做什么，德莱尼都会全力支持你的。

pairs.source: Commander, is that you? Your aura has grown quite strong.
pairs.text: 指挥官，是你吗？你的气场又变强了。

pairs.source: The very elements of Draenor tremble, friend. Can you hear them? Listen... listen...
pairs.text: 德拉诺的元素正在颤抖，朋友。你听到了吗？听呐……听……

pairs.source: Spirits of stone, lend your strength to our champion.
pairs.text: 岩石之灵，将你们的力量赐予我们的勇士吧。

pairs.source: Spirits of air, grant our champion quickness of mind and body.
pairs.text: 大气之灵，请赋予我们的勇士敏捷的头脑和身躯。

pairs.source: Spirits of water, give our hero the gift of your wisdom.
pairs.text: 流水之灵，请将你的智慧赐予我们的英雄。

pairs.source: Spirits of flame, lend us your fury, that our enemies will be driven before us!
pairs.text: 烈焰之灵，将你的怒火赐予我们，让我们赶走面前的敌人！

pairs.source: Arise, champion. Know that the primal heart of Draenor burns within you.
pairs.text: 站起来吧，勇士。记住，德拉诺的原始之心在你胸中燃烧。

pairs.source: Gul'dan will do all he can to sever our connection to the elements, to deprive us on their power. You must stop him.
pairs.text: 古尔丹会拼命切断我们与元素的联系，剥夺我们的元素之力。你必须阻止他。

pairs.source: The fate of our world is in your hands, commander. Lok'tar ogar.
pairs.text: 世界的命运掌握在你的手中，指挥官。Lok'tar ogar。

pairs.source: This isn't possible. There are so many of them.
pairs.text: 这不可能。他们人太多了。

pairs.source: Hold fast, Alliance! We will not fall this day! Push them back to the portal!
pairs.text: 守住，联盟！今天我们绝不会倒下！把他们赶回传送门里去！

pairs.source: There are demon hunters on my world, doom commander. This is unacceptable.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手闯入了我的地盘，指挥官。这是不可容忍的。

pairs.source: Do not let them enter the volcano. The key to the Legion's worlds must not fall into their hands, Beliash.
pairs.text: 别让他们进入火山。通向军团诸界的钥匙决不能落入他们手中，贝尔艾什。

pairs.source: My eredar are summoning in more demons to attack them from behind, your highness.
pairs.text: 我的艾瑞达正在召唤更多恶魔抄他们的后路，陛下。

pairs.source: I will personally deal with their leader, my queen.
pairs.text: 我会亲自解决他们的首领，陛下。
我的部队就是你的部队。

pairs.source: We will assist in establishing the volcano foothold.
pairs.text: 我们会帮忙建造火山要塞的。

pairs.source: Curse Helya! Curse her cowardly followers! I'll not rest until she is dead!
pairs.text: 该死的海拉！该死的走狗！我要看着她死！

pairs.source: I was Illidari once... left for dead at the Black Temple. Now you will witness the might of my new master!
pairs.text: 我也曾是伊利达雷……被丢在黑暗神殿等死。现在，见证我新主人的力量吧！

pairs.source: I have wasted too much time here. No more!
pairs.text: 我已经浪费了不少时间。我受够了！

pairs.source: Cenarius's loss has left Malfurion unable to see reason.
pairs.text: 失去塞纳留斯让玛法里奥丧失理智了。

pairs.source: Make haste to the World Tree. He may be headed there, all too ready to take reckless risks.
pairs.text: 快去世界之树。他可能去那儿了，我们不能冒这个险。

pairs.source: Meanwhile, you and I will follow his trail from here. Malfurion must not fall.
pairs.text: 同时，我们要跟着玛法里奥，找到他，绝不能让他也倒下。
伊利达雷$n，这就是库斯卡的大军。

pairs.source: Lord Illidan sends his best wishes for a speedy success.
pairs.text: 伊利丹大人希望能速战速决。

pairs.source: I assume the foothold has been established?
pairs.text: 我猜堡垒已经建好了吧？
真走运……又一座邪能火山。

pairs.source: Ah, there you are. Lord Illidan has placed my Shivarra at your disposal.
pairs.text: 啊，你来了。伊利丹大人让你来指挥我的破坏魔。

pairs.source: A small force has infiltrated the Black Temple, but the Sha'tari army is still being repelled.
pairs.text: 一支小型部队潜入了黑暗神殿，可沙塔尔的部队仍在节节败退。

pairs.source: We are to obtain the Sargerite Keystone with all due haste and return to aid in the defense.
pairs.text: 我们得以最快的速度拿到萨格里特钥石，然后回防黑暗神殿。

pairs.source: If you will excuse us. Come my dears. Up the volcano to the foothold.
pairs.text: 我们该告退了。来吧，宝贝们，到火山上的堡垒去。

pairs.source: You have proven yourself the greatest living warrior on Azeroth. It is for this reason I have saved you.
pairs.text: 你证明了自己是艾泽拉斯在世的最伟大的战士。因此我救了你。

pairs.source: I have foreseen the coming of a mighty champion to these shores. One who would slay countless foes and prove their valor time and again. One who would lead my armies to victory against the great darkness that seeks to devour this world!
pairs.text: 我预见到会有一个强大的英雄来到这片海滩。这个英雄将斩杀无数敌人，不断证明自己的勇气。这个英雄将带领我的大军战胜想要吞噬这个世界的可怕黑暗！

pairs.source: I name you Valarjar! Bring glory to these halls on the wings of my val'kyr!
pairs.text: 我赐你瓦拉加尔之名！乘着瓦格里的双翼，为英灵殿带来荣耀吧！

pairs.source: Knights of the Ebon Blade! Assemble as we honor one of our own!
pairs.text: 黑锋骑士团，集合！向我们的战友致敬！

pairs.source: You have all heard the legends of countless battles fought... of trials overcome at great cost.
pairs.text: 大家都聽過他的傳奇故事和戰績，以及不惜代價克服的試煉。

pairs.source: His exemplary deeds in the name of the Ebon Blade have shown him to be one of the best of us, worthy of our highest honor.
pairs.text: 他是黑锋骑士团的榜样，是我们中最优秀的一员，完全配得上这份至高的荣誉。

pairs.source: By the will of the Lich King and upon my authority as Highlord, I declare that $n, wielder of the Blades of the Fallen Prince, will henceforth be known as Deathlord of the Ebon Blade.
pairs.text: 以巫妖王的意志以及我作为大领主的权能，我宣布这位勇士，堕落王子之剑的持有者，$n，将从今日起继任黑锋骑士团死亡领主。

pairs.source: By the will of the Lich King and upon my authority as Highlord, I declare that $n, wielder of the Maw of the Damned, will henceforth be known as Deathlord of the Ebon Blade.
pairs.text: 以巫妖王的意志以及我作为大领主的权能，我宣布这位勇士，诅咒之喉的持有者，$n，将从今日起继任黑锋骑士团死亡领主。

pairs.source: By the will of the Lich King and upon my authority as Highlord, I declare that $n, wielder of Apocalypse, will henceforth be known as Deathlord of the Ebon Blade.
pairs.text: 以巫妖王的意志以及我作为大领主的权能，我宣布这位勇士，天启的持有者，$n，将从今日起继任黑锋骑士团死亡领主。

pairs.source: You will all bow to him as you once did to me, and carry out his will against the Legion!
pairs.text: 你们要像对我那样对他行礼，在他的指挥下对抗燃烧军团！

pairs.source: S - Save the temple! <choking sound> Hurry!
pairs.text: 救——救救神殿！<窒息的咳嗽声>快！

pairs.source: So HE is the key to Azeroth's downfall.
pairs.text: 所以，他就是毁灭艾泽拉斯的关键。

pairs.source: Before us this day stands our comrade in arms, $n.
pairs.text: 在大家面前的，是我们的战友，$n。

pairs.source: Enough! I will break you myself!
pairs.text: 够了！我要亲手解决你们！

pairs.source: It is time you be given a position that befits your accomplishments, $n.
pairs.text: 是时候授予你应得的地位了，$n。
你的宝贝“大地之环”必将崩溃！

pairs.source: I get the feeling this fight isn't over yet.
pairs.text: 我有预感，战斗还没有结束。

pairs.source: Varian, I found him! Look, across the chasm, Tirion!
pairs.text: 瓦里安，我找到了！看，在裂口那边，提里奥！

pairs.source: Dat's no invasion force. Dat's an army!
pairs.text: 这不是入侵的小分队，而是一支大军！

pairs.source: That was too easy, something's wrong.
pairs.text: 这太容易了，有些不对劲。

pairs.source: There, across the chasm, Gul'dan! He has Tirion!
pairs.text: 那边，裂口那边，是古尔丹！他抓了提里奥！

pairs.source: All da Horde, get ta Thrall!
Cordana! You will answer to the High Council for this.
pairs.text: 科达娜！高阶议会会惩罚你的罪行的。

pairs.source: Soon. The body is cold, but his soul is not done fighting. We have work to do before he is ready.
pairs.text: 很快就好。虽然身躯已死，但灵魂还在挣扎。我们得让他做好准备。

pairs.source: Illidan Stormrage. At last, I meet the great Betrayer.
pairs.text: 伊利丹·怒风。总算见到伟大的背叛者了。

pairs.source: By this hammer, I claim this mountain!
pairs.text: 以圣锤之名，我将统治至高岭！

pairs.source: Flummox no need pets! Flummox eats them NOW!
pairs.text: 弗鲁莫斯不需要宠物！弗鲁莫斯要吃了它们！

pairs.source: What the heck is wrong with you?!

pairs.text: 你或许该换几个好宠物上来。
你到底有没有认真打啊？

pairs.source: It's all part of the plan.
Now, let's see about activating that gateway.
pairs.text: 现在，我看看怎么激活传送门。

pairs.source: Only one of us is coming out of this alive...  Wait...
pairs.text: 我们中只有一个人能活着离开这里……等等……

pairs.source: I will take you to Helheim myself, "hero" of Azeroth!
pairs.text: 我要亲手抓你去冥狱深渊，艾泽拉斯的“英雄”！

pairs.source: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger!

pairs.text: 如果你有胆子话，就再来试试吧！

pairs.source: My guide didn't say anything about this!
pairs.text: 我的攻略上没提到过这个！
怎么可能？我看的可是傻瓜攻略！

pairs.source: You're no match for my pets!
Cyana, Jace, Allari... find the keystone.
pairs.text: 赛娅娜，杰斯，阿莱利……去找钥石。

pairs.source: This hammer... I must claim it for my masters...
pairs.text: 这把锤子……我要为主人拿到它……

pairs.source: Well done. You must have a strong connection with your companions.
pairs.text: 干得好。你和你的小伙伴之间，一定有着深厚的情谊。

pairs.source: When you stop calling them pets and begin calling them friends, then can you defeat me.
pairs.text: 当你不再将它们当成宠物，而是朋友的时候，你就能击败我了。

pairs.source: I take no joy in this.
You should take better care of your friends.
pairs.text: 你应该多关心一下你的朋友。

pairs.source: Your bond is not yet strong enough.
After this is over, we'll all go out for a pet treat.
pairs.text: 等战斗结束后，我们就去吃宠物糕点。

pairs.source: You are truly a master strategist.
It's okay, you can try again.
pairs.text: 没关系，你可以再试一次。

pairs.source: Maybe a stronger pet would be better?
pairs.text: 或许换个更强壮的宠物会好一些？

pairs.source: That last pet seemed a little weak.
pairs.text: 刚才那只宠物好像有点弱。

pairs.source: You'll have to work harder to win.
pairs.text: 要想获胜，你还要更加努力。

pairs.source: Ha! You call yourself a pet tamer?
pairs.text: 哈！你还敢自称是驯宠师？
这个垃圾是谁卖给我的？

pairs.source: I thought this was pay to win!
pairs.text: 这不是付了钱就能赢的吗？！

pairs.source: Can I still get a refund?
My nightmare! This is the Junior Argent Tournament all over again!
pairs.text: 真是个噩梦！这简直又是一次未成年人银色锦标赛！

pairs.source: Back to training for you! Fifty lance squats!
pairs.text: 回去再好好训练吧！先做五十个深蹲！

pairs.source: It seems I have a new nemesis!
pairs.text: 看来我要有一个新死敌了！

pairs.source: I can do this blindfolded if you prefer.
pairs.text: 如果你想的话，我可以蒙着眼睛跟你打。

pairs.source: The tip of the spear is always sharpest.
You can always be my squire.
Are you ready Sir Murkeston? Fight gallantly!
pairs.text: 你准备好了吗，奔波尔斯顿爵士？勇敢地战斗吧！

pairs.source: When you fight the ocean, the ocean always wins.
pairs.text: 想和海洋作对的人一定会以失败收场。
太阳出来啦！宠物们，出击吧！

pairs.source: My guys need more time out on the water I think.
pairs.text: 我想我的伙计们应该在水上多呆点时间。

pairs.source: You need more training before you paddle out.
pairs.text: 你在出海前应该再多训练训练。

pairs.source: Not every wave is a winner.
pairs.text: 并非所有的海浪都是赢家。

pairs.source: It would appear the pit lord is planning an invasion.
pairs.text: 看来这个深渊领主正在策划一场入侵。

pairs.source: Ready your weapons, children of my wrath! Tonight we strike at the heart of the mortals' defenses!
pairs.text: 拿起武器，我的怒火之子们！今晚，我们要直捣那些凡人的要害！

pairs.source: They must have linked their gateway to our summoning portal. They plan to attack Dalaran! We need to close that portal!
pairs.text: 他们肯定将他们的通道和我们的召唤传送门连接到了一起。他们打算攻击达拉然！我们得关闭那座传送门！

pairs.source: Assuming we can even reach the gateway...
pairs.text: 说得好像我们能抵达通道似的……

pairs.source: What is this commotion I hear? Why has the portal been closed?
pairs.text: 我听到的骚动是怎么回事？传送门怎么关闭了？

pairs.source: What is this? The petulant mortals disrupt my portals and invade my archives? I should have simply destroyed you like that petty little gnome.
pairs.text: 怎么回事？这些傲慢的凡人干扰了我的传送门，还侵入了我的档案室？我要像碾碎那个废物侏儒一样碾碎你们。

pairs.source: Judge me all you like, sister, but you cannot stop us.
pairs.text: 尽管骂吧，姐妹，但你阻止不了我们。

pairs.source: You are too late, Warden. This vault will be your tomb.
pairs.text: 太迟了，守望者。这里将是你的坟墓。

pairs.source: Demon hunters, you have to survive. Find the one named Archmage Khadgar. You can trust him.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手，你们要活下去。去找大法师卡德加。他值得信赖。

pairs.source: Hurry, then. The Wardens are coming, with the Illidari in tow.
pairs.text: 那就快点吧。守望者要来了，还有伊利达雷。

pairs.source: For generations, the tauren of this mountain fought. Countless lives--even entire tribes--were lost.
pairs.text: 一代又一代，这里的牛头人自相残杀。无数生命——甚至整个部族——都因此而消逝。

pairs.source: Once, upon returning from such a battle, Huln Highmountain found his people slaughtered by a previously unknown foe.
pairs.text: 有一次，胡恩·高岭打完这样一场战争归来，却发现他的人民都被一个闻所未闻的敌人杀害了。

pairs.source: Battling his grief, Huln spoke with the leaders of the remaining tribes. He convinced them to unite under one banner to oppose this new threat.
pairs.text: 克服悲痛之后，胡恩与剩下的部族首领们谈判。他说服他们团结起来，对抗这一新的威胁。

pairs.source: I will tell you the story of Huln Highmountain.
pairs.text: 我要告诉你关于胡恩·高岭的故事。

pairs.source: And now you will bear witness to Huln's trials...
pairs.text: 现在，你将见证胡恩所经历的试炼……

pairs.source: The beast is there! An'she protect us!
pairs.text: 那头野兽在那儿！愿安瑟保佑我们！

pairs.source: It went into that deep patch of mist. It could be hiding anywhere! Hero, do you have a trap strong enough to hold the beast?
pairs.text: 它跑进迷雾深处了。它可能藏在任何地方！英雄，你有什么陷阱能够困住那头野兽吗？
我们誓与高岭部族共进退。

pairs.source: It claws at us from the mist! Hurry!
pairs.text: 它在迷雾中向我们攻击！快！

pairs.source: It is... over for me... you must... finish this.
pairs.text: 我不行了……你必须……完成任务。

pairs.source: Everyone must pay the blood price!
pairs.text: 人人都得付出血的代价！

pairs.source: Children of the deep, rise and crush these shan ronir!
pairs.text: 深渊之子，站起来，碾碎这些走狗！

pairs.source: Illidan... now, you belong to the Legion.
pairs.text: 伊利丹……现在，你归燃烧军团了。

pairs.source: It would appear we've been discovered.
Did you think you could escape my grasp so easily?
pairs.text: 你们以为能轻易逃出我的掌心吗？

pairs.source: Haughty warlocks! You presume to issue commands to my kind! Face the consequences for your insolence!
pairs.text: 傲慢的术士！你们竟敢号令我的同胞！准备为你们的傲慢付出代价吧！

pairs.source: I will smash you like the insignificant gnats you are!
pairs.text: 我要碾碎你们这些卑贱的蝼蚁！
烧吧！在邪能之火中燃烧吧！

pairs.source: You will not get away! I'm not done with you yet!
pairs.text: 你们休想跑掉！我还有账要跟你们算呢！

pairs.source: Your skull will make a fine trophy!
pairs.text: 你的脑袋会是个很好的战利品！

pairs.source: Ungh! Press on, warlock... close the portal!
pairs.text: 噢！继续，术士……关闭传送门！

pairs.source: I will burn you to cinders!
This is not over, warlock! I will see the end of you!
pairs.text: 还没结束呢，术士！我要看着你死！
杀掉……那个怪物。找到……雄鹰之爪……

pairs.source: The ritual will focus our energy into a portal at the center of the structure. We must keep it stable!
pairs.text: 这个仪式能把我们的力量集中到传送门上。必须保持它的稳定！

pairs.source: Excellent! The path is taking form! It grows more stable by the moment!
pairs.text: 很好！道路开始成型了！它越来越稳定了！

pairs.source: The Dreamway is ready! Good work, everyone.
pairs.text: 梦境之路开启了！各位，干得好。

pairs.source: UNCROSS THE WIRES TO SAVE MY DIGITAL LIFE
pairs.text: 令电线不交叉，拯救我的数字生命

pairs.source: UNCROSS THE WIRES TO SAVE MY DIGITAL LIFE
pairs.text: 令电线不交叉，拯救我的数字生命

pairs.source: The Deacon has started the ritual! He is not to be disturbed!
pairs.text: 执事大人已经启动了仪式！任何人都不能打扰他！

pairs.source: The Deacon has started the ritual! He is not to be disturbed!
pairs.text: 执事大人已经启动了仪式！任何人都不能打扰他！

pairs.source: Master Slaghammer! We have an intruder!
Master Slaghammer! We have an intruder!
Master Slaghammer! We have an intruder!
pairs.text: 熔锤大人！我们发现了一个入侵者！

pairs.source: Master Slaghammer! We have an intruder!
$n, I present you with a gift from Lord Illidan himself.
pairs.text: $n，我带来了伊利丹大人的礼物。

pairs.source: We cannot fight the monster until you place the trap! Hurry!
pairs.text: 在你放下陷阱之前，我们敌不过它的！快！

pairs.source: Hold off these beasts until the trap is sprung!
pairs.text: 拦住这些野兽，等待陷阱发动！

pairs.source: Yes... the Blade is right! I am unstoppable! Once Zakajz lives again, I will hold dominion over this world!
pairs.text: 没错……那把剑说得对！我是不可阻挡的！等我们复活了扎卡兹，我就将统治这个世界！

pairs.source: Our old leaders chose to work with pawns. I choose the REAL power!
pairs.text: 我们昔日的首领选择跟棋子合作。而我，选择了真正的掌权者！

pairs.source: Defend me, Blade! You said this would work!
pairs.text: 保护我吧，剑！你说过这能行！

pairs.source: This... this shouldn't be happening! Why aren't you protecting me?!
pairs.text: 不……不该是这样的！你为什么不保护我？！

pairs.source: Give me another chance! No! Noooo!
pairs.text: 再给我一个机会吧！不！不！！！

pairs.source: You think to stop me? With this weapon I can do anything! ANYTHING!
pairs.text: 你想阻止我？有了这把武器，我就无所不能！无所不能！

pairs.source: Behold Saraka, Destroyer of Worlds! Brought to heel after millennia of wanton destruction.
pairs.text: 看，诸界毁灭者萨拉卡！她所到之处，就会带来万年的毁灭。

pairs.source: The draenei sought to devise a ritual that could turn the naaru back to the Light. To aid their quest, I called together many priesthoods to work in unison.
pairs.text: 德莱尼一直想设计出一种仪式，让纳鲁回归圣光。为了帮助他们，我召集了其他牧师一起来帮忙。

pairs.source: We are close to success. I believe the weapon you obtained will tip the scales in our favor. If you would step into the main circle, we can begin the ritual!
pairs.text: 我们就快成功了。我相信你的那件武器一定能力挽狂澜。你只要踏入主法阵，我们就能开始仪式了！

pairs.source: Yes! Use the blade to draw out the Void energy!
pairs.text: 对！用这把剑抽出虚空能量！

pairs.source: Yes! Fill it with healing Light!
Yes! Purge it with holy fire!
Yes! It's working! Can you feel it?
pairs.text: 好！成功了！你感觉到了吗？

pairs.source: The hunger, the rage, they are gone. The Light has welcomed me home.
pairs.text: 饥渴、愤怒，都消失了。圣光在欢迎我归来。

pairs.source: The Beacon calls to bring forth light, we will answer in your time of need.
pairs.text: 道标召唤来了圣光。只要你有需要，我们随时都能响应召唤。

pairs.source: Once again you have proven your worth, my friend. With the aid of Saa'ra and the power of your weapon behind you, there is no one more capable!
pairs.text: 你再次证明了自己的能力，我的朋友。有了萨拉的帮助和这把武器的力量，再没有比你更强大的人了！

pairs.source: Priesthoods from all over Azeroth have agreed to donate time and resources to this new Conclave. We have a singular purpose: the defeat of the Burning Legion!
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯所有的教派都答应为新生的教团提供时间和资源。我们的目标只有一个，那就是打败燃烧军团！

pairs.source: I hereby bring the Conclave to order! Together we will bring hope and healing to our allies, and banish our foes into the void!
pairs.text: 我在此宣布教团正式成立！我们将携手为盟友带去希望和抚慰，并将敌人赶回虚空！

pairs.source: Now, champion, we shall transform this prison into a temple that will serve as the headquarters of our campaign. This shouldn't take long...
pairs.text: 现在，勇士，我们要将这座牢笼转化成我们的战役指挥中心。这要不了多少时间……

pairs.source: You cannot trust your own mind!
See how I bend your mind to my will!
pairs.text: 看着，我要让你服从我的意志！

pairs.source: Can you hear me, my friend?
Follow me. We must address the others.
pairs.text: 跟我来。我们必须找到其他人。

pairs.source: Behold the power of the Twinblades of the Deceiver. The Fel Hammer is ours!
pairs.text: 见证欺诈者双刃的力量吧！邪能之槌号是属于我们的！

pairs.source: We are the blades that will strike down the Legion. We are the chosen warriors of Lord Illidan.
pairs.text: 我们将是斩杀燃烧军团的尖刀，是伊利丹大人挑选出来的战士。

pairs.source: The Fel Hammer is ours at last. Gaze upon the might of the Twinblades of the Deceiver!
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号终于归我们了。看看欺诈者双刃的力量吧！

pairs.source: Malfurion, my old friend... the perfect bait!
pairs.text: 玛法里奥，我的老朋友……多么完美的诱饵！

pairs.source: Ahh, the Mother of Dreams has arrived at last.
Today, we have gained new strength thanks to our leader, $n.
pairs.text: 今天，多亏了我们的领袖$n，我们得到了一种新的力量。

pairs.source: With the legendary Storm Brew, our efforts in the war against the Legion will redouble!
pairs.text: 有了传说中的风暴蜜酒，我们抗击燃烧军团的力量就能翻倍了！

pairs.source: Let us fight for the fallen, and bring peace to this world once again!
pairs.text: 让我们干掉那个堕落者，让这个世界恢复宁静吧！

pairs.source: What are you doing? Run, you fools! The demon is near!
pairs.text: 你们在干嘛？快跑吧，蠢货！那个恶魔就在附近！

pairs.source: Prepare yourself. Step into the circle when you are ready.
pairs.text: 做好准备，然后就踏入法阵吧。

pairs.source: Behold the site of my final battle... and there lies my foe. Even now, Zakajz struggles for consciousness. You must hurry!
pairs.text: 看，我最后的战场……最后的敌人。此刻，扎卡兹依然挣扎着想醒来。你得快一点！

pairs.source: Greetings to you both. The tremors from the Emerald Dream grow more potent. We must begin the ritual at once!
pairs.text: 欢迎两位。翡翠梦境的震荡越来越激烈，我们必须立刻开始仪式！

pairs.source: The greatest shaman in the world are gathering below. What's left of 'em, that is.
pairs.text: 全世界最伟大的萨满都来了。反正剩下的都来了。

pairs.source: Go now. Hruthnir waits at the Sky Launch to aid you.
pairs.text: 去吧，胡尼尔在天台上等着，他会帮你的。

pairs.source: The Ashtongue will fight beside you.
pairs.text: 灰舌死誓将与您并肩战斗。

pairs.source: You may call upon the Coilskar as well.
Our mission is not yet complete. We are all yours to command.
pairs.text: 我们的任务还没完成。我们听候您的调遣。

pairs.source: Your efforts have not gone unnoticed, $n. Time and again you have proven yourself to be one of our finest.
pairs.text: 你的努力有目共睹，$n。你一再证明了自己是我们中最优秀的一员。

pairs.source: The strength, ferocity, and nobility you have shown are without peer. It is time you were honored accordingly.
pairs.text: 你所展现出的力量，勇猛和高尚无与伦比。是时候让你得到应有的嘉奖了。

pairs.source: It is my honor to welcome $n as an Archdruid of the Cenarion Circle! May all the creatures of the wilds celebrate your ascension!
pairs.text: 我荣幸地宣布，$n将成为塞纳里奥议会的大德鲁伊！愿荒野众生都为此欢欣鼓舞！

pairs.source: You think you can best my snails?
pairs.text: 你以为你能击败我的蜗牛？

pairs.source: At least dead snails are delicious.

pairs.text: 我打算把他留到下一顿再吃。

pairs.source: You have a little slime on your face.
If you're done with that one, it'd make a great stew!
pairs.text: 如果你不想要了，我可以用它炖一锅好汤！

pairs.source: Tremble before me! I bring darkness to this world.
pairs.text: 在我面前颤抖吧！我将黑暗带到了这个世界。

pairs.source: Free. Free! FREE! Free of that accursed prison.
pairs.text: 自由。自由！我自由了！终于摆脱那个该死的牢笼了。

pairs.source: Such pitiful creatures. Is that the last of them?
pairs.text: 可悲的小东西。这已经是最后一批了吗？

pairs.source: Yes, mistress. The Tideskorn will keep them captive until you are ready to harvest their souls.
pairs.text: 遵命，夫人。蔑潮部族会盯着他们，直到您收割他们的灵魂。

pairs.source: Good. Now tear this monastery to shreds!
pairs.text: 很好。现在，把这座禅院撕成碎片吧！

pairs.source: Your order is broken, monks! You can do nothing against us.
pairs.text: 你们的门派完蛋了，武僧！你们对付不了我们。

pairs.source: Our WILL is not broken. We will fight to our last breath, demon-lover.
pairs.text: 我们的意志坚不可摧。我们会奋战到底，恶魔。

pairs.source: You will die by my blade, $c!
Hurry, $n. Those fel spreaders are doing incredible damage.
pairs.text: 快，$n。那些邪能散播器已经造成了严重的伤害。

pairs.source: We'll hold them back here. Strike at the demons now, or it will be too late!
pairs.text: 我们来挡住他们。快去攻击恶魔，否则就迟了！

pairs.source: Hurry up now, I'm right behind! The King's got your back if you get in a bind!
pairs.text: 快，我会跟紧你的！如果你遇到麻烦，美猴王会罩着你的！

pairs.source: Master, you have witnessed with your own eyes the Legion's capability for destruction.
pairs.text: 大宗师，你已经亲眼见证了燃烧军团的破坏力。
我就是你最可怕的梦魇。

pairs.source: Yes, let the anger swell inside you!
pairs.text: 对，让你体内的怒火膨胀吧！

pairs.source: I can feel the corruption spreading!
pairs.text: 我能感觉到腐蚀在扩散！

pairs.source: That one wouldn't have lasted long anyway.
You will pay for your insolence.
pairs.text: 你会为你的傲慢付出代价的。

pairs.source: Tyrande Whisperwind! I have longed for this encounter for many years.
pairs.text: 泰兰德·语风！我已经期盼这次相遇很多年了。

pairs.source: Your adoring husband will be joining me in the nightmare. His was a special invitation.
pairs.text: 你亲爱的丈夫就快融入我的梦魇了。他可是特别嘉宾。

pairs.source: This way. The rest of the survivors are up here.
pairs.text: 这边。其他幸存者就在上面。

pairs.source: And our dear Ysera! Would you believe she has had a change of heart?
pairs.text: 还有亲爱的伊瑟拉！你知道她已经变心了吗？

pairs.source: She will aid me in my conquest of Val'sharah, starting with your precious Temple of Elune.
pairs.text: 她会帮我征服瓦尔莎拉，就从你的宝贝月神殿开始。

pairs.source: Kneel beside your beloved as he draws his final breath? Or watch the temple of your goddess burn!
pairs.text: 想跪在你的爱人身边看他咽气吗？还是看着你的神殿化为火海吧！

pairs.source: The Fel Hammer is ours at last. Gaze upon the might of the Aldrachi Warblades!
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号终于归我们了。见证奥达奇战刃的力量吧！

pairs.source: Behold the power of the Aldrachi Warblades. The Fel Hammer is ours!
pairs.text: 准备好见证奥达奇战刃的力量。邪能之槌号是属于我们的！

pairs.source: Lets begin your lesson in humility.
pairs.text: 我就先教教你什么叫谦虚吧。

pairs.source: Begone! I need time to contemplate this affront.
pairs.text: 走开！我要好好想想这次的羞辱。

pairs.source: You will learn respect or I will continue to educate you in it.
pairs.text: 你得学会谦卑，不然我就继续教训你。

pairs.source: That one isn't fit to clean my quarters, much less battle!
pairs.text: 这种玩意儿给我打扫房间我都不要，更别说战斗了！
有意思，再露两手给我看看吧。
一次不幸的计算错误而已。

pairs.source: You cannot discern between a victory or a sacrifice.
pairs.text: 你连胜利和牺牲都分不清楚。

pairs.source: It is finished! The claws are ours!

pairs.text: 麝牛！赐予我你的坚韧吧！

pairs.source: Ha! Musken prove to be the strongest once again!
pairs.text: 哈！麝牛又一次证明了自己才是最强的！

pairs.source: More! Bring me more to crush!
pairs.text: 还不够！我还要碾碎更多的敌人！
布约恩！赐予我你的狂野吧！

pairs.source: Ha! Bears prove to be the strongest once again!
pairs.text: 哈！白熊又一次证明了自己才是最强的！

pairs.source: More! Bring me more to rip apart!
pairs.text: 还不够！我还要砸扁更多的敌人！
很快就会有新的灵魂加入我们了。

pairs.source: Lay still and let the water take you.
pairs.text: 躺着别动，让海水将你带走吧。

pairs.source: Death comes quickly to the weak.
You begin to irritate me mortal.
Your death will be slow and savored.
pairs.text: 我一定会慢慢弄死你，好好品尝你的痛苦的。

pairs.source: Let us see if those you have brought are worthy.
pairs.text: 让我们看看你带来的这些野兽有没有资格吧。

pairs.source: These trials are not to be taken lightly.
You may enter, but spare me your pleas for help, shaman. I know of the Earthen Ring's plan to unite the elements!
pairs.text: 你可以进来，但是求助就免了，萨满。我知道大地之环想联合四大元素！

pairs.source: The Burning Legion threatens us all, but the power of the Firelands must be earned.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团威胁到了我们所有人，但火焰之地不会白白出力。

pairs.source: Approach my throne and we shall see just how far you will go to save this world!
pairs.text: 到我的王座来，让我看看你能为拯救世界出多少力吧！

pairs.source: I must get back to my cooking!
Finally. Now, back to my preparations.
pairs.text: 总算搞定了。我该回去继续准备了。

pairs.source: I cannot work in these conditions!
If you can't take the heat...
pairs.text: 如果你忍受不了高温的话……

pairs.source: I have to recheck the recipe.
We have found you... and you have found the grave.
pairs.text: 我们找到了你……而你找到了墓穴。

pairs.source: I will begin the ritual. Focus your will upon the spirit while our friend keeps us safe.
pairs.text: 我来启动仪式。专心跟幽灵沟通，这位朋友会保护我们的。

pairs.source: I died to ease the pain of my failure. Why do you disturb me?
pairs.text: 我用死亡来缓解失败的痛苦。你为何要打扰我？！

pairs.source: I've read yer saga. Where did ye find the shield?
pairs.text: 我读过你的传说。你在哪儿找到它的？

pairs.source: It seems you compel me to answer... My journey took me to Stormheim, to a tomb of warrior kings.
pairs.text: 看来我必须回答了……旅途将我带到了风暴峡湾的战士之王的墓穴。

pairs.source: We will finish what ye started.
pairs.text: 我们会完成你未竟的任务。

pairs.source: Return to your rest, and be disgraced no more.
pairs.text: 重新安息吧，你不必再羞愧了。

pairs.source: Thanks for yer help, Tahu. I won't forget this!
pairs.text: 谢谢你，塔胡。我不会忘记你的！

pairs.source: It was my honor to serve. I must go to Netherlight Temple and inform the Conclave of our success. Good luck.
pairs.text: 这是我的荣幸。我得去虚空之光神殿，把好消息告诉大主教。祝你好运。

pairs.source: As for us, we should get back to Dalaran. I'll meet ye there!
pairs.text: 至于我们，该回达拉然了。我在那里等你！

pairs.source: Want to know the exact time and date of your death?
pairs.text: 想知道你确切的死期吗？
我所能看到的越来越少。

pairs.source: I already know your next move.
pairs.text: 我已经预料到你下一步的行动了。

pairs.source: Welcome, Lord of Flame! Welcome, Kil'jaeden!
pairs.text: 欢迎，烈焰领主！欢迎，欺诈者！

pairs.source: You have done well, Akaari. You have earned my blessing.
pairs.text: 你做得很好，阿卡丽。你赢得了我的祝福。

pairs.source: Azhir manari kirel. Akim manari galar!
pairs.text: Azhir manari kirel. Akim manari galar! (惡魔咒語)

pairs.source: The fangs... their power is beyond comprehension! I am your humble servant, my lord!
pairs.text: 吞噬者之牙……它们的力量超乎想象！我是您谦卑的仆人，我的主人！

pairs.source: It is time for your true test. Use the Fangs to dismantle Azeroth's kingdoms from within. Let their shattered husks pave our path to victory!
pairs.text: 你该面对真正的考验了。使用你的吞噬者之牙，从内部瓦解艾泽拉斯诸国。用它们破碎的残骸铺就我们胜利的大道！

pairs.source: They will taste blood in your name!
pairs.text: 它们将以你之名畅饮鲜血！

pairs.source: I bid you greetings, Opener of Doors. You are the first.
pairs.text: 欢迎你，开门者。你是第一个进来的人。

pairs.source: I am Yrgrim, Champion of Tyr! Let us see if you are worthy to bear his shield.
pairs.text: 我是提尔的勇士伊格瑞姆！让我看看你能否继承他的盾牌。

pairs.source: Long have I waited for one who proves worthy. Face me in battle that we might test your heart!
pairs.text: 我一直在等待合格的继承者。来与我一战，我要考验你的心灵！

pairs.source: I must see if you possess the will, the strength, and the stamina to wield this shield. Will you face me in a trial of combat?
pairs.text: 我得看看，你是否有足够的意志、力量和耐力来掌握这面盾牌。你愿意接受试炼，与我一战吗？

pairs.source: I am ready for your trial, Yrgrim.
pairs.text: 我准备好接受你的试炼了，伊格瑞姆。

pairs.source: I am ready for your trial, Yrgrim.
pairs.text: 我准备好接受你的试炼了，伊格瑞姆。

pairs.source: I am beaten! You are indeed worthy. Were Tyr alive, he would make you his champion. I hereby bestow Truthguard upon you. Use it to defend Azeroth from its enemies.
pairs.text: 我输了！你确实有资格。如果提尔活着，他也会选你为勇士的。真理守护者就交给你了。用它守护好艾泽拉斯吧。

pairs.source: What are you filthy mortals doing near the master's portal? I'll rip the answer from your souls!
pairs.text: 肮脏的凡人在主人的传送门附近做什么？我要把答案从你们的灵魂里榨出来！

pairs.source: Well done. Make sure to practice every day.
pairs.text: 干得好，别忘了每天练习。

pairs.source: We have the hammer! Everyone, run! The tomb is collapsing!
pairs.text: 我们拿到战锤了！快跑！墓穴要塌了！

pairs.source: Your escape... means nothing. Will find you again...
pairs.text: 你们的逃亡……毫无意义。我会找到你们的……

pairs.source: Apologies for the hasty retreat! The tomb's collapse was triggered by the hammer's removal.
pairs.text: 抱歉，撤退得太匆忙了！一旦拿走战锤，墓穴就会崩塌。

pairs.source: Her exemplary deeds in the name of the Ebon Blade have shown her to be one of the best of us, worthy of our highest honor.
pairs.text: 她是黑锋骑士团的榜样，是我们中最优秀的一员，完全配得上这份至高的荣誉。

pairs.source: You will all bow to her as you once did to me, and carry out her will against the Legion!
pairs.text: 你们要像对我那样对她行礼，在她的指挥下对抗燃烧军团！

pairs.source: Today, we dealt a great blow to the unseen enemies of the Nightmare.
pairs.text: 今天，我们对梦魇中隐形的敌人造成了沉重打击。

pairs.source: However, Xavius, Lord of the Nightmare, still lives. Only when he is defeated, will Azeroth truly be safe.
pairs.text: 但是，梦魇之王萨维斯依然活着。只有击败他，艾泽拉斯才能重获安全。

pairs.source: To accomplish this task, I gift you with my blessing. Use my power to serve and protect the wilds.
pairs.text: 为此，我把我的祝福赐予你。用我的力量保护荒野吧。

pairs.source: Thank you, druids of the Dreamgrove. May you prosper under the leadership of your new Archdruid.
pairs.text: 谢谢，梦境林地的德鲁伊。愿你们在新大德鲁伊的领导下欣欣向荣。

pairs.source: You're all bark and no bite.
I'm going to give you guys the wittle bandages for your wittle boo-boos!
pairs.text: 你们这些粗心的小家伙，我要给你们包上爱的绷带！

pairs.source: By the light of Elune! What happened to the shrine!?
pairs.text: 月神之光啊！神殿怎么了！？

pairs.source: Well done! Now we can begin our counter attack!
pairs.text: 干得好！现在我们可以反击了！

pairs.source: Your pathetic barriers mean nothing to the Legion!
pairs.text: 你那可悲的屏障对军团毫无意义！

pairs.source: I'll never let Ashamane's Fangs fall to your kind!
pairs.text: 我绝不允许阿莎曼之牙落入你们的手中！

pairs.source: Insolent mortal! We will hunt you down! You only delay the inevitable!
pairs.text: 傲慢的凡人！我们不会罢休的！你只是在垂死挣扎罢了！

pairs.source: Take a good look, brute! You'll never see the Fangs again!
pairs.text: 看好了，野蛮人！和阿莎曼之牙永别吧！

pairs.source: Verstok was at the shrine! Find out what's going on up there. I'll meet up with you as soon as I can, $n.
pairs.text: 维斯托克来过祭坛！去搞清发生了什么。我会尽快与你汇合，$n。

pairs.source: Well done! The Legion's attack has been broken!
pairs.text: 干得好！军团的进攻被击溃了！

pairs.source: What the... the Fangs are gone! What happened, $n?
pairs.text: 怎么……阿莎曼之牙不见了！怎么回事，$n？

pairs.source: $n, I have been expecting you, though not the traitor, Altruis.
pairs.text: $n，我一直在等你，而不是这个叛徒奥图里斯。

pairs.source: No matter. There is little time.
I entrusted the duplicitous Akama with planning the campaign against the Legion.
pairs.text: 我让阿卡玛那个两面派策划了对燃烧军团的进攻。

pairs.source: He alone knows every detail. You will need his counsel if you are to succeed.
pairs.text: 只有他知道全部细节。如果你想成功，就需要他的建议。

pairs.source: You must also regain the Sargerite Keystone to invade the Legion's worlds.
pairs.text: 你还要找回萨格里特钥石才能侵入燃烧军团的世界。

pairs.source: Find out where the Wardens hid it away.
pairs.text: 去搞清楚守望者把它藏哪儿了。

pairs.source: We have attracted attention. I must move.
pairs.text: 我们引起了注意。我得走了。

pairs.source: You will not be able to contact me like this again. The Illidari are now yours, $n.
pairs.text: 你以后就联络不上我了。伊利达雷就归你了，$n。

pairs.source: $n, I have been expecting you. Ah good... Kayn Sunfury.
pairs.text: $n，我一直在等你。啊，很好……凯恩·日怒。

pairs.source: There is little time. Listen closely.
Can you hear me through this thing, $n? You should be near Verstok's location by now.
pairs.text: 能听到我说话吗，$n？你应该已经在维斯托克的附近了。

pairs.source: My foolish protege was in such a rush to escape the Shrine, I'll wager he failed to mask his scent. Shift into cat form and you'll likely detect it.
pairs.text: 我的笨学徒逃得很仓促。他肯定没有掩盖自己的气味。只要变成猎豹形态，你就能发现他的踪迹。

pairs.source: Careful! The ruins are infested by withered, pitiful creatures with an unending hunger for the arcane. The power of the Fangs might have lured some to Verstok's trail.
pairs.text: 小心！这片废墟里充斥着枯法者，这些怪物不断渴求着魔力。阿莎曼之牙的力量或许会吸引他们去跟踪维斯托克。

pairs.source: Whatever you did seems to have annoyed those withered. This might work to your advantage. See if you can find another switch.
pairs.text: 你的行为似乎惹怒了那些枯法者。这或许对你有利。去找找另一个开关吧。

pairs.source: Has Verstok gone mad? Wielding the Fangs enhances one's senses, but I'm afraid it also heightened his paranoia.
pairs.text: 维斯托克疯了吗？阿莎曼之牙能提高感知能力，可我怕这会加剧他的妄想症。

pairs.source: You must get the Fangs away from Verstok, $n. The longer they remain in his possession, the greater his delusion becomes.
pairs.text: 你一定要夺回阿莎曼之牙，$n。它们在维斯托克的手里时间越长，他的妄想症就越严重。

pairs.source: The doors are shut? Look around the courtyard for something that might open them. Just be mindful of the withered.
pairs.text: 门关上了？去庭院里看看，有没有能打开它们的东西。但要小心枯法者。

pairs.source: What on Azeroth was that!? Be careful, $n!

pairs.text: 别走开……现在是进餐时间！
这是什么？又来了一个入侵者！

pairs.source: For your insolence, your end will be painful and slow!
pairs.text: 为了惩罚你的傲慢，我要慢慢折磨死你！

pairs.source: This display is meaningless! Your doom is at hand!
pairs.text: 这场闹剧毫无意义！你死定了！

pairs.source: Foolish orc! You will be the first to witness the Legion's arrival into my city.
pairs.text: 愚蠢的兽人！你将首先见证军团降临我的城市。

pairs.source: Long have I waited for this day. Let us not waste another moment!
pairs.text: 我早就在等这一天了。别再浪费时间了！

pairs.source: Ered'nash ila mornu nakuun. Ered'nash ban man'ari!
pairs.text: Ered'nash ila mornu nakuun. Ered'nash ban man'ari! (惡魔咒語。)

pairs.source: I returned in disgrace and sought to wash away my failure in the blood of others.
pairs.text: 我带着失败归来，想用别人的血洗刷我的失败。

pairs.source: Behold, Suramar. Our haven. Our sanctuary.
pairs.text: 看，苏拉玛。它是天堂，是神殿。

pairs.source: There I found the shrine to Tyr's champion, but was denied entry. I tried many times, until I could bear the pain no longer.
pairs.text: 我在那里找到了提尔的勇士祭坛，却不得其门而入。我试了很多次，直到无法忍受为止。

pairs.source: A good start! You fight well!
pairs.text: 很好的开始！你打得不错！

pairs.source: Elisande and the Legion seek to bring us to heel. Through fear. Through hunger.
pairs.text: 艾利桑德和燃烧军团想用恐惧和饥饿让我们臣服。

pairs.source: The flame of the shal'dorei flickers. We must re-ignite it.
pairs.text: 夏多雷之火即将熄灭。我们得重新点燃它。

pairs.source: We must stir the noble hearts of my people.
pairs.text: 我们要唤醒人民高贵的心灵。

pairs.source: YOU... must show them that Azeroth has not forsaken them.
pairs.text: 你……要让他们看到，艾泽拉斯没有抛弃他们。

pairs.source: Light, hear our prayers... for shadows close in around us.
pairs.text: 圣光，请听我们祈祷……暗影笼罩了我们。

pairs.source: Grant us this one audience, so the Ashbringer may yet save our world.
pairs.text: 请允许此人显灵，让灰烬使者再次拯救世界。

pairs.source: Do you know where it is, Uther? We risk everything if we return to that place.
pairs.text: 你知道它在哪儿吗，乌瑟尔？只要能回去，我们不惜一切。

pairs.source: Maxwell, my old friend! It's been too long.
pairs.text: 玛克斯韦尔，老朋友！好久不见。

pairs.source: You're both doing the Light's work, but if you seek to recover the Ashbringer, you must hurry.
pairs.text: 你们都在践行圣光之道，但要找回灰烬使者，就得快点了。

pairs.source: I can feel the Ashbringer calling out from an island that lies close to the tomb of the evil one. And the blade is not alone...
pairs.text: 我感觉，它正在一座岛上召唤我们，就在某个恶徒的墓穴附近。但那里不止灰烬使者……

pairs.source: Tirion still lives, but his light is fading. You must move swiftly, or he will perish! That is all I can tell you.
pairs.text: 提里奥还活着，但他的时间不多了。你们得快点，否则他会死的！我只能说到这里了。

pairs.source: Uther, wait! I have more to ask you! Uther!
pairs.text: 乌瑟尔，等等！我……我还有问题！乌瑟尔！

pairs.source: Good luck, friends. Walk always in the Light.
pairs.text: 祝你们好运。愿圣光眷顾你们。
所有人都上甲板。准备轰炸！
所有人都上甲板。准备轰炸！

pairs.source: I did what I thought was-
I will hear no more. The sentence is death. Proceed.
pairs.text: 我不想再听了。我判处你死刑，立即执行。

pairs.source: Tylos, jump us back to Mardum.
Tylos, jump us back to Mardum.
Tylos, jump us back to Mardum.
pairs.text: 泰罗斯，让我们返回马顿。

pairs.source: Tylos, jump us back to Mardum.
The Doomhammer could be anywhere. We'll have to split up.
pairs.text: 毁灭之锤可能在任何地方。我们得分头行动。

pairs.source: I will speak with the shaman at the Temple of Earth.
pairs.text: 我去跟大地神殿的萨满谈谈。

pairs.source: Our evac is almost here. We have to warn the Alliance and Horde.
pairs.text: 我们的直升机就要到了。我们必须去警告联盟和部落。

pairs.source: They must turn their fleets around. The Broken Shore is a deathtrap.
pairs.text: 必须让他们的舰队调头。破碎海滩是个死亡陷阱。

pairs.source: The island is crawling with demons. Far more than we anticip...
pairs.text: 这座岛上挤满了恶魔。比我们估计的还要……

pairs.source: So, you have uncovered our little secret.
pairs.text: 看来，你们发现了我们的小秘密。

pairs.source: Let me assure you, your precious fleets will fall into our trap.
pairs.text: 我向你们保证，你们的宝贝舰队一定会落入我们的陷阱。

pairs.source: You'll never get away with it, Detheroc!
pairs.text: 你休想逍遥法外，迪瑟洛克！

pairs.source: Oh, but I will. And you, Mathias Shaw, will help us to do it.
pairs.text: 噢？那你恐怕要失望了。因为你，马迪亚斯·肖尔，会帮我们的。

pairs.source: Now I am the leader of SI:7!
pairs.text: 现在，我就是军情七处的领袖了！

pairs.source: We were on the Broken Shore mere hours before the Alliance and Horde fleets arrived.
pairs.text: 在联盟与部落舰队抵达前几个小时，我们来到了破碎海滩。

pairs.source: Mathias Shaw led our SI:7 team on a secret recon of the island. We were awaiting extraction.
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯·肖尔带领我们军情七处小队对这座岛进行了秘密侦察。我们正在等待撤离。

pairs.source: Ahh a gift fit for a queen. You have my thanks...
pairs.text: 啊，一份适合女王的礼物。谢谢你……

pairs.source: Now the power of the arcan'dor is mine!
pairs.text: 现在，阿坎多尔的力量属于我了！

pairs.source: Ahhh, the defenders of the Light arrive. We have been waiting.
pairs.text: 啊，圣光的守护者来了。我们等候多时了。

pairs.source: You can go no further, Balnazzar. I will have justice for my slain brethren!
pairs.text: 到此为止了，巴纳扎尔。我要为死去的同胞讨回公道！

pairs.source: Justice...or vengeance, paladin? Choose carefully, for hatred leads down a dark path.
pairs.text: 你要的是公道……还是复仇，圣骑士？仇恨可是条不归路。

pairs.source: You will die by my blade!
Pitiful. Jarvox, take care of his execution. Slowly and with great agony, if you will.
pairs.text: 可怜虫。贾沃克斯，杀了他，但别让他死的太快。

pairs.source: I see a great darkness looming over Netherlight Temple. The shadow of the Burning Legion, ready to strike.
pairs.text: 我看到巨大的黑暗笼罩着虚空之光神殿。那是燃烧军团，他们要攻击了。

pairs.source: Our order will fall at his hands, everyone within will perish.
pairs.text: 教团会毁在他手中，所有人都将死去。

pairs.source: This will be our fate. We are doomed to die at the hands of the dreadlord Balnazzar.
pairs.text: 这就是命运。我们注定要死于恐惧魔王巴纳扎尔之手。

pairs.source: This will be our fate... unless...
I see a path that leads to our victory! You are there, walking with the Light, guiding us all.
pairs.text: 我看到了一条通往胜利的道路！你沐浴着圣光，指引我们前行。

pairs.source: An old enemy becomes an ally.
pairs.text: 昔日的敌人将成为盟友。
被遗忘的暗影再次崛起！
圣光之下，我们万众一心。

pairs.source: Demons in the throne room! Protect the king!
pairs.text: 王座厅里有恶魔！保护国王！

pairs.source: Shatter their portals! Drive out the Legion!
pairs.text: 打碎他们的传送门！把燃烧军团赶出去！

pairs.source: You discovered us too late, Illidari! FELBLADE, ATTACK!
pairs.text: 你发现得太晚了，伊利达雷！魔刃者，攻击！

pairs.source: You discovered us too late, Illidari! FELBLADE, ATTACK!
pairs.text: 你发现得太晚了，伊利达雷！魔刃者，攻击！
传送门开启了！他们来了！

pairs.source: Did you think I wouldn't see what you truly are, demon?
pairs.text: 你以为我看不出你的真面目吗，恶魔？

pairs.source: Dagg find da big treasure dis time!
By order of the Grand Magistrix, you are hereby charged with sedition. You undermine my authority and must pay the price.
pairs.text: 大魔导师有令，你犯有煽动叛乱罪。你妨碍了我的权威，必须为此付出代价。

pairs.source: Akama. Your duplicity is hardly surprising.
pairs.text: 阿卡玛。你的两面三刀并没有让我感到意外。

pairs.source: I should have slaughtered you and your malformed brethren long ago.
pairs.text: 我早就应该把你和你那些畸形的同胞全部杀掉。

pairs.source: We've come to end your reign, Illidan. My people, and all of Outland, shall be free!
pairs.text: 我们要终结你的统治，伊利丹！我的人民，以及整个外域，都将重获自由！

pairs.source: Today is the day we turn the tide.
Today is the day that we re-take our world.
pairs.text: 今天，我们要夺回我们的世界。

pairs.source: And send the Legion back to the hell that spawned them.
pairs.text: 并将燃烧军团赶回他们的地狱去。

pairs.source: Boldly said. But I remain... unconvinced.
pairs.text: 说得好。但是这毫无意义。

pairs.source: Bring the Vineyards to heel. I will tolerate no more insubordination.
pairs.text: 让酒庄的人都老实点，我绝不容忍任何反抗。

pairs.source: Archimonde, you will not be allowed further! The very soul of Azeroth rises against you!
pairs.text: 阿克蒙德，到此为止了！艾泽拉斯之魂起来反抗你了！

pairs.source: The veil is lifted from my eyes, heroes. The shadows retreat, and the Dream beckons.
pairs.text: 我眼前的迷雾散开了，英雄们。阴影退去，梦境重获新生。

pairs.source: Behold, the enemy is among us!
You cannot hide what you truly are, demon!
pairs.text: 你掩盖不了你的真面目，恶魔！

pairs.source: More of them are in our midst!
pairs.text: 我们中间还有他们的人！

pairs.source: Is this it, mortals? Is this all the fury you can muster?
pairs.text: 你们就这点本事吗？这就是你们全部的能耐？
让埃辛诺斯的烈焰吞噬你们！

pairs.source: Maiev... How is it even possible?
You discovered us too late, Illidari! FELBLADE, ATTACK!
pairs.text: 你发现得太晚了，伊利达雷！魔刃者，攻击！

pairs.source: Their fury pales before mine, Illidan. We have some unsettled business between us.
pairs.text: 他们的愤怒和我的相比简直不值一提，伊利丹。我们之间终于要决一胜负了。

pairs.source: My long hunt is finally over. Today, justice will be done!
pairs.text: 我长久以来的追猎终于要结束了！今天，正义将得到伸张！

pairs.source: Who shall be next to taste my blades?
Spirits! Sweep these mortals into the tides!!!
pairs.text: 幽灵们！将这些凡人丢进水里去！！！

pairs.source: All who summon the ferryman, must pay the toll!
pairs.text: 所有召唤摆渡人的人，都得买船票！

pairs.source: You wish for passage to Helheim? Then you shall have it! Ahahahaha!
pairs.text: 你想前往冥狱深渊？那就如你所愿！

pairs.source: Those who summon, pay the toll, forfeit now your eternal soul!
pairs.text: 召唤我的人，付钱吧，我要没收你们永恒的灵魂！

pairs.source: You cannot hide what you truly are, demon!
pairs.text: 你掩盖不了你的真面目，恶魔！

pairs.source: You cannot hide what you truly are, demon!
pairs.text: 你掩盖不了你的真面目，恶魔！

pairs.source: Praise to the goddess. She has blessed us this night with new life.
pairs.text: 赞美女神。今晚，她赐给了我们新的生命。

pairs.source: The birth of not one, but two healthy males.
pairs.text: 诞生的不是一个，而是两个健康的男孩。
真漂亮。几乎一模一样，除了——

pairs.source: That one! His eyes are golden!
pairs.text: 那个！他的眼睛是金色的！

pairs.source: Indeed. The child is destined for a great and prosperous future. His name... is Illidan.
pairs.text: 是的。这个孩子注定会有一个伟大而光辉的未来。他的名字是……伊利丹。

pairs.source: Illidan, your anger is misplaced. I have not insulted you.
pairs.text: 伊利丹，你的怒火发错了地方。我并没有冒犯你。

pairs.source: You have cast me out, Cenarius!
pairs.text: 你要把我赶走吗，塞纳留斯！

pairs.source: No. You may remain here, but I will no longer be your teacher.
pairs.text: 不。你可以留在这里，但我不会再做你的老师了。

pairs.source: So I must learn from... a NOVICE... instead of a MASTER?
pairs.text: 你要我要向一个新人学习……而不是一位大师？

pairs.source: To walk this path requires sacrifice, Illidan... Something you have yet to understand.
pairs.text: 要走上这条道路需要做出牺牲，伊利丹……牺牲是你现在还无法理解的。

pairs.source: No matter how hard this world fights, it will fall.
pairs.text: 不管这个世界如何反抗，都终将陨落。
我们的眼睛……欺骗了我们。

pairs.source: Beyond this army is another... and another... and another...
pairs.text: 这支军队之外，还有另一支……还有无数支……

pairs.source: Even if we defeat them here, it will mean nothing.
pairs.text: 即使我们在这里把他们击败，也毫无意义。

pairs.source: And I will find that way.
If you wish to continue studying the wilds, you may do so with your brother.
pairs.text: 如果你希望继续研究荒野，那你可以和你的兄弟一起学习。

pairs.source: Malfurion will become the first druid because he is a dedicated student. You... are NOT.
pairs.text: 玛法里奥会成为第一个德鲁伊，因为他是个专注的学生。而你……不是这样。

pairs.source: The army that marches on Azeroth is but a whisper of the Legion's true strength.
pairs.text: 进军艾泽拉斯的军队，不过是燃烧军团中的沧海一粟。

pairs.source: unless we find another way to fight them.
pairs.text: 除非我们能找到其他办法对抗他们。

pairs.source: Behold this motley throng in which the rebels put their faith.
pairs.text: 这就是叛军的靠山，一群乌合之众。

pairs.source: Kaldorei? You disgrace a glorious past, hiding in trees and cloaking yourselves in false piety. You have grown as savage as the trolls that skulk about your forests.
pairs.text: 卡多雷？你们玷污了我们光辉的历史，躲在树林里，假作虔诚。你们已经跟森林里的巨魔一样野蛮了。

pairs.source: Quel'dorei? You are peasants playing at nobility, all too willing to mingle with lesser races that dilute your bloodline. You are unworthy of the name high elves.
pairs.text: 奎尔多雷？一群沐猴而冠的暴发户，和低等种族通婚已经稀释了你们的血脉。你们配不上高等精灵之名。

pairs.source: Sin'dorei? Of all the elves, I thought you might understand the choice I made to save my people. Instead, you ally with misfits and monsters.
pairs.text: 辛多雷？在所有精灵中，我以为你们最能理解我为拯救人民做出的选择。但你们却和废物和怪胎勾结了起来。

pairs.source: Each of you has debased your proud lineage. Each of you has forgotten the ancient power that is our birthright.
pairs.text: 你们都贬低了自己高贵的血脉，你们都忘了我们与生俱来的古老力量。

pairs.source: But Suramar remembers! We are the Nightborne, last of the true elves. The rest of you are hollow echoes of our greatness.
pairs.text: 但苏拉玛会记住！我们是夜之子，最后的、真正的精灵。而你们只是昔日辉煌的拙劣遗孑。

pairs.source: Let this failed rebellion be a lesson to any that would stand against the shal'dorei!
pairs.text: 就让这次失败的起义给所有反抗夏多雷的人一个教训吧！

pairs.source: Your actions are illogical. All possible results for this encounter have been calculated.
pairs.text: 你的行为不合逻辑。我已经计算出了这场战斗所有可能的结果。

pairs.source: Enough of this weakness, boy! Contain your magic!
pairs.text: 别这么软弱！控制住你的魔力！

pairs.source: Another year of slumber. I wonder if Medivh will ever awaken.
pairs.text: 他又昏睡了一年。麦迪文还会醒过来吗？

pairs.source: Does our old friend dream? Is he trapped in nightmares?
pairs.text: 他会做梦吗？他是不是被困在梦魇里了？

pairs.source: Now you're ready to oversee the tower's protection in my absence.
pairs.text: 现在，你可以在我离开时主持塔楼的防务了。

pairs.source: Hmm, I must remember to shut you down from time to time. Overuse might cause you to become... erratic.
pairs.text: 唔，我得记得经常关掉你。过度使用可能会导致你变得……古怪。

pairs.source: It couldn't have been helped, you know. We tried to alter it, but it was all part of a larger scheme.
pairs.text: 只能这样了。我们试过挽救他，但那背后有更大的阴谋。

pairs.source: I know. All part of a greater cycle. A cycle that now at last may be broken.
pairs.text: 我知道。这是既定的宿命。但它现在终于被打破了。

pairs.source: As you can see, the Legion's reach still extends beyond the Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 正如你看见的，破碎海滩外仍然有军团的触手。

pairs.source: Their agents lurk across Azeroth, threatening to subvert our efforts at the tomb. They are some of the Legion's most powerful champions.
pairs.text: 他们的密探遍布艾泽拉斯，妄图破坏我们在那座墓穴的行动。他们是军团最强大的勇士。

pairs.source: If the plans of these fiends come to fruition, all our efforts--all our sacrifices--will have been for naught.
pairs.text: 如果让这些恶魔得逞，我们所有的努力——还有牺牲——就全白费了。

pairs.source: We must enlist your help to hunt these targets down. You may be the only one with any chance of stopping them.
pairs.text: 我们得靠你帮忙猎杀这些目标。现在你是唯一有可能阻止他们的人。

pairs.source: Our power manifests: Kirin'var torel, ahm shalar, azakim!
pairs.text: 力量显现：Kirin'var torel，ahm shalar, azakim！

pairs.source: Together! We must all lend our strength!
pairs.text: 一起来，我们大家都得出力。

pairs.source: Much has been asked of you in the course of this war, champion. I fear even more is needed.
pairs.text: 你已经为这场战争付出了许多，勇士。但这恐怕还不够。

pairs.source: Our friend lies just in here.
pairs.text: 我们的朋友就躺在这儿。

pairs.source: It breaks my heart to see him like this.
pairs.text: 他这副样子真叫我心碎。

pairs.source: Stay plucky, you will do better next time!
pairs.text: 不要灰心，下次你一定会表现得更好！

pairs.source: You won on a wing and a prayer!
pairs.text: 你不过是侥幸赢了一次而已！

pairs.source: Wretched mortal! What have you done to my ship?!
pairs.text: 卑贱的凡人！你对我的船做了什么？！

pairs.source: No matter! You will pay for this... I WILL DEVOUR YOUR SOUL!
pairs.text: 没关系！你会付出代价的……我要吞掉你的灵魂！

pairs.source: May I have your attention please. This ship is about to Self-Destruct. Please exit this ship at your soonest convenience.
pairs.text: 请注意。本舰即将自毁。请尽快离开本舰。

pairs.source: My computer! How... how did you guess my password?! It had many symbols and capitalized letters!
pairs.text: 我的计算机！你……你是怎么猜到我的密码的？！我用了很多符号和大写字母的！

pairs.source: Enough! I have little time for games!
Foolish mortals! Did you truly believe the Burning Legion would be so easily defeated?
pairs.text: 愚蠢的凡人！你们真的以为燃烧军团会这么容易就被击败吗？

pairs.source: Behold the power of the fel!
Careful, champion. Something is emerging from the portal... something powerful!
pairs.text: 小心，勇士，有东西从传送门里出来了……很强大！

pairs.source: I... I live, but I'm in no condition for battle. Hurry, champion, you must stop him!
pairs.text: 我……还活着，但没法战斗了。快，勇士，快去阻止他！

pairs.source: Good, but can you do it again?
pairs.text: 很好，但你还能复制这次胜利吗？

pairs.source: Good, but can you do it again?
pairs.text: 很好，但你还能复制这次胜利吗？

pairs.source: Cue awesome scene of the Fel Hammer destroying one of the Legion ships and the others jumping away!
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号摧毁了一艘燃烧军团的飞船，还把其他飞船吓得纷纷逃窜，那场面真是太壮观了！
接受我的庇护吧，英雄们！

pairs.source: Odyn was a fool to choose you as his champion.
pairs.text: 奥丁是个傻瓜，居然选你做他的勇士。

pairs.source: It will be amusing to see his shame when you fall.
pairs.text: 等你倒下后，他羞愧的样子一定很搞笑。

pairs.source: Your kind should not be here. This land is OURS, and only we are worthy of entering this tournament!
pairs.text: 你这种人根本不应该来这儿。这片土地是属于我们的，只有我们才有资格参加这个试炼！

pairs.source: I wonder if your name will be remembered after you've failed...
pairs.text: 我很好奇，等你输了之后，谁还会记住你的名字……

pairs.source: Your size probably matches your strength. Puny.
pairs.text: 你的体格跟你的力量很相称，小崽子。

pairs.source: I'd let you work out with me, but these weights are as big as you. Come back when you grow muscles.
pairs.text: 我想请你跟我一起练来着，但这些哑铃都快跟你一样大了。你还是回去练练肌肉再来吧。

pairs.source: It's alright if you want to leave. Most of my opponents lose as soon as they look at me.
pairs.text: 如果你想离开也没关系。我的大部分对手一看我的体格就认输了。

pairs.source: I misjudged your strength, brul. I used to believe that size mattered, but perhaps I was mistaken.
pairs.text: 我误判了你的实力，伙计。我一直以为体格能决定胜负，或许我错了。

pairs.source: When I spoke to the shaman of my tribe, he foresaw a victory for me on this day. Perhaps you should bow out of this one, fellow warrior.
pairs.text: 我跟我的部族的萨满交谈时，他预见到了我今天的胜利。或许你应该直接认输，战士。

pairs.source: You seem like one of strong will, but my will is stronger. As is my my mind.
pairs.text: 你看起来意志很坚定，但我的意志更强大。我的精神同样如此。

pairs.source: I look forward to our match, warrior. If you should survive to see it.
pairs.text: 我期待着和你的比赛，战士。如果你能撑到那一关的话。

pairs.source: I now know what the shaman meant. I have learned humility, and have grown stronger because of it.
pairs.text: 我现在明白萨满的话是什么意思了。我已经学会了谦卑，也将因此而变得更加强大。

pairs.source: Welcome, warriors, to the Trial of Rage!
pairs.text: 战士们，欢迎参加怒火试炼！

pairs.source: I'm gonna toss you around like a ragdoll, $r!
pairs.text: 我要把你像个破布娃娃一样扔出去，$r！

pairs.source: My shield has fended off armies of warriors. I don't believe one $r will be able to pierce it.
pairs.text: 我的盾牌能挡住千军万马。我才不信区区一个$r就能刺穿它。

pairs.source: It will be my pleasure to crush you.
Do not feel shame when you fall. My defense is impenetrable.
pairs.text: 就算你倒下了，也不用感到羞愧。我的防御是无懈可击的。

pairs.source: It was my honor to be welcomed here by Odyn. I will prove his choice in my strength was not misjudged.
pairs.text: 我很荣幸能在此受到奥丁的欢迎。我会证明，他选择我的力量是明智之举。

pairs.source: Her blade has felled many a warrior inside this ring. Can the Battlelord find a way to triumph?
pairs.text: 她的剑已经在这里放倒了许多战士。战争领主能获胜吗？

pairs.source: It's been a while since my blade has tasted blood. I wonder if it will be pleased with yours...
pairs.text: 我的剑已经很久没有畅饮鲜血了。不知道它会不会喜欢你的血……

pairs.source: Wait! Stop, I... I cannot go on. You're clearly the stronger brul here.
pairs.text: 等等！住手，我……我坚持不住了。你显然比我更强壮。

pairs.source: I yield, Battlelord. You have proven yourself beyond a shadow of a doubt to be the superior warrior.
pairs.text: 我投降，战争领主。你已经证明了自己，毫无疑问，你是个出众的战士。

pairs.source: A melee for the ages! Asrea has been so dominant that many spectators considered her unbeatable. It would seem her hubris has ushered in her downfall!
pairs.text: 这真是百年难遇的精彩战斗！阿斯丽娅如此强势，许多观众都以为她战无不胜了。看来她的傲慢毁了她！

pairs.source: The Battlelord has bested all challengers! The trial is complete!
pairs.text: 哈哈哈……战争领主战胜了所有挑战者！试炼完成了！

pairs.source: Let us revel in our champion's victory! All hail the Battlelord!
pairs.text: 为勇士的胜利欢呼吧！战争领主万岁！

pairs.source: When I defeat you, I shall be one step closer to ascension.
pairs.text: 等我打败了你，就离晋升又近了一步了。

pairs.source: I... I can't believe I lost. Perhaps I am not worthy to ascend...
pairs.text: 我……我不敢相信自己居然输了。或许我没有资格得到晋升。

pairs.source: It is amusing how you continue to fight, even though you're bound to lose.
pairs.text: 真是有趣，你居然还要坚持战斗，哪怕注定要失败。

pairs.source: Your fighting style does not impress, nor concern me. You will fall to my strength soon.
pairs.text: 你的战斗方式一点也不出奇，不过我也不在乎。你很快就会败在我的力量之下的。

pairs.source: You're so tiny! It's like playing with a rabbit.
pairs.text: 你太小了！这简直就像陪兔子玩耍一样。

pairs.source: They may never forgive me for what I have done, but at least they will be safe. For now, my family will be safe.
pairs.text: 他们或许永远不会原谅我，但他们至少能苟活下来。我的家族暂时安全了。

pairs.source: The Night of the Wilds is upon us once more, friends.
pairs.text: 荒野之夜再次降临了，朋友们。

pairs.source: On this evening, the spirits of the great beasts of legend rise in these very fields.
pairs.text: 今日之夜，传说中的巨兽之魂将出现在这片土地上。

pairs.source: One among us has been chosen to enter the darkness.
pairs.text: 我们之中有个人已被选中，将走入黑夜。

pairs.source: To hunt the noble spirits and return them to their honored rest.
pairs.text: 去狩猎那些高贵的兽魂，让它们安息。

pairs.source: Raise your steins to the Huntmaster, our hunter of beasts!
pairs.text: 举杯向我们的猎兽者——狩猎大师致敬吧！

pairs.source: Behold! Den-mother Fereki, great predator of the earth, and mighty Vetholnir, lord of the skies.
pairs.text: 看！狼母菲瑞奇，地上最强的野兽，和强大的天空之王维托尼尔。

pairs.source: Archdruid! The Shrine of Aviana is under attack again, and this time it's a full-scale invasion! The Ancient needs our help!
pairs.text: 大德鲁伊！艾维娜圣殿又遭到攻击了，这次是全面入侵！那位半神需要帮助！

pairs.source: To hell with the front lines! I'm going around back to take out their casters and artillery. You're welcome to join me!
pairs.text: 去他的前线！我要绕到后方去除掉那些施法者和火炮。你可以跟我一起去！

pairs.source: Did you hear that? Screams from the shrine! We've gotta get back there!
pairs.text: 你听到没有？圣殿的方向传来了尖叫声！我们得回去！

pairs.source: Perish before the might of the Legion!
pairs.text: 死在军团的力量之下吧！

pairs.source: The shrine is lost. Druids, take flight! Retreat!
pairs.text: 圣殿失守了。全体起飞！撤退！

pairs.source: What the... Flight Form's not working?! With the idol gone, we've lost our wings! Everyone teleport out and regroup at the Dreamgrove!
pairs.text: 什么……飞行形态不管用？！没有神像，我们也失去了双翼！所有人传送到梦境林地重新集结！

pairs.source: What a hunt! This, out here, is the true spirit of the wilds. Let us revel the night away and leave our cares for the morning!
pairs.text: 精彩的狩猎！此时此地，这才是真正的荒野之魂。让我们彻夜狂欢，将烦恼留到明天吧！

pairs.source: You're ordered to report to the battlefield at once. Take out those demons shredding our front lines!
pairs.text: 你现在的任务是立刻去战场报到。消灭那些正在撕裂前线的恶魔！

pairs.source: The mighty Legion has attacked, and we are barely holding off their siege.
pairs.text: 强大的燃烧军团进攻了，我们只能勉强抵挡他们的围攻。

pairs.source: The Helm of Domination shows me many things, Deathlord.
pairs.text: 统御头盔告诉了我很多事，死亡领主。

pairs.source: Velen. At long last, you return to the home you abandoned.
pairs.text: 维伦。你终于回到被你抛弃的故乡了。

pairs.source: You turned your back on your people, Prophet. Your world. Such betrayal should be answered with death.
pairs.text: 你背叛了你的人民，先知。还有你的世界。这种背叛只能用死亡来偿还。

pairs.source: That voice... Hatuun? How did you survive this hell for so long?
pairs.text: 这声音……哈顿？你是怎么在这个地狱里活下来的？

pairs.source: We changed, just as Argus did. We endured. What choice did we have?
pairs.text: 我们变了，就像阿古斯。除了忍耐，还能怎么办？

pairs.source: Stay your weapons! The Prophet and his ally are not our foes.
pairs.text: 住手！先知和他的盟友不是我们的敌人。

pairs.source: High Exarch Turalyon... we meet at last.
pairs.text: 大主教图拉扬……我们终于见面了。

pairs.source: I have no wish to fight you, Hatuun. But I cannot allow your bitterness to impede our war against the Legion.
pairs.text: 我不想跟你作对，哈顿。但我不能让你的怨恨妨碍我们与军团的战斗。

pairs.source: We must stand together, all of us, if we are to have any chance of defeating the Legion.
pairs.text: 我们必须团结起来，才有机会击败军团。

pairs.source: For millennia, the Army of the Light has waged war upon the Burning Legion. Battles. Skirmishes. Sabotage.
pairs.text: 数千年来，圣光军团一直在与燃烧军团征战不休，用尽了一切手段。

pairs.source: We were committed to our cause. Either we would end the Legion's crusade... or they would end ours.
pairs.text: 我们都愿意为此而献身。不是我们终结军团的远征……就是他们毁灭我们。

pairs.source: When at last our final assault on Argus began, we knew we might not survive it. And when the Xenedar was hit, it seemed all hope was lost.
pairs.text: 对阿古斯发起总攻时，我们就知道自己可能无法生还。泽尼达尔坠毁时，我们似乎没有了希望。

pairs.source: Your people... your worlds... always crumble.
pairs.text: 你们的人民……你们的世界……终将崩溃。

pairs.source: I am. In no small part thanks to our friend here. But Alleria... there's something else.
pairs.text: 没事。多亏了我们的朋友。可，奥蕾莉亚……还有件事。

pairs.source: When you are ready to depart, Battlelord, this portal will return you to Skyhold.
pairs.text: 战争领主，你准备好后，就用这座传送门回苍穹要塞吧。
