pairs.source: When you are ready. We have much to discuss.
pairs.text: 你准备好之后，我们得谈谈。

pairs.source: But the Light never abandoned us. It called you here and gave us another chance at victory. What we do with that chance... that is up to us.
pairs.text: 但圣光从未抛弃我们。它召唤你来此，又给了我们胜机。这机会该如何利用……就看我们的了。

pairs.source: There is a way. We will use what power we have to help you.
pairs.text: 有一条近路。我们能用自己的力量帮你。

pairs.source: Arator... not a day passed that your mother and I didn't--
pairs.text: 阿拉托尔……我和你的母亲没有一天不——

pairs.source: Every choice we made was to keep you safe. It broke our hearts to be apart from you.
pairs.text: 我们的决定都是为了你的安全。离开你让我们的心都碎了。

pairs.source: Andorhal, a few months after the Cataclysm. We're in the middle of a battle between the Horde and the Alliance.
pairs.text: 这是刚经历过大灾变的安多哈尔。我们卷入了一场部落和联盟的冲突。

pairs.source: There it is! You have your orders. Slay the dragon!
pairs.text: 它在那儿！我命令你们，杀了那头龙！

pairs.source: See, this is one of the problems with being a gnome. Sometimes Horde soldiers just get the urge to KICK you.
pairs.text: 你瞧，这就是身为侏儒的苦恼。有些部落的士兵总是把你当做软柿子捏。

pairs.source: Soldiers of the Alliance! Hold your ground! She can't hide forever.
pairs.text: 联盟的士兵们！守住阵地！她不可能一直躲下去。

pairs.source: The ALLIANCE wants me too? What's going on right now?
pairs.text: 联盟也想抓我？到底出什么事了？

pairs.source: The Well of Eternity, just prior to the War of the Ancients. About ten thousand years before your time, $n. Give or take.
pairs.text: 上古之战前的永恒之井。距离你现在的时代大约是一万年，$n。大概吧。

pairs.source: These fel wounds are bad. We need to get me back to Wyrmrest.
pairs.text: 我伤得很重。我们得把我送回龙眠神殿去。

pairs.source: There should be a time portal up on the other side of the Well. I know the way. Follow me!
pairs.text: 井的另一边应该有座时间传送门。跟我来，我认识路！

pairs.source: The man'ari torment my kind with their fel magic rituals. Let their dark words be purged... in fire!
pairs.text: 堕落者在用邪能仪式折磨我的人民。用烈焰……净化那些黑暗咒语！

pairs.source: The scorched parchment you left behind will remind the Legion that our resistance cannot be silenced. Thank you.
pairs.text: 你留下的那张烧焦的羊皮纸能提醒军团，我们的抵抗不容忽视。谢谢你。

pairs.source: Even when tortured by the Legion, my people rebel against their accursed crusade. The demons may break their bodies, but never their wills. Go, release their spirits so that they may find peace.
pairs.text: 虽然饱受折磨，我的人民仍在抵抗军团该死的远征。恶魔能摧毁他们的躯体，但不能击溃他们的意志。去释放他们的灵魂，让他们安息。

pairs.source: The spirits of those who resist the Legion inspire us all.
pairs.text: 那些反抗军团的烈士之魂鼓舞了所有人。

pairs.source: Our people are being used as fodder for vile rituals. Destroy these monstrous creations and help us honor the remains of our dead.
pairs.text: 我们的人民被当成了邪恶仪式的炮灰。毁掉这些可怕的造物，帮我们妥善安置死者的遗体。

pairs.source: Those fiends capture my people and subject them to heinous rituals. We will no longer be hunted. Help us bring the fight to the Legion!
pairs.text: 那些恶魔俘虏了我的人民，用可怕的仪式控制他们。我们不会再忍耐了。帮我们反抗军团吧！

pairs.source: As the Legion encroaches upon the hunting grounds of the panthara, the starving beasts have grown more aggressive. Thin their numbers, before they wipe out our talbuk herds.
pairs.text: 随着军团不断蚕食影豹的猎场，那些饥饿的野兽变得更具攻击性了。去削减它们的数量吧，别让它们灭绝我们的塔布羊群。
伯特的机器人要打坏蛋！

pairs.source: The code clearly missing a semicolon!
pairs.text: 这段代码显然少了一个分号！

pairs.source: Now the ones we've lost can find rest.
The lives and souls of my people are safer, thanks to you.
pairs.text: 多亏了你，我们的生命和灵魂安全多了。

pairs.source: Those steeds are vital in our battle against the demons. You have my thanks for safeguarding them.
pairs.text: 那些塔布羊对于我们跟恶魔的战争至关重要。谢谢你保护了它们。

pairs.source: My scouts found the remains of Aggonar. We are in your debt, High Exarch. And yours, outlander.
pairs.text: 斥候找到了阿苟纳的遗体。这多亏了你和这个外来者，大主教。

pairs.source: Kil'jaeden's ship. Even after its destruction, its presence vexes us. Clear the surrounding area of its blight.
pairs.text: 是基尔加丹的船。即使已经坠毁，它依然讨厌。去清除它造成的破坏吧。

pairs.source: A pity the memory of Kil'jaeden's existence cannot be purged as easily as you cleansed these grounds.
pairs.text: 基尔加丹留下的悲伤记忆可没法像你净化这片土地一样被轻松抹去。

pairs.source: The Legion is arming a devastator to fire on the Xenedar! We need you to commandeer it.
pairs.text: 军团正在组装灭绝者，想用它轰击泽尼达尔！你得去攻占它。

pairs.source: Nice shooting! With that cursed ship out of commission, we can focus on other fronts.
pairs.text: 打得好！那艘船报废之后，我们就能集中应对其他战线了。

pairs.source: Turn the cannon on Kil'jaeden's ship!
pairs.text: 将火炮对准基尔加丹的船！

pairs.source: The darkened naaru pulses with Void energy.
pairs.text: 这个黑化的纳鲁散发着虚空能量。

pairs.source: ...calling those who would use this power for their own ends.
pairs.text: ……召唤那些想占有这些力量的人。

pairs.source: But your ally saved many of us from the Legion's grasp. Perhaps you have changed.
pairs.text: 但你的盟友从军团手中救出了许多我的同胞。或许你也变了。

pairs.source: We seek you as allies. We came to Argus at the call of the Army of the Light to bring an end to the Legion. Stand with us once more!
pairs.text: 我们想跟你们结盟。我们应圣光军团请求，来阿古斯消灭燃烧军团。再次跟我们并肩战斗吧！

pairs.source: An end? Pah! Their numbers are beyond measure. It is an impossible task. A death wish!
pairs.text: 消灭？呸！他们的兵力数不胜数。这是不可能的，是找死！

pairs.source: The circle nears completion. The mortals must not disrupt the rebirth.
pairs.text: 法阵就快完成了。别让那些凡人干扰重生。

pairs.source: Those who will not serve shall be destroyed. It is the only way.
pairs.text: 不愿臣服者都将被毁灭。这是唯一的方法。

pairs.source: Become the instrument of my wrath once again, Aggramar. End this incursion of the Light.
pairs.text: 再一次宣泄我的怒火吧，阿格拉玛。终结这场圣光的入侵。

pairs.source: The hour of rebirth draws near. Are the souls prepared?
pairs.text: 重生即将到来。灵魂们准备好了吗？

pairs.source: Our kin still resist the true path, master. But they will soon be broken.
pairs.text: 那些同胞还在抗拒真理，主人。但他们即将崩溃。

pairs.source: One still eludes us. Her essence is needed to ensure the victory of my crusade.
pairs.text: 有个泰坦仍然逍遥法外。她的精华能确保远征的胜利。

pairs.source: The Life-Binder will soon reveal herself. She will not escape me, master!
pairs.text: 生命的缚誓者很快就会现身。她逃不掉的，主人！

pairs.source: When my new Pantheon rises, no power in the universe will stand against the Legion!
pairs.text: 当新的万神殿崛起，宇宙中就没有力量能阻挡军团了！

pairs.source: I remember the awakening... how life sprang forth all around us.
pairs.text: 我还记得觉醒时……生命在我们周围绽放。

pairs.source: I remember unity... until it was shattered by betrayal.
pairs.text: 我还记得团结的泰坦……可背叛毁了我们。

pairs.source: I remember fleeing... to keep him from his prize.
pairs.text: 我还记得……那些逃亡的日子。

pairs.source: The time for hiding is over. Aid me... or everything ends.
pairs.text: 现在我不能再躲藏了。帮帮我……否则一切都完了。

pairs.source: It cannot end like this. Take the others and go, Prophet. We will buy you time.
pairs.text: 别放弃。带上其他人逃走吧，先知。我们为你争取时间。

pairs.source: Hatuun! You do not have to do this!
I will hunt you across the stars, traitor! Even if it takes a thousand years!
pairs.text: 我会横跨星海找到你，叛徒！哪怕要花上一千年！

pairs.source: Swear loyalty to me, pledge the hearts of your people to my cause.
pairs.text: 宣誓效忠我吧，让你的人民加入我的事业。

pairs.source: Together, we will become Legion, and defeat the hungering void that would consume us all.
pairs.text: 我们将共同组成燃烧军团，击败想要吞噬我们的饥饿虚空。

pairs.source: It is little enough to ask, for what he offers us.
pairs.text: 相比他的恩赐，这点要求不算多。

pairs.source: Such power... And he speaks the truth.
pairs.text: 这种力量……他没有骗我们。

pairs.source: I had hoped the others would sense the darkness behind Sargeras's words.
pairs.text: 我曾指望别人能看出萨格拉斯的谎言背后的黑暗。

pairs.source: The ata'mal crystal soon showed me the horrible truth of what would come to pass if we accepted the titan's offer.
pairs.text: 阿塔玛水晶很快就让我看清了真相，接受那泰坦的提议只会带来可怕的后果。

pairs.source: I will transform you, granting you knowledge beyond imagining and might beyond measure.
pairs.text: 我会改造你，赋予你超乎想象的知识和难以估量的力量。

pairs.source: But they were blinded by their vanity... their hunger for power.
pairs.text: 可他们都被虚荣心……和对力量的渴望蒙蔽了。

pairs.source: We would be transformed not into wise leaders, but into hateful monsters.
pairs.text: 我们不会转化成睿智的领袖，而会是可憎的怪物。

pairs.source: My fellow soldiers, the trials you have endured are proof that the Light shines bright within your hearts.
pairs.text: 我的战友们，你们经历的试炼证明了你们的内心闪耀着圣光。

pairs.source: One final test remains--and it is the most daunting of all.
pairs.text: 现在只剩最后一个考验了——但它也是最艰难的。

pairs.source: It will force you to peer into the very core of what you are. Of what you believe yourself to be.
pairs.text: 它会迫使你们正视自己的真面目，以及你们对自己的认识。

pairs.source: Many worthy draenei have undergone this trial, only to return broken... or worse.
pairs.text: 许多出色的德莱尼经历这个试炼后变成了破碎者……甚至更糟。

pairs.source: Should you feel the slightest doubt, turn back now. It will be counted as wisdom, not cowardice.
pairs.text: 如果你们有一点犹豫，请立刻退回去。这不是懦弱，而是明智。

pairs.source: But if you are truly ready, step forward and embrace your fate.
pairs.text: 如果你们确实准备好了，就上前来迎接命运吧。

pairs.source: T'paartos... we have discussed this. Each initiate must be accompanied by a second. Where is yours?
pairs.text: 提帕托斯……我们已经说过了，每个新兵都要带一个副手。你的副手呢？

pairs.source: T'paartos needs no one to aid him!
The last initiate who attempted the trial alone came back in pieces. Choose a second, or head back to the barracks.
pairs.text: 上一个试图单独接受试炼的新兵最后粉身碎骨了。马上选个副手，否则就回兵营去。

pairs.source: So be it! T'paartos shall bring... this puny one!
pairs.text: 那好吧！提帕托斯就选……这个小家伙！

pairs.source: Let the trial begin. Light be with you both.
pairs.text: 开始试炼吧。愿圣光保佑你们俩。

pairs.source: The Void. A force of infinite hunger.
pairs.text: 虚空。它的饥渴永无止尽。

pairs.source: Sages and scholars fear the Void.
But we understand a truth that they do not.
pairs.text: 但我们知道他们不了解真相。

pairs.source: The Void has shaped us... changed us. But you will become its master.
pairs.text: 虚空造就和改变了我们。但你要成为它的主人。

pairs.source: Through millennia of struggle, the Light has shown us the true path.
pairs.text: 经过数千年的斗争，圣光终于为我们指明了正途。

pairs.source: At long last, our enemy has fallen. The Legion is no more. Yet our war is far from over. New threats gather in the shadows, awaiting their moment to strike.
pairs.text: 我们的敌人终于倒下了。燃烧军团已不复存在。但我们的战争远未结束。新的威胁正在阴影中酝酿，等待发难的时机。

pairs.source: You are Lightforged. You must stand as a beacon of hope against the darkness.
pairs.text: 你是光铸者。你必须成为对抗黑暗的希望灯塔。

pairs.source: For ten-thousand years, Suramar was the only world we knew.
pairs.text: 一万年来，苏拉玛就是我们的整个世界。

pairs.source: As the ages passed, Azeroth changed around us... and fell into the Legion's grasp.
pairs.text: 几百年过去，艾泽拉斯已然变了……还落入了燃烧军团之手。

pairs.source: Our leaders betrayed us, striking a bargain with the demons. But we rose up against tyranny... and drove the devils out. Suramar is ours once more, and we will never again let it fall into darkness.
pairs.text: 我们的领袖背叛了我们，与恶魔达成了交易。可我们奋起反抗暴政……赶走了恶魔，夺回了苏拉玛。我们再也不会让它陷入黑暗。

pairs.source: To secure our people's future, you must help reclaim our place in Azeroth.
pairs.text: 为了人民的未来，你必须帮我们在艾泽拉斯争取一席之地。

pairs.source: First Arcanist Thalyssra and honored guests. Welcome to Silvermoon.
pairs.text: 首席奥术师塔莉萨，还有诸位贵宾。欢迎光临银月城。

pairs.source: It is a pleasure to visit your fine city at last. Thank you for extending the invitation, Regent Lord.
pairs.text: 很荣幸能拜访这座优雅的城市。感谢您的邀请，摄政王阁下。

pairs.source: Please, call me Lor'themar. But where are my manners? Allow me to introduce another guest: Lady Alleria Windrunner, a hero of Silvermoon's past.
pairs.text: 叫我洛瑟玛就行。啊，差点忘了。请允许我向你们介绍：奥蕾莉亚·风行者女士，她曾是银月城的英雄。

pairs.source: An unexpected honor, Lady Windrunner. Silgryn told me of your courage during the campaign on Argus.
pairs.text: 这真是意外之喜，风行者女士。希尔格林跟我提起过你在阿古斯之战中的英勇表现。

pairs.source: The honor is mine, First Arcanist. I do not mean to intrude upon your visit. Perhaps I should return another time.
pairs.text: 我也很高兴见到你，首席奥术师。我无意打扰你的访问。也许我该稍后再来。

pairs.source: Nonsense. Whatever you came to say, you may say in front of our guests.
pairs.text: 无稽之谈。你有什么话都可以当着诸位客人的面说。

pairs.source: As you wish. I come bearing an offer from High King Anduin Wr--
pairs.text: 那好吧。我带来了至高王安度因·乌瑞恩的——

pairs.source: I had hoped your visit was motivated by a love for Silvermoon. Instead, you come at the behest of the Alliance's boy-king. How disappointing.
pairs.text: 我还以为你是出于对银月城的热爱而来。可你却是奉联盟那个小鬼国王之命而来。这真叫人失望。

pairs.source: Cutting words, Lor'themar. Are they yours, I wonder, or has the dutiful ranger I knew become the mouthpiece of your warchief?
pairs.text: 出言不逊啊，洛瑟玛，这是真心话，还是从前那个忠于职守的游侠已经成了大酋长的喉舌？

pairs.source: You doubt my words, yet how can we trust your own? Do you deny that the lords of the Void whisper to you? Did you not surrender yourself to the shadows on Argus?
pairs.text: 你质疑我，我们又何尝不怀疑你？你敢说虚空领主没有对你低语吗？你不是已经在阿古斯投入暗影的怀抱了吗？

pairs.source: It seems the offer I bring has been anticipated... and spurned. Very well. But before I leave, I have one request.
pairs.text: 看来你对我的来意早有预料……而且一口回绝了。不过在离开之前，我有一个请求。

pairs.source: It has been a thousand years since I set eyes upon the Sunwell. May I visit it once again?
pairs.text: 我已经有一千年没有见过太阳之井了。我能再去看它一眼吗？

pairs.source: I advise against it. We cannot trust that she will not--
pairs.text: 我反对。我们不能信任她——

pairs.source: Whatever she has become, Alleria is a daughter of Quel'Thalas. I will not deny her pilgrimage to our most sacred site. First Arcanist, you and your retinue would be welcome to join us.
pairs.text: 无论奥蕾莉亚如何改变，她都是奎尔萨拉斯的女儿。我不会阻拦她前往我们的圣地朝圣。首席奥术师，我们也欢迎您和您的扈从。

pairs.source: I would consider it an honor to see the Sunwell, Lor'themar. And I prefer that my friends call me Thalyssra.
pairs.text: 能看一眼太阳之井也是我的荣幸，洛瑟玛。还有，我喜欢朋友们叫我塔莉萨。

pairs.source: Rommath, kindly open the way for us.
pairs.text: 罗曼斯，请帮我们打开通道吧。

pairs.source: These words speak of more than earth and stone. They tell the history of our people, enduring hardship and conflict to unite against common foes.
pairs.text: 这些话语提到了大地与岩石，还有我们人民的历史，我们排除万难团结到一起，抵抗我们共同的敌人。

pairs.source: At times we were divided. At times we lost our way. But the spirits of our ancestors reminded us that we are bound together by earth, river, and sky. That we are family, and family is worth fighting for.
pairs.text: 我们会分裂，也会迷失。但先祖之灵说，我们由大地、河流和天空联系在一起。我们是一家人，应该为家人而战。

pairs.source: The time has come for you to venture beyond our sacred peaks.
I did not expect you back so soon, High Exarch. I assume your meeting with the king went well?
pairs.text: 没想到你这么快就回来了，大主教。你跟国王的会见还顺利吧？

pairs.source: It is good to see your city free, First Arcanist.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛已经解放，首席奥术师。

pairs.source: For that, we owe you both a great debt. You proved instrumental to our cause.
pairs.text: 我们都欠你一份情。你对我们的事业帮助巨大。

pairs.source: The Horde was proud to fight by your side against the Burning Legion, my lady.
pairs.text: 能与你并肩对抗燃烧军团，部落也很自豪，女士。

pairs.source: I must admit, when I first learned of the Horde, I was skeptical that we would share common ground.
pairs.text: 我必须承认，第一次听说部落时，我怀疑我们是否会有共同点。

pairs.source: I thought our kin from Kalimdor would make obvious allies. But their arrogance and mistrust soon proved otherwise.
pairs.text: 我本以为卡利姆多的远亲更适合结盟。但他们既傲慢，又多疑，我很失望。

pairs.source: Arcanist Thalyssra. I remember where your order stood in the War of the Ancients. How do we know you won't betray us and become the next Elisande... the next Azshara?
pairs.text: 奥术师塔莉萨。我还记得你们在上古之战中的表现。你怎么保证不会背叛我们，不会成为下一个艾利桑德……下一个艾萨拉？

pairs.source: We do not intend to be slaves to the Nightwell. We seek to drive the Legion from Suramar and put an end to Elisande's oppression.
pairs.text: 我们不想做暗夜井的奴隶。我们想把军团赶出苏拉玛，并结束艾利桑德的高压统治。

pairs.source: The kaldorei will fight to see the Legion defeated and the Nightwell destroyed. Beyond that... we shall see where Elune's wisdom guides us.
pairs.text: 卡多雷愿意为击败军团、摧毁暗夜井而战。除此之外……就全赖艾露恩的智慧指引了。

pairs.source: It would seem "Elune's wisdom" guided her away from the bond we once shared. So be it.
pairs.text: 看来，“艾露恩的智慧”不想让她修复与我们的关系。那就这样吧。

pairs.source: The sin'dorei are also scorned by Tyrande and her prideful lot. Yet for many ages her people slept in dens or hid in trees while my people fought to save this world.
pairs.text: 辛多雷也被泰兰德和她高傲的盟友嘲笑。他们多年来睡在山洞，躲在树巅，而我们则在为拯救这个世界奋战。

pairs.source: The Alliance feels too walled off... too cloistered. My people will never endure such stagnation again.
pairs.text: 联盟过于封闭……过于与世隔绝。我的人民再也无法忍受这种静滞。

pairs.source: That is why I am grateful for your invitation to Silvermoon. I would like to inquire whether there could be a place for the nightborne in your Horde.
pairs.text: 所以我很感谢您邀请我前往银月城。我想借此询问，夜之子在你们的部落里能不能有一席之地。

pairs.source: I am sure the regent lord will be pleased to learn of your interest. Are you ready to depart?
pairs.text: 我想摄政王听到你的话肯定很高兴。你准备好出发了吗？

pairs.source: It would be an honor, Lady Liadrin. Oculeth has the coordinates to your capital. I will gather Silgryn and Valtrois, and meet you in Silvermoon.
pairs.text: 真是荣幸，女伯爵莉亚德琳。欧库勒斯有银月城的坐标，我会叫上希尔格林和瓦尔托伊。到那儿见。

pairs.source: Walk the path that Huln took so very long ago, and bring honor to the name... Highmountain.
pairs.text: 踏上胡恩多年前走过的道路，为至高岭之名带来……新的荣耀。

pairs.source: And in turn, we have been reborn as instruments of its power.
pairs.text: 作为回报，我们也重生为它的力量载体。

pairs.source: But to those who would threaten this world... or attack our allies... you will embody the Light's wrath.
pairs.text: 然而对那些威胁这个世界……或攻击我们盟友的人……你将成为圣光之怒的化身。

pairs.source: Venture forth alongside new allies and show the world that the legacy of the nightborne is one of nobility... and strength.
pairs.text: 去跟新盟友一起冒险，让世界看看，夜之子的遗产高贵……而强大。

pairs.source: Its whispers have broken the will of dragons... and lured even the titans' own children into madness.
pairs.text: 它的低语能战胜巨龙的意志……甚至引诱泰坦之子陷入疯狂。

pairs.source: That the Void is a power to be harnessed... to be bent by a will strong enough to command it.
pairs.text: 虚空之力可以被掌握……只要有强大的意志，就能号令它。

pairs.source: Wield the shadows as a weapon to save our world... and defend the Alliance!
pairs.text: 将暗影化为武器，拯救我们的世界……并且保卫联盟！

pairs.source: A delivery of delicious fish is coming soon!
pairs.text: 一批美味的水产品即将送达！

pairs.source: Manipulate the arcane, destroying enemies with overwhelming power.
pairs.text: 操纵奥术之力，以压倒性的能量毁灭敌人。

pairs.source: Ignite enemies with balls of fire and combustive flames.
pairs.text: 使用灼热的火球和燃烧的烈焰烧尽敌人。

pairs.source: Freezes enemies in their tracks and shatters them with Frost magic.
pairs.text: 使用冰霜魔法冻结敌人的脚步，再彻底粉碎他们的身体。

pairs.source: Invokes the power of the Light to protect and to heal.
pairs.text: 唤起圣光的能量来保护和治疗盟友。

pairs.source: A righteous crusader who judges and punishes opponents with weapons and Holy magic.
pairs.text: 正义的十字军，使用手中的武器和神圣的魔法对敌人进行审判和制裁。

pairs.source: Driven by a frenzied persistence to pursue prey, these beasts stop at nothing to achieve victory; even death is temporary for these predators.
pairs.text: 在疯狂的执念驱使下不断追逐猎物，这些猛兽会不择手段地夺取胜利；对这些掠食者而言，死亡也不过是短暂的休憩。

pairs.source: Guileful creatures capable of skillfully mitigating lethal blows dealt to themselves and their allies.
pairs.text: 狡猾的生物，擅长化解针对自己及其盟友的致命攻击。

pairs.source: Stalwart and veteran defenders who unquestionably place their thick hides and protective exteriors in harm's way for their allies.
pairs.text: 健壮而老练的防御者，他们无疑会将自己厚实的皮肤和防护性外壳挡在针对其盟友的伤害之前。

pairs.source: Can take on the form of a powerful Moonkin, balancing the power of Arcane and Nature magic to destroy enemies at a distance.
pairs.text: 可以变形为强大的枭兽，释放奥术和自然的平衡之力在远距离毁灭敌人。

pairs.source: Takes on the form of a great cat to deal damage with bleeds and bites.
pairs.text: 致命的猎豹形态，利用撕咬和流血造成大量伤害。

pairs.source: Takes on the form of a mighty bear to absorb damage and protect allies.
pairs.text: 强大的熊形态，吸收伤害并保护盟友。

pairs.source: Uses heal-over-time Nature spells to keep allies alive.
pairs.text: 使用持续性治疗法术来维持盟友的生命。

pairs.source: An icy harbinger of doom, channeling runic power and delivering vicious weapon strikes.
pairs.text: 冰冻末日的使者，能够引导符文能量并使用武器狠毒地打击敌人。

pairs.source: A master archer or sharpshooter who excels in bringing down enemies from afar.
pairs.text: 百步穿杨的神射手，擅长远距离夺走敌人的性命。

pairs.source: A rugged tracker who favors using animal venom, explosives and traps as deadly weapons.
pairs.text: 精练的追踪者，能将动物剧毒，爆炸物和陷阱当作致命的武器来使用。

pairs.source: Uses magic to shield allies from taking damage as well as heal their wounds.
pairs.text: 使用魔法护盾保护盟友不受伤害，也能及时治愈他们的伤口。

pairs.source: A versatile healer who can reverse damage on individuals or groups and even heal from beyond the grave.
pairs.text: 多才多艺的治疗者，既能够单体治疗也能够照顾到整个团队，甚至能够在牺牲后继续治疗。

pairs.source: Uses sinister Shadow magic, especially damage-over-time spells, to eradicate enemies.
pairs.text: 使用邪恶的暗影魔法彻底根除敌人，尤其擅长持续伤害法术。

pairs.source: A deadly master of poisons who dispatches victims with vicious dagger strikes.
pairs.text: 致命的使毒高手，能够使用匕首迅速而冷酷的杀死敌人。

pairs.source: A ruthless fugitive who uses agility and guile to stand toe-to-toe with enemies.
pairs.text: 无情的游荡剑客，擅长与敌人短兵相接。

pairs.source: A spellcaster who harnesses the destructive forces of nature and the elements.
pairs.text: 能够驾驭元素的施法者，使用自然的毁灭之力打击敌人。

pairs.source: A totemic warrior who strikes foes with weapons imbued with elemental power.
pairs.text: 信仰图腾之力的战士，使用灌注元素能量的武器攻击敌人。

pairs.source: A healer who calls upon ancestral spirits and the cleansing power of water to mend allies' wounds.
pairs.text: 能召唤先祖之魂的治疗者，使用水之净化能量来治愈盟友的创伤。

pairs.source: A master of shadow magic who specializes in drains and damage-over-time spells.
pairs.text: 暗影魔法大师，擅长吸取能量和持续伤害法术。

pairs.source: A master of chaos who calls down fire to burn and demolish enemies.
pairs.text: 使用混乱魔法的大师，能够降下灾厄的烈焰，将敌人焚烧殆尽。

pairs.source: A sturdy brawler who uses liquid fortification and unpredictable movement to avoid damage and protect allies.
pairs.text: 坚韧的勇士，以行云流水、变化莫测的身法闪避伤害并保护盟友。

pairs.source: A martial artist without peer who pummels foes with hands and fists.
pairs.text: 武艺无双，尤其擅长拳脚功夫的武者。

pairs.source: A healer who masters the mysterious art of manipulating life energies, aided by the wisdom of the Jade Serpent and Pandaren medicinal techniques.
pairs.text: 掌握了神秘技艺，擅长操纵生命能量的治疗者，受到青龙的指引和熊猫人医术的加持。

pairs.source: Driven by a rabid persistence to pursue prey, these carnivorous beasts stop at nothing to achieve victory; even death is temporary for these predators.
pairs.text: 在强烈的执念驱使下不断追逐猎物，这些食肉的猛兽会不择手段地夺取胜利；对这些掠食者而言，死亡也不过是短暂的休憩。

pairs.source: Guileful creatures capable of skillfully mitigating lethal blows dealt to themselves and their allies.
pairs.text: 狡猾的生物，擅长化解针对自己及其盟友的致命攻击。

pairs.source: Stalwart and veteran defenders who unquestionably place their thick hides and protective exteriors in harm's way for their allies.
pairs.text: 健壮而老练的防御者，他们无疑会将自己厚实的皮肤和防护性外壳挡在针对其盟友的伤害之前。

pairs.source: A brooding master of warglaives and the destructive power of Fel magic.
pairs.text: 恐怖的战刃大师，使用邪能魔法的破灭之力。

pairs.source: Embraces the demon within to incinerate enemies and protect their allies.
pairs.text: 接受内心的恶魔，用它烧尽敌人，保护盟友。

pairs.source: This booming coastal city is run by Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders.  Mortal enemies of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and part of the Steamwheedle Cartel.
pairs.text: 一个由黑水海盗的头目，大财主里维加兹经营的繁荣的海港城市。它也是热砂集团的一部分，主要仇敌是血帆海盗。
叛变的迪菲亚盗贼(艾泽拉斯)
锻造 - 护甲锻造专精

pairs.source: This Alliance capital is the pride of the Dun Morogh dwarves.  Home to King Magni.
pairs.text: 这座联盟的大都市是丹莫罗矮人们的骄傲，也是麦格尼国王的家。

pairs.source: The former denizens of Gnomeregan, now living in New Tinkertown and in league with the Alliance.
pairs.text: 诺莫瑞根以前的居民，现在流亡到了新工匠镇并居住在此，联盟方的重要成员。

pairs.source: The dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood epitomize excellence in craftsmanship and are bent on unlocking the secrets of Blackrock Mountain.
pairs.text: 瑟银兄弟会的矮人有着无与伦比的制造技术，并致力于解开黑石山中的全部秘密。

pairs.source: Led by Sylvanas Windrunner, the Forsaken have joined a tenuous alliance with the Horde and established this capital in the vast depths under the Ruins of Lordaeron.
pairs.text: 希尔瓦娜斯·风行者领导下的被遗忘者与部落之间建立起了微弱的同盟关系，并在洛丹伦地下遗迹的深处建立起了这座城市。

pairs.source: This Alliance capital is populated by Night Elves and is located in the Island of Teldrassil.  Ruled by the Priestess of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind.
pairs.text: 坐落在泰达希尔岛上的联盟城市，暗夜精灵的首都，由月女祭司泰兰德·语风统治。

pairs.source: A primarily human criminal organization that operates mostly out of the Alterac Mountains and Hillsbrad Foothills.
pairs.text: 一个主要由人类组成的犯罪组织，目前占据着奥特兰克山脉与希尔斯布莱德丘陵的部分地区。

pairs.source: One of the last bastions of human power, this Alliance capital is ruled by the young but wise king, Anduin Wrynn.
pairs.text: 这座人类势力的最后堡垒目前由年轻但是睿智的国王安度因·乌瑞恩统治着。

pairs.source: Founded by Thrall, this Horde capital city is home to many of the proud orc clans of Durotar.
pairs.text: 这座由萨尔建立的部落城市是许多兽人氏族的家园。

pairs.source: Baine Bloodhoof leads his people, the proud Tauren, from this mighty Horde capital.
pairs.text: 贝恩·血蹄及其领导下的牛头人的家园，壮丽而伟大的部落城市。
制皮 - 元素制皮专精
制皮 - 龙鳞制皮专精

pairs.source: These bloodthirsty corsairs are the bane of many a merchant in the high seas.  Sworn enemies of Booty Bay.
pairs.text: 一群嗜血的海盗，所有海上商人的公敌。藏宝海湾的死敌。

pairs.source: These centaur have made their home in the southern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Magram Centaur.
pairs.text: 一群居住在凄凉之地南方的半人马，玛格拉姆半人马的仇敌。

pairs.source: These centaur have made their home in the eastern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Gelkis Centaur.
pairs.text: 一群居住在凄凉之地东部的半人马，吉尔吉斯半人马的仇敌。

pairs.source: These trolls have come to Yojamba Isle in an effort to recruit help against the resurrected Blood God and his Atal'ai Priests in Zul'Gurub.
pairs.text: 这群居住在尤亚姆巴岛的巨魔正在努力招募全世界的勇士，希望他们能够帮助自己对抗祖尔格拉布中的邪神哈卡以及他的阿塔莱祭司们。
锻造 - 武器锻造专精

pairs.source: This guild of thieves and assassins welcomes only those of extraordinary prowess into its fold.  Sworn rivals of the Syndicate.
pairs.text: 这个由盗贼与刺客组成的行会只欢迎那些有着出色实力的人进入他们的领地。他们也是辛迪加的仇敌。

pairs.source: Capital of the Steamwheedle Cartel and home to goblinhood's finest engineers, alchemists and merchants.
pairs.text: 热砂集团的首府，诸多优秀地精技师、炼金师和商人的家乡。

pairs.source: Part of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this goblin city provides a neutral haven for those that wish to trade goods and services in the Barrens.
pairs.text: 热砂集团的成员，这座城市给许多希望在贫瘠之地做生意的人提供了一个开放和中立的天堂。

pairs.source: The League of Arathor seeks to reclaim the lost land of Arathi Basin for their benefactors in Stormwind.
pairs.text: 阿拉索联军正试图为暴风城夺回阿拉希盆地。

pairs.source: The Defilers seek to claim Arathi Basin's valuable resources for the Horde.
pairs.text: 污染者试图为部落夺取阿拉希盆地的重要资源。

pairs.source: An organization focused on protecting Azeroth from the threat of the Scourge.  Strongholds of the Argent Dawn can be found in the Eastern and Western Plaguelands.
pairs.text: 一个致力于从亡灵天灾军团的威胁下拯救艾泽拉斯世界的组织。银色黎明的据点遍布东西瘟疫之地。

pairs.source: This tribe of exiled trolls has joined forces with Thrall and the Horde.  They now call Durotar their home, which they share with their orc allies.
pairs.text: 一群被放逐的巨魔，加入了萨尔领导下的部落。他们现在将杜隆塔尔当作自己的新家，并与兽人盟友们一起生活在那里。
制皮 - 部族制皮专精
工程学 - 地精工程学专精
工程学 - 侏儒工程学专精
锻造 - 战锤锻造专精
锻造 - 战斧锻造专精
锻造 - 长剑锻造专精

pairs.source: As the last uncorrupted furbolg tribe, the Timbermaw seek to preserve their spiritual ways and end the suffering of their brethren.
pairs.text: 作为最后一支尚未堕落的熊怪部族，木喉部族正致力于保留他们那种独特的精神修行之道，并试图终结其他熊怪部族的痛苦。

pairs.source: This trading post is run by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel and it sits in the crossroads of Winterspring's main trade routes.
pairs.text: 热砂集团经营之下的一座贸易城市，坐落于冬泉谷的两条主要干道的交叉处。

pairs.source: This small group of reclusive night elves raises and trains wintersabers in the Winterspring area.
pairs.text: 这是一些专门在冬泉谷地区驯养冬泉霜刃豹的暗夜精灵。

pairs.source: The druids of Cenarion Circle are guardians of nature and make their home in tranquil Moonglade.
pairs.text: 塞纳里奥议会的德鲁伊是自然的守卫者，他们定居于宁静的月光林地。

pairs.source: The Frostwolf Clan seeks to drive out the dwarves of the Stormpike Expedition from Alterac Valley.
pairs.text: 霜狼氏族正在努力将雷矛探险队赶出奥特兰克山谷。

pairs.source: The Stormpike Dwarves have set up residence in Alterac Valley, where they're locked in battle with the Frostwolf Orcs.
pairs.text: 一群在奥特兰克山谷建立了永久居所的矮人，正与霜狼氏族的兽人激烈交战中。

pairs.source: These elementals have made their home on the islands east of Azshara.  Sworn enemies of the armies of Ragnaros.
pairs.text: 这些元素生物定居于艾萨拉的东部的一座小岛上，是拉格纳罗斯及其军团的死敌。

pairs.source: A remnant of the once powerful elves living in Dire Maul, yet still wise and knowledgeable about great secrets.
pairs.text: 一群居住在厄运之槌的精灵后裔，他们仍然具有着相当渊博的智慧与学识，并保守着一些伟大的秘密。

pairs.source: Fierce orcs of the Warsong Clan, locked in battle against the Silverwing Sentinels in Warsong Gulch.
pairs.text: 战歌氏族是最具攻击性的兽人氏族，目前正与暗夜精灵的银翼哨兵部队在战歌峡谷激烈地交战中。

pairs.source: Staunch defenders of Ashenvale, locked in battle against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.
pairs.text: 灰谷地区坚定的守卫者，目前正与战歌氏族在战歌峡谷中激烈交战。

pairs.source: A carnival that showcases the weird and the extraordinary, located on a mysterious island only accessible for the first week of every month.
pairs.text: 一个向全世界展示着各类珍奇异宝的马戏团。马戏团位于一座神秘的岛屿上，只在每月的第一周开放。

pairs.source: The descendants of the Bronze Dragonflight are the guardians of time and care little for the mortal races.
pairs.text: 青铜龙军团的后代，时间的守卫者，对凡人种族漠不关心。

pairs.source: The capital of Quel'Thalas, home of the blood elves.  Though nearly destroyed by Arthas' attack on the Sunwell, Silvermoon is once again a thriving city.
pairs.text: 奎尔萨拉斯的首都，血精灵的家园。虽然银月城几乎被阿尔萨斯毁灭，但它再次成为了一座繁荣的城市。

pairs.source: Once a high elf town, Tranquillien became abandoned after the Scourge invaded Quel'Thalas.  It has now been reclaimed by the Forsaken and the blood elves who seek to rid the Ghostlands of the Scourge.
pairs.text: 塔奎林曾是一座高等精灵的城镇，但是在天灾军团入侵奎尔萨拉斯之后被废弃了。现在，被遗忘者和血精灵联手夺回了这座城镇。

pairs.source: The naaru vessel that brought the draenei to Azeroth.  Though stranded in the Azuremyst Isles, it acts as a home city for this noble race.
pairs.text: 将德莱尼人带到艾泽拉斯世界来的纳鲁飞船，目前搁浅在秘蓝岛上。对于这个高贵的种族来说，埃索达是他们的主城。

pairs.source: An ancient order of draenei priests once run by Velen, the Aldor are currently led by High Priestess Ishanah.  They are servants of the naaru in Shattrath City known as the Sha'tar.  Rivals of the Scryers.
pairs.text: 一个古老的德莱尼祭司组织，起初由维伦领导。现在他们在高阶女祭司伊沙娜的指引下为沙塔斯城的纳鲁效力。与占星者势力敌对。

pairs.source: Led by Nexus-Prince Haramad, the Consortium is a loosely affiliated cartel of ethereal smugglers, traders and thieves that has come to Outland to benefit from its riches.
pairs.text: 由星界巨商哈拉麦德领导的星界财团是一个结构松散的商业联盟，其成员都是从事走私、贸易或盗窃的虚灵。

pairs.source: Voren'thal the Seer leads the dissident blood elves who've rejected Kael'thas' path to power.  They've joined forces with the naaru of Shattrath City, much to the dismay of the Aldor.
pairs.text: 由先知沃雷塔尔领导的这群血精灵拒绝跟随凯尔萨斯。他们加入了沙塔斯城的纳鲁联军，这令奥尔多感到非常不安。

pairs.source: The Sha'tar are a group of powerful naaru who rule over a rebuilt Shattrath City.  With the help of the Aldor and the Scryers, they lead the battle against Illidan and the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 沙塔尔是一群统治沙塔斯城的强大纳鲁人的组织。在奥尔多和占星者的帮助下，他们正在领导针对伊利丹和燃烧军团的战斗。

pairs.source: This reclusive group of brown-skinned orcs has escaped any form of demonic corruption.  They have retained their traditional way of life in the face of great changes in Outland.
pairs.text: 这群隐居的棕皮兽人逃脱了恶魔的腐蚀，并在天崩地裂的外域中保持了古老的传统。

pairs.source: An exploratory force sent to Outland by the Cenarion Circle to study surviving life forms.  The Cenarion Expedition has quickly gained in size and autonomy since the opening of the Dark Portal.
pairs.text: 塞纳里奥议会派往外域研究生态的探险队。在黑暗之门开启后，远征队迅速壮大，并获得了自治权。

pairs.source: Vestiges of the Sons of Lothar, veterans of the Alliance that first came into Draenor, have steadfastly held on to this Hellfire outpost.  They are now joined by the armies from Stormwind and Ironforge.
pairs.text: 这座前哨基地坐落在地狱火半岛上，由第一批深入德拉诺的联盟精英部队“洛萨之子”的残余力量坚守。现在他们得到了来自暴风城和铁炉堡的支援。

pairs.source: The expedition sent through the Dark Portal by Thrall has built a stronghold in Hellfire Peninsula.  Thrallmar serves as a base of operations for much of the Horde's activities in Outland.
pairs.text: 由萨尔派出的远征军在地狱火半岛建立的要塞。萨尔玛是部落在外域的大部分行动的根据地。

pairs.source: A secret sect of the Kirin Tor founded to spy on Medivh and his activities.
pairs.text: 一个由肯瑞托为了调查麦迪文和监视他的活动而建立的秘密组织。

pairs.source: The sporelings are a mostly peaceful race of mushroom-men native to Outland. Their home is located in the southern bogs of Zangarmarsh.
pairs.text: 生活在外域的孢子人是一个非常温和的种族。他们的家园就坐落在赞加沼泽南部的沼泽地中。

pairs.source: Draenei for "redeemed."  These Broken have escaped the grasp of their various slavers in Outland and have made their home in Nagrand.  It is there that they seek to rediscover their destiny.
pairs.text: 在德莱尼语中意为“得到救赎”。这些从各种奴役和控制中逃出来的破碎者在纳格兰建立了自己的家园，寻找自己真正的命运。
时光之穴 - 敦霍尔德
时光之穴 - 南海镇卫兵

pairs.source: The Keepers of Time are bronze dragons hand-picked by Nozdormu to watch over the Caverns of Time.
pairs.text: 这些由诺兹多姆亲自挑选的青铜龙无时无刻不在监视着时光之穴。

pairs.source: A secretive subgroup of the Bronze Dragonflight, led by Soridormi, prime mate of Nozdormu.
pairs.text: 隶属于青铜龙军团的秘密组织，由诺兹多姆最亲密的伴侣索莉多米领导。

pairs.source: Used for the Blackheart the Inciter event.
Used for the Blackheart the Inciter event.
Used for the Blackheart the Inciter event.
Used for the Blackheart the Inciter event.
Used for the Blackheart the Inciter event.
The refugees of Shattrath come from diverse backgrounds and races.  Word of helpful deeds spreads quickly among the Denizens of Lower City.
pairs.text: 来自各个地方、各个种族的避难者在沙塔斯城的聚集地。在贫民窟中，善行善举总是会很快传遍所有人的耳朵。

pairs.source: The elite of the Broken tribe known as the Ashtongue, officially aligned with Illidan. The Deathsworn are Akama's most trusted lieutenants and are privy to their leader's mysterious motivations.
pairs.text: 来自破碎者灰舌部族的精英勇士，表面上与伊利丹结盟。这些勇士是阿卡玛最信任的部下，并参与了他的秘密计划。

pairs.source: This unusual brood of dragons was spawned from the eggs of Deathwing's black dragonflight, and infused with raw nether-energies.  Now, they seek to find their identity beyond the shadows of their father's destructive heritage.
pairs.text: 这种罕见的龙是死亡之翼的后代，受到原始的虚空能量影响后发生了变异。现在，他们正在努力摆脱死亡之翼的血脉带来的阴影，找寻自己的命运。
黑暗神廟大門 - 伊利達瑞

pairs.source: An airborne military force created by Shattrath City to deal with the threats that loom in the highest reaches of Outland.
pairs.text: 一支由沙塔斯城建立的空中武装力量，职责是应对潜伏在外域天空中的威胁。

pairs.source: The combined forces of the Alliance in Northrend, lead by the Valiance Expedition, but also including civilian groups such as the Explorer's League.
pairs.text: 联盟派往诺森德的多支部队的统称，由无畏远征军领导。同时也包括一些非军事组织，如探险者协会。

pairs.source: The enlightened denizens of Ogri'la have made their dwelling in the western Blade's Edge Mountains, where proximity to apexis crystals has caused them to transcend their brutish ogre nature.
pairs.text: 聪明而开化的奥格瑞拉食人魔居住在刀锋山的西部区域，那里富产的埃匹希斯水晶使得他们的智商远远超越了其他野蛮的同类。

pairs.source: The main armies of the Alliance in Northrend, moving against the Scourge and unified under King Varian Wrynn's command.
pairs.text: 联盟在诺森德的主力部队，由瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王统领，对抗天灾军团。

pairs.source: The combined forces of the Horde in Northrend, spearheaded by the Warsong Offensive.
pairs.text: 部落派往诺森德的多支部队的统称，由战歌远征军充当先头部队。
奪取旗幟 - 旗幟 - 聯盟

pairs.source: These hardy people are cousins of the Tauren and have become valuable scouts for the armies of the Horde as they march northward.
pairs.text: 这些坚强的牦牛人是牛头人的同类，在部落远征诺森德的战役中，他们成为了具有重要价值的斥候。

pairs.source: The Forsaken tasked by Sylvanas Windrunner with enacting Undercity's vengeance against Arthas by delivering the latest strain of their deadly Plague.
pairs.text: 这支由希尔瓦娜斯·风行者派遣的被遗忘者势力想要在诺森德散播他们最新研制成功的瘟疫病菌，以此来向阿尔萨斯复仇。

pairs.source: This organization seeks to find the origin of the dwarven race by collecting Titan artifacts.  Their most recent research has led them to various archeological sites in Northrend.
pairs.text: 这个组织致力于通过发掘泰坦遗留下来的古器追寻矮人种族的起源。最近他们来到诺森德的多处古迹进行研究。
山羊競速強化道具 DND

pairs.source: The tuskarr are a tough but peaceful people who derive their livelihood from fishing and whaling.  Their settlements have recently come under fierce attack and welcome any allies who would come to their aid.
pairs.text: 海象人是坚韧而和平的种族，通过捕鲸和捕鱼谋生。他们的家园最近正在遭受凶猛的攻击，急需来自外界的援手。

pairs.source: Shattrath City's final push against Prince Kael'thas' operations in the Sunwell.
pairs.text: 沙塔斯城的精锐部队，目标是向太阳之井的凯尔萨斯王子发动最终的攻势。

pairs.source: Garrosh Hellscream commands the Horde's main expeditionary forces as they make their way into Northrend to face Arthas and the armies of the Scourge.
pairs.text: 部落的主力部队由加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮率领，向盘踞在诺森德的阿尔萨斯和天灾军团发起挑战。

pairs.source: The mages and archmages running the city of Dalaran.  Faced with the rising threats of the Blue Dragonflight and the Scourge, they've transported their city to the heart of Northrend.
pairs.text: 统治达拉然的法师和大法师们。由于蓝龙军团和亡灵天灾造成的威胁，他们将整座城市传送到了诺森德的腹地。

pairs.source: With the Blue Dragonflight's violent upheaval against all mortal users of magic, the remaining dragonflights have banded under the leadership of the Red Dragonflight to combat their wayward kin.
pairs.text: 由于蓝龙军团粗暴地干涉凡人种族使用魔法的权利，其余的龙族不得不联合在红龙军团旗下，与这些狂乱的同胞抗衡。

pairs.source: A militant core of high elves that rejects the admission of blood elves into the Kirin Tor.  They've united under the banner of Vereesa Windrunner and joined the Alliance forces in Northrend.
pairs.text: 这支高等精灵中的精锐部队拒绝让血精灵进入肯瑞托。他们联合在温蕾萨·风行者的旗帜下，与诺森德的联盟军队并肩作战。

pairs.source: Freed from the grasp of the Lich King, his former Death Knights have regrouped against him under the banner of Highlord Darion Mograine.
pairs.text: 在脱离了巫妖王的控制之后，这些曾经效命于他的死亡骑士联合起来，在大领主达里安·莫格莱尼的领导下对抗巫妖王。
奪取旗幟 - 旗幟 - 部落
奪取旗幟 - 旗幟 - 中立

pairs.source: Driven from their lands by the Scourge, this fierce tribe of wolvar stumbled upon Sholazar Basin, where they intend to make their new home.  Their aggressive nature has put them at odds with the various gorloc tribes known collectively as the Oracles.
pairs.text: 这群凶猛的狼獾人被天灾军团追杀，偶然来到了索拉查盆地，遂决定在此安家。由于极富攻击性，他们与被称为神谕者的鳄鱼人部族成水火之势。

pairs.source: The gorlocs of Sholazar Basin are a race of reptilian creatures who see themselves as guardians of the titan technology that remains in the zone (though they understand little of it).  They find themselves in an escalating territorial war with the wolvar.
pairs.text: 索拉查盆地的鳄鱼人将自己视为该区域中存留的泰坦科技的守护者（虽然他们基本不了解这种科技）。目前他们正在与狼獾人进行着不断激化的领土战争。

pairs.source: Led by Tirion Fordring, the Argent Crusade combines the reformed Order of the Silver Hand with the Argent Dawn in one final push against the forces of the Lich King.
pairs.text: 提里奥·弗丁领导的银色北伐军是由白银之手骑士团和银色黎明重组而成的，他们的目标是击溃巫妖王的军队。

pairs.source: The frost giants of the Storm Peaks are a war-like race that makes their home in Dun Niffelem.
pairs.text: 这支风暴峭壁的冰霜巨人部族非常好战，他们定居在丹尼芬雷。

pairs.source: Traditionally barred from Dalaran, the Horde has been accepted into the city through the efforts of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver.  His followers have taken up his name and watch over the ward known as Sunreaver's Sanctuary.
pairs.text: 在大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的努力下，一贯被达拉然据之门外的部落也获准进入这座城市。他的追随者保卫着以他的名字命名的夺日者圣殿。

pairs.source: This mysterious race of frost dwarves makes their home in the Storm Peaks.  They've recently befriended members of the Explorers' League and welcome Alliance members within their settlements.
pairs.text: 这个神秘的冰霜矮人种族定居在风暴峭壁。他们最近与探险者协会成为了朋友，并且欢迎联盟的成员造访他们的家园。

pairs.source: Run by the ruthless Trade Prince Gallywix, the Bilgewater Cartel is the most powerful trading company on the Isle of Kezan. From their headquarters at Bilgewater Port, the cartel dominates trade all over the South Seas.
pairs.text: 由无情的贸易巨子加里维克斯控制的锈水财阀是科赞岛上最强大的贸易公司。他们的总部坐落在锈水码头，整片南海的贸易都被他们所掌控。

pairs.source: The people of Gilneas are a nation of survivors.  Having walled themselves off from the rest of humanity, they must now face new threats from within.
pairs.text: 吉尔尼斯是一个幸存者的国度。当他们最后的人性也被剥去后，吉尔尼斯面临着来自内部的全新威胁。

pairs.source: This gathering of the most powerful shaman of Azeroth seeks to maintain the balance between the world's elemental forces.  Their main focus during the cataclysm has been to  repair and stabilize the damage caused by Deathwing's arrival.
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯最强大的萨满祭司都聚集到了一起，期望能够维持这个世界各股元素力量之间的平衡。在这场大灾变中，他们正竭力修复死亡之翼的来临对世界造成的伤害。

pairs.source: Under a pact by Tirion Fordring and Darion Mograine, the Argent Crusade and the Knights of the Ebon Blade have set aside their differences during the attack on Icecrown Citadel until the Lich King is slain.
pairs.text: 在提里奥·弗丁与达里安·莫格莱尼的共同协议下，银色北伐军与黑锋骑士团决定暂时放下分歧、统一战线，合力攻入冰冠堡垒，击败巫妖王。

pairs.source: Faced with the impending devastation of Mount Hyjal, the most powerful members of the Cenarion Circle have joined forces with their Emerald Dragonflight allies to fend off Ragnaros' elemental hordes and the Twilight's Hammer.
pairs.text: 圣山海加尔面临着毁灭的威胁，塞纳里奥议会集结了最强大的成员，与他们的翡翠绿龙盟友一同抵御着拉格纳罗斯和暮光之锤的入侵。
奪取旗幟 - 旗幟 - 聯盟 2
奪取旗幟 - 旗幟 - 部落 2

pairs.source: Guild reputation is your personal standing with your guild, and is required to buy guild rewards.  Guild reputation is gained automatically when you earn guild experience.
pairs.text: 公会声望代表了你在公会中的个人地位，购买公会奖励时需要达到与之对应的声望。公会声望会在你获得公会经验值时自动获得。

pairs.source: The elemental plane of earth, Deepholm, is ruled by Therazane and her children, the Stone Lords.  After witnessing the devastation Deathwing and his followers caused her realm, Therazane treats all outsiders with open hostility.
pairs.text: 塞拉赞恩和她的石领主子嗣们统治着土元素位面深岩之洲。在见证了死亡之翼及其追随者对她的国度造成的伤害后，塞拉赞恩对所有外来者都充满了敌意。

pairs.source: This wayward orc clan was once empowered by Deathwing himself to enslave red dragons, including Alexstrasza.  Currently less numerous and powerful, the Dragonmaw make their home in the Twilight Highlands.
pairs.text: 这支狂放不羁的兽人氏族曾经在死亡之翼的授意下奴役了红龙军团和红龙女王阿莱克丝塔萨。如今龙喉氏族的数量和实力都已不如往昔，他们在暮光高地上建立了家园。

pairs.source: The cat-like people of Ramkahen are the descendants of the Tol'vir, guardians of Uldum.  Though they've lost their stone bodies, protecting the secrets of the titans is still a part of their rigid tradition.
pairs.text: 拉穆卡恒的猫形子民是奥丹姆守护者托维尔一族的后裔。尽管他们失去了石头的身体，但保护泰坦秘密的使命仍然留在了他们一成不变的传统中。

pairs.source: The Wildhammer dwarves are known for their near-reckless courage as well as their unsurpassed gryphon-riding skills.  After losing their home of Grim Batol to a Dark Iron Curse, they've spread their dwellings around the Twilight Highlands.
pairs.text: 蛮锤部族以他们近乎鲁莽的勇气和出类拔萃的狮鹫骑战技艺而闻名。因为黑铁矮人的诅咒，他们失去了在格瑞姆巴托的家园。在那之后，蛮锤矮人们分散地定居在暮光高地上。

pairs.source: Once led by Duke Reginald Baradin II, this fierce army has historic ties to the island stronghold of Tol Barad.  They have joined the forces of the Alliance in an effort to repeal the Horde invaders and gain control of this strategic island.
pairs.text: 这支曾经由雷吉纳德·巴拉丁二世公爵率领的精锐之师和海岛要塞托尔巴拉德有着深厚的历史渊源。他们加入了联盟军队，旨在击退部落入侵者并捍卫这座极具战略意义的岛屿。

pairs.source: Hellscream's Reach is an elite Horde regiment comprised solely of veterans of multiple tours of duty.   Handpicked by Garrosh himself, he has commanded them to take complete control of Tol Barad.  Failure is not an option.
pairs.text: 地狱咆哮近卫军是部落的一支精英部队，由最骁勇善战的老兵编制而成。加尔鲁什亲自选拔了这些战士，并命令他们夺取托尔巴拉德。只许成功，不许失败。

pairs.source: Infuriated by the destruction wrought by the Lord of Flame, the Cenarion Circle seize the initiative, fighting back against Ragnaros and driving deep into the very heart of the Firelands.
pairs.text: 火元素领主带来的毁灭激怒了塞纳里奥议会。他们主动出击，直捣拉格纳罗斯在火焰之地的巢穴。

pairs.source: For nearly three generations, the esteemed Shang Xi has prepared pandaren heroes for lives of adventure.
pairs.text: 备受尊重的尚喜大师教导过无数渴望冒险的熊猫人英雄，尚喜武院的历史也可以追溯至三代人之前。

pairs.source: A spirited, violent, and short-lived race of monkey people
pairs.text: 一支活泼、暴躁而短命的猴族。
時光之穴永恆之井 - 伊利丹

pairs.source: CoT Well of Eternity - High Elves
pairs.text: 時光之穴永恆之井 - 高等精靈
時光之穴永恆之井 - 伊利丹(潛行)
時光之穴永恆之井 - 惡魔

pairs.source: CoT Well of Eternity - Demon Balls
pairs.text: 時光之穴永恆之井 - 惡魔球

pairs.source: CoT Well of Eternity - Hunter Stalkers
pairs.text: 時光之穴永恆之井 - 獵人潛獵者

pairs.source: A reserved, methodical race of fish people.
pairs.text: 一支内敛而守序的鱼形人种族。

pairs.source: A noble and spirited tribe of Monkey people.
pairs.text: 高贵而活泼，以原始部落方式生存的猴族。

pairs.source: The evil spirits of the land.
A remnant of the once powerful elves living in Dire Maul, yet still wise and knowledgeable about great secrets.
pairs.text: 一群居住在厄运之槌的精灵后裔，他们仍然具有着相当渊博的智慧与学识，并保守着一些伟大的秘密。

pairs.source: The ancient progenitors of this land, the Mogu hate any and all pretenders, including the upstart Pandaren.
pairs.text: 魔古族曾是古代潘达利亚的统治者。如今他们仇视所有篡夺这片土地的下等种族，特别是那些自命不凡的熊猫人。

pairs.source: This mysterious society of Pandaren intend to solve the Mogu problem once and for all.
pairs.text: 这支神秘的熊猫人教派意图一劳永逸地解决魔古族带来的麻烦。

pairs.source: The shadowy protectors of Pandaria's temples, the Shado-Pan are wrought with mystery.
pairs.text: 这个神秘莫测的熊猫人门派守护着潘达利亚的天神寺庙。

pairs.source: The Tillers are peaceful and productive pandaren, working with the land to feed the massive appetites of their people.
pairs.text: 阡陌客是一个由热爱和平与劳作的熊猫人结成的农业组织。他们终日辛勤耕作，只为满足熊猫人一族对美食的终极追求。

pairs.source: Jogu's easy to find - gazing into the bottom of a bottle of the cheapest Stormstout Brewery has to offer.
pairs.text: 贾古很容易找到——只要去看看风暴烈酒酿造厂出品的最廉价的酒桶底部就行了。

pairs.source: Ella aspires to be a great brewer, but she has a long road ahead of her!
pairs.text: 艾拉渴望成为一名伟大的酒仙，但她还有很多路要走！

pairs.source: Old Hillpaw is the canniest chicken raiser around.
pairs.text: 老农山掌是四邻八乡最有经验的养鸡专业户。

pairs.source: If you've ever had a question about sheep, Chee Chee will know the answer.
pairs.text: 如果你有关于绵羊的问题，吱吱一定能帮你解答。

pairs.source: A stout, proud defender of the farmlands, Sho is always there when you need a strong fist.
pairs.text: 作为一个壮实、自豪的农场保卫者，阿烁总会在你需要一个强壮的打手时出现。

pairs.source: The respected leader of the Tillers, Haohan Mudclaw is swamped with responsibilities.
pairs.text: 作为阡陌客的可敬领袖，郝瀚·泥爪责任重大。

pairs.source: Tina Mudclaw is fond of the delicate things in life.
pairs.text: 迪娜·泥爪最喜欢生活中那些精美的物品。

pairs.source: Managing the Halfhill Market makes Gina Mudclaw one stressed lady!
pairs.text: 经营半山市集使吉娜·泥爪变成了一位强势的女性！

pairs.source: Fish Fellreed's found out more about the history of this land than the rest of the town's forgotten.
pairs.text: 相比其他健忘的镇民，玉儿·采苇更了解这片土地的历史。

pairs.source: Farmer Fung grows the biggest vegetables in the Heartland!
pairs.text: 农夫老方家种的蔬菜可是汇风岭一绝！

pairs.source: The Anglers are a group of Pandaren fisherman that hope to feed their people and grow their knowledge of fishing.
pairs.text: 授人以鱼不如授人以渔，这群名为垂钓翁的熊猫人不光想着填饱族人的肚子，还希望能够提高自己的钓鱼本领。

pairs.source: The ravening swarms of the Mantid roam the Towlong Steppes and Dread Wastes, crushing all in their path.
pairs.text: 横扫螳螂高原和恐惧废土的恐怖掠食虫群，所过之处无不是一片狼藉。

pairs.source: These Mantid Elders are untouched by the corruption and insanity that has overtaken the remainder of the Mantid Swarm. They seek to work with the races of Pandaria to restore their Queen to glory.
pairs.text: 令整支螳螂妖虫群发疯的堕落之源并没有影响到这些螳螂妖长者。他们希望与潘达利亚的其他种族合作，从而找到令族群和女皇恢复如初的方法。

pairs.source: These brave Pandaren defend the temples of Pandaria from the evils of the Sha.
pairs.text: 勇敢的熊猫人为了保卫潘达利亚的四方神寺而与邪恶的煞战斗。

pairs.source: Caretakers of the mysteries of Pandaria, these brave souls roam the continent, hoping to learn from their history.
pairs.text: 作为潘达利亚秘密的守护者，这些勇敢的学者周游大陆，希望能以史为鉴，继往开来。

pairs.source: These noble Pandaren safeguard the secrets of hereditary brews, braving great hardship to construct their potent concoctions.
pairs.text: 这些高贵的熊猫人守护着世代相传的酿酒秘诀，为了酿造出烈性美酒而甘冒奇险。

pairs.source: Led by the intrepid Ji Firepaw, the Huojin Pandaren are quick to act and quicker to fight for what they believe in.
pairs.text: 勇敢无畏的季·火掌领导着火金派熊猫人。他们风风火火，敢作敢为，为贯彻自己的信念而战。

pairs.source: Led by the stalwart Aysa Cloudsinger, the Tushui Pandaren believe in contemplation and reasoned action.
pairs.text: 沉静稳重的艾莎·云歌领导着土水派熊猫人。他们深思熟虑，三思而行，一切行动都遵循理性。

pairs.source: 5.0 Cooking - This is a hidden faction used to level up Nomi.
pairs.text: 5.0烹飪 - 這是用來為糯米升級的隱藏聲望。

pairs.source: The consummate fisherman and lover of fine alcohol from across the land, Nat's irascible exterior belies a love of teaching.
pairs.text: 纳特是全世界最负盛名的钓鱼大师与美酒爱好者，在他暴躁易怒的外表下藏着一颗好为人师的心。

pairs.source: Black Prince Wrathion is the last of the black dragons. He has been known to richly reward those who earn his trust and support his endeavors.
pairs.text: 黑王子拉希奥是黑龙族群的最后一员。传说他对忠诚效命者的报酬十分丰厚。

pairs.source: The first season of the Horde Brawler's Guild occurred during the Pandaria campaign.
pairs.text: 在潘达利亚战役期间，部落搏击俱乐部的第一赛季拉开了帷幕。

pairs.source: Horde forces in Pandaria, stationed at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚的部落部队，驻扎在卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨。

pairs.source: Alliance forces in Pandaria, stationed at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚的联盟部队，驻扎在卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港。

pairs.source: Ignited by Jaina's fury, the Kirin Tor Offensive seek to seize Thunder Isle for the glory of the Alliance!
pairs.text: 被吉安娜的怒火点燃，肯瑞托远征军誓要夺取雷神岛，捍卫联盟的荣耀！

pairs.source: Outcast from Dalaran, the Sunreaver Onslaught fight to obtain powerful mogu artifacts from among the ruins of Thunder Isle, and to secure their future if the Horde falls to anarchy.
pairs.text: 被赶离达拉然后，夺日者先锋军致力于在雷神岛的废墟间寻找强大的魔古族神器，万一部落分崩离析，好将未来掌握在自己手中。

pairs.source: Akama is distrustful of Warlocks after witnessing Illidan's fall to his own corruption, followed by the invasion of the Black Temple by Warlocks after the Cataclysm.
pairs.text: 在见证了伊利丹的堕落后，阿卡玛对术士充满了猜忌。而大灾变之后，术士们又对黑暗神殿展开了入侵。

pairs.source: The first season of the LFG Brawler's Guild occurred during the Pandaria campaign.
pairs.text: 在潘达利亚战役期间，联盟搏击俱乐部的第一赛季拉开了帷幕。
比兹莫搏击俱乐部（第1赛季）

pairs.source: Monster, Enforced Neutral For Force Reaction
pairs.text: 怪物，強迫反應為強制中立

pairs.source: These valorous Shado-Pan venture into the Throne of Thunder to vanquish the evil found within, and exact justice for the centuries of slavery they endured under the Thunder King's reign.
pairs.text: 这些勇敢的影踪派成员们深入雷电王座，全力以赴遏制暗藏其中的邪恶势力，也为自己千百年来饱受雷电之王奴役的遭遇伸张正义。

pairs.source: Vol'jin has declared open rebellion against Garrosh Hellscream. With the aid of both Horde and Alliance forces, he gathers resources in preparation for an attack on Orgrimmar itself.
pairs.text: 沃金已经公开宣布反抗加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。在部落和联盟军队的帮助下，他正在收集资源，准备对奥格瑞玛发动总攻。

pairs.source: The Frostwolf orcs of Frostfire Ridge are a tight-knit family of brutal warriors, well equipped to deal with the savage realities of Draenor.
pairs.text: 霜火岭的霜狼兽人是一群紧密团结在一起的凶猛战士。他们能很好地适应德拉诺残酷的环境。

pairs.source: The Timewalkers guard the timeways from those who would take advantage of the bronze dragonflight's mortality; most are adventurers or scholars that have previously worked with the Keepers of Time.
pairs.text: 时光旅行者保卫着时间流，不让那些因青铜龙军团的覆灭而蠢蠢欲动的人有机可乘；他们主要由冒险者和学者组成，大多是原时光守护者的成员。

pairs.source: Shaohao, the long lost Emperor of the Pandaren people, is a personage worthy of deep respect.
pairs.text: 少昊是逝去已久的熊猫人皇帝，是一位值得敬重的人物。

pairs.source: Frostfire ogres are not interesting, but they do like to argue.
pairs.text: 霜火食人魔没什么爱好，就是喜欢吵架。

pairs.source: You've been corrupted by the power of Ordos, and have turned against your friends and foes in mindless rage.
pairs.text: 你被斡耳朵的力量腐蚀了。被怒火冲昏头脑的你将对盟友和敌人进行无差别攻击。

pairs.source: Worshippers of the dread god Rukhmar, these vile filth seek to stain the world with the blood of their foes.
pairs.text: 作为恐怖之神鲁克玛的崇拜者，这些邪恶的暴徒试图用敌人的鲜血染红这个世界。

pairs.source: Working from the shadows, the Arakkoa Outcasts seek to bring a brighter tomorrow.
pairs.text: 在黑暗中挣扎的鸦人流亡者在苦苦追寻着光明的未来。

pairs.source: A tenuous alliance of many of the orc clans of Draenor under the leadership of Grommash Hellscream.
pairs.text: 由德拉诺的众多兽人氏族勉强联合而成的脆弱联盟，由格罗玛什·地狱咆哮领导。

pairs.source: Twisted in the service of the Shadow Council, these draenei have sacrificed much in pursuit of power.
pairs.text: 一群扭曲并效忠暗影议会的德莱尼，为了追求力量牺牲了许多东西。

pairs.source: Highmaul ogres like togas and gladiator fights.
pairs.text: 悬槌食人魔喜欢穿宽外袍，观看角斗士比赛。

pairs.source: Horde forces in Ashran, stationed at Warspear.
pairs.text: 部落在阿什兰的部队，驻扎在战争之矛。

pairs.source: Alliance forces in Ashran, stationed at Stormshield.
pairs.text: 联盟在阿什兰的部队，驻扎在暴风之盾。

pairs.source: The second season of the Horde Brawler's Guild occurred during the Draenor campaign.
pairs.text: 德拉诺战役期间的部落搏击俱乐部第二赛季活动。

pairs.source: The second season of the Alliance Brawler's Guild occurred during the Draenor campaign.
pairs.text: 德拉诺战役期间的联盟搏击俱乐部第二赛季活动。
比兹莫搏击俱乐部（第2赛季）

pairs.source: The Laughing Skull clan calls the most savage reaches of Draenor home, laughing maniacally at the impending annihilation they face from every side.
pairs.text: 嘲颅氏族的家园位于德拉诺最蛮荒的边界。他们会对来自各方的毁灭威胁报以疯狂的癫笑。

pairs.source: The defenders of Shattrath struggle to regain control of their capital city, having been betrayed from within.
pairs.text: 努力想要夺回主城的沙塔斯城防御者，但却遭到来自内部的背叛。

pairs.source: The goblins of the Steamwheedle Preservation Society seek to liberate relics from the ogres of Nagrand with the noble intention of selling them to the highest bidder.
pairs.text: 热砂保护协会的地精们致力于将珍贵的遗物从纳格兰的食人魔手中解放出来。毋庸置疑，他们必然是怀着崇高的目标——把遗物卖出最高的价钱——来做这件事的。

pairs.source: Under the leadership of five powerful exarchs, the draenei of Draenor have prospered in a savage world.
pairs.text: 在五位强大的大主教率领下，德拉诺的德莱尼在这个蛮荒的世界中欣欣向荣。

pairs.source: Draenor is a long of infinite opportunity, and very little competition.
pairs.text: 德拉诺有着无限的商机和极其有限的竞争。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Delvar by inviting him to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请德尔瓦一起战斗，与他建立起友谊。
驻扎在你兵营中的保镖。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Tormmok by inviting him to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请托莫克一起战斗，与他建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Ishaal by inviting him to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请伊沙尔一起战斗，与他建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Illona by inviting her to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请艾萝娜一起战斗，与她建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Vivianne by inviting her to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请薇薇安一起战斗，与她建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Aeda by inviting him to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请艾达一起战斗，与她建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Your personal bodyguard, stationed at your barracks. You can build friendship with Leorajh by inviting him to fight alongside you.
pairs.text: 你的私人保镖，驻扎在你的兵营里。你可以通过邀请利奥拉一起战斗，与他建立起友谊。

pairs.source: Highmaul ogres like togas and gladiator fights.
pairs.text: 悬槌食人魔喜欢穿宽外袍，观看角斗士比赛。

pairs.source: Demons from places unknown and unrivaled in power.
pairs.text: 来自未知之地的恶魔，有着无与伦比的力量。

pairs.source: The Highmountain Tribe has dwindled in numbers over the years, and with the drogbar threat looming, seek new allies to save their homeland.
pairs.text: 高岭部族的人口已经逐年减少，随着卓格巴尔的威胁加剧，他们需要寻找新的盟友来拯救他们的家园。

pairs.source: If you have to ask, you're already dead.
pairs.text: 如果你非要问的话，那你已经是个死人了。

pairs.source: Yrel has assembled the remaining Exarchs and is calling for a crusade in Velen's name. Together they are working to establish a foothold in Tanaan Jungle and to overthrow Gul'dan.
pairs.text: 伊瑞尔集结了幸存下来的大主教们，并以维伦的名义发动了攻势。当前他们正试图在塔纳安丛林建立据点，誓要将古尔丹的阴谋彻底粉碎。

pairs.source: Seeking to protect Azeroth with a decisive victory on Draenor, Warchief Vol'jin is assembling an elite team of champions to establish a foothold in Tanaan Jungle and to overthrow Gul'dan.
pairs.text: 要想守护艾泽拉斯，就必须在德拉诺取得决定性胜利。为此，部落酋长沃金召集了麾下最最精锐的勇士在塔纳安丛林建立据点，只为打倒古尔丹等邪恶势力。

pairs.source: Survivors of a grisly civil war, these beleaguered arakkoans hope the reclamation of apexis artifacts will hold the key to peacefully rebuilding their civilization.
pairs.text: 作为一场残酷内战的幸存者，这些四面受敌的鸦人希望找回埃匹希斯神器是帮助他们和平重建鸦人文明的关键。

pairs.source: The treacherous wilds of Tanaan Jungle have attracted the craftiest hunters from both Azeroth and Draenor. To defeat the beasts of Tanaan, one must become a beast.
pairs.text: 危机四伏的塔纳安丛林吸引来艾泽拉斯和德拉诺出类拔萃的猎手。想要击败塔纳安的野兽，你就得比他们更野。

pairs.source: These exiled Nightborne elves suffer withdrawals after being cut off from the Nightwell. They oppose their people's alliance with the Legion and fight for some kind of redemption.
pairs.text: 这些被放逐的夜之子精灵由于被切断了和暗夜井的联系，饱受戒断魔瘾的痛苦。他们反对同胞与燃烧军团结盟，并为某种救赎而战。

pairs.source: The druids and their allies in Val'sharah have guarded the Emerald Dream since time immemorial.
pairs.text: 德鲁伊和他们在瓦尔莎拉的盟友从不可考的年代起，就一直守护着翡翠梦境。

pairs.source: After Legion forces broke the Vault of the Wardens with the aid of Gul'dan, what few Wardens remain are determined to rebuild their prison and hunt down the terrifying beasts that were let loose when it fell.
pairs.text: 自从燃烧军团在古尔丹的帮助下攻破守望者地窟后，剩下的少数守望者就决心重建她们的监狱并追捕那些趁乱逃跑的恐怖野兽。

pairs.source: The Night Time is the Right Time [PH]
The ghostly Court of Farondis and its allies continue the fight against an onslaught of invaders on the cursed island of Azsuna.
pairs.text: 由幽灵组成的法罗迪斯宫廷及它的盟友们正在阿苏纳被诅咒的岛屿上持续抗击入侵者。

pairs.source: Elves that have sworn themselves to fighting against the Burning Legion, no matter the cost.
pairs.text: 发誓要不惜一切代价对抗燃烧军团的精灵。

pairs.source: These are the chosen warriors of Odyn, sworn to his service in life and death.
pairs.text: 他们是被奥丁选中的战士，发誓在生前及死后都效忠于他。

pairs.source: Once a student of the Kirin Tor, Margoss has turned to fishing to ease his stressful life.
pairs.text: 马戈斯曾是一名肯瑞托学徒，他通过钓鱼来舒缓生活的压力。

pairs.source: High in their floating home city of Dalaran, Olisarra and Angelique treat the injured, the sick and the quite nearly, fatally wounded. They also sell wares to travelers who are in need of medical supplies.
pairs.text: 欧莉萨拉和安吉莉克住在浮空城达拉然。她们在这里救死扶伤，治病救人。她们还向需要医疗补给的旅行者出售物品。

pairs.source: The warchief has gathered creatures from all over Azeroth and Outland to participate in bloody arena deathmatches with heroes of the Horde.
pairs.text: 酋长从艾泽拉斯和外域各地收罗来了各种生物，将它们放置在血腥的竞技场中与部落的英雄们进行生死搏斗。

pairs.source: A group of battle-hungry fighters has gathered creatures from all over Azeroth and Outland to participate in bloody arena deathmatches with heroes of the Alliance.
pairs.text: 一群格斗狂人从艾泽拉斯和外域各地收罗来了各种生物，将它们放置在血腥的竞技场中与联盟的英雄们进行生死搏斗。

pairs.source: Allies of the demigod Aviana and protectors of the winged creatures of the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 半神艾维娜的盟友，破碎群岛所有有翼生物的守护者。

pairs.source: Allies of the demigod Aviana and protectors of the winged creatures of the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 半神艾维娜的盟友，破碎群岛所有有翼生物的守护者。

pairs.source: The coalition of orders dedicated to defeating the Legion at the Tomb of Sargeras and Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 各大势力的联军，致力于击败萨格拉斯之墓和破碎海滩的燃烧军团。

pairs.source: One of the last bastions of human power, this Alliance capital is ruled by the prodigal king, Varian Wrynn.
pairs.text: 这座人类势力的最后堡垒目前由流浪归来的国王瓦里安·乌瑞恩统治着。

pairs.source: The Highmountain Tribe has dwindled in numbers over the years, and with the drogbar threat looming, seek new allies to save their homeland.
pairs.text: 高岭部族的人口已经逐年减少，随着卓格巴尔的威胁加剧，他们需要寻找新的盟友来拯救他们的家园。

pairs.source: These are the chosen warriors of Odyn, sworn to his service in life and death.
pairs.text: 他们是被奥丁选中的战士，发誓在生前及死后都效忠于他。

pairs.source: The ghostly Court of Farondis and its allies continue the fight against an onslaught of invaders on the cursed island of Azsuna.
pairs.text: 由幽灵组成的法罗迪斯宫廷及它的盟友们正在阿苏纳被诅咒的岛屿上持续抗击入侵者。

pairs.source: The druids and their allies in Val'sharah have guarded the Emerald Dream since time immemorial.
pairs.text: 德鲁伊和他们在瓦尔莎拉的盟友从不可考的年代起，就一直守护着翡翠梦境。

pairs.source: These exiled Nightborne elves suffer withdrawals after being cut off from the Nightwell. They oppose their people's alliance with the Legion and fight for some kind of redemption.
pairs.text: 这些被放逐的夜之子精灵由于被切断了和暗夜井的联系，饱受戒断魔瘾的痛苦。他们反对同胞与燃烧军团结盟，并为某种救赎而战。

pairs.source: After Legion forces broke the Vault of the Wardens with the aid of Gul'dan, what few Wardens remain are determined to rebuild their prison and hunt down the terrifying beasts that were let loose when it fell.
pairs.text: 自从燃烧军团在古尔丹的帮助下攻破守望者地窟后，剩下的少数守望者就决心重建她们的监狱并追捕那些趁乱逃跑的恐怖野兽。

pairs.source: The coalition of orders dedicated to defeating the Legion at the Tomb of Sargeras and Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 各大势力的联军，致力于击败萨格拉斯之墓和破碎海滩的燃烧军团。

pairs.source: The ancient keeper of the Royal Pond in Azsuna.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的皇家池塘古老的守护者。

pairs.source: The watcher of fish in Val'sharah.
A master of the river and the fish within.
A raven with bright, intelligent eyes and a love of fish.
pairs.text: 有着一双明亮睿智眼睛的渡鸦，喜欢鱼。

pairs.source: A mysterious withered who makes her home by the waterfalls.
pairs.text: 住在瀑布旁的神秘枯法者。

pairs.source: Summoned from far away, Impus collects shells in hopes of creating a "magic gateway" to return home.
pairs.text: 被人从远方召唤的英帕斯正在收集贝壳，希望能制造出一座“魔法传送门”返回家乡。

pairs.source: Chronormu (Chromie for short) has always been one of the more active, approachable bronze dragons. Strengthening your bond with her will increase her power in the Deaths of Chromie scenario.
pairs.text: 克罗诺姆（简称克罗米）是一头活跃、亲切的青铜龙。拉近你与她之间关系将增强她在场景战役“克罗米之死”中的力量。

pairs.source: After the fall of Argus, the draenei's finest warriors followed the prime naaru Xe'ra across the cosmos in an eternal war to bring about the Legion's end. Since then, other survivors of the Burning Crusade have joined the ranks of the Lightforged.
pairs.text: 阿古斯陷落后，德莱尼精英战士追随始祖纳鲁泽拉跨越宇宙，打响了旨在消灭燃烧军团的永恒之战。从那时起，燃烧的远征的其他幸存者也加入了光铸者的行列。

pairs.source: Although many struggled to oppose the Burning Legion's conquest of Argus, not all were able to escape. Emboldened by the arrival of new allies, these refugees and outcasts stand united in their mission to reclaim their home.
pairs.text: 虽然有许多人都在燃烧军团征服阿古斯时奋起抗争，但并不是所有人都成功逃离了。而今在新的友军的鼓舞下，这些难民和流亡者已经联合起来，为夺回家园而战。

pairs.source: 7.0 Champions Test - Chen Stormstout - Uses Test Faction (949)
Increases success chance when fighting orcs.
Cast by a mage to deal damage to many enemies.
pairs.text: 由法师施放，可同时伤害许多敌人。

pairs.source: Used by a warrior to greatly reduce damage.
pairs.text: 由战士施放，可显著降低所受伤害。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting in the mountains.
pairs.text: 提高在山地中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting in the snow.
pairs.text: 提高在雪地中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting in the desert.
pairs.text: 提高在沙漠中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Cast by a priest to help the target escape harm's way (or just to mess with them).
pairs.text: 由牧师施放，帮助目标躲避伤害（或给他们捣蛋）。

pairs.source: Cast by a priest to heal a group of allies.
pairs.text: 由牧师施放，可治疗一群盟友。

pairs.source: Increases the experience this follower gains from a mission by 50%.
pairs.text: 此追随者完成任务时获得的经验提高50%。

pairs.source: Increases the XP gained for all followers on a mission.
pairs.text: 提高所有追随者完成任务后获得的经验值。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting demons.
Increases success chance when fighting beasts.
Increases success chance when fighting ogres.
pairs.text: 提高战胜食人魔的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting primals and their minions.
pairs.text: 提高战胜原兽及其爪牙的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting breakers and their minions.
pairs.text: 提高战胜毁灭者及其爪牙的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting elemental furies.
pairs.text: 提高战胜元素之怒的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting aberrations and undead.
pairs.text: 提高战胜畸变怪和亡灵的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting arakkoa and their minions.
pairs.text: 提高战胜鸦人及其爪牙的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting in a forest.
pairs.text: 提高在森林中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting underground.
pairs.text: 提高在地下赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting in the jungle.
pairs.text: 提高在丛林中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Grants a very large bonus to mission success chance.
Increases success chance when fighting in a swamp.
pairs.text: 提高在沼泽中赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when fighting on plains.
pairs.text: 提高在平原上赢得战斗的几率。

pairs.source: Boosts work order production when assigned to the Mine.
pairs.text: 被指派到矿井时可提高产品订单的产量。

pairs.source: Grants herbalism benefits and boosts work orders when assigned to the Herb Garden.
pairs.text: 被指派到药圃时可提供草药学加成，还能提高产品订单的产量。

pairs.source: Offers various Alchemy benefits when assigned to the Alchemy Lab, and increases success chance on Alchemy missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到炼金实验室时可提供炼金加成，并提高炼金任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Can reduce your durability damage and increase work order output when assigned to the Forge, and increases success chance on Blacksmithing missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到熔炉时可降低你的物品耐久损失，提高产品订单的产量，以及锻造任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Offers a variety of enchanting benefits when assigned to the Enchanter's Study, and increases success chance on Enchanting missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到附魔研究室时可提供各种附魔加成，并提高附魔任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Sells engineering gadgets and boosts work orders when assigned to the Engineering Works, and increases success chance on Engineering missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到工坊时可出售工程学装置，并提高产品订单的产量，以及工程学任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Allows the creation of special documents and boosts work orders when assigned to the Scribe's Quarters, and increases success chance on Inscription missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到铭文师之家时可以制造特殊的文件，并提高产品订单的产量，以及铭文任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Offers a variety of Jewelcrafting benefits when assigned to the Gem Boutique, and increases success chance on Jewelcrafting missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到珠宝店时可提供各种珠宝加工加成，并提高珠宝加工任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Can craft tents and boost work orders when assigned to the Tannery, and increases success chance on Leatherworking missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到制革厂时可制造各种帐篷，并提高产品订单的产量，以及制皮任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Offers a variety of tailoring benefits when assigned to the Tailoring Emporium, and increases success chance on Tailoring missions.
pairs.text: 被指派到裁缝店时可提供各种裁缝加成，并提高裁缝任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Boosts work order production based on follower level while assigned to the Barn.
pairs.text: 被指派到畜棚时能根据追随者的等级提高产品订单的产量。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when on a mission with a gnome.
pairs.text: 提高与侏儒一起执行任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when on a mission with a human.
pairs.text: 提高与人类一起执行任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Increases success chance when on a mission with a dwarf.

pairs.text: 在成功的任务中使用，可搜索周围水域，带回一箱有用的残骸。

pairs.source: A fishing net that is attached to the back of a ship, courtesy of the tuskarr.  Supplies fish when returning from a successful mission.
pairs.text: 附加在船后的渔网，由海象人友情赞助。可在任务成功后额外提供一批渔获。

pairs.source: A long spyglass that seems to display nothing when you look through it.  Maybe it will come in handy.
pairs.text: 一支长长的望远镜，但你透过它却什么都看不到，或许会派上用场。

pairs.source: Lunges toward an enemy. Sometimes used on critters to travel quickly.
pairs.text: 迅速扑向敌人。有时候会对小动物使用以进行快速移动。

pairs.source: Used by demon hunters to control multiple dangerous enemies at once.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手的技能，用于同时控制多个危险的敌人。

pairs.source: Demon hunters can cover their skin in fel stone to absorb large blows. Also notoriously uncomfortable.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手能用邪能之石覆盖他们的皮肤，吸收大量的伤害。当然副作用是会头晕恶心浑身不舒服。

pairs.source: Some demon hunters take the mantra "fight fire with fire" a bit too seriously.
pairs.text: 有些恶魔猎手似乎把“以火攻火”这话当成字面意思理解了。

pairs.source: Magic is a delicacy among the Illidari. Tastes like chicken.
pairs.text: 魔法是伊利达雷公认的美食，鸡肉味，嘎嘣脆。

pairs.source: Used by demon hunters to who are... not prepared.
pairs.text: 如果不想老是“啊，如此弓……”的话，恶魔猎手们还是多用用这个技能比较好。

pairs.source: Demon hunters can unleash the demon within to defeat the strongest foes.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手可以释放自己的心魔，以击败最强大的对手。

pairs.source: Increases the oil gained from a mission by 100%.
pairs.text: 使完成任务后获得的原油提高100%。

pairs.source: Murlocs can exit their ship and swim ashore even when underwater, always functioning as a Transport.  Being amphibious has its perks.
pairs.text: 即使在水下，鱼人也可以离开舰船泅水上岸，充当运输舰。两栖生物也有它的好处。

pairs.source: The kraken unleashed in this area grants Apexis Crystals upon completion of any successful mission.
pairs.text: 出现在这一海域的海怪可以让你在成功完成任务后获得埃匹希斯水晶。

pairs.source: An airship spots and attacks hostile ships in the area, increasing the success chance of missions.
pairs.text: 一艘能够发现并攻击附近敌对舰船的飞艇，可提高任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Increases the experience gained from a mission for all ships by 50%.
pairs.text: 使所有舰船完成任务所获得的经验值提高50%。

pairs.source: Grants additional Apexis Crystals upon completion of any successful mission.
pairs.text: 任务成功完成后可获得额外的埃匹希斯水晶。

pairs.source: Increases the experience gained from a mission for all ships by 50%.
pairs.text: 使所有舰船完成任务所获得的经验值提高50%。

pairs.source: Increases the success chance of missions.
Allows transports to run missions that require boots on the ground.
pairs.text: 允许运输舰参与需要地面行动的任务。

pairs.source: Greatly increases success chance when fighting many creature types.
pairs.text: 大幅提高战胜多种生物的几率。

pairs.source: Grants a bonus to mission success chance, and provides a greater success chance when fighting demons.
pairs.text: 提高任务成功率，并大幅提高战胜恶魔的几率。

pairs.source: Increases the Apexis Crystals gained from a mission by 100%.
pairs.text: 使完成任务后获得埃匹希斯水晶提高100%。

pairs.source: Capable of launching attacks from the air.
A spellcaster who harnesses the destructive forces of nature and the elements to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 能够驾驭元素的施法者，使用自然的毁灭之力打击敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A totemic warrior who strikes foes with weapons imbued with elemental power to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 信仰图腾之力的战士，使用灌注元素能量的武器攻击敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A healer who calls upon ancestral spirits and the cleansing power of water to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 能召唤先祖之魂的治疗者，使用水之净化能量来治愈盟友的创伤，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A martial artist without peer who counters some |C00b3ffffBosses|R with hands and fists.
pairs.text: 武艺无双的武者，尤其擅长拳脚功夫，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A sturdy brawler who counters some |C00b3ffffBosses|R, using liquid fortification and unpredictable movement.
pairs.text: 坚韧的勇士，拥有行云流水、变化莫测的身法，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A healer who masters the mysterious arts of manipulating life energies to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 精通操纵生命能量之术的治疗者，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master of shadow magic who specializes in drains and damage-over-time spells to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 暗影魔法大师，专精吸取能量和持续伤害法术，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master of demons who compels demonic powers to aid them in countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 恶魔大师，能奴役强大的恶魔为其效命，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master of chaos who calls down fire to burn and counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用混乱魔法的大师，能够降下灾厄的烈焰，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Invokes the power of the Light to protect and to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 唤起圣光的能量来保护盟友，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A righteous crusader who judges and counters some |C00b3ffffBosses|R with weapons and Holy magic.
pairs.text: 正义的十字军，使用手中的武器和神圣魔法对敌人进行审判和制裁，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Uses Holy magic to shield themselves and defend allies to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用神圣的魔法为自己和盟友提供防护，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A furious berserker wielding a weapon in each hand, unleash a flurry of attacks to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 双手各持一柄武器的暴怒狂战士，掀起的暴力飓风能够轻易将敌人切碎，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A battle-hardened master of two-handed weapons, using mobility and overpowering attacks to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 久经沙场的战斗大师，擅使双手武器，利用灵活的移动和压制性的攻击来摧垮敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A stalwart protector who uses a shield to counter |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 一位坚韧的守护者，可以使用盾牌来应对|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Manipulate the arcane to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R with overwhelming power.
pairs.text: 操纵奥术之力，以压倒性的能量毁灭敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Ignite the air around you with balls of fire and combustive flames to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用灼热的火球和熊熊烈焰烧尽敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R by freezing them in their tracks and shattering them with Frost magic.
pairs.text: 使用冰霜魔法冻结敌人的脚步，再彻底粉碎他们的身体，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A ruthless fugitive who uses ability and guile to stand toe-to-toe, countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 无情的亡命徒，擅长与敌人短兵相接，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A dark stalker who leaps from the shadows to ambush and counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 阴影中的追猎者，擅长在最恰当的时机对毫无戒备的猎物发起致命的伏击，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A deadly master of poisons who counters some |C00b3ffffBosses|R with vicious dagger strikes.
pairs.text: 致命的使毒高手，能够使用匕首迅速而冷酷地发动袭击，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A versatile healer who can counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 多才多艺的治疗者，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Uses sinister Shadow magic, to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用邪恶的暗影魔法，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Uses magic to shield allies from taking damage to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用魔法护盾保护盟友不受伤害，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Can take on the form of a powerful Moonkin, balancing the power of Arcane and Nature magic to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 可以变形为强大的枭兽，释放奥术和自然的平衡之力，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Takes on the form of a great cat to deal damage with bleeds and bites, to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 变形为致命的猎豹形态，利用撕咬和流血造成大量伤害，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Uses powerful Nature spells to keep allies alive and counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 使用强大的自然法术治愈盟友，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A brooding master of warglaives who uses the destructive power of Fel Magic to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 恐怖的战刃大师，使用邪能魔法的破灭之力，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Embraces the demon within to incinerate enemies and protect allies, countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 接受内心的恶魔，用它烧尽敌人，保护盟友，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: Allies of the Demon Hunters made up of Naga, Broken and even demons, the Outcast employ a variety of techniques to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 恶魔猎手的盟友，由纳迦、破碎者甚至恶魔构成，他们会使用多种技能，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: An icy harbinger of doom, channeling runic power and delivering vicious weapon strikes to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 冰冻末日的使者，能够引导符文能量并使用武器狠毒地打击敌人，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A dark guardian who manipulates and corrupts life energy to sustain themselves in the face of an enemy onslaught, countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 黑暗的守护者，控制和腐蚀生命能量的能力使其能够直面敌人的猛攻，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master of death and decay, spreading infection and controlling undead minions to counter some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 死亡与腐化的大师，通过传播感染和控制亡灵爪牙作战，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master of the wild who can tame a wide variety of beasts to assist them in countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R.
pairs.text: 对荒野了如指掌，能够驯服多种多样的野兽协助作战，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A master archer or sharpshooter who excels in countering some |C00b3ffffBosses|R from afar.
pairs.text: 百步穿杨的神射手，擅长远距离夺走敌人的性命，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: A rugged tracker who counters some |C00b3ffffBosses|R using animal venom, explosives and traps as deadly weapons.
pairs.text: 精练的追踪者，能将动物剧毒，爆炸物和陷阱当作致命的武器来使用，可以应对某些|C00b3ffff首领|R。

pairs.source: When sent on missions, theres a chance you will bring back a random item.
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回一样随机物品。

pairs.source: Negates the stench created by Fel corrupted air.
pairs.text: 去除被邪能腐化的空气中的臭味。

pairs.source: Increases the success chance of missions in this area.
pairs.text: 提高这个区域的任务成功几率。

pairs.source: Roll a short distance to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 进行短距离翻滚，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Breathe fire in front of you to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 向面前喷吐火焰，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Jab the enemy in the throat, to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 猛击敌人的咽喉，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Chance from successful missions to return with a Golden Banana. Golden Bananas are given to Champions to improve success chance.
pairs.text: 成功完成任务有几率带回金色香蕉。可以将金色香蕉给予勇士，增加成功几率。

pairs.source: Troops on this mission will be killed.
pairs.text: 执行该任务的部队将会阵亡。

pairs.source: Ignite the area around the Warlock, to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 点燃术士周围的区域，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Counters the enemy's spellcast, to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 反制敌人的施法，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and counters a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 将你传送到你的恶魔法阵，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 用强风冲击干扰目标的注意力，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing movement speed to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 将萨满祭司变成一头幽魂之狼，提高移动速度，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing Nature damage to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 向敌人射出一支闪电箭，造成自然伤害，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Smash the target's mind with cold to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 以寒冰之气攻击目标心灵，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Corrupts the ground, causing Shadow damage to counter |C00b3ffffMinions|R.
pairs.text: 腐蚀地面，造成暗影伤害，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: The Death Knight freezes their blood to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 死亡骑士冻结自己的血液，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Increases movement speed for a short duration to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 短时间内提高你的移动速度，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Set a fire trap at the target location that explodes to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 在地面上放置一个火焰陷阱，当敌人接近时会爆炸，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: In a whirlwind of steel you counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 像旋风一般挥舞手中的武器，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Leap through the air to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
Pummel the target, to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
Consecrate the land beneath you to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 奉献脚下的土地，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Rebuke the enemy to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
Protects you from all damage to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 使你对所有的伤害免疫，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Silences the target to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 制造一次以施法者为中心的神圣能量爆炸，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: You pull the spirit of the friendly target, instantly moving them directly in front of you to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 你抓住友方目标的灵魂，使其立即移动到你面前，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: A quick kick that counters a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 快速用脚踢目标，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Sprays knives all around you to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 向附近所有目标投掷刀刃，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Increases your movement speed to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 提高你的移动速度，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Hurl a demonic glaive at your enemies, to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 向你的敌人投掷一把恶魔利刃，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Interrupts the enemy to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 打断敌人施法，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Teleport forward a short distance to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 向前方传送一小段距离，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Interrupt the enemy's spellcast to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 打断敌人施放的法术，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Ice shards pelt the target area to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 破碎的冰块从天而降击中目标区域，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: You skull bash the target to counter a |C00b3ffffSpell|R.
pairs.text: 你对目标迎头痛击，应对|C00b3ffff法术|R。

pairs.source: Calls down a rain of starlight to counter a |C00b3ffffMinion|R.
pairs.text: 召唤星光之雨，应对|C00b3ffff爪牙|R。

pairs.source: Activate Cat form and quickly dash to counter a |C00b3ffffHazard|R.
pairs.text: 激活猎豹形态并快速冲刺，应对|C00b3ffff危害|R。

pairs.source: Champions on this mission will lose experience.
pairs.text: 执行这个任务的勇士会失去经验值。

pairs.source: Champions on this mission will lose item level.
pairs.text: 执行这个任务的勇士会降低物品等级。

pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a Healhtstone, usable to heal troops for 1 Vitality.
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回治疗石，用于为部队回复1点活力。

pairs.source: Chance on mission success to return with an item to summon either a Pack of Imps or a Swarm of Wild Imps.
pairs.text: 成功完成任务有几率带回一件物品，可以召唤结群小鬼或野生小鬼。

pairs.text: 成功完成任务有几率带回一件物品，可以召唤一队瓦拉加尔候选者或瓦拉加尔雷铸者。

pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a Healing Stream Totem, usable to heal troops for 1 Vitality.
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回治疗之泉图腾，用于为部队回复1点活力。

pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a Wild Mushroom, usable to heal troops for 1 vitality.
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回野性蘑菇，用于为部队回复1点活力。
