pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a Soul Fragment, usable to heal troops for 1 Vitality.
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回灵魂残片，用于为部队回复1点活力。

pairs.text: 成功完成任务有几率带回一件随机物品。

pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a Strange Ball of Energy, usable to increase a Champion's success chance for 1 mission.
pairs.text: 有一定几率在完成任务后获得一个奇怪的能量球，使用后可提高一名勇士执行下一个任务的成功率。

pairs.source: Chance to return from a mission with a random reward from inside the magic hat!
pairs.text: 执行任务时有几率带回一顶魔法帽，从中获得随机奖励！

pairs.source: A grizzled veteran with intimate knowledge of Argus, able to counter |C00b3ffffArgus Elites|R.
pairs.text: 头发花白的老兵，对阿古斯了如指掌，可应对|C00b3ffff阿古斯精英|R。

pairs.source: This structure stores and maintains the garrison's armaments.
pairs.text: 这座建筑可以存放并养护要塞的武器装备。

pairs.source: Doubles the chance for your quest rewards to get a rare or epic Bonus Upgrade, and increases the potency of the upgrade. Allows the collection of armor scraps from the orc clans of Draenor for armor transmogrification use.
pairs.text: 使你的任务奖励额外升级为稀有或史诗品质的几率翻倍，并提高奖励升级的几率。并使你可以从德拉诺的兽人氏族处收集护甲碎片，用于幻化护甲。

pairs.source: This structure stores and maintains the garrison's armaments.
pairs.text: 这座建筑可以存放并养护要塞的武器装备。

pairs.source: Opens up work orders for follower weapons and armor in exchange for garrison resources.  Also, new armor transmogrification items unlock.
pairs.text: 下达订单，用要塞物资换取追随者的武器和护甲。同时解锁新的护甲幻化物品。

pairs.source: This structure stores and maintains the garrison's armaments.
pairs.text: 这座建筑可以存放并养护要塞的武器装备。

pairs.source: Grants 1 of your 3 seals of inevitable fate (raid bonus loot roll) at no cost each week.
pairs.text: 每周免费获得三种既定命运印记中的一种（团队额外拾取机会）。

pairs.source: The Barn houses captured creatures that provide the garrison with leather, meat, and fur.
pairs.text: 畜棚可以捕捉动物，为要塞提供皮革、鲜肉和毛皮。

pairs.source: Allows you to capture clefthoof, elekk, wolves, and talbuk for leather and fur.  Used for leatherworking and tailoring recipes.
pairs.text: 允许你捕捉裂蹄牛、雷象、狼和塔布羊，获取制皮和裁缝配方所需的皮革和毛皮。

pairs.source: The Barn houses captured creatures that provide the garrison with leather, meat, and fur.
pairs.text: 畜棚可以捕捉动物，为要塞提供皮革、鲜肉和毛皮。

pairs.source: Allows you to capture boars and riverbeasts for rare meats used to create the most powerful food.
pairs.text: 允许你捕捉野猪和淡水兽，获取制作强力食品的稀有肉类。

pairs.source: The Barracks houses your garrison's military forces and followers.
pairs.text: 兵营可以容纳你的要塞部队和追随者。

pairs.source: Unlocks patrol missions.  Patrol missions have higher than normal follower experience rewards.
pairs.text: 解锁巡逻任务。巡逻任务的经验奖励比普通追随者任务的奖励更高。

pairs.source: The Barracks houses your garrison's military forces and followers.
pairs.text: 兵营可以容纳你的要塞部队和追随者。

pairs.source: Allows a follower with the bodyguard trait to accompany you as a guardian in Draenor zones.
pairs.text: 允许拥有看家护院专长的追随者在德拉诺充当你的护卫。

pairs.source: The Barracks houses your garrison's military forces and followers.
pairs.text: 兵营可以容纳你的要塞部队和追随者。

pairs.source: Increases your follower limit by 5 and grants access to racial guards and banners.
pairs.text: 使你的追随者人数上限提升5，并可使用其他种族的卫士和战旗。

pairs.source: A bountiful garden for the planting and harvesting of Draenor herbs.
pairs.text: 一块肥沃的药圃，可种植并收获德拉诺草药。

pairs.source: Grows Draenic Seeds into herbs each day and herbalism nodes are available in the garden.
pairs.text: 每天用德拉诺种子种植出药材，并使药圃中出现草药点。

pairs.source: Adventure!  Excitement! A Hero and his followers need all these things, along with a place to rest afterward.
pairs.text: 冒险！刺激！英雄和他的追随者不但需要这些，还需要一个能够安心休息的场所。

pairs.source: Each day, a visitor offering a dungeon quest with generous rewards will spend the day at your inn.
pairs.text: 每天，你的旅店中将出现一位访客并为你提供一个回报丰厚的地下城任务，持续一天。

pairs.source: Adventure!  Excitement! A Hero and his followers need all these things, along with a place to rest afterward.
pairs.text: 冒险！刺激！英雄和他的追随者不但需要这些，还需要一个能够安心休息的场所。

pairs.source: Recruits random followers each week.  You can specify traits and abilities you're especially interested in.
pairs.text: 每周随机招募追随者。你可以指定你最感兴趣的专长和技能。

pairs.source: Unlocks the particularly lucrative garrison resource missions.
pairs.text: 解锁奖励大量要塞资源的任务。

pairs.source: Enables instant travel to strategic points in Draenor!
pairs.text: 可立即抵达德拉诺的各个战略要地！

pairs.source: Allows the collection of Ogre Waystones from Ogres on Draenor.  These waystones can be used to power an Ogre Waygate of your choice on Draenor.  Also occasionally triggers Runes of Power during combat.
pairs.text: 使你可以从德拉诺的食人魔身上收集到食人魔道标石。这些道标石可以用来给你在德拉诺选定的食人魔传送门充能。在战斗中偶尔也会触发能量符文。

pairs.source: Enables instant travel to strategic points in Draenor!
pairs.text: 可立即抵达德拉诺的各个战略要地！

pairs.source: Unlocks access to a second Ogre Waygate for a total of 2.
pairs.text: 解锁第二座食人魔传送门，最多可解锁2座。

pairs.source: Enables instant travel to strategic points in Draenor!
pairs.text: 可立即抵达德拉诺的各个战略要地！

pairs.source: Unlocks access to a third Ogre Waygate for a total of 3.
pairs.text: 解锁第三座食人魔传送门，最多可解锁3座。

pairs.source: The Lumber Mill enables access to different types of Timber throughout Draenor.
pairs.text: 伐木场可解锁德拉诺的各种木材。

pairs.source: Allows you to mark small trees in Draenor for harvest. Harvested Timber can be converted to work orders for garrison supplies.
pairs.text: 允许你在德拉诺标记出可砍伐的小型树木。收获的木材通过产品订单转化为要塞物资。

pairs.source: The Lumber Mill enables access to different types of Timber throughout Draenor.
pairs.text: 伐木场可解锁德拉诺的各种木材。

pairs.source: Allows you to mark medium trees for additional Timber.
pairs.text: 允许你标记中型树木，获取额外的木材。

pairs.source: The Menagerie provides new opportunities to develop and enhance your pet retinue.
pairs.text: 宠物小窝可以让你训练和强化你的宠物。

pairs.source: Attracts elite pets you can battle for rewards.  Also lets 5 of your battle pets hang out in your garrison.
pairs.text: 吸引可为你战斗并获取奖励的精英宠物。同时让你的5只战斗宠物在要塞中游荡。

pairs.source: The Storehouse has room to keep your and the garrison's items safe and secure.
pairs.text: 仓库可以妥善保存你和要塞所生产的物品。

pairs.source: Enables access to your personal bank and increases the total number of active work orders for all buildings by 5.
pairs.text: 令你可以使用私人银行，并使所有建筑的活跃产品订单数提升5。

pairs.source: The Salvage Yard turns other people's trash into your treasure.
pairs.text: 废品站可以把别人的垃圾变成你的宝物。

pairs.source: Allows Salvage to be occasionally recovered from missions.
pairs.text: 使完成任务后偶尔能回收到一些废品。

pairs.source: The Forge produces both basic components for use by blacksmiths, as well as armor and weapons ready for battle.
pairs.text: 熔炉可以生产出锻造所需的基本材料，以及战斗所需的护甲和武器。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Blacksmithing items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产锻造物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The mine was once abandoned, but there are still underground riches ready to be discovered.
pairs.text: 这是一座曾经废弃的矿井，但它的地下依然有着丰富的矿产在等待着人们的发掘。

pairs.source: Allows players to mine Draenic Stone from mineral nodes in Draenor. Draenic Stone can be converted to work orders for Draenor minerals.
pairs.text: 使玩家可在德拉诺的矿点采到德拉诺岩石。德拉诺岩石可以通过产品订单转化为德拉诺的矿产。

pairs.source: The mine was once abandoned, but there are still underground riches ready to be discovered.
pairs.text: 这是一座曾经废弃的矿井，但它的地下依然有着丰富的矿产在等待着人们的发掘。

pairs.source: Allows followers with the Mining trait to work here, granting a unique bonus.  Also opens a new mineshaft, granting access to additional mining nodes and allows up to 14 work orders at one time.
pairs.text: 允许拥有采矿专长的追随者在此工作，提供特殊的奖励。同时开放一座新矿坑，提供额外的矿点，并允许同时接受最多14份产品订单。

pairs.source: The mine was once abandoned, but there are still underground riches ready to be discovered.
pairs.text: 这是一座曾经废弃的矿井，但它的地下依然有着丰富的矿产在等待着人们的发掘。

pairs.source: A final mineshaft allows access to rich mining nodes.  In addition, garrison guards will patrol your mine, keeping it clear of hostile goren. Also allows up to 21 work orders at one time.
pairs.text: 最后一座矿坑，可开启富矿矿点。此外，要塞守卫会巡视矿井，确保它不被敌对的鬣蜥人破坏。并允许同时接受最多21份产品订单。

pairs.source: The Fishing Shack provides support to those looking for their next big catch.
pairs.text: 渔夫小屋可为那些想钓大鱼的人提供场所。

pairs.source: Allows small Draenor fish to be caught in garrison waters and provides access to daily Fishing quests.
pairs.text: 可以在要塞水域内钓到小型德拉诺鱼类。同时开启德拉诺每日钓鱼任务。

pairs.source: The stables provide significant benefits to your mounts.
pairs.text: 兽栏可以为你的坐骑提供极大的增益。

pairs.source: Enables the capture and training of special mounts on Draenor.  Also allows you remain mounted while interacting with objects in outdoor Draenor zones.
pairs.text: 允许捕捉并训练特定的德拉诺坐骑。同时允许你在德拉诺的野外区域与物体互动时，可以保持骑乘状态。

pairs.source: The stables provide significant benefits to your mounts.
pairs.text: 兽栏可以为你的坐骑提供极大的增益。

pairs.source: You will no longer get dazed by enemies while riding mounts in outdoor Draenor zones.
pairs.text: 你在骑乘状态下穿过德拉诺的野外区域时，不会被敌人晕眩。

pairs.source: The stables provide significant benefits to your mounts.
pairs.text: 兽栏可以为你的坐骑提供极大的增益。

pairs.source: Increases mount speed in Draenor by 20%.
pairs.text: 使坐骑在德拉诺的速度提高20%。

pairs.source: The Alchemy Lab creates a variety of reagents and alchemical wonders.
pairs.text: 炼金实验室可以制造出各种药剂和炼金奇物。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Alchemy items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产炼金物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Tannery refines raw leather into strong, leatherworked items that are useful for adventurers of any kind.
pairs.text: 制革厂可以将生皮加工成各种坚韧的制皮物品，供冒险者使用。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Leatherworking items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产制皮物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Engineering Works produces a host of useful gizmos and parts for the intrepid tinkerer, and also creates wondrous mechanical devices.
pairs.text: 工坊可以为勇敢的工匠生产出各种实用的小玩意儿和零件，还可以制造神奇的机械设备。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Engineering items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产工程学物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Enchanter's Study creates both the magical precursors that form an enchantment, as well as completed and usable item enchantments.
pairs.text: 附魔研究室可以制造用于附魔的魔法材料以及实用的附魔产品。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Enchanting items and allows non-Enchanters to disenchant items.  Also allows work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产附魔物品，并可以让非附魔专业的玩家分解物品，并可接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Tailing Emporium is your one stop shop for anything crafted with cloth.
pairs.text: 裁缝店能为需要采购各种布制品的你提供一站式服务。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Tailoring items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产裁缝物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Scribe's Quarters produces all manners of magical inks, pigments, and paper, and can also create glyphs and other magical items.
pairs.text: 铭文师之家可以生产各种魔法墨水、颜料和纸张，还可以制作雕文和其他魔法物品。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Inscription items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产铭文物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Gem Boutique allows for the creation of wondrous gems and other jewelcrafted items.
pairs.text: 珠宝店可以制造神奇的宝石和其他珠宝加工物品。

pairs.source: Allows the production of Jewelcrafting items and work orders.
pairs.text: 允许生产珠宝加工物品并接受产品订单。

pairs.source: The Trading Post is the garrison's center of commerce with the natives of Draenor.
pairs.text: 货栈是要塞与德拉诺原住民们进行交易的贸易中心。

pairs.source: A merchant shows up each day selling trade goods.  Also allows the trade of crafting reagents for garrison resources.
pairs.text: 商人每天到访一次，出售各种货物，并允许你用生产材料换取要塞物资。

pairs.text: 允许你捕捉精英野兽，获取锻造史诗护甲和武器所需的狂野之血。

pairs.source: Allows enormous Draenor fish to be caught in garrison waters.  Also grants you a chance to catch a unique fish that can be used to lure mysterious creatures onto the shore.
pairs.text: 可以在要塞水域内钓到巨型德拉诺鱼类。并使你有一定几率在要塞水域内钓到特殊鱼类。这种鱼可以将神秘生物引到海滩上来。

pairs.source: A bountiful garden for the planting and harvesting of Draenor herbs.

pairs.source: Allows followers with the Herbalism trait to work here, granting a unique bonus.  Also increases the amount of herbs that can be harvested at the garden and allows up to 14 work orders at one time.

pairs.text: 允许你标记大型树木，获取更多木材。

|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_DepthCharges.blp:24:24:0:0|t|cffffffff驱逐舰|r

pairs.source:
Carriers are outfitted with a squadron of ace bomber pilots.

|cffb2f0ffCountered by: |r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_Stealth.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff Submarine|r
pairs.text:
航母搭载有一队王牌轰炸机飞行员。

|cffb2f0ff应对舰船：|r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_Stealth.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff潜水艇|r

pairs.source:
Destroyers are quick, heavily armored ships known for hunting Submarines.

|cffb2f0ffCountered by: |r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_ArmorPiercingAmmo.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff Battleship|r
pairs.text:
驱逐舰是装甲厚实的高速舰船，擅长猎杀潜水艇。

|cffb2f0ff应对舰船：|r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_ArmorPiercingAmmo.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff战列舰|r

pairs.source:
Feared for its devastating long-range artillery cannons, Battleships are unmatched in the open sea.

|cffb2f0ffCountered by: |r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_Bombers.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff Carrier|r
pairs.text:
战列舰以毁灭性的远程舰炮著称，在公海上所向披靡。

|cffb2f0ff应对舰船：|r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_Bombers.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff航母|r

pairs.source: Massive frozen ice chunks float on the surface of the water.  Navigating through the maze of ice leaves your ships vulnerable to attack.
pairs.text: 水面上漂浮着巨大的冰块。在冰块间迷宫般的水道中航行容易使你的舰船遭到攻击。

pairs.source: Powerful wind gusts, violent lightning strikes, and rogue waves are just three concerns when sailing through Stormy Weather.
pairs.text: 在风暴天气中航行，你只需要担心三件事：狂风吹袭，电闪雷鸣以及凶猛的海浪。

pairs.source: A Dense Fog coats this location in absolute darkness.
pairs.text: 浓雾将这一区域彻底笼罩在黑暗之中。

pairs.source: Chaotic Whirlpools appear without reason or warning, causing havoc on any vessel trying to pass through.
pairs.text: 漩涡乱流的出现毫无预兆，会对途径的任何船只造成毁灭性的破坏。

pairs.source: Accelerates through water with reckless power, half of the battle is just keeping up. The other half is physical.
pairs.text: 以不竭的动力乘风破浪，飞速前行。赶上它你就成功了一半，另一半就得靠真刀真枪了。

pairs.source: Capable of making abrupt turns without warning, this is a difficult target to hit.
pairs.text: 能够在毫无预兆的情况下进行急转弯，这类目标很难击中。

pairs.source: As a minelayer, this ship dispenses proximity mines behind it, leaving a treacherous trail to follow.
pairs.text: 作为一艘布雷舰，这艘舰船会在身后布下大量水雷，令追踪变得危机四伏。

pairs.source: A quick opening attack that can end a battle before it begins.
pairs.text: 一次迅速的正面打击能够干脆利落地结束战斗。

pairs.source: A ship run by a veteran captain, well versed in nuanced naval combat.  Expert Captains cannot be countered directly, but must be accounted for to succeed.
pairs.text: 由精锐船员驾驶的舰船，擅长精妙的海战。专业船长没有直接的应对办法，但要想成功就不能忽视了他们。

pairs.source:
An objective that requires moving goods or troops to locations on land.

|cffb2f0ffCountered by: |r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_BoardingPartyALLIANCE.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff Transport|r
pairs.text:
需要将物资或部队运送到地面位置的目标。

|cffb2f0ff应对舰船：|r
|TInterface\ICONS\Ships_ABILITY_BoardingPartyALLIANCE.blp:24:24:0:0|t |cffffffff运输舰|r
一种严酷而危险的环境。

pairs.source: Gronnlings are a menace to the region.  We should partner with the Frostwolf clan to thin the population.  One may even join our cause...
pairs.text: 小戈隆对这一地区构成了威胁。我们应该与霜狼氏族合作，削减他们的数量。某个人甚至可能因此加入我们的事业……

pairs.source: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!
pairs.text: 我们应该好好搜索一下逃出塔纳安丛林时所乘的船只，上面肯定会有一些有用的东西！

pairs.source: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!
pairs.text: 去搜尋我們逃出塔南森林搭的船應該會相當值得，很有可能會找出一些有用的東西。

pairs.source: Gronnling bones have been discovered in the cavern behind the garrison. Your alchemists are interested in digging them up for research purposes.
pairs.text: 要塞地下的洞穴里发现了小戈隆的骨骼。你的炼金师们很希望把它们挖出来作为研究之用。

pairs.source: The Grimfrost Ogres east of the Icewind Drifts are blatantly mistreating frostwolves.  Unacceptable!
pairs.text: 冰风雪原东面的肃霜食人魔竟敢公然虐待霜狼。这种行为决不能接受！

pairs.source: There are reports of a bloody massacre on the Stonefury Cliffs!  Scatter the Frostbeak Scavengers and rescue wounded allies!
pairs.text: 有报告称石怒崖发生了一桩血腥的大屠杀！快去赶走那些霜喙食腐鸟，营救受伤的盟友吧！

pairs.source: A scout has located a cache of Thunderlord potions frozen in the snow. Recovering them will allow your alchemists to learn about the ingredients of Draenor.
pairs.text: 一名斥候在雪地里发现了一箱冰冻的雷神药水。找到它们有助于你的炼金师了解德拉诺的各种炼金材料。

pairs.source: This is Matt's test mission *bugles and horns blair a triumphant tune*
pairs.text: 這是麥特的測試任務 *喇叭和號角吹起勝利的曲調*

pairs.source: Rylaks from the Burning Glacier have been attacking our supply caravans.  The material must flow!
pairs.text: 来自炽燃冰川的双头飞龙攻击了我们的补给车队。我们必须保证物流通畅！

pairs.source: Bladespire ogres on the Burning Glacier usually carry packs of supplies when they venture out into the dunes of Frostfire. They may contain new types of potions.
pairs.text: 炽燃冰川的食人魔在去探索霜火岭的丘陵时，都会带着大包的补给。那里面或许会有新型药水。

pairs.source: Kill the orcs in the mountains.
Kill the ogres in the desert.
Kill the undead in the snow.
Kill the beasts in the jungle.
Kill the demons in the forest.
Kill the breakers in the town.
Kill the furies in the swamp.
pairs.text: 杀掉沼泽里的元素之怒。

pairs.source: Kill the primals in the plains.
The sword of a thousand truths must be destroyed in the Blackrock Foundry.  Make it happen dawg.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂里的万千箴言之剑必须被摧毁。快动手吧，兄弟。

pairs.source: One Mission To Rule Them All
A regular patrol around the garrison seems like a good idea...
pairs.text: 在要塞周围安排定期巡逻似乎是一个不错的主意……

pairs.source: Corrupted beasts continue to plague the Cursed Woods. The Starfall Sentinels request our aid in putting the poor creatures out of their misery.
pairs.text: 被腐蚀的野兽一直是诅咒林地中最大的祸害。坠星哨兵请求我们帮忙让这些可怜的生物从痛苦中解脱。

pairs.source: We could send several of our best on a raid of the Thunderlord outpost of Colossal's Fall!  Go forth to victory.
pairs.text: 我们可以派一些精英去突袭巨灵之殁的雷神岗哨！快去夺取胜利吧。

pairs.source: It's best not to lose a bet with the janitor.
pairs.text: 你最好不要输掉跟清洁工打的赌。

pairs.source: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!
pairs.text: 我们应该好好搜索一下逃出塔纳安丛林时所乘的船只，上面肯定会有一些有用的东西的！

pairs.source: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!
pairs.text: 去搜尋我們逃出塔南森林搭的船應該會相當值得，很有可能會找出一些有用的東西。

pairs.source: A regular patrol around the garrison seems like a good idea...
pairs.text: 在要塞周围安排定期巡逻似乎是一个不错的主意……

pairs.source: Lunarfall Ravens from Moonflower Valley have been attacking our supply caravans.  The material must flow!
pairs.text: 来自月花谷的坠月渡鸦攻击了我们的补给车队。我们必须保证物流通畅！

pairs.source: We could send several of our best on a raid of the Shadowmoon outpost of Shaz'Gul!  For the Alliance!
pairs.text: 我们可以派一些精英去突袭沙兹古尔的影月岗哨！为了联盟！

pairs.source: Arcane Anomalies are endangering the Fey Dragons of the Shimmer Mor.  Unacceptable!
pairs.text: 奥术畸体威胁到了荧光腐沼里的灵龙。这是绝对不可接受的！

pairs.source: The Shadowmoon have taken several Rangari and Alliance forces captive.  Infiltrate and rescue!
pairs.text: 影月兽人俘虏了一些游侠和联盟部队。快潜入他们的营地救出这些俘虏！

pairs.source: The gronn and the ogres are working together on a two-pronged attack. We must disrupt their machinations before they overwhelm us.
pairs.text: 戈隆和食人魔正计划合力围攻我们。我们必须在他们得逞之前粉碎他们的阴谋。

pairs.source: If there are design flaws in the Blackrock clan's war machines, we can disable them. Break in and inspect the war machines for weaknesses.
pairs.text: 只要黑石氏族的战争机器有设计缺陷，我们就能破坏它们。快潜入敌方营地，检查他们的战争机器，寻找其弱点吧。

pairs.source: Draenor can count the genesaur among its most vicious creatures. We must contain them before they spread from Gorgrond to other areas.
pairs.text: 原祖荆兽是德拉诺最邪恶的生物之一。我们必须遏制住它们从戈尔隆德向其它地区扩散的势头。

pairs.source: We would like to leave the vicious arakkoa alone, but capturing their temple in the Spires of Arak would give us a strategic advantage.
pairs.text: 我们最好别去招惹那些邪恶的鸦人，但占领他们在阿兰卡峰林的神殿可以让我们取得战略优势。

pairs.source: Abyssals, the minions of Sargeras, are roaming the forests of Talador, setting them ablaze. Destroy them before the forest is ash.
pairs.text: 萨格拉斯的爪牙深渊魔正在塔拉多的森林里游荡，大肆焚烧树木。在森林化为灰烬之前，快去消灭他们吧。

pairs.source: Many of the rescued draenei prisoners have gone missing, and we think the saberon are to blame. Go investigate, but go well armed.
pairs.text: 许多获救的德莱尼俘虏失踪了，罪魁祸首应该是刃牙虎人。先将自己武装到牙齿，然后去调查一下吧。

pairs.source: With infernals and felguard invading Talador, the rest of the Burning Legion can't be far behind. Defeat them, and try to find their source.
pairs.text: 随着地狱火和恶魔卫士对塔拉多的入侵，其余的燃烧军团部队也不远了。去击败他们，并试着找出这些恶魔的来源。

pairs.source: The voidlords and voidcallers plaguing Shadowmoon Valley are being summoned by someone. Find and kill whoever is responsible.
pairs.text: 正在影月谷肆虐的空灵领主和虚空召唤者是被某个人召唤来的。无论这是谁干的，去找出这个家伙并干掉他。

pairs.source: Magnaron and goren both grow rocky plates on their hides that have magical properties. Collect these plates for our use.
pairs.text: 玛戈隆和鬣蜥人的皮肤上长着具有魔法力量的岩石板。去收集这些石板供我们使用。

pairs.source: Numerous and powerful, ogre warlords are formidable allies of the Iron Horde. Try to induce them to leave - forcefully, if necessary.
pairs.text: 许多强大的食人魔督军都是钢铁部落的可怕盟友。快去说服他们离开吧——如有必要，可以使用武力。

pairs.source: To weaken the Thunderlord clan, we must eliminate their fiercest warriors - their clefthoof-riders. Go to their camp and free their mounts.
pairs.text: 为了削弱雷神氏族，我们必须消灭他们最凶猛的战士——裂蹄牛骑兵。快去他们的营地放走他们的坐骑吧。

pairs.source: Fel magic has corrupted a few ancients of Shadowmoon Valley. They must be cut down to end their mad rampages.
pairs.text: 邪能魔法腐蚀了影月谷的一些古树。我们必须砍倒它们，终止其疯狂的破坏行为。

pairs.source: The Warsong clan is a symbol of the Iron Horde's power. Under the cover of night, set its camp ablaze. This will kill their morale.
pairs.text: 战歌氏族是钢铁部落的力量象征。在夜色的掩护下，烧毁战歌氏族的营地。这能够打击他们的士气。

pairs.source: Patrols have reported that roving bands of saberon are waylaying merchants traveling through Nagrand. Find them and stop them.
pairs.text: 巡逻队报告说有一群刃牙虎人正在到处伏击纳格兰的商队。去找到并阻止他们吧。

pairs.source: Arakkoa talonpriests have begun sacrificing draenei to their god, Terokk. Interrupt their ritual and free the prisoners.
pairs.text: 鸦人的鸦爪祭司已经开始将德莱尼献祭给他们的神泰罗克了。去打断他们的仪式，释放那些俘虏吧。

pairs.source: In a remote corner of Talador, a small faction of draenei has embraced the worship of Sargeras. Stop their cult before it spreads.
pairs.text: 在塔拉多的遥远角落，一小撮德莱尼正在崇拜萨格拉斯。请在他们的邪教扩散开之前阻止他们。

pairs.source: Ogre slavers have captured many of the draenei displaced by the Iron Horde. Send someone to their camp and liberate them.
pairs.text: 食人魔奴贩们捕捉了许多因钢铁部落入侵而失去家园的德莱尼。派个人去他们的营地解放这些俘虏吧。

pairs.source: Without their leader, the high ogre attack our spies warned us about will fail. Send an assassin to kill their warlord in Nagrand.
pairs.text: 只要失去首领，就能破坏高等食人魔袭击我们密探进行警告的图谋。派个刺客去干掉他们藏身于纳格兰的督军吧。

pairs.source: The hardened bark of the genesaur and botani offer an opportunity to strengthen our armor.  Do what needs to be done.
pairs.text: 原祖荆兽和木精的硬化外壳可以强化我们的护甲。无论采用何种手段，去帮我们搞一些来吧。

pairs.source: Pests! These ravagers are everywhere - in our supplies, in our barracks! Eradicate their nest in the Spires of Arak before they overrun us.
pairs.text: 害虫！我们的补给品里，兵营里，到处都是这些掠食者的身影！在被它们彻底淹没之前，快去毁掉它们位于阿兰卡峰林的巢穴吧。

pairs.source: Infernals are an uncommon sight in Talador. We'd like to keep it that way. The more that are destroyed, the better.
pairs.text: 地狱火在塔拉多非常少见。我们希望这种情况能保持下去。去干掉那些地狱火，越多越好。

pairs.source: Basilisks have turned some arakkoa in the Spires of Arak to stone. It's macabre, but this stone is a precious resource. Gather it carefully.
pairs.text: 蜥蜴将阿兰卡峰林的一些鸦人变成了石头。这很可怕，但这种石头是珍贵的资源。请将它们仔细收集起来。

pairs.source: A group of territorial elementals has claimed an area near our supply route in Frostfire Ridge. Slay them and collect any lost supplies.
pairs.text: 一群占山为王的元素占据了我们位于霜火岭补给线的周边地区。去杀掉它们，收集丢失的补给。

pairs.source: Dark magic runs amok in Shadowmoon Valley, giving rise to maddened, unnatural creatures. End their suffering.
pairs.text: 黑暗魔法正在影月谷疯狂肆虐，使生物发生了疯狂的、非自然的变化。去结束它们的痛苦吧。

pairs.source: Shadowmoon spellcasters are experimenting with unstable void magic near the Teluuna Observatory. Because that's going to end well.
pairs.text: 影月氏族的施法者正在特鲁纳观星台附近实验不稳定的虚空魔法。因此我们必须阻止他们。

pairs.source: Don't be fooled. They're only adorable until they swarm you and gnaw your face off.
pairs.text: 别被骗了。它们看似可爱，却能够一拥而上，把你的脸咬烂。

pairs.source: Lately the plains have been even more bitterly cold than usual. Find out what's causing this weather before it starts costing lives.
pairs.text: 最近平原上比过去更寒冷了。在有人冻死之前，找出天气变化的原因吧。

pairs.source: Elementals are plentiful in Frostfire Ridge. Goren love eating them, and whatever the goren eat, they inherit its powers. Not good.
pairs.text: 霜火岭有大量元素生物。鬣蜥人喜欢吃元素生物，而无论它们吃了什么，都能继承其力量。这可不大妙。

pairs.source: The Bloodmaul ogres have begun raiding Horde outposts, costing us soldiers and supplies. We believe a new warlord is to blame.
pairs.text: 血槌食人魔开始袭击部落的岗哨了。我们损失了许多士兵和补给。我们认为，这都是他们的新督军造成的。

pairs.source: It's time to chop down a few ancient trees. Only the ones that are demonically corrupted, mind you. The rest, you can hug if you like.
pairs.text: 是时候去砍掉一些古树了。但提醒一下，你只能砍那些被恶魔腐蚀的古树。剩下的……如果你愿意，可以去抱抱他们。

pairs.source: Shadowmoon forces have abducted a Wildhammer shaman near the Cursed Woods. Rescue our foolhardy ally and bring the orcs to justice.
pairs.text: 影月氏族的部队在诅咒林地附近绑架了一位蛮锤萨满。快去救出我们那位有勇无谋的盟友，并将那些兽人绳之以法吧。

pairs.source: We have reports of the Shadowmoon prowling Gloomshade Grove, shrouding the land in foul magic. Disrupt their dark rituals at any cost.
pairs.text: 我们收到报告说影月氏族正在幽影林地里活动，用污秽的魔法笼罩了那片土地。一定要不惜一切代价打断他们的黑暗仪式。

pairs.source: Thunderlord hunting parties have been sighted to the north. Set an ambush in the cliffs and show them what the real Horde is made of!
pairs.text: 北边出现了雷神狩猎小队的踪影。我们要在悬崖那里设下埋伏，让他们看看真正部落的实力！

pairs.source: The Shadow Council has wormed its way into a network of caves west of the garrison. We cannot allow it to gain a foothold in the region!
pairs.text: 暗影议会占据了要塞西边纵横交错的洞穴网络。我们不能让它在这一区域站稳脚跟！

pairs.source: Killing full-grown rylaks has not diminished their numbers in the least. Scour their nesting grounds and end this menace at the source.
pairs.text: 杀死成年的双龙飞龙完全无法减少它们的数量。去血洗它们的巢穴，从源头上解决这个威胁吧。

pairs.source: A strange disease is spreading among Gorgrond's ancients, driving them mad. Destroy them before the infection escalates.
pairs.text: 一种奇怪的疾病正在戈尔隆德的古树间传播。被感染的古树都发了疯。在情况恶化之前，去消灭这些古树吧。

pairs.source: Scouts have recovered a map of Blackrock supply caches hidden across Gorgrond. Destroying them would strike a grave blow to our enemy.
pairs.text: 斥候们发现了一张地图，上面标出了戈尔隆德的黑石补给箱的藏匿地点。去摧毁它们可以给我们的敌人当头一棒。

pairs.source: The Gorgrond genesaur have overhunted in their territory and are raiding nearby draenei camps for food. Attack them and lure them away.
pairs.text: 戈尔隆德的原祖荆兽正在它们的领地内大肆捕猎，并抢劫附近的德莱尼营地里的食物。去攻击它们，将它们引走吧。

pairs.source: A group of goren has settled in a valuable quarry nearby. We need to get them out if we plan to use the quarry in the future.
pairs.text: 一群鬣蜥人占领了附近的一座珍贵的矿场。如果我们还想用这座矿场的话，就得把他们赶走。

pairs.source: Gronnlings continue to interrupt our efforts to expand into Gorgrond. We need to thin their numbers if we wish to gain a foothold.
pairs.text: 小戈隆一直在干扰我们在戈尔隆德的扩张计划。如果想要在那里站稳脚跟的话，我们就得减少它们的数量。

pairs.source: Iron Horde siege weapons are deadly at a distance but vulnerable up close. Targeting their armaments with a small force may prove wise.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的攻城武器在远处很有威力，可一旦靠近就破绽百出。派出一支精英小队去破坏他们的军备或许是个明智的方法。

pairs.source: Shivan have been sighted on the outskirts of Talador. They may be the first wave of a Burning Legion incursion. Investigation is warranted.
pairs.text: 破坏魔出现在了塔拉多的外围。她们或许就是燃烧军团的第一波入侵部队。我们需要去调查一下。

pairs.source: A cavern beneath an inhabited section of Talador has become unstable due to the appetite of the goren inside. We must protect those above.
pairs.text: 由于鬣蜥人的好胃口，塔拉多一处定居点地下的洞穴开始变得不稳定了。我们必须保护地面上的居民。

pairs.source: A charismatic high arakkoa priest is inciting his congregation to raid nearby settlements in the name of Terokk. We must defend our allies.
pairs.text: 一位具有超凡神力的高阶鸦人祭司正在鼓动他的教派以泰罗克的名义袭击附近的定居点。我们必须保护我们的盟友。

pairs.source: Absolute power corrupts, and that's absolutely the reason we must neutralize this powerful warlock. Terminate with extreme prejudice.
pairs.text: 绝对的力量造成绝对的堕落，因此我们必须消灭这个强大的术士。快派人去刺杀这个家伙吧。

pairs.source: From Azeroth to Draenor, bullies and their cronies remain the same. Please show our new "friends" how we deal with their kind on Azeroth.
pairs.text: 从艾泽拉斯到德拉诺，恶棍和他们的同党都是一样讨厌。去让我们的新“朋友”见识一下，我们在艾泽拉斯是怎么对付恶棍的。

pairs.source: The ogron are said to be violence incarnate, but I've heard your allies are called the same. Let's find out who lives up to their hype.
pairs.text: 据说独眼魔是暴力的化身，可我听说你的盟友们也有这么一个绰号。让我们看看谁更名符其实吧。

pairs.source: Shattered Hand orcs embrace pain, for they say it strengthens them. Make them very strong. Then very dead.
pairs.text: 碎手兽人享受痛苦，因为他们认为这能增强他们的力量。那就让他们变得空前强大，然后死得不能再死吧。

pairs.source: The Pale are twisted, cowardly wretches, but even scavengers can be deadly in sufficient numbers. Still, that's easily solved, isn't it?
pairs.text: 白鬼是扭曲、怯懦的渣滓。可只要数量够多，食腐鸟也会成为致命的威胁。不过，这是很容易解决的，不是吗？

pairs.source: Ravagers reproduce quickly and eat anything. Like crickets. They're also homicidal and roughly the size of horses. Not like crickets.
pairs.text: 掠食者的繁殖速度很快，而且什么都吃，就像蟋蟀一样。但它们还很残忍嗜杀，而且体型像马一样大。这一点就不像蟋蟀了。

pairs.source: Our livestock have gone missing. Tracks point to the rylaks. Deal with the threat, but don't take them lightly.
pairs.text: 我们的家畜失踪了。一切线索都指向了双头飞龙。去解决这个麻烦，但别小看了它们。

pairs.source: A vicious wind serpent appears to be acting on orders from an unseen master, wearing down our defenses. Seek out and end this threat.
pairs.text: 一条邪恶的风蛇似乎在其幕后主子的指使下削弱我们的防御。去找出并解决这个威胁。

pairs.source: Our informants in the Shattered Hand have turned out to be double agents. Set up a covert meeting and eliminate them.
pairs.text: 经过证实，我们在碎手氏族中的线人都是双面间谍。去安排一次秘密接头，然后把他们一网打尽吧。

pairs.source: Energy-siphoning water spirits are giving our spellcasters fits. Time to bring in reinforcements.
pairs.text: 吸取能量的流水之魂恰好克制了我们的施法者。是时候向他们伸出援手了。

pairs.source: The cause of our recent communal lethargy has been traced to Highmaul sorcerers. Find them and put an end to their sinister arcane rites.
pairs.text: 经过证实，我们最近出现的嗜睡症状与悬槌巫师有关。去找到他们，终结他们邪恶的魔法仪式吧。

pairs.source: Warsong shaman have enacted a spell to open an abyss beneath our feet! Kill all of them before the sands in the hourglass run out!
pairs.text: 战歌萨满创造了一种法术，能在我们脚下撕开一道深渊！在沙漏中的沙子流完之前，快去干掉他们！

pairs.source: High ogre warriors are in battle array, screaming that they're going to "destroy the interlopers." Do you think they're talking about us?
pairs.text: 高等食人魔战士正在排兵布阵，叫嚣着要“消灭入侵者”。你说他们指的会不会是我们？

pairs.source: Burning Blade orcs are attacking treasure hunters at Oshu'gun and looting their crystals. Could they be preparing for some dark ritual?
pairs.text: 火刃兽人在袭击沃舒古的寻宝者，并抢夺他们的水晶。他们是不是在准备某种黑暗仪式？

pairs.source: Our scouts have vanished without a trace! They were last seen entering gronn lands. Find out what happened to them.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候都消失了！他们最后一次现身时，正准备进入戈隆的领土。去找出他们的下落吧。

pairs.source: Shadowmoon Valley is haunted by orc spirits that lash out in confusion and rage. Until they are put to rest, no one is safe.
pairs.text: 影月谷到处都是迷茫和愤怒的兽人幽灵。在他们安息之前，所有人都处在危险之中。

pairs.source: The Thunderlord orcs are growing bold: their scouts follow Horde parties with little stealth or fear. Such arrogance deserves a response.
pairs.text: 雷神兽人越来越大胆了：他们的斥候竟敢大摇大摆地跟踪部落的队伍。对于这种傲慢的行为，我们要坚决予以回击。

pairs.source: Wayward podlings have stolen a crate of our giant growth elixirs. Recover the potions before the creatures consume them and run amok.
pairs.text: 疯疯癫癫的魔荚人偷走了我们的一箱增长药剂。在这些怪物喝下药水并开始发疯前，快去夺回它们。

pairs.source: Blackrock messengers have been spotted crisscrossing the region. Any missives they are carrying could prove invaluable to our cause.
pairs.text: 黑石信使正在这一带流窜。他们所携带的任何文件都可能对我们有着极大的帮助。

pairs.source: Ogre slavers are carrying off our allies to fight in their arenas. Pose as a would-be gladiator and free the unwilling combatants.
pairs.text: 食人魔正迫使我们的盟友在他们的竞技场里战斗。快假装成角斗士去救出那些不情愿的斗士吧。

pairs.source: We know the ogron are going to attack soon because they told us. No one ever said they were smart. Stop them before they do any real harm.
pairs.text: 我们知道独眼魔很快就要进攻了，因为他们自己已经告诉我们了。从来没人说过他们聪明。在他们造成真正的伤害之前，快去阻止他们吧。

pairs.source: Redistributing wealth from the departed isn't stealing. Trouble is, there's a mighty arakkoan sorcerer who doesn't know it. Do let him know.
pairs.text: 重新分配死者的财物不算偷窃。麻烦的是，有一个强大的鸦人巫师并不这么认为。快去好好“说服”他一下吧。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde's shredders are laying waste to Talador's forests. Bastards. If someone's doing that, it should be our forces.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的切割者正在毁灭塔拉多的森林。这群混蛋。如果说谁有资格那么干，那也得是我们的人。

pairs.source: The arakkoa have begun stealing and hoarding gold. Time to steal it back.
pairs.text: 鸦人已经开始偷窃和储藏黄金了。是时候把它们偷回来了。

pairs.source: Saberon have begun attacking with wild abandon. They believe they have nine lives. Prove them wrong.
pairs.text: 刃牙虎人开始疯狂进攻了。他们以为自己有九条命。去告诉他们这种想法有多么可笑吧。

pairs.source: Our soldiers in the field need medical supplies, but Warsong orcs are patrolling the road. Escort the caravan so it makes its destination.
pairs.text: 我们在战场上的士兵急需医疗补给，可沿途有战歌兽人的巡逻队。请护送车队安全抵达目的地吧。

pairs.source: Warsong orcs have razed our camp to the north, and the lone survivor says they're headed this way. We must repel the invaders!
pairs.text: 战歌兽人捣毁了我们北边的营地，唯一的幸存者说他们往这儿来了。我们必须击退入侵者！

pairs.source: Hippos are taking over the Verdant Mire. They're violently territorial and extremely tough. They're also blocking key resources.
pairs.text: 淡水兽占据了碧影湿地。它们的领地观念极强而且非常彪悍。这阻碍了我们获取重要物资。

pairs.source: In this harsh environment, sturdy transportation is essential. Cripple the Iron Horde by taking out its greatest beasts of burden.
pairs.text: 在这片严酷的环境中，结实的交通工具是必须的。去消灭钢铁部落最健壮的驮兽，以此削弱他们的实力吧。

pairs.source: A noxious mist is pervading Blademoon Bloom. Find and neutralize the source so that our forces can pass safely through the region.
pairs.text: 一股剧毒的雾气在刃月密林中弥漫。去找出并消灭雾气的源头，让我们的部队安全通过这一区域。

pairs.source: The pale have stolen a shipment of Iron Horde weaponry. Recover the armaments - by force if necessary - before our enemy does.
pairs.text: 白鬼偷走了钢铁部落的一批武器。快赶在我们的敌人之前抢回这批军备吧，如有必要可以使用武力。

pairs.source: Habitat changes in Gorgrond have forced hydras to encroach on draenei settlements. It is a pity, but we must kill these desperate beasts.
pairs.text: 由于在戈尔隆德的栖息地发生变化，多头蛇开始蚕食德莱尼的定居点了。这很遗憾，但我们必须消灭这些绝望的野兽。

pairs.source: Every year, great herds of clefthoof migrate through Gorgrond, causing tremors and dust storms. We must divert them from our camp.
pairs.text: 每一年，大群裂蹄牛都会穿越戈尔隆德，使大地震动，尘土飞扬。我们必须让它们远离我们的营地。

pairs.source: Elementals are chaotic by nature and are best avoided. This elemental has something we need: resources. Make it an offer it cannot refuse.
pairs.text: 元素生物天性混乱，最好别去招惹它们。但这个元素生物有我们需要的东西：物资。去好好劝劝它，让它无法拒绝我们的要求吧。

pairs.source: Our garrison requires resources, so it's harvest time. Kindly remind this savage plant and its minions why we're atop the food chain.
pairs.text: 我们的要塞需要物资，所以又到收获的时候了。去善意提醒一下这棵野蛮的植物和它的爪牙，让它们知道为什么我们才是食物链的顶端。

pairs.source: An ancient has begun attacking everyone and everything in its path. On a related note, we're currently low on firewood.
pairs.text: 有棵古树正在疯狂袭击所有阻挡他的人和物。另外根据相关提示，我们正缺少木柴呢。

pairs.source: We think the recent dread raven attacks are connected to the arakkoa. We'll investigate them. You hunt down and kill their minions.
pairs.text: 我们认为最近发生的恐惧渡鸦袭击与鸦人有关。我们得调查一下它们，而你则要去追杀他们的爪牙。

pairs.source: War has ravaged the region's plant life, and the clefthoof don't have enough to eat. We should thin out their numbers before they starve.
pairs.text: 战争破坏了这一地区的植被，裂蹄牛没有了足够的食物。在它们挨饿之前，我们得削减它们的数量。

pairs.source: Enraged, Stonegar has begun attacking shaman near the Throne of the Elements. We must send forces to aid.
pairs.text: 被激怒的斯通加尔开始攻击元素王座附近的萨满了。我们得派出援军。

pairs.source: Our former courier got spooked and dropped an important package from Karabor in a thicket of botani and ancients.  Retrieve the package!
pairs.text: 我们的前情报员被一群木精和古树吓坏了，丢失了一个来自卡拉波的重要包裹。快去夺回那个包裹！

pairs.source: Bladespire ogres have captured a band of laborers from the garrison. Infiltrate their fortress and free the workers.
pairs.text: 刀塔食人魔从要塞抓走了一批工人。快潜入他们的要塞，释放那些工人。

pairs.source: Several gronn and ogron came here to attack us, but the dumb beasts are just fighting each other. Let's kill them all and end this farce.
pairs.text: 有一群戈隆和独眼魔来袭击我们，结果这群笨蛋却自己打起来了。快去干掉他们，终止这场闹剧吧。

pairs.source: Blackrock orcs are testing out their war machines on the region's unsuspecting fauna. This aggression will not stand!
pairs.text: 黑石兽人正在用本地无辜的动物试验他们的战争机器。这种暴行绝对不能容忍！

pairs.source: Demons have been skulking about the Court of Souls, and it's not because they enjoy the scenery. Find out what they're plotting.
pairs.text: 恶魔已经潜入了英灵之庭，它们显然不是来欣赏风景的。快去弄清它们的阴谋吧。

pairs.source: Agents of the Burning Legion are hunting down refugee draenei from Shattrath. Gather the refugees and take them to safety.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的密探正在追杀来自沙塔斯的德莱尼难民。快去收拢难民，将他们送去安全的地方。

pairs.source: Several laborers have gone missing, and we fear that the arakkoa plan to burn them alive in sacrifice. We must save them!
pairs.text: 有一些工人失踪了。我们担心鸦人会在献祭中活活烧死他们。我们必须拯救他们！

pairs.source: We have intel that a unit of Shattered Hand orcs is en route to assist the Iron Horde in Talador. Too bad they'll never make it.
pairs.text: 我们收到情报说，一队碎手兽人已经出发，前去支援塔拉多的钢铁部落。可惜他们永远别想到达目的地了。

pairs.source: To the south lies Shadowfall Canyon, where wretched creatures are subjucating spirits of Fire, Earth, and Wind. Hopefully, no worse.
pairs.text: 在南边的坠影峡谷中，有一些卑劣的怪物正在奴役火焰、大地和狂风之魂。但愿情况不会继续恶化了。

pairs.source: High ogres are enslaving gronn with pernicious magic, almost doubling the size of their army. We must put an end to the spellcasting.
pairs.text: 高等食人魔用恶毒的魔法奴役了许多戈隆。这使他们的部队扩充了近一倍。我们必须阻止他们继续施法。

pairs.source: Shadowmoon orcs are summoning void beasts through hastily opened portals that could tear Draenor apart, once again. Stop them!
pairs.text: 影月兽人为了召唤虚空兽，仓促地开启了许多传送门。这可能会再次撕裂德拉诺。快阻止他们！

pairs.source: Gronn attacked an alchemist's wagon, and now they're hopped up on strength elixirs.  Let's get 'em before they find the invisibility potions.
pairs.text: 戈隆攻击了一位炼金师的货车。现在，它们已经迷上了力量药水。在它们发现隐形药水之前，快去解决它们吧。

pairs.source: The genesaur and their botani minions are attacking caravans on the road to Talador. We'll make them rue the day they were sprouted!
pairs.text: 原祖荆兽和它们的木精爪牙正在袭击经过塔拉多的车队。我们要让它们后悔发芽来到这个世界上。

pairs.source: Our scouts spotted a group of ogre slavers gathering in Gorgrond. We cannot allow them a chance to fortify their position. Attack!
pairs.text: 我们的斥候发现有一群食人魔奴贩聚集到了戈尔隆德。我们不能给他们立足的机会。进攻！

pairs.source: Shattered Hand raiders do not simply kill, they take trophies from their victims. We know their next target. Stop them.
pairs.text: 碎手掠夺者不仅杀人，还会从受害者身上夺取战利品。我们知道他们的下一个目标，快去阻止他们。

pairs.source: Arakkoa flocks are looting abandoned draenei homesteads. They're also killing any who try to stop them. That makes them our problem now.
pairs.text: 一群鸦人正在肆意掠夺德莱尼的家园。他们还杀害了所有妨碍他们的人。显然他们已经对我们造成威胁了。

pairs.source: The distressed spirits of fallen Azeroth soldiers have begun to rise. Quickly, let us end their torment.
pairs.text: 阵亡的艾泽拉斯将士们不幸的灵魂正在复苏，让我们结束他们的折磨吧。

pairs.source: Some sadistic saberon think the chaos on Draenor means they can butcher innocents without fear of punishment. Disabuse them of that notion.
pairs.text: 一些嗜虐成性的刃牙虎人以为德拉诺的混乱意味着他们可以随意虐杀无辜者，而不用害怕被惩罚。快去纠正他们的错误观念吧。

pairs.source: Some important Burning Blade orcs wish to discuss battle strategy with Iron Horde leaders. It would be a shame if they never arrived.
pairs.text: 一些火刃氏族的大人物想要跟钢铁部落的首领谈谈战略问题。如果他们无法见面，那该多么遗憾呐。

pairs.source: A group of defectors wishes to escape the Iron Horde! Let's clear the way for them.
pairs.text: 一群变节者想要逃出钢铁部落！让我们帮他们肃清道路吧。

pairs.source: Modern anthropologists had hoped Draenor would reveal the origin of the rock flayer.  They were disappointed.
pairs.text: 现代人类学家希望德拉诺能揭示剥石者的起源。可他们失望了。

pairs.source: Scouts have heard rumors of valuables within a mysterious cave in the Umbrafen.
pairs.text: 斥候们听说了一些流言，据说黯影沼泽的一座神秘洞穴里埋藏着珍贵的宝藏。

pairs.source: Rumors grow of a Pale orc that thrives on ambushing the unsuspecting for anything that shines.  He might be found in a cave to the southwest.
pairs.text: 有传言说，一个白鬼兽人热衷于伏击所有毫无防备的旅人，夺走他们身上所有亮晶晶的东西。你或许能在西南边的洞穴里找到他。

pairs.source: The Grimfrost ogres regularly rob Frostwolf orcs and offer them as sacrifices to Brorrok the Devourer.  Let's relieve them of their stolen goods.
pairs.text: 肃霜食人魔会定期掠夺霜狼兽人，并将战利品作为祭品献给吞噬者布罗克。让我们拿回他们偷走的东西吧。

pairs.source: Legends speak of a cave above the Nightmarsh replete with valuable trade resources - along with an amphibious abomination residing in it.
pairs.text: 传说暗夜沼泽上的一座洞穴里充斥着珍贵的物资——同时里面还住着一只两栖怪物。

pairs.source: The frostwing screechers of the Southwind Cliffs are overpopulated.  If ignored, this will eventually disrupt mining operations.
pairs.text: 南风崖的霜翼尖啸者已经泛滥成灾了。如果再不处理，这可能会最终干扰采矿工作。

pairs.source: We'll need to regularly fend off warpstalkers in the Shimmering Mor to ensure a steady supply of fey dragons for transport purposes.
pairs.text: 我们需要定期清理荧光腐沼里的迁跃兽，以保证运输用精灵龙的稳定供应。

pairs.source: The elementals of Gorgrond are regularly whipped into a frenzy by Dessicus of the Dead Pools.  Let's see what we can do about that.
pairs.text: “死水”德斯克斯会定期逼疯戈尔隆德的元素生物。让我们看看能对此做点什么吧。

pairs.source: The saberon continue to be a menace to our outpost in Gorgrond.  Let's show them why this world isn't named Sabronia.
pairs.text: 刃牙虎人正持续威胁我们在戈尔隆德的岗哨。让他们明白这个世界为什么不叫刃牙诺吧。

pairs.source: Iron Horde artillery units have positioned themselves on the ridge above the Shivering Trench.  This is a clear and present danger!
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的火炮部队正驻扎在战栗壕沟上方的山脊上。这个威胁已经再清楚不过了！

pairs.source: Some say the podlings of Gloomshade Grove bow to the mad king of the east.  Find him, and end his reign of podling terror.
pairs.text: 有人说幽影林地里的魔荚人都臣服于住在东边的一位疯狂大王。去找到他，并终结他对魔荚人的统治。

pairs.source: A reduced kaliri population would be greatly appreciated by virtually every hero moving about the skies, for all time.
pairs.text: 事实上，几乎所有在天空上活动的英雄都会对卡利鸟数量的减少感激万分的。

pairs.source: Scouting reports indicate some substandard adventurers are trapped in Deathweb Hollow.  I suppose we should lend a hand.
pairs.text: 侦察报告表明一些菜鸟冒险者被困在逝网之谷中了。我想我们应该帮他们一把。

pairs.source: The arakkoa have enslaved more outcasts and have resumed their excavation efforts.  Another setback for them is in order.
pairs.text: 鸦人奴役了更多的流亡者，并重新开始了挖掘工作。我们需要再次挫败他们的行动。

pairs.source: Kill the orcs in the mountains.
Kill the orcs in the mountains.
Don't you worry.  Just make like a bear, get in, get the honey, and get out.
pairs.text: 别担心。你只需要向熊看齐，冲进去，抢到蜂蜜，然后出来就行了。

pairs.source: The Shattered Hand clan is positioned on the Shattered Rise and likely to strike again.  Handle it!
pairs.text: 碎手氏族正驻扎在碎手高地，即将再次发动进攻。去解决他们！

pairs.source: The Highmaul ogres have an excavation underway at Stonecrag Gorge.  Get in there and extract information about their relics!
pairs.text: 悬槌食人魔正在岩壁峡谷进行发掘。快去搜集有关他们圣物的信息吧！

pairs.source: Lug'dol and his nascent brawler thugs are using our supply escorts for combat practice.  You know we can't allow this to continue.
pairs.text: 鲁格多尔和他新招募的暴徒正在拿我们的补给护送队练手。你知道的，我们不能让这种事继续下去。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde have built a harbor in Gorgrond that they call the Iron Docks. Show our enemy how fragile their vaunted "iron" truly is.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落在戈尔隆德建造了一座港口，他们称其为钢铁码头。去让我们的敌人瞧瞧，他们所吹嘘的“钢铁”是多么不堪一击吧。

pairs.source: A little bird informed me that the arakkoa of Skyreach have been preying on our forward scouts. Make sure they regret that decision.
pairs.text: 有只小鸟告诉我，通天峰的鸦人正在猎杀我们前线的斥候。让他们去为这个行为后悔吧。

pairs.source: Orcs from an alternate universe invaded our Blackrock Mountain. How ironic. Let's educate them on what happened to the previous residents.
pairs.text: 来自异世界的兽人入侵了我们的黑石山。真是讽刺。快去教训他们一下，让他们知道上一批入侵者的下场吧。

pairs.source: Using a mausoleum as a staging ground is a completely new level of disrespect. Let's allow the departed to rest with smiles on their faces.
pairs.text: 使用陵墓作为驻地是彻头彻尾的无礼行径。快去让逝者带着微笑安息吧。

pairs.source: The Bloodmaul use slave labor to fuel their efforts. If we liberate the miners, we'll disrupt their operations. Textbook win-win situation.
pairs.text: 血槌食人魔用奴隶作为劳动力。如果我们解放了那些矿工，就能干扰他们的工作了。这真是最贴切的双赢局面。

pairs.source: Two words: Orcish engineering.  Even odds their rail system will take care of itself, but let's stack the odds in our favor.
pairs.text: 简单地说：兽人工程学。虽然他们的铁路系统有一半的自我毁灭几率，但我们还是让这个几率再提高一点吧。

pairs.source: The Ziggy Sawdust X3-9 is the latest in clear-cutting technology. Unleash the adorable robot on the Everbloom and enjoy the show.
pairs.text: 兹吉牌X3-9锯末机器人拥有最新的林地清场技术。快将这架可爱的机器人放入永茂林地，欣赏纷飞的锯末吧。

pairs.source: How convenient of Ner'zhul and his lackeys to flee into their clan's burial grounds. It will make choosing their graves much quicker.
pairs.text: 耐奥祖和他的同党逃入了氏族的墓地，这真是太方便了。这下他们连墓地都不用选了。

pairs.source: Our enemies boast that their massive ship at the Iron Docks cannot be sunk. This crate of shiny new seaforium charges begs to differ.
pairs.text: 我们的敌人吹嘘说他们在钢铁码头内的巨舰是永不沉没的。这箱闪闪发亮的全新爆盐炸弹会让他们明白自己错得有多离谱。

pairs.source: The dread ravens are gathering scraps from below Skyreach. They are building more of those constructs or nests. They must be stopped.
pairs.text: 恐惧渡鸦正在通天峰下收集碎片。他们正在建造更多的构装体或巢穴。必须阻止他们。

pairs.source: The druids fear that the proto-drake populations are plummeting. Rescue their eggs from Warlord Zaela's army in Upper Blackrock Spire.
pairs.text: 德鲁伊们担心始祖幼龙的数量会急剧减少。快去黑石塔上层，从督军扎伊拉的大军手中抢救始祖龙蛋吧。

pairs.source: Scouts report that strange figures are lurking near Auchindoun, disturbing the mausoleums. We must destroy anything with even a hint of fel.
pairs.text: 斥候报告说奥金顿附近有陌生的身影出没。这打扰了陵墓的清静。我们必须消灭一切带有邪能痕迹的东西。

pairs.source: Rescuing slaves in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines is our priority, but to do this, we must thin the number of fire furies there.
pairs.text: 我们的首要任务是拯救血槌炉渣矿井里的奴隶。为此，我们得削减里面的烈焰之怒数量。

pairs.source: Goblin engineers are designing weapons for Blackrock and Thunderlord orcs. Well, we have weapons too. Go to Grimrail Depot and use them.
pairs.text: 地精工程师们正在为黑石和雷神兽人设计武器。好吧，我们也有武器。去恐轨车站使用它们吧。

pairs.source: Some magi stopped to smell the roses in the Everbloom. Oops. If we hurry, we should be able to save some of them.
pairs.text: 有些魔导师已经闻不到永茂林地的玫瑰花香了。喔唷。如果我们动作快点，或许还能拯救几个。

pairs.source: Some of the Shadowmoon clan's treasures are poorly guarded. We'll take what we can and destroy the rest!
pairs.text: 影月氏族的部分宝藏守卫十分松懈。我们要拿走能拿走的一切，然后毁掉剩下的东西！

pairs.source: They won't stand it. They'll know we planned it. The Iron Horde will think we're a mirage, but it's just sabotage.
pairs.text: 他们肯定挡不住的。他们会知道我们的计划。钢铁部落会以为我们在痴心妄想，但这只是一次破坏行动。

pairs.source: Atop Skyreach, the high arakkoa are building mechanical constructs as weapons of war. Stop them, but beware their dread raven guards.
pairs.text: 在通天峰的顶上，高阶鸦人正在制造可充当战争武器的机械构装体。快去阻止他们，但要小心他们的恐惧渡鸦守卫。

pairs.source: To siege the Iron Horde held Blackrock Spire, we must rid it of dragonkin and proto-dragons. Their mysterious keeper must also perish.
pairs.text: 要想攻下被钢铁部落占领的黑石塔，我们必须解决那些龙人和始祖龙。它们神秘的饲养者也得死。

pairs.source: The Shadow Council is raising warriors interred at Auchindoun to create draenei constructs. Stop them before they defile the place further.
pairs.text: 暗影议会正在复活埋葬在奥金顿里的战士，并用他们制作德莱尼构造体。在他们进一步亵渎那片土地之前，快去阻止他们吧。

pairs.source: The Bloodmaul have discovered a powerful artifact, and their warlord is overseeing the excavation. Ambush the warlord and take the artifact.
pairs.text: 血槌食人魔发现了一件强大的神器，他们的督军正在亲自监督发掘工作。去伏击那个督军，夺走神器。

pairs.source: The Grimrail Depot owes its efficiency to goblin and orc overseers. Kill them, and you'll kill its ability to ship arms to distant camps.
pairs.text: 恐轨车站的效率全靠那些地精和兽人监工维持。杀了他们，你就摧毁了它向远方的营地运输武器的能力。

pairs.source: We dispatched a mage to deal with a hostile pack of genesaur, but now he's on their side. He must be infected. Time to send in the cavalry.
pairs.text: 我们派了一位法师去对付一群充满敌意的原祖荆兽。结果他却站到了它们一边。他肯定是被感染了。是时候派出援军了。

pairs.source: Testing mission complete and all that.
pairs.text: 测试任务完成及一切相关情况。

pairs.source: The bloodmaul ogres of the Stonefury Cliffs are infamous as brutal slavemasters.  Show no quarter and free their slaves.
pairs.text: 石怒崖的血槌食人魔是一群臭名昭著的奴隶贩子，十分野蛮。去解放那些的奴隶，不要对他们手软。

pairs.source: If our troops are to become battle hardened, there would be no better test than the immense magnaron, Drov the Ruiner.
pairs.text: 如果我们的部队需要经历战火洗礼，那么没有比那头巨大的戈隆，毁灭者多弗更合适的练手对象了。

pairs.source: The Sargerei have taken control of Socrethar's Rise and are establishing countless demonic portals, we can't let this continue.
pairs.text: 萨格雷已经控制了索克雷萨高地，并在那里建造了无数恶魔之门。不能再让这种情况继续下去了。

pairs.source: We need to shut down the legion gateways in operation within Shattrath.  Strike out at their vigilant watchful eyes.
pairs.text: 我们得关闭沙塔斯内运作的燃烧军团传送门。先去消灭他们负责警戒的眼魔吧。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde is running critical supply missions from the beach of Ironfist Harbor.  Three of our best should disrupt their operations.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正在从铁拳港运送重要的补给品。我们得派三个最强的士兵去干扰他们的行动。

pairs.source: The Shattered Hand clan has established the ironically named Bladefist Hold.  Let's make a mockery of it.
pairs.text: 碎手氏族建造了一座名字非常讽刺的堡垒，刃拳堡。让我们好好嘲弄它一番吧。

pairs.source: With great risk comes great reward.  Plumb the dangers of Darksting Cave in southern Gorgrond and see what you can find.
pairs.text: 俗话说高风险，高回报。去试探一下戈尔隆德南部的暗刺洞穴的危险程度，看看你会有什么发现。

pairs.source: The Steamscar of Gorgrond are notorious looters.  Let's repossess the valuables for great justice.
pairs.text: 戈尔隆德的汽痕部族是声名狼藉的强盗。让我们去重申一下正义的价值吧。

pairs.source: Shadow Council pillagers continue to ravage the Auchenai catacombs of the Tomb of Lights.
pairs.text: 暗影议会的强盗们一直在洗劫圣光之墓里的奥金尼墓穴。

pairs.source: As it happens, the reagents used by the Shadow Council fetch a handy sum on the black market.  We're certain there's a stockpile in Gul'rok.
pairs.text: 正巧，暗影议会所使用的原料可以在黑市上卖到一大笔钱。我们可以肯定，古尔罗克肯定有大量这种原料。

pairs.source: The goblins of Pinchwhistle *are* the noxious local environment.  I see no reason we shouldn't relieve them of some valuables.
pairs.text: 宾奇维斯的地精正在毒害当地的环境。我看不出任何理由不能从他们那里抢一些利润过来。

pairs.source: The wolfmother Gar'lua raises the most ferocious of Warsong wolves.  Their pelts would dent the Warsong war effort and fetch a tidy sum.
pairs.text: 狼母加鲁尔驯养了最凶猛的战歌座狼。弄些它们的毛皮来，这可以削弱战歌氏族的战力，还可以卖一大笔钱。

pairs.source: Even an ogre as incompetent as Ug'lok the Frozen can amass a fortune via slave labor, but be prepared to counter his magic should it happen to work.
pairs.text: 就连冰封者乌戈洛克这么无能的食人魔都能靠奴隶攒起一大笔财富。但你得准备好承受他的魔法，万一它生效了呢。

pairs.source: Rumor has it that Brambleking Fili's staff points the way to a hidden cache.  Myth?
pairs.text: 传说荆棘大王菲里的权杖能指引你找到一个隐藏的宝箱。这是传说吗？

pairs.source: The Iron Horde excavations taking place in The Pit occasionally turn up rare diamonds.  Retrieve one and we'll make use of it.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落在黑石矿坑的发掘工作偶尔能挖到一些稀有的钻石。去抢一颗来，我们需要它。

pairs.source: Not only does the ammunition of the Iron Horde carry value on the black market, but lifting some means less for the Earthbreaker cannon.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的军火不但能在黑市上卖个好价钱，而且我们弄走的越多，碎地者火炮可以使用的弹药就越少。

pairs.source: You and I both know the arakkoa are loaded.  Feels like we could make a fortune just chipping away at the walls.
pairs.text: 你我都知道鸦人是富豪。只要从他们的墙上凿点碎片下来，就够我们吃一辈子了。

pairs.source: A joint operation between the Venture Co. and Iron Horde is taking place on Darktide Roost.  Profit must be some sort of motive.
pairs.text: 风险投资公司和钢铁部落正在黑潮栖木联合行动。这肯定是利益驱使下的行动。

pairs.source: The Iron Docks have resumed operations despite our previous incursions. Let us show them how base their iron is against our mettle.
pairs.text: 钢铁码头已经从我们上次的突袭行动中恢复过来，又重新开始运转。去让他们明白，和我们的韧性相比，他们的钢铁是多么脆弱吧。

pairs.source: The denizens of Skyreach have stymied the war effort in arakkoan territory. Time to implement our new strategy: Operation Open Season.
pairs.text: 通天峰的住民已经阻碍了我们在鸦人领土的战争行动。是时候采取新的战略了：开放式打击阶段。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde and its lackeys have "energetically" refused to vacate our own Blackrock Mountain. Go collect back rent from their corpses.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落及其爪牙已经“强势”拒绝了撤出我们的黑石山。那就从他们的尸体上收点租金回来吧。

pairs.source: The Sargerei and their allies continue their desecration of Auchindoun. I recommend executing our "no traitor left behind alive" policy.
pairs.text: 萨格雷和他们的盟友还在继续亵渎奥金顿。我建议执行我们的“叛徒必须死”政策。

pairs.source: Ogres are bringing in slaves to shore up defenses in the mines. Free the slaves, and the area will be vulnerable to attack.
pairs.text: 食人魔正在驱使奴隶防御矿井。去释放那些奴隶，这一区域就会变得不堪一击了。

pairs.source: The Blackrocks need an uninterrupted supply of metal to fuel production of their war machines. Let's make life difficult for them.
pairs.text: 黑石氏族需要源源不断的金属补给才能维持战争机器的生产。让我们去给他们制造点麻烦吧。

pairs.source: The natives are restless. Again. The Kirin Tor have asked us to help them with some "gardening."
pairs.text: 本地的植物又开始不安分了。肯瑞托请求我们帮忙搞些“园艺”工作。

pairs.source: Our shaman have prepared a ritual to return souls summoned by the Shadowmoon to rest. Go and perform this ritual at the burial grounds.
pairs.text: 我们的萨满准备了一个仪式，可以让影月氏族召唤的灵魂重新安息。快去墓地举行这个仪式吧。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde's flagship is at the Iron Docks. It's intimidating, but if it's steered into a shoal, it'll founder like any other boat.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的旗舰就停在钢铁码头。它很恐怖，可只要被开进暗礁群，它就会像其它船只一样沉没了。

pairs.source: Apexis devices are sun powered, but what if the sun is blocked? Zeppelins will work, and the goblins might help. Go, but pack airsick bags.
pairs.text: 埃匹希斯装置都是太阳能的，可如果太阳被挡住了呢？飞艇可以做到这一点，地精也会来帮忙的。去吧，但记得带上呕吐袋。

pairs.source: Is It a Bird? A Zeppelin?
A fortress in a volcano is both ingenious and foolhardy. Impenetrable, yes, but a shaman can cause an eruption that will decimate it.
pairs.text: 一座火山中的堡垒既是天才的设想也是愚蠢的念头。它确实无法被攻破，可一个萨满就能引起火山喷发，从而将它淹没。

pairs.source: Soulbinder Nyami has hidden caches of reagents for the Sargerei's summoning rituals all across Auchindoun. Find the caches and destroy them.
pairs.text: 缚魂者尼娅米在奥金顿各处藏了好几箱萨格雷召唤仪式所需的材料。去找出这些箱子并摧毁它们。

pairs.source: A mineshaft has collapsed, and those Bloodmaul dogs have left the enslaved miners down there to die. We must dig them out!
pairs.text: 有一座矿坑垮塌了，那些血槌的狗东西居然任由奴隶矿工在下面自生自灭。我们得把他们挖出来！

pairs.source: A train full of artillery and explosives is about to leave the depot. Detonating one bomb should be enough to destroy the entire payload.
pairs.text: 一列装满火炮和炸药的列车即将出站。只要引爆一个炸弹，应该就能摧毁整辆列车了。

pairs.source: The river we've been using as our water source has been tainted by those nasty spores! Find a new source before people get thirsty.
pairs.text: 被我们当成水源的那条河被那些恶心的孢子污染了！在人们出现饮水困难前，快去找一条新水源吧。

pairs.source: The spirits of the burial grounds are restless. Seek their knowledge and their power to end Ner'zhul's scheming once and for all.
pairs.text: 墓地中的幽灵无法安息。去追寻他们的知识和力量，用它们彻底破坏耐奥祖的阴谋。

pairs.source: With some diving gear and a little luck, a seaborne attack could be our best chance of infiltrating the heavily fortified Iron Docks.
pairs.text: 只要有潜水设备和一点运气，水下攻击可能是我们潜入守卫森严的钢铁码头的最好办法。

pairs.source: The arakkoa view us "ground dwellers" as nothing more than beasts. Let us see what they think after we lay waste to their lofty spires.
pairs.text: 鸦人将我们这些“地面居民”视为野兽。等我们把他们引以为傲的通天峰化为废墟之后，看他们还有什么话说吧。

pairs.source: Getting into Blackrock Spire will not be easy, but we have a secret weapon: mole machines. The Black Irons will never know what hit them.
pairs.text: 进入黑石塔并不容易，可我们有秘密武器：钻探机。黑铁杂碎们永远不会知道是谁袭击了他们。

pairs.source: A portal in Auchindoun links Draenor to the demon world of Argus. Cut off the Legion's reinforcements: destroy every trace of the portal.
pairs.text: 奥金顿内的一座传送门连通了德拉诺和恶魔的世界阿古斯。快去彻底摧毁传送门，切断燃烧军团的后援。

pairs.source: Slaves in the Slag Mines are ripe for revolt. Aid them. Then ask if they've dug up any powerful relics lately. Try to be subtle.
pairs.text: 炉渣矿井里的奴隶已经准备起义了。去帮帮他们，顺便问问他们最近有没有挖到什么强大的圣物。谨慎行事。

pairs.source: Trains symbolize inevitability, but you've never put much stock in fate. That's good: you've got a huge infrastructure to shatter.
pairs.text: 火车就是势不可挡的象征，可你从不相信命运。这很好：有一座巨型公共设施正等着你去摧毁。

pairs.source: The Kirin Tor who were sent to Gorgrond have gone silent. Turned or slain? Find out what's going on, and get them back on task if you can.
pairs.text: 肯瑞托派去戈尔隆德的人失去了音讯。他们到底是叛变了还是遇害了。去查清发生了什么事，如果可能的话最好让他们回到岗位上去。

pairs.source: The time for a critical assault on Highmaul is at hand.  To victory!
pairs.text: 对悬槌堡的总攻即将开始。为了胜利！

pairs.source: Rumored not to exist, yet clearly baseless.
pairs.text: 谣传并不存在，没有任何依据。

pairs.source: The Netherstorm must have come from somewhere.  Get on a boat, sail northeast, and bring something good back while you're at it.
pairs.text: 虚空风暴肯定是从某处刮来的。快乘上小船，驶向东北方，并想办法带点好东西回来。

pairs.source: Some shifty troll sold our troops a bunch of worthless junk.  Rough him up a bit and get a refund!
pairs.text: 某个狡诈的巨魔将一堆垃圾卖给了我们的军队。快去好好教训他一顿，让他退钱！

pairs.source: The Warsong clan stationed in Lok-rath is rumored to stockpile some strange form of currency.  It may hold some historic significance.
pairs.text: 传说驻扎在洛克拉斯的战歌氏族收藏了一种奇怪的货币。它或许具有重大的历史意义。

pairs.source: It's best not to lose a bet with the janitor.
pairs.text: 你最好不要输掉跟清洁工打的赌。

pairs.source: Mogor the Ogre is having trouble with some gladiators, but slaughtering other ogres would look bad for him.  He'll pay us for the dirty work.
pairs.text: 食人魔穆戈尔和几位角斗士发生了摩擦，可他不想杀害同胞。因此他决定付钱让我们帮他干脏活。

pairs.source: The ruthless war prides of the Bloodmane have made off with the Reveries of Sethek, scrolls sacred to the outcasts.
pairs.text: 血鬃氏族残忍的战争虎王偷走了流亡者的圣卷，《塞泰克之梦》。

pairs.source: The once-great city of Shattrath continues to be subjugated by the legion.  Cry havoc, and let slip the followers of war.
pairs.text: 盛极一时的名城沙塔斯依然在燃烧军团的掌握之中。关门，放追随者！

pairs.source: Sometimes, a follower's skills just aren't cutting the mustard.  The ring offers a rare opportunity to retrain.
pairs.text: 有时候，某个追随者的技能可能不怎么合用。而竞技场就提供了一个难得的再造机会。

pairs.source: Slay our Alliance adversaries for the glory of the Horde!  Go forth to victory!
pairs.text: 为了部落的荣耀，干掉联盟的敌人！迈向胜利吧！

pairs.text: 为了联盟的荣耀，干掉部落的敌人！

pairs.source: Gorgrond plays host to one of the most fearsome creatures in all Draenor.  Tremble before his might, but come back with some plunder afterwards.
pairs.text: 戈尔隆德有着全德拉诺最可怕的生物之一。在他的力量面前颤抖吧，但抖完了记得带些战利品回来。

pairs.source: A manifestation of a Sun God, Rukhmar demands fealty and obedience.  She will not be defeated easily.
pairs.text: 作为太阳神的化身，鲁克玛要求绝对的忠诚和服从。她可不是那么好对付的。

pairs.source: If you really want to join the Steamwheedle Preservation Society, you've got to really care about Highmaul artifacts.
pairs.text: 如果你真想加入热砂保护协会，那你一定得仔细留意悬槌神器。

pairs.source: While we were occupied with the sabotage of the Dark Portal, Blingtron managed to build a vault of riches.  Find it!
pairs.text: 在我们忙着破坏黑暗之门时，布林顿已经设法累积了一大笔财富。快去找到他的宝库！

pairs.source: We could use a master tactician around here.  Plus, we might get some autographs.
pairs.text: 我们这儿需要一位战术大师。此外，我们可能还想要一些签名。

pairs.source: We could use a master tactician around here.  Plus, we might get some autographs.
pairs.text: 我们这儿需要一位战术大师。此外，我们可能还想要一些签名。

pairs.source: Rumor has it there's a chili cook-off soon, and frankly I'm tired of eating the same gruel every day.  Send someone to get whatever wins.
pairs.text: 传说马上就要举办辣椒烹饪大赛了，而老实说，我已经受够了每天喝稀粥的日子了。快派个人去随便赢点什么回来吧。

pairs.source: Behold!  Endless customization awaits in this system within a system within a system.
pairs.text: 看！在这个系统的系统的系统中，有着无数个性化的元素在等待着你们！

pairs.source: Coldtusk the boar continues to roam the shivering trench, and clearly we can't rely on the ravagers to take care of him.
pairs.text: 野猪冷牙一直在战栗壕沟那里游荡，显然我们不能指望掠食者去解决它。

pairs.source: The furies that roam the Southwind Cliffs have been known to leave their dead frozen in place.  Perhaps there are things worth retrieving.
pairs.text: 游荡在南风崖的元素之怒以死后会冻结在原地而著称。或许那里会有一些值得回收的东西。

pairs.source: The marshes of the Umbrafen are the stomping ground of Ba'ruun, a danger to all that need enter the fen.
pairs.text: 黯影沼泽是巴鲁恩的地盘，它对所有进入沼泽的人都构成了威胁。

pairs.source: Rumors speak of a ghostly talbuk that haunts the southern reaches of Shadowmoon Valley, we should investigate.
pairs.text: 传说影月谷的南部边界上游荡着一头幽灵塔布羊。我们得去调查一下。

pairs.source: Comb the northern wastelands of Gorgond for Rolkor.  Find him and defeat him for the glory of the garrison.
pairs.text: 去戈尔隆德的北部荒野上掘地三尺寻找洛克尔吧。为了要塞的荣耀，去找到并击败他。

pairs.source: Our scouts speak of a cavern in northern Gorgrond in which a strange ogron named Gelgor of the Blue Flame lies.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说，戈尔隆德北部的一座山洞里住着一头名叫“蓝焰”戈尔高的古怪独眼魔。

pairs.source: Hen-Mother Hami.  She who breeds the swooping terrors of the sky.  Find her, subdue her, and restore freedom to the skies.
pairs.text: 雌鸟哈米，她就是盘旋在天空中的那群灾星的母亲。去找到她，击败她，让天空重获自由。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde have equipped a particularly violent elekk named Steeltusk.  Let's make sure this doesn't become more common.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落武装起了一头特别暴虐的雷象，名叫钢牙。快去阻止这种恐怖武器继续推广吧。

pairs.source: Scouts report a many-headed beast named Festerbloom waylaying travelers crossing the Murkbog.  Clear the path for everyone's sake.
pairs.text: 斥候报告说，一只有许多脑袋，叫做脓花的野兽正在劫掠阴郁沼泽里过往的旅人。为了大家的安全，去肃清道路吧。

pairs.source: Rumors swirl of an ancient gone awry in the undergrowth.  Track down this "Shadowbark" and take care of business.
pairs.text: 传说灌木林地里有一棵被扭曲的古树。去找到这个“影皮”，然后解决他。

pairs.source: We've isolated the murderous Warmaster Blugthol to a tower within Mar'gok's Overwatch.  It's time to take him out.
pairs.text: 我们已经将残忍的战争大师布格索尔堵在了马尔高克岗哨的塔楼里。是时候解决他了。

pairs.source: Just north of Grommashar dwell the Sabermaw clan, notorious outpost raiders.  Strike out at their leader, Soulfang, and crush their morale.
pairs.text: 格罗玛什尔的北方住着刃喉氏族，他们是一群臭名昭著的强盗。去干掉他们的首领灵牙，狠狠打击他们的士气吧。

pairs.source: A very large Iron Horde fuel-storage tank sits alongside a rail bridge to the north. Crack the tank open, add some dynamite.  BOOM!
pairs.text: 一辆钢铁部落的巨型油罐车就停在北边的铁路桥旁。去打开油罐，放点炸药进去吧。轰！

pairs.source: We suspect a goblin merchant of selling to both us and the Iron Horde. Tail him, and if he is double-dealing, drag him back by his ears.
pairs.text: 我们怀疑有个地精商人在同时跟我们和钢铁部落做生意。去跟踪他，如果他真的是个两面派，那就揪着他的耳朵把他拖回来。

pairs.source: Iron Horde raiders have descended on nearby draenei villages. Find the raiders' camp and raid it. Turnabout, they say, is fair play.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的强盗袭击了附近的德莱尼村庄。去找到这群强盗的营地，然后狠狠劫掠一番。所谓风水轮流转，这很公平。

pairs.source: Word has it that an Iron Horde mine near our outpost has hit a rich vein. We can't let them have nice things. Storm in and claim the mine.
pairs.text: 据说我们的岗哨附近有一座钢铁部落的矿井，那里有一座富矿。我们不能让他们占有这么好的地方。冲进去，占领那座矿井吧。

pairs.source: Iron Horde cuisine is revolting, but the refugees need food. Find orc camps and pilfer what rations they have. Mints might be prudent too.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落做的饭菜简直就是泔水，可难民们需要食物。去找到兽人的营地，偷走他们的干粮。最好再准备点薄荷。

pairs.source: Rumor has it that the Thunderlord clan is using strange "blades of omen" that can change size. Destroy these weapons while we can.
pairs.text: 传说雷神氏族在使用一种奇怪的、可以改变大小的“预兆之刃”。有可能的话，去摧毁这些武器吧。

pairs.source: Grommash has a legendary ego and temper. Hit the Warsong hard and he'll be consumed with the need for vengeance. We want him distracted.
pairs.text: 格罗玛什极其自负和暴躁。只要狠狠打击战歌氏族，他就会被复仇冲昏头脑。我们得让他分心。

pairs.source: Blackrock scouts have discovered a vast trove of metal ore perfect for making weapons. Make sure they never report their findings.
pairs.text: 黑石斥候发现了一大批适合制造武器的金属矿石。不要放他们回去报告自己的发现。

pairs.source: Curiously, our scouts say a Shadowmoon encampment is always vulnerable at night. You'd think they'd be more used to the dark. Oh well.
pairs.text: 奇怪，我们的斥候说影月氏族的一座营地在夜里总是变得格外脆弱。你还以为他们会更习惯黑暗呢。

pairs.source: Some Shattered Hand raiders have scattered, but though they look haggard, they may soon find new victims to splatter.
pairs.text: 一群碎手强盗被打散了。虽然现在十分惶恐，但他们很快就会找到新的受害者了。

pairs.source: Those Highmaul ogres are annexing more land than we can afford to lose. We're green-lighting a terminal solution to this problem: you.
pairs.text: 那些悬槌食人魔对土地的渴望已经超过我们的忍受极限了。我们全票通过了一个终极解决方案，那就是——你。

pairs.source: Bloodmaul ogres enslave others and then rely on their forced labor. Go inspire the downtrodden by kicking the fight out of their oppressors.
pairs.text: 血槌食人魔奴役其他种族，并依靠剥削奴隶的劳动力为生。为了鼓舞那些被践踏的奴隶，去跟他们的压迫者狠狠大战一场吧。

pairs.source: The Bladespire clan has concocted a "foolproof" plan of defense. Make it backfire by killing their elite and leaving their "fools" alive.
pairs.text: 刀塔氏族制定了一个“防火防盗防蠢蛋”的防御计划。为了破坏这个计划，快去干掉他们的精英，把“蠢蛋”留下。

pairs.source: We cannot allow the arakkoa to acquire more of their deadly Apexis technology. Raid their excavation sites. Leave nothing but dust behind!
pairs.text: 我们不能让鸦人继续获取致命的埃匹希斯技术了。去突袭他们的挖掘场，把那里化为齑粉！

pairs.source: Our alchemists have found uses for the oils secreted by arakkoa feathers. Gather as many as you can - by any means necessary.
pairs.text: 我们的炼金师发现鸦人羽毛分泌出的油脂很有用处。尽力去多收集一些来吧——无论你采用什么手段都行。

pairs.source: We have crafted a device to mimic an arakkoa's cries for help. Deploy it in the Spires of Arak to draw our feathery foes into an ambush.
pairs.text: 我们制造了一个仪器，可以模仿鸦人求救的叫声。将它放在阿兰卡峰林，把我们的扁毛敌人引进埋伏圈。

pairs.source: The podlings have been raiding the graves of our allies to feed one of their genesaur. Recover the bodies. If they want mulch, mulch them!
pairs.text: 为了喂养它们的原祖荆兽，魔荚人劫掠了我们盟友的墓地。去夺回那些尸体。如果他们需要肥料，就让他们自己变成肥料吧！

pairs.source: We need to get the gronn riled again. Kill the local meat-based wildlife and see if starvation turns them against the Iron Horde nearby.
pairs.text: 我们得再次激怒那些戈隆。去杀掉当地的食肉动物，看看饥饿能不能让它们对附近的钢铁部落产生兴趣。

pairs.source: Our scouts report that the botani are snatching workers from the quarries. Kill the primals and find out what they are using the orcs for.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说木精正在掠夺矿场里的工人。去杀掉那些原兽，搞清他们要那些兽人干什么。

pairs.source: The reckless warlock Gul'dan intends to create a fel volcano in the center of Shadowmoon Valley. Stop him before he dooms us all.
pairs.text: 不顾一切的术士古尔丹想在影月谷中心制造一座邪能火山。在他毁灭我们所有人之前，快去阻止他。

pairs.source: Shadow Council agents plan to cut a path through Tanaan and pave it with their enemies' bones. Such an atrocity must not come to pass.
pairs.text: 暗影议会的密探计划用敌人的骨头铺设出一条横穿塔纳安的道路。我们决不能容忍这种暴行的发生。

pairs.source: Warlocks in the northwest are draining life from the land, preparing to summon a demon lord. Well? Don't just stand there!
pairs.text: 西北边的术士正在摄取大地中的生命力，想用这些力量召唤出一个恶魔领主。所以呢？别再干站着了！

pairs.source: Pale orcs stole a powerful trinket and fled to the mountains. Now they vow to kill anyone who comes near "the precious." Challenge accepted!
pairs.text: 白鬼兽人偷走了一个强大的饰品，并逃入了群山之中。现在，他们还发誓要杀掉所有靠近“宝贝”的人。接受这个挑战吧！

pairs.source: Massive flooding has cut off our supply lines, and the water elementals responsible show no signs of stopping. Let's hang them out to dry.
pairs.text: 洪水切断了我们的补给线，而引发洪水的水元素似乎并没有停手的打算。快去把它们挂起来风干！

pairs.source: A doomsday weapon has been enchanted to look like an adorable baby clefthoof. Clefthoof violently defend their young. Proceed with caution.
pairs.text: 一件灭世武器在魔法的作用下变成了一头看似可爱的小裂蹄牛。裂蹄牛非常护崽，你要小心靠近。

pairs.source: Disrupt tense negotiations between the Iron Horde and the Highmaul ogres to acquire an Abrogator Stone for Khadgar.
pairs.text: 打断钢铁部落和悬槌食人魔的激烈谈判，帮卡德加弄到一块消魔之石。

pairs.source: A powerful Bloodmaul magma-shaper is using an Abrogator Stone as a piece of navel jewelry. Don't tell Khadgar where we got it.
pairs.text: 有个强大的血槌塑火者将一块消魔之石嵌在了脐环上。别告诉卡德加它是怎么来的。

pairs.source: A failed Stonemaul assault on the Overlook Ruins has left ogre corpses everywhere. Search them for an Abrogator stone!
pairs.text: 石槌氏族对岗哨废墟的突袭失败了，那里如今到处都是食人魔尸体。去他们身上寻找一块消魔之石吧！

pairs.source: Ogres are wagering an Abrogator Stone on an upcoming Ring of Blood gladiatorial contest. Send in the ringers.
pairs.text: 食人魔将一块消魔之石当做了即将到来的鲜血竞技场角斗大赛的奖品。快派一些高手去吧。

pairs.source: Scouts have discovered a ruined ogre guard tower in Talador. It's haunted. Also, we're running out of scouts.
pairs.text: 斥候在塔拉多发现了一座废弃的食人魔守卫塔楼。它里面闹鬼，而且，我们的斥候人手也不够了。

pairs.source: Good news! We've located some Elemental Runes that Khadgar is looking for. Bad News: They're in The Pits.
pairs.text: 好消息！我们发现了一块卡德加所需的元素符文。但坏消息是，它在黑石矿坑里。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde is moving an Elemental Rune via train to the Blackrock Foundry. It's ambush time.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正打算用货车将一块元素符文运往黑石铸造厂。准备伏击。

pairs.source: In the chaos of the battle of Shattrath, the Sargerei absconded with some of the Elemental Runes that Khadgar is looking for.
pairs.text: 在沙塔斯之战的一片混乱中，萨格雷偷偷藏起了卡德加所需的几块元素符文。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde have subjugated a stone fury in Ironfist Harbor. It's got the Elemental Runes Khadgar seeks.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落驯服了一头石怒元素并将它关在了铁拳港。它手里有卡德加所需的元素符文。

pairs.source: The Bladefist clan are capturing pale prisoners. We suspect they're looking for the same Elemental Runes as Khadgar.
pairs.text: 刃拳氏族正在到处搜捕白鬼。我们怀疑他们和卡德加一样，也在寻找那些元素符文。

pairs.source: Elemental Runes have been smuggled into the Iron Siegeworks. Essentially a suicide mission. Send followers you don't like.
pairs.text: 一批元素符文已经被偷运到了钢铁军工厂。想要夺回它们无异于自杀。所以还是派你最讨厌的追随者去吧。

pairs.source: Amethon has been long forgotten, deep in a cave in Talador. His crystals are very valuable.
pairs.text: 艾默松早已被人遗忘在塔拉多幽深的洞穴中。他的水晶非常珍贵。

pairs.source: Gor'thul, betrayer of the Shattered Hand, is an outcast. It is said he has befriended a lot of cats.
pairs.text: 碎手氏族的叛徒戈图尔正在潜逃中。据说他和一群猫交上了朋友。

pairs.source: Nullifier Darkoor has been in hiding long enough. It's time to take him down and put an end to the Fel Breakers once and for all.
pairs.text: 废灵者达库尔已经躲藏得够久了。是时候将他绳之以法，彻底解决这个破魔者了。

pairs.source: Undertow appears from the depths, pulling boats into the sea and destroying our lines of contact between Tanaan Jungle and Shadowmoon Valley.
pairs.text: 逆流从深渊中现身，将船只拖入海底。它正在摧毁我们位于塔纳安丛林和影月谷之间的联络线。

pairs.source: A massive rockworm has taken residence on the shores of Gorgrond, devouring the local lobstroks.
pairs.text: 一只巨型岩虫正盘踞在戈尔隆德的海岸上，吞食当地的龙虾人。

pairs.source: Hemet Nesingwary would be very interested in his head.
pairs.text: 赫米特·奈辛瓦里会对它的脑袋非常感兴趣的。

pairs.source: Reforge the weapon of the most brutal gladiator to fight in the Ring of Blood.
pairs.text: 重铸最野蛮的角斗士的武器，在鲜血之环大打一场。
遗物猎人：古特里克的杀生刀

pairs.source: Claim the power of the arakkoa god before the Adherents of Rukhmar can take it for themselves.
pairs.text: 抢在鲁克玛信徒之前获取鸦人之神的力量。

pairs.source: Destroy the ancient barrier to access this dark and powerful tome.
pairs.text: 摧毁古代屏障，获取这本黑暗而强大的魔典。

pairs.source: Relic Hunter: Grimoire of Nameless Void
pairs.text: 遗物猎人：无名虚空魔典

pairs.source: Seek the blessings of Frostfire to empower the ancient Thunderlord spear.
pairs.text: 寻求霜火岭的祝福，强化古老的雷神长矛。

pairs.source: Take the cursed skull mask from the legendary Laughing Skull assassin.
pairs.text: 从嘲颅氏族的传奇杀手那里夺取被诅咒的颅骨面具。

pairs.source: Recover the ancient crystal shards to restore this mysterious artifact of the draenei.
pairs.text: 找回古老的碎片，修复这件神秘的德莱尼神器。

pairs.source: A strike against the Foundry could cripple the war machinery of the Iron Horde. Our forces await your command.
pairs.text: 突袭铸造厂，摧毁钢铁部落的战争机器。我们的部队在等候你的指令。

pairs.source: Your scouts report that our forces need backup in Frostfire Ridge.
pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在霜火岭的部队需要支援。

pairs.source: Your scouts report that our forces need backup in Spires of Arak.
pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在阿兰卡峰林的部队需要支援。
探查德拉诺：阿兰卡峰林

pairs.source: Your scouts report that our forces need backup in Talador.
pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在塔拉多的部队需要支援。

pairs.source: Your scouts report that our forces need backup in Gorgrond.
pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在戈尔隆德的部队需要支援。

pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在影月谷的部队需要支援。

pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在纳格兰的部队需要支援。

pairs.text: 你的斥候报告说我们在纳格兰的部队需要支援。

pairs.source: The more slaves we free at the Stonefury Cliffs, the more we weaken the Bloodmaul.
pairs.text: 我们从石怒崖救出的奴隶越多，血槌食人魔的力量就越衰落。

pairs.source: Scouts report that a rapid assault on Socrethar's Rise could turn up an additional stash of apexis crystals.
pairs.text: 斥候报告说，现在对索克雷萨高地发起突袭的话，就能搜刮到额外的埃匹希斯水晶。
