pairs.text: 突袭铸造厂，摧毁钢铁部落的战争机器。我们的部队在等候你的指令。

pairs.source: A rare lily grows in the waters of Talador.  Our alchemists say it is many times more efficient than frostweed.
pairs.text: 一种生长在塔拉多水域中的稀有莲花。我们的炼金师说它比寒霜草的效果要强得多。

pairs.source: A disgruntled Bladespire Chef has provided us with a lead on an ancient map hidden in the mines beneath the citadel.
pairs.text: 一位刀塔酋长满不情愿地向我们提供了一条线索，据说堡垒地下的矿井中藏着一张古代地图。

pairs.source: A disgruntled Bladespire Chef has provided us with a lead on an ancient map hidden in the mines beneath the citadel.
pairs.text: 一位刀塔酋长满不情愿地向我们提供了一条线索，据说堡垒地下的矿井中藏着一张古代地图。

pairs.source: A Steamscar saberon has been caught skulking around our walls. If we let him go, he's agreed to sell out a rival shaman who has been mapping the location of many hidden treasures.
pairs.text: 我们抓到了一名潜伏在城墙外的汽痕虎人。他许诺说，如果我们放他走，他就告诉我们一个敌对萨满的下落。据说他绘制了一张包含许多隐秘宝藏的藏宝图。

pairs.source: A farmer claims knowledge of where many of Talador's secrets are hidden, and will share them if we'll help destroy the demons that ruined his land.
pairs.text: 一名农夫声称他知道许多塔拉多秘密宝藏的下落。如果我们帮他消灭破坏他家园的恶魔，他就愿意跟我们分享这些秘密。

pairs.source: Rumors are swirling that a raid on an Outcast hovel has yielded a particularly interesting map. Intercept the arakkoa before they return to Skyreach!
pairs.text: 有传言称，一群洗劫了某个流亡者小屋的强盗得到了一张有趣的地图。趁他们还没回到通天峰，快去拦下这些鸦人吧！

pairs.source: A Warsong elder carrying historical documents important to the clan is communing at the Elemental Plateau. Relieve her of her burdens.
pairs.text: 一名战歌长老正携带着一份对氏族极具历史意义的文件在元素高地活动。快去帮她卸下这份沉重的负担吧。

pairs.source: Ancient carvings in the tombs of the Fortress of Anguish may lead us to discover many secrets in Shadowmoon Valley. We'll have to fight our way in.
pairs.text: 痛楚堡垒内的墓穴上的远古雕刻或许可以让我们发现许多影月谷的秘密。我们必须想办法杀进去。

pairs.source: Ancient carvings in the tombs of the Fortress of Anguish may lead us to discover many secrets in Shadowmoon Valley. We'll have to fight our way in.
pairs.text: 痛楚堡垒内的墓穴上的远古雕刻或许可以让我们发现许多影月谷的秘密。我们必须想办法杀进去。

pairs.source: The Umbrafen swamps have been overgrown by giant fungi for as long as anyone can remember - why are Ogre ruins buried here?
pairs.text: 黯影沼泽从人们有记忆起就生长着无数巨型菌类——这种地方怎么会有食人魔废墟？

pairs.source: The Shadowmoon Clan have interred their dead in this area for generations - find out more about their history.
pairs.text: 影月氏族世世代代都将族中的亡者埋在这个地方——去多了解一下他们的历史吧。

pairs.source: The Thunderlord regard Colossal's Fall as a sacred location, claiming it was their clan who felled this Colossal many decades ago.
pairs.text: 雷神氏族视巨灵之殁为圣地，声称是他们的氏族在许多年前打倒了这个巨人。

pairs.source: Relics of long-forgotten orc clans can be found by carefully traversing between the Daggermaw Flows lava streams - and dealing with deadly fire elementals.
pairs.text: 只要你在刀喉溪的熔岩流中仔细寻找，就能发现失落已久的兽人氏族的遗物——但要小心那些致命的火元素。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde are attempting to unearth long-lost ogre artifacts in the Broken Spine area. Evict them and claim the rewards as your own.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正在破碎之脊挖掘失落已久的食人魔神器——快去赶走他们，将他们的收获据为己有。

pairs.source: The botani have claimed the abandoned ogre fortress at the Overlook Ruins as a new incubator. Stop them before they overgrow all of Gorgrond.
pairs.text: 木精已经将岗哨废墟里废弃的食人魔堡垒当成了新的育苗房。在他们蔓延到整个戈尔隆德之前，快去阻止他们吧。

pairs.source: The outcast arakkoa were forced to abandon much of their written knowledge and history when the high arakkoa attacked Veil Shadar.
pairs.text: 在高阶鸦人攻击沙达尔鸦巢时，鸦人流亡者被迫遗弃了许多手稿和历史文件。

pairs.source: We Will Fight In the Shadar
The ghosts of ogre sorcerers haunt the Ango'rosh ruins, guarding artifacts forgotten by all others.
pairs.text: 食人魔巫师的幽灵在安葛洛什废墟中徘徊，守护着早已被人们遗忘的神器。

pairs.source: The high arakkoa have enslaved their outcast brethren to dig in the apexis excavation site, looking for ancient artifacts. Set the workers free.
pairs.text: 高阶鸦人奴役了自己的流亡者同胞，并驱使他们挖掘这片埃匹希斯挖掘场，寻找古代神器。快去解放那些工人吧。

pairs.source: Many shiny trinkets and precious valuables have been lost in Sethekk Hollow, the place where cursed arakkoa are cast out from Skyreach.
pairs.text: 塞泰克山谷是被诅咒的鸦人被驱逐出通天峰的地方，散落着许多亮晶晶的饰品和珍贵的宝贝。

pairs.source: The Steamwheedle Preservation Society management needs the Stonecrag dig site to be an ogre-free zone before their workers will agree to excavate, and have promised a cut of the proceeds if we help out.
pairs.text: 热砂保护协会的管理层要求肃清岩壁峡谷挖掘场里的食人魔，否则他们的工人就拒绝工作。如果我们肯帮忙，他们愿意分一部分收入给我们。

pairs.source: We've heard reports that the Steamwheedle Preservation Society is looking to start a dig site at the razed Warsong outpost - why wait for them when you can claim the easy finds now?
pairs.text: 我们收到报告说，热砂保护协会在废弃的战歌岗哨开辟了一个新的挖掘场。既然有现成的便宜可捡，干嘛还要等他们来动手呢？

pairs.source: The ancient communal site of Oshu'gun holds offerings from various orc clans. If not for the murderous void elementals unleashed by the pale, it would be a nice place to visit.
pairs.text: 沃舒古古老的集会广场下埋藏着许多来自不同兽人氏族的贡品。要不是白鬼放出的致命虚空元素，也不失为一个值得一去的地方。

pairs.source: A monstrous beast roams the Murkbog.  Our alchemists say they can harvest it for a bounty of alchemy supplies.
pairs.text: 一头怪兽正在阴郁沼泽中游荡。我们的炼金师说它的身上可以采集到大量炼金材料。

pairs.source: Scavengers gnaw and pick at the fallen.  Kill them so we can do some scavenging of our own.
pairs.text: 食腐鸟正在啄食那些死者。快去干掉它们，以便我们自己回收一些物资。

pairs.source: Blacksmiths know that furies can be harvested for the best flux.  Snuff the fires and bring it home.
pairs.text: 铁匠们说那些元素之怒身上可以采集到最优质的助熔剂。快去熄灭它们的烈焰，把它们带回家。

pairs.source: The Shadowmoon clan possess weaponry we can harness for raw magic.  Raid their encampment and collect their enchanted weapons.
pairs.text: 我们可以使用影月氏族的武器来驾驭原始的魔力。快去突袭他们的营地，收集一些附魔武器回来。

pairs.source: Ogre are known to possess massive, thick, and long swords.  Disenchanting them makes a tremendous amount of dust.
pairs.text: 食人魔那巨大、沉重的长剑久负盛名。将这些武器分解可以得到大量魔法尘。

pairs.source: Our engineers are excited about tearing apart a siege engine for parts.  Let's take one down and let them have their fun.
pairs.text: 我们的工程师最喜欢将攻城武器拆成零件了。快去弄一架回来让他们过过瘾吧。

pairs.source: The pale are expert scavengers.  Let's relieve them of some of that salvage.
pairs.text: 白鬼都是专业拾荒者。让我们帮他们分担一些战利品吧。

pairs.source: The arakkoa decorate their weapons and armor with fantastic jewels.  Acquire them and let our jewelcrafters cut them into something useful.
pairs.text: 鸦人喜欢用名贵的宝石装点自己的武器和护甲。快去弄点回来，让我们的珠宝匠把它们制作成有用的东西吧。

pairs.source: Apparently the goren can't digest the valuable gems they eat.  Your mission should be clear.
pairs.text: 显然鬣蜥人消化不了它们吞下的那些珍贵宝石，所以你的任务已经很明确了。

pairs.source: If we can decipher some stolen iron horde documents, we can find and assassinate their scouts.
pairs.text: 如果我们能解密偷来的钢铁部落文件，就可以找到并干掉他们的斥候了。

pairs.source: It's time to make some changes to the Iron Horde's orders.  If we can kill the guards, we can rewrite history before it happens.
pairs.text: 是时候篡改一下钢铁部落的指令了。如果能干掉那些守卫，我们就能改写历史。

pairs.source: There's some rather large clefthoof in Nagrand.  Let's take one down before they are killed by trappers.
pairs.text: 纳格兰有一些特别巨大的裂蹄牛。趁它们没被陷阱捕杀殆尽之前，快去抓一头来吧。

pairs.source: Iron Horde tents are made from rugged leather that can be crafted into fine leather armor.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的帐篷都是用结实的皮革制成的。我们可以把它们做成优质的皮甲。

pairs.source: Rylak's collect an immense amount of fur when building their nests.  Raid a nest and recover the fur.
pairs.text: 双头飞龙在筑巢时会收集大量兽毛。快去突袭它们的巢穴，把那些兽毛带回来。

pairs.source: The garn are primarily known for their ferocity, but they are only slightly lesser well known for their sumptuous furry pelts.
pairs.text: 铁颚狼以凶猛著称，但它们华美的毛皮也同样久负盛名。

pairs.source: Our need for equipment upgrades never ends, take a few of our best to the apexis excavation site.
pairs.text: 我们升级装备的需求是永无止境的，带上我们最精锐的战士，去埃匹希斯挖掘场吧。

pairs.source: We'll leave the elementals of Nagrand to themselves right after we've gotten some of the elemental samples we need.
pairs.text: 只要采集到足够的元素样本，我们就不用再打扰纳格兰的元素生物了。

pairs.source: Head to neutral ground at the Ring of Trials and learn a thing or two about fighting alongside ogres.
pairs.text: 前往试炼竞技场的中立地带，和食人魔一起战斗，学一学他们的战斗技巧吧。

pairs.source: As we have a number of arakkoa allies, let's run some joint operations to build relations.
pairs.text: 我们有不少鸦人盟友，为了增进双方的友谊，让我们来搞几次联合行动吧。

pairs.source: With the installation of a negatronic control unit, a true emotional bond between lifeform and machine can happen!  Get one!
pairs.text: 在安装了负电子控制单元后，生命体和机械之间就能建立起真正的感情！快去弄一个来！

pairs.source: The saberon have highly developed rituals and customs.  Live among them, learn their ways, and gain strength from this experience.
pairs.text: 刃牙虎人有着高度成熟的宗教仪式和社会风俗。去和他们生活一段时间，学习他们的处世之道，并从中汲取力量吧。

pairs.source: We need someone to document the devastation taking place here on Draenor. Head to Nagrand and photograph all you can.
pairs.text: 我们需要有人记录下德拉诺发生的灾难。快去纳格兰尽你所能地拍摄下一切吧。

pairs.source: Your photos turned out great, but now we need some more creative shots. Head back out to the field and see what you can do!
pairs.text: 你的照片确实很出色，但现在我们需要更有创意的照片。快回到野外去，看看你有什么想法吧！

pairs.source: You will find Yozshura the Blademaster atop Mount Volwrath.  Seek his wisdom, challenge him, and return enlightened.
pairs.text: 你必须去沃尔拉斯山顶找剑圣姚素莱，挑战他，聆听他的教诲，得到启迪后再回来。

pairs.source: The troops are hungry, go pick up a few pies.
An Iron Horde submarine is making a break for our shipyard.  Take it out.
pairs.text: 一艘钢铁部落的潜水艇闯入了我们的船坞，快去击沉它。

pairs.source: We need to find more paladin allies if we are to have any hope of bringing the fight to the Legion.
pairs.text: 想要与军团有一战之力，我们需要找到更多的圣骑士盟友。

pairs.source: There have been sightings of Legion scouts in the skies above the forest canopy.
pairs.text: 有人在这座森林的上空目击到了军团的侦察部队。

pairs.source: An ancient scroll in our archives describes a Titan communicator somewhere in Val'Sharah that could provide us with invaluable knowledge.
pairs.text: 据一枚古代卷轴记载，瓦尔莎拉的森林某处藏着一个泰坦通讯器，它能带给我们无价的知识。

pairs.source: The Horde have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through and you can raid the Horde navy.
pairs.text: 部落在他们的要塞附近部下了封锁线。冲破它，你就能狠狠蹂躏部落的海军了。

pairs.source: The Horde have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through and you can raid the Horde navy.
pairs.text: 部落封鎖了他們要塞週遭的海域。突破他們的封鎖線，襲擊部落的海軍船艦。

pairs.source: Assault the Iron Horde defense in the Barrier Sea to unlock access to the waters around Tanaan.  Success grants access to Hellfire Citadel naval missions.
pairs.text: 攻破钢铁部落位于隔绝之海的防线，打开进入塔纳安周围水域的通道，从而开启地狱火堡垒的海军行动。

pairs.source: The Alliance have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through to raid and plunder.
pairs.text: 联盟在他们的要塞附近部下了封锁线。冲破它，好好教训一下那些家伙。

pairs.source: Push the Iron Horde out of the South Seas by defeating their blockade.  Success grants access to the primal resources around Nagrand.
pairs.text: 攻破钢铁部落的封锁线，将他们赶出南海，获取纳格兰的原生资源。

pairs.source: Now that our ships are more equipped, re-engage the enemy.  It's lurking in the same area.
pairs.text: 现在我们的舰船装备更精良了，再去见见老对手吧。它还是在老地方等着。

pairs.source: The Second Time is the Charm
Now that our ships are more equipped, re-engage the enemy.  It's lurking in the same area.
pairs.text: 现在我们的舰船装备更精良了，再去见见老对手吧。它还是在老地方等着。

pairs.source: The Second Time is the Charm
You've never lived until you've taken down an enemy vessel while you're both flirting with watery disaster.
pairs.text: 不在海难中顺手干掉一艘敌船，你都不好意思说自己出过海。

pairs.source: These destroyers plan to shell a Laughing Skull village near the Iron Docks. It's our closest foothold against the Iron Horde. We can't lose it.
pairs.text: 这些驱逐舰打算去攻击钢铁码头附近的一座嘲颅村庄。那是我们对抗钢铁部落的前线阵地，我们决不能失去它。

pairs.source: We designed submarines specifically to sneak up on unsuspecting carriers.  We've set up a carrier in the reef for you to practice.
pairs.text: 为了偷袭毫无防备的航母，我们特意设计出了潜水艇。我们已经在暗礁区准备了一艘航母供你练手。

pairs.source: We've set up submarines at different depths in Frostfire Bay.  Take a destroyer out and train them in the art of sub hunting.
pairs.text: 我们在霜火海湾的不同水深处准备了好几艘潜水艇。开上你的驱逐舰，去练习一下猎杀潜水艇的本领吧。
精确调整过的深水炸弹

pairs.source: Although goren infest the Molten Quarry, iron ore is plentiful there. So are Alliance scum. Don't let that destroyer secure their grip on the area.
pairs.text: 虽然熔岩采石场里鬣蜥人肆虐，但那里的铁矿石依然相当充足。可是那里的联盟渣滓也不少。别让那艘驱逐舰帮助他们霸占了那片区域。

pairs.source: Demons and Shadow Council agents have overrun much of Shattrath. Even so, we will keep fighting. We shall not yield while the Alliance still stands.
pairs.text: 恶魔和暗影议会的探子已经攻占了沙塔斯的大部分区域。即使如此，我们仍然要坚持战斗。只要联盟不垮，我们就绝不投降。

pairs.source: We've heard rumors of a powerful new demon presence in Faronaar. We should investigate before it threatens our hold on the area.
pairs.text: 听说有一个强大的新恶魔出现在了法罗纳尔。我们有必要去调查一下，以免它威胁到了我们对那个区域的控制力。

pairs.source: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Azsuna. We should find it.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的某处有一座强大的圣光信标。我们得找到它。

pairs.source: Senegos' prime consort has sent out a cry for help. We owe it to our allies to send aid.
pairs.text: 塞纳苟斯的配偶来找我们求助。我们有必要派出盟友，报答他们的恩情。
阿苏纳 - 肯瑞托海滩

pairs.source: Iron Horde forces have been harvesting potent toxins in the Writhing Mire and using them in combat. Now they're shipping a batch of toxins north.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落在蜿蜒泥沼采集到了强效毒液并将其用于战斗。眼下他们正打算将一批毒液运往北方。

pairs.source: This sub just limped back home for repairs, only to find the harbor nearly deserted. Finish off the sub while we keep the enemy busy elsewhere.
pairs.text: 这艘潜水艇好不容易才返回基地准备修缮，却发现港口已经几近废弃。我们来拖住其他地方的敌人，你去干掉那艘潜艇。

pairs.source: These two vessels are heading south in a hurricane. Even Hellscream wouldn't have sent them out unless their mission was dire. We must intercept them.
pairs.text: 这两艘船正顶着飓风驶向南方。如果不是有紧急任务的话，就算是疯狂如地狱咆哮也不会派它们出来的。我们必须拦下它们。

pairs.source: Rumor has it a cargo fleet recently sank out here, far from land. Unfortunately we're not the only ones who've heard this rumor.
pairs.text: 有小道消息称，一支运输舰队不久前在这片远离陆地的水域沉没。遗憾的是，我们不是唯一收到消息的人。

pairs.source: Surely these vessels are just ferrying bird enthusiasts to the bay. Not beast tamers who plan to enslave its massive hydras for the Iron Horde. Surely.
pairs.text: 毫无疑问，这些驶向海湾的船上搭载的都是热心的鸟类爱好者，而不是为钢铁部落奴役多头蛇的驯兽师。毫无疑问。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde uses subs to transport gold up and down the western coast. Taking one out would hit Hellscream's pocket and fill our coffers.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正使用潜水艇在西海岸来回运送黄金。只要击沉一艘潜艇，就能重创地狱咆哮的经济，顺便让我们赚得盆满钵满。

pairs.source: This enemy sub is loaded with gold, so it can't outrun us. Instead, it's been hiding out between a rocky shoal and a whirlpool, hoping to lure us to our doom.
pairs.text: 这艘敌方潜水艇装满了黄金，所以肯定跑不过我们。它躲进了一片暗礁与漩涡之间，企图将我们诱入绝境。

pairs.source: A damaged engine has crippled a destroyer far from shore. That's what happens when you only value warriors and plunder. Not that the gold should go waste.
pairs.text: 在远离海岸的大洋深处，有一艘驱逐舰因为引擎损坏而抛锚了。谁要是一味重视战士和战利品，这种事就是难免的啦。但那些黄金可不能浪费了。

pairs.source: While mutineers were seizing this destroyer, storms broke out, and a whirlpool ensnared the ship. That's bad luck. And thanks to us, it's about to get worse.
pairs.text: 叛徒们刚刚控制了这艘驱逐舰，风暴就来了，巨大的漩涡困住了这艘船。这可真不走运。有我们在，他们还会更加倒霉的。

pairs.source: In this poor weather, Hellscream has sent subs to harry our fleet. Act decisively so that they never again see the light of day.
pairs.text: 在这种糟糕的天气下，地狱咆哮还派出潜艇来骚扰我们的舰队。我们应该果断出击，决不能让他们有重见天日的机会。

pairs.source: Enemy destroyers are terrorizing the waters west of the Spires of Arak. Crushing them won't restore the lives that've been lost, but it'd be a good start.
pairs.text: 敌方驱逐舰正在阿兰卡峰林西边的海域耀武扬威。虽然干掉他们也无法挽回逝去的生命，但这起码是一个好的开始。

pairs.source: With no wind and a ripped mainsail, an enemy carrier has slowed to a crawl, along with its escorts. Make sure their troops and cargo never make landfall.
pairs.text: 由于风力不足且风帆破损，一艘敌方航母正在护航舰队的掩护下缓慢前行。我们决不能让他们的部队和物资登陆。

pairs.source: Enemy subs have taken a sudden interest in this area. They may be tracking down an elemental rune. In the wrong hands, it could prove devastating.
pairs.text: 敌方潜艇突然对这一区域表现出了莫大的兴趣。他们可能是在搜寻一块元素符文。一旦让它落入坏人手中，可能会造成毁灭性的后果。

pairs.source: Storms have broken out around the Ancestral Grounds. The enemy vessel off the coast may be to blame. Also the fact that most shaman loathe the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 先祖之地周围发生了风暴。这可能是沿海的敌方船只搞的鬼，难怪大部分萨满都很讨厌钢铁部落。

pairs.source: Evidently Hellscream thought subs might be a safer way to transport elemental runes. Safer, yes. Sneaky, no.
pairs.text: 显然，地狱咆哮认为用潜艇运送元素符文会更加未必。要我说的话，这确实更安全，但也并不出人意料。

pairs.source: Hellscream should realize by now that the elements won't willingly serve the Iron Horde. And trying to compel their obedience is unwise.
pairs.text: 地狱咆哮现在应该已经明白了，元素是不会甘愿臣服于钢铁部落的。强迫它们屈服的做法并不明智。

pairs.source: Lately the Iron Horde has been gathering magical items. They've learned brute force can't solve everything. Remind them it still has its uses.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落最近一直在收集魔法物品。他们已经明白暴力并不能解决一切问题。快去提醒他们一下，暴力有时候还是很有用的。

pairs.source: A shipment of abrogator stones is on its way to Grommashar. We must intercept it. The Iron Horde is trouble enough without a bunch of magical gems.
pairs.text: 一批消魔之石正被运往格罗玛什尔。我们必须进行拦截。就算没有这批魔法宝石，钢铁部落也已经够麻烦的了。

pairs.source: An enemy carrier has veered off course, and it's emanating powerful magic. Something odd is afoot. Find out what. More importantly, claim that magic.
pairs.text: 一艘敌方战列舰偏离了航线，并不断释放出强大的魔力。这其中必有古怪。快去调查一下。最重要的是，把那种魔力弄回来。

pairs.source: Several magi and their schooner have been taken into the Iron Horde's "protection". Rescue the magi. Their gratitude could pay well.
pairs.text: 一些法师和他们的帆船受到了钢铁部落的“保护”。去救出那些法师。他们的感谢一定会物有所值。

pairs.source: Iron Horde vessels are often attacked by lobstrok here, and so Hellscream means to slay their matriarch. Coming to her aid would be in our best interests.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的船只常在这里遭到龙虾人的袭击，因此地狱咆哮想要干掉他们的首领。去帮助她才是最符合我们利益的做法。

pairs.source: Northwest of Talador, offshore, is an unyielding rock vise called the Colossal's Fist. The Iron Horde hasn't yet discovered it. Arrange an introduction.
pairs.text: 塔拉多西北方的海域里有一块坚固的岛礁，叫做巨人之拳。钢铁部落还没有发现它。快去了解一下吧。

pairs.source: Captain Ironbeard is a deadly menace on the seas, but he's obsessed with a kraken that doesn't exist. Distract him and then launch a sneak attack.
pairs.text: 铁须船长是这片海域上的一大祸害，可他沉迷于某个子虚乌有的海怪传说。快去分散他的注意力，然后发动一次偷袭吧。

pairs.source: Shattered Hand forces just dispatched these vessels, which headed straight into a storm. Their recklessness will work to our advantage.
pairs.text: 碎手氏族的部队刚刚派出了这些船只，头也不回地冲进了暴风雨中。他们的鲁莽对我们来说可是好事。

pairs.source: Subtlety isn't really Hellscream's strong suit. Probably these ships thought the mountains would hide their approach.
pairs.text: 偷偷摸摸并不是地狱咆哮的强项。这些潜水艇大概以为群山的阴影能掩护它们靠近。

pairs.source: So what if they're nowhere near Horde or Alliance waters? Sooner or later, they will be.
pairs.text: 要是它们能在部落或联盟的水域里完全绝迹该多好？这是迟早的事。

pairs.source: These ships were loaded with containers of raw fel before they left Ironhold Harbor. Wherever they're headed, we must destroy them and their deathly cargo.
pairs.text: 这些舰船在离开铁城港前装满了未经加工的邪能。无论它们要去哪里，我们都得摧毁它们以及那些致命的货物。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde keeps sending fresh workers and supplies to the Dark Portal. Should we take pity and let their ships through so they can rebuild it? No.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落正源源不断地向黑暗之门运送工人和补给品。我们会大发慈悲让他们的船过去，好让他们完成重建工作吗？显然不会。

pairs.source: These bastards have been playing tag with our forces, landing hits on our forces, only to evade our counterattacks. It's hurting our troops and their morale.
pairs.text: 这些混蛋一直在跟我们的部队捉迷藏，不断偷袭，躲避反击。这不但会造成伤亡，更会打击士气。

pairs.source: Kilrogg Deadeye has made his choice. Now his Bleeding Hollow orcs travel to Hellfire Citadel and return to Tanaan empowered by demonic blood.
pairs.text: 基尔罗格·死眼已经做出的选择。现在，他的血环兽人正在前往地狱火堡垒，他们将在接受恶魔之血的强化后返回塔纳安。

pairs.source: Kilrogg Deadeye has made his choice. Now his Bleeding Hollow orcs travel to Hellfire Citadel and return to Tanaan empowered by demonic blood.
pairs.text: 基爾羅格‧亡眼做出了決定，他手下的血之谷獸人都在地獄火堡壘接受了惡魔之血的強化，然後回到塔南森林待命。

pairs.source: Hellscream has posted a sub near the Horde's main base on Ashran. Take that sub out. Alliance, that means you, too. Factional hatreds have no place here.
pairs.text: 地狱咆哮在部落位于阿什兰的主基地附近布置了一艘潜水艇。去击沉它。虽然你是联盟，但也责无旁贷。相比大局，阵营仇恨就显得无足轻重了。

pairs.source: Iron Horde forces have landed in Tangleheart, endangering its rich soil and plentiful timber. Also its powerful ancients. Who were already pretty angry.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的部队已经登陆了丛林之心，威胁到了那里肥沃的土地和丰富的木材资源，以及那些强大的古树。它们已经非常愤怒了。

pairs.source: If a Tree Falls in the Forest
These ships are about to leave Ironhold Harbor. They're probably still hung over from last-minute partying. They're certainly not expecting a fight.
pairs.text: 这些舰船即将离开铁城港。趁他们还宿醉未醒，快去打他们一个措手不及吧。

pairs.source: A Ship in Harbor Is Safe, But...
An enemy carrier has seized control of the Darktide Strait. Losing that waterway would hurt Horde shipping concerns worldwide. Our course is clear.
pairs.text: 一艘敌方航母控制了黑潮海峡。一旦失去那条航道，就会危及部落在全世界的航运业。我们的目标已经很清楚了。

pairs.source: A true warrior would only hunt a sub in bad weather. Barefoot. In arctic waters. Against the current. Both ways.
pairs.text: 真的勇士就要在坏天气里猎杀潜水艇，脚踩冰水，搏击激流，一样都不能少。

pairs.source: Outmanned thirty to one. Alliance weaklings would call this a risky fight. In the Horde, we call it a target-rich environment.
pairs.text: 一挑三十！联盟的懦夫会管这叫冒险。但在部落，我们管这叫目标充裕！

pairs.source: Battleship counters destroyer, but carrier counters battleship. Sub counters carrier, but destroyer counters sub. In short, luck will decide this fight.
pairs.text: 战列舰克制驱逐舰，航母克制战列舰，潜水艇克制航母，而驱逐舰又克制潜水艇。总而言之，这将是一场由运气主宰的战斗。
运气也是实力的一部分

pairs.source: The city of Elodor houses the draenei's leaders, who are allied with the Alliance. Teach both groups a lesson: seize one of their gold shipments.
pairs.text: 与联盟结盟的德莱尼首领就住在艾洛多尔的市区里。去给他们一个教训吧：抢走他们运送的一批黄金。

pairs.source: The so-called dragons living here are fragile mounts, but foolish draenei pay well for them. Divert their latest cargo of gold to a better cause: ours.
pairs.text: 生活在这里的所谓“飞龙”作为坐骑极其脆弱，但愚蠢的德莱尼却肯花大价钱来购买它们。去把他们最近运来的那批黄金抢过来。在我们手里，它们可以更好地发挥作用。

pairs.source: When Alliance forces sailed to Shadowmoon, their ship arrived intact. Maybe draenei aren't as cursed as we thought. Maybe they even brought gold with them.
pairs.text: 当联盟部队驶向影月谷时，他们的船只都安然到港了。或许德莱尼也没我们想的那么该死。没准他们船上还带着黄金呢。

pairs.source: The mail armor in this vessel's cargo hold will serve us well once we spice it up a bit.
pairs.text: 只要稍加改装，这艘船运送的锁甲就能为我们所用了。

pairs.source: This vessel is taking a cargo full of leather armor to Alliance fighters in Zeth'Kur. Leather shouldn't be wasted on them. Isn't lace more their thing?
pairs.text: 这艘船上装满了给联盟在泽库尔的战士配备的皮甲。好皮子可不能浪费在他们身上。他们更适合蕾丝，对吧？

pairs.source: This Alliance carrier is heading for Stormshield with fresh troops and supplies. But it's a long journey between Shadowmoon Valley and Ashran.
pairs.text: 这艘驶向暴风之盾的航母上满载着生力军和补给品。但从影月谷到阿什兰的航路可不短。

pairs.source: Cowardly Alliance dogs have begun targeting our carriers even when they are far from Shadowmoon waters. Show them what a true threat looks like.
pairs.text: 联盟的胆小鬼盯上了我们的航母，即使远离影月谷的水域也不能摆脱他们的骚扰。去让他们见识一下真正的威胁吧。

pairs.source: The waters around Shadowmoon Valley are regularly patrolled by Alliance subs, but these two are far from shore. They look lonely. Let's send them company.
pairs.text: 影月谷周边的水域都有联盟潜艇定期巡航，但这两艘离海岸太远了。他们看起来很寂寞，我们去给他们做个伴吧。

pairs.source: If we steal Alliance-bound boots, and a barefoot Alliance mage trips and dies, would that count as a Horde victory? Why, yes. Plus, hey, new boots.
pairs.text: 要是我们偷走这批运往联盟的靴子，让光脚的联盟法师绊倒摔死，这算不算是部落的胜利呢？而且，那些可是新靴子。

pairs.source: Horde vessels wanted for Alliance raid. Must love plunder and long walks on the beach. High tolerance for the colors blue and violet a plus.
pairs.text: 部落的船只正盼着联盟来袭呢。他们肯定很喜欢抢夺战利品，以及海滩上的漫步。他们对蓝色和紫色的忍耐度可是很高的。

pairs.source: Alliance forces in Shadowmoon have an easy life. Lush forests, mild weather, supply shipments... maybe even fresh bacon. Make those bastards pay.
pairs.text: 影月谷的联盟部队过得太舒坦了。繁茂的森林，温和的气候，充足的补给……没准还有新鲜的培根。快去让那些混蛋付出代价吧。

pairs.source: The Earthen Ring kindly requests that all plundered mail armor be divided equally among those who wear it. Otherwise, the elements might become displeased.
pairs.text: 大地之环善意地要求我们将抢来的锁甲平均分配。否则，元素可是会不高兴的。

pairs.source: A shipment of tailored goods from Shadowmoon Valley is headed for our enemies in Stormshield. Intercept it, and share in the spoils.
pairs.text: 一船来自影月谷的裁缝产品正驶向暴风之盾。拦下它，把战利品分了。

pairs.source: Draenei-crafted plate is just as sturdy as Horde-crafted plate. Tell your soldiers they will seize and wear this cargo, or they will go naked into battle.
pairs.text: 德莱尼制造的板甲跟部落的产品一样坚固。告诉你的士兵们，去把这批货抢来自用，否则就让他们光着身子上战场。

pairs.source: Another day, another Alliance shipment to Ashran. Are they trying to be stealthy, heading so far east before circling back to Stormshield? Pathetic.
pairs.text: 新的一天，新一批的联盟货物也将运往阿什兰了。他们以为往东边绕了那么大一个圈子，就能偷偷把东西运回暴风之盾了吗？可怜虫。

pairs.source: An enemy carrier guards the channel entrance. If we take it out, we can storm Scuttler's Coast to the north, and cut off Alliance shipments to the south.
pairs.text: 一艘敌方航母守住了海峡入口。如果我们干掉它的话，就能突袭北边的沙蟹海滩，切断联盟通向南方的补给线了。

pairs.source: With Archmage Khadgar elsewhere on business, an enemy vessel has secured the eastern passage into Zangarra. They expect a fight. Let's not disappoint them.
pairs.text: 趁着大法师卡德加分身乏术，一艘敌方船只守住了进入赞加拉的东部航道。他们在期待战斗，我们可不能让他们失望。

pairs.source: This vessel is carrying plenty of plate armor; Alliance soldiers just happen to be wearing it. Why are you letting Alliance scum wear your armor?
pairs.text: 这艘船上运载了大量板甲；这都是准备送给联盟士兵去穿的。干嘛要让联盟的渣滓穿你们的盔甲呢？

pairs.source: This destroyer looks to be disabled far from land. But our scouts report this is just an act: a submarine is circling in the waters below.
pairs.text: 这艘驱逐舰似乎是在远离陆地的海面上抛锚了。但我们的斥候报告说这只是假象：在这艘驱逐舰周围的水面下，还有一艘潜水艇在盘旋着。

pairs.source: These radiant and perilous waters absorbed their magical properties from precious stones lining the sea floor. Such a gem would make a powerful necklace.
pairs.text: 这些具有辐射的危险水结晶吸收了珍贵的海底宝石的魔法成分。这块宝石可以制作出一条强大的项链。

pairs.source: The name sounds peaceful, but your crew should bring gas masks. The atmosphere here tends to be toxic, which is doubtless why the Horde sent a sub.
pairs.text: 虽然这个地名听起来祥和，可你的船员去那里时最好带上防毒面具。那里的空气可能有毒，显然这就是部落派出潜艇的原因。

pairs.source: Frostboar Point is tactically worthless; it hardly merits a carrier patrol. Somehow the Horde has discovered our plans to export the area's boars.
pairs.text: 霜彘海礁毫无战略价值，根本不值得出动航母巡视。但部落发现了我们出口本地野猪的计划，情况就不一样了。

pairs.source: The orcs who named the Coldsnap Coast didn't mean that its weather was a temporary cold spell. They meant the cold would snap most people in two.
pairs.text: 给极寒大陆架命名的兽人已经表明，那里的气候并不是周期性的降温，而是常年都处在能冻掉你下巴的状态下。

pairs.source: Bloodmaul ogres live here alongside their ogron masters, who constantly hammer the ground with boulders. All in all, it's a fun getaway spot.
pairs.text: 这里的血槌食人魔和他们的独眼魔主子生活在一起。后者正日夜用巨石锤打大地。总之，这会是一个不错的度假休闲之所。

pairs.source: Frostangler Bay is a virtual cornucopia of disgusting-looking marine life. But it's palatable enough if you cook it properly. Bring back a fat haul.
pairs.text: 霜钓海湾充斥着各种样子恶心的海洋生物。但只要你烹制得当，它们都非常美味。快去捞一批水产回来吧。

pairs.source: Horde forces plan to attack the Icescar Boneyard. If they fail, their deaths will only fuel the Shadow Council's foul sorcery. Stop the Horde, whatever it takes.
pairs.text: 部落部队计划攻击冰痕坟场。如果他们失败了，遇难者就会成为暗影议会的邪恶巫术的能量来源。我们要不惜一切代价阻止部落。

pairs.source: Several races on Draenor offer excellent pay for these giant mushrooms. That said, the shortsighted Horde will quickly wipe them out if we don't intervene.
pairs.text: 德拉诺的一些种族愿意为那些大蘑菇出大价钱。也就是说，如果我们不插手的话，短视的部落很快就会将它们一扫而空的。

pairs.source: Yes, it's constantly snowing here, but it also has volcanic activity. No, it's never a comfortable temperature. Look, you're not going ashore anyway.
pairs.text: 是的，这里终年下雪，但也有火山活动。不，这里从来都不存在什么宜人的气候。看，你都不肯上岸了吧。

pairs.source: This far north, Horde forces seem to think themselves safe from our ships. But then thinking never was their strong suit.
pairs.text: 在这遥远的北方，部落部队似乎以为自己已经摆脱我们的舰船了。但思考从来都不是他们的强项。

pairs.source: Battleship counters destroyer, but carrier counters battleship. Sub counters carrier, but destroyer counters sub. Thus, skill will be this fight's deciding factor.
pairs.text: 战列舰克制驱逐舰，航母克制战列舰，潜水艇克制航母，而驱逐舰又克制潜水艇。因此，技战术将成为这场战斗的决定因素。

pairs.source: Driven by bloodlust, orc animals target our carriers even when they're far from Frostfire waters. We won't meekly endure this aggression. Strike back.
pairs.text: 在嗜血欲望的驱使下，兽人畜生们盯上了我们的航母，即使是远离霜火岭水域的也不放过。面对这种挑衅，我们是不会逆来顺受的。我们要反击。

pairs.source: Stop complaining. You never know: they might not smell that bad.
pairs.text: 别抱怨了。谁知道呢，没准它们也没有那么臭呢。

pairs.source: Our spies have noted regular supply shipments to Wor'gol via the Southwind Cliffs. The Horde hasn't noted our noting them. We've noted that, too.
pairs.text: 我们的间谍发现，有船只通过南风崖定期向沃高尔运送补给。我们还发现，部落还没有发现我们已经发现了这个秘密。

pairs.source: These Horde vessels are rounding Highmaul on their way north. If ogres don't seize their cargo of plate armor, it will soon outfit our enemies. Stop them.
pairs.text: 这些部落船只正绕过悬槌堡前往北方。如果他们运送的板甲没有被食人魔劫走，那么很快就会出现在我们的敌人身上了。快去阻止他们。

pairs.source: When Horde forces sailed to Frostfire, their ship arrived mostly intact. Perhaps orcs aren't witless brutes. Unless they left behind valuable cargo.
pairs.text: 部落军队驶向霜火岭时，他们的船只几乎是完好无损地抵达了目的地。兽人或许并不是没脑子的莽夫，虽然他们还是丢下了许多值钱的货物。

pairs.source: Pretend you're getting them from a big brother or sister. But give them a thorough scrubbing before you put them on. Just in case.
pairs.text: 你就把它们当成是你的哥哥或姐姐穿剩下的吧。不过在穿之前，你最好还是把它们彻底洗一洗，以防万一。

pairs.source: The orcs of Throm'var are supplying the Horde with fine furs and supple leather. Such a pity they'll be used to garb our boorish foes.
pairs.text: 索姆瓦尔的兽人正源源不断地向部落输送优质的毛皮和上好的皮革。让我们那些粗鲁的敌人来穿它们真是太糟蹋东西了。

pairs.source: These battleships are so overburdened with cargo, their sailors hardly need to swab the decks. Teach them the value of caution, and lighten their load.
pairs.text: 这些战列舰上装满了货物，船上的水手连擦洗甲板的活儿都省了。快去教教他们保持警惕的重要性，顺便帮他们减轻点负担吧。

pairs.source: Hellscream's forces have recently grown scarce along the Orunai Coast. Now the Horde dares to use it as drop-off point for cargo.
pairs.text: 最近，奥鲁纳海岸的地狱咆哮部队越来越少了。如今，部落已经大着胆子把那里当成卸货点了。

pairs.source: Take out that enemy supply ship, but act quickly if anyone goes overboard. The orcs don't call it Frostbite Deep for nothing.
pairs.text: 干掉那艘敌方的补给船，但行动一定要快，以防有人狗急跳墙。霜冻深渊这个名字可不是随便叫叫的。

pairs.source: Procuring quality leather can be tedious, but the Horde plans to shell the hydras here and skin them. Exhausting work. Perfect setup for a lucrative win.
pairs.text: 获取高品质皮革的过程是很乏味的，但部落计划剥制这里的多头蛇皮革。这个活儿可不轻松，我们正好来个黄雀在后，赚它个盆满钵满。

pairs.source: Shipments for Wor'gol must first pass through the Pale Cove's treacherous currents and jagged rocks. That will be the perfect time for us to strike.
pairs.text: 驶向沃高尔的补给船必须首先通过苍白海湾的复杂洋流及嶙峋暗礁。我们正好趁机突袭。

pairs.source: Orcish cloth armor is just as soft and comfortable as ours. Tell your magi they will seize and wear this cargo. No exceptions, gnomes. Make it work.
pairs.text: 兽人的布甲跟我们的一样柔软舒适。告诉你的法师，他们必须弄到这批货物，那就是他们的装备。没有例外，侏儒也得穿。快动手吧。

pairs.source: A Horde warrior bound for Frostfire Ridge clumsily dropped a magic necklace overboard. Put him and his vessel out of their misery.
pairs.text: 一位前往霜火岭的部落战士不小心在船上丢下了一条魔法项链。快去帮他和他的船解脱吧。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde swooped in when they identified a rogue submarine closing in on their stronghold.  Unfortunately for them, it was just a riverbeast.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落发现了一艘偷偷靠近他们堡垒的潜水艇，就迫不及待地扑了上去。遗憾的是，那只是一只淡水兽。

pairs.source: It's a Boat, It's a Plane, It's... Just a Riverbeast.
The deep waters of Draenor's oceans have seen many deaths and precious little peace. This ship and its crew are doomed to wander the seas for eternity.
pairs.text: 德拉诺的深海见证过无数死亡以及珍贵而短暂的安宁。这艘船和它的船员注定要在大海上永世徘徊。

pairs.source: This ghost ship lies in wait, attacking unwary sailors who approach the treacherous shoals off Gorgrond's eastern coast.
pairs.text: 这艘幽灵船静静潜伏着，准备攻击一切靠近戈尔隆德东海岸浅滩的水手。

pairs.source: Seizing a fortune proved this destroyer's undoing. Its crew turned on each other, only to become cursed ghosts, unable to spend the gold they gave their lives for.
pairs.text: 巨额的财富反而导致了这艘驱逐舰的灭亡。船员们自相残杀，最后变成被诅咒的幽灵，再也没法花用他们拿命换来的黄金了。

pairs.source: A young shark has been abandoned in a storm off the coast of Nagrand.  Defend it from the Iron Horde and it will likely follow you home.
pairs.text: 纳格兰的沿海出现了一条被遗弃的小鲨鱼。别让钢铁部落抓走它，它或许会愿意跟你回家。

pairs.source: Uncharted waters proved deadly to these sailors, who still roam the area as murderous ghosts. That said, they were well paid before their deaths.
pairs.text: 未知的海域对这些水手来说显然是致命的，如今他们已化身凶残的幽灵，在这一带游荡。据说，他们在死前都是富翁。

pairs.source: On the one hand, great riches. On the other hand, furious walking corpses. Oh, come now. We all know what choice you're going to make.
pairs.text: 一边是巨额的财富，一边是凶猛的行尸。噢，来吧，我们都知道你会同意的。

pairs.source: Sabotaged by spies, these carriers sank on their way to battle. Denied a glorious death in battle, their ghostly crews sink other ships out of bitterness.
pairs.text: 由于间谍的破坏，这些航母在开赴战场的途中沉没了。因为没能光荣地战死沙场，船上不甘的幽灵水手们正不断袭击其他船只作为报复。

pairs.source: The hulls of destroyers are so thick, it's impossible to pierce it with normal ammunition.  We've crafted battleships with the sole purpose of penetrating destroyer armor.
pairs.text: 驱逐舰的外层装甲非常厚实，普通弹药根本不可能打穿它。为了能够击穿驱逐舰的装甲，我们特意建造出了战列舰。

pairs.source: Transport ships are required to deliver troops to battle or to load up valuable cargo.  Take a transport on this training mission and ensure it reaches its destination intact.
pairs.text: 运输舰可以运送部队、装载珍贵货物。这就派遣一艘运输舰去执行这项训练任务吧，一定要确保它安然抵达目的地。

pairs.source: We designed submarines specifically to sneak up on unsuspecting carriers.  We've set up a carrier in the bay. See if you can sneak up on it.
pairs.text: 为了偷袭毫无防备的航母，我们特意设计出了潜水艇。我们已经在海湾里准备了一艘航母，去看看你能不能偷袭到它吧。

pairs.source: The best way to take out battleships is by air.  Take a carrier out and have your ace bomber pilots put some holes into it.
pairs.text: 对付战列舰最好的办法就是空中打击。快开上你的航母，让你王牌轰炸机飞行员给它开几个洞吧。

pairs.source: We've set up submarines at different depths off the coast of Shadowmoon Valley.  Take a destroyer out and train them in the art of sub hunting.
pairs.text: 我们在影月谷海岸的不同水深处准备了好几艘潜水艇。开上你的驱逐舰，去练习一下猎杀潜水艇的本领吧。

pairs.source: The hulls of destroyers are so thick, it's impossible to pierce it with normal ammunition.  We've crafted battleships with the sole purpose of penetrating destroyer armor.
pairs.text: 驱逐舰的外层装甲非常厚实，普通弹药根本不可能打穿它。为了能够击穿驱逐舰的装甲，我们特意建造出了战列舰。

pairs.source: The best way to take out battleships is by air.  Take a carrier out and have your ace bomber pilots put some holes into it.
pairs.text: 对付战列舰最好的办法就是空中打击。快开上你的航母，让你王牌轰炸机飞行员给它开几个洞吧。

pairs.source: Capture Ironfist Harbor and interrogate prisoners as to the whereabouts of Gul'dan's flagship.
pairs.text: 占领铁拳港并拷问俘虏，了解古尔丹的旗舰下落。

pairs.source: Captured prisoners indicated that Gul'dan's flagship was last seen in this area of dangerous shoals.
pairs.text: 俘虏招供说，古尔丹的旗舰最后一次出现，就是在这片危险的浅滩内。

pairs.source: Should give you a huge success chance boost, if it's the first mission of the day. Also should give you a cool item!
pairs.text: 如果这是当天的第一个任务，那么应该会大幅提升你的成功率。还会给你一个超酷的物品！

pairs.source: A Horde sub has been spotted spying around our base.  Take your new destroyer out and end it.
pairs.text: 我们在基地附近发现了一艘部落潜水艇。快派出你的新型驱逐舰击沉它吧。

pairs.source: Our forward outpost has additional blueprints drafted up and a prototype ship.  Take the transport out and load up the shipment.
pairs.text: 我们的前沿岗哨绘制了新的图纸并制造了一艘舰船样品。派出你的运输舰把东西运回来吧。

pairs.source: An Alliance sub has been spotted spying around our base.  Take your new destroyer out and end it.
pairs.text: 我们在基地附近发现了一艘联盟潜水艇。快派出你的新型驱逐舰击沉它吧。

pairs.source: Our forward outpost has additional blueprints drafted up and a prototype ship.  Take the transport out and load up the shipment.
pairs.text: 我们的前沿岗哨绘制了新的图纸并制造了一艘舰船样品。派出你的运输舰把东西运回来吧。

pairs.source: Countless munitions are created in Blackrock Foundry, then infused with fel energies in Hellfire Citadel. It's vital that we intercept or destroy whatever we can.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂生产出无数弹药，然后在地狱火堡垒中灌注邪能。我们必须尽力拦截或摧毁那些弹药，这对战局至关重要。

pairs.source: Countless munitions are created in Blackrock Foundry, then infused with fel energies in Hellfire Citadel. It's vital that we intercept or destroy whatever we can.
pairs.text: 黑石鑄造場打造出無數軍火之後，會送到地獄火堡壘灌注魔化能量。事關重大，我們要盡可能攔截或破壞這些武器。

pairs.source: Keeping the Iron Reaver in good repair is a full-time job, and it requires a steady supply of parts from Blackrock Foundry. Disrupt that supply.
pairs.text: 钢铁掠夺者的修缮维护工作是全天候的，需要黑石铸造厂稳定供应零部件。去干扰一下他们的补给线吧。

pairs.source: Keeping the Iron Reaver in good repair is a full-time job, and it requires a steady supply of parts from Blackrock Foundry. Disrupt that supply.
pairs.text: 保養鋼鐵劫奪者是全天候的後勤作業，需要黑石鑄造廠穩定地供應零件。破壞他們的補給線！

pairs.source: Blackrock Foundry regularly ships newly forged cannons to Tanaan, where they bolster Hellfire Citadel's defenses. Every ship we sink saves thousands of lives.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂会定期将新造好的火炮运往塔纳安，用以加固地狱火堡垒的防御。我们每击沉一艘运输舰，都能拯救数千条生命。

pairs.source: There is someone out here who knows about the Pillars of Creation. We must find them.
pairs.text: 这里肯定有人知道创世之柱的下落。我们必须找到他们。

pairs.source: We need the most fearless Illidari to join our cause if we are to have any chance of defeating the Legion.
pairs.text: 想要与军团有一战之力，我们需要招募最无畏的恶魔猎手。
阿苏纳 - 伊利达雷哨所

pairs.source: A waterlogged crate has washed up on shore.  Break through the Iron Horde and pick it up.
pairs.text: 一只浸水的箱子被冲上了海岸。快冲破钢铁部落的封锁，把它弄回来。

pairs.source: If we can find a usable Legion gateway, we can launch an assault on one of their worlds and take it as our own.
pairs.text: 若能找到可使用的军团传送门，我们就能对一个军团世界发动攻击，并将它据为己有。

pairs.source: Vhaka the Vile and her crew once terrorized Draenor's seas, killing and plundering without remorse. Cursed for their evil deeds, they lash out at the living.
pairs.text: 邪恶的瓦卡和她的船员曾经横行德拉诺诸海，肆无忌惮地抢劫船只，杀害船员。如今，这些因恶行而受到诅咒的家伙还在迁怒于生者。

pairs.source: Although his surprise attacks were legend, Giras the Guileful was just as infamous for his gambling addiction. Even now he's said to enjoy wagering on cards or dice.
pairs.text: 虽然狡猾的基拉斯曾打出过许多经典的伏击战，却因为沉迷赌博而声名狼藉。据说直到现在，他还是离不开纸牌和骰子。

pairs.source: Push the Iron Horde out of the South Seas by defeating their blockade.  Success grants access to the primal resources around Nagrand.
pairs.text: 攻破钢铁部落的封锁线，将他们赶出南海，获取纳格兰的原生资源。

pairs.source: Assault the Iron Horde defense in the Barrier Sea to unlock access to the waters around Tanaan.  Success grants access to Hellfire Citadel naval missions.
pairs.text: 攻破钢铁部落位于隔绝之海的防线，打开进入塔纳安周围水域的通道，从而开启地狱火堡垒的海军行动。

pairs.source: Transport ships are required to deliver troops to battle or to load up valuable cargo.  Take a transport on this training mission and ensure it reaches its destination intact.
pairs.text: 运输舰可以运送部队、装载珍贵货物。这就派遣一艘运输舰去执行这项训练任务吧，一定要确保它安然抵达目的地。

pairs.source: The sticky, sweet liquid inside of swamplighter hives is highly combustible. Extract some and we can use it as a crude oil substitute.
pairs.text: 沼泽荧光虫蜂巢里黏稠甜美的液体非常易燃。去挖一些来，我们可以把它当做天然的原油替代品。

pairs.source: The white-hot cores of the abyssals assaulting Shattrath could be useful as a compressed fuel source, if we can obtain a few.
pairs.text: 攻打沙塔斯的深渊魔有着白热的核心，如果我们可以弄点来的话，可以把它作为压缩燃料使用。

pairs.source: Poundface has cornered a small group of our allies bringing oil from the Blackrock Foundry. Help them get the oil back to our garrison.
pairs.text: 烂脸拖住了我们的一小队盟友，他们携带着从黑石铸造厂弄来的原油。快去帮他们把原油运回我们要塞吧。

pairs.source: An elder Warsong shaman's spirit has been disturbed by unrest in Nagrand. The ogres would be willing to trade some supplies with us if we can put it to rest.
pairs.text: 在纳格兰，有一位战歌氏族老萨满的灵魂受到了惊扰。如果我们能让他重新安息，那里的食人魔愿意向我们提供一些补给作为报酬。

pairs.source: Our allies in Spires of Arak have requested our aid against a large swarm of ravager wasps threatening their oil-pumping operations.
pairs.text: 我们在阿兰卡峰林的盟友请求我们帮忙对付一群暴怒的野蜂，蜂群已经威胁到了他们的原油开采工作。

pairs.source: Deep within Auchindoun, Draenei power crystals still hum with life. We can surely use them as a source of fuel.
pairs.text: 奥金顿深处的德莱尼能量水晶仍然散发着生命的嗡鸣。它们肯定可以作为燃料使用。

pairs.source: Two enormous watery monsters guard a strange oil-producing plant deep in the Everbloom. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 两只巨大的水怪守护着永茂林地深处一株能够生产原油的奇怪植物。我们得去调查一下。

pairs.source: Two powerful ogres have taken over a portion of the mines containing a shipment of valuable fuel.
pairs.text: 两个强大的食人魔占据了一部分矿区，那里正巧有一批珍贵的燃料。

pairs.source: Terrible void creatures are coming from a deep chasm in the burial grounds. There may be other valuables down there as well.
pairs.text: 可怕的虚空生物正源源不断地从墓地的裂口处涌出。裂口下面可能还会有一些值钱的东西。

pairs.source: A master of beasts has been seen escorting a shipment of oil to Blackrock Mountain. Stop him!
pairs.text: 一位兽王正护送一批原油前往黑石山。快去阻止他！

pairs.source: A group of podlings has been spotted near some recently-formed tar pits in Gorgrond. If we defeat them, we can extract the fuel.
pairs.text: 在戈尔隆德新近形成的焦油坑附近出现了一群魔荚人。如果我们击败他们，就可以抽取那里的燃料了。

pairs.source: The corrupting blood in Spires of Arak has turned the carrion-consuming species into undead monstrosities.
pairs.text: 阿兰卡峰林的腐化之血将那里的食腐生物都变成了亡灵怪物。

pairs.source: A decrepit ogre caravan was spotted in Frostfire, surrounded by hostile wildlife. It looks like they were hauling oil.
pairs.text: 我们在霜火岭发现了一辆老旧的食人魔篷车。不怀好意的野生动物已经包围了它。那辆车上装的好像是原油。

pairs.source: The void's effect on Draenor has become more pronounced. Vile bloods of the land are emerging.
pairs.text: 虚空对德拉诺的影响愈发明显了。大地中涌出了邪污之血。

pairs.source: A powerful spider named Death's Bite has returned as an undead, and terrorizes Talador yet again.
pairs.text: 一只名叫死颚的大蜘蛛变成了亡灵，再次横行于塔拉多。

pairs.source: A group of tiny fiery puppies was spotted deep within Blackrock Foundry. If we save them, we may be able to raise them.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂的深处出现了一群燃烬狼崽。如果我们能救出它们，它们或许就会在要塞里住下了。

pairs.source: Two enormous breakers have been spotted out on Gorgrond. What better way to test our might?
pairs.text: 戈尔隆德出现两只巨型毁灭者。还有比这更能证明实力的挑战吗？

pairs.source: A group of burning blademaster spirits has been roused by the activities in Nagrand. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 纳格兰的骚乱惊动了一群火刃氏族剑圣的灵魂。我们得去调查一下。

pairs.source: Some ancient artifacts containing untold knowledge are being jealously guarded by arakkoa out in Spires of Arak.
pairs.text: 阿兰卡峰林的鸦人们警惕地看守着一些含有未知知识的古老神器。

pairs.source: The ogres found a huge supply cache out in Frostfire Ridge. Who's up for some ogre hunting?
pairs.text: 食人魔在霜火岭发现了一大箱补给。有人想出去打几只食人魔玩吗？

pairs.source: A group of frost furies has gathered in the snowy wastes of Frostfire Ridge and laid waste to a caravan carrying valuable weaponry.
pairs.text: 一群冰霜之怒聚集在霜火岭的雪原上，袭击了一辆运送珍贵武器的篷车。

pairs.source: Rumors abound of terrible demons near Shattrath that could drive a follower insane by just looking at them.
pairs.text: 传说沙塔斯附近有一群可怕的恶魔，见过它们的人都被逼疯了。

pairs.source: Tanaan Jungle is a harsh landscape, home to some of the most powerful beasts on this world.
pairs.text: 塔纳安丛林是一片严酷的土地，那里居住着这个世界上最强大野兽。

pairs.source: A deep chasm, filled with blackness, was found deep within the burial grounds. Who knows what horrors await us there?
pairs.text: 墓地中发现了一条黑暗的裂口。天知道有什么在那里等着我们呢。

pairs.source: The botani of Shadowmoon have regrown, stonger than ever. Let us show them our might and test ourselves in the process.
pairs.text: 影月谷的木精又卷土重来了，而且实力更胜往昔。去让他们看看我们的力量，顺便测试一下自己有没有进步吧。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Alliance around Shadowmoon.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 一艘当地的私掠船正受雇攻击影月谷附近的联盟船只。你要做的就是越过钢铁部落在南海的封锁线，将一批货物走私过去。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Alliance around Shadowmoon.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 影月谷當地有個私掠者已經在替我們攻擊聯盟，而你只需把貨物走私過鋼鐵部落在南海設下的封鎖線。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Alliance around Shadowmoon.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 一艘当地的私掠船正为敌人效力，攻击影月谷附近的联盟船只。你要做的就是越过钢铁部落在南海的封锁线，将一批货物偷运过去。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Alliance around Shadowmoon.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 影月谷當地有個私掠者已經在替我們攻擊聯盟，而你只需把貨物走私過鋼鐵部落在南海設下的封鎖線。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Horde around Frostfire.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 一艘当地的私掠船正为敌人效力，攻击影月谷附近的部落船只。你要做的就是越过钢铁部落在南海的封锁线，将一批货物偷运过去。

pairs.source: A local privateer has offered their service attacking the Horde around Frostfire.  All you have to do is smuggle some goods past the Iron Horde blockade in the South Sea.
pairs.text: 一艘当地的私掠船正为敌人效力，攻击影月谷附近的部落船只。你要做的就是越过钢铁部落在南海的封锁线，将一批货物偷运过去。

pairs.source: Captain Thokash found himself outgunned by a host of Alliance ships.  If you assist, he will deploy to the north to increase the experience gain of your fleet.
pairs.text: 索卡什船长发现自己被一群联盟舰船火力压制了。如果你帮他一把，他愿意镇守北方，提高你的舰队所获得的经验值。

pairs.source: Captain Reania found herself outgunned by a host of Horde ships.  If you assist, she will deploy to the north east to increase the experience gain of your fleet.
pairs.text: 瑞妮娅船长发现自己被一群部落舰船火力压制了。如果你帮她一把，她愿意镇守东北方，提高你的舰队所获得的经验值。

pairs.source: A Kraken is floating face down, surrounded by a fleet of Iron Horde ships.  Free it from the Iron Horde grasp and it may be willing to help.
pairs.text: 一只海怪正瑟缩地漂浮在海面上，周围是钢铁部落的舰队。快去把它从钢铁部落的魔爪中救出来，它或许会愿意帮助我们。

pairs.source: A Kraken is floating face down, surrounded by a fleet of Iron Horde ships.  Free it from the Iron Horde grasp and it may be willing to help.
pairs.text: 一只海怪正瑟缩地漂浮在海面上，周围是钢铁部落的舰队。快去把它从钢铁部落的魔爪中救出来，它或许会愿意帮助我们。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde discovered an abandoned airship base south of Nagrand.  If we defend the base, we can launch air support for Tanaan.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落在纳格兰南部发现了一座废弃的飞艇基地。如果我们保住那座基地，就可以对塔纳安进行空中支援了。

pairs.source: The Iron Horde discovered an abandoned airship base south of Nagrand.  If we defend the base, we can launch air support for Tanaan.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落在纳格兰南部发现了一座废弃的飞艇基地。如果我们保住那座基地，就可以对塔纳安进行空中支援了。

pairs.source: An Iron Horde shipment containing maps to treasure, hidden under the sea in Nagrand, is headed through the Tanaan Sea.  If you intercept it, you can use the maps for yourself.
pairs.text: 一批钢铁部落的货物正在横渡塔纳安海域，其中包括纳格兰海底的藏宝图。如果你能将它拦截下来，就可以将这批地图收归己用了。

pairs.source: An Iron Horde shipment containing maps to treasure, hidden under the sea in Nagrand, is headed through the Tanaan Sea.  If you intercept it, you can use the maps for yourself.
pairs.text: 一批钢铁部落的货物正在横渡塔纳安海域，其中包括纳格兰海底的藏宝图。如果你能将它拦截下来，就可以将这批地图收归己用了。

pairs.source: Countless munitions are created in Blackrock Foundry, then infused with fel energies in Hellfire Citadel. It's vital that we intercept or destroy whatever we can.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂生产出无数弹药，然后在地狱火堡垒中灌注邪能。我们必须尽力拦截或摧毁那些弹药，这对战局至关重要。

pairs.source: Countless munitions are created in Blackrock Foundry, then infused with fel energies in Hellfire Citadel. It's vital that we intercept or destroy whatever we can.
pairs.text: 黑石鑄造場打造出無數軍火之後，會送到地獄火堡壘灌注魔化能量。事關重大，我們要盡可能攔截或破壞這些武器。

pairs.source: Keeping the Iron Reaver in good repair is a full-time job, and it requires a steady supply of parts from Blackrock Foundry. Disrupt that supply.
pairs.text: 敌人要日夜不间断地维护钢铁掠夺者，而这样的维护工作需要黑石铸造厂稳定供应零部件。去干扰一下他们的补给线吧。

pairs.source: Blackrock Foundry regularly ships newly forged cannons to Tanaan, where they bolster Hellfire Citadel's defenses. Every ship we sink saves thousands of lives.
pairs.text: 黑石铸造厂会定期将新造好的火炮运往塔纳安，用以加固地狱火堡垒的防御。我们每击沉一艘运输舰，都能拯救数千条生命。

pairs.source: Kilrogg Deadeye has made his choice. Now his Bleeding Hollow orcs travel to Hellfire Citadel and return to Tanaan empowered by demonic blood.
pairs.text: 基尔罗格·死眼已经做出了选择。现在，他的血环兽人正在前往地狱火堡垒，他们将在接受恶魔之血的强化后返回塔纳安。

pairs.text: 基爾羅格‧亡眼做出了決定，他手下的血之谷獸人都在地獄火堡壘接受了惡魔之血的強化，然後回到塔南森林待命。

pairs.source: The Horde have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through and you can raid the Horde navy.
pairs.text: 部落在他们的要塞附近布下了封锁线。冲破它，你就能狠狠蹂躏部落的海军了。

pairs.source: The Horde have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through and you can raid the Horde navy.
pairs.text: 部落封鎖了他們要塞週遭的海域。突破他們的封鎖線，襲擊部落的海軍船艦。

pairs.text: 攻破钢铁部落位于隔绝之海的防线，打开进入塔纳安周围水域的通道，从而开启地狱火堡垒的海军行动。

pairs.text: 联盟在他们的要塞附近部下了封锁线。冲破它，好好教训一下那些家伙。

pairs.source: Captain Reania found herself outgunned by a host of Horde ships.  If you assist, she will deploy to the north east to increase the experience gain of your fleet.
pairs.text: 瑞妮娅船长发现自己被一群部落舰船火力压制了。如果你帮她一把，她愿意镇守东北方，提高你的舰队所获得的经验值。

pairs.source: Captain Thokash found himself outgunned by a host of Alliance ships.  If you assist, he will deploy to the north to increase the experience gain of your fleet.
pairs.text: 索卡什船长发现自己被一群联盟舰船火力压制了。如果你帮他一把，他愿意镇守北方，提高你的舰队所获得的经验值。

pairs.source: Pick up a shipment of oil from your off-shore oil rig.
pairs.text: 从你的离岸油井中提取一批原油。

pairs.source: Our troops in Tanaan have some more equipment to pick up, but it's not safe to send it alone.  Take a transport and a destoyer out to make the drop.
pairs.text: 我们在塔纳安的部队又搞到了一些装备，但就这么把它们运过来不太安全。派一艘运输舰和一艘驱逐舰去接应一下吧。

pairs.source: Our troops in Tanaan have some more equipment to pick up, but it's not safe to send it alone.  Take a transport and a destoyer out to make the drop.
pairs.text: 我们在塔纳安的部队又搞到了一些装备，但就这么把它们运过来不太安全。派一艘运输舰和一艘驱逐舰去接应一下吧。

pairs.source: Gul'dan has sent submarine hunter-killers to thwart your mission. Lure them into a trap!
pairs.text: 古尔丹已派出反潜舰船来破坏你的行动。把它们引到陷阱里去！

pairs.source: You've located Gul'dan's flagship! Maneuver with the wind to take out her carrier escort...
pairs.text: 你发现了古尔丹的旗舰！快利用风向干掉护航的航母……

pairs.source: You've run Gul'dan's flagship aground, but now all her guns are trained toward the sea. Prepare for the worst.
pairs.text: 你已经逼得古尔丹的旗舰搁浅了，可现在它所有的火炮都对准了海面。你要做好最坏的打算。

pairs.source: Azsuna appears to be an idyllic island teeming with wildlife. Reports of magical activity in the area, however, suggest that not all is as it sems.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳似乎是一座遍布野生动物的世外桃源。然而一系列关于该区域充斥着魔法活动的报告，似乎证明事情不像想象的那么简单。

pairs.source: Val'Sharah once stood as the heart of druidism on Azeroth, the mighty world tree Shaladrassil standing tall at its center. There are sure to be long-lost secrets hidden in its thickets that would be useful against the Legion.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉曾是艾泽拉斯德鲁伊信仰的中心，世界之树莎拉达希尔耸立于正中间的位置。森林中隐藏着诸多失落已久的秘密，它们或许有助于我们对抗军团。

pairs.source: Highmountain is all that stands of the range that once divided Suramar from the northern lands. Rumor has it that the leader of an ancient tauren tribe on the lonely mountain's slopes wields a relic of legendary power.
pairs.text: 至高岭的险峰将苏拉玛和古代北地隔绝开来。传说在这座孤山之中有一支古老的牛头人部族，他们的领袖掌握着一件拥有神力的遗物。

pairs.source: Once grazing land for the beasts of the Suramar elves, the bluffs of Stormheim now serve as the capital of an ancient race of Vrykul that fled the northern lands after the Great Sundering.
pairs.text: 风暴峡湾的峭壁曾是苏拉玛精灵放牧野兽的牧场，如今已经成为了一支古代维库部落的首都，他们是在大分裂后从北地逃到这里的。

pairs.source: Our scouts report seeing a knight trapped by a horde of demons. Destroy the demons and bring our brother in arms home.
pairs.text: 我们的侦察兵报告说有一位骑士遭到了恶魔的围困。干掉那些恶魔，让我们的兄弟回家。

pairs.source: The forces of Nightmare are closing in on a sacred moonwell. We can't let it fall into darkness.
pairs.text: 梦魇的部队靠近了一口神圣的月亮井。我们绝不能让它受到黑暗势力的污染。

pairs.source: A Fel Lord may be building up forces in the harsh northern bluffs.
pairs.text: 一名邪能领主可能正在北部险峻的悬崖处组建一支部队。

pairs.source: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Stormheim. We should find it.
pairs.text: 风暴峡湾的某处有一座强大的圣光信标。我们得找到它。

pairs.source: The Legion is planning to launch a coastal assault on Stormheim. We need to find out where.
pairs.text: 军团正计划对风暴峡湾发动一场登陆战，我们必须找到他们计划的登陆位置。

pairs.source: We've heard whispers that a demon has been offering the Highmountain tauren dark power.
pairs.text: 我们听到传闻，有一名恶魔正试图劝诱至高岭的牛头人接受黑暗力量。

pairs.source: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Highmountain. We should find it.
pairs.text: 至高岭的某处有一座强大的圣光信标。我们得找到它。

pairs.source: A captured imp told us his masters were planning to attack a Highmountain tauren village - we need to figure out which one.
pairs.text: 我们抓获的一名小鬼俘虏供认说他的主人们正计划攻打至高岭的一处牛头人村落。我们得搞清楚是哪一处。

pairs.source: We can go after the heavy hitters later, right now we need someone who has seen everything. There is one that has been in every war for the past few decades and can do more than kill.
pairs.text: 打打杀杀的事情可以之后再处理，眼下我们需要找个见多识广的家伙。正好我知道有个人参加了过去几十年里每一场战争，而且还不是光懂打架。

pairs.source: The only way to strengthen our order is through continued focus and training. There is an ancient master who may be willing to share his martial secrets. Seek him out and train with him, and return stronger and wiser.
pairs.text: 刻苦锻炼、日益精进才是弘扬我派的唯一途径。有一名老师傅可能会愿意分享他的武学经验。我们必定能从他那里学到不少东西。

pairs.source: We will need to recruit a master summoner to assist the Council. A warlock of a notable family was rumored to be spotted in Dalaran.
pairs.text: 我们必须劝诱一名召唤大师来为议会效力。据说有一位挺有名的术士最近出现在了达拉然。

pairs.source: We believe we can lure a worthwhile rogue into our order with the right... motivation.
pairs.text: 我们应该可以靠某种……“动力”把一个物有所值的潜行者招募到我们的行列中来。

pairs.source: The mages of Dalaran seem trustworthy... but are they?
pairs.text: 达拉然的法师看上去值得信任……但真的如此吗？

pairs.source: Akazamzarak knows where he can find a whole city of mages, so long as you don't mind the smell.
pairs.text: 阿卡扎曼扎拉克说他知道哪里有一座满是法师的城市，前提是你不介意那里的味道。

pairs.source: The Naga have secrets, seek them out.
A sea giant is running rampant, lets hope size doesnt matter.
pairs.text: 一个海巨人在四处横行，希望他的体型不会给你造成麻烦。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Azsuna.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在阿苏纳地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Suramar
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在苏拉玛地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Val'sharah.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在瓦尔莎拉地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 瓦尔莎拉

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in High Mountain.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在至高岭地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Stormheim.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在风暴峡湾地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 风暴峡湾

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in The Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在破碎海滩地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 破碎海滩

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Thal'Dranath.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在萨尔达纳斯地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 萨尔达纳斯

pairs.source: Demons have invaded Azsuna en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵阿苏纳！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: Among the trees of Val'sharah a number of enemies lie in wait.
pairs.text: 大量的敌人躲藏在瓦尔莎拉的森林中。

pairs.source: The swamps outside Bradensbrook are wailing.  See whats causing the noise, and silence it.
pairs.text: 鲑鱼溪外的沼泽在悲鸣。查出导致这一噪音的源头，并让它安静下来。

pairs.source: Harpies in the Haglands have started raiding our nearby camps for supplies.
pairs.text: 女巫秘地的鹰身人最近在掠夺我们附近营地里的资源。

pairs.source: The murlocs have made a foothold in the wrecks at Shipwreck Cove.  Clear them out.
pairs.text: 一帮鱼人在沉船海湾的废墟中建立了营地。清理掉它们。

pairs.source: The Feltotems at Torok's Bluff are assaulting our troops as they make passage through the pass.  Show them the error of their ways.
pairs.text: 图鲁克断崖的邪能图腾一直在伏击我们经过那里的部队。看来他们需要一点教训。

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 为了犒劳部队，我们决定大摆宴席。往菜谱里加些山羊肉吧。

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 部隊需要一頓大餐來慰勞一下，今天就宰山羊加菜好啦。

pairs.source: The Tideskorn are have made a push to new areas of Stormheim, and its not appreciated.  Take care of them.
pairs.text: 蔑潮维库人最近扩大了他们在风暴峡湾的领地，但我们可不乐意了。解决他们。

pairs.source: The time has come to clear out the demon forces at the gates of Valor.  Ready your best.
pairs.text: 做好准备。是时候把勇者之门的恶魔部队驱逐干净了。

pairs.source: Assault on the Gates of Valor
Demons have invaded Stormheim en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵风暴峡湾！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: Demons have invaded Highmountain en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵至高岭！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: Demons have invaded Val'sharah en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵瓦尔莎拉！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: Demons have invaded Suramar en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵苏拉玛！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: Demons have invaded Broken Shore en masse!  Reinforcements are required immediately to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 军团大举入侵破碎海滩！我们需要立即派出援军对抗这一威胁。

pairs.source: We lost contact with the monks at Tian Monastery. We should send Chen Stormstout to investigate.
pairs.text: 我们和天禅院的武僧们失去了联系。需要派陈·风暴烈酒前去调查。

pairs.source: We've encountered a tribe of hostile Tideskorn vrykul and are under attack. These are the same enemies who kidnapped our allies!
pairs.text: 我们遭遇了敌对的蔑潮维库人部族，受到了攻击。就是这些人绑架了我们的盟友！

pairs.source: We made camp near a field of graves, but at night, apparitions rose and attacked!
pairs.text: 我们在一个墓地附近扎营，但鬼怪在夜里复活了，开始攻击我们！
追踪蔑潮：永不安息的亡者

pairs.source: The Tideskorn slipped away. We made camp for the night, but the howls of wild beasts echo across the valleys. Stay alert!
pairs.text: 蔑潮走了。我们在夜里扎营，但那些野生动物的嚎叫响彻整个山谷。保持警惕！

pairs.source: We've tracked the Tideskorn to a large, fortified camp at the Gates of Valor. Find any information we can about the kidnapped prisoners.
pairs.text: 我们追踪蔑潮的踪迹一路追到了勇者之门附近一座戒备森业的庞大营地。找到任何与被绑架的囚徒有关的消息。

pairs.source: Tracking the Tideskorn: The Gates of Valor
Drakes have beset our scouts from the skies. These fearsome dragons are looking for their next meal. Let's try not to be dinner!
pairs.text: 幼龙正从天空围攻我们的斥候。这些可怕的幼龙正在寻找下一餐的食物。加油，不要成为他们的午餐！

pairs.source: We made camp at the base of the mountain, but the area is home to hostile ettin. We'll need to fend them off before we make our ascent.
pairs.text: 我们在山底扎营，但这里是凶猛的双头怪的家园。在上山之前，我们必须得赶走他们。

pairs.source: The tauren at Snowblind Mesa are dealing with encroaching drogbar. They've asked for our aid in exchange for shelter.
pairs.text: 雪盲台地的牛头人正在应对来犯的卓格巴尔。他们请求我们提供帮助，并表示可以提供住所作为交换。

pairs.source: We are nearing Freya's Spring, but the area is guarded by a drogbar chieftain who calls himself the mountain king. Defeat him and we will gain our prize!
pairs.text: 我们正在接近弗蕾亚之泉，但这片区域是由一个卓格巴尔酋长看守，他自称为山丘之王。击败他们，我们就可以获得奖励！

pairs.source: A strange magic seeps from beneath the roots of the world tree, Shaladrassil. We must send our champions to investigate this disturbance.
pairs.text: 世界之树莎拉达希尔的根系下方渗出了奇怪的魔法。我们必须派出勇士调查这个异象。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛魔鳞蜥蜴的皮肤具有一些……有趣的特性。我们弄一些来进行研究吧。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 蘇拉瑪爾的法鱗石化蜥蜴皮有些…特別的效果。拿一些回來研究吧。

pairs.source: The Nightbornes infiltrations have gone on too long.  Stop them at all costs.
pairs.text: 夜之子已经渗透得太远了。必须不计一切代价阻止他们。

pairs.source: Yet still more demons flood the depths of Suramar.  We must hold them.
pairs.text: 恶魔依然从苏拉玛的地底不断涌出。我们必须挡住他们。

pairs.source: The Order of the Broken Temple is established, but we need more. Tianji, a renowned troop trainer in the Ox Style, just sent word that she has been attacked!
pairs.text: 残寺派已经建立了，但我们还需要更多的帮手。田吉是玄牛派中有名的部队训练师，刚刚发来消息说她遭到了攻击！

pairs.source: This high on the mountain, the elements themselves are our greatest enemy. Elementals of wind and ice roam the peaks. Defeat them and press on!
pairs.text: 在这么高的山顶，元素生物本身就是我们最大的敌人。风元素和冰元素在山峰四处游荡。击败他们，继续前行！

pairs.source: We have lost an important set of missives in the Fel Pits of Faronaar.  Retrieve them.
pairs.text: 我们在法罗纳尔的魔能熔池遗失了一些重要的信件。把它们取回来。

pairs.source: The academy at Narthalas once held a great library with a wealth of knowledge.  See if you can find it.
pairs.text: 纳萨拉斯的学院曾经有一座巨大的图书馆，里面保存着丰富的知识。试试能否找到它。

pairs.source: The enemy has established an array of casters and are bombarding us with terrible balls of Fel energy.  We need help to counter these attacks!
pairs.text: 敌人组建了施法者部队，对我们展开了可怕的邪能轰炸。我们需要更多的协助才能对抗这些攻击。

pairs.source: The Burning Legion's minions might have information about where the missing council members are being held. It must be obtained at any cost.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的仆从们可能会知道失踪的议会成员被关押在哪里。必须要不惜一切代价获得这个消息。

pairs.source: Harpies are spreading their foul curse throughout Highmountain. Death is the only way to ensure the curse won't continue.
pairs.text: 鹰身人正在至高岭散布邪恶的诅咒。只有死亡才能阻止她们。

pairs.source: Black Rook Assassins are attacking Bradensbrook, killing livestock and stealing crops. Defend the village from these ruthless attackers.
pairs.text: 黑鸦刺客正在攻击鲑鱼溪，杀害家畜，偷窃庄稼。快去保护那些无辜的村民。

pairs.source: Nightmare imps have taken over Moonclaw Vale, corrupting the once serene glade. Help restore balance by ridding the area of imps.
pairs.text: 噩梦小鬼占领了月爪谷，他们正在亵渎这片静怡的森林。除掉那里的小鬼，恢复山谷的平衡。

pairs.source: Dalaran's underbelly has a bit of a rodent problem. Exterminate the pests before they make their way out of the sewers.
pairs.text: 达拉然下水道最近在闹鼠灾。去打扫一下下水道，免得它们钻出来。

pairs.source: A group of poachers are threatening the wildlife in Highmountain. Show them what it's like to be hunted!
pairs.text: 有一群偷猎者威胁着至高岭的野生动物们。让他们感受下被狩猎的滋味！

pairs.source: Archmage Khadgar is concerned for the safety of Dalaran's citizens. He's asked the Unseen Path to provide protection for the city, discreetly.
pairs.text: 大法师卡德加非常担心达拉然居民的安全。他已经请求隐秘通途为这座城市提供保护，但要我们低调行事。

pairs.source: An imp mother has made Bradensbrook her breeding grounds, birthing countless imps into the nearby fields. Defeat the imp mother before her brood grows.
pairs.text: 一个鬼母把鲑鱼溪当成了育婴所，在附近的地区养育了无数的小鬼。在她的子嗣继续增长之前，将其击败。

pairs.source: Unseen Protection: The Mother of Imps
A wave of infernals have crashed upon the shores of Suramar. They must be stopped before they march inland.
pairs.text: 一波地狱火降落在了苏拉玛的海岸。必须在他们进入内陆之前阻止他们。

pairs.source: The Legion has launched an invasion on the eastern coast of Stormheim. Our hunters can attack at range from the cliffs, protecting the infantry below.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团在风暴峡湾的东海岸发动了一波攻击。我们的猎人可以从峭壁之上发起远程打击，保护下方的步兵。

pairs.source: A clan of cave-dwelling drogbar are pilfering eagle eggs to feed to their fledgling worms. They must be stopped before the great eagle becomes extinct!
pairs.text: 一群生活在洞穴中的卓格巴尔偷走了鹰蛋，用来喂食他们驯养的幼虫。在巨鹰被灭绝之前，必须要阻止他们！
隐秘保护：卓格巴尔佳肴

pairs.source: The Black Harvest archives contain a vast amount of magical knowledge collected over time. It's possible that within its walls we will find something.
pairs.text: 黑暗收割议会的档案中蕴含着大量的魔法知识。在他们的围墙里我们应该会有所收获。

pairs.source: The staff Shinfel used in battle against Cho'gall would be powerful enough to create the soul link, but first we'll need to find it.
pairs.text: 辛菲儿在与古加尔的战斗中使用的法杖应该足以用于创造灵魂链接，但首先我们得找到它。

pairs.source: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout the city of Dalaran, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.
pairs.text: 我们得找一个擅长召唤大恶魔的术士。搜索一下达拉然城，留意任何有潜力的人。

pairs.source: Theres a foul smell in the air.
pairs.text: 空气中充满的了邪恶的味道。

pairs.source: The enemies are continually encroaching on Azsuna.  Seek them out, and destroy them.
pairs.text: 敌人在持续不断地进攻阿苏纳。找到他们，摧毁他们。

pairs.source: We must find our way into Faronaar, but the roads are covered in demons.  Let us see if we can scout out an alternate route.
pairs.text: 我们得想办法进入法罗纳尔，但这一路上都是恶魔。让我们看看能否找到别的路径。

pairs.source: Theres a Deathscreamer up in the mountains thats keeping us up at night.  Can you help out?
pairs.text: 山上有个召亡战士让我们整天晚上睡不着觉。你能想想办法吗？

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 为了犒劳部队，我们决定大摆宴席。菜谱中需要加入山羊。

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 部隊需要一頓大餐來慰勞一下，今天就宰山羊加菜好啦。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛魔鳞蜥蜴的皮肤拥有一些……特性。我们弄一些来进行研究吧。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 蘇拉瑪爾的法鱗石化蜥蜴皮有些…特別的性質。拿一些回來研究吧。

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: The Ettin need to be erradicated.
Snowmane Village is under attack!  Send reinforcements immediately.
pairs.text: 雪鬃村正在遭到攻击！快派援兵过去。

pairs.source: Send some troops toe Candle Rock, and clear out the Bluewax miners there.  We need the resources in that mine.
pairs.text: 派些部队去烛照岩清理掉那边的蓝烛矿工。我们需要那里的矿产资源。

pairs.source: If we can take control of some drakes, we can take away some air superiority from the Tideskorns.
pairs.text: 如果我们能控制一些幼龙，就能削弱蔑潮维库人的空中优势。

pairs.source: Deep in a cave on Blackbeak Overlook can be found some very powerful Mushrooms that creates a soothing balm.
pairs.text: 在黑喙崖上的一个洞穴里可以找到一种特别的蘑菇，能用来制作镇痛膏。

pairs.source: Reclaimers in Suramar are performing some curious rituals.  Interrupt them, and try to discover their intentions.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛的复国者们正在执行某种奇怪的仪式。打断他们的仪式并查清他们的目的。

pairs.source: The hides of the Sablehorn provide valuable materials for our troops.
pairs.text: 黑角鹿皮对我们的部队来说是价值极高的材料。

pairs.source: Cleanse the Dreadroot of its Twisted Keepers.
pairs.text: 清除恐惧之根中扭曲的守卫者。

pairs.source: Deep under the trees roots near Shalda'Nir grow some powerful flowers.
pairs.text: 莎达尼尔树根附近的地下生长着不少力量强大的花朵。

pairs.source: The enemies are continually encroaching on Azsuna.  Seek them out, and destroy them.
pairs.text: 敌人在持续不断地进攻阿苏纳。找到他们，摧毁他们。

pairs.source: The Feltotem, led by a vicious Crawliac, are mustering troops.  Hit them before they can strike us.
pairs.text: 一部分邪能图腾现在由一只紫喉鹰身人率领着，他们正在聚集部队。让我们先发制人。

pairs.source: Bosses are on the loose, stop them.
pairs.text: 首领在大杀特杀，阻止他们。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛魔鳞蜥蜴的皮肤拥有一些……特性。我们弄一些来进行研究吧。

pairs.source: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.
pairs.text: 蘇拉瑪爾的法鱗石化蜥蜴皮有些…特別的性質。拿一些回來研究吧。

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: A mass of armies are preparing for battle.  Crush them.
pairs.text: 一支庞大的军队正在备战。碾碎他们。

pairs.source: Slithering Sliss has eluded our capture for too long.  We have her cornered.
pairs.text: 滑行者瑟莉丝一直以来都躲过了我们的追捕。但我们终于把她逼近死胡同里了。

pairs.source: This trio of terrors needs to be dealt with, but it will take everything we can muster.
pairs.text: 这三人组必须死，不过我们得尽全力对付他们。

pairs.source: Its time to take Stili the Salty down.
pairs.text: 是时候除掉咸鱼斯提里了。

pairs.source: The paths along the cliffs of Highmountain are beseiged with dangers.
pairs.text: 至高岭的山路上潜伏着各种危险。

pairs.source: The paths along the cliffs of Highmountain are beseiged with dangers.
pairs.text: 至高岭的山路上潜伏着各种危险。

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 为了犒劳部队，我们决定大摆宴席。菜谱中需要加入山羊。

pairs.source: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.
pairs.text: 部隊需要一頓大餐來慰勞一下，今天就宰山羊加菜好啦。

pairs.text: 为了犒劳部队，我们决定大摆宴席。菜谱中需要加入山羊。

pairs.text: 部隊需要一頓大餐來慰勞一下，今天就宰山羊加菜好啦。

pairs.text: 苏拉玛魔鳞蜥蜴的皮肤拥有一些……特性。我们弄一些来进行研究吧。

pairs.text: 蘇拉瑪爾的法鱗石化蜥蜴皮有些…特別的性質。拿一些回來研究吧。

pairs.text: 苏拉玛魔鳞蜥蜴的皮肤拥有一些……特性。我们弄一些来进行研究吧。
