pairs.text: 蘇拉瑪爾的法鱗石化蜥蜴皮有些…特別的性質。拿一些回來研究吧。

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: We will fight them, no matter where they hide.
pairs.text: 我们会与他们作战，不论他们躲在哪里。
我们在街道中与他们作战

pairs.source: Black Rook must fall, send our forces to weaken their defenses.
pairs.text: 我们必须攻克黑鸦堡垒，派部队去削弱他们的防御。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Azsuna.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在阿苏纳地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in High Mountain.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在至高岭地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Stormheim.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在风暴峡湾地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 风暴峡湾

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Suramar
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在苏拉玛地区获得额外的支援。

pairs.source: Send a follower on this mission to have extra support while in Val'sharah.
pairs.text: 派一名追随者执行这个任务，以在瓦尔莎拉地区获得额外的支援。
地区支援 - 瓦尔莎拉

pairs.source: The Earthen Ring must send representatives to Skywall to negotiate with the elementals of air. Since the death of Al'Akir, Skywall has been in turmoil.
pairs.text: 大地之环必须派代表去天空之墙探讨与空气元素的结盟事宜。自从奥拉基尔死后，天空之墙就一片混乱。

pairs.source: There are rumors of a new threat in Deepholm and Therazane has not been present in negotiations with the Elemental Lords. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 据说深岩之洲出现了新的威胁，而石母塞拉赞恩没有出现在元素领主的协商会议上。我们需要进行相关调查。

pairs.source: The death of Ragnaros has left the Firelands in chaos. Uniting the elemental plane of fire to our cause will not be easy. We should send an envoy.
pairs.text: 拉格纳罗斯的死让火焰之地陷入了一片混乱。我们若想要统合火元素位面可不容易。我们必须派去一名使者。

pairs.source: Number Nine Jia is a lorekeeper of much renown. Unfortunately, during the attack on the Peak of Serenity, many of her scrolls were left behind.
pairs.text: 贾九鹤是一位知名的博学者。然而不幸的是，在晴日峰受到攻击时，她的许多卷轴被弄丢了。

pairs.source: Our Class Hall is established, but we are going to need help. Summoner Morn, a renowned Elemental Summoner just sent word that he has been attacked!
pairs.text: 我们的职业大厅已经建好了，但还需要更多的帮助。一位有名的元素召唤师摩恩传来消息说他遭受了攻击！

pairs.source: It appears that we will need those troops sooner than we thought. The Hydraxian Waterlords just sent a distress call from Azsuna.
pairs.text: 看来部队投入实战的时机比预想的早。海达希亚水元素刚刚从阿苏纳发出了求救信号。

pairs.source: One boss, one army, one spell.
pairs.text: 一个首领，一支军队，一个法术。

pairs.source: The research samples from Shaladrassil are ready. Let us assign Naralex to study them. He will need time to focus and examine them closely.
pairs.text: 莎拉达希尔的样本已经准备好了。我们可以派纳拉雷克斯去进行研究。他需要花一些时间来仔细分析它们。

pairs.source: The Temple of Elune is beset by satyr and the minions of the Legion. Celestine of the Harvest is helping, but we will need her here.
pairs.text: 月神殿被萨特和燃烧军团的爪牙包围了起来。丰收女巫塞莱斯廷正在想办法，但我们需要她到这里来。

pairs.source: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Celestine of the Harvest
pairs.text: 集合织梦者：丰收女巫塞莱斯廷

pairs.source: Thisalee Crow is in over her head. Sea giants have captured her, and she is being forced to battle in their underground fighting ring. We need to get her out!
pairs.text: 希萨莉·黑鸦遇到了大麻烦。海巨人抓住了她，逼她参与他们的地下搏击擂台。我们得把她救出来！
集合织梦者：希萨莉·黑鸦

pairs.source: Matoclaw led a team of druids into Highmountain to deal with harpies, but she's been cornered. Defeat Nest Matron Subonn and bring Matoclaw back!
pairs.text: 麦托克劳带领一支德鲁伊队伍前往至高岭处理鹰身人的问题，但她被包围了。击败巢穴主母苏伯妮，把麦托克劳带回来！

pairs.source: We haven't heard from Talza and his scouts in Stormheim. Considering the hostile vrykul in that area, it's likely they've been waylaid.
pairs.text: 我们尚未收到前往风暴峡湾的塔尔扎和他的斥候传回的消息。考虑到那片区域中存在敌对的维库人，他们很可能遭到了伏击。

pairs.source: Satyr warbands have been spotted near the northern shores of Azsuna. They are using Shards of Nightmare to expand Xavius's influence.
pairs.text: 有人在阿苏纳的北部海滩上发现了萨特军团的踪迹。他们正在使用梦魇碎片，以扩大萨维斯的影响力。

pairs.source: Shala'nir, the druid grove at the base of the world tree, has been overrun by the satyr and their leader, Banehoof. Send our champions to kill Banehoof.
pairs.text: 世界树底部的德鲁伊林地沙拉尼尔已经被萨特和他们的首领灾蹄所攻占。派出我们的勇士，前去杀掉灾蹄。
为传送门供能：瓦尔莎拉

pairs.source: We've received a call for aid from the tauren tribes who live along the Sylvan Falls. Satyr scouting camps have begun raiding their villages.
pairs.text: 我们最近收到报告，居住在林荫瀑布附近的牛头人部族请求帮助。萨特的斥候营地开始攻击他们的村庄了。
为传送门供能：林荫瀑布

pairs.source: The Broken Isles harbor many arcane secrets. We should send out our mages and discover as many as we can!
pairs.text: 破碎群岛隐藏着许多奥术秘密。我们必须派出法师过去，发掘尽可能多的秘密！

pairs.source: The Nightborne Vault is located deep within the Legion incursion area of Suramar. If Archmage Vargoth has been there, we should find signs of him.
pairs.text: 夜之子宝库位于苏拉玛的燃烧军团所进攻区域的深处。如果大法师瓦格斯已经到过那里，我们应该可以找到他的痕迹。

pairs.source: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Nightborne Vault
pairs.text: 大法师瓦格斯的旅行：夜之子宝库

pairs.source: The Dreamgrove is established, but we are going to need help. Sister Lilith, a renowned troop trainer, sent word that she is en route but has been attacked!
pairs.text: 梦境林地已经建好了，但我们还需要帮助。莉莉丝是位有名的部队训练师，她捎来口信说自己正在途中，但遭受了攻击！

pairs.source: Sundersong Glade is under attack by the Legion's forces. This is a perfect opportunity to test our new troops in the field, and to unlock vital knowledge.
pairs.text: 碎歌林地正在遭受燃烧军团的进攻。这是个绝佳的机会，我们可以实地测试下新的部队，并且了解关键信息。

pairs.source: Odyn has chosen you to command his armies, but we are going to need to train a combat-ready force. Send Ragnvald to find the greatest vrykul captain.
pairs.text: 奥丁选择了让你来指挥他的军队，但我们需要训练出一支拥有战斗力的部队。派拉格瓦尔德出去，找到最强大的维库人队长。

pairs.source: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our efforts. This will allow us to free a prisoner held at a village loyal to Helya.
pairs.text: 我们已经招募了一些部队，可以用来为我们的事业添砖加瓦。这样我们可以去一个效忠海拉的村庄，解救那里的一名囚犯。

pairs.source: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our champions' efforts.  The extra forces will allow us to free a prisoner held captive.
pairs.text: 我们已经招募了一些部队，可以用来为勇士提供增援。多余的部队能让我们解救一名被俘虏的囚犯。

pairs.source: We've watched for hunters who might contribute to the order. Recruiter Lenara, a renowned troop trainer, has been attacked!  Send Loren Stormhoof to her aid.
pairs.text: 我们正在留意那些可能会对组织有所贡献的猎人。征募官乐娜拉是位著名的部队训练师，但她遭受了攻击！派罗伦·雷蹄去帮助她。

pairs.source: Now that we've recruited some troops, it's time to put them in the field. Hostile Feltotem have been kidnapping our allies, and need to be taught a lesson.
pairs.text: 现在我们已经招募了一些部队，是时候把他们投入到实战中了。邪能图腾的敌人一直在绑架我们的盟友，得给他们点教训尝尝。

pairs.source: Our scouts in the field will have the information we need to help determine where to focus our efforts. We need to gather their reports.
pairs.text: 我们在野外的斥候会有些消息，可以帮我们确定当前的重点。我们需要收集他们的报告。

pairs.source: We need reinforcements in order to defeat Hakkar! Most have answered our call, but Shandris Feathermoon remains mired in battle with the naga. Help her, so she will help us in return.
pairs.text: 我们需要援军的帮助来击败哈卡！大多数盟友都响应了我们的召唤，但珊蒂斯·羽月依然深陷在和纳迦的战斗中。去帮帮她，作为回报，她也会给我们提供帮助。

pairs.source: To train new broken warriors how to deal with the new Burning Legion, Battlelord Gaardoun is requesting that you gather demonic implements.
pairs.text: 为了训练破碎者战士来应对新的燃烧军团，战争领主加尔顿要你去收集恶魔的工具。

pairs.source: The dead dreadlord, Razelikh the Defiler, has returned to the world. Strangely, he sometimes goes around killing other demons.
pairs.text: 死去的恐惧魔王，污染者拉瑟莱克回到了这个世界。奇怪的是，有时候他会四处晃荡，杀死其他的恶魔。

pairs.source: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our champions' efforts. The Hatecoil naga have disturbed a massive water elemental.
pairs.text: 我们已经招募了一些部队，可以用来为勇士提供增援。积怨纳迦惊扰了一个巨型水元素。

pairs.source: Assign a champion here to be your combat ally.
pairs.text: 在这里指派一名勇士作为你的战友。

pairs.source: At night, our camps are beset with the howls and cries of the local wildlife, namely the prowlers that come out of the woods to seek easy prey.
pairs.text: 入夜以后，我们的营地里充斥着当地野生动物的嚎叫，那是从树林里出来觅食的潜伏者。

pairs.source: A nearby cave has been taken over by a massive, slumbering bear. Clear out the cave, so we can rest easier ourselves.
pairs.text: 附近的一个洞穴被一只打盹的巨熊占领了。把这个洞穴清空，让我们自己可以在里面舒舒服服休息下。

pairs.source: The Garden of Elune has fallen to terrifying shadow-creatures, including a night elf sorceress now known only as The Oracle.
pairs.text: 艾露恩的花园落入了恐怖的暗影生物手中，其中有一个暗夜精灵巫师，也就是现在人们所称的神谕者。

pairs.source: For centuries, the Nightwatchers kept Nar'thalas safe and beautiful. Now, it's fallen to the naga, and even their own spirits turn against them.
pairs.text: 几个世纪以来，守夜人一直守护着纳萨拉斯的安全和美丽。现在，它已经落入纳迦之手，甚至他们自己的灵魂也背叛了他们。

pairs.source: It's one thing to have to camp in the middle of the woods, and it's another to wake full of tiny darts and surrounded by evil sprites.
pairs.text: 在树林地扎营是一回事，醒来后身上全是小动物，还被一群邪恶的林精包围，这就是另外一码事了。

pairs.source: Our sentries are terrified. At night, some great creature screeches and howls at them from the darkness. Seek out the terror that flaps in the night.
pairs.text: 我们的哨兵被吓坏了。夜里的时候，有些巨大的生物隐匿在黑暗之中，向他们发出尖啸和嚎叫。去找出这些在夜里制造恐怖的来源。

pairs.source: Faronaar is one of the Legion's most well-protected bastions in Azsuna. If we can take out some of their powerful demons, we will have the advantage.
pairs.text: 法罗纳尔是燃烧军团在阿苏纳保护最森严的堡垒之一。如果我们能干掉几个强大恶魔，就能夺得一些优势。

pairs.source: The drogbar have burrowed their way out of the hills of Suramar, and are causing structural instability to the buildings in the area. We should root them out.
pairs.text: 卓格巴尔在苏拉玛的山中挖掘了无数地道，让这一带的建筑结构不太稳定。必须把他们根除。

pairs.source: Outside the Moon Guard Stronghold, a siegemaster is blocking the way with a massive arcane siege weapon.
pairs.text: 在月之守卫要塞的外面，一名攻城大师制造了一台巨大的奥术攻城武器，挡住了出路。

pairs.source: The Hall of the Guardian is established, but we are going to need more help. Archmage Omniara, a renowned Elemental Summoner, was just attacked!
pairs.text: 守护者圣殿已经建好了，但我们还需要帮助。著名的元素召唤者大法师欧妮娅拉刚刚受到了攻击！

pairs.source: Highmountain has a bear problem. Not just any bears, but bears cursed and corrupted by the harpies. We should cull them and end their suffering.
pairs.text: 至高岭的熊是让人头疼的问题。并非普通的熊，而是被鹰身人诅咒和腐蚀了熊。我们必须杀掉它们，结束它们的痛苦。

pairs.source: The Highmountain tauren have called for reinforcements to protect Thunder Totem from drogbar invaders. We should bolster their borders.
pairs.text: 至高岭牛头人向我们请求援军，帮他们保护雷霆图腾免受卓格巴尔的入侵。我们要帮助他们守住边境。

pairs.source: At the worst possible time, we have a worgen hunter who's gone mad. He's setting out traps for our allies. Hunt the hunter.
pairs.text: 在最糟糕的时刻，我们有个狼人猎手发疯了。他布下的陷阱坑了我们自己的盟友。去狩猎那名猎手吧。

pairs.source: Along the coast of Azsuna, the Britterbrine raiders have collected and hoarded vast amounts of loot. We should see if we can claim any.
pairs.text: 在阿苏纳的海岸沿线，苦水强盗搜罗了大量的战利品。我们去看看能否抢回一些。

pairs.source: The Hatecoil hold an ace up their sleeves - if naga had sleeves. They have a massive creature, ready to summon at any moment. Destroy Golza.
pairs.text: 积怨者还有张王牌藏在袖子里——如果纳迦有袖子的话。他们还有一只巨大的生物，以供随时召唤。消灭贡尔扎。

pairs.source: The vrykul use runestones to summon powerful elementals, including Boulderfall, the Eroded, who can block the flow of rivers vital to the life of the valley.
pairs.text: 维库人使用符文石召唤强大的元素生物，包括被侵蚀的崩岩，它能够截断河流，让峡谷的生存遭到威胁。

pairs.source: In the Drowned Gardens of Azsuna, the Hatecoil naga have disturbed the souls of the Nightwatchers. Seek out and destroy their Stormbringer sorceress.
pairs.text: 在阿苏纳的水下花园中，积怨纳迦惊扰了守夜人的灵魂。找出并消灭他们的风暴使者女巫。

pairs.source: Dalaran is no stranger to attack, but sometimes the threat comes from within. A mage's experimental creature has escaped into the sewers.
pairs.text: 达拉然受到攻击不足为奇，但有时候威胁是来自于内部。一个法师的实验生物逃进了下水道。

pairs.source: Off the coast of Suramar, the naga have set up a stronghold. Below, Reef Lord Raj'his gathers a powerful army of ocean-dwellers.
pairs.text: 在苏拉玛沿海的地方，纳迦们建立了一座要塞。要塞的下方，暗礁领主拉希斯聚集了一支由海洋生物所组成的强大军队。

pairs.source: The lion seals of Azsuna are taking up much of the viable shoreline and driving everyone away. Remove Ravyn-Drath, and the others will follow.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的海狮占据了大部分可栖息的海岸线，把其他动物都赶走了。赶走拉文达斯，其他海狮也会跟随而去。

pairs.source: Some beasts don't wait for the cover of darkness to attack, and Abesha, a pale beast, has been stalking our allies in broad daylight. Dispose of the beast.
pairs.text: 有的野兽不会等到夜幕降临才发动攻击。阿比莎，一只全身白毛的野兽，在大白天的时候就跟踪尾随我们的盟友。干掉那只野兽。

pairs.source: An attack squad of demons has emerged from Legion Camp: Chaos, and now threatens our allies in Azsuna. Seek out Lord Gorgamesh and his wyrmtongues.
pairs.text: 一支恶魔的突袭分队正从军团营地：混沌涌出，他们威胁到了我们在阿苏纳的盟友。干掉高戈麦什领主和他的虫语者。

pairs.source: Even other nightborne are afraid of Lilith the Terrible, who stalks the night with her dreaded Infiltrators. Face all fears, and dispose of Lilith.
pairs.text: 就连其他夜之子也都十分畏惧可怕的莉莉丝，她和恐怖的渗透者一起潜伏在黑夜中。直面所有的恐惧，解决掉莉莉丝。

pairs.source: Defending the borders of Suramar, Guardian Thor'el is sworn to attack anyone that approaches the city. Strike at the guardian to help clear a path.
pairs.text: 卫兵索艾尔守卫着苏拉玛的边境，他发誓要干掉任何胆敢靠近这座城市的敌人。攻击这名卫兵，扫清进城的道路。

pairs.source: The evil magic of the Nightmare has been seeping into the rivers of Val'sharah, and altered the aquatic life to a terrible degree.
pairs.text: 梦魇的邪恶魔法已经渗入到瓦尔莎拉的河流中，将水中的生命变得极为恐怖。

pairs.source: The vrykul's long-dead ancestors rise from their graves, threatening our allies. Face the Nameless King, and put him back to rest.
pairs.text: 维库人早已死去的先祖从墓穴中复活了，威胁着我们的盟友。直面无名君王，让他再度安息。

pairs.source: Harpies love anything shiny, and the skywitches of Highmountain have stolen a piece of the vessel. Take it back, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.
pairs.text: 鹰身人喜欢一切闪亮的东西，至高岭的天空女巫们偷走了容器的一块碎片。把它找回来，这样我们才能布置针对哈卡的陷阱。

pairs.source: A fragment of the vessel has fallen into the hands of Aughild the Bitter, a failed valkyra aspirant. Recover it from her, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.
pairs.text: 一个容器的碎片落于怨恨的阿格希尔德之手，她是一个落选的瓦尔基拉候选者。从她那里把容器找回来，这样我们才能布置针对哈卡的陷阱。

pairs.source: Dark storms still gather above the Tomb of Sargeras, where the Legion army has gathered. Let us send our champions to the Broken Shore to scout the area and look for survivors.
pairs.text: 黑暗风暴依然汇集在萨格拉斯之墓上方，燃烧军团的部队在那里集结。我们要把勇士们派到破碎海滩去侦察那片区域并寻找生还者。

pairs.source: Now that we have some recruits, we should deploy them in the field. A wrathguard, Valitos, leads a demon attack on Hearthglen. Let us send our champions to aid the citizens there.
pairs.text: 现在我们已经招募了一些新兵，可以把他们投入到战场中了。愤怒卫士瓦里托斯带领恶魔攻击了壁炉谷。我们派遣勇士去支援当地的人民吧。

pairs.source: The vrykul of Stormheim compete fiercely to win the favor of the Valkyra, and Isel the Hammer smiths their shields. We should remove her.
pairs.text: 风暴峡湾的维库人为了得到瓦尔基拉的青睐在进行激烈的竞争，“大锤”伊赛尔负责为他们锻造护盾。我们必须除掉她。

pairs.source: Wandering the remains of a ruined tower in Suramar, the nightborne Cadraeus threatens the roads and any travelers in the area.
pairs.text: 夜之子卡德乌斯在苏拉玛倒塌的塔楼废墟中游荡，威胁着道路和附近的旅行者。

pairs.source: Crab Rider Grmlrml seems to have found a new way of getting around. If it takes hold, we could be looking at an invasion of crab-riding murlocs.
pairs.text: 看起来海蟹骑手格姆尔找到了一个新的方法来四处游荡。如果让他的方法流传开，我们将来就会面临骑着海蟹的鱼人的进攻。

pairs.source: In the Temple of a Thousand Lights, ancient mages still linger in the form of spirits and banshees. Destroy Arcanist Thinwhisp and her Ancient Flamecallers.
pairs.text: 在千光神殿中，远古的法师们以灵体和女妖的形态徘徊不去。杀死奥术师淡鹬，消灭她的上古召焰者。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has transformed once-beautiful creatures into twisted visions. Wraithtalon, once a mighty hippogryph, now preys upon our allies.
pairs.text: 梦魇将曾经美丽的生物转化为了扭曲的幻象。怒爪曾经是只威猛的角鹰兽，现在却把我们的盟友当作猎物。

pairs.source: The murlocs of Shipwreck Cove have caused more than their fair share of wrecks. Dispose of their Grand Admiral, and the waterways should be safer.
pairs.text: 沉船海湾的鱼人们已经造成了太多的海难。干掉他们的将军，让航路更安全。

pairs.source: The Nar'thalas Academy was once a place of great learning. Although it is now in ruins, we know Archmage Vargoth visited it recently.
pairs.text: 纳萨拉斯学院曾经是个求学氛围浓厚的地方。虽然现在已经成为了废墟，但我们知道大法师瓦格斯最近到访过这里。

pairs.source: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: Ruins of Nar'thalas
pairs.text: 大法师瓦格斯的旅行：纳萨拉斯废墟

pairs.source: The magical tome we found most likely came from Tel'anor. We may be able to learn more of Archmage Vargoth's travels there if you send a champion.
pairs.text: 我们发现的这本魔法书籍很可能来自于泰安诺。如果你能派出一名勇士，也许我们可以了解更多关于大法师瓦格斯在那里旅行的情况。

pairs.source: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Scholars of Tel'anor
pairs.text: 大法师瓦格斯的旅行：泰安诺的学者

pairs.source: The crystal ball we found in Archmage Vargoth's study was used by Grommash Hellscream. We should send a Champion to investigate its former location in Ashenvale.
pairs.text: 我们在大法师瓦格斯的研究中所发现的水晶球被格罗玛什·地狱咆哮使用过。我们应该派一名勇士去调查一下它之前所在的灰谷。

pairs.source: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Forests of Ashenvale
pairs.text: 大法师瓦格斯的旅行：灰谷的森林

pairs.source: Zooti Fizzlefury is Archmage Vargoth's closest friend and confidant. Send a champion to Archmage Khadgar's tower in Talador to see if Zooti is still there.
pairs.text: 佐提·轮怒是大法师瓦格斯最好的朋友和知己。派一名勇士前往大法师卡德加在塔拉多的法师塔，看看佐提是否还在那里。

pairs.source: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: Best Friends Forever
pairs.text: 大法师瓦格斯的旅行：最好的朋友

pairs.source: Verdisa of the green dragonflight has asked for our help in capturing roving satyr warbands in Val'sharah. Help take down their foes!
pairs.text: 绿龙军团的沃尔蒂萨请求我们的援助，帮他们活捉在瓦尔莎拉徘徊的萨特军团。帮忙击败他们的敌人！
魔环的准备工作：梦魇般的情景

pairs.source: Belgaristrasz of the red dragonflight has contacted us with a plan to retake the Oculus. He needs as many Legion communication devices as can be found.
pairs.text: 红龙军团的贝加里斯塔兹已经联系了我们，他们有个重新夺取魔环的计划。他需要尽可能多的燃烧军团通信装置。
魔环的准备工作：通讯中断

pairs.source: We will need to boost our power if we are to break through the wards surrounding the Oculus. The Ley Ruins of Zarkhenar are continually spilling out ley energy.
pairs.text: 要想突破包围魔环的那些守卫，我们还需要更多的能量。扎赫纳尔魔网废墟一直溢出魔网能量。
魔环的准备工作：用魔网干掉他们

pairs.source: Eternos of the Bronze Dragonflight reports a Legion invasion near the Bronze Dragonshrine in Dragonblight. He requests our aid!
pairs.text: 青铜龙军团的伊特努斯报告，在龙骨荒野的青铜巨龙圣地附近出现了燃烧军团入侵的踪迹。他要求我们施以援手！
魔环的准备工作：伊特努斯

pairs.source: Verdisa, Belgaristrasz, and Eternos are reluctant to return to the Oculus themselves. However, some of their strongest drakes will aid us if we clear the way.
pairs.text: 沃尔蒂萨、贝加里斯塔兹和伊特努斯不愿亲自返回魔环。不过，只要我们扫清道路，他们最强大的一些幼龙就会来帮我们。
魔环的准备工作：采取攻势

pairs.source: A small demon force has been located in eastern Azsuna, and rumors are that they report directly to Balnazzar. Send our champions to confront them.
pairs.text: 有人在阿苏纳东部发现了一支小型恶魔部队，传言说他们直接听命于巴纳扎尔。派出我们的勇士，与他们正面交锋。

pairs.source: An order of priests from the Conclave have been spotted combing the landing site of the Broken Shore, searching for survivors amidst dangerous demons.
pairs.text: 有人发现教团的一队祭司正在破碎海滩的登陆点附近搜索，在危险的恶魔中寻找生还者。
大领主的命令：神圣同盟

pairs.source: The furbolgs of Val'sharah appear to have come under a demonic influence. We must investigate at once.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉的熊怪好像受到了恶魔的影响。我们必须立刻进行调查。
大领主的命令：军团防御

pairs.source: We've made contact with a tribe of Highmountain tauren. They have an excess supply of furs and leather, but a demon incursion stands in the way.
pairs.text: 我们已经和一个至高岭的牛头人部族进行了接触。他们拥有多余的皮毛和皮革，但恶魔进攻阻碍了贸易。
大领主的命令：获取军需

pairs.source: A small demon force has been located in eastern Aszuna, and rumors are that they report directly to Balnazzar. Send our champions to confront them, and extract any information we can about the dreadlord's location.
pairs.text: 有人在阿苏纳东部发现了一支小型恶魔部队，传言说他们直接听命于巴纳扎尔。派出我们的勇士，与他们正面交锋，并且收集任何跟恐惧魔王所在地有关的信息。

pairs.source: The sorcerer Thal'kiel was one of the first Eredar who learned the techniques of summoning and controlling demons. His skull would make a powerful weapon if we can locate it.
pairs.text: 巫师萨奇尔是最早学会召唤和控制恶魔的艾瑞达人之一。如果我们能找到他的颅骨下落，那将成为强大的武器。

pairs.source: Wielded by Sataiel, the first necrolyte, the Deadwind Harvester earned its name by stripping the life from the lands known as Deadwind pass. After centuries locked away, Ulthalesh has been discovered in the posession of the Dark Riders - we must track them down.
pairs.text: 第一位通灵师萨泰尔挥舞着逆风收割者，在逆风小径夺取了无数生命，这也是那把神器名字的来源。在被深藏了几个世纪之后，有人发现乌萨勒斯在黑暗骑士的手上——必须找到他们的下落。

pairs.source: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout the hills of Highmountain, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.
pairs.text: 我们需要找到一位精通召唤强大恶魔的术士。在至高岭的群山中进行侦察，留意任何有潜力的人。

pairs.source: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Azsuna, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.
pairs.text: 我们需要找到一位精通召唤强大恶魔的术士。在阿苏纳进行侦察，留意任何有潜力的人。

pairs.source: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Val'sharah, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.
pairs.text: 我们需要找到一位精通召唤强大恶魔的术士。在瓦尔莎拉进行侦察，留意任何有潜力的人。

pairs.source: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Stormheim, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.
pairs.text: 我们需要找到一位精通召唤强大恶魔的术士。在风暴峡湾进行侦察，留意任何有潜力的人。

pairs.source: A group of former Lieutenants of Al'Akir have opposed the rule of the new Windlord. One of them, Mistius, has been particularly violent against the Earthen Ring.
pairs.text: 一些奥拉基尔从前的军官反对新的风元素领主的统治，其中米斯图斯对大地之环的反对尤为激烈。
桑德兰的敌人：米斯图斯

pairs.source: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir has opposed the rule of the new Windlord. This lieutenant, Zeph, has been setting up multiple ambushes against the Earthen Ring.
pairs.text: 一位奥拉基尔从前的军官反对新的风元素领主的统治。这位名为泽弗的军官已经针对大地之环发动多次伏击。

pairs.source: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir has sided with the Burning Legion. This lieutenant, Alacris, must be stopped before he sparks a rebellion from within Skywall.
pairs.text: 一位奥拉基尔从前的军官已经站在燃烧军团一边。必须阻止这位名为阿拉克里斯的军官，防止他在天空之墙内部发动叛乱。
桑德兰的敌人：阿拉克里斯

pairs.source: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir is seeking to undermine the war effort. This lieutenant, Tulmos, must be defeated before more lives are lost.
pairs.text: 一位奥拉基尔从前的军官正在想方设法破坏我们在战争中的投入。必须击败这位名为图尔莫斯的军官，防止更多生命白白牺牲。
桑德兰的敌人：图尔莫斯

pairs.source: Elementalist Janai has requested that we send a strike team to the Firelands to collect Cinderweb eggs for her research.
pairs.text: 元素师佳奈请求我们派出一支突击小队前往火焰之地，收集烬网蛛卵以进行研究。

pairs.source: On a recent expedition to Deepholm, one of our teams recorded strange seismic activity. These were not ordinary tremors... We should investigate further.
pairs.text: 最近对深岩之洲的探索中，我们队伍中的一名成员记录下了奇怪的地震活动。这些可不是普通的震动……我们需要进行深入的调查。

pairs.source: The dragon Zeryxia has been slain, but the Twilight's Hammer has not fully abandoned their efforts in Deepholm. We should send a strike team.
pairs.text: 巨龙泽瑞西亚已经被杀死，但暮光之锤并没有彻底放弃他们在深岩之洲的努力。我们应该派出一支突击小队。

pairs.source: The elementals of the Firelands are engaged in an epic battle for supremacy. We must send our Champions to undergo a trial of strength.
pairs.text: 火焰之地的元素们为了夺取霸权而进行着激烈的战斗！我们必须派出勇士，接受力量的试炼。

pairs.source: The Uncrowned have been established, but we are going to need help.
pairs.text: 无冕者的组织已经建立，但我们还需要帮助。

pairs.source: Lord Ravenholdt has provided a sizeable sum of gold in order to entice Winstone Wolfe to work for the Uncrowned. "The Wolf" is staying at Ravenholdt Manor.
pairs.text: 拉文霍德公爵提供了相当数量的金币，引诱温斯顿·沃尔菲为无冕者效力。“孤狼”正呆在拉文霍德庄园中。

pairs.source: We were attacked by relentless harpies. Defend against the attack and take down their leader.
pairs.text: 我们遭到了鹰身人的无情攻击。守住这次攻击，干掉他们的领袖。
弗蕾亚之泉：鹰身人主母

pairs.source: Andu'talah has fallen to the Nightmare, and Xavius seeks the power of the vessel. He hid a piece of it there. Retrieve it, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.
pairs.text: 安杜塔拉已经堕入了梦魇，萨维斯正在追寻容器的力量。他把容器的一块碎片藏在了那里。把那块碎片找回来，这样我们才能布置针对哈卡的陷阱。

pairs.source: The spirits at the Temple of a Thousand Lights have stolen a piece of the vessel, and are using it to empower themselves. Take it, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.
pairs.text: 千光神殿中的灵魂偷走了一块容器的碎片，用来为他们提供力量。把碎片夺回来，这样我们才能布置针对哈卡的陷阱。

pairs.source: Matron Mother Malevolence has supplied you with a list of hard-to-find fel magic apparatuses. They will prove useful.
pairs.text: 主母玛沃伦丝给你提供了一份遗失很久的邪能魔法装置的清单。它们会非常有用的。

pairs.source: Belath Dawnblade has asked you to send your Ashtongue warriors to infiltrate the Black Temple. This will prepare you to confront Akama.
pairs.text: 贝拉斯·黎明之刃请求你派出灰舌战士渗透到黑暗神殿中。这可以帮你做好准备，直面阿卡玛。

pairs.source: When the Legion invaded the Vault of the Wardens, it wasn't just the Illidari who escaped. Sira Moonwarden has asked for our assistance.
pairs.text: 当燃烧军团入侵守望者地窟时，从那里逃脱的并非只有伊利达雷。赛拉·月卫请求我们提供援助。

pairs.source: Working With the Wardens: Isle of the Watchers
Sira Moonwarden is asking that we hunt down and either capture or kill the satyr known as Skul'vrax. His last known whereabouts were at the Tidal Marsh.
pairs.text: 赛拉·月卫请求我们追踪一个名为斯库瓦克斯的萨特的下落，无论将其抓获或击杀均可。他最后出现的地点在潮汐沼泽。
配合守望者：斯库瓦克斯

pairs.source: Mellok, Son of Torok is a leader within the new Feltotem tribe, pledging himself to the Legion. The Wardens have asked us to deal with him.
pairs.text: 麦罗克，图鲁克之子是新的邪能图腾部落的领袖，他向燃烧军团宣誓效忠。守望者请求我们解决他。

pairs.source: Working With the Wardens: Mellok, Son of Torok
pairs.text: 配合守望者：麦罗克，图鲁克之子

pairs.source: A fel-corrupted storm dragon named Fathnyr occasionally ranges out from its Thorim's Peak aerie. The Wardens have been harassed by the beast.
pairs.text: 有名为法斯尼尔的风暴巨龙受到了邪能的腐蚀，他偶尔会从托里姆峰的巢穴中飞出来。守望者正饱受这只野兽的骚扰。

pairs.source: An eredar named Mal'Dreth the Corruptor convinced several of the Warden adepts to turn traitor and work for the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 一个名为腐蚀者马尔戴斯的艾瑞达诱惑了守望者中的几位精英，让他们背叛了守望者，为燃烧军团效力。

pairs.source: Working With the Wardens: Mal'Dreth the Corruptor
pairs.text: 配合守望者：腐蚀者马尔戴斯

pairs.source: A Legion command ship has appeared on the horizon. Send our champions to lead them away from the Wandering Isle!
pairs.text: 一艘军团指挥舰出现在天际。派出我们的勇士，把他们从迷踪岛引开！

pairs.source: Even in death, the souls of Azsuna cannot be at peace. Gilamore the Sinister has raised a company of spirit-mages. Stop her, and lay those souls to rest.
pairs.text: 死亡也无法让阿苏纳的灵魂得到安息。邪恶的吉拉摩尔培养了一群幽灵法师。阻止她，让那些灵魂安息吧。

pairs.source: On the rocky northern coast of Stormheim, a sea giant has been causing havoc for all ships in the area. We need that coast cleared.
pairs.text: 在风暴峡湾北部多山的海岸上，一个海巨人给这片区域中的所有船舶带来了灾难。我们需要确保海岸线的安全。

pairs.source: At the base of the Weeping Bluffs, a disturbed water elemental is making it impossible for us to reach the wreckage of our sky-ships.
pairs.text: 在泣风崖的底部有一个不安分的水元素，它的存在让我们无法到达飞船的残骸地点。

pairs.source: The Ruined Sanctum stands as a sad reminder of what has been lost to time. Yet its ancient guardian still stands watch. We should put Syphonus to rest.
pairs.text: 荒废圣殿矗立在那里，作为令人悲伤的标志，提醒着我们在岁月中失去的一切。而它古老的守卫者依然在履行职责。我们必须让赛法努斯安息。

pairs.source: At the edge of Nightmare, the satyr are spreading their influence right to the doorstep of Malorne's Refuge. Take out their leader, Kalazzius the Guileful.
pairs.text: 在梦魇的边缘，萨特正在扩散他们的影响力，甚至已经来到了玛洛恩的庇护所门前。干掉他们的首领，狡猾的卡拉苏斯。

pairs.source: Few creatures are as tough and resilient as the mountain ettin, and thus, they make the perfect target to test our munitions.
pairs.text: 很少有生物能像山岭双头怪一样强壮和坚韧，它们也正好是我们用来测试弹药的最佳目标。

pairs.source: What was once a place of peace has become the realm of nightmare. Dreadful creatures spread darkness and filth through Val'sharah.
pairs.text: 这里曾经是个宁静祥和之地，现在已经成为了梦魇的国度。恐怖的生物正在瓦尔莎拉四处散布着黑暗和污秽。

pairs.source: The harpies of Highmountain will take any chance they get to harass and curse our allies, and steal our supplies. We should target them in their nests.
pairs.text: 至高岭的鹰身人会抓住一切机会骚扰和诅咒我们的盟友，偷走我们的补给。我们应该把他们的巢穴作为目标。

pairs.source: Not only do we have a murloc problem, we have a murloc that's stolen vrykul armor. See if you can put a stop to Grrvrgull the Conqueror.
pairs.text: 我们面对的不仅是鱼人的问题，还有一个鱼人偷走了维库人的护甲。去看看你们有没有办法阻止征服者格古尔。

pairs.source: High in the mountains over Stormheim, the matriarch of the Stormwing dragons builds her brood. We should slay her and her spawn.
pairs.text: 在风暴峡湾的高山之巅，风暴之翼的巨龙女王构筑了巢穴。我们要杀了她和她的子嗣。

pairs.source: One of our allies believes that Anax, the giant toad in Suramar, must secrete some kind of useful venom. Seek out Anax, and see what you can find.
pairs.text: 我们的一位盟友认为，苏拉玛的一只巨型蟾蜍阿纳克斯会分泌一些非常有用的毒液。找到阿纳克斯，看看会有什么发现。

pairs.source: Felsoul Hold is churning out infernals almost too fast for us to handle. We should purge their numbers, so the Legion cannot rain them down.
pairs.text: 邪魂堡垒正在制造大量的地狱火，速度之快远不是我们所能应对的。必须削减它们的数量，否则就要面对铺天盖地的地狱火雨了。

pairs.source: The local tribes have been terrorized by a giant fish lurking in the lakes of Highmountain. It's made off with a few of the fishermen as well.
pairs.text: 至高岭的湖水中藏着一条巨鱼，让当地的部族惊恐不已。这条鱼也吓走了一些渔夫。

pairs.source: Among the peaks of Highmountain, a lone ettin has been causing havoc for travelers traveling up the peak. Clear out Oubdob da Smasher.
pairs.text: 在至高岭的山巅，一头独行的双头怪在给旅行者制造灾难。清除碾压者奥布多布。

pairs.source: Our allies have hit a wall of storms in Galebroken Path, likely due to the awakened storm elemental raining down on them. Destroy Bladesquall.
pairs.text: 我们的盟友在碎风小径碰到了一道风暴，很可能是因为遭遇了苏醒的风暴元素。消灭风刀。

pairs.source: Undead kings and heroes aren't the only thing to worry about in the graveyards of the vrykul. Fjorlag, the Grave's Chill, stalks the living and dead.
pairs.text: 在这片维库人的坟地中，要担心的问题可不仅仅只是君王和英雄的亡灵。还有“墓穴冰魔”弗约拉格，他是徘徊于生死之间的幽灵。

pairs.source: Near Moonfall retreat in Suramar, spiders and their ilk have taken over the gardens. We should cut away their webs for our troops in that area.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛的月落庇护所附近，蜘蛛们占据了花园。我们得清除那些蜘蛛网，让我们的部队可以驻扎在这个区域。

pairs.source: The once-idyllic gardens of Ambervale are now overrun by withered husks. Among them, Shal'an grows ever more powerful.
pairs.text: 曾经如田园般的琥珀谷花园里现在已经全是枯法行尸。其中最强大的行尸名叫沙兰。

pairs.source: A worgen hunter by the name of Houndmaster Ely has taken it upon himself to hunt down the Forsaken, without regard for any chain of command.
pairs.text: 一个名叫驯犬者伊莱的狼人猎手坚持追捕被遗忘者，已经违反了上级的直接命令。

pairs.source: A harpy matron, known as Seersei, has been constructing statues of remarkable life-like qualities in the forest of Val'sharah.
pairs.text: 一个名叫希尔赛的鹰身人主母在瓦尔莎拉的森林中建造了栩栩如生的雕像。

pairs.source: Wormtalon harpies have taken over Shadowfen village, and the former residents seek some of their stolen valuables, as well as revenge. Provide both.
pairs.text: 虫爪鹰身人占据了影沼村，之前居住在那里的居民正在想方设法找回他们被偷走的贵重物品，同时也在寻求复仇。我们来把这两个问题都解决掉。

pairs.source: While we usually don't mind a sea giant that eats murlocs, Bodash the Hoarder has begun targeting anything that comes close to his home.
pairs.text: 通常我们并不会太在意一只以鱼人为食的海巨人。但是囤积者博达什开始把所有接近他栖息地的目标当作食物了。

pairs.source: Not much can fend off trinket-stealing harpies, but Skullhat, a skull-wearing kobold of the Skywhisker tribe, has managed to hole up in the harpies' hills.
pairs.text: 没有多少人能挡住喜欢偷窃小饰品的鹰身人，但天须部族的颅盔，一个戴着骷髅头盔的狗头人，却成功地在鹰身人的山岭中藏住了东西。

pairs.source: The vrykul infuse their tattoos with ancient magic, and hold their inkbinders in high regard. Destroying them will cripple the vrykul's ability to use that magic.
pairs.text: 维库人习惯将古代魔法注入到纹身之中，所以非常敬重缚墨者。杀掉缚墨者，可以削弱维库人使用这种魔法的能力。

pairs.source: Outside the walls of Skold-Ashil, a disgraced and fallen shieldmaiden named Lagertha has been plotting to forcefully take her place among the Valkyra.
pairs.text: 在斯考德-艾希尔墙壁外面，一个名叫拉格萨的堕落女武神正妄图强行在瓦尔基拉中夺取一个位置。

pairs.source: Dalaran has requested a supply of pristine sand. The best source of this would be from the notorious sand elemental, Beacher.
pairs.text: 达拉然请求供应原始之沙。这种沙子最理想的来源就是在阿苏纳所发现的那个臭名昭著的沙砾元素，滩沙。

pairs.source: In Suramar, a vrykul warrior named Hertha Grimdottir has been lying in wait for travelers. Put an end to her.
pairs.text: 在苏拉玛，一个名叫赫萨·格里姆多迪的维库人战士一直在伏击过往旅行者。干掉她。

pairs.source: Once a caretaker of the spirits at Shield's Rest, Runeseer Sigvid has gone mad while the Helejar defile graves. Put him out of his misery.
pairs.text: 符文先知希格维德曾经是盾憩岛上灵魂的看管者，当海拉加尔亵渎了墓地后，他就变得疯狂了。结束他的痛苦吧。

pairs.source: In the Halls of the Mountain King, the drogbar and vrykul are conducting all manner of strange rituals, harnessing the power of the mountain. Put a stop to it.
pairs.text: 在山丘之王的大厅里，卓格巴尔和维库人进行着各种奇怪的仪式，驾驭山岭的力量。阻止他们！

pairs.source: Beneath the boughs of Dreadroot, a powerful satyr named Thondrax is harnessing the energies of the Rotwood in order to perform a nightmarish ritual.
pairs.text: 在恐惧之根的枝干下，有一个名为松达克斯的强大萨特，他在利用腐林的力量进行梦魇仪式。

pairs.source: The sea giants are notorious for causing shipwrecks, but one in particular will go out of his way to drag any vessel onto the rocky shores of Azsuna.
pairs.text: 每个人都知道海巨人会带来海难，但有一个海巨人做得过头了。他会把所有船只拉到多岩的阿苏纳海滩。

pairs.source: Kobold legend speaks of a dark, devouring presence deep in the caverns of Highmountain. It is the reason kobolds fear the dark.
pairs.text: 狗头人传说中，在至高岭的洞穴深处，有一个吞噬一切的黑暗存在。这也是狗头人那么怕黑的原因。

pairs.source: The mages of Dalaran have requested a super dense fertilizer. The best material for this comes from the remains of Mac the Bear's meals, found in Azsuna.
pairs.text: 达拉然的法师请求提供超浓度的肥料。最合适的肥料就是巨熊马克餐后的排泄物，你可以在阿苏纳找到。

pairs.source: The Highmountain tribes cherish the hide of a rare and elusive creature, the Majestic Elderhorn, for their most important ceremonies. Track the beast.
pairs.text: 至高岭的部族对威严的大角鹿的毛皮奉若至宝，他们会在最重要的仪式上使用这种稀有而灵活的生物的毛皮。追踪这头野兽。

pairs.source: Watching over Skild-Ashil is the Ivory Sentinel, a titan construct made to ward off the unworthy. We must prove that our champions are mightier.
pairs.text: 守卫斯考德-艾希尔的是白色哨兵，它是个泰坦构造体，用于驱逐那些无能者。我们必须证明我们的英雄比它更强。

pairs.source: Overlooking Bradensbrook, the malicious ghost of Kiranys Duskwhisper defies any attempt to contain or dislodge him from his vigil.
pairs.text: 奇兰尼斯·暮语怨毒的鬼魂俯瞰着鲑鱼溪，任何胆敢阻碍他守望的人都会付出代价。

pairs.source: The Dead Exist in the Past
The Koralune ettin make the gardens of Ambervale their home in Suramar. One has been causing havoc, particularly if someone is an elf.
pairs.text: 一只库拉伦双头怪在苏拉玛琥珀谷的花园中安了家。它一直在制造灾难，精灵是最大的受害者。

pairs.source: A satyr named Perrexx has been making sport out of hunting the druids of Moonclaw Vale, as though they were trophies! Turn the tables on him.
pairs.text: 一个名叫皮里克斯的萨特一直以狩猎月爪谷的德鲁伊为乐，把德鲁伊当成了战利品！让他感受下被狩猎的滋味吧。

pairs.source: The vrykul have employed some unorthodox methods to tame storm drakes. One such tamer is Glimar Ironfist, the drake-wrestler.
pairs.text: 维库人有一些非传统的手段用来驯服风暴幼龙。其中一名驯兽师是葛利玛·铁拳，幼龙摔跤手。

pairs.source: The Skyhorn tribe in Highmountain has come under attack from a very large roc named Crawshuk the Hungry. The roc is causing terror in the village.
pairs.text: 至高岭中的天角部族受到一只巨型大鹏的攻击，它的名字是饥饿的克劳舒克。这只大鹏在村落中引起了恐慌。

pairs.source: The war has put a strain on supplies, and the troops crave fresh meat. A gigantic river crab named Tideclaw should provide enough to last them a while.
pairs.text: 战争给补给的供应带来了巨大的压力，部队渴望新鲜的肉。一只名叫潮爪的巨型河蟹可以提供足够的肉，让大家吃上一段时间。

pairs.source: Even in Dalaran, we must be ever vigilant for threats. The Legion have infiltrated through the sewers and seek to taint the drinking water of the citizens.
pairs.text: 即使是在达拉然，我们也必须时刻警惕着威胁。军团已经通过下水道渗透了进来，并伺机污染居民的饮用水。

pairs.source: Allari wants you to send your forces to scout Felsoul Hold in Suramar. Once there, they are to identify likely capture targets.
pairs.text: 阿莱利要你派出部队，侦查位于苏拉玛的邪魂堡垒。到了那里以后，他们要找到可能的俘虏目标。

pairs.source: Preparations for Invasion: Scouting their Hold
Not everyone has a set of artifact warglaives. If we are to invade a demon world, it would be best if the Illidari received improved weapons.
pairs.text: 并不是所有人都有一对神器战刃。如果要进攻一个恶魔世界，那么伊利达雷的武器最好应该改良一番。

pairs.source: Now that the Legion targets at Felsoul Hold have been observed for a while, it is time to send your most capable in to capture them.
pairs.text: 我们已经对邪魂堡垒中军团目标观察了一段时间，是时候派出你最得力的人手去抓捕他们了。

pairs.source: Preparations for Invasion: Snatch and Grab
It has been many years since the Fel Hammer was in full operational order. Jace needs all hands on deck to help out with some necessary maintenance.
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号的上一次全负荷作战已经是很多年前的事了。杰斯要求船上的所有人都去帮忙，进行必要的维修。

pairs.source: With the captured demons safely trapped below deck on the Fel Hammer, Allari is ready to apply her tender mercies and use the Scythe of Souls.
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号甲板下关押着被抓获的恶魔，阿莱利准备让他们见识一下什么叫慈悲，使用夺魂之镰。

pairs.source: Preparations for Invasion: Where Are the Felsouls?!
The Knights of the Ebon Blade have been established at Acherus, but we will need allies in our fight against the Legion.  Send Nazgrim to counter this threat.
pairs.text: 黑锋骑士团已经在阿彻鲁斯建立，但在对抗燃烧军团的战斗中，我们还需要更多盟友。让纳兹戈林来应对这次威胁。

pairs.source: Now that we have bolstered our numbers, we should display our might and place our troops in the field. The sea giants should be a suitable test of their skill.
pairs.text: 现在我们的人手已经得到了扩充，该展现我们的力量，把部队投入战场了。海巨人是合适的目标，可以用来检验他们的技能。

pairs.source: We've established Netherlight Temple as a sanctuary, but now it's time to send Calia Menethil to spread the word about its existence and enlist others.
pairs.text: 我们已经建立了虚空之光神殿，这里将成为我们的庇护所。现在应该派佳莉娅·米奈希尔去把这个消息传播出去，并且招募其他人。

pairs.source: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our champions' efforts.  Send them out on a routine scouting mission.
pairs.text: 我们已经招募了一些部队，可以用来为勇士提供增援。派他们去执行例行的侦察任务。

pairs.source: The Highmountain tribe have been afraid to leave their homes at night, thanks to a large cat prowling the border of the village.
pairs.text: 至高岭的部族害怕在夜里离开家门，因为有只巨大的猫科野兽潜行在他们村庄的边境附近。

pairs.source: Aluneth was most notably wielded for a time by Aegwynn, the only female Guardian of Tirisfal, although stories indicate that it is far older than she. After passing from her hands, it was eventually locked away in a secret vault, where it remains still.
pairs.text: 艾露尼斯最著名的经历是作为提瑞斯法守护者中唯一的女性成员艾格文的武器。但据很多故事中说，这把法杖的历史要比艾格文古老得多。在离开她的手中之后，这把法杖被藏在一个秘密的地窟里，一直尘封未动。

pairs.source: Artifact: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
pairs.text: 神器：艾露尼斯，护法者之杖

pairs.source: "Flamestrike" in its native tongue, Felo'melorn was borne into battle by members of the Sunstrider family. Ultimately, the sword was lost in Northrend.
pairs.text: 用精灵语命名的烈焰之击原本是逐日者家族所使用的战斗武器。这把剑最终遗失在诺森德。

pairs.source: Alodi's greatstaff, Ebonchill, was the bane of many demons in the Legion. After he retired his mantle of Guardian, the staff passed down through his apprentices, eventually lost to time. None know where it resides now, save perhaps Alodi himself.
pairs.text: 阿洛迪的圣杖黑檀之寒曾经是燃烧军团恶魔的克星。在阿洛迪从守护者的位置上退下来后，这把法杖传给了他的徒弟，并最终在时间的长河中失去了踪迹。也许除了阿洛迪本人，没人知道它现在的下落。

pairs.source: If we're going to throw SI:7 off our trail, we need to make a show of it. Let's start some false intrigue on our very own Archmage Khadgar.
pairs.text: 要摆脱军情七处的追踪，我们得演出戏。先从我们的大法师卡德加开始吧。

pairs.source: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Dalaran
Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has disappeared in Stormheim. Let SI:7 think we are hot on her trail. We are, but we will assign a decoy agent for SI:7 to notice.
pairs.text: 希尔瓦娜斯·风行者在风暴峡湾中消失了。让军情七处的人以为我们对她的下落非常着急。我们确实很着急，但还是需要安排一个作为诱饵的特工，引起军情七处的注意。

pairs.source: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Stormheim
We have a deep contact on the ground in Azsuna. He goes by many names, including Mr. Shackle. Send some people down there to "interfere" with him.
pairs.text: 我们在阿苏纳有个深藏不露的联络人。他有很多名字，其中一个是沙考尔先生。派些人去那里和他“谈谈”。

pairs.source: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Azsuna
The Highmountain tribes are outstanding warriors, hunters, and shaman. What they are not is stealthy. Setup surveillance of each tribe's camps.
pairs.text: 至高岭的部族有非常优秀的战士、猎人和萨满。但他们最不擅长隐匿和潜行。监视每个部族的营地。

pairs.source: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Highmountain
There is something with the nightborne in Suramar. Unfortunately, their city has too much protection. However, we should let SI:7 see us trying.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛的夜之子中一定发生了什么。很不幸，他们的城市有太多的保护措施。我们要让军情七处的人认为我们在努力侦察。

pairs.source: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Suramar
A young druid with great potential, Graham Silverclaw, led our scouts to the edge of Suramar. But he ran into a Legion hunting party, and he needs assistance.
pairs.text: 格拉哈姆·银爪是一位具有巨大潜力的年轻德鲁伊，他带领我们的斥候前往了苏拉玛的边缘地区。但他碰到了军团的捕猎活动，需要支援。
集合织梦者：格拉哈姆·银爪

pairs.source: Even in the forests of Ashenvale, the satyr, led by Rethazar the Fallen, have been spotted, and they may soon attack outright.
pairs.text: 就连灰谷的森林里，也有人发现了堕落者瑞萨扎尔所率领的萨特。他们可能很快就会对我们发动全面进攻。

pairs.source: The doom guard Metreon has rallied the satyr of Felwood, and they have attacked Moonglade itself! We cannot allow Moonglade to fall to the Legion.
pairs.text: 末日守卫密特隆聚集了费伍德森林里的萨特，开始攻击月光林地！我们不能让月光林地落在燃烧军团的手上。
为传送门供能：月光林地

pairs.source: Those who were once our friends have been claimed by the Nightmare, and the dryad keepers near Andu'talah are among those fallen.
pairs.text: 我们曾经的好友现在已经被梦魇所占据，安杜塔拉附近的树妖看护者也堕落了。
为传送门供能：安杜塔拉

pairs.source: We've received word that Oracle Tidecress, a powerful naga sorceress, has been meeting with the Darkfiend satyr. Slay her and her comrades.
pairs.text: 我们收到了消息称神谕者泰德瑞丝，一个强大的纳迦女巫，一直在与暗魔萨特会面了。杀掉她和她的同伙。
为传送门供能：卡德拉尔

pairs.source: Priests from all over Azeroth have been aiding our allies on the front lines since the Burning Legion began its invasion. It is time to send in some relief.
pairs.text: 自从燃烧军团入侵以来，艾泽拉斯各地的牧师都一直在前线为我们的盟友提供救助。是时候派人过去减轻他们的压力了。

pairs.source: Since the days of the Argent Dawn, Light's Hope Chapel has been a beacon of the Light on Azeroth. Travel there and collect a fragment of Light.
pairs.text: 从银色黎明的时代开始，圣光之愿礼拜堂就一直是圣光在艾泽拉斯大陆上的信标和灯塔。前去那里收集一块圣光的碎片。
神圣之地：圣光之愿礼拜堂

pairs.source: The priests of the Exodar have preserved a long tradition of the Light. Collect a fragment from the Exodar, and beware: the Legion may be drawn to it.
pairs.text: 埃索达的牧师们长期以来都保留着圣光的传统。从埃索达收集一块碎片。要小心，燃烧军团可能会被碎片吸引而来。

pairs.source: Uther the Lightbringer was the first paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand, and never faltered from his beliefs. His grave is sacred to followers of the Light, but it may also draw evil spirits.
pairs.text: 乌瑟尔·光明使者是白银之手骑士团的第一个圣骑士，他对圣光的信仰从未动摇。他的墓地对圣光的追随者来说无比神圣，但也会吸引一些邪恶的灵魂。

pairs.source: Deep beneath Auchindoun, the naaru D'ore has been regenerating into a being of pure Light once more. Seek out this holy shrine.
pairs.text: 在奥金顿的地下深处，纳鲁德欧里已经再生，成为纯净的圣光存在。到这座神圣之所看一看。

pairs.source: The Legion will do everything it can to stop us from revitalizing the wisp, and seek to intercept us before we can collect the last fragment.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团会不惜一切代价阻止我们让小精灵重新获得活力。在我们收集到最后一块碎片之前，燃烧军团会一直对我们围追堵截。

pairs.source: In order to fulfill Velen's prophecy, we must infiltrate our enemies and find out if any among them could make a potential ally.
pairs.text: 为实现维伦的预言，我们必须渗透到敌人内部，看看是否能将他们中的某些人变为我们的盟友。

pairs.source: The eredar at Faronaar smith weapons out of lumenstone. Strike at their forges and take the metal we seek, dealing a double blow to our enemies.
pairs.text: 法罗纳尔的艾瑞达人使用流明石锻造武器。攻击他们的熔炉，带走我们所寻找的金属，对他们造成双重打击。

pairs.source: The nightborne of Suramar city are studying the properties of lumenstone to augment their constructs. Break into the city and steal their supplies.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛城的夜之子正在研究流明石的性质，用以强化他们的建筑。进入城市，偷走他们的货物。

pairs.source: Our scouts report that the vrykul have acquired a cache of lumenstone weapons, and they intend to melt them down to create armor for their drakes.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说，维库人已经获得了一箱流明石武器，准备将它们熔铸，为他们的幼龙打造护甲。

pairs.source: The demons have left lumenstone weapons scattered all over the Broken Shore. If we move fast, we can recover those weapons.
pairs.text: 恶魔们遗留的流明石武器散布在破碎海滩各处。如果我们动作快点，还可以回收那些武器。

pairs.source: Long ago, a shipment of lumenstone was lost overboard during a terrible storm above Vashj'ir. Unfortunately, the naga may have found it before us.
pairs.text: 很久以前，我们运送流明石的船只在瓦丝琪尔上方遭遇了恐怖的暴风雨，不幸沉没了。更不幸的是，纳迦们在我们之前发现了这批货物。

pairs.source: There are still pockets of the brood queen's forces scattered about below us on Mardum. They could prove a threat to the Fel Hammer.
pairs.text: 蛛后还有一些部队残留在马顿，就在我们的下方。他们会对邪能之槌造成威胁。

pairs.source: The Broken Shore is the obvious location to begin our search for Master Mathias Shaw. We must determine where the Legion is holding him.
pairs.text: 要寻找马迪亚斯·肖尔大师，我们显然应该从破碎海滩开始。必须确定燃烧军团把他关押在哪里。

pairs.source: Where In the World is Mathias?: Obvious Start
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：明显的起点

pairs.source: Mathias is being moved around. Detheroc is a clever dreadlord. The trail leads to Black Rook Hold. Too bad you did not notice him before.
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯被关押的地方不停变化。迪瑟洛克是个很聪明的恐惧魔王。种种线索都在指向黑鸦堡垒。真可惜，你们之前都没发现他。

pairs.source: Where In the World is Mathias?: Black Rook Hold
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：黑鸦堡垒

pairs.source: The command center known as the Altar of End Times floats above Faronaar in Azsuna. Break in and have a look around.
pairs.text: 指挥中心末世祭坛漂浮在阿苏纳的法罗纳尔上空。突破进去，然后四处看看。

pairs.source: Where In the World is Mathias?: Altar of End Times
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：末世祭坛

pairs.source: The Burning Legion has a powerful ally in the vrykul God-King Skovald. Perhaps they are holding Mathias Shaw at the Gates of Valor.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团在维库人中有个强力的盟友，神王斯科瓦尔德。也许他们把马迪亚斯·肖尔关押在了勇者之门。

pairs.source: Where In the World is Mathias?: Gates of Valor
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：勇者之门

pairs.source: We seem to have run out of leads. Time to do the impossible. Time to sneak into SI:7 headquarters and see if Detheroc has left any clues for us.
pairs.text: 我们好像失去了线索。只能背水一战了。潜入到军情七处总部，看看迪瑟洛克有没有留下任何线索。

pairs.source: Where In the World is Mathias?: SI:7
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：军情七处

pairs.source: At the gates of the Hall of Valor, the Felskorn have assembled, including a massive brute named Cleaver Northamel. Slay him, and collect his blood.
pairs.text: 很多蔑魔者聚集在英灵殿的大门前，其中包括一个魁梧的蛮兵，斩杀者诺萨米尔。杀了他，收集他的血液。

pairs.source: The druids at Val'sharah have their hands full with the satyr and the Nightmare. We can help by destroying a rampaging satyr warband, led by Illbringer Zizzifrax.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉的德鲁伊正忙于应对萨特和梦魇。我们可以帮帮他们，摧毁疫病使者基兹法克斯所率领的萨特军团。

pairs.source: The Legion has desecrated the sacred burial sites of the Highmountain tribe, raising the bodies of the dead. We should put them back to rest.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团将死者的尸体复活，他们亵渎了至高岭部族神圣的埋骨之地。我们必须还他们安息。

pairs.source: In the Felbeast Dens, the Legion creates terrifyingly resilient breeds of manastalkers. We should disrupt their operation by killing Felbreeder Argnotha.
pairs.text: 在邪兽巢穴里，燃烧军团制造了新的魔法猎犬种类，它们的韧性异常恐怖。我们必须中断他们的行为，杀掉邪能哺育者阿格诺莎。

pairs.source: In Felsoul Hold, giant infernals and felbats attack any who come near. Dispose of a few, and collect their blood for our use.
pairs.text: 在邪魂堡垒中，巨型地狱火和魔蝠会攻击任何靠近的人。干掉几个这样的敌人，收集它们的鲜血供我们使用。

pairs.source: We need to send an emissary to the priests at Netherlight Temple. However, there may be danger along the way. Let us send Maxwell Tyrosus.
pairs.text: 我们需要向虚空之光神殿的牧师们派出一名大使。但沿途可能会有危险。派玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯去吧。

pairs.source: Word has reached us that another titan relic may reside in the Halls of Valor, far above Stormheim. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 我们收到消息说，另外一件泰坦圣物可能在风暴峡湾上方的英灵殿里。我们需要进行相关调查。

pairs.source: If we are to bring about the return of the Four Horsemen, then we will need to acquire suitable steeds. Send word for Salanar the Horsemen to come to Acherus.
pairs.text: 如果想让四骑士回归，需要有合适的战马。给骑手萨拉纳尔发出消息，让他来阿彻鲁斯。

pairs.source: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Invincible, the former steed of Arthas Menethil. Since the defeat of Arthas, it has been lost beneath Icecrown.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要阿尔萨斯·米奈希尔曾经的坐骑“无敌”的鞍座。自从阿尔萨斯被击败后，鞍座就遗失在了冰冠冰川。

pairs.source: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Frozen Crown
pairs.text: 堕落战马：冰冻皇冠的鞍座

pairs.source: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Deathcharger, the former steed of Baron Rivendare. Following his defeat, the saddle was returned to Stratholme.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要瑞文戴尔曾经的坐骑死亡战马的鞍座。自从他被击败后，鞍座被送回了斯坦索姆。

pairs.source: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle used by the great Sir Thomas, the Headless Horseman. The saddle is buried in the cemetery of the Scarlet Monastery.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要伟大的托马斯爵士，也就是无头骑士曾用过的鞍座。那个鞍座被埋藏在血色修道院的墓地中。

pairs.source: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Headless Horseman
pairs.text: 堕落战马：无头骑士的鞍座

pairs.source: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Midnight, the steed of Attumen the Huntsman. The saddle should be found somewhere within the ruins of Karazhan.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要猎手阿图门曾经的坐骑“午夜”的鞍座。在卡拉赞废墟的某处应该可以找到那个鞍座。

pairs.source: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Huntsman
Salanar the Horseman requires the Shadow Reins used by an ancient Dark Rider. They can only be obtained by defeating one of the Dark Riders directly.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要黑暗骑士曾用过的暗影缰绳。只能通过击败一名黑暗骑士来获取。

pairs.source: Even in shade form, Xavius can exert his power over Shaladrassil and torments our allies. We should investigate how far the corruption has reached.
pairs.text: 即使是在影子形态下，萨维斯也能将他的力量延伸到沙拉达希尔，折磨我们的盟友。我们必须调查腐蚀的情况。

pairs.source: The Violet Hold in Dalaran contains some of the most dangerous creatures ever captured. We cannot allow it to fall to the Legion. Investigate!
pairs.text: 达拉然的紫罗兰监狱中囚禁着一些史上最危险的生物。我们不能让监狱落在燃烧军团的手上。快去调查！

pairs.source: Even after his fall, Deathwing leaves devastation in his wake. The drogbar have built beneath the mountain, and may have obtained a powerful artifact.
pairs.text: 即使在陨落之后，死亡之翼依然在身后留下无数毁灭的痕迹。卓格巴尔在山下大兴工事，他们可能获得了强大的神器。

pairs.source: Though she hasn't made an appearance herself, Queen Azshara still controls the naga with an iron will, and is rumored to be after a powerful relic.
pairs.text: 虽然她自己还没现身，但艾萨拉女王依然用她的钢铁意志控制着纳迦。有传言称她正在寻找一件强大的圣物。

pairs.source: Not all vrykul travel to the Halls of Valor. The damned and accursed are rumored to go to the Maw of Souls, a dreadful ship sailing an endless sea.
pairs.text: 并非所有的维库人都会前往英灵殿。据说，那些受到诅咒的维库人会前往噬魂之喉，一艘航行在无尽之海上的恐怖航船。

pairs.source: Suramar City is an architectural marvel, but its reach goes far beyond the glittering spires and avenues above. We should investigate below.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛城是个建筑界的奇迹，但它的伟大之处不仅仅只是地面上闪光的尖塔和街道。我们需要对下方进行深入调查。

pairs.source: Grand Apothecary Putress was once a trusted advisor to Sylvanas. He deserved his end, but he may still prove useful. Harvest the Essence of Undeath from his soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 大药剂师普特雷斯曾是深受希尔瓦娜斯信任的顾问。他得到了应有的惩罚，但他本身可能依然很有用。前往暗影界，从他的灵魂中收集死灵精华吧。

pairs.source: Consumed by fear, Grand Empress Shek'zeer spread devastation. Her death was a blessing to the Pandaren... and now to us as well. Harvest the Essence of Fear from her soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 被恐惧吞噬的大女皇夏柯希尔散播着毁灭。她的死亡，对于熊猫人来说是件好事……对我们也一样。前往暗影界，从她的灵魂中收集恐惧精华吧。

pairs.source: A manipulator and traitor, Soulbinder Nyami wielded powerful shadow magic in life. In death, she is the perfect vessel for the Essence of Shadow. Harvest the essence from her soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 缚魂者尼娅米是一名阴谋家和叛徒，她生前掌握着强大的暗影魔法。在死后，她成了暗影精华的完美载体。前往暗影界，从她的灵魂中收集暗影精华吧。

pairs.source: After the death of his son, Admiral Daelin Proudmoore was consumed by the thirst for revenge. Collect the Essence of Hatred from his soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 经历了丧子之痛后，海军上将戴林·普罗德摩尔的心灵就被复仇的渴望蒙蔽了。前往暗影界，从他的灵魂中收集憎恨精华吧。

pairs.source: Once a Gilnean archmage, Arugal unleashed the worgen, and they attacked both friend and foe. Collect the Essence of Darkness from his soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 阿鲁高曾经是吉尔尼斯的大法师，他释放了狼人，而狼人的攻击不分敌我。前往暗影界，从他的灵魂中收集黑暗精华吧。

pairs.source: The dead rise from their graves at Black Rook Hold, and we believe that even long-deceased members of the Ravencrest family walk again.
pairs.text: 黑鸦堡垒的墓地中有复活的亡者，我们认为是已逝的拉文凯斯家族成员。

pairs.source: Even in a time of turmoil, the citizens of Suramar do their best to get on with daily life. However, there may be valuable intel from the Court of Stars.
pairs.text: 即使是在混乱的时期，苏拉玛城的居民们仍然尽力维持着日常的生活。然而群星庭院里可能会有非常有价值的情报。

pairs.source: When Cordana Felsong betrayed the Wardens, Maiev Shadowsong was forced to unleash all prisoners within the Vault. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 当科达娜·邪歌背叛守望者时，玛维·影歌被迫释放了地窟中所有的囚犯。我们需要进行相关调查。

pairs.source: Investigate the Vault of the Wardens
Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉正在被梦魇所吞噬。在我们面对黑暗之前，先要派出部队前去调查腐蚀之力的核心。

pairs.source: Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉正在被梦魇所吞噬。在我们面对黑暗之前，先要派出部队前去调查腐蚀之力的核心。

pairs.source: Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉正在被梦魇所吞噬。在我们面对黑暗之前，先要派出部队前去调查腐蚀之力的核心。

pairs.source: Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉正在被梦魇所吞噬。在我们面对黑暗之前，先要派出部队前去调查腐蚀之力的核心。

pairs.source: Before we can break our way to the other side, we will need to find the best place to steal a Legion gateway. Felsoul Hold is a candidate.
pairs.text: 在我们能够突破到另一边之前，得找到个最合适的地方来偷取燃烧军团的传送门。邪魂堡垒就是个待选的目标。

pairs.source: Jorhuttam, the great worm, swallowed whole the fabled Gjallerhorn. Send your champions to track the beast!
pairs.text: 尤胡塔姆是只巨型蠕虫，它吞下了传说中的迦拉尔之角。派出你的勇士，找到这只野兽的下落！

pairs.source: On the Trail of the Great Worm
The demons keep a rich stockpile of weapons at Legion Camp: Ruin in Azsuna. Assault the enemies there and return with any lumenstone that you can find.
pairs.text: 在阿苏纳的军团营地：废墟，恶魔们储备着大量的武器。对那里的敌人发动突击，带回来所有能找到的流明石。

pairs.source: The nightborne are moving a large shipment of lumenstone behind the city walls. Invade under cover of darkness and claim the steel for our order!
pairs.text: 夜之子正在把一大批流明石运到城墙的后方。在黑暗的掩护下发动攻击，为我们夺回那些金属！

pairs.source: Our scouts stumbled upon a vrykul raiding party equipped with lumenstone weapons. We can deal a double blow - eliminate the enemy, and take their weapons for our own.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候偶然发现了一支维库人的突击部队，他们都配备着流明石武器。我们可以对他们造成双重打击：消灭敌人，带走他们的武器为我们所用。

pairs.source: The Broken Shore is littered with debris from battle, with plenty of lumenstone to gather. Just beware of the demons still patrolling the area.
pairs.text: 破碎海滩到处都是战斗所留下的杂物，其中有大量的流明石供我们收集。要小心，恶魔依然在这片区域进行巡逻。

pairs.source: The naga in southern Val'sharah are using weapons crafted from lumenstone. We'll have to convince the naga to part with it.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉南部的纳迦们使用的武器是由流明石锻造而成。我们必须说服纳迦放弃那些武器。

pairs.source: To attract new rogues, thieves, and other sundry scoundrels, you need to make Lonika Stillblade an offer she can't refuse. Send Vanessa VanCleef.
pairs.text: 想要吸引更多的恶棍、盗贼和其他各色歹徒，你需要给洛妮卡·静刃提供一个她无法拒绝的提议。派梵妮莎·范克里夫前往吧。

pairs.source: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
The Alliance's intelligence agency, SI:7, has been acting very strange of late. Send our agents into Stormwind City to spy on them and gather intel.
pairs.text: 联盟的情报机构军情七处近期的行为非常古怪。派出我们的特工进入暴风城，对他们进行监视并收集情报。

pairs.source: In order to press gang more cutthroats into the ranks of the Uncrowned, Fleet Admiral Tethys wants our finest. A pirate, Yancey Grillsen, would be perfect.
pairs.text: 为了征调更多的凶犯加入到无冕者中，舰队上将特塞斯想要从我们中最厉害的好手开始。扬希·格里尔森这位海盗就是最好的人选。

pairs.source: Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉正在被梦魇所吞噬。在我们面对黑暗之前，先要派出部队前去调查腐蚀之力的核心。

pairs.source: The Legion's influence has swept across the Nighthold. Before we can attack the heart of the nightborne stronghold, send our forces to investigate.
pairs.text: 军团的力量横扫了暗夜要塞。在我们攻击夜之子要塞的心脏之前，先要派出部队前去进行调查。
