pairs.source: As well-intentioned as some warlocks may be, they sometimes get carried away. A pair of warlocks have a fragile containment on a doomlord.
pairs.text: 有些术士本意是好的，但经常做过头。区区几个术士对末日领主的抑制力还远远不够。

pairs.source: The Tideskorn vrykul pride themselves on their hunting skills, and none more so than Huntress Estrid with her fearsome companion, Halfdan.
pairs.text: 蔑潮维库人一直对他们的捕猎技巧备感骄傲，女猎手艾丝蒂德和她那可怕的伙伴哈尔弗丹更是其中的佼佼者。

pairs.source: Deep in the Bitestone Caverns, a gigantic basilisk has been absorbing the latent power of crystals into its armor.
pairs.text: 在啮岩洞穴深处，一只巨型蜥蜴一直在吸收水晶中蕴含的力量，融入到自己的护甲中。

pairs.source: The Feathermane have recently become hunted. A singing owlcat named Rauren has been tempting the surviving Feathermane kittens away.
pairs.text: 羽鬃最近正在被猎杀。一只名叫劳伦的唱歌鹰头猫一直试图把羽鬃赶走。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has seeped into the waterways of Val'sharah, corrupting even powerful elemental creatures. Pollous the Fetid disrupts the river.
pairs.text: 梦魇已经渗入到了瓦尔莎拉的水道，就连强大的元素生物也被腐蚀了。恶臭的波洛斯阻断了河流。

pairs.source: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.
pairs.text: 夺魂者是由三名海拉加尔维库人组成的组织，意图掠夺他们自己的国王的坟墓中的财宝。阻止他们，不然他们会造成更多的伤害。

pairs.source: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.
pairs.text: 奪魂者是一群有組織的黑爾拉亞維酷人，打算要盜掠他們自己國王的墳墓。阻止他們，別讓他們造成更多的破壞。

pairs.source: The Legion breeds felbats as flying mounts for their soldiers, but one in particular has grown so large it darkens the sky with its wings.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团培养了魔蝠作为他们士兵的飞行坐骑，但其中一只长得极为巨大，挥舞双翼时甚至会遮蔽天空。

pairs.source: The Terror that Flaps in the Day
Once a librarian of the Kirin Tor, Normantis the Deposed never forgave the damage done by Malygos and the blue flight in Northrend.
pairs.text: 作为一名曾经的肯瑞托图书管理员，被驱逐的诺曼提斯绝对不会原谅玛里苟斯和蓝龙军团在诺森德所造成的破坏。

pairs.source: Even powerful druids have succumbed to the Nightmare in Shala'nir. One of them, Lyrath Moonfeather, used to embody balance and harmony.
pairs.text: 即使最强大的德鲁伊也在沙拉尼尔的梦魇面前屈从了。利拉斯·月羽就是其中的一员，她曾经是平衡与和谐的化身。

pairs.source: A famous boxing champion in Highmountain has issued a challenge to everyone: Whoever can last three rounds with him will be rewarded handsomely.
pairs.text: 至高岭著名的搏击冠军向所有人发起了挑战：谁能在和他的对决中撑3个回合，将会获得丰厚的奖励。
无可争议的重量级选手

pairs.source: A vicious beast, Daggerbeak, has been preying on the equine sunrunners in the open glades of Azsuna. The poor creatures are terrified.
pairs.text: 一只凶残的野兽，刀喙，一直在阿苏纳的开阔林地中捕食逐日圣马。那些可怜的生物被吓坏了。

pairs.source: We have reason to suspect that a Legion agent has successfully infiltrated the city of Dalaran, and is now posing as a simple fruit vendor.
pairs.text: 我们有理由怀疑，有个燃烧军团的特工成功渗透进了达拉然城，现在扮作了一个普通的水果商人。

pairs.source: An Apple a Day Keeps the Legion Away
pairs.text: 一天一苹果，军团远离我

pairs.source: A rift has split right through the ley-ruins, discharging dangerous amounts of energy. We should destroy as many ley-creatures as we can.
pairs.text: 魔网废墟中被撕开了一道裂隙，放射出大量危险的能量。我们必须消灭尽可能多的魔网生物。

pairs.source: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.
pairs.text: 夺魂者是由三名海拉加尔维库人组成的组织，意图掠夺他们自己国王坟墓中的财宝。阻止他们，不然他们会造成更多的伤害。

pairs.source: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.
pairs.text: 奪魂者是一群有組織的黑爾拉亞維酷人，打算要盜掠他們自己國王的墳墓。阻止他們，別讓他們造成更多的破壞。

pairs.source: The warlocks in Azsuna are at it again, summoning demons they can't possibly hope to control. We can't always fight more fire with fire.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的术士们又开始行动了，召唤一些他们根本无力控制的恶魔。我们不能总是这样以火攻火。

pairs.source: No Matter How Many Times We Tell Them...
The drogbar have an underground snail-racing ring deep in their caverns. Recently, a vicious fight broke out. We should investigate.
pairs.text: 在卓格巴尔的洞穴里，有个地下的蜗牛竞速跑道。最近那里爆发了一场残酷的打斗。我们需要进行相关调查。

pairs.source: A corrupted Ancient of War, Ironbranch, resides deep in the overrun grove of Shala'nir. Other nightmarish creatures flock to him.
pairs.text: 有棵名叫铁枝的被腐蚀的战争古树居住在沙拉尼尔被蹂躏的林地深处。其他梦魇生物都在朝它蜂拥而去。

pairs.source: Deep in the vaults of the Arcway, the eredar are stealing knowledge vital to our allies, and they may discover a weakness.
pairs.text: 魔法回廊的宝库深处，艾瑞达正在窃取对我们盟友而言至关重要的情报。他们可能会发现一个弱点。

pairs.source: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them!
pairs.text: 夺魂者是由三名海拉加尔维库人组成的组织，意图掠夺他们自己国王坟墓中的财宝。阻止他们，不然他们会造成更多的伤害。

pairs.source: A fel-crazed vrykul warrior has broken through the outer defenses of Dalaran, and made it all the way to Krasus' landing!
pairs.text: 一个在邪能的影响下变得疯狂的维库人战士击破了达拉然外围的防御工事，一路杀到了克拉苏斯平台！

pairs.source: Black Rook Hold has been overrun by the spirits of the damned. The long-dead Theryssia rises from her grave, attacking anyone.
pairs.text: 黑鸦堡垒已经被受诅咒者的灵魂所占领了。早已死去多时的泰莉西亚从墓穴中复活，开始攻击所有人。

pairs.source: Over time, the natural ley energy and mana fields of Suramar have altered the wildlife. Myonix, the matron of the manasabers, is a terrifying beast.
pairs.text: 随着时间流逝，苏拉玛的自然魔网能量和法力场使野外动物逐渐发生了变化。魔刃豹米奥妮克丝已经变成一只恐怖的野兽。

pairs.source: The nightborne have been drawing on the energies of the Starweaver's Sanctum, summoning terrible creatures of pure energy.
pairs.text: 夜之子一直在织星圣殿中抽取能量，召唤恐怖的纯能量形态的生物。

pairs.source: The manascale basilisks have been driven out of their caves, and their petrifying gaze is turning anyone - including other wildlife - completely to stone.
pairs.text: 魔鳞蜥蜴被赶出了巢穴，他们的石化凝视会把任何人变成石头，也包括野生生物。

pairs.source: The nightborne are slaughtering Moonfall hippogryphs by the flock, and their nests are under attack. We must put a stop to it.
pairs.text: 夜之子正在成群地屠杀月落角鹰兽，它们的巢穴正在受到攻击。我们必须阻止这一切。

pairs.source: In the heart of Suramar City, some nightborne have embraced the Legion's 'gifts' more readily than others. Miasu must be stopped.
pairs.text: 在苏拉玛城的中心，有些夜之子对军团的“恩赐”抱有比其他人更大的兴趣。必须阻止米娅苏。

pairs.source: Few beasts are as dangerous and terrifying as Charfeather, an alpha owlcat that does not fear any hunter. Dispose of Charfeather.
pairs.text: 很少有野兽会像焦羽那样危险而恐怖，它是鹰头猫的领袖，从不畏惧任何猎人。干掉焦羽。

pairs.source: A monstrous Withered named Valakar the Thirsty has been drawn to the latent ley-energies of Azsuna, and seeks to consume everything in his path.
pairs.text: 一个名为饥渴的瓦拉卡的枯法者被阿苏纳隐藏的魔网能量所吸引，阻挡它的一切都会被吞噬。

pairs.source: The Thistleleaf sprites have been baiting unwary travelers into their groves, by placing what appears to be unguarded treasure right out in the open.
pairs.text: 蓟叶林精会把那些看似无人看守的宝藏放在开阔的地带，引诱那些轻率的旅行者进入他们的林地中。

pairs.source: The Hatecoil naga have been capturing sailors off the coast of Azsuna, and forcing them to work for the sea giants of the coves.
pairs.text: 积怨纳迦一直在在阿苏纳沿海捕捉水手，强迫他们为海湾的海巨人工作。

pairs.source: The Mak'rana of Azsuna have been riled up by all our activity on the coast, and they're now chopping holes in any ships that come near.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的玛拉纳被我们在海岸上的活动激怒了，现在他们会在任何接近的船只上凿洞。

pairs.source: Deep in the walls of Black Rook Hold, even the war sabers have been raised from death. The matriarch Darkshade watches over her unnatural brood.
pairs.text: 在黑鸦堡垒的深处，就连军队用的刃豹也被复活了。刃豹的主母黑暗之影正看护着她可怕的子嗣。

pairs.source: The Murkwater naga have taken over the ruins of Kal'delar, far too close to our outposts in Val'sharah. We should target their most powerful warriors.
pairs.text: 暗水纳迦们占据了卡德拉尔的废墟，距离我们在瓦尔莎拉的岗哨近在咫尺。我们必须干掉他们最强大的战士。

pairs.source: Deep in the forests of Val'sharah, a lone saber has been ambushing any traveler that wanders too close to his den. Hunt down Bahagar.
pairs.text: 在瓦尔莎拉森林的深处，一只独行刃豹会伏击任何靠近它巢穴的旅行者。消灭巴哈加。

pairs.source: With our resources stretched thin across the Broken Isles, even the furbolg tribes of Val'sharah are pushing into new territory.
pairs.text: 我们在破碎群岛上的资源捉襟见肘，就连瓦尔莎拉的熊怪部族都开始扩张领地了。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has the wasps into a deadly frenzy. The greatest of the wasps, Mahajik, is large enough to kill with a single sting. Destroy Mahajik.
pairs.text: 梦魇令蜂群变得致命而狂暴。蜂群中最厉害的是马哈吉克，它体型巨大，只需一次钉刺即可杀死目标。消灭马哈吉克。

pairs.source: Perhaps driven out from the hills by his brethren, Gornoth the Lost only knows how to wander and how to kill. We should seek him out and kill him.
pairs.text: 被兄弟从山中逐出之后，迷路的葛诺斯只会四处游荡和猎杀。我们必须找到他，然后消灭他。

pairs.source: Of the same cut as his father, Hill Prince Urgo is destined to be lord of the dangerous hill ettin tribes in Highmountain. We should strike at him.
pairs.text: 山地之王乌格跟他的父亲简直一模一样，他注定要成为至高岭中危险的山岭双头怪部族领主。我们必须对他发起攻击。

pairs.source: With all the upheaval in Highmountain, the Ambershard elementals are pouring out of their caverns and threatening the Highmountain tribes.
pairs.text: 由于至高岭最近的动荡局面，琥珀碎片元素生物从洞穴中倾泻而出，威胁着至高岭的各个部族。

pairs.source: The Feltotem tribe in Highmountain have bred demonic hounds to serve as guardians. We should cull their numbers.
pairs.text: 至高岭中的邪能图腾部族饲养着恶魔猎犬，用它们来看家护院。我们必须削减它们的数量。

pairs.source: The Blind Marshlands live up to their name, as thick fog and mist conceal the sad horrors within. We should put the long-dead back to rest.
pairs.text: 盲眼沼泽正如其名，厚厚的云雾遮挡着其中的悲伤和恐惧。我们必须让那些早就与世长辞的灵魂安息。

pairs.source: Deep in the waters of Helheim, a terrifying helsquid named Soulthirster preys on any unfortunate soul to step in the water. Dispatch the squid.
pairs.text: 在冥狱深渊的深水中，有一只可怕的、名叫吸魂者的冥界鱿鱼，它会捕食任何踏入到这片水域中的不幸灵魂。消灭这条鱿鱼。

pairs.source: Among Helya's fleet of ships, bearing damned souls on the sea for all eternity, Captain Dargun's crew is among the most feared. Destroy him.
pairs.text: 在海拉的舰队中，达昆船长的手下全是些不得不在海上进行永恒航行的诅咒灵魂，令人闻风丧胆。消灭他。

pairs.source: Helya's helhounds are a fearsome pack of predators, but Fenri is a three-headed beast bred for terror and despair. Find him in the depths of Helheim.
pairs.text: 海拉的地狱犬本就是令人恐惧的捕食者了，而芬里这三头野兽是专为恐惧和绝望而生的。在冥狱深渊的深处找到他。

pairs.source: For meat, Hannval the Butcher has slaughtered beasts and men for his terrible table. Find him in the hills of Stormheim and put an end to the feast.
pairs.text: 为了砧板上的鲜肉，屠夫汉瓦尔屠杀了许多野兽和人类。在风暴峡湾的群山中找到他，结束他的血腥盛宴。

pairs.source: In the Field of Forgotten Kings, Oktel Dragonblood no longer rests peacefully in his grave. He was among the first to ride dragons. Defeat him.
pairs.text: 在遗忘王者的领地，奥克泰尔·龙血不再呆在墓穴中安息。他是第一批骑乘巨龙的人之一。击败他。

pairs.source: Our scouts report that Legion agents have been trying to infiltrate Dalaran through its own citizens. We should investigate and unmask any enemies.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说，燃烧军团的特工试图通过达拉然的居民渗透到达拉然城里。我们必须进行调查，找到任何可能的敌人。

pairs.source: While the mages of Dalaran know to float a city, they sometimes forget about the cracks in the foundation. Latent energy has come to life there.
pairs.text: 虽然达拉然的法师知道怎样让一座城市浮起来，但他们有时也会忘记地基的裂缝。潜在的能量在那里获得了生命。

pairs.source: Late at night, someone has been going to the cemetery in Dalaran and attempting to raise the dead. We should investigate and put a stop to it.
pairs.text: 有人在夜间前往达拉然的墓地试图复活死者。我们必须进行调查，阻止这一切。

pairs.source: Someone has been shattering windows throughout Dalaran, leaving a trail of destruction and broken glass. Investigate and find the culprit.
pairs.text: 有人在达拉然各地砸窗户，留下一地破坏痕迹和碎玻璃渣。前去调查，找到幕后的罪犯。

pairs.source: Dalaran is no stranger to rats, but they've become even more of a nuisance than usual in the Underbelly. See what's causing all the fuss.
pairs.text: 达拉然对老鼠并不陌生，但下水道里老鼠的问题已经让人无法忍受了。去看看是什么原因导致了这场麻烦。

pairs.source: The Valkyra are under attack by Felskorn vrykul. Aid them and crush those who've betrayed Odyn.
pairs.text: 瓦尔基拉受到蔑魔维库人的攻击。帮助他们，消灭那些背叛了奥丁的人。

pairs.source: Powerful armaments were lost when the great ship Vaesska sank at sea.  Send your armies to retrieve them and strengthen our forces!
pairs.text: 巨轮瓦斯卡在海洋中沉没后，强大的武器也随之遗失了。派出你的部队去找回那些武器，强化我们自己的部队！

pairs.source: A group of mighty warriors loyal to Odyn has been captured by sea giants and are being forced to fight in their underground pit. Free them!
pairs.text: 一群效忠于奥丁的强大战士被海巨人抓住了，他们被迫在地下角斗场进行战斗。释放他们！

pairs.source: Our scouts report that the Britterbrine came across a cache that may have come from Azshara's treasure room. We should see what we can bring back.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说苦水强盗发现了一个宝箱，可能是来自于艾萨拉的宝藏储藏室。我们得去看看能找到些什么。

pairs.source: The nightborne pride themselves on the great heights they've achieved with their civilization. Send our champions to their tournament.
pairs.text: 夜之子以他们文明所达到的高度而感到骄傲。派出我们的勇士，参加他们的锦标赛。

pairs.source: At Raven's Glory Arena in Black Rook Hold, our champions can prove their worth and earn respect for our cause. Send them to the Rumble.
pairs.text: 在黑鸦堡垒的渡鸦之耀竞技场，我们的勇士可以证明自己的价值，并为我们的事业赢得尊重。派他们去参加争斗。

pairs.source: The Highmountain tauren have requested our aid to protect their borders from the Feltotem. In return, their ritualists will grant us powerful potions.
pairs.text: 至高岭牛头人请求我们提供帮助，保护他们的边界不受邪能图腾的侵害。作为回报，他们的仪祭师会给我们提供强力的药水。

pairs.source: Our scouts report that the Legion is experimenting with the properties of Sargeras' own blood, in order to bolster their armies. We should send our champions to acquire the blood for ourselves.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说燃烧军团正在试验萨格拉斯的血液成分，想要强化他们的军队。我们必须派勇士去夺取那些血液，以为我们所用。

pairs.source: Amalia, famous battle-pet tamer, has a litter of corgi puppies she needs to find homes for! To determine a rightful owner, she's holding a tournament.
pairs.text: 阿玛利亚是位著名的战斗宠物训练师，她有一窝柯基幼犬，需要找人领养！为找到合适的主人，她举办了一场锦标赛。

pairs.source: Master Tamer Flummox isn't the most conventional pet tamer. Now, he's acquired a firebat pup and means to eat it! Rescue the pup from certain doom.
pairs.text: 驯宠大师弗鲁莫斯向来不按牌理出牌。这次他得到了一只火蝠幼崽，居然想吃了它！将那只幼崽从厄运中拯救出来。

pairs.source: To train new broken warriors how to deal with the new Burning Legion, Battlelord Gaardoun is requesting that you gather demonic implements.
pairs.text: 为了训练破碎者战士来应对新的燃烧军团，战争领主加尔顿要你去收集恶魔的工具。

pairs.source: Felsoul Hold was not suitable for our plans, but there is one other option. Scout out the area around Felblaze Ingress, to see if we have any hope.
pairs.text: 邪魂堡垒不适合我们的计划，但没有别的办法了。侦查邪焰隘口附近的区域，看看有没有希望。
为我们的到来做好准备

pairs.source: The Legion gateway in Felblaze Ingress is the only place powerful enough to take your armies to Niskara. Hymdall will need to wrest it from the Legion first.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团在邪焰隘口的传送门是唯一能把你的军队带到尼斯卡拉的地方。海姆达尔先要把它从燃烧军团手中夺过来。

pairs.source: Nightborne nobles are planning to hunt an elusive, rare fox, possibly the last of his kind. Send your champions to uncover more information.
pairs.text: 夜之子的贵族们计划要捕猎一只稀有而且行踪飘忽的狐狸，可能是它的族类中仅存的最后一只了。派出你的勇士，找到更多信息。

pairs.source: According to the Stablemaster, only certain nightborne nobles are invited to the hunt. Send your champions to question Lord Nimrod about the hunt.
pairs.text: 根据兽栏管理员的说法，只有特定的夜之子贵族受到了此次狩猎的邀请。派出你的勇士，前去询问尼姆罗德领主关于此次狩猎的情况。

pairs.source: After taking Lord Nimrod's hunt invitation, we must discover where the fox hunt will begin. Send your champions to question Lady Dyana on the location.
pairs.text: 收到尼姆罗德领主的狩猎邀请后，我们必须弄明白这次猎狐从哪里开始。派出你的勇士，询问蒂亚娜夫人狩猎的地点。

pairs.source: One last piece of the map remains and you will be ready to stop the nightborne's fox hunt. Send your champions to confront Houndmaster Britomar.
pairs.text: 还剩下最后一条线索，然后你就可以去阻止夜之子的猎狐行动了。派出你的勇士，去会见驯犬者布里托玛。

pairs.source: The Hatecoil naga have stirred up the Salteye murlocs, who are now threatening the Ruins of Nar'thalas. They need to be pushed back.
pairs.text: 积怨纳迦激怒了盐目鱼人，鱼人们现在威胁着纳萨拉斯废墟。我们得把他们赶回去。

pairs.source: The Llothien grizzlies have voracious appetites, and the cliffwing nest right on the ground. It's too tempting a target for hungry bears.
pairs.text: 洛希恩灰熊的胃口极大，而崖翼之巢就在他们眼皮底下。对于饥饿的熊来说，实在是太过诱人。

pairs.source: Though many parts of Val'sharah have been overrun, the corrupted flora may provide valuable insight into the properties of the Nightmare.
pairs.text: 虽然瓦尔莎拉的大部分地区都已遭到蹂躏，但那些被腐蚀的植物可能会提供珍贵的信息，让我们得以了解梦魇的特性。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has corrupted once-peaceful creatures of the forest, including a herd of stags and does. Put them out of their misery.
pairs.text: 梦魇已经腐蚀了这片森林中一度温顺的生物，就连鹿群也变得狂暴起来。结束它们的痛苦吧。

pairs.source: There are many paths to the great caverns in Highmountain, but some are more dangerous than others. Explore to see if there's a better way inside.
pairs.text: 有很多路都能通往至高岭山中巨大的洞穴，但有些尤为危险。去进行探索，看看里面是否会有更好的路径。

pairs.source: The Feltotem have poisoned the waterways of Highmountain with their dreadful rituals, sickening the wildlife. Put a stop to it.
pairs.text: 邪能图腾部族用他们可怕的仪式给至高岭的水路下了毒，毒害了野外的动物。阻止他们！

pairs.source: Many ships have run aground on the coast of Stormheim, and the sharks are a menace for survivors. Dispose of a few, so the sailors can rebuild.
pairs.text: 很多船只在风暴峡湾的海岸边搁浅，而鲨鱼对幸存者造成了威胁。消灭一些鲨鱼，让水手们能够幸存下来。

pairs.source: Hidden in the cliffs of Stormheim, undying spirits keep a watch, despite having long passed on. Bring them some resolution to their vigil.
pairs.text: 不朽的灵魂潜藏风暴峡湾的峭壁之中。尽管他们已经故去多年，依然在那里守望着。让他们从守望中解脱吧。

pairs.source: The Ruins of Falanaar are a dangerous place, especially for any that are wary of arachnids. Thin out the number of Lurkers there.
pairs.text: 法兰纳尔废墟是个危险的地方，特别是对于那些害怕蜘蛛的人而言。消灭一些那里的潜伏者，减少它们的数量。

pairs.source: The forests of Val'sharah have been overrun by Nightmare, and that terror now creeps across into Suramar. Push the satyrs and their defilers back.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉的森林已被梦魇占据，而且这种恐惧已经逐渐渗入苏拉玛城。击退萨特和他们手下的亵渎者。

pairs.source: On the Timeworn Strand, gigantic turtles wander the ancient ruins. Their meat would go a long way to supporting our troops. Beware of naga though.
pairs.text: 在上古海滩上，巨大的海龟在古代废墟中四处游荡。他们的肉可以为我们的部队提供大量补给。对了，要小心纳迦。

pairs.source: In the Lost Orchard, specters brew an arcane-aged wine so awful, it would serve as a decent poison. Disrupt their ghostly operations.
pairs.text: 在失落果园里，幽灵们酿出了用奥术陈化的葡萄酒，味道差得简直可以充当上佳的毒药。中断他们那可怕的行动。

pairs.source: In the shadow of Black Rook Hold, herds of innocent goats have been terrorized by risen hounds. The farmers depend on those goats for their livelihood.
pairs.text: 在黑鸦堡垒的阴影中，无辜的山羊群被复活的猎犬吓坏了。农民们的生计就指望着这些羊了。

pairs.source: Our scouts report a system of natural caverns beneath Black Rook Hold. We should investigate to see if they are as fortified as the castle above.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说在黑鸦堡垒下方存在一个天然洞穴系统。我们应该去调查一下，看看那些洞穴是否像上面的城堡那样难以攻破。

pairs.source: The Swamprock murlocs of Shipwreck Cove have a long history of grabbing survivors from wrecks and dragging them back to their village.
pairs.text: 沉船海湾的沼岩鱼人长久以来一直会从沉船中捕获幸存者，然后将他们拖回到自己的村庄。

pairs.source: The wyrmtongue are scavenging the graves of the Highmountain tauren, courtesy of the Feltotem incursion. Teach them a lesson in respecting the dead.
pairs.text: 拜邪能图腾的入侵所赐，虫语者正在至高岭牛头人的墓地里搜寻腐肉。给它们点教训，让它们学会尊重死者。

pairs.source: Usually, the squallhunter drakes prey on the stags of Stormheim, but one stag has turned the tables, slaughtering dragons. Hunt down this beast.
pairs.text: 通常猎风者幼龙会捕食风暴峡湾的牡鹿，但有只牡鹿反客为主，杀死了巨龙。消灭那只野兽。

pairs.source: Storm drakes normally live in colonies or are tamed by the vrykul, but one lone drake does neither. Instead, it preys on everyone.
pairs.text: 风暴幼龙通常是群居生活，或者被维库人驯服，但有只孤独的幼龙却并非如此，它捕食所有的猎物。

pairs.source: Many Moonfall Acolytes are still trapped after the Nightfallen attacked the Moon Guard Stronghold. Send in some aid for those left behind.
pairs.text: 在堕夜精灵攻击了护月要塞后，许多月落助祭依然被困在那里。派人过去，给他们提供帮助。

pairs.source: Harpies have moved into the ruins of Tel'anor, destroying the once-beautiful buildings with their foul nests. Dispose of them.
pairs.text: 鹰身人搬进了泰安诺的废墟，用他们污秽的巢穴毁灭了那些曾经美丽的建筑。消灭他们。

pairs.source: In the Ruins of Llothien, the prowlers have taken over. No one can study or investigate the ruins until their numbers are culled some.
pairs.text: 徘徊者们已经占据了洛希恩废墟。除非能把它们的数量减少一些，否则没人能去研究或调查那片废墟。

pairs.source: Suramar is split between crumbling ruins and glittering civilization, yet neither is completely safe. Investigate where we can be the most help.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛被分为两部分，一部分是摇摇欲坠的废墟，一部分是闪闪发光的高度文明。但两者都不安全。调查一下，看哪里最需要我们的帮助。

pairs.source: Azsuna's coast is littered with shipwrecks and hazards wrought by its hostile inhabitants. Search for and destroy any lingering threats.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的海滩上到处都是遇难船只的残骸，以及当地那些恶意的居民造成的危险。搜索并消灭任何徘徊的威胁。

pairs.source: The demons of Faronaar extend their influence deep into Azsuna, corrupting any and all they can. Search, and dispose of any under the Legion's thumb.
pairs.text: 法罗纳尔的恶魔已经把影响力扩散到了阿苏纳的深处，腐蚀一切能腐蚀的目标。搜索并消灭任何受到军团腐蚀的目标。

pairs.source: The forests of Val'sharah are no place to wander off alone. Danger waits behind every tree, and sometimes it doesn't wait.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉的森林并不适合独自闲逛。每棵树后面可能都会潜伏着危险，有的时候危险就在眼前。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has corrupted the roots of Shaladrassil and many creatures within Val'sharah. Seek out and dispose of the crooked elements.
pairs.text: 梦魇已经腐蚀了沙拉达希尔的根基，也腐蚀了瓦尔莎拉的许多生物。找到并消灭那些扭曲的元素。

pairs.source: It's not just the pathways of Highmountain that are cause for concern. Some of the greatest threats lie in wait for the unwary.
pairs.text: 要担心的不仅仅是至高岭的道路，在你不注意的时候，最大的危险就会降临。

pairs.source: Scouts report geological instability in Highmountain, where something must be moving just beneath the surface. Investigate and destroy.
pairs.text: 斥候报告了至高岭地质不稳定的情况，地表下方肯定有东西在移动。进行调查并消灭那个东西。

pairs.source: Not all vrykul will ascend to the halls of Valarjar, and those are desperate to avoid the turmoil of Helheim. They will do anything to earn honor.
pairs.text: 并不是所有的维库人都会进入瓦拉加尔的神殿。而那些急切地想要逃离冥狱深渊的魔爪的人，会不顾一切去赢得荣耀。

pairs.source: It is said that the Titan watchers themselves observe all the residents of Stormheim, and who is worthy to ascend. Prove our worth.
pairs.text: 据说泰坦监护者们会亲自观察风暴峡湾的所有居民，观察那些有资格进入神殿的人。证明我们的价值吧。

pairs.source: The nightborne have preserved a culture across thousands of years, but not everything is so civilized and pristine. Investigate what lies beneath.
pairs.text: 夜之子保留了延续数千年的文化，然而并非一切都是文明而淳朴的。前去调查这背后隐藏着什么。

pairs.source: Despite being half-ruined, the latent energies in Suramar attract creatures of all sorts. Explore the ruins and discover what feeds on this power.
pairs.text: 虽然已经有一半成了废墟，苏拉玛中潜藏的能量依然吸引着各类生物的到来。探索废墟，找到那些以这些能量为食的生物。

pairs.source: The elven ruins of Azsuna hold secrets we can't begin to comprehend. Search and rediscover what has been lost to time.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的精灵废墟中隐藏着我们无法理解的秘密。搜索这里，重新发现那些被岁月掩盖的遗产。

pairs.source: The denizens of Azsuna, whether natural or unnatural, are a dangerous sort. Be wary while traveling through the area.
pairs.text: 阿苏纳的居民，无论是自然的还是非自然的产物，都非常危险。在这片区域行动时务必要小心。

pairs.source: The nights in Val'sharah are filled with the howls of disturbed creatures. Investigate the cause and put them out of their misery.
pairs.text: 瓦尔莎拉的夜晚充满着焦躁生物的嚎叫。调查清楚原因，然后结束它们的痛苦。

pairs.source: Creatures in Val'sharah were hardly tame before the Nightmare crept in, and corrupting energies have made them even more dangerous.
pairs.text: 在梦魇到来之前，瓦尔莎拉的生物的秉性已经算是非常暴烈，现在腐蚀的能量让它们更具危险。

pairs.source: Though mostly covered in rocky hills and snowy cliffs, Highmountain also has its forests, with their own beauties and dangers.
pairs.text: 尽管大部分地区都是荒山和白雪覆盖的峭壁，至高岭也有森林，并且孕育了独特的美丽和危险。

pairs.source: The tauren of Highmountain have learned to live with the perilous landscape, but more than just cliffs and peaks endanger the tribes.
pairs.text: 至高岭的牛头人知道如何应付危险的地理环境。但是威胁着他们的部族的不仅仅是峭壁和山峰。

pairs.source: Not only the vrykul threaten anyone who enters the hills of Stormheim. Sometimes danger strikes from the sky.
pairs.text: 对进入风暴峡湾的人来说，危险的不仅仅是维库人。有时候危险会从天而降。

pairs.source: Dangers creep from the Helmouth, and even the dead are not safe in their graves. Investigate Stormheim and fight back against death itself.
pairs.text: 危险会从地狱之口中蔓延而出，即使是墓穴中的死者也并不安全。调查风暴峡湾，击退死亡。

pairs.source: Demons simply don't know when they're beaten. Even now, they plot to invade parts of Suramar. Investigate, and stop them.
pairs.text: 恶魔自己不知道何时才算失败。即使是现在，他们依然在计划入侵苏拉玛的部分地区。进行调查并阻止他们。

pairs.source: Demons simply don't know when they're beaten. Even now, they plot to invade parts of Suramar. Investigate, and stop them.
pairs.text: 恶魔自己不知道何时才算失败。即使是现在，他们依然在计划入侵苏拉玛的部分地区。进行调查并阻止他们。

pairs.source: Should give you a huge success chance boost, if it's the first mission of the day. Also should give you a cool item!
pairs.text: 如果这是当天的第一个任务，那么应该会大幅提升你的成功率。还会给你一个超酷的物品！

pairs.source: Lucian from One Last Glass was overheard lamenting the loss of a shipment of extraodinarly stinky cheese.  Apparently the courier was overrun as he made his way through the Underbelly.
pairs.text: 据说，再来一杯的鲁希安痛失了一批异香奶酪。显然那位送货员是在穿越达拉然下水道时遭遇了不测。

pairs.source: There was once a great stock of wine in Falanaar.  Send some troops to investigate and see what they can find.
pairs.text: 法兰纳尔曾藏有一大批美酒。派些部队去调查一下，看看他们能发现什么吧。

pairs.source: Karazhan stirs. Send our forces to investigate the tower.
pairs.text: 卡拉赞有异动。派我们的部队去调查一下那座塔楼吧。

pairs.source: Now that you've found your way into the guild, it seems only fair that your champions should be allowed to participate.
pairs.text: 既然你已经进入了俱乐部，你的勇士也应该有资格参加比赛，这样才算公平。

pairs.source: The Warhammer Council is a fearsome foe.
pairs.text: 战锤议会是可怕的敌人。

pairs.source: There's nothing quite like the thrill of defending the honor of your faction and engaging in some friendly, or not so friendly, competition. Send your champion to explore the battlegrounds.
pairs.text: 再也没有比参加友好——或是不那么友好——的比赛，并捍卫本阵营的荣耀更激动人心的事了。派你的勇士们去探索战场吧。

pairs.source: The melee continues in the battleground. Send our forces to assist the cause.
pairs.text: 战场上仍然在混战。派我们的部队去支援本方勇士吧。

pairs.source: There's nothing quite like the sound of the crowd cheering as you deftly maneuver and muscle for rank. Send your champions to the arenas to see what they can learn.
pairs.text: 再也没有比巧用战术和实力克敌制胜时，观众发出的欢呼声更能振奋人心的声音了。派你的勇士去竞技场学习学习吧。

pairs.source: Your champions have heard of a place of endless war, where the tides of battle flow constantly. Send them to investigate further.
pairs.text: 你的勇士听说有个永不落幕的战场。在那里，局势瞬息万变。派他们去深入调查一下吧。

pairs.source: Are you afraid of the dark?
I've Got A Strange Feeling About This
We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.
pairs.text: 为了返回破碎海滩，我们还需要支援。去找其他职业的领袖，请求他们的援助吧。

pairs.source: We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.
pairs.text: 如果我們要返回破碎海岸，就需要更多支援。去找其他職業的領袖，尋求他們協助。

pairs.source: If we wish for our offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: A young druid with great potential, Graham Silverclaw, led our scouts to the edge of Suramar. But he ran into a Legion hunting party, and he needs assistance.
pairs.text: 格拉哈姆·银爪是一位具有巨大潜力的年轻德鲁伊，他带领我们的斥候前往了苏拉玛的边缘地区。但他碰到了军团的捕猎活动，需要支援。
集合织梦者：格拉哈姆·银爪

pairs.source: Salanar the Horseman requires the Shadow Reins used by an ancient Dark Rider. They can only be obtained by defeating one of the Dark Riders directly.
pairs.text: 骑手萨拉纳尔需要黑暗骑士曾用过的暗影缰绳。只能通过击败一名黑暗骑士来获取。

pairs.source: We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.
pairs.text: 如果我們要返回破碎海岸，就需要更多支援。去找其他職業的領袖，尋求他們協助。

pairs.source: Once a Gilnean archmage, Arugal unleashed the worgen, and they attacked both friend and foe. Collect the Essence of Darkness from his soul in the Shadowlands.
pairs.text: 阿鲁高曾经是吉尔尼斯的大法师，他释放了狼人，而狼人的攻击不分敌我。前往暗影界，从他的灵魂中收集黑暗精华吧。

pairs.source: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 如果我们希望对破碎海滩的突袭能成功，就必须与艾泽拉斯的其他势力结盟。

pairs.source: Dispatch champions to investigate Legion activities on the Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 派遣勇士调查燃烧军团在破碎海滩的活动。

pairs.source: Lumbering across the land is a Legion infernal of monstrous proportions. Dispatch our forces to bring it down.
pairs.text: 一头燃烧军团的巨型地狱火正在这片土地上横行无忌。快派我们的部队去干掉它吧。

pairs.source: Before we can fully scout the Broken Shore, we must clear the skies of Legion threats.
pairs.text: 在彻底调查破碎海滩前，我们必须肃清燃烧军团的空中威胁。

pairs.source: It is said the demon Dantalionax can drain all hope from the hearts of mortals. Our forces need him eradicated.
pairs.text: 据说，恶魔丹塔利纳克斯能吸干凡人心中所有的希望。必须让我们的部队消灭他。

pairs.source: We must send a team to scout the gates of the Tomb of Sargeras. Be aware: this is likely a one-way mission.
pairs.text: 我们得派一支队伍去侦察一下萨格拉斯之墓的大门。小心，执行这个的任务的人很可能有去无回。

pairs.source: We have wounded trapped on the Broken Shore! Dispatch your champions to bring them home.
pairs.text: 我们的伤员都被困在破碎海滩上了！派我们的勇士去把他们带回家吧。

pairs.source: Eredar mages are using portals to bring reinforcements to the Broken Shore. Unless we stop them, we'll never gain a foothold.
pairs.text: 艾瑞达法师他们正在使用军团传送门将援军召唤到破碎海滩上。如果不阻止他们，我们永远都别想建立稳定的阵地。

pairs.source: The Llothien grizzlies have voracious appetites, and the cliffwing nest right on the ground. It's too tempting a target for hungry bears.
pairs.text: 洛希恩灰熊的胃口极大，而崖翼之巢就在他们眼皮底下。对于饥饿的熊来说，实在是太过诱人。

pairs.source: The Ruins of Falanaar are a dangerous place, especially for any that are wary of arachnids. Thin out the number of Lurkers there.
pairs.text: 法兰纳尔废墟是个危险的地方，特别是对于那些害怕蜘蛛的人而言。消灭一些那里的潜伏者，减少它们的数量。

pairs.source: Our scouts report a system of natural caverns beneath Black Rook Hold. We should investigate to see if they are as fortified as the castle above.
pairs.text: 我们的斥候报告说在黑鸦堡垒下方存在一个天然洞穴系统。我们应该去调查一下，看看那些洞穴是否像上面的城堡那样难以攻破。

pairs.source: Usually, the squallhunter drakes prey on the stags of Stormheim, but one stag has turned the tables, slaughtering dragons. Hunt down this beast.
pairs.text: 通常猎风者幼龙会捕食风暴峡湾的牡鹿，但有只牡鹿反客为主，杀死了巨龙。消灭那只野兽。

pairs.source: Storm drakes normally live in colonies or are tamed by the vrykul, but one lone drake does neither. Instead, it preys on everyone.
pairs.text: 风暴幼龙通常是群居生活，或者被维库人驯服，但有只孤独的幼龙却并非如此，它捕食所有的猎物。

pairs.source: Many Moonfall Acolytes are still trapped after the Nightfallen attacked the Moon Guard Stronghold. Send in some aid for those left behind.
pairs.text: 在堕夜精灵攻击了护月要塞后，许多月落助祭依然被困在那里。派人过去，给他们提供帮助。

pairs.source: The demons of Faronaar extend their influence deep into Azsuna, corrupting any and all they can. Search, and dispose of any under the Legion's thumb.
pairs.text: 法罗纳尔的恶魔已经把影响力扩散到了阿苏纳的深处，腐蚀一切能腐蚀的目标。搜索并消灭任何受到军团腐蚀的目标。

pairs.source: The Nightmare has corrupted the roots of Shaladrassil and many creatures within Val'sharah. Seek out and dispose of the crooked elements.
pairs.text: 梦魇已经腐蚀了沙拉达希尔的根基，也腐蚀了瓦尔莎拉的许多生物。找到并消灭那些扭曲的元素。

pairs.source: It's not just the pathways of Highmountain that are cause for concern. Some of the greatest threats lie in wait for the unwary.
pairs.text: 要担心的不仅仅是至高岭的道路，在你不注意的时候，最大的危险就会降临。

pairs.source: The Command Center has provided us with time-sensitive intel on the Sentinax. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a fighting chance for this opportunity.
pairs.text: 指挥中心为我们提供了有关森提纳克斯号的情报。但这些情报具有时效性。只有你最精锐的勇士和部队才有可能抓住这个机会。
精锐打击：森提纳克斯号

pairs.source: A cache of Legion supplies has been discovered, due to information received from the Command Center. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a chance to take advantage of this opportunity.
pairs.text: 多亏了指挥中心发来的情报，我们发现了一箱燃烧军团的补给品。只有你最精锐的勇士和部队才有可能抓住这个机会。

pairs.source: The Command Center reports a library of ancient scrolls hidden beneath the The Lost Temple. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a chance to take advantage of this opportunity.
pairs.text: 指挥中心报告说，失落的神殿地下有一个收藏古代卷轴的图书馆。只有你最精锐的勇士和部队才有可能抓住这个机会。

pairs.source: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的权力宝座安托鲁斯就在眼前。朝燃烧王座进军前，先派部队去调查一下吧。

pairs.source: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的权力宝座安托鲁斯就在眼前。朝燃烧王座进军前，先派部队去调查一下吧。

pairs.source: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的权力宝座安托鲁斯就在眼前。朝燃烧王座进军前，先派部队去调查一下吧。

pairs.source: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的权力宝座安托鲁斯就在眼前。朝燃烧王座进军前，先派部队去调查一下吧。

pairs.source: Nath'raxas Hold contains a cache of fel crystals we could use to power our defenses. Infiltrate the Legion's base and recover them.
pairs.text: 纳斯拉克斯要塞有一箱邪能水晶，可以用来给我们的防御工事供能。潜入军团的基地，把水晶取回来吧。

pairs.source: The panthara in the Grove of Naroua are too numerous, and threaten the cragscaler population. Thin their numbers.
pairs.text: 纳罗瓦林地的影豹数量太多了，威胁到了岩羊的种群。快去削减一些影豹的数量。

pairs.source: The Legion is building a weapon in Nath'raxas Hold. Send our champions to discover what it is, and how to destroy it.
pairs.text: 军团正在纳斯拉克斯要塞建造一件武器。让我们的勇士去侦察一下那究竟是什么武器，并了解摧毁这件武器的办法。

pairs.source: The Army of the Light requires aid defending the Xenedar's wreckage. Help them hold the line.
pairs.text: 圣光军团需要援军守卫泽尼达尔的残骸。去帮助他们守住阵线吧。

pairs.source: Powerful weaponry must be removed from the Xenedar before the Legion finds a way past the Army of the Light.
pairs.text: 必须把泽尼达尔的强大武器运走，要是等燃烧军团突破了圣光军团的防线，那就麻烦了。

pairs.source: An enraged pit lord is leading a battalion of demons to retake the Annihilan Pits. Set a trap to welcome them home.
pairs.text: 一个愤怒的熔池领主带领着一群恶魔，想要夺回安尼赫兰熔池。快设下陷阱欢迎他们“回家”。

pairs.source: Annihilan Fanatics are attempting to recover Aggonar's remains to hasten his reconstruction. Disrupt their efforts.
pairs.text: 安尼赫兰狂热者想夺回阿苟纳的遗体以加快他的重建速度。快去干扰他们。

pairs.source: The Legion is fortifying the Deceiver's Scar with Fel Devastators. Sabotage these cannons before they are operational.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团正在使用邪能灭绝者巩固欺诈者之痕的防御。趁这些火炮还没装好，快把它们破坏掉。

pairs.source: Several Lightforged Battlesuit pilots are trapped behind enemy lines on the Shattered Fields. They must be saved.
pairs.text: 几个光铸装甲驾驶员被困在了破碎之野的敌军后方，一定要救出他们。

pairs.source: Eredar Soulshapers are creating monstrous ur'zul in the Petrified Forest. They must be stopped.
pairs.text: 艾瑞达塑灵师正在石化森林里制造可憎的乌祖尔。一定要阻止他们。

pairs.source: The fighting is fiercest on the Shattered Fields. Turn the battle in our favor.
pairs.text: 破碎之野的战斗最为激烈。快去帮部队占得上风。

pairs.source: The Garothi Obliterator roaming the Argus Wastes poses a severe threat to any troop movements. It must be destroyed.
pairs.text: 加洛西歼灭者正在阿古斯废土上横行无忌，对我们的部队行动构成了重大威胁。一定要把它干掉。

pairs.source: Our champions can hold against an army of Legion in the Black Gorge. Do not allow the Legion access to the pass.
pairs.text: 我们的勇士可以把燃烧军团牵制在漆黑峡谷。别让他们通过。

pairs.source: There is wealth in the Argus Wastes, and the wyrmtongue know how to find it. Track one of these scavengers to their trove.
pairs.text: 阿古斯废土上也有宝藏，而虫语者知道怎样找到他们。跟踪一名虫语者，前往他们的藏宝库。

pairs.source: Siegemaster Voraan is launching a new assault on Darkfall Ridge. Defend the Vindicaar against his attacks.
pairs.text: 攻城大师沃兰对堕暗岭发起了新一轮攻击。抵御他的攻击，守护好维迪卡尔。

pairs.source: Tereck the Selector is capturing Krokul Wranglers in the Petrified Forest. Put an end to him.
pairs.text: 分选者泰瑞克在石化森林搜捕克罗库驯兽师。快去终结他的暴行。

pairs.source: The Legion sends supplies from Nath'raxas Hold through the Black Gorge to the Shattered Fields. Confiscate or destroy their next shipment.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团会从纳斯拉克斯要塞送出物资，穿过漆黑峡谷，最后送往破碎之野。快去收缴他们的下一批货物，或者干脆毁掉。

pairs.source: Life continues to flourish in the Grove of Naroua. It must be protected from Legion patrols.
pairs.text: 生命依然在纳罗瓦林地不断繁衍。一定不能让燃烧军团的巡逻队伍发现这里。

pairs.source: The krokul want to recover lost artifacts from the ruins of Darkfall Ridge. Guard against Legion attacks while they work.
pairs.text: 克罗库想从堕暗岭的废墟里找回他们失落的遗物。保护好他们，别让他们在干活时遭到燃烧军团的攻击。

pairs.source: Kil'jaeden's vessel contains powerful artifacts. Send our champions into the wreckage to recover what they can.
pairs.text: 基尔加丹的飞船上有强大的神器。派我们的勇士深入残骸，看看能找到什么吧。

pairs.source: Shadow-touched Krokul have enslaved their brethren in the Ruins of Oronaar. Liberate them from the maddening whispers of the void.
pairs.text: 染影克罗库在奥罗纳尔废墟奴役他们的同胞。从虚空的疯狂低语中解放他们吧。

pairs.source: Spirits of the distant past relive their final nightmares in Triumvirate's End. Set them to rest.
pairs.text: 在执政团之末，还有来自遥远年代的幽灵重温着他们临终前的梦魇。去让他们安息吧。

pairs.source: Void begins to encroach on the Circle of the Aspirants. Do not allow the void to control any more of Mac'Aree.
pairs.text: 虚空开始蚕食候选者之环了。别让虚空控制玛凯雷的更多地盘。

pairs.source: The Azurelight Bazaar once contained all manner of ancient treasure. Comb through the wreckage.
pairs.text: 蔚蓝之光集市上曾经贩卖过各种上古珍宝。在废墟里好好搜寻一下。

pairs.source: Reinforce the Shadow's Concourse so the ethereals cannot move freely between the Umbra Hollows and Shadowguard Incursion.
pairs.text: 快去支援暗影广场，不能让虚灵在幽影谷和影卫入侵营地之间自由行动。

pairs.source: Legion hunters overrun the Arinor Gardens. Determine their mission, and prevent its conclusion.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的猎人正在阿尔诺花园肆虐。快去查清他们的企图，并阻止他们。

pairs.source: Before they turned to fel, the eredar were masters of the arcane. Explore the Praetorium in search of lost magic.
pairs.text: 艾瑞达在堕入邪能前，都是精通奥术的大师。去搜索一下裁判所，寻找失落的魔法。

pairs.source: Void aberrations are spilling out of the Umbra Hollows. Cull their numbers before they overrun Mac'Aree.
pairs.text: 虚空畸体正从幽影谷不断涌出。快去削减他们的数量，别让他们占据玛凯雷。

pairs.source: The voidscarred of Oronaar Collapse are beyond reaching. End their suffering.
pairs.text: 奥罗纳尔陷坑的灵痕克罗库已经没救了。去终结他们的痛苦吧。

pairs.source: The veil between Mac'Aree and the void is fragile within Isolon. Prevent the shadowguard from exploiting this weakness.
pairs.text: 在埃索隆地区，玛凯雷与虚空之间的屏障很脆弱。别让影卫虚灵利用这个弱点。

pairs.source: The waters flowing in the Prophet's Reflection are free of fel and void corruption. Discover how this has come to pass.
pairs.text: 先知的倒影池里的水没有被邪能和虚空的腐化。去研究一下这是怎么回事吧。

pairs.source: Vigilants endlessly patrol Azurelight Square. Recover any vigilants that can be purified. Destroy those that cannot.
pairs.text: 警卫永远都在蔚蓝之光广场巡逻。去把还能获得净化的警卫带回来，没救的干掉。

pairs.source: The shadowguard within the Umbra Hollows must be stopped. Send our champions to halt their rituals.
pairs.text: 必须阻止幽影谷的影卫虚灵。派勇士去阻止他们的仪式吧。

pairs.source: Millennia ago, Azurelight Bazaar was a thriving marketplace. Lost treasures of the eredar may still remain.
pairs.text: 许多年前，蔚蓝之光集市非常繁荣。那里可能还有艾瑞达的失落珍宝。

pairs.source: Roving voidcallers are increasing the shadow's influence in the Shadowguard Incursion. Destroy them.
pairs.text: 徘徊的虚空召唤者正在增强影卫入侵营地的暗影影响力。快把他们干掉。

pairs.source: Power flows through the Conservatory of the Arcane. Augari Wakeners practice their craft in death, and must be purged.
pairs.text: 奥秘学宫里流淌着能量，死去的奥古雷启迪者还在施放着魔法，必须清除他们。

pairs.source: The Talgathi vessel above Kil'jaeden's Terrace ensures the Legion's control over the area. Find a way to dismantle it.
pairs.text: 塔尔加斯的战舰就在基尔加丹平台上方。有它在，燃烧军团就能控制这片区域。设法把它解决掉。

pairs.source: The knowledge to create more vigilants rests within the Wakener's Enclave. Send your champions to retrieve it.
pairs.text: 要想创造更多警卫，就需要启迪者飞地里收藏的知识。快派你的勇士去找找。

pairs.source: Shadowguard Abyss Callers  attempt to summon another void lord through the Umbral Locus. Prevent their ritual from succeeding.
pairs.text: 影卫深渊召唤者想在幽影之地再召唤一个虚空领主。阻止仪式，别让他们成功。

pairs.source: Void Harvesters are collecting a tremendous amount of void energy in the Shadowguard Incursion. They must be destroyed!
pairs.text: 虚空收割器正在影卫入侵营地里收集大量的虚空能量。一定要把它们毁掉！

pairs.source: The Defiled Path leads straight to the Burning Breach. Scout ahead for a path across.
pairs.text: 污染小径直通燃烧裂口。先去侦察一下前面的路吧。

pairs.source: Infernals blaze across Keeper's Juncture. Banish them back into the Nether.
pairs.text: 地狱火在守护者的连接点肆意燃烧。把它们送回扭曲虚空吧。

pairs.source: The Legion's explosive munitions are crafted in Felfire Armory. Steal as many as you can.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的弹药都是在邪火军械库制造的。尽量多偷点出来。

pairs.source: Venture near the Burning Breach. Measure the Legion's defenses.
pairs.text: 前往燃烧裂口，试探一下燃烧军团的防线。

pairs.source: Legion vessels dock at Terminus, taking on soldiers and supplies for their assaults against Azeroth. Bring those vessels down.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的战舰都停靠在终端船坞，等装载好士兵和物资后再出发袭击艾泽拉斯。去把这些战舰打下来。

pairs.source: Eredar summoners call massive infernals from the Nether. Disrupt their portals.
pairs.text: 艾瑞达召唤者从扭曲虚空召唤了巨型地狱火。快去破坏他们的传送门。

pairs.source: Two massive fel cannons are wearing down the Vindicaar's shields. Disable them!
pairs.text: 两台巨型邪能火炮正在削弱维迪卡尔的护盾。快把它们干掉！

pairs.source: Admiral Rel'var coordinates Legion movements from Terminus. Destroy him.
pairs.text: 雷尔瓦将军正在终端船坞协调着燃烧军团的行动。去把他干掉。

pairs.source: Wyrmtongue engineers working in Felfire Armory are easily lured by riches. Exploit this weakness.
pairs.text: 在邪火军械库工作的虫语者工程师很容易就会被财宝引诱。好好利用这一点。

pairs.source: Numerous krokul slaves are working Scavenger's Post. Free as many as you can.
pairs.text: 许多克罗库奴隶正在清道夫岗哨工作。尽量多救几个出来吧。

pairs.source: An endless stream of Legion demons parade across the Defiled Path toward our footholds. Resist the Tide.
pairs.text: 无数恶魔正从污染小径鱼贯而出，向我们的堡垒进军。挡住这如潮的恶魔。

pairs.source: Scores of demon arachnids infest Ven'orn's Lair. Exterminate them.
pairs.text: 海量的恶魔蜘蛛正在维农的巢穴肆虐。快把它们消灭掉。

pairs.source: Many fallen litter the Boneyard. Scour the area for implements of power.
pairs.text: 废料场里到处都是死者。搜寻这片区域，寻找强力的物品。

pairs.source: Scavenger's Post is crawling with wyrmtongue looking for valuable salvage. Beat them to it.
pairs.text: 清道夫岗哨里充斥着寻找珍贵物资的虫语者。我们要抢在他们前面。

pairs.source: We can't allow the demons to circumvent our defenses on Fiend's Run. Reinforce the flanks.
pairs.text: 绝不能让恶魔绕过我们位于恶魔小径的防御工事。快去增援侧翼。

pairs.source: Scores of Legion forces threaten to push the Vindicaar out of the Antoran Wastes permanently. Don't allow it.
pairs.text: 一支燃烧军团部队威胁要把维迪卡尔永远赶出安托兰废土。别让他们得逞。

pairs.source: Legion sorcerers use demon blood in their foul rituals. Relieve them of their supply.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的巫师在使用恶魔之血进行污秽的仪式。去断绝他们的物资供应吧。

pairs.source: Powerful demon lords form the Vanguard of the Legion assault across Fiend's Run. We must take one down.
pairs.text: 强大的恶魔领主组成了燃烧军团先锋，通过恶魔小径打过来了。我们必须击败他们。

pairs.source: Lightforged have been wrapped in webs in Ven'orn's Lair. Free them.
pairs.text: 许多光铸者被维农的巢穴里的蛛网缠住了。去解救他们。

pairs.source: The enemy is targeting our Lightforged Battlesuits. Protect them from the Legion's shriekers.
pairs.text: 敌人的目标是我们的光铸装甲。保护好它们，别让军团的尖啸者破坏了。

pairs.source: Krokul armaments were abandoned in the Petrified Forest. Seek them out.
pairs.text: 克罗库的武器都丢失在了石化森林里。去把它们找出来。

pairs.source: Ancient eredar weapons and armor lay within Mac'Aree. Scour the ruins.
pairs.text: 玛凯雷城里有很多远古艾瑞达武器和护甲。在废墟里好好找找。

pairs.source: Weapons liberated from the Legion can be melted down and reforged into implements of the Light. Raid the enemy's armories.
pairs.text: 从燃烧军团那里缴获的武器可以熔铸成圣光道具。去把敌人的军械库洗劫一空吧。

pairs.source: Darkfall Ridge was a stable settlement for decades. Tools and provisions can be found if the Legion is removed.
pairs.text: 几十年来，堕暗岭一直是一片安稳的定居地。只要打跑燃烧军团，你就能在那找到工具和补给。

pairs.source: Krokul supply caches litter the Argus Wastes. Track them down.
pairs.text: 克罗库补给箱都散落在阿古斯废土上。把它们找出来。

pairs.source: The shadowguard imbue their weaponry with the shadow. Understanding their techniques could yield potent defenses.
pairs.text: 影卫虚灵给自己的武器灌注了暗影。只要搞懂他们的技术，就能为我们增添强大的防御手段。

pairs.source: The Seat of the Triumvirate was a site of miracles. Strip the ruined husk of any marvels that remain.
pairs.text: 执政团之座曾是奇迹之地。搜索一下残留的废墟，看看还有没有什么神奇的东西。

pairs.source: Intercept shipments of raw materials headed for Felfire Armory. Bring it back to the Vindicaar for processing.
pairs.text: 去把运往邪火军械库的原材料拦截下来，带回维迪卡尔处理。

pairs.source: Bring the Light to the Spirit Crucible. Do not allow any more souls to be consumed by the Legion's engines.
pairs.text: 让圣光照亮炼魂熔炉，别再让燃烧军团的引擎吞噬更多的灵魂了。

pairs.source: Chieftain Hatuun has requested that you recover supplies hidden in Darkfall Ridge. In return, Krokul Ridgestalkers will help your forces navigate Argus' desolate landscape.
pairs.text: 酋长哈顿请求你取回藏在堕暗岭的物资。作为报答，克罗库山岭猎手会帮助你的军队摸清阿古斯的荒凉地貌。

pairs.source: The krokul wish to rescue their brethren from Nath'raxas Hold before they are turned by the fel. Should you succeed, the Legion's influence in this region will diminish.
pairs.text: 克罗库想要营救纳斯拉克斯要塞的同胞，防止他们被邪能转化。如果你成功了，军团对这片地区的影响力就会被削弱。

pairs.source: Alleria has asked you to search the Ruins of Oronaar for any krokul not yet consumed by the Shadow.
pairs.text: 奥蕾莉亚请你搜索奥罗纳尔废墟，寻找还没被暗影吞噬的克罗库。

pairs.source: Wresting Argus from the Legion's control will be for naught if the void prevails. Expel the shadowguard from Mac'Aree.
pairs.text: 如果让虚空获胜，那与燃烧军团的战斗就毫无意义了。把玛凯雷的影卫虚灵赶出去。

pairs.source: High Exarch Turalyon has requested your assistance for an audacious assault against the Legion war machine.
pairs.text: 大主教图拉扬请求你帮忙，对军团战争机器展开一次无畏的攻击。

pairs.source: The Army of the Light will delay Legion reinforcements while Felfire Armory is destroyed by your forces.
pairs.text: 只要你的部队摧毁邪火军械库，圣光军团就可以拖慢燃烧军团的增援速度了。

pairs.source: Lady Heretica saturates the infernals of Nath'raxas Hold with Sargerite, dramatically increasing their destructive potential. Put an end to these rituals.
pairs.text: 赫拉迪卡夫人正在为纳斯拉克斯要塞的地狱火填充萨格里特，极大提高了他们的破坏力。去中止这些仪式吧。

pairs.source: The Legion's Pit Lords siphon Primal Sargerite from the Annihilan Pits. Destroy them and collect this Sargerite for our order.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团的熔池领主正在从安尼赫兰熔池虹吸源生萨格里特。去把他们干掉，给我们的组织收集一些萨格里特。

pairs.source: The Portal Keepers beneath Kil'jaeden's Terrace are necessary for the Legion to quickly reinforce Mac'Aree. Send the Portal Keepers back into the Nether.
pairs.text: 基尔加丹平台下面的传送门看护者对燃烧军团快速增援玛凯雷起到了关键作用。把这些传送门看护者送回扭曲虚空吧。

pairs.source: Fel corrupters in the Arinor Gardens thrum with sargerite. Dismantle them.
pairs.text: 阿尔诺花园的邪能腐蚀者正在滥用萨格里特。去把他们解决掉。

pairs.source: Foul experiments breed stronger demons in the Putrid Laboratory. Eliminating the Antoran Soulshapers would halt their progress.
pairs.text: 腐臭实验室正在通过邪恶的实验制造更加强大的恶魔。去把那些安托兰塑灵师消灭掉，就能中断他们的实验了。

pairs.source: The Scavenger's Boneyard lay beneath the Legion's garrisons in the Antoran Wastes. Send your champions to waylay Legion patrols traveling between them.
pairs.text: 食腐者废料场位于燃烧军团在安托兰废土的要塞的下方。派遣你的勇士去偷袭在各个要塞之间巡逻的燃烧军团部队吧。

pairs.source: There are remote regions of the Argus Wastes with little Legion presence. Scout the Wastes for any resources untouched by fel corruption.
pairs.text: 阿古斯废土上有些偏远区域，就连燃烧军团也很少去那里。去侦察一下那些地区，看看能不能弄到一些没被邪能腐化的资源。

pairs.source: When Kil'jaeden's ship crashed into Argus, it uncovered a cave network rich with minerals. We have a day to explore nine caverns before the Legion arrives.
pairs.text: 基尔加丹的战舰坠毁在阿古斯时，爆炸炸出的洞穴网络里有丰富的矿产。在军团赶到之前，我们有一天的时间探索这九个洞窟。

pairs.source: Many fragments of Argus floating near Mac'Aree appear untouched by fel corruption. Send your champions to investigate.`
pairs.text: 玛凯雷附近漂浮着不少阿古斯的碎片，它们似乎还没沾染邪能。派你的勇士去调查一下。

pairs.source: Voidscarred Krokul hoard Argunite in the Ruins of Oranaar for some dark purpose. Uncover their troves.
pairs.text: 灵痕克罗库在奥罗纳尔废墟囤积了很多阿古尼特水晶，打算用它们完成某些不可告人的目的。去把他们的宝库抢过来吧。

pairs.source: A great summoning circle calls demons from  the Twisting Nether back to Argus. Dismantle the circle; slow the Legion's reinforcements.
pairs.text: 有个巨型召唤法阵正在将恶魔从扭曲虚空召唤回阿古斯。破坏这个法阵，拖住燃烧军团的援军。

pairs.source: A vortex of power envelops the Spirit Crucible. Lead an incursion against the Eredar Soulflayers tapping into that energy.
pairs.text: 炼魂熔炉被一股能量漩涡笼罩。带领人马闯进去，消灭那些吸取这种能量的艾瑞达剥魂者。

pairs.source: Lightforged blacksmiths are willing to outfit our champions. Retrieve the materials necessary for their work.
pairs.text: 光铸者铁匠很乐意为我们的勇士打造装备。快去帮他们收集必须的材料吧。

pairs.source: Alleria has revealed a forgotten Eredar armory. We should send our champions to investigate.
pairs.text: 奥蕾莉亚发现了一个被遗忘艾瑞达军火库。我们应该派勇士去调查一下。

pairs.source: Our champions must be adequately armed to assist Hatuun. Order them to search Krokuun for suitable equipment.
pairs.text: 为了帮助哈顿，我们的勇士必须有精良的装备。命令他们去搜索克罗库恩，寻找合适的装备吧。
神器 - 萨满祭司任务
神器 - 恶魔猎手任务
神器 - 死亡骑士任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 战役任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 一般任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 宝藏任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 特殊奖励任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 任务提供任务
7.0 职业大厅 - 宝藏任务 - 地下城
7.0 职业大厅 - 宝藏任务 - 团队副本

pairs.source: Enables you to stable five more mounts at the stable for public display.
pairs.text: 使你的兽栏能够公开展示额外五头坐骑。

pairs.source: A rare mount trader has taken up shop at your garrison stables building.
pairs.text: 一名稀有坐骑商人在你要塞的兽栏中开设了商店。

pairs.source: Allows you to abort a current mission and immediately bring followers back.
pairs.text: 允许你中断当前任务并立即召回追随者。

pairs.source: Recruit a random follower with a specific Trait, Ability or Role for 10 Material.
pairs.text: 花费10份材料，随机招募一名拥有特殊专长、技能或职责的追随者。

pairs.source: Enables access to garrison cooking dailies.
pairs.text: 开启要塞日常烹饪任务。

pairs.source: Additional miners will fill carts for you that are full of ore and other strange things.
pairs.text: 额外的矿工会在你的矿车里装满矿石和其它奇怪的东西。

pairs.source: Plant an orchard in your garrison that will produce rare fruit.
pairs.text: 在你的要塞内开辟一座果园，可生产稀有水果。

pairs.source: Increases the hourly skin gathering rate by 10%.
pairs.text: 每小时的皮革产量提高10%。

pairs.source: Creates bonus material by crushing the waste rocks from mining for use in roads, concrete, etc.
pairs.text: 碾碎挖矿时挖出的废石可获得额外材料，可用于修路、制造水泥等。

pairs.source: Removes travel time for the first misison every day that requres 5 followers.
pairs.text: 移除每天第一个需要5名追随者参与的任务的行动时间。

pairs.source: Provides access to portals that grant transport to cities other than Orgrimmar and Stormwind.
pairs.text: 开启通往除奥格瑞玛和暴风城之外其他城市的传送门。

pairs.source: Automates harvesting of herbs from the garden.
pairs.text: 可自动收获药圃中的草药。

pairs.source: Generates more Blackrock Ore reagents in your shipments.
pairs.text: 每次运到的货物可提供更多的黑石矿石原料。

pairs.source: Generates more True Iron Ore reagents in your shipments.
pairs.text: 每次运到的货物可提供更多的真铁矿石原料。

pairs.source: A delivery a fresh fish every day, direct to your Fishing Shack!
pairs.text: 每天提供新鲜的鱼，直接送往你的渔夫小屋！

pairs.source: Greatly increases the chance that you will find bait while fishing in Garrison waters.
pairs.text: 大大提高你在要塞水域钓鱼时发现鱼饵的几率。

pairs.source: Grants you a chance to catch Frostdeep Minnow's in Garrison waters.  These can be used to summon a Frostdeep Cavedweller.
pairs.text: 使你有一定几率在要塞水域里抓到深寒鲦鱼。这种鱼可以用来召唤深寒穴居者。

pairs.source: Your Alchemy Lab takes on students, and the class has a couple of potions for you each day.
pairs.text: 你的炼金实验室开始招收学徒，他们可以每天为你提供一些药水。

pairs.source: The lab specializes in the mutable nature of physical objects, increasing the amount of Metamorphic Crystals that can be produced each day.
pairs.text: 实验室专研物质的转化属性，提高质变水晶的日产量。

pairs.source: The lab specializes in catalyzing alchemical reactions, increasing the amount of Alchemical Catalysts that can be produced each day.
pairs.text: 实验室专研炼金催化反应，提高炼金催化剂的日产量。

pairs.source: Strengthens the troops in your Call to Arms ability, generating more damage.
pairs.text: 强化受你战斗的召唤技能影响的部队，可造成更多伤害。

pairs.source: Summons a First Aid nurse NPC that grants healing potions and bandages each day.
pairs.text: 召唤一名急救护士NPC，可每天提供药水和绷带。

pairs.source: Occasionally catches thieves who can pay fines or provide useful information to serve their sentence.
pairs.text: 让偶尔抓到的盗贼缴纳罚款或者提供有用情报来赎罪。

pairs.source: Garrison guards patrol your mine, keeping it clear of hostile Goren.
pairs.text: 要塞守卫将巡视你的矿井，驱逐充满敌意的鬣蜥人。

pairs.source: Reduces cost of purchasing buildings and changing specializations.
pairs.text: 降低购买建筑和更改专精的成本。

pairs.source: Though individually frail and unintelligent, ghouls serve the Ebon Blade as fodder, overwhelming their enemies with sheer numbers.
pairs.text: 尽管单个食尸鬼在力量和智能方面都很弱，但它们能够凭借压倒性的数量，充当黑锋骑士团的战力之一。

pairs.source: Fragile but flexible, geists are capable of scaling vertical walls, and climbing over uneven surfaces in order to catch their unwary victims.
pairs.text: 恶鬼脆弱但敏捷，还能攀爬垂直的墙壁。它们常攀附在暗处，袭击毫无防备的目标。

pairs.source: Raised from the grave by the Lich King, Ebon Knights are made for one purpose: Kill, or be killed.
pairs.text: 黑锋骑士由巫妖王亲自复活，他们存在的目的只有一个：杀戮或死亡。

pairs.source: Hardened veterans, Ebon Ravagers have survived many wars, slain many enemies, and are the epitome of the Ebon Blade's fiercest soldiers.
pairs.text: 黑锋掠夺者身经百战、杀敌无数，是黑锋骑士团中最勇猛的士兵。

pairs.source: Devolved after exposure to fel energies, the Ashtongue Broken learned to hide and survive by any means necessary, and will fight from shadow or in the open.
pairs.text: 因暴露在恶魔能量下而慢慢退化的灰舌破碎者学会了不择手段生存下去，他们会在明处和暗处与敌人战斗。

pairs.source: Once loyal to Lady Vashj and Kael'thas, the Coilskar tribe of naga have trained their myrmidons into tough, fearsome warriors.
pairs.text: 曾效忠瓦丝琪和凯尔萨斯的纳迦部族库斯卡将他们的忠仆训练成强大勇猛的战士。

pairs.source: Illidari Demon Hunters adopt the power of demons, sacrificing their elvish features in the process, in order to more effectively slay the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 伊利达雷恶魔猎手接受了恶魔之力，为了更有效地猎杀燃烧军团的恶魔，他们牺牲了原本的精灵外貌。

pairs.source: The most advanced Illidari completely embrace the form and might of demons, transforming into dark, winged creatures capable of obliterating their enemies.
pairs.text: 最高阶的伊利达雷成员全身心接受了恶魔的力量和形态，变成了长翼的黑暗生物，能将敌人彻底消灭。

pairs.source: When the forest is threatened, the trees themselves will come to life to defend their home.
pairs.text: 森林受到威胁时，树木们变成树人保护家园。

pairs.source: Gentle and playful in times of peace, the dryads, half-elf and half-fawn daughters of Cenarius, will relentlessly hunt down those who would do harm to nature.
pairs.text: 树妖是塞纳留斯的女儿，同时具有精灵与神鹿的血统。她们在和平年代开朗温柔，但若有谁敢破坏自然，她们会毫不留情地将其猎杀。

pairs.source: Master shapeshifters, the Druids of the Claw invoke the power of the bear, taking the shape of the beast and utilizing its strength and resilience to ravage their enemies.
pairs.text: 利爪德鲁伊是变形大师，他们能召唤熊的力量，变身成为力大无比又皮糙肉厚的野兽痛击敌人。

pairs.source: Half-elf and half-stag in appearance, with a single clawed hand woven like tree branches, the Keepers of the Grove descend from Cenarius himself, and wield immense power over nature.
pairs.text: 林地守护者是塞纳留斯的后代，他们拥有一半精灵一半雄鹿的身形，一只手像是由树根编制而成的利爪。他们在自然界中拥有无比强大的力量。

pairs.source: Skilled with bows, and often used to support infantry from range, archers are effective in groups when they concentrate their fire on a single target, or at a cluster of enemies.
pairs.text: 弓箭手箭术高超，通常用来给步兵提供远程支援。集群的弓箭手能有效压制单个目标或成群的敌人。

pairs.source: The master Marksmen of the Unseen Path develop their skills so completely, that they are able to hit an enemy with little to no visibility.
pairs.text: 隐秘通途的神射手大师箭术已登峰造极，就算视野很差或根本没有视野，他们也能射中敌人。

pairs.source: No matter how severe the elements or faint the trail, Unseen Trackers are capable of expertly pursuing and dispatching their quarry.
pairs.text: 不管环境多么恶劣、踪迹多么隐秘，隐秘通途的追踪者总能老练地追踪并干掉猎物。

pairs.source: While all hunters have some skill in the outdoors, Pathfinders embrace the lifestyle completely, and not only survive out in the wild by choice, but also have no equal in using the terrain against their opponents.
pairs.text: 所有猎人都有一定的野外生存技能，而探路者更是其中的佼佼者。他们不仅自愿在荒野中生存，利用地形对付敌人的本领更是无人能及。

pairs.source: Though most mages see elementals as unpredictable, frost mages have adopted water elementals as their magical familiar of choice for many centuries.
pairs.text: 大多数法师认为元素生物反复无常难以驾驭，但冰霜法师将水元素收为仆从已经有好几百年的历史了。

pairs.source: Animated by powerful sorcery, Arcane Golems are forged by expert masons and metalworkers, and empowered to defend mages with brute force.
pairs.text: 奥术傀儡由专家级石匠和熔炼师打造而成，并由强大的魔法驱动，用蛮力保护法师们。

pairs.source: The Tirisgarde recruit only the most talented spellcasters to be their apprentices, and even newcomers are more powerful than the masters of lesser orders.
pairs.text: 提瑞斯秘法会只招募最有天赋的施法者当学徒，就算是他们的新学徒也比其他组织里的大师更为强大。

pairs.source: Elite practitioners of the arcane and the elements, Kirin Tor Invokers can boast a legacy that includes Nielas Aran, the father of Medivh, and have no equal in the magical arts.
pairs.text: 肯瑞托召唤师是操控奥术和元素之力的精英施法者，他们在魔法方面的技艺无人能及，麦迪文的父亲聂拉斯·埃兰就是其中一员。

pairs.source: "Physical strength is developed without, but fortitude comes from within." -Wrathion
pairs.text: “力量是外在的表现，而坚忍来自于内心。”——拉希奥

pairs.source: Trained in a fighting style which allows them to outlast most opponents, Ox Adepts have sworn to protect the weak with all their might.
pairs.text: 玄牛高手擅长和对手打持久战，能拖垮大多数对手。倾尽全力保护弱者是他们的庄严使命。

pairs.source: Determined and resilient, only the most stalwart of the Ox monks ascend to be called master, often after facing a test against their worst fears, and overcoming all.
pairs.text: 玄牛武僧坚毅果敢，只有在试炼中克服了自己最大恐惧的最强者才能晋升为大师。

pairs.source: "Strength and power are as different as sun and moon." - Xuen, the White Tiger
pairs.text: “力量与气力的差别，就如日月般一目了然。”——白虎雪怒

pairs.source: Drilled so that their blows fly as fast as lightning, Tiger Adepts understand that restraint, and knowing the perfect time to strike is more important than how hard they hit.
pairs.text: 白虎高手经过勤学苦练，出手迅如闪电。他们知道克制自己等待完美的出手时机，远比用猛力强攻更为重要。

pairs.source: Quick and calm, the masters of the Way of the Tiger harness both patience and power without equal, harnessing their inner strength in the service of others.
pairs.text: 遵循白虎之道的大师们迅捷而沉着，拥有无人能及的力量与耐心。他们驾驭内在的力量服务他人。

pairs.source: Though many squires of the Silver Hand aspire to one day become knights themselves, many see it as an honor to serve someone who has given themselves fully to the Light.
pairs.text: 尽管很多白银之手的侍从都渴望着有朝一日能成为骑士，他们中也有不少人以服侍全身心投入圣光的骑士为荣。

pairs.source: While most paladins of the Silver Hand charge into battle on warhorses, Shieldbearers specialize in defensive combat, forming an impenetrable wall of protection.
pairs.text: 白银之手的大多数圣骑士都会骑马上阵杀敌，而持盾卫士则精通防御性战斗技巧，他们能在战场上立起坚不可摧的防护之墙。

pairs.source: Knights of the Silver Hand devote themselves as diligently to combat training as much as they do to their daily prayers, honing their battle skills in order to best defend the weak and the innocent.
pairs.text: 白银之手的骑士每天不仅虔诚地祈祷，练武也从不懈怠，他们为了保护无辜和弱者而苦练本领。

pairs.source: Templar of the Silver Hand are not only the most skilled in battle, but are also the most righteous in their demeanor. Strength of arms and purity of mind are strict requirements, and only those who possess both are named champions.
pairs.text: 白银之手圣殿骑士不仅武艺出类拔萃，举手投足更是正气凛然。只有同时拥有过人的勇武和纯洁的内心者才有资格晋升为勇士。

pairs.source: Often just beginning on their spiritual path, Acolytes of the Conclave feel a deep desire to learn, and enthusiastically embrace tutelage and tasks.
pairs.text: 教团的助祭往往刚踏上他们的修行之路，他们有着强烈的求知欲，满怀热情地接受指导和执行任务。

pairs.source: Paragons of the Conclave wield the Light with precise expertise, and over the years, have become known for rigorous study and interpretation of texts.
pairs.text: 教团的圣贤能精准地驾驭圣光，多年以来，他们一直以刻苦研读典籍而闻名。

pairs.source: Devoted clergy who undergo strict physical duress, including painful self-flagellation, Zealots of the Conclave willingly endure torment in order to achieve spiritual enlightenment.
pairs.text: 教团的狂热者是虔诚的神职人员，他们的修行方式对肉体十分严苛，其中包括痛苦的自我鞭笞。但为了寻求灵魂的开悟，他们甘愿忍受痛苦。

pairs.source: The dark, secretive rites of the Dark Zealots push faithful practitioners to their breaking point and beyond. Those who survive are capable of cloaking themselves entirely in shadow.
pairs.text: 黑暗狂热者神秘的黑暗仪式会考验参与者的意志，使其突破临界点。从仪式中活下来的人能够将自己完全隐藏在阴影中。

pairs.source: Often called common criminals, Bandits are often used by the Uncrowned to obtain information and goods through stealth or strongarm tactics.
pairs.text: 盗匪与普通的罪犯并无太大区别，无冕者常派他们用偷窃或暴力的手段获取情报与货物。

pairs.source: The hardened outlaws of the Defias Brotherhood, defiant against corrupt nobility, wear red bandanas in order to symbolize the blood shed by the oppressed.
pairs.text: 迪菲亚兄弟会这些久经考验的法外狂徒以反抗贵族的腐败统治为己任，他们通常戴着红色的面罩，象征着受压迫者的鲜血。

pairs.source: "A dueling ring, here?  I suppose if they're going to be degenerate gamblers anyway, they might as well stay in fighting shape."  - Jorach Ravenholdt
pairs.text: “这里居然有决斗场？无论如何都要堕落成赌鬼的话，不如当个能打的赌鬼。”——乔拉齐·拉文霍德

pairs.source: Bloodsail Buccaneers can fight on land and on sea, both sober and not. The sight of their crimson sails on the horizon is enough to convince their enemies to surrender before a single cannon is fired.
pairs.text: 血帆海盗无论在海上还是陆地、无论清醒还是喝醉状态下都能战斗。他们的对手远远看到血红色的船帆时，通常就会吓得放弃抵抗直接投降。

pairs.source: Low-ranking among the elemental hierarchy, lesser elementals overwhelm their foes with sheer, unending numbers.
pairs.text: 小型元素是地位较低的元素生物，靠压倒性的数量吞没敌人。

pairs.source: Only the most powerful shamans can summon and command a greater elemental, or else the greater elemental may turn on them and punish them for their hubris.
pairs.text: 只有最强大的萨满才能召唤并支配巨型元素。换做其他人，很可能会命丧巨型元素之手。

pairs.source: "You do not need ears to hear the earth beneath you as it needs not words to speak." - Earthcaller Yevaa
pairs.text: “倾听脚下的大地并不需要耳朵，因为大地之声无需言语。”——唤地者耶法

pairs.source: "It proves difficult for your enemies to defeat you when you command the very ground on which they stand." - Geomancer Jakara
pairs.text: “如果你能支配敌人脚下的土地，那他们想击败你简直是异想天开。”——地卜师贾卡拉

pairs.source: Proficient air shamans act as a living conduit for the elements, wrapping themselves in the fury of the tempest as they become an Air Ascendant.
pairs.text: 老练的空气萨满能够化身成为元素之力的导体，将身体包裹在狂怒的风暴中，化身为空气升腾者。

pairs.source: Infusing their bodies with flame, Fire Ascendants become one with the inferno, searing their enemies down to the bone.
pairs.text: 烈焰升腾者将火焰注入自己的体内，与烈焰融为一体，将敌人烧成灰烬。

pairs.source: Transcending flesh and embracing the element of water, Water Ascendants harness the versatile and cleansing power of the seas, with a strength as deep as the ocean itself.
pairs.text: 超越肉体的束缚、接受水元素的流水升腾者驾驭流水多变而洁净的力量，如同大海一般深沉而强大。

pairs.source: Lowly among demons, imps are often underestimated due to their singular lack of toughness. Yet when in a group, they quickly replace the fallen, and their real threat is in how difficult it is to kill every single one of them.
pairs.text: 小鬼是低阶恶魔，常常因为单体力量薄弱而被低估。但集群之后，它们前赴后继，最让人头疼的一点就是很难把它们赶尽杀绝。

pairs.source: "I've no idea where they came from.  One minute I was there raining hellfire upon my enemies, and next thing I know these little fiends were swarming around, flinging fel bolts everywhere." -Lulubelle Fizzlebang
pairs.text: “我们不知道它们从哪儿冒出来的。我刚刚还在对敌人降下火雨，一转眼就发现一大群这种小鬼东西到处乱丢邪能箭。”——露露贝拉·菲兹班

pairs.source: The Acolytes of the Black Harvest are ready to sacrifice everything for the forbidden knowledge they pursue, including each other. Many of the newer acolytes are often found dead after experimental rituals.
pairs.text: 黑暗收割议会的助祭愿意为了探求禁断的知识献出一切，包括彼此的生命。很多新加入的助祭常常在实验性仪式中丧命。

pairs.source: It is rare for acolytes of the Black Harvest to reach the rank of Invoker, as they are often consumed by the dark energies they call upon as part of their ascent.
pairs.text: 黑暗收割议会中很少有助祭能晋升为祈祷者，因为他们常常会被自己在晋升仪式中召唤出来的黑暗能量吞噬。

pairs.source: "The vrykul prisoners we took looked at their fallen comrades with an odd sadness.  They looked like they envied the dead." -King Varian Wrynn
pairs.text: “我们抓来的维库囚犯用怪异而悲伤的眼神看着死去的同伴。就好像他们羡慕死者一样。”——瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王

pairs.source: Valarjar that prove themselves in the afterlife are rewarded with bodies cast from pure metals and cloaked lightning from the skies.
pairs.text: 能够在死后的生命中证明自己的瓦拉加尔得到的奖励是纯粹的金属与天空中的闪电打制的身躯。

pairs.source: Direct in their disposition and their tactics, Shieldmaidens seek to prove their worth in battle, so that their name is remembered forever in Odyn's Hall of Valor.
pairs.text: 女武神的性格耿直，战术也是直来直往，她们追求在战斗中证明自己的价值，让自己的名字在奥丁的英灵殿中永世流传。

pairs.source: The mightiest of shieldmaidens are chosen by the Valkyra to serve Eyir, a titan watcher. If she dies valiantly, a Valkyra Shieldmaiden may be chosen to become a legendary Val'kyr.
pairs.text: 瓦尔基拉会挑选最强大的女武神为泰坦监护者艾尔效力。如果瓦尔基拉女武神英勇战死，则将会被选为传说的瓦格里。

pairs.source: The echo of Niuzao is strong and unyielding, capable of withstanding even the toughest foes.
pairs.text: 砮皂的回响坚毅顽强，能抵御最强大的敌人。

pairs.source: The echo of Chi-Ji restores allies' spirits with its beautiful song, invigorating them with energy and purpose.
pairs.text: 赤精的回响能用美妙的歌声恢复盟友的士气，给他们活力和希望。

pairs.source: The echo of Xuen embodies the ferocity and cunning of the tiger celestial, dealing incredible damage on the field of battle.
pairs.text: 雪怒的回响代表了白虎天神的凶猛与灵敏，能在战场上造成难以置信的伤害。

pairs.source: Calling upon long forgotten energies of conflicts from ages past, this guardian provides a link to the brutal side of nature and the cycle of life and death that rules all creation.
pairs.text: 这名守护者能唤起古老的冲突中被遗忘的能量，令自然展现出可怕的一面，并再现支配万物的生死循环。

pairs.source: Powerful echos of the Celestials empower their chosen allies with strength, restoration and ferocity.
pairs.text: 激荡的天神之力将力量、重生与野性赋予他们选中的盟友。

pairs.source: Stitched together from several different bodies, abominations are large, tough, undead brutes armed with cleavers and hooks, ready to tear apart their foes with a single swing.
pairs.text: 手持切肉刀和肉钩的憎恶由若干具尸体缝合而成，魁梧、强大而野蛮，时刻准备着将敌人一刀撂倒。

pairs.source: On the frozen wings of their steeds they fall upon their victims with fury and vengeance. Those who face the Frostreavers quickly learn to fear the sky above them.
pairs.text: 他们乘着坐骑冰封的双翼，将怒火和复仇降到受害者的头上。那些面对寒霜骑士的人很快就会开始畏惧头顶的天空。

pairs.source: Towering over the battlefield, these demonic priestesses carve through their foes with a fury of blades being wielded by their 6 arms. When facing these monstrosities, all notion of a fair fight should be abandoned.
pairs.text: 这些高大的恶魔女祭司俯视战场，用六条手臂挥舞长剑，在敌阵中杀出一条血路。在面对这些怪物时，对于战斗稍有概念的人都该懂得放弃。

pairs.source: Wardens of the Dreamgrove are recruited and trained from a very young age. Removed from their families, they develop such a tight bond with the grove itself that they will feel physical pain should any harm come to it.
pairs.text: 梦境林地的守护者都是从小招募和训练的。他们远离家人，与林地本身产生了紧密的联系。只要有任何威胁靠近林地，都会让他们感受到切肤之痛。

pairs.source: Rarely seen among the Nightborne, the Hunter class are experts at striking from hidden positions. They often leverage the paths of the Arcways itself to attack, and then disappear before their foe even knew they were there.
pairs.text: 在夜之子中非常少见的猎人是伏击的专家。他们经常利用魔法回廊的地形进行攻击，然后在敌人发现之前悄然远遁。

pairs.source: Sworn with the protection of the Kirin Tor, these highly trained Guardians are a terrifying addition to any battle. With razor sharp precision, they unleash brutal coordinated assaults on enemy lines.
pairs.text: 这些训练有素的卫兵曾发誓保护肯瑞托，是战场上不容忽视的可怕力量。他们能够极其精准地对敌方阵列发动强大的协同攻击。

pairs.source: While many students of the Monk paths will focus and specialize on a particular Celestial, Masters of Serenity believe that a more even approach will bring them closer to enlightenment.
pairs.text: 虽然许多武僧弟子都会专注于某位至尊天神的流派，但宁静大师们相信，均衡发展可以让他们更接近启迪。

pairs.source: Deployed to only the most vicious battlefields, Crusaders are the Silver Hand's answer to an immovable barrier.
pairs.text: 十字军只出现在最险恶的战场上，是白银之手的攻坚部队。

pairs.source: If you ever see a Hooded Priest walking towards you, turn around and walk the other way. Maybe even run.
pairs.text: 如果你看到一位带着兜帽的牧师向你走来，那你最好转身换条路走，甚至是用跑的。

pairs.source: Ravenholdt's personal guard. Deployed form his manor whenever a "special" occasion demands it.
pairs.text: 拉文霍德的私人卫兵。每当有“特殊”情况发生时，他们才会出动。

pairs.source: Though still reeling from the great sundering, the Earthen Ring heeds the call on the Broken Isles. The threat posed by the Legion is too great, and requires a rallying of all sides.
pairs.text: 虽然大分裂的余波仍在，大地之环还是响应号召来到了破碎群岛。燃烧军团的威胁太强大了，需要团结一切可团结的力量。

pairs.source: Massive brutes which thrive on destruction, many believe them to be mindless, but they actually are quite intellectual, for a demon.
pairs.text: 魁梧的野蛮战士，以破坏为乐。许多人认为他们没有脑子，其实对恶魔而言，他们相当聪明。

pairs.source: Only the most elite, the most battle hardened of soldiers make it into the Shock Forces.
pairs.text: 只有最精锐、最久经战火考验的士兵才能加入突击队。

pairs.source: The Lightforged are implacable soldiers in an unwinnable war. Bathed in the Light and armed with holy fire, they effortlessly carve through scores of lesser demons.
pairs.text: 光铸者是坚定的战士，坚持着一场看似毫无胜算的战争。他们沐浴在圣光中，以圣焰为武器，足以在低级恶魔中轻松杀出重围。

pairs.source: The Krokul have evaded extinction and endured Argus' infernal landscape. They are survivors.
pairs.text: 克罗库在阿古斯地狱般的环境中逃过了灭顶之灾并得以存续。他们是生存专家。

pairs.source: The Broken of Mac'Aree were spared the Fel, only to succumb to the Void. A few Void-Touched have had their minds unclouded, but they remain inextricably bonded to the Shadow.
pairs.text: 玛凯雷的破碎者虽然逃过了邪能的魔掌，却还是屈服于虚空的力量。少数灵媒克罗库虽然心智尚存，但还是无法摆脱与虚空的联系。

pairs.source: Grimtotem Warriors fight to eliminate enemies of the Tauren. To the Grimtotem, nearly all races are enemies of the Tauren. However, while Magatha remains in the Maelstrom, the Grimtotem will assist the Earthen Ring.
pairs.text: 恐怖图腾的战士战斗的目的是消灭牛头人的敌人。对恐怖图腾来说，几乎所有种族都是牛头人的敌人。但是，只要玛加萨还留在大漩涡，恐怖图腾就会协助大地之环。

pairs.source: Enables a chance on mission success for your Champions to return with Champion armaments or equipment.
pairs.text: 你的勇士在成功完成任务后有几率带回勇士武器或装备。

pairs.source: Allows you to place a work order for 1 of your 3 weekly Seals of Broken Fate in exchange for Order Resources.
pairs.text: 你可以下达工作订单，用职业大厅资源交易获得每周3个破碎命运印记中的1个。

pairs.text: 可以获得火焰领主、大地领主、风之领主和水之领主的帮助。每天会有一个随机的元素领主出现在你的职业大厅中，给你提供一个强大的战斗增益。

pairs.text: 使你非重复类的任务奖励额外升级为稀有或史诗品质的几率提高。

我一直都会乐意帮助你的。

pairs.source: A guy walked up to me and said, "I'm a teepee, I'm a wigwam, I'm a teepee, I'm a wigwam."  I said, "Relax, man, you're too tense."
One good thing about being dead, biological clock seems to have stopped.
Us Undead girls really know how to have a good time because, after all, what's the worst thing that could happen?
I don't care that much about romance.  I fell in love before, and look what happened to me.

pairs.text: 我一直都会乐意帮助你的。

pairs.source: You know, older bulls really only have one function.
pairs.text: 你要知道，年长的公牛只有一个功能。

pairs.source: Allow me to express my deepest thanks.
pairs.text: 请允许我表示我深深的感谢。

pairs.source: You can't start a duel while invisible
pairs.text: 你无法在隐形状态下开始决斗

pairs.source: Some of your settings will not take effect until you restart the game.
pairs.text: 你的有些设置需要你重新启动游戏才能够生效。

pairs.source: You must repair that item before you auction it.
pairs.text: 你必须先修理该物品才能将其拍卖。

pairs.source: You can press the |cffffd200Spacebar|r to make your character jump. You can use jumping to get past obstacles or just for fun.
pairs.text: 你可以按下|cffffd200空格键|r来进行跳跃。跳跃可以帮助你越过障碍物，跳跃本身也很有趣。

pairs.source: This is a flight master who trains flying beasts to carry passengers from one location to another. For a minimal fee, you can swiftly travel to other flight masters that you have spoken to in the past.|n|nWhen you discover a new city, finding the flight master will allow you to return easily in the future.
pairs.text: 这是一个专门训练飞行兽并提供飞行运输服务的飞行管理员。只需一小笔花费，你就可以快速地飞往任何你曾经接触过的飞行管理员那里。|n|n当你发现一座新的城镇之后，最好先去找到该城镇的飞行管理员，以便日后能够快速抵达这里。

pairs.source: The durability of one of your items is getting low. The character icon below your minimap indicates the damaged item in yellow.|n|nFind a vendor in town to repair the item before it breaks.
pairs.text: 你的一件装备的耐久值已经很低。耐久值低的装备显示为小地图下方角色图标的黄色部分。|n|n找到城镇中的商人，在装备完全损坏前进行修理。

pairs.source: One of your items has broken! The character icon below your minimap indicates the broken item in red.|n|nYou can get the item repaired by a vendor in town. Until you do, you will gain no benefit from the item.
pairs.text: 你的一件装备已经损坏！损坏的装备显示为小地图下方角色图标的红色部分。|n|n你可以找城镇中的商人为你修理装备。装备得到修理前将无法为你提供属性加成。

pairs.source: Uncheck to disable glowing effect while in ghost form. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.
pairs.text: 关闭此选项可以禁止鬼魂状态下的泛光效果，可略微提高运行速度。

pairs.source: You are already on that quest.
You are already on that quest.
Man, dawg, you know, it's like I'm feeling you, but I'm not feeling you, you know?
May your generosity be returned to you a hundred fold.
pairs.text: 愿你再次表现的如此慷慨而且其程度可以是现在的一百倍。

pairs.source: Enough of this chit chat.  Let's get to it, then.
pairs.text: 废话够了。让我们开始吧。

pairs.source: Oh, I'm having a wardrobe malfunction.  Oh, there's my hammer.
pairs.text: 哦，我的衣橱有点问题。哦，那是我的锤子。

pairs.source: I don't drink anymore.  'Course, I don't drink any less, either.
I don't like to be underground.  It reminds me of death.
My uncle has brass balls.  No, really!
pairs.text: 我的叔叔有黄铜作的球。不，这是真的！

pairs.source: I don't have a drinking problem.  I drink, I get drunk, I fall down, no problem.
I'd like to see you in a kilt.
Baby, I'm mortal now.  Time's a wasting.
You know those Ancient Protectors in Darnassas?  They're not that old.
pairs.text: 你知道达纳苏斯的古代保护者吗? 它们并不是那么古老。

pairs.source: Man, I was halfway through the Emerald Dream when I had to pee.
I'm the type of girl my mother warned me about.
pairs.text: 我是我妈妈警告过的那种女孩。

pairs.source: Actually, I'm more of a morning elf.
Oh, I'm dancing again.  I hope all your friends are enjoying the show.
pairs.text: 哦，我又在跳舞了。我希望你所有的朋友都喜欢这个表演。

pairs.source: Check my breath.  Is it bad enough for you?
Don't mind the drool.  It's just embalming fluid.
You don't need deodorant when you don't have any armpits.
pairs.text: 如果你没有腋窝的话既不需要任何除臭剂。

pairs.source: I heard a knee slapper once, and skipped my kneecap right across a lake.
May the wind be at your back.
May your ancestors forever guard your path.
pairs.text: 愿你的祖先会永远指引你前进。

pairs.source: Mess with the bull, you get the horns.
I've got big soulful eyes, long eyelashes, and a wet tongue.  What more could a guy want?
You know how hard it is to get your groove on with the spirit of your great grandmother looking over you?
I have a number of inventions I'd like to show you back at my place.
I had an idea for a device that you could put small pieces of bread in to cook, but in the end I really didn't think there would be much of a market for it.
They will speak of your exploits for generations.
pairs.text: 他们会世代颂扬你的发现的。

pairs.source: I kill two dwarves in the morning, I kill two dwarves at night.  I kill two dwarves in the afternoon, and then I feel alright. I kill two dwarves in time of peace and two in time of war. I kill two dwarves before I kill two dwarves, and then I kill two more.
You don't have enough money for that quest.
pairs.text: 你没有足够的钱去完成这个任务。

pairs.source: I'd like to give a shout out to my boys in Gnomeregan.  Keeping it real Big-T, Snoop-Pup, and Little Dees.  Y'all are short, but you're real, baby.
I got a shrunken head.  I just came out of the pool.
Talents are spent through the talent interface and are used\nto acquire special talents that improve and customize your character.
pairs.text: 天赋通过天赋界面分配，其作用是\n获取特定天赋以强化并自定义你的角色。

如果你队伍的成员符合条件的话

Adds to your Attack Power, Damage-Per-Second. Strength
does not affect Critical Hit chances at all. Strength does
not improve your chance to block, but rather the amount

part by Strength (and the other part by your shield).

增加你的攻击强度和每秒伤害。
力量不会影响爆击的几率。力量

另一部分由盾牌本身的属性决定。
你看上去相当……相当美味。

pairs.source: You're the type I'd like to sink my teeth into.
pairs.text: 你是那种我恨之入骨的人。

pairs.source: I come from the Orcs.  We eat with spoons and forks.  We love to eat our pork.
I like men who aren't afraid to cry; cry uncle.
I feel very feminine, and I'll beat the crap out of anyone who disagrees.
You'd like to run your hands through my beard, wouldn't you?
pairs.text: 你是不是想要摸摸我的胡子，是不是？

pairs.source: Let's get on with it, then.  I've got a quest to do in fifteen minutes.
I like my beer like I like my women; stout and bitter.
Oh, I'm just a social drinker.  Every time someone says, "I'll have a drink", I say, "So shall I."
I'll have you know I can flatten steel with my thighs.
pairs.text: 我会让你知道我能用我的大腿打磨钢。

pairs.source: I won't fall for any bad pickup line.  You've got to try two or three, at least.
You're an Emerald Dream come true.
pairs.text: 你简直好像是翡翠梦境变成了真实一样。

pairs.source: Last night I went to an awesome stag party.
I don't know about you, but I can't understand a thing those Wisps say.  I usually just nod.
There's nothing like sleeping in the forest under the moonlight.
pairs.text: 没有什么比得上在月光沐浴下在森林里睡觉的事情了。

pairs.source: You know, Wisps are actually pretty useful for personal hygiene.
pairs.text: 你要知道，小精灵对于个人卫生很有用处。

pairs.source: I don't smell that bad for a dead dude, do I?
Roses are gray, violets are gray.  I'm dead and color blind.
Hey diddle diddle, the mucus and the spittle, the corpse sank in the lagoon.  The murloc said, "Ahhh..." to see such a sight, and the Dwarf spanked the baboon.
You know, once you're dead, nothing smells bad anymore.  Rotten eggs?  No problem.  Dead fish?  Like a spring breeze.
pairs.text: 你要知道，一旦你死了，就没有什么不好闻的东西了。腐臭的鸡蛋？没有问题。死鱼？那好像一股清新的威风。

pairs.source: Why does everyone automatically assume I know tailoring and cooking?
That armor looks good on you.  It would also look good on my floor.
pairs.text: 你穿的护甲不错。如果它能躺在我的地板上的话会更好。

pairs.source: You have six different smiles; one for when you're angry, one for when you tear flesh, one for when you chew flesh, one for when you loot bodies, one for when you skin game, and one for when you want to kill something.
I look bigger in those mirrors where things look bigger.

Your character can learn professions such as Cooking or Blacksmithing, which will allow you to find or create items of value.|n|nTo learn more about professions ask a guard in a major city for directions to the profession trainers.
pairs.text: 你的角色可以学习专业，如烹饪或锻造，专业使你能够采集或制造珍贵的物品。|n|n你可以向各大主城中的守卫询问各种专业的训练师所在的位置。

pairs.source: You may want to invite other players to team up with you to more easily overcome your enemies.|n|nMany difficult quests can be quickly completed in a group, as quest credit is shared by the group. Moreover, groups earn bonus experience, relative to solo players.
pairs.text: 你可以邀请其他玩家与你组队，使战斗过程更为轻松。|n|n组队使你可以轻松完成许多困难的任务，队伍中的成员将共享杀死的怪物。而且组队时还可以获得一定的经验值奖励。
