Able to walk/jump through a wall
Getting ported to the wrong graveyard
The following are not considered environment issues:
pairs.text: 以下不被认为是环境问题：

pairs.source: Player died and would like a port back to original location
pairs.text: 玩家死亡后希望被传送到原来的位置

pairs.source: Inquiry of a location that is difficult to find
pairs.text: 询问一个很难找到的地方

pairs.source: Issues that deal with NPCs and Creeps functioning or interacting incorrectly
pairs.text: 与NPC和野生怪物交流的问题或者别的交流问题

pairs.source: The following are examples of Non-Quest NPC/Creep issues:
pairs.text: 以下是非任务NPC/怪物的例子：
野生生物一直保持躲避状态
野生生物重生速度过快或者过慢

pairs.source: Vendor NPC not itemized or not responding
pairs.text: NPC商人没有物品出售或者没有反映

pairs.source: The following are NOT considered Non-quest NPC/Creep issues:
pairs.text: 以下不被认为是非任务NPC/怪物的问题：

pairs.source: Request for Non-Quest NPC/Creep spawn or despawn
pairs.text: 需要关于非任务NPC/野生怪物重生或者移除的请求
需要关于非任务NPC/野生怪物信息的请求

pairs.source: Problem with Quest related NPCs or Creeps
pairs.text: 和任务相关的NPC或者怪物的问题
报告非任务NPC/野生怪物问题

pairs.source: An issue that results in the inability to initiate or complete a quest
pairs.text: 关于无法实施或者开始或者完成任务的问题

pairs.source: The following are examples of Quest/Quest NPC issues:
pairs.text: 以下是任务/任务NPC的例子：

pairs.source: A quest related NPC or object is not functioning appropriately
pairs.text: 任务相关NPC或者物体无法正常工作

pairs.source: Unable to acquire quest related items
pairs.text: 无法获取任务相关物品

pairs.source: Quest creep not dropping a required quest item
pairs.text: 任务要求所杀的怪物不掉落任务所需要的物品

pairs.source: The following are NOT considered Quest/Quest NPC issues:
pairs.text: 以下不被认为是任务/任务NPC问题：
需要任务NPC/野生怪物信息的请求

pairs.source: Request for information that would simplify a quest
pairs.text: 需要关于简化一个任务的信息请求

pairs.source: Our Technical Support team is available to help you with any technical issues that occur while you are using World of Warcraft.
pairs.text: 我们的技术团队会解决您在魔兽世界游戏中遇到的任何技术问题。

pairs.source: The following are examples of Technical issues:
pairs.text: 以下是技术问题的例子：

pairs.source: Decline in game performance (game becomes slow or choppy)
pairs.text: 游戏运行表现降低（游戏速度变慢或者出现停顿）

pairs.source: Display errors (black boxes, flickering objects, distortions, etc)
pairs.text: 显示错误（黑色方形物体，物体显示闪烁，显示扭曲等等）

pairs.source: Cinematics or in-game movies not playing correctly
pairs.text: 过场动画或者别的游戏动画无法正常播放

pairs.source: Having problems setting up your account or need to make changes to your billing options?
pairs.text: 创建账号的时候遇到问题或者支付问题

pairs.source: Billing & Account services can help with these kinds of issues:
pairs.text: 支付和账号服务和以下事务相关：

pairs.source: Help setting up new accounts or making changes to existing accounts
Canceling your World of Warcraft account
Issues regarding abilities, professions, reputation, and talents
pairs.text: 关于技能，职业，声望和天赋的问题

pairs.source: The following are examples of character issues:
pairs.text: 以下是角色相关问题的例子：
技能/属性缺失或者无法正常发挥效力

pairs.source: Unable to log in to World of Warcraft
Skill level is showing as negative

pairs.text: 天赋不正常工作或者出现缺失

pairs.source: Information about your character, including equipment, combat statistics, and reputation.
pairs.text: 关于你的角色的各种信息，包括装备、战斗属性和声望。

pairs.source: Show information on spells, and interface.
pairs.text: 显示法术和界面的信息。

pairs.source: To prepare a spell or ability for use, open the Spellbook & Abilities window, left-click the spell or ability and drag it down to your action bar.
pairs.text: 你的所有法术和技能。如果你想要将法术或技能图标拖到动作条上，就打开法术书和技能窗口，左键点击你想要拖拉的法术或者技能，然后将其拖到动作条上。

pairs.source: The array of talents available to enhance and specialize your character.
pairs.text: 天赋的各种组合选择能够强化你的角色，并使你的角色与众不同。

pairs.source: A list of all the active quests you currently have. You can have up to 25 active quests at one time.
pairs.text: 你现在所拥有的任务。你最多可以同时拥有25条任务记录。

pairs.source: Information about other people in the game. You can use the Social window to manage your friends list and ignore list, as well as see who is online.
pairs.text: 关于游戏中的其他玩家人物的信息。你可以使用社交窗口来设置你的好友名单和屏蔽名单，以及查看有哪些玩家在线。

pairs.source: As you explore a zone, more areas of interest will become visible on the world map. You can use left-click to zoom in, or right-click to zoom out.
pairs.text: 在你探索一个地区时，它附近的地区会显示在世界地图上。你可以使用左键放大地图，右键缩小地图。

pairs.source: Modify your settings, change your hotkeys or exit the game.
pairs.text: 更改各项设置，自定义快捷键或退出游戏。

pairs.source: Access the Online Knowledge Base or speak to a Game Master (GM) about a problem you are having.
pairs.text: 您可以通过在线知识库或是与GM对话来解决您遇到的问题。

pairs.source: The time it takes to talk with the game server. Consistently high (red) latencies may indicate a problem with your Internet connection.
pairs.text: 和游戏服务器通讯的平均时间。如果延迟一直很高（红色）的话，那么你的互联网连接可能有问题。

pairs.source: Commands used for communicating with others. With the Chat menu, you can talk to people standing nearby, send a private message to one person, chat with party members, wave at a friend, or create a macro.
pairs.text: 与别人联系的命令。使用聊天菜单，你可以和周围的玩家聊天，可以发送悄悄话，或者和队伍成员聊天，和一个朋友挥手致意或者创建一个宏。

pairs.source: The amount of experience (XP) you have earned. The color of the XP bar indicates your rest state: light blue for Rested, and purple for Normal. Rested players earn twice the experience they would normally gain from slaying a monster. Characters become less rested when they kill monsters, and more rested by spending time at or logging out at an inn or city.
pairs.text: 你所得到的经验值（XP）。你的经验槽的颜色代表了你的休息状态，蓝色代表精力充沛，紫色代表正常。精力充沛的玩家通过杀死怪物所得的经验值是正常状态下的两倍，你可以在城市或者旅馆中逗留或者下线以获得更多的休息良好状态时间。

pairs.source: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
pairs.text: 右键点击获得这个窗口的自定义选项列表。左键点击并拖拉来移动这个窗口。

pairs.source: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
pairs.text: 右鍵點擊獲得這個視窗的自定義選項列表。左鍵點擊拖曳來移動這個視窗。

pairs.source: If you belong to a party, you can right-click your portrait to bring up the Party Options menu. This menu will allow you to quit the party or see what looting rules the party is using. A party leader can add or remove party members, as well as change the party's looting rules.
pairs.text: 如果你在一个小队中，你可以右键点击你的头像来打开小队选项菜单。这个菜单可以让你退出队伍或者查看现在使用的物品捡拾方式。小队的领袖可以增加或者移除队员，并且还可以改变物品捡拾方式。

pairs.source: Right-click to bring up special commands for interacting with another player. You can inspect their equipment, issue a party invite, initiate a trade, or challenge a player to a duel. A group leader can promote or remove that player from the group.
pairs.text: 右键点击可以实施和别的玩家交互的特殊命令。你可以查看他们的装备，发出组队邀请，开启交易窗口或者和他进行对决。一个队伍的领导可以提升队伍中队员的作用或者将其移除队伍。

pairs.source: Abandons the selected quest, removing it from the Quest Log. Any quest that you abandon can be accepted again at some later date. There is no penalty for abandoning a quest.
pairs.text: 放弃选定的任务，将其从任务日志中移除。任何被放弃的任务都可以重新获得。放弃一个任务不会给你带来任何惩罚。

pairs.source: Shares the selected quest with any party members who are eligible for the quest. Certain quests, such as those granted by items, cannot be shared.
pairs.text: 和符合条件的队伍队员共享任务。有些任务（比如通过物品触发的任务）无法共享。

pairs.source: Enable this option for smooth lighting across characters.
pairs.text: 开启这个选项可以平滑角色光线表现。

pairs.source: Allows you to locate other players in the world.
pairs.text: 找到其他玩家在这个世界中的位置。

pairs.source: Allows you to modify the list of players whom you are currently ignoring.
pairs.text: 编辑你想要屏蔽的玩家的名单。

pairs.source: Allows you to manage a list of players you enjoy playing with. You receive notifications of friends logging on or off.
pairs.text: 编辑你比较乐意一起游戏的玩家的名单。你可以收到这些玩家上线和下线的提示。

pairs.source: Allows you to view information about your guild, and players in it. If you are an officer, you can also manage your guild from this tab.
pairs.text: 查看关于你所在的公会及其会员的信息。如果你是公会的管理人员，还可以在这个窗口中进行公会管理工作。

pairs.source: Allows you to view or modify your raid group. Raid groups are groups of more than 5 people used to defeat very difficult challenges at high levels.
pairs.text: 查看或者编辑你的大型团队。团队是一支由超过5个玩家组成的队伍，可以用来击败高等级的非常强大的敌人。

pairs.source: Adds a player to your friends list. You will be notified whenever a friend logs on or off. Other players do not know whether they are on your friends list.
pairs.text: 将一个玩家添加到你的好友名单中。当该玩家登录或者退出游戏的时候，你会收到相应的提示。其他玩家不会知道他们是否在你的好友名单之上。

pairs.source: Removes the selected player from your friends list.
pairs.text: 将选定的玩家从你的好友名单之中移除。

pairs.source: Sends a private message to the selected player.
pairs.text: 给选定的玩家发送信息。

pairs.source: Invites the selected player to join a group.
pairs.text: 邀请选择的玩家加入队伍。

pairs.source: Adds a player to your ignore list. You will no longer see messages or other text from players on your ignore list, nor will these players be able to communicate with you in any other way.
pairs.text: 将一个玩家添加到你的屏蔽名单中。你将不会收到屏蔽名单上玩家的信息或者别的文字，被屏蔽的玩家也无法使用任何方式与你联络。

pairs.source: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.
pairs.text: 将选定的玩家从你的屏蔽名单之中移除。

pairs.source: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.
pairs.text: 將選定的玩家從你的忽略名單中移除。

pairs.source: Promotes the selected player one rank higher.
pairs.text: 提升所选择玩家在公会中的等级。

pairs.source: Demotes the selected player one rank lower.
pairs.text: 降低所选择玩家在公会中的等级。

pairs.source: Removes the selected player from the guild.
pairs.text: 将选定的玩家移除公会。

pairs.source: Adds a new player to the guild.
Invites the selected guild member to join a group.
pairs.text: 邀请选择的公会成员加入队伍。

pairs.source: Allows you to customize the names of each rank in your guild, along with its privileges.
pairs.text: 自定义公会等级的名称和它们的权限。

pairs.source: Click to view your public note. This is information that other players will see about you in the guild UI. If you click on the note itself, you will be able to edit it.
pairs.text: 点击察看你的公共信息。这个信息是别人通过公会用户界面可以查看到的。如果你点击这条信息，那你就可以对其进行编辑。

pairs.source: Invites the selected player to join a group.
pairs.text: 邀请选择的玩家加入队伍。

pairs.source: Under master-looter rules, the group leader is the only group member allowed to loot items at or above the threshold. Items below threshold and money are distributed via the round robin rules.
pairs.text: 在队长分配规则下，只有队伍领袖才能够捡拾品质等于或高于预设级别的物品。在该级别之下的物品和金钱采用轮流拾取方式分配。

pairs.source: Under round-robin rules, group members take turns looting the monsters that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
pairs.text: 在轮流拾取规则下，队伍队员按照顺序捡拾怪物掉落物品。金钱自动平分。

pairs.source: Under free-for-all rules, all group members may loot a monster that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
pairs.text: 在自由拾取规则下，所有的队伍队员都可以捡拾任何杀死怪物掉下的物品。金钱自动平分。

pairs.source: Surrenders your leadership of the group, naming the selected player to succeed you.
pairs.text: 交出队伍的领导权，选定的玩家将继续行使这一职责。

pairs.source: Removes the selected player from the group.
pairs.text: 将选定的玩家移出队伍。

pairs.source: Inspects any armor and weapons that the selected player has equipped.
pairs.text: 观察选定的玩家所装备的护甲和武器。

pairs.source: Initiates a trade with the selected player.
pairs.text: 与选择的玩家进行交易。

pairs.source: Causes you to begin following the selected player. You will automatically continue to follow the player until this auto follow mode is disrupted.
pairs.text: 让你开始跟随选定的玩家。你将自动跟随这个玩家，直到自动跟随模式被取消。

pairs.source: Challenges the selected player to a duel. The first player to reach zero hit points loses the duel.
pairs.text: 向选定的玩家发出挑战，进行对决。生命值首先降到零的玩家将被判负。

pairs.source: Information about your pet, including its combat statistics, spell resistances, and diet.
pairs.text: 关于你宠物的信息，包括它的战斗属性、法术抗性和食谱。

pairs.source: Gives your pet a new name that you specify. A pet can only be renamed once.
pairs.text: 给你的宠物设定一个新名字。一个宠物只能被改名一次。

pairs.source: Abandons your pet, letting it return to the wild. Once you abandon a pet, you can never regain its companionship.
pairs.text: 放弃你的宠物，让它回归自然。一旦你放弃了宠物，它将永远不再回来。

pairs.source: The amount of health you currently have. If your health reaches zero, you will die. Health automatically regenerates when you are out of combat.
pairs.text: 你现在所拥有的生命值。如果你的生命值为0的话，那你就会死亡。当你脱离战斗的时候，生命值会自动恢复。

pairs.source: The amount of mana you currently have. Players require mana in order to cast spells. Mana automatically regenerates if you have not cast a spell in the past five seconds.
pairs.text: 你现在所拥有的法力值。玩家需要法力值来施放法术。如果你不进行施法动作的时间超过5秒，法力值就会开始自动回复。

pairs.source: Warriors (and Druids in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form) require Rage in order to use their abilities.
pairs.text: 战士（以及德鲁伊的熊形态和巨熊形态）使用技能需要怒气。怒气可以通过制造伤害或者承受伤害获得。

pairs.source: Rogues (and Druids in Cat Form) require Energy in order to use their abilities.
pairs.text: 潜行者（以及德鲁伊的猎豹形态）需要能量来使用他们的技能。能量会不断地自动恢复。

pairs.source: The amount of happiness your pet currently has. Content pets inflict normal damage on their enemies, whereas Happy pets inflict enhanced damage, and unhappy pets inflict reduced damage. Happiness goes down when your pet dies or as it grows hungry, while feeding your pet will increase its happiness.
pairs.text: 你现在宠物的喜悦程度。让你的宠物感到满足会让它对敌人造成普通伤害，而高兴状态下的宠物会制造更多的伤害，而不高兴状态下的宠物制造的伤害会减少。当你的宠物死亡或者饥饿状态的时候会降低喜悦程度，而喂食你的宠物能增加它的喜悦程度。

pairs.source: Hunters require focus to use their abilities.  Focus generates while standing still.
A proud member of the Horde, opposed to members of the Alliance (Night Elves, Dwarves, Humans, Gnomes, Draenei, and Worgen).
pairs.text: 一名部落的成员，和联盟的成员相敌对（暗夜精灵，矮人，人类，侏儒，德莱尼和狼人）。

pairs.source: A proud member of the Alliance, opposed to members of the Horde (Orcs, Trolls, Tauren, Undead, Blood Elves, and Goblins).
pairs.text: 一名联盟的成员，和部落的成员相敌对（兽人，巨魔，牛头人，亡灵，血精灵和地精）。

pairs.source: You can now attack and be attacked by any player in the game.
pairs.text: 你可以在游戏中攻击和被任何玩家攻击。

pairs.source: Drop an item into this slot to permit other players to unlock a container, or enchant or poison an item. An item placed in this slot will not be traded; rather, it will simply return to its owner's inventory.
pairs.text: 将物品放入这个空格中可以让其他玩家进行开锁、附魔或淬毒。放在这里的物品不会被交易，在交易结束之后，它会回到原拥有者的物品栏中。

pairs.source: Sound issues (no sound or music, static, looping effects, etc)
pairs.text: 声音问题（没有声音或者音乐，杂音，循环音效等等）

pairs.source: Crashes or error messages of any kind occurring during gameplay
pairs.text: 游戏中出现的崩溃或者错误信息

pairs.source:
Raids are groups of more than 5 people and are typically used to defeat unique challenges at high levels.

|cffffffff- Raid members cannot earn credit toward most non-raid quests. Specifically, they will not receive non-raid quest credit for killing creatures or collecting items.

- Raids grant substantially less experience for defeating monsters than normal groups.

- Raids allow you to overcome challenges that might otherwise be nearly impossible.|r
pairs.text:
团队是超过5个人的队伍，这是为了击败高等级的特定挑战而准备的大型队伍模式。

|cffffffff- 团队成员无法获得非团队任务所需的物品或者杀死怪物的纪录。

- 在团队中，你通过杀死怪物获得的经验值相对普通小队要少。

- 团队让你可以赢得用其它方法根本无法通过的挑战。|r

pairs.source: You have not chosen any talents.
pairs.text: 你还没有选择过任何天赋。

pairs.source: If you find your corpse, you can resurrect for no penalty.  If I resurrect you all of your items will take up to 25%% durability damage (equipped and inventory).
pairs.text: 如果你找到你的尸体，你可以复活而且不会受到任何惩罚。如果让我复活你，那么你所有的物品会损失25%%的耐久度（包括装备着的和包中的物品）。

pairs.source: Remember, if you find your corpse there is no penalty.  Are you sure you want to have all your items take up to 25% durability damage?
pairs.text: 记住，如果你找到自己的尸体的话，将不会受到任何惩罚。你决定现在以损失所有装备25%耐久度的代价来复活吗？

pairs.source: A quest giver with a gray '!' over its head has a quest that you are too low level to accept. Check back once you gain a few levels.
pairs.text: 如果任务给予者头顶上标有灰色感叹号，则表示你的等级还无法接受他所给予的任务。当你升级之后再回来看看吧。

pairs.source: You have obtained a ranged weapon. To use it, first equip the weapon by opening your |cffffd200Character Info|r and your |cffffd200Backpack|r and dragging the item onto your character.|n|nThen, open up your |cffffd200Spellbook|r and drag the |cffffd200Shoot|r or |cffffd200Throw|r ability onto your action bar.|n|nOnly hunters, warriors and rogues may use ranged weapons. Mages, priests and warlocks may use wands.
pairs.text: 你获得了一件远程武器。要使用它，请首先打开|cffffd200角色面板|r和|cffffd200背包|r，将要装备的远程武器拖拽到你的角色身上。|n|n然后打开你的|cffffd200法术书|r，将|cffffd200射击|r或|cffffd200投掷|r技能的图标拖拽到你的快捷栏中。|n|n只有猎人、战士和盗贼可以使用远程武器。法师、牧师和术士可以使用魔杖。

pairs.source: You cannot fire bows and guns without ammunition. To purchase ammunition, visit a gun or bow merchant in a city. To equip ammunition, |cffffd200Right Click|r it.
pairs.text: 你无法在不装备弹药的情况下使用弓和枪。你可以到城镇中的枪械或弓箭商人处购买弹药，然后|cffffd200右键点击|r弹药以装备它。

pairs.source: You have joined a raid group: a group with an increased limit of 40 members, though usually 10 or 25. Raid groups are necessary to enter the most challenging dungeons or to defeat the most powerful enemies, typically at high level.|n|n|cffff2020While in a raid group, you will not earn credit towards most quests. To leave a raid group, Right Click on your character portrait and select Leave party.|r
pairs.text:
你加入了一个团队（可以容纳最多40人的队伍，但通常由10人或25人组成）。挑战最危险的地下城或最强大的敌人，特别是高等级的敌人，都需要由团队来完成。

pairs.source: Rank is the final result of all the honor system calculations.  Based upon a comparison between your standing for the week versus your current rank, your rank may either rise, fall, or stay the same.  Higher level players rise more quickly in rank (and fall more slowly) than lower level players.  In addition, rank increases more quickly at low ranks than at high ranks.
pairs.text: 荣誉系统的计算结果将以军阶的形式表现。根据你的本周排名和当前军阶级别的对比，你的军阶级别可能会提高、降低或保持不变。高级的玩家提升军阶的速度更快（下降也更慢）。另外，低级军阶提升的速度比高级军阶提升的速度更快。

pairs.source: Each time you or a group you are part of does damage to an enemy player in PvP that is subsequently killed you gain an honorable kill.   You only get an honorable kill if the target’s difficulty is green or better (the target would give you experience if it were a monster).    Only enemy players give honorable kills.
pairs.text: 每当你或你所在的队伍在PvP中对一个敌方玩家造成伤害，并且该玩家随后被杀死，则你可以获得一次荣誉击杀。只有在目标等级对你来说是绿色或更高（即杀死与该玩家等级相当的怪物可以获得经验值）的情况下才能获得荣誉击杀。只有敌方玩家会提供荣誉击杀。

pairs.source: Each time you assist in killing a civilian in PvP that is too low of a level to give you experience (a gray level number), you will get a dishonorable kill.   Each dishonorable kill you get immediately reduces your overall ranking slightly, and each additional dishonorable kill you get during a single day has a larger effect than the last one.   Dishonorable kills are directly applied to your ranking.
pairs.text: 每当你在PvP中协助或主动杀死了一个等级过低（对你来说是灰色）的平民，则你获得一个非荣誉击杀。每次非荣誉击杀都会立刻稍稍降低你的总体排名，而非荣誉击杀的次数越多，每次遭受的惩罚也越严重。非荣誉击杀直接影响你的排名。

pairs.source: Honor is what you gain by making honorable kills in PvP combat.   How much honor you gain per kill is determined by how much damage you (or your group) did to the player that was killed, with more damage done equaling more honor.   This honor gain is split amongst the members of your group or raid group.   Also you will gain less honor for killing the same player over and over again in a short period of time, so after a few kills of the same player you will get little or no honor from killing them.
pairs.text: 荣誉点数是通过在PvP战斗中进行荣誉击杀获得的。杀死敌人可以获得多少点数取决于你（或你所在的队伍）对其造成了多少伤害，并由你所在的小队或团队均分。如果你在短时间内反复杀死同一个敌方玩家，则每次杀死他所获得的荣誉点数也会越来越少，因此，在数次杀死同一个敌方玩家之后，你将获得极少的荣誉点数，甚至不再获得任何荣誉点数。

pairs.source: Standing is how you are doing compared to all other players on your side (Horde or Alliance).   If your standing is 150, then there were 149 players who gained more honor than you did during that time period. You must get at least 25 Honorable Kills in a week in order to be eligible to gain Standing and Rank.
pairs.text: 排名是根据你与其他同阵营玩家（联盟或部落）的对比得出的。如果你的排名是150，那就是说有149名玩家在上一阶段中获得的荣誉点数比你多。你每周必须获得至少25个荣誉击杀点数才能参与军阶评定。

pairs.source: Remember, your character has special abilities on the action bar on the lower part of your screen.|n|nUsing those abilities will kill an enemy much faster than just swinging your weapon.
pairs.text: 请记住，你的角色在屏幕下方的动作条中有特殊技能可以使用。|n|n利用这些技能，你能更加轻松迅速地击败敌人。

pairs.source: To free up bag space or make some money you can sell some of the items you have collected.|n|nLocate a vendor and |cffffd200Right Click|r them. Then open your bags and |cffffd200Right Click|r on any items you want to sell.
pairs.text: 如果你想清空一下自己的背包或换点钱花，可以将你所收集到的部分物品售出。|n|n先找到一名商人，|cffffd200右键点击|r他。然后打开背包，|cffffd200右键点击|r你想要出售的任何物品。

pairs.source: Congratulations! You have killed enough targets to complete your quest|n|nReturn to your quest giver to claim your reward.
pairs.text: 恭喜！你已经击败了足够多的敌人，可以完成任务了|n|n去找任务给予者领取你的奖励吧。

pairs.source: In the upper left corner of your screen is your health bar in green. When your health bar reaches zero, you will die, so be careful.|n|nBelow your health bar is a second bar representing the resource your class uses to power your special abilities, such as rage, energy or mana.
pairs.text: 屏幕左上角显示的是你的绿色生命条。当你的生命值减为零时，你将死亡，所以请一定小心。|n|n生命条下面的第二个条表明了你在使用职业特殊技能时所需的相关能量，比如怒气值，能量值或者法力值。

pairs.source: Remember to visit |cffffd200Marshal McBride|r. He has a quest for you! |cffffd200Right Click|r on him when your cursor is a |cffffd200Yellow Question Mark|r.
pairs.text: 记得拜访|cffffd200治安官玛克布莱德|r。他有一个任务交给你！当你的鼠标指针变成|cffffd200黄色问号|r时|cffffd200右键点击|r他。

pairs.source: Your bags are full so you won't be able to pick up any more loot. To free up some bag space, visit vendor characters and sell them some of your junk.|n|nThere are usually vendors in every city, town or outpost.
pairs.text: 你的背包已经满了，所以你无法再拾取任何物品。如果要清空背包，请访问游戏中的商人，向他们出售你不要的物品。|n|n每座主城、城镇和哨站都有商人。

pairs.source: You do not meet the requirements for the chosen dungeons.
pairs.text: 你没有满足进入该地下城的要求。

pairs.source: Role Check failed because a group member did not respond.
pairs.text: 团员没有响应，职责检查失败。

pairs.source: Role Check failed because your group is not viable.
pairs.text: 你的队伍不符合要求，职责检查失败。

pairs.source: You cannot mix dungeons, raids, and random when picking dungeons.
pairs.text: 挑选地下城时你不能将地下城、团队副本和随机副本混合在一起。

pairs.source: The dungeon you chose does not support players from multiple realms.
pairs.text: 你选择的地下城不支持跨服组队。

pairs.source: One or more group members are pending invites or disconnected.
pairs.text: 有一个或更多的队员处于待定状态或已经断线。

pairs.source: Could not retrieve information about some party members.
pairs.text: 无法获取某些队员的信息。

pairs.source: One or more dungeons was not valid.
pairs.text: 一个或更多的地下城暂不可用。

pairs.source: You can not queue for dungeons until your deserter debuff wears off.
pairs.text: 在你的逃亡者负面效果消失之前，你无法进入地下城排队系统。

pairs.source: One or more party members has a deserter debuff.
pairs.text: 有一个或更多的队员带有逃亡者的负面效果。

pairs.source: One or more party members do not meet the requirements for the chosen dungeons.
pairs.text: 有一个或更多的队员不符合进入所选地下城的要求。

pairs.source: A Dungeon group has been found.
pairs.text: 找到了一个要去地下城的队伍。

pairs.source: Waiting for all players to confirm their roles...
pairs.text: 等候所有玩家确认职责中……

pairs.source: You may not queue for this dungeon.
pairs.text: 你不能进入这个地下城的队列。

pairs.source: You may not queue for this.
You do not have the World of Warcraft expansion.
pairs.text: 你没有安装正确的《魔兽世界》资料片。

pairs.source: You must advance to a higher level.
You are already locked to this instance.
You do not meet the requirements for this dungeon.
pairs.text: 你的级别没有达到该地下城的要求。

pairs.source: Unit Nameplates can overlap if units are visually in a line. Turn this off to keep each Unit Nameplate seperate from each other.
pairs.text: 单位姓名板会因为视野而重叠在一起。关掉此选项可以使姓名板相互隔开。

pairs.source: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemy pets, guardians, and totems.
pairs.text: 选中此选项可以显示敌方宠物、护卫和图腾的姓名板。

pairs.source: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemy totems.
pairs.text: 选中此选项可以显示敌人图腾的姓名板

pairs.source: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly pets, guardians, and totems.
pairs.text: 选中此选项可以显示友方宠物、护卫和图腾的姓名板。

pairs.source: Someone has declined the invite. You have been returned to the front of the queue.
pairs.text: 有人拒绝了你的组队邀请。你已被添加到队列的前端。

pairs.source: You are in a dungeon group.
pairs.text: 你在一个地下城小队中。

pairs.source: You can not queue for random dungeons while on random dungeon cooldown.
pairs.text: 当你尚有处于冷却状态的随机地下城进度时，你无法进入随机地下城排队系统。

pairs.source: One or more party members are on random dungeon cooldown.
pairs.text: 队伍中有一个或更多的队员拥有正在冷却中的随机地下城进度。

pairs.source: Lag is often caused by having a large number of players in one location, such as a city or Battleground. It can also be caused by high latency between your computer and the WoW servers. Submitting this report will help us detect and hopefully address lag problems you might be experiencing. \n\nWhat type of lag are you experiencing? Click on a button below to submit a report.
pairs.text: 通常导致延迟的原因是一个地区内的玩家数量过多，如大城市或战场。从你的计算机到游戏服务器的连接延迟过高也会导致这一问题。发送此报告将帮助我们侦测并有可能解决你所遇到的延迟问题。\n\n你现在遇到的是哪种延迟？请点击下方按钮，发送相关报告。

pairs.source: It takes a long time for loot that you click on or that someone assigns to you to show up in your inventory. It may also take a long time to trade items with another player.
pairs.text: 在你点击拾取物品，或者有人给予你物品之后，需要相当长一段时间，物品才会显示在你的物品栏中。和另一名玩家进行交易也需要相当长的一段时间。

pairs.source: There is a long delay when posting, buying, searching or paging through auctions.
pairs.text: 在拍卖行中摆放、购买、搜索或是浏览物品时会有很长的延迟。

pairs.source: It takes a long time to open mail or retrieve items from mail.
pairs.text: 需要相当长一段时间才能打开信件或取得信件中的物品。

pairs.source: It takes a long time for your friends to see messages you send them or for you to see messages they send you.
pairs.text: 要过相当长一段时间，你的朋友才能看到你发给他们的信息，或者让你看到他们发给你的信息。

pairs.source: Creatures and players may pop or teleport from place to place. They may also run in place. You may notice that you try to attack creatures that aren't really where you think they are.
pairs.text: 生物和玩家有可能突然凭空冒出来，或者在跑动中从一个位置在瞬间移动到另一个位置。你会发现，当你攻击一个怪物的时候，它已经不在你想象中的位置上了。

pairs.source: It takes a long time after you try and use a spell or ability before the spell or ability actually occurs. Abilities may behave as if they are on cooldown even though they are not.
pairs.text: 在你使用一个法术或者技能以后，需要相当长一段时间法术或技能才会生效。技能即使不在冷却中的状态，也可能显示为正处于冷却中。

pairs.source: Your lag report has been successfully submitted.
pairs.text: 你的延迟报告已经成功提交。

pairs.source: There are too many Mutated Abominations.
The potions have all been depleted by Professor Putricide.
pairs.text: 药水都被普崔塞德教授用完了。

pairs.text: 你没有选择任何有效的栏位。

pairs.text: 你必须至少选择一个职务。

pairs.source: Type your comment here. This will be seen by other players using Other Raids.
pairs.text: 在此处输入你的注释。其他玩家将在其他团队列表中看到这些注释。

pairs.source: Your class may not perform this role.
pairs.text: 你的职业无法担任该职责。

pairs.source: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly totems.
pairs.text: 选中该选项以显示友方图腾的姓名板。

pairs.text: 在游戏中显示敌方守护者的名字。

pairs.text: 选中该选项以显示敌方守护者的姓名板。

pairs.source: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly guardians.
pairs.text: 选中该选项以显示友方守护者的姓名板。

pairs.source: Show friendly guardian names in the game world.
pairs.text: 在游戏中显示友方守护者的名字。

pairs.source: These options allow you to control how buffs and debuffs are displayed.
pairs.text: 这些选项允许你控制增益效果和负面效果的显示方式。

pairs.source: Filters certain buffs into a buff consolidation box. Short term buffs are displayed in the box. Very long term buffs are displayed in the box until they are about to expire.
pairs.text: 将一部分增益效果划分至一个增益效果盒。短时间增益效果在该盒中显示。持续时间很长的增益效果显示在该盒中，直到效果即将消失。

pairs.source: Show only the debuffs you applied on enemy targets.
pairs.text: 仅显示你对敌方目标施放的负面效果。

pairs.source: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
pairs.text: 将视角固定在你所设置的角度，但你的角色移动时则恢复到跟踪视角。

pairs.source: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
pairs.text: 将视角固定在你所设置的角度，但你的角色移动时则恢复到跟踪视角。

pairs.text: 你当前处于其他团队列表中。

pairs.source: List yourself for Other Raids or assemble a Raid
pairs.text: 使你自己处于其他团队列表中或召集一个团队

pairs.source: You may not list yourself for Other Raids while you are queued for a Dungeon.
pairs.text: 处于地下城队列时无法加入其他团队列表。

pairs.source: You may not queue for a Dungeon while you are listed for Other Raids.
pairs.text: 处于其他团队列表时无法加入地下城队列。

pairs.source: You do not have a valid teleport location.
pairs.text: 你没有有效的传送地点。

pairs.source: A role check has been initiated. Your group will be queued when all members have selected a role.
pairs.text: 已开始职责检查。当所有人都选择了职责后，队伍将进入队列。

pairs.source: You have already defeated enough of them.
pairs.text: 你已击败了足够的人数。

pairs.source: You have too many group members to queue for that.
pairs.text: 你的队伍成员太多，无法进入队列。

pairs.source: Frostmourne has rendered you unable to resurrect.
pairs.text: 霜之哀伤使你无法复活。

pairs.source: Color quest titles by difficulty when displayed with the World Map.
pairs.text: 将任务名称按照任务难度以不同颜色显示在世界地图上。

pairs.source: You need to be closer to interact with that target.
pairs.text: 你必须更加靠近该目标才能与之互动。

pairs.source: Raid difficulty cannot be changed at this time. An event is in progress.
pairs.text: 当前无法改变团队副本难度。正在进行一个事件。

pairs.source: Raid difficulty cannot be changed at this time. An encounter is in progress.
pairs.text: 当前无法改变团队副本难度。正在进行首领战。

pairs.source: Raid difficulty cannot be changed at this time. A player is in combat.
pairs.text: 当前无法改变团队副本难度。一名玩家正在战斗中。

pairs.source: Raid difficulty cannot be changed at this time. A player is busy.
pairs.text: 当前无法改变团队副本难度。一名玩家正忙。

pairs.source: A raid difficulty change is currently in progress.
pairs.text: 团队副本难度修改已经在进行中。

pairs.source: You can find your corpse and resurrect at that location. Players that are level 10 or below can resurrect here with no penalty.
pairs.text: 你可以找到你的尸体并在尸体位置复活。10级或以下的玩家可以在此复活并不受任何惩罚。

pairs.source: You'll take the item, but only if nobody else really wants it.
pairs.text: 如果没人想获得该物品，你可以拿走该物品。

pairs.source: You want to Greed the item, but you want it disenchanted if you win the roll.
pairs.text: 你想选择贪婪取向，但你会在赢得该物品后将其分解。

pairs.source: Starts a vote to remove the selected player from the group.
pairs.text: 发起一个将被选中的玩家从队伍中移出的投票。

pairs.source: You are already queued for something else.
pairs.text: 你已经进入了其它队列。

pairs.source: Indicates that you are an experienced player and are comfortable instructing the group in how to overcome the encounters.
pairs.text: 表示你拥有在副本中战斗的经验，并愿意指导团队攻克难关。

pairs.source: You have been removed from the queue because you did not accept the invitation.
pairs.text: 你已被移出队列，因为你没有接受邀请。

pairs.source: You have been removed from the queue because someone in your party did not accept the invitation.
pairs.text: 你已被移出队列，因为你的小队中的某个成员没有接受邀请。

pairs.source: You cannot queue for a battleground or arena while using the dungeon or raid queueing systems.
pairs.text: 使用地下城或团队排队系统时无法进入战场或竞技场队列。

pairs.source: You cannot queue for a dungeon or raid while using battlegrounds or arenas.
pairs.text: 使用战场或竞技场系统时无法进入地下城或团队队列。

pairs.text: 你没有完成所需的任务。

pairs.source: You do not have the required item.

pairs.text: 你现在处于地下城查找队列中。

pairs.text: 你现在处于其他团队列表中。

pairs.text: 你已不再处于其他团队列表中。

pairs.text: 你当前的等级无法进入任何团队副本。

pairs.text: 队伍中的队长取消了职责检查。

pairs.source: Cannot equip item in this form
pairs.text: 在该形态下无法装备此物品

pairs.source: Your corpse is not in that instance
pairs.text: 你的尸体不在那个副本中

pairs.source: Incorrect party size for this arena.
pairs.text: 队伍人数与该竞技场不符。

pairs.text: 从你的任务查看列表中添加或删除所选任务。|n你也可以按住SHIFT键点击某任务或其图标。

pairs.source: You have already destroyed the KTC Oil Platform.
pairs.text: 你已经摧毁了卡亚罗贸易公司油井平台。

pairs.text: 你已经发射了足够多的笼子。

pairs.source: Your class may not roll need on this item.
pairs.text: 你的职业无法对这件物品掷出需求骰子。

pairs.source: You already have the maximum amount of this item.
pairs.text: 你已达到获取该物品的数量上限。

Requires Single-Stage Booster Rockets. Return to Hobart Grapplehammer to get more.
pairs.text: 需要单级助推火箭。回去找霍巴特·钩锤再要一些。

pairs.source: Players cannot be kicked while in combat, or shortly after combat.
pairs.text: 玩家无法在战斗中和战斗结束后的短时间内被踢出。

pairs.source: Players cannot be kicked after the instance is complete.
pairs.text: 玩家无法在副本完成后被踢出。

pairs.source: Players cannot be kicked during loot rolls.
pairs.text: 玩家无法在战利品分配掷骰时被踢出。

pairs.source: You cannot teleport out of the dungeon while in combat.
pairs.text: 你不能在战斗中传送出地下城。

pairs.source: The item is too low level to accept that gem
pairs.text: 物品等级太低，无法镶嵌这颗宝石

pairs.source: You have already captured enough wild cluckers.
pairs.text: 你已经捉住了足够多的野生肉鸡。

pairs.source: Requires Remote Control Fireworks. Return to Hobart Grapplehammer to get more.
pairs.text: 需要远程遥控焰火。回去找霍巴特·钩锤再要一些。
更宽的任务目标追踪栏

pairs.source: Increases the width of the Objectives tracker.
pairs.text: 增加任务目标追踪栏的宽度。

pairs.source: You have learned a new |cffffd200combat stance|r. Defensive Stance does less damage than Battle Stance, but makes you harder to kill and is especially useful while tanking.
pairs.text: 你学会了一种新的|cffffd200作战姿态|r。防御姿态造成的伤害比战斗姿态要低，但会让你更难以被杀死，这在扮演坦克角色时尤其有用。

pairs.source: Can't attack while actions are prevented.
Check this to be able to list the quests in any order you want.
pairs.text: 勾选此项，可使任务以任何你所选择的顺序排列。

pairs.source: Check this to sort quests by the distance from their map locations to you.
pairs.text: 勾选此项，可使任务按照任务地点与你相隔距离的远近排序。

pairs.source: Check this to sort quests in decreasing order of difficulty.
pairs.text: 勾选此项，可使任务按照从难到易的顺序排序。

pairs.source: Check this to sort quests in increasing order of difficulty.
pairs.text: 勾选此项，可使任务按照从易到难的顺序排序。

pairs.source: Uncheck this to hide tracked achievements.
pairs.text: 取消此项来隐藏所追踪的成就。

pairs.source: Uncheck this to hide completed quests.
pairs.text: 取消此项来隐藏已完成的任务。

pairs.source: Uncheck this to hide quests that are not in your current zone.
pairs.text: 取消此项来隐藏不处于你当前所在地图上的任务。

pairs.source: Can't do that while in a Random Battleground queue.
pairs.text: 你不能在随机战场队列中那么做。

pairs.source: Can't queue for Random Battleground while in another Battleground queue.
pairs.text: 当你处于另一个战场队列中时，你无法加入随机战场队列。

pairs.source: The auction house is closed at the moment.|nPlease try again later.
pairs.text: 拍卖行目前暂时关闭。|n请稍后再试。

pairs.source: You do not have enough items.
You recently queued for a Random Dungeon.\nYou may queue for another in:
pairs.text: 你近期加入过一个随机地下城队列。\n需要过一段时间才可加入另一个，等待时间为：

pairs.source: One of your group members has recently queued for a Random Dungeon and may not yet queue for another.
pairs.text: 你的一名队友近期加入过一个随机地下城队列，暂时无法加入另一个。

pairs.text: 你每天取得的首次胜利将为你赢得：

pairs.text: 每天继首次胜利之后的每次胜利将为你赢得：

pairs.source: Completing Random Battlegrounds will earn you extra rewards.
pairs.text: 完成随机战场可使你获得额外奖励。

pairs.source: Your urgent assistance is needed to combat our foes! Completing this Battleground will earn you extra rewards.
pairs.text: 我们急需你与我们并肩抗敌！完成该战场可使你获得额外奖励。

pairs.source: You already have the max number of recruits.
You already have the max number of volunteers.
You cannot auction items with a limited duration.
pairs.text: 你不能拍卖带有持续时间的物品。

pairs.source: You are now the Dungeon Guide.
Your inventory is full. Your item has been delivered to your mailbox.
pairs.text: 你的背包已满。已将物品发往你的邮箱。

pairs.source: You can't mount while affected by that shapeshift.
pairs.text: 你无法在该变形效果下骑乘。

pairs.source: You recently deserted a group and may not queue again for:
pairs.text: 你刚刚逃离了随机队伍，在接下来的时间内无法再度排队：

pairs.source: One of your group members has recently deserted a group and may not yet queue for another.
pairs.text: 你的一名队伍成员刚刚逃离了随机副本队伍，在接下来的时间内无法再度排队。

pairs.source: Three fawns are already following you!
pairs.text: 已经有三只小鹿在跟随你了！

pairs.source: Visit a trainer to learn first aid.  First aid lets you turn cloth into bandages for healing yourself and others.

pairs.source: If your Hearthstone is not on cooldown, you can use it to teleport you to your home location. Click the Hearthstone button below (or in your backpack) to teleport.

pairs.source: If your Hearthstone is on cooldown and you don't want to wait for it, you have the option for your character to die and be teleported to the nearest graveyard.  You can then either resurrect at the Spirit Healer, suffering durability loss, or attempt to retrieve your corpse.
pairs.text: 如果你的炉石在冷却中而你又不想等待，你可以使用该选项来杀死你的角色，并将你的灵魂传送至最近的墓地。你可以通过灵魂医者，以损失装备耐久度的方式复活或者通过自行寻回尸体的方式复活。

Should you receive a whisper from someone claiming they are a Blizzard employee, make sure to check for the logo. If they don't have it, it's not from us! Right-click their name and select \"|cffffd200Report Spam|r\" to let us know.

pairs.source: Do Not Share Your Login Information

pairs.source: Sharing your Account Information could lead to all of your shiny new epics disappearing! Keep your password secret, otherwise your account could be in real danger and may lead to it being compromised. We recommend that your Blizzard account password is unique.
pairs.text: 分享你的账号信息可能会让你丢掉崭新耀眼的史诗装备！保护你的密码，否则你的账号就真的危险了，甚至可能导致账号被盗。我们建议你为你的暴雪游戏通行证设置一个单独的密码。

pairs.source: Malicious third-party programs called keyloggers are one of the most common ways players have their accounts compromised (\"hacked\").  These may be downloaded unknowingly, so you should always keep your computer clean and protected with anti-virus and anti-spyware software.
pairs.text: 被泛称为键盘记录器的恶意第三方软件是导致玩家账号被盗（\"hacked\"）的最常见原因之一。这些软件可能会在不经意间被下载到电脑里，所以你应当保持一个干净的电脑软件环境并使用杀毒软件和反间谍软件来提供保护。

pairs.source: Visit |cffffd200www.battle.net|r for more information on account security.
pairs.text: 访问|cffffd200http://www.battlenet.com.cn/|r以获取更多账号安全相关的信息。

In the Arena and Rated Battlegrounds, winning matches will earn you Conquest Points.  Winning matches also increases your Arena or Rated Battleground Rating.  The higher your rating the more Conquest Points you may earn each week.\n\n On the Conquest page, you will be able to queue for Rated Arenas or Battlegrounds.

pairs.source: In the Arena, winning matches will earn you Conquest Points.  Winning matches also increases your Arena Rating.  The higher your rating the more Conquest Points you may earn each week.\n\n On the Arena Teams page, you will be able to create teams, manage team members and view your team's statistics.

pairs.source: To recover artifacts, you need to collect artifact fragments. Fragments are found in digsites visible on your map. When you reach a dig site, use the Survey ability. Your survey tool will indicate the approximate direction and distance to the cache of fragments. You can collect fragments six times in a dig site before you need to move to a new digsite. Once you have enough fragments, you can solve an artifact to learn a little more about Azeroth's past. Happy hunting!
pairs.text: 你需要搜集散落在世界各处的神器碎片来将它们复原为完整的神器。你能够在挖掘场里找到这些碎片，挖掘场的位置会标记在你的地图上。在挖掘场使用调查技能，你的调查工具就会显示出神器碎片大致的埋藏方向和位置。在前往一个新的挖掘地址前你可以在一个挖掘场中收集六次碎片。当你拥有了足够的碎片之后，你就可以破译隐藏在神器中的秘密，了解更多关于艾泽拉斯昔日的历史和传说。寻宝愉快！

pairs.source:
An ancient Titan stronghold built to protect the Vault of Archavon.  Horde and Alliance forces battle furiously for control of the place, eager to seize the artifacts and relics held within the vault for their battle against the Lich King.

Gnome and goblin engineers work feverishly in hastily-assembled workshops to crank out the mighty siege engines attackers will need to batter down the fortress' walls and towers.
pairs.text:
这座上古泰坦的堡垒保卫着阿尔卡冯的宝库。为了夺取宝库里的上古神器和圣物来对抗巫妖王，部落和联盟在此展开了激烈的厮杀。

在仓促搭建的工坊车间里，兴奋的侏儒和地精工程师拼装出了强大的攻城坦克。进攻方需要这些巨型攻城器械来对付要塞厚重的城墙和塔楼。

pairs.source:
Once a mighty island citadel of Stromgarde, Tol Barad was razed and later abandoned by rampaging orcs in the Second War. Years later the island was reclaimed by Kul Tiras, and a band of wizards oversaw the construction of a vast magical prison over the fortress' ruins.

As a large-scale battle, the attacking team must simultaneously control the Ironclad Garrison, Warden's Vigil, and Slagworks to claim victory.  The attacking force may use abandoned siege vehicles to destroy the three watch towers, extending the duration of the battle.
pairs.text:
托尔巴拉德曾经是激流堡王国的领土，但在第二次兽人战争中被肆虐的兽人夷平并抛弃了。多年之后，库尔提拉斯夺回了这座岛屿，一群巫师接管了要塞的废墟，将其改造为一座大型魔法监狱。

在这场大规模的战斗中，攻方队伍需要同时占领铁甲兵营、典狱官岗哨和熔渣车间来获得胜利。进攻方还可以使用岛上荒废的攻城载具来摧毁三座塔楼以延长战斗的持续时间。

pairs.source:
The noble races of the Alliance are bound together by proud traditions of nobility, honor, faith, justice, and sacrifice.

The many different Alliance peoples all contribute their technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful and just world.

Take up their banner to represent the high ideals of the Alliance throughout Azeroth and beyond.
pairs.text:
荣誉、信仰、正义、牺牲、传承，这些共同信念促使高贵的联盟种族紧密团结在一起。

无数成员将他们的科学技术、魔法奥秘和精神智慧贡献给了联盟，旨在建立一个和平公正的世界。

扛起这面战旗意味着你将肩负他们的理想，在艾泽拉斯世界中贯彻联盟的信念。

pairs.source:
The proud nations of the Horde are loosely joined in an alliance of convenience against a hostile world that would see them destroyed.

Focused, ferocious, and sometimes monstrous, the Horde values strength and honor, but struggles to keep aggression in check.

Join the Horde and fight to build a world where their people can live free.
pairs.text:
为了对抗这个充满敌意的世界，高傲的部落种族结成了松散的同盟以抗衡那些妄图毁灭他们的敌人。

部落是专注、狂野，甚至是蛮横的同义词，他们崇尚力量与荣耀，行事激进，咄咄逼人。

加入部落，你将与他们一同为自由与生存而战。

pairs.source: Your character can now choose a class specialization. Specializations confer new abilities at level 10, and provide additional abilities at higher level. Most specializations use different attacks or spells than other specializations in the same class.\n\nSome specializations allow you to fulfill different roles, such as tanking or healing. You can change your specialization at any time by visiting a class trainer.

pairs.source:
If you have stumbled onto a bug, we will need as much detail as possible to find and fix it. Using the field below, please describe the issue:

-|cffffd200Be specific|r about every step that leads to the problem.
-Include any relevant |cffffd200character names, NPCs, and locations|r.
-|cffffd200Avoid typos or abbreviations|r, which make bugs much harder to track down.
-Include |cffffd200how long|r you have been seeing the problem, and |cffffd200how often|r (if more than once).
pairs.text:
为了修正您遇到的游戏错误，我们需要请您提供尽可能多的细节来确认并修复这个问题。请使用下方的表格来描述这个问题：

-|cffffd200请详细描述|r你遇到该问题之前的每一个游戏步骤。
-包括所有相关的|cffffd200角色名，NPC名和地点|r。
-|cffffd200请避免使用错别字或错误表述|r，这会让我们难以追踪问题。
-包括您遇到这个问题已经有|cffffd200多长时间|r，以及遇到这个问题的|cffffd200频繁程度|r （如果遇到该问题的次数不止一次）。

pairs.source:
Player feedback helps the World of Warcraft team find opportunities to improve every aspect of the game.

If you choose to submit a suggestion, |cffffd200please be specific|r, and |cffffd200organize your thoughts|r in a |cffffd200constructive fashion|r:

-Which part of the gameplay is your suggestion about?
-What specific problem are you trying to fix?
-How do you think this could be improved in a fun and fair way?
pairs.text:
玩家的反馈意见可以帮助魔兽世界开发团队提高游戏的方方面面。

如果您想要提交建议，请|cffffd200具体|r并|cffffd200有条理|r地提出|cffffd200建设性的意见|r:

-您想对游戏的哪一部分提出建议？
-您想要修改游戏存在的哪方面问题？
-您为何会认为这样的修改能使游戏变得更加有趣、更加公平？

pairs.source: World of Warcraft is intended to be a fun, fair, and safe environment. If you encounter a player who is using an |cffffd200offensive name|r, is |cffffd200spamming|r in chat, |cffffd200cheating|r, or using |cffffd200foul language|r, there's a quick and easy way to report the problem to Blizzard for follow-up.\n\nTo report a player for rule-breaking or offensive behavior, |cffffd200right-click the player's name|r in chat, or |cffffd200right-click the player's portrait|r, and select the option to |cffffd200Report Player|r.
pairs.text: 魔兽世界旨在提供有趣、公平并且安全的游戏环境。如果您遇到玩家使用|cffffd200包含人身攻击性的名字|r，或者在聊天时发送|cffffd200骚扰|r信息，在游戏中|cffffd200作弊|r，或是使用|cffffd200不当语言|r，您都可以快捷方便地向暴雪举报。\n\n要举报玩家破坏游戏规则或者带有人身攻击性的行为，请|cffffd200右键点击玩家的名字|r，并且点选|cffffd200举报玩家|r。

pairs.source: The Alliance consists of five races: the noble humans, the adventurous dwarves, the enigmatic night elves, the ingenious gnomes, and the honorable draenei. Bound by a loathing for all things demonic, they fight to restore order in this war-torn world.

pairs.source: Five races comprise the Horde: the brutal orcs, the shadowy undead, the spiritual tauren, the quick-witted trolls, and the driven blood elves. Beset by enemies on all sides, these outcasts have forged a union they hope will ensure their mutual survival.

pairs.source: You must choose a different race.

Long ago the majestic high elves created the splendid golden city of Quel'Thalas, built around a magical fount of energy known as the Sunwell. When the Lich King destroyed their capital in the Third War, the survivors turned to the Horde for help.\n\nNow known as the blood elves, these refugees are all that remains of their glorious civilization. They strive to rebuild Quel'Thalas while struggling against a crippling addiction to the very magical energies that once built their empire.
pairs.text: 很久以前，高贵的高等精灵围绕着名为太阳之井的魔法喷泉建立起了黄金之城奎尔萨拉斯。但在第三次大战中，巫妖王摧毁了他们的都城，幸存者们只得向部落求助。\n\n这些如今自称为血精灵的流亡者已经是这个灿烂文明的最后遗孑。他们一直致力于重建奎尔萨拉斯，并努力与曾经建立起他们帝国的那股魔法能量的诱惑做斗争。

pairs.source: Driven from their home world of Argus, the honorable draenei fled the Burning Legion for eons before finding a remote planet to settle on. They shared this world with the shamanistic orcs and named it Draenor. In time the Legion corrupted the orcs, who waged war and nearly exterminated the peaceful draenei. A lucky few fled to Azeroth, where they now seek allies in their battle against the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 高贵的德莱尼人从他们生活着的阿古斯世界逃出来之后，被燃烧军团追杀了数不清的岁月，最终在一个遥远的星球定居。他们与这个世界的原住民——信奉萨满教义的兽人和平相处，并给这里起名为德拉诺。在兽人被燃烧军团腐蚀而变得嗜血好战之后，德莱尼人几乎遭到了灭顶之灾。一部分幸存者逃到了艾泽拉斯，并在这里找到了共同对抗燃烧军团的盟友。

pairs.source: In ages past, the dwarves cared only for riches taken from the earth's depths. Then records surfaced of a god-like race said to have given the dwarves life... and an enchanted birthright. Driven to learn more, the dwarves devoted themselves to the pursuit of lost artifacts and ancient knowledge. Today dwarven archaeologists are scattered throughout the globe.
pairs.text: 很久以来，矮人只关心深埋在地底的财富。后来在一些被发掘出来的文献上记录着：某个神一般的种族创造了矮人，并赋予他们特殊的能力。为了对自己种族的起源有更多的了解，矮人们开始全力挖掘失落的神器，搜集远古的知识。今天，矮人的考古学家已经遍布了世界各地。

pairs.source: Though small in stature, the clever gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect to secure a place in history. Their subterranean kingdom of Gnomeregan is a marvel of steam-driven technology, and their skill at both engineering and the arcane arts has been a tremendous benefit to the Alliance across numerous campaigns.
pairs.text: 虽然生活在卡兹莫丹的侏儒身材都很矮小，但他们还是凭借超群的智慧在历史上占据了一席之地。他们的地下王国诺莫瑞根是蒸汽动力科技的奇迹，在工程学和奥术上的造诣也在历次战役中让联盟获益良多。

pairs.source: Originally the slaves of jungle trolls on the Isle of Kezan, the goblin race was forced to mine Kaja'mite ore out of the Undermine, deep in the bowels of Mount Kajaro.  Unbeknownst to anyone at the time, the mineral had magical properties that caused the goblins to rapidly increase in both cunning and intelligence.  Tinkering their own powerful artifacts of engineering and alchemy in secret, the goblins overthrew their troll oppressors, taking over the island that they now call home.  Quickly rising to prominence as masters of mercantilism, goblins and their global trade conglomerates dominate all commerce across Azeroth.
pairs.text: 科赞岛上的地精曾经是丛林巨魔的奴隶，被强迫开采深埋于卡亚罗山脉地底的卡亚矿石。然而不为人知的是，这些矿物具有某种神秘的魔法效力，受其影响的地精很快就变得既聪明又狡猾。醉心于工程学和炼金术，地精秘密地发明出了各式威力强大的神奇道具，并借此推翻了巨魔主人的统治，在科赞岛上建立了自己的家园。在那之后，地精大师级的商事手腕迅速崭露头角，他们的环球贸易寡头公司支配着整个艾泽拉斯世界的商业。

pairs.source: Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat, craftsmanship, and magic with stunning efficiency. The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
pairs.text: 人类是个年轻而多才多艺的种族，可以以惊人的效率学习战斗技巧、制造技术和操控魔法的技艺。靠着勇猛和乐观的天性，人类建造了许多世界上最伟大的王国。在这个动乱的时代，经历了世代纷争的人类正在努力恢复昔日的辉煌，创造光明的未来。

The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
pairs.text: 人类是个年轻而多才多艺的种族，可以以惊人的效率学习战斗技巧、制造技术和操控魔法的技艺。靠着勇猛和乐观的天性，人类建造了许多世界上最伟大的王国。在这个动乱的时代，经历了世代纷争的人类正在努力恢复昔日的辉煌，创造光明的未来。

pairs.source: Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire, but their reckless use of primal magic brought them to ruin. In grief, they withdrew to the forests and remained isolated there until the return of their ancient enemy, the Burning Legion. With no other choice, the night elves emerged at last from their seclusion to fight for their place in the new world.
pairs.text: 一万年前，暗夜精灵就已经建立了一个庞大的帝国，但是他们无节制地滥用魔法，最终导致了帝国的毁灭。幸存的暗夜精灵怀着悲伤重新回到了森林中，过起了与世隔绝的隐居生活，直到他们过去的敌人燃烧军团重新来到这个世界。现在，别无选择的暗夜精灵重新开始和外界接触，为了自己的种族能在这个新的世界中生存下去而战斗着。

pairs.source: The orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs, they were enslaved by the Burning Legion and forced into war with the humans of Azeroth. Although it took many years, the orcs finally escaped the demons' corruption and won their freedom. To this day they fight for honor in an alien world that hates and reviles them.
pairs.text: 兽人原本居住在德拉诺世界，过着信仰萨满教的和平生活。后来兽人被燃烧军团奴役，与艾泽拉斯的人类进行了惨烈的战争。多年之后，兽人最终摆脱了恶魔的控制并重新获得了自由。今天，他们为了荣誉和尊严，与一切憎恨和羞辱他们的敌人作战。

pairs.source: Shrouded in fog for ages, the ancient realm of Pandaria has remained unspoiled by war. Now that it has been rediscovered, Pandaren heroes are stepping forward to declare their allegiance to either the Alliance or the Horde. The most adventurous of the Pandaren come from the Wandering Island, a mysterious land cut off from the rest of Azeroth and Pandaria itself.
pairs.text: 千百年来，不散的迷雾一直笼罩着潘达利亚，让这个古老的国度远离战火的纷扰。如今迷雾已经散去，熊猫人英雄纷纷踏上了冒险的旅程，他们将选择与联盟或是部落并肩作战。最具冒险精神的熊猫人来自迷踪岛——这是一座与世隔绝，行踪不明的神秘岛屿，既不在潘达利亚，也不属于艾泽拉斯的任何已知版图。

pairs.source: Once mindless slaves to the terrible Lich King, the gruesome Forsaken have overthrown his rule and now pledge loyalty to the wicked banshee queen Sylvanas. Under her reign Forsaken armies have reclaimed the ruined kingdom of Lordaeron. Every day is a struggle against vengeful humans who wish to wipe them out, and a constant battle of wills against Horde allies who distrust the sinister motives of the undead.
pairs.text: 作为昔日的无脑奴隶，阴郁的被遗忘者推翻了可怕的巫妖王，转而向邪恶的女妖之王希尔瓦娜斯宣示效忠。在她的领导下，被遗忘者大军夺回了洛丹伦王国的废墟。然而面对一心复仇的人类，以及那些不信任亡灵邪恶动机的部落盟友，每一天对他们来说都是持续不断的抗争与战斗。

pairs.source: Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the Earth Mother. Many of the nomadic wandering tribes of tauren have gathered together under a single banner to settle in the fertile plains of Mulgore. Were it not for the timely intervention of the orcs, the whole race may have been wiped out by marauding centaur. The tauren honor their blood-debt to this day, fighting alongside the Horde to protect their land.
pairs.text: 牛头人一直以来都在努力保护自然的平衡，并时刻遵循着他们所信仰的女神：大地母亲的意愿。众多游牧部族聚集在同一面大旗下，定居于莫高雷的肥沃平原上。要不是兽人及时伸出了援手，这个种族可能已经被劫掠成性的半人马灭绝了。牛头人至今依然牢记这笔血债，为保护自己的土地而与部落并肩作战。

pairs.source: Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe were besieged on all sides by warring factions. The orcish Horde came to their aid, convincing the Darkspear to sail across the Great Sea and settle in the untamed lands of Kalimdor. Though they cling to their shadowy heritage, the Darkspear remain vocal advocates of a united Horde, lending the strength of their arms and powerful tribal magics to the common cause.
pairs.text: 暗矛部落的巨魔原本居住在荆棘谷的丛林中，但是由于各阵营之间的连年征战而被迫流离失所。兽人的部落向他们伸出了援手，并说服暗矛部落渡过无尽之海，在卡利姆多的蛮荒之地定居下来。虽然他们继承了巨魔种族的黑暗本性，但是暗矛巨魔主张保持部落的团结，并愿意以强大的武力和原始部族魔法为部落共同的事业而效力。

pairs.source: The worgen were first unleashed upon the Eastern Kingdoms by Archmage Arugal during the Third War. Primarily used as a weapon against the Scourge, the beasts soon proved to be a burden greater than the humans of Lordaeron could bear. A mysterious curse began to spread among those who fought alongside the wolf-men, causing them to become worgen themselves.  The curse rapidly spread as it reached Gilneas, trapping its inhabitants behind the very walls built to protect them.  The survivors of the curse now seek to find a new fate for their people -- their destiny unwritten...
pairs.text: 在第三次战争期间，东部王国的大法师阿鲁高将狼人释放到了这个世界上。狼人最初被当作对抗亡灵天灾的武器，然而不久之后，这些野兽就变成了洛丹伦的人民难以承受的灾厄。某种神秘的诅咒开始传播，将那些与狼人一同作战的人类也变成了这种獠牙利爪的怪物。诅咒很快就蔓延到了吉尔尼斯王国，王国的居民被困在了那堵原本建来保护他们的高墙之后。现在，诅咒的幸存者正为他们的人民寻求新的命运，历史的宿命又翻开了一页……

pairs.source: The nightborne of Suramar spent millennia isolated behind an arcane barrier, slowly transformed by the magic of the Nightwell. These proud, noble elves now seek to reclaim their place in Azeroth.
pairs.text: 数千年间，苏拉玛的夜之子一直在奥术屏障下与世隔绝地生活。同时，在暗夜井的魔力影响下，他们的外形也逐渐改变了。这些骄傲而高贵的精灵如今想要找回他们在艾泽拉斯的位置。

pairs.source: The tauren of Highmountain are devoted to the spirits of earth, river, and sky. After ages spent protecting their sacred mountain, they are now ready to venture out into the world beyond the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 至高岭的牛头人崇敬大地、河流与天空之灵。在过去的诸多时代中，他们一直都守护着自己的圣山，而如今，他们已经做好了准备，想要前往破碎群岛之外的世界冒险。

pairs.source: Seeking to harness the corruptive magic of the Void, these outcast elves endured an unexpected transformation. They are determined to master their newfound powers and resist the whispers eager to lure them into madness.
pairs.text: 这些被驱逐的精灵试图掌握虚空的堕落魔力，但却意外地令自己的外形发生了改变。他们决心掌握这种新的力量，并抵抗企图引诱他们堕入疯狂的低语。

pairs.source: Fighting a long, bitter war against the Burning Legion, these draenei soldiers were infused with the Holy Light to become living weapons. Victorious at last, these Lightforged stand ready to defend Azeroth.
pairs.text: 这些德莱尼与燃烧军团进行了一场漫长而艰苦的战争。他们被灌注了圣光之力，成为了强力的武器。获得最终的胜利后，这些光铸者担负起了保卫艾泽拉斯的责任。

pairs.source: Blessed Garb of the Undead Slayer
Healing in excess of a target's maximum health is instead converted to a heal absorption effect.
pairs.text: 对目标的过量治疗会被转化为治疗吸收效果。

pairs.source: Enemies pay far less attention to threat generated by tanks.
pairs.text: 敌人对坦克所产生威胁值的关注程度大幅下降。

pairs.source: While in combat, enemies periodically cause gouts of flame to erupt beneath the feet of distant players.
pairs.text: 在战斗中，敌人会周期性地令远处的玩家脚下喷发出岩浆柱。

pairs.source: All enemies' melee attacks apply a stacking blight that inflicts damage over time and reduces healing received.
pairs.text: 所有敌人的近战攻击都将造成可叠加的枯萎效果，造成持续伤害并降低所受到的治疗效果。

pairs.source: Additional non-boss enemies are present throughout the dungeon.
pairs.text: 整个地下城都将增加额外的非首领敌人。

pairs.source: Non-boss enemies enrage at 30% health remaining, dealing 100% increased damage until defeated.
pairs.text: 非首领敌人在生命值降至30%时将被激怒，伤害提高100%，直至被击败为止。

pairs.source: When any non-boss enemy dies, its death cry empowers nearby allies, increasing their maximum health and damage by 20%.
pairs.text: 任何非首领敌人死亡时，其临死的哀嚎将强化附近的盟友，使其最大生命值及伤害提高20%。

pairs.source: When slain, non-boss enemies leave behind a lingering pool of ichor that heals their allies and damages players.
pairs.text: 非首领敌人被击杀后会留下一个缓慢消失的脓液之池，可以治疗其盟友，并且伤害玩家。

pairs.source: Boss enemies have 40% more health and inflict up to 15% increased damage.
pairs.text: 首领敌人的生命值提高40%，造成的伤害最多提高15%。

pairs.source: Non-boss enemies have 20% more health and inflict up to 30% increased damage.
pairs.text: 非首领敌人的生命值提高20%，造成的伤害最高提高30%。

pairs.source: When slain, non-boss enemies explode, causing all players to suffer 10% of their max health in damage over 4 sec. This effect stacks.
pairs.text: 非首领敌人被击杀时会爆炸，令所有玩家在4秒内受到其最大生命值10%的伤害。此效果可叠加。

pairs.source: When injured below 90% health, players will suffer increasing damage over time until healed above 90% health.
pairs.text: 受到伤害导致生命值低于90%时，玩家会受到越来越高的周期性伤害，直到其生命值被治愈到90%以上为止。

pairs.source: While in combat, enemies periodically summon Explosive Orbs that will detonate if not destroyed.
pairs.text: 在战斗中，敌人会周期性地召唤爆裂宝珠。如果不将其摧毁，宝珠将会爆炸。

pairs.source: Periodically, all players emit a shockwave, inflicting damage and interrupting nearby allies.
pairs.text: 所有玩家都会周期性地发出冲击波，对附近的盟友造成伤害并打断其施法。

pairs.source: Non-boss enemies are granted temporary immunity to Loss of Control effects.
pairs.text: 非首领类的敌人将暂时免疫失控效果。

pairs.text: 从盎迦猴岛的邪恶猢狲海盗手中抢救丛林酒。

pairs.source: Investigate an ancient mogu crypt that has become infested by the Sha.
pairs.text: 调查被煞魔盘踞的古代魔古陵寝。

pairs.source: Craft brew with lightning and save the monastery from a rampaging saurok.
pairs.text: 巧妙利用闪电酿造美酒，从暴动的蜥蜴人手中解救禅院。

pairs.source: The Sha of Fear has fled to this tranquil haven to recover, corrupting the pure waters with its tainted blood.
pairs.text: 逃入这个宁静港湾的惧之煞已经占据了这一区域，并用自己的污秽之血腐化了这里的纯净之水。

pairs.source: Long dormant, this ancient archive of the mogu has awakened, as have its protectors. Danger and mystery await within....
pairs.text: 这座沉寂已久的远古魔古宝库及其守护者已经苏醒。危险与谜团等待着人们的探索……

pairs.source: Buried deep in the mountainside, the heart of the ancient mogu repository holds a secret that may threaten all of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 深藏于群山之下的古代魔古宝库中心收藏着一个足以威胁全艾泽拉斯的秘密。

pairs.source: Spurred on by the Klaxxi, the time has come to assault the heart of the mantid empire.
pairs.text: 在卡拉克西的鼓动下，向螳螂妖帝国中枢发动总攻的时刻到了。

pairs.source: The mantid Empress, consumed by paranoia and twisted by the Sha of Fear, rules from her seat deep within the Heart of Fear.
pairs.text: 被恐惧扭曲的螳螂妖女皇已经完全被自己的妄想所控制。此刻，她正躲在恐惧之心深处的王座上发号施令。

pairs.source: Break the defenses of Zan'vess and recover the invaluable Mantid weapons.
pairs.text: 攻破扎尼维斯的防线，夺回珍贵的螳螂妖武器。

pairs.source: Lend aid to the citizens who yet remain in the destroyed remains of Theramore.
pairs.text: 为那些依然滞留在塞拉摩废墟中的市民提供帮助。

pairs.text: 为那些依然滞留在塞拉摩废墟中的市民提供帮助。

pairs.source: Escort Vol'jin to discover the secrets that lie within a Saurok-infested cave.
pairs.text: 护送沃金勇闯满是蜥蜴人的洞穴，发掘洞中的秘密。

pairs.source: Help the Alliance fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助联盟在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Defend Lion's Landing from a reinforced Horde assault!
pairs.text: 部落援兵来袭，保卫雄师港！

pairs.source: Break the defenses of Zan'vess and recover the invaluable Mantid weapons.
pairs.text: 攻破扎尼维斯的防线，夺回珍贵的螳螂妖武器。

pairs.source: Follow the trail of the Council of the Black Harvest into the heart of the Black Temple.
pairs.text: 追寻黑暗收割议会留下的蛛丝马迹，深入黑暗神殿。

pairs.source: Defend Domination Point from a reinforced Lion's Landing assault!
pairs.text: 雄师港派出了联盟援军袭击统御岗哨，死守阵地！

pairs.source: Assault the troll town of Zeb'tula to gain a foothold on the Isle of the Thunder King.
pairs.text: 突袭巨魔的领地赞布图拉，以图在雷神岛上获取落脚点。

pairs.source: It is time to take down Shan Bu and cripple the Thunder King's forces.
pairs.text: 打倒山怖，削弱雷电之王大军的时候到了。

pairs.source: The forces of the Zandalari have rallied in the ruins surrounding the Thunder King's island citadel.
pairs.text: 赞达拉的大军已经在雷电之王的海岛要塞外围的废墟中集结。

pairs.source: Beneath the foundations of the Throne of Thunder lie vast caverns, teeming with ancient horrors.
pairs.text: 雷电王座的地基之下存在着巨型溶洞，里面充满了远古的恐怖怪物。

pairs.source: In the horrific chambers beneath Lei Shen's citadel, the mogu conducted terrible experiments into reshaping life.
pairs.text: 在雷神要塞下的恐怖殿堂内，魔古族在进行着改造生命的可怕实验。

pairs.source: From within his inner sanctum, the risen Thunder King plots the return of the great mogu empire.
pairs.text: 崛起的雷电之王正在他的内殿中策划着光复魔古帝国的阴谋。

pairs.source: Work with Wrathion to discover the secrets of the Lightning Forge.
pairs.text: 与拉希奥合作，发现雷霆熔炉的秘密。

pairs.source: Escort Vol'jin to discover the secrets that lie within a Saurok-infested cave.
pairs.text: 护送沃金勇闯满是蜥蜴人的洞穴，发掘洞中的秘密。

pairs.source: Assault the troll town of Shaol'mara to gain a foothold on the Isle of the Thunder King.
pairs.text: 突袭巨魔城镇绍尔马拉，以图在雷神岛上获取落脚点。

pairs.source: Loot as much as you can before the Thunder King's forces arrive.
pairs.text: 在雷电之王的大军抵达前，尽量多抢夺一些战利品。

pairs.source: It is time to take down Shan Bu and cripple the Thunder King's forces.
pairs.text: 打倒山怖，削弱雷电之王大军的时候到了。

pairs.source: Grizzle Gearslip and his goblins have uncovered something terrifying in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
pairs.text: 格里兹尔·轮滑和他的地精们在锦绣谷发现了一些可怕的东西。

pairs.source: Craft brew with lightning and save the monastery from a rampaging saurok.
pairs.text: 巧妙利用闪电酿造美酒，从暴动的蜥蜴人手中解救禅院。

pairs.source: Test your mettle against a variety of challenges.
pairs.text: 测试你面对各种挑战时的勇气。

pairs.source: Random Mists of Pandaria Heroic Scenario
pairs.text: 随机熊猫人之谜场景战役（英雄）

pairs.source: Grizzle Gearslip and his goblins have uncovered something terrifying in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
pairs.text: 格里兹尔·轮滑和他的地精们在锦绣谷发现了一些可怕的东西。

pairs.source: Investigate an ancient mogu crypt that has become infested by the Sha.
pairs.text: 调查被煞魔盘踞的古代魔古陵寝。

pairs.source: Help the Horde fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助部落在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Help the Horde fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助部落在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Help the Alliance fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助联盟在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Defeat the greatest tamers of Pandaria.
pairs.text: 击败潘达利亚最伟大的驯宠师。

pairs.source: Venture through the scarred Vale of Eternal Blossoms, exploring unearthed mogu ruins to discover the source of the destruction.
pairs.text: 冒险穿越满目疮痍的锦绣谷，探索被发掘出的魔古废墟，发现毁灭的源头。

pairs.source: War has come to the gates of Orgrimmar, as Alliance forces and the Darkspear Rebellion seek revenge against Garrosh Hellscream.
pairs.text: 战火已经烧到了奥格瑞玛的大门前，联盟部队和暗矛起义军誓要向加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮讨还公道。

pairs.source: Within a secret Kor'kron base carved into the sweltering caverns beneath Orgrimmar, Garrosh is assembling his ultimate army.
pairs.text: 在奥格瑞玛地下闷热的洞穴中藏着库卡隆的秘密基地。加尔鲁什正在这里集结他最后的大军。

pairs.source: Wielding the dark power that lay dormant beneath Pandaria, Garrosh seeks to bring a new order to Azeroth. He must be stopped!
pairs.text: 在掌握了潜藏于潘达利亚地下的黑暗力量后，加尔鲁什试图在艾泽拉斯构建全新的秩序。一定要阻止他！
随机时空漫游地下城（燃烧的远征）

pairs.source: Work with Sungshin Ironpaw to discover the secret ingredient of the Lin family's Secret Ingredient Soup.
pairs.text: 与孙行·铁掌合作，发现林家秘制面汤的秘制原料。

pairs.source: Work with Sungshin Ironpaw to discover the secret ingredient of the Lin family's Secret Ingredient Soup.
pairs.text: 与孙行·铁掌合作，发现林家秘制面汤的秘制原料。
《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城

pairs.source: Rescue Jungle Brew from the evil clutches of the hozen pirates of Unga Ingoo.
pairs.text: 从盎迦猴岛的邪恶猢狲海盗手中抢救丛林酒。

pairs.source: Investigate an ancient mogu crypt that has become infested by the Sha.
pairs.text: 调查被煞魔盘踞的古代魔古陵寝。

pairs.text: 巧妙利用闪电酿造美酒，从暴动的蜥蜴人手中解救禅院。

pairs.source: Break the defenses of Zan'vess and recover the invaluable Mantid weapons.
pairs.text: 攻破扎尼维斯的防线，夺回珍贵的螳螂妖武器。

pairs.source: Lend aid to the citizens who yet remain in the destroyed remains of Theramore.
pairs.text: 为那些依然滞留在塞拉摩废墟中的市民提供帮助。

pairs.source: Escort Vol'jin to discover the secrets that lie within a Saurok-infested cave.
pairs.text: 护送沃金勇闯满是蜥蜴人的洞穴，发掘洞中的秘密。

pairs.source: Help the Alliance fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助联盟在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Defend Lion's Landing from a reinforced Horde assault!
pairs.text: 部落援兵来袭，保卫雄师港！

pairs.source: Break the defenses of Zan'vess and recover the invaluable Mantid weapons.
pairs.text: 攻破扎尼维斯的防线，夺回珍贵的螳螂妖武器。

pairs.source: Defend Domination Point from a reinforced Lion's Landing assault!
pairs.text: 雄师港派出了联盟援军袭击统御岗哨，死守阵地！

pairs.source: Escort Vol'jin to discover the secrets that lie within a Saurok-infested cave.
pairs.text: 护送沃金勇闯满是蜥蜴人的洞穴，发掘洞中的秘密。

pairs.text: 格里兹尔·轮滑和他的地精们在锦绣谷发现了一些可怕的东西。
