pairs.text: 巧妙利用闪电酿造美酒，从暴动的蜥蜴人手中解救禅院。

pairs.source: Grizzle Gearslip and his goblins have uncovered something terrifying in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
pairs.text: 格里兹尔·轮滑和他的地精们在锦绣谷发现了一些可怕的东西。

pairs.source: Investigate an ancient mogu crypt that has become infested by the Sha.
pairs.text: 调查被煞魔盘踞的古代魔古陵寝。

pairs.source: Help the Horde fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助部落在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Help the Horde fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助部落在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Help the Alliance fend off enemy forces in the midst of a battle for naval supremacy on the High Seas.
pairs.text: 帮助联盟在一场争夺制海权的公海激战中击退敌方舰队。

pairs.source: Atop the Blackrock Foundry, Warlord Blackhand oversees his clan's ancestral home amidst searing heat that only he can bear.
pairs.text: 在黑石铸造厂的顶层，督军黑手正在只有他能忍受的超高温中俯视着先祖的家园。

pairs.source: The Ironmarch vanguard has set up a base of operations in Blackrock Spire, and must be stopped!
pairs.text: 铁军先锋已经在黑石塔安营扎站，必须阻止他们！

pairs.source: Long dormant, this ancient archive of the mogu has awakened, as have its protectors. Danger and mystery await within....
pairs.text: 这座沉寂已久的远古魔古宝库及其守护者已经苏醒。危险与谜团等待着人们的探索……

pairs.source: Buried deep in the mountainside, the heart of the ancient mogu repository holds a secret that may threaten all of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 深藏于群山之下的古代魔古宝库中心收藏着一个足以威胁全艾泽拉斯的秘密。

pairs.source: Spurred on by the Klaxxi, the time has come to assault the heart of the mantid empire.
pairs.text: 在卡拉克西的鼓动下，向螳螂妖帝国中枢发动总攻的时刻到了。

pairs.source: The mantid Empress, consumed by paranoia and twisted by the Sha of Fear, rules from her seat deep within the Heart of Fear.
pairs.text: 被恐惧扭曲的螳螂妖女皇已经完全被自己的妄想所控制。此刻，她正躲在恐惧之心深处的王座上发号施令。

pairs.source: The Sha of Fear has fled to this tranquil haven to recover, corrupting the pure waters with its tainted blood.
pairs.text: 逃入这个宁静港湾的惧之煞已经占据了这一区域，并用自己的污秽之血腐化了这里的纯净之水。

pairs.source: The forces of the Zandalari have rallied in the ruins surrounding the Thunder King's island citadel.
pairs.text: 赞达拉的大军已经在雷电之王的海岛要塞外围的废墟中集结。

pairs.source: Beneath the foundations of the Throne of Thunder lie vast caverns, teeming with ancient horrors.
pairs.text: 雷电王座的地基之下存在着巨型溶洞，里面充满了远古的恐怖怪物。

pairs.source: In the horrific chambers beneath Lei Shen's citadel, the mogu conducted terrible experiments into reshaping life.
pairs.text: 在雷神要塞下的恐怖殿堂内，魔古族在进行着改造生命的可怕实验。

pairs.source: From within his inner sanctum, the risen Thunder King plots the return of the great mogu empire.
pairs.text: 崛起的雷电之王正在他的内殿中策划着光复魔古帝国的阴谋。

pairs.source: Venture through the scarred Vale of Eternal Blossoms, exploring unearthed mogu ruins to discover the source of the destruction.
pairs.text: 冒险穿越满目疮痍的锦绣谷，探索被发掘出的魔古废墟，发现毁灭的源头。

pairs.source: War has come to the gates of Orgrimmar, as Alliance forces and the Darkspear Rebellion seek revenge against Garrosh Hellscream.
pairs.text: 战火已经烧到了奥格瑞玛的大门前，联盟部队和暗矛起义军誓要向加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮讨还公道。

pairs.source: Within a secret Kor'kron base carved into the sweltering caverns beneath Orgrimmar, Garrosh is assembling his ultimate army.
pairs.text: 在奥格瑞玛地下闷热的洞穴中藏着库卡隆的秘密基地。加尔鲁什正在这里集结他最后的大军。

pairs.source: Wielding the dark power that lay dormant beneath Pandaria, Garrosh seeks to bring a new order to Azeroth. He must be stopped!
pairs.text: 在掌握了潜藏于潘达利亚地下的黑暗力量后，加尔鲁什试图在艾泽拉斯构建全新的秩序。一定要阻止他！

pairs.source: Deathwing seeks to destroy Wyrmrest Temple and end the lives of the Dragon Aspects and Thrall.
pairs.text: 死亡之翼妄图摧毁龙眠神殿，一劳永逸地消灭萨尔和守护巨龙。

pairs.source: Deathwing must be destroyed, or all is lost.
pairs.text: 必须消灭死亡之翼，否则万物都将遭到毁灭。

pairs.source: Deep within the Blackrock Foundry, brutal and giant creatures temper and forge the machinery of war for the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 在黑石铸造厂的深处，野蛮而巨大的生物在日夜锻打着钢铁部落的战争机器。

pairs.source: Only the unnatural heat of the Foundry furnace can smelt the Blackrock ore, essential to the might of the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 只有铸造厂熔炉中反常的高温才能融化黑石矿石，而这种矿石正是钢铁部落的武力核心。

pairs.source: The extent of the Iron Horde's arms and armaments is a terrible sight to behold.
pairs.text: 延绵不绝的钢铁部落武器和军火构成了一副可怕的图景。

pairs.source: As ogres and Iron Horde leaders gather for a spectacle in the great arena of Highmaul, a destructive plot roils in the shadows.
pairs.text: 当食人魔和钢铁部落的首领们集聚一堂，在悬槌堡的大竞技场中观看难得一见的奇景时，一场毁灭性的阴谋正在暗中酝酿。

pairs.source: Only a select few have seen the inside of the Gorthenon atop Highmaul; rumors abound of strange relics and sorcery within.
pairs.text: 只有少数被选中的幸运儿曾见识过悬槌堡顶层的迦台农神殿；传说里面藏着诡异的圣物和巫术。

pairs.source: Atop Highmaul, Imperator Mar'gok works to unlock ancient secrets so that ogres may reclaim their birthright as lords of Draenor.
pairs.text: 在悬槌堡顶层，元首马尔高克正致力于发掘上古的秘密，从而使食人魔夺回德拉诺之王的荣光。

pairs.source: You have embarked on a mission to rescue Highlord Tirion Fordring in the Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 你接受了前往破碎海滩营救大领主提里奥·弗丁的任务。

pairs.source: Before the gates of Hellfire Citadel, fel-infused siege engines and monstrous beasts stand ready for an assault on Azeroth.
pairs.text: 由邪能驱动的攻城机器和恐怖的野兽正在地狱火堡垒的大门前整装待发，准备踏上入侵艾泽拉斯的征程。

pairs.source: Kilrogg was first to accept Gul'dan's twisted offer, but many orcs followed. Bloodthirsty and savage, they await in these halls.
pairs.text: 基尔罗格率先接受了古尔丹扭曲的礼物，但这也带动了许多兽人的效仿。如今，这些嗜血而野蛮的家伙就在这些大厅中严阵以待。

pairs.source: With Gul'dan's ascent to power, the Sargerei and other members of the Shadow Council now work openly in service of the Legion.
pairs.text: 在古尔丹执掌大权后，萨格雷以及暗影议会的其他成员就公开效忠燃烧军团了。

pairs.source: Atop the spires of the Citadel, demonic champions ready themselves, as Gul'dan begins a dark ritual....
pairs.text: 在地狱火堡垒的峰顶，古尔丹正准备开始黑暗仪式，而那些恶魔勇士们则严阵以待……

pairs.source: On the grounds of the ruined Dark Portal, Archimonde himself comes forth to ensure that the Legion's plans do not fail.
pairs.text: 在黑暗之门的瓦砾之上，阿克蒙德亲自坐镇，以确保燃烧军团的计划得以顺利实现。

pairs.source: Random Timewalking Dungeon (Wrath of the Lich King)
pairs.text: 随机时空漫游地下城（巫妖王之怒）

pairs.source: You are leading an elite force of demon hunters on a hunt to obtain the Warglaives of Kil'Jaeden.
pairs.text: 你领导着一支恶魔猎手精英小队，试图获得基尔加丹的战刃。

pairs.source: You have been summoned to Icecrown to build a weapon of great power.
pairs.text: 你受到召唤前往冰冠堡垒，铸造一把强大的武器。

pairs.source: The Blades of the Fallen Prince
You have arrived at the tomb island of Magnar Icebreaker to discover his legacy.
pairs.text: 你已经抵达马格纳·破冰者的陵墓所在的岛屿，准备发掘他的遗物。

pairs.source: You've arrived in the portal world holding Sargeras' Hound, Malchezath, to slay him and obtain his fangs.
pairs.text: 你抵达了萨格拉斯之犬玛尔奇扎斯所在的门户世界，准备杀了他，夺取他的獠牙。
随机军团再临英雄地下城

pairs.source: You have traveled to Niskara in search of a demonic weapon of great power.
pairs.text: 你前往尼斯卡拉搜寻一件强大的恶魔武器。

pairs.source: The masters of the monk temple at the Peak of Serenety have called for a gathering to discuss the threat of the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 晴日峰的武僧寺院中的大师们准备召开一次大会，来讨论燃烧军团的威胁。

pairs.source: Pursue the foul demon Geth'xun through the Maelstrom and purify the realm of earth.
pairs.text: 追杀邪恶的恶魔格斯逊穿过大漩涡并净化土地的国度。
直升2.0团队与地下城副本
直升2.0团队与地下城副本

pairs.source: You have entered Icecrown to recover the fabled runeblade, Felo'melorn.
pairs.text: 你进入了冰冠堡垒寻找传说中的符文剑，烈焰之击。

pairs.source: You have traveled to the Skywall, realm of the wind elementals, in search of the legendary Fists of the Heavens.
pairs.text: 你前往风元素的国度——天空之墙，寻找传说中的诸天之拳。
随机时空漫游地下城（大地的裂变）

pairs.source: You have traveled to Niskara, homeworld of the Legion Inquisition.
pairs.text: 你到达了燃烧军团审判庭的所在地，尼斯卡拉。

pairs.source: You are attempting to deal with the aquatic disturbance off the coast of Val'sharah.
pairs.text: 你试图解决瓦尔莎拉海滩上的水域骚乱。

pairs.source: You are leading an elite force of demon hunters on a hunt to slay Varedis Felsoul in his Legion stronghold in Suramar.
pairs.text: 你带领着一支恶魔猎手精英小队来到瓦雷迪斯·邪魂位于苏拉玛的燃烧军团堡垒刺杀他。

pairs.source: You are closing in on Caria Felsoul, wielder of the infamous Aldrachi Warblades.
pairs.text: 你已经包围了臭名昭著的奥达奇战刃的持有者，凯丽娅·邪魂。

pairs.source: You and Fleet Admiral Tethys have located the Dread Admiral Eliza's fleet off the coast of Azsuna.
pairs.text: 你和舰队上将特塞斯在阿苏纳的海岸附近发现了亡灵舰长伊丽扎的舰队。

pairs.source: The Shado-Pan urgently need help liberating a powerful artifact from the clutches of the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 为了从燃烧军团手中夺回一件强大的神器，影踪派急需你的帮助。

pairs.source: You have traveled the Emerald Dream to Ursoc's Lair in search of the claws of the Bear God.
pairs.text: 你进入了翡翠梦境，前往乌索克之巢寻找巨熊之神的利爪。

pairs.source: You have been summoned to Icecrown by the Lich King.
pairs.text: 你受到巫妖王的召唤进入了冰冠堡垒。

pairs.source: You must interrogate Taldath the Destroyer for information on Varedis' whereabouts.
pairs.text: 你必须拷问毁灭者塔尔达斯，找出瓦雷迪斯·邪魂的下落。

pairs.source: You have found the secret lair of the Dark Riders, but their leader must be defeated for you to claim the artifact.
pairs.text: 你发现了黑暗骑士的秘密巢穴，但必须先击败他们的首领才能得到神器。

pairs.source: Havi offers aid against the Legion if you prove your valor on the Broken Shore.
pairs.text: 如果你能在破碎海滩证明自己的勇气，哈维就会协助你对抗燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Apata has found the location of the Talonclaw, guarded by an ancient enemy. Kill the monster and take back the spear.
pairs.text: 阿帕塔发现了雄鹰之爪的下落，但它被一个古老的敌人守护着。杀了那个怪物，夺回长矛。
恐痕裂隙最终场景战役

pairs.source: After the disastrous events at the Broken Shore, the world's shaman convene an emergency meeting at the very heart of Azeroth.
pairs.text: 破碎海滩一役惨败之后，全世界的萨满在艾泽拉斯的中心召开了一次紧急会议。

pairs.source: You have found the secret lair of the Dark Riders, but their leader must be defeated for you to claim the artifact.
pairs.text: 你发现了黑暗骑士的秘密巢穴，但必须先击败他们的首领才能得到神器。

pairs.source: You have found the secret lair of the Dark Riders, but their leader must be defeated for you to claim the artifact.
pairs.text: 你发现了黑暗骑士的秘密巢穴，但必须先击败他们的首领才能得到神器。

pairs.source: Someone has forgotten to loot something of incredible importance from the Lich King.
pairs.text: 有人忘记了拾取巫妖王的某件重要物品。

pairs.source: Venture into the forgotten corridors of Deepholm to retrieve the Doomhammer from a demonic foe.
pairs.text: 深入深岩之洲被遗忘的长廊，从一名恶魔手中夺回毁灭之锤。

pairs.source: The powerful Fist of Ra-Den awaits any who can prove to the White Tiger that they are mighty enough to wield it.
pairs.text: 强大的莱登之拳在等待着新的主人，只要你能向白虎证明自己的力量，就能得到它。

pairs.source: You and Lyessa Bloomwatcher have traveled to the base of Nordrassil to cleanse G'Hanir, the Mother Tree of its corruption.
pairs.text: 你和莱莎·护蕾来到诺达希尔的根部净化加尼尔，母亲之树所遭受的腐蚀。

pairs.source: Return to the Throne of Tides to track down a powerful relic of ages past: Sharas'dal, Scepter of the Tides.
pairs.text: 返回潮汐王座，追踪一件古老的强大圣物：莎拉达尔，潮汐权杖。

pairs.source: The Dark Queen and the Sea
You have traveled to Shield's Rest, an island that holds ancient vrykul tombs.
pairs.text: 你来到了盾憩岛，这座岛屿上坐落着古老的维库人墓穴。

pairs.source: You must infiltrate Akaari Shadowgore's fortress and take the Fangs of the Devourer from her corpse.
pairs.text: 你必须潜入阿卡丽·影血的堡垒，从她的尸体上拿走吞噬者之牙。

pairs.source: Inside a tomb of ancient vrykul kings lies a shrine to Tyr. Enter it and find the Truthguard.
pairs.text: 在一座古代维库国王的陵墓中有一个提尔的圣坛。进入圣坛，找到真理守护者。

pairs.source: You have traveled to the shattered world of Niskara in search of the legendary crystalline staff, T'uure.
pairs.text: 你进入了尼斯卡拉的破碎世界寻找传说中的水晶之杖，图雷。

pairs.source: You tread within the ancient titan city of Ulduar.
pairs.text: 你进入了古老的泰坦之城，奥杜尔。

pairs.source: You have traveled to this demon infested valley in search of the Skull of the Man'ari.
pairs.text: 你进入了这座恶魔肆虐的山谷，寻找堕落者之颅。

pairs.source: Mimiron has called you to the Spark of Imagination in Ulduar to plan your next move.
pairs.text: 米米尔隆召唤你前往奥杜尔的思想火花谋划下一步的行动。

pairs.source: You have traveled to this ancient ruin in search of Verstok Darkbough, who fled from Ashamane's Fall with the Fangs of Ashamane.
pairs.text: 你来到这片上古遗迹寻找维斯托克·暗枝。他带着阿莎曼之牙从阿莎曼之墓逃走了。

pairs.source: Ebonchill is in the hands of a power eredar mage hunter. Attract his attention with a powerful ritual and turn the tables on him
pairs.text: 黑檀之寒在一个强大的艾瑞达法师猎人手上。用强大的仪式吸引他的注意力，然后扭转局面。

pairs.source: The Veiled Hand has infiltrated Stormwind and plans to summon the Legion directly into the city.
pairs.text: 隐蔽之手已经潜入暴风城，计划将燃烧军团直接召唤到城里。

pairs.source: Convince Akama to stand by your side in the war against the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 说服阿卡玛在与燃烧军团的战争中站在你这边。

pairs.source: To cleanse the Nightmare, the brave must ascend the great tree Shaladrassil, where the veil of dreams is thinnest.
pairs.text: 为了净化梦魇，勇士必须登上巨树莎拉达希尔，这里梦境的帷幕最为稀薄。

pairs.source: The Nightmare's sway is greatest over those closest to nature, clouding the minds of her stalwart protectors with fear and rage.
pairs.text: 与自然的关系越密切，受梦魇的影响就越深。这些坚韧的自然守护者被恐惧和愤怒蒙蔽了心智。

pairs.source: Deep within this dark and formless expanse, where reality shifts and the senses deceive, the Nightmare Lord awaits.
pairs.text: 在这个黑暗无形的领域深处，现实不断变动，人的感官也变得无法信赖。梦魇之王在此等候。

pairs.source: An undersea passage offers access to the foundations of the Nightwell itself, but forgotten terrors await within.
pairs.text: 这个水下的通路可以进入暗夜井的地基，但是久已被忘却的恐惧也在里面等候。

pairs.source: The palatial grounds of the Nighthold stand as the pinnacle of a culture thoroughly shaped - and twisted - by magic.
pairs.text: 暗夜要塞的宫殿地区是他们的文化的顶点，这个文化由魔法塑造，也被魔法扭曲。

pairs.source: For Grand Magistrix Elisande, who mortgaged her people's future in a dark bargain with the Legion, a day of reckoning comes.
pairs.text: 大魔导师艾利桑德以她人民的未来作为抵押，与燃烧军团定下了黑暗的契约。如今清算的日子来临了。

pairs.source: Atop the Nighthold, the warlock Gul'dan arrives at the purpose for which his Legion masters sent him to Azeroth. Destiny awaits.
pairs.text: 术士古尔丹来到了暗夜要塞之巅，完成他的军团主人派他来到艾泽拉斯所履行的使命。命运在等待。

pairs.source: Convince Akama to stand by your side in the war against the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 说服阿卡玛在与燃烧军团的战争中站在你这边。

pairs.source: Follow Archmage Vargoth into the Oculus.
pairs.text: 跟随大法师瓦格斯进入魔环。

pairs.source: Defeat Hakkar the Houndmaster within the Violet Hold.
pairs.text: 在紫罗兰监狱中击败驯犬者哈卡。

pairs.source: You have arrived at the Jade Temple to seek out the former staff of the Monkey King, Fu Zan.
pairs.text: 你来到了青龙寺，寻找美猴王曾用过的法杖福枬。

pairs.source: Send a message to the Burning Legion by invading Niskara and putting an end once and for all to Caria and Varedis Felsoul.
pairs.text: 入侵尼斯卡拉，与凯丽娅·邪魂和瓦雷迪斯·邪魂做个了断，向燃烧军团表明态度。

pairs.source: Send a message to the Burning Legion by invading Niskara and putting an end once and for all to Caria and Varedis Felsoul.
pairs.text: 入侵尼斯卡拉，与凯丽娅·邪魂和瓦雷迪斯·邪魂做个了断，向燃烧军团表明态度。

pairs.source: Fight alongside your army of withered and make your way into the Collapse.
pairs.text: 与你的枯法者大军并肩作战，进入大陷坑。

pairs.source: Testing if a generic LFG record is all I need.
pairs.text: 测试一下是否普通的寻求组队记录就够我用了。
蔑潮港获取场景战役 - JMC
普通的寻求组队场景战役记录。
提瑞斯法林地获取场景战役 - JMC
普通的寻求组队场景战役记录。
盾憩岛获取场景战役 - JMC

pairs.source: You tread within the ancient titan city of Ulduar.
pairs.text: 你进入了古老的泰坦之城，奥杜尔。

pairs.source: Disguised as Jergosh, join the Shadow Council's hunt for the Eye of Dalaran in Tol Barad.
pairs.text: 乔装成耶戈什，加入暗影议会，在托尔巴拉德搜寻达拉然之眼。

pairs.source: Defend Netherlight Temple against Lord Balnazzar's invasion.
pairs.text: 防守虚空之光神殿，抵御巴纳扎尔的入侵。

pairs.source: Defend Netherlight Temple against Lord Balnazzar's invasion.
pairs.text: 防守虚空之光神殿，抵御巴纳扎尔的入侵。

pairs.source: Return to the tower of Karazhan to seek the clues to the Pillars of Creation.
pairs.text: 回到卡拉赞寻找创世之柱的线索。
卡拉赞 - 柱子的线索
伊利丹的起源：拉文凯斯的遗产

pairs.source: Atop the Blackrock Foundry, Warlord Blackhand oversees his clan's ancestral home amidst searing heat that only he can bear.
pairs.text: 在黑石铸造厂的顶层，督军黑手正在只有他能忍受的超高温中俯视着先祖的家园。

pairs.source: Deep within the Blackrock Foundry, brutal and giant creatures temper and forge the machinery of war for the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 在黑石铸造厂的深处，野蛮而巨大的生物在日夜锻打着钢铁部落的战争机器。

pairs.source: Only the unnatural heat of the Foundry furnace can smelt the Blackrock ore, essential to the might of the Iron Horde.
pairs.text: 只有铸造厂熔炉中反常的高温才能融化黑石矿石，而这种矿石正是钢铁部落的武力核心。

pairs.source: The extent of the Iron Horde's arms and armaments is a terrible sight to behold.
pairs.text: 延绵不绝的钢铁部落武器和军火构成了一副可怕的图景。

pairs.source: As ogres and Iron Horde leaders gather for a spectacle in the great arena of Highmaul, a destructive plot roils in the shadows.
pairs.text: 当食人魔和钢铁部落的首领们集聚一堂，在悬槌堡的大竞技场中观看难得一见的奇景时，一场毁灭性的阴谋正在暗中酝酿。

pairs.source: Only a select few have seen the inside of the Gorthenon atop Highmaul; rumors abound of strange relics and sorcery within.
pairs.text: 只有少数被选中的幸运儿曾见识过悬槌堡顶层的迦台农神殿；传说里面藏着诡异的圣物和巫术。

pairs.source: Atop Highmaul, Imperator Mar'gok works to unlock ancient secrets so that ogres may reclaim their birthright as lords of Draenor.
pairs.text: 在悬槌堡顶层，元首马尔高克正致力于发掘上古的秘密，从而使食人魔夺回德拉诺之王的荣光。

pairs.source: Before the gates of Hellfire Citadel, fel-infused siege engines and monstrous beasts stand ready for an assault on Azeroth.
pairs.text: 由邪能驱动的攻城机器和恐怖的野兽正在地狱火堡垒的大门前整装待发，准备踏上入侵艾泽拉斯的征程。

pairs.source: Kilrogg was first to accept Gul'dan's twisted offer, but many orcs followed. Bloodthirsty and savage, they await in these halls.
pairs.text: 基尔罗格率先接受了古尔丹扭曲的礼物，但这也带动了许多兽人的效仿。如今，这些嗜血而野蛮的家伙就在这些大厅中严阵以待。

pairs.source: With Gul'dan's ascent to power, the Sargerei and other members of the Shadow Council now work openly in service of the Legion.
pairs.text: 在古尔丹执掌大权后，萨格雷以及暗影议会的其他成员就公开效忠燃烧军团了。

pairs.source: Atop the spires of the Citadel, demonic champions ready themselves, as Gul'dan begins a dark ritual....
pairs.text: 在地狱火堡垒的峰顶，古尔丹正准备开始黑暗仪式，而那些恶魔勇士们则严阵以待……

pairs.source: On the grounds of the ruined Dark Portal, Archimonde himself comes forth to ensure that the Legion's plans do not fail.
pairs.text: 在黑暗之门的瓦砾之上，阿克蒙德亲自坐镇，以确保燃烧军团的计划得以顺利实现。
伊利丹的起源：黑暗虚空

pairs.source: The time has come to attack the Sanctum of Order and enter the Palace from below.
pairs.text: 时机已经成熟，攻打秩序大殿，并从下方进入宫殿。

pairs.source: The time has come to lead your forces into a full frontal attack on Suramar City itself.
pairs.text: 时机已经成熟，带领你的大军，正面进攻苏拉玛城。

pairs.source: It is time to bring Archmage Xylem to justice once and for all.
pairs.text: 该去彻底制裁大法师克希雷姆了。

pairs.source: Face the final test of the titan keeper Odyn, then descent into the depths of Helheim to defeat Helya once and for all!
pairs.text: 面对泰坦守护者奥丁的最终试练，然后深入冥狱深渊，彻底击败海拉！
必须阻止瑟玛普拉格的导弹发射！

pairs.source: Fight the Imp Mother to get special powers.
pairs.text: 与鬼母作战，获得特殊的力量。

pairs.source: The Fel Hammer is under attack. Defend it!
pairs.text: 邪能之槌号遭到攻击。保护它！
邪能之槌号恶魔猎手场景战役

pairs.source: You are attempting to reign in the elements contained in the three disc fragments of the mage class mount.
pairs.text: 你打算控制住法师职业坐骑的三块飞碟碎片所中蕴含的元素。

pairs.source: Defeat the deviate critters that have overtaken the Wailing Caverns.
pairs.text: 击败盘踞在哀嚎洞穴中的变异小动物。

pairs.source: Stop the Legion attack on Stormstout Brewery!
pairs.text: 快阻止燃烧军团对风暴烈酒酿造厂的攻击！

pairs.source: Panic At The Brewery - Monk Scenario
pairs.text: 酿酒厂的恐慌 - 武僧场景战役

pairs.source: You must stop Kruul before he reaches full strength!
pairs.text: 必须阻止库鲁尔，不能让他恢复最大的力量！

pairs.source: Stop Tugar Bloodtotem and his Fel Worms from bringing down the mountain.
pairs.text: 阻止图加·鲜血图腾和他的邪能蠕虫震塌至高岭的企图。

pairs.source: Sigryn must be stopped before she confronts Odyn.
pairs.text: 必须在希格林挑战奥丁前阻止她。

pairs.source: Claim a gift from the Titans deep beneath the waves.
pairs.text: 从大海深处取出泰坦的礼物。

pairs.source: Raest has tapped into the Twisting Nether to give him god-like powers. He must be stopped.
pairs.text: 莱斯特与扭曲虚空建立了联系，获得了神祇般的力量。你必须阻止他。
随机时空漫游地下城（熊猫人之谜）

pairs.source: You're gathering holy water and finding the location of Rivendare's mount.
pairs.text: 你需要收集圣水，并找到瑞文戴尔的坐骑下落。

pairs.source: [temp]Find the Risen General and put an end to him.
pairs.text: 找到复活的将军并终结他的生命。

pairs.source: The End of the Risen Threat
You're entering a tournament held by Odyn to prove who's the strongest warrior in the land.
pairs.text: 你参加了奥丁举办的比武大赛，要证明自己是世界上最强大的战士。

pairs.source: Defeat the mysterious creatures that have taken residence in the Deadmines.
pairs.text: 击败居住在死亡矿井的神秘生物。

pairs.source: Lure out and defeat Arax'ath to claim the Wrathsteed.
pairs.text: 引出阿拉萨斯并将他击败，夺取愤怒战马。

pairs.source: Defeat the mysterious creatures that have taken residence in the Gnomeregan.
pairs.text: 击败居住在诺莫瑞根的神秘生物。

pairs.source: Defend the Shrine of Aviana from the Legion assault.
pairs.text: 保卫艾维娜圣殿，抵抗燃烧军团的进攻。

pairs.source: You are attempting to bring a Wild Felwing under your control through force.
pairs.text: 你要用武力驯服一头野生邪翼蝠。

pairs.source: After weeks of hard-fought battle, Azeroth's heroes at last enter the dark Tomb, but the Legion has been preparing as well...
pairs.text: 经过数周的艰苦奋战，艾泽拉斯的英雄们终于进入了黑暗的萨格拉斯之墓，但燃烧军团早有准备……

pairs.source: The lower reaches of the one-time Temple of Elune have been sealed away for generations, spawning unthinkable horrors.
pairs.text: 昔日月神殿的下层区域，已经被封印了数代，滋生着难以想象的恐怖。

pairs.source: Aegwynn sealed away the defeated Avatar of Sargeras deep beneath the Tomb, but that fearsome husk now begins to stir....
pairs.text: 艾格文击败萨格拉斯的化身后，将他封印在了陵墓深处，但那具恐怖的躯壳现在又开始活动了……

pairs.source: In the depths of the Tomb of Sargeras, Kil'jaeden appears cornered at last. Or are we just playing into the Deceiver's hands?
pairs.text: 在萨格拉斯之墓的深处，基尔加丹似乎终于走投无路了。但这是真的吗？还是我们落入了欺诈者的陷阱？

pairs.source: Magni has beckoned you to Sholazar basin with an urgent message.
pairs.text: 麦格尼传来了紧急消息，召唤你前往索拉查盆地。

pairs.source: You're here to make the Lords of the Winds swear allegiance to Thunderaan.
pairs.text: 你要让风元素领主们宣誓效忠桑德兰。

pairs.source: The Throne of the Four Winds
Find out what's happening in Akazamzarak's Hat.
pairs.text: 搞清楚阿卡扎曼扎拉克的帽子出了什么问题。
阿卡扎曼扎拉克的帽子

pairs.source: Hunt down Infazzar the Shade, and retrieve the Idol of Aviana.
pairs.text: 追杀“暗影”伊法扎尔，夺回艾维娜雕像。

pairs.source: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
Locate the bones of the fallen dragon and raise them in undeath.
pairs.text: 找到陨落巨龙的骸骨并使其复生。

pairs.source: It's the Trial of Style! Flaunt your transmog skills to win first place!
pairs.text: 时尚试炼到了！尽情展示你的幻化技巧，赢取冠军吧！
时空漫游团队副本：黑暗神殿

pairs.source: Help Chromie rescue her future self from a mysterious assailant.
pairs.text: 帮助克罗米从神秘袭击者手中拯救未来的自己。

pairs.source: Traverse the maze that is the Endless Halls.
pairs.text: 在无尽大殿的迷宫中穿行。

pairs.source: The Legion musters its forces against the Light's incursion, defying those who dare besiege Antorus.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团召集兵力抵御圣光的进攻，消灭任何胆敢围攻安托鲁斯的人。

pairs.source: From deep within its stronghold, the immortal army advances upon countless worlds... and seeks to claim the Dark Titan's prize.
pairs.text: 不朽的军团从他们的要塞深处向着无数个世界进军……希望获得黑暗泰坦的奖赏。

pairs.source: Only the most devoted--or the most vile--may tread so close to the heart of the Legion's power.
pairs.text: 只有最狂热，或者最恶毒之辈，才能踏入燃烧军团的力量核心。

pairs.source: Forces that shape the cosmos. Sights too wondrous for mortal eyes. Come forth, heroes, and behold eternity's end.
pairs.text: 这是塑造了宇宙的力量，是凡人之眼无法承受的绝景。上前来吧，英雄们，亲眼目睹永恒的终结。
大型侵入点：主母芙努娜

pairs.source: Greater Invasion Point: Pit Lord Vilemus
pairs.text: 大型侵入点：深渊领主维尔姆斯

pairs.source: In true goblin fashion, Landro Longshot has put a stranglehold on the distribution of these mysterious incorporeal mounts.
pairs.text: 按照真正的地精传统，兰德鲁·郎绍特为这些神秘的灵体坐骑套上了项圈。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: Historians claim that these incorporeal beasts were created when Draenor exploded, unleashing energies that warped the world's flora and fauna.
pairs.text: 历史学家声称这些灵体生物是在德拉诺爆炸时诞生的，四溢的能量包裹着那个世界，植物或动物就形成了现在这种样子。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: Only the swiftest heroes venturing into the troll temple of Zul'Aman were able to subdue these rare battle mounts.
pairs.text: 只有以最快速度横扫巨魔神庙祖阿曼的英雄才能驯服这些稀有的战斗坐骑。

pairs.source: Brewers retired this mount from active advertising service after complaints that the beasts were "too temperamental" to control in major cities.
pairs.text: 由于接到大量关于这种野兽“过于兴奋”，在主城中难以控制的投诉后，啤酒商们就不再让这种坐骑参加活动广告服务了。

pairs.source: Dwarves attribute this breed's even temperament to rigorous training, but other races argue that a daily diet of strong ale has something to do with it.
pairs.text: 矮人将这种动物平和的性情归结于严格的训练，但其他种族认为这与其每天一桶烈酒的习性有关。

pairs.source: Members of the Cenarion Circle have shared a long and prosperous partnership with their hippogryph allies. When conflict is unavoidable, the Cenarion War Hippogryph is called into service.
pairs.text: 塞纳里奥议会的成员和他们的角鹰兽盟友结下了长久而深厚的友谊。当冲突不可避免时，塞纳里奥作战角鹰兽就会被征召入伍。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r芬德雷·迅矛|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r赞加沼泽，外域|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r塞纳里奥远征队 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Only the most talented engineers have the courage and the mental stamina to create a flying machine that boasts stability and safety.  Turbo-charging one is just crazy!
pairs.text: 只有最天才的工程师才有勇气和毅力制造出稳定安全的飞行器。涡轮加速飞行器真是太酷了！

pairs.source: The backbone of the Alliance air force is comprised predominantly of gnomish flying machines due to their maneuverability and speed.
pairs.text: 侏儒飞行器以其高机动性和飞行速度成为了联盟空军的主力。

pairs.source: The most aggressive nether drakes were awarded those heroes who showed significant prowess and commitment in the gladiatorial arena.
pairs.text: 这些最具攻击性的虚空幼龙只会奖励给那些在角斗士竞技场中展现出过人实力和热情的英雄们。
残酷角斗士的虚空幼龙

pairs.source: The most aggressive nether drakes were awarded those heroes who showed significant prowess and commitment in the gladiatorial arena.
pairs.text: 这些最具攻击性的虚空幼龙只会奖励给那些在角斗士竞技场中展现出过人实力和热情的英雄们。
残酷角斗士的虚空幼龙

pairs.source: First designed as a booster for a much larger rocket, the X-51 was determined to give the perfect thrust capacity for a single rider payload.
pairs.text: X-51的推进器最初是为更大的火箭设计的，但最后却成为单人荷载火箭的完美推动力。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: What it lacks in safety features it more than makes up for in speed and style.  Not for the faint of heart.
pairs.text: 速度和外观弥补了它不够安全的缺陷。胆小者请勿使用。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: I may question Prince Kael'thas's loyalties, but never his style. -Elrodan
pairs.text: 我可以质疑凯尔萨斯王子的忠诚，但无法否认他的品位。——艾尔隆丹
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r凯尔萨斯·逐日者|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r魔导师平台

pairs.source: Be it into the flood, or into the fire, this one will go where you require.
pairs.text: 不管是上刀山还是下火海，它都能带着你抵达想去的地方。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r塞满战利品的南瓜|n|cFFFFD200节日：|r万圣节|n

pairs.source: Uniquely aggressive and pugnacious elekk bulls are culled from the herd and sold to Ethereal traders. The traders then train the bulls for combat and sell them to owners unconcerned about safety.
pairs.text: 特别凶猛好斗的雄性雷象会被赶出象群并卖给虚灵商人。这些商人会对它们进行战斗训练，并将它们卖给不怕死的主人。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r卡特尔中尉|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风城|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\PVPFRAME\PVPCurrency-Honor-Alliance.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Some horses merely adopt the dark. This horse was born in it, molded by it.
pairs.text: 有些战马很难适应黑暗。而这匹马就是在黑暗中诞生，用黑暗塑造而成。

pairs.source: Zhevras are rarely used as mounts in Azeroth due to their stubborn nature and tendency to bite.
pairs.text: 在艾泽拉斯，斑马很少被当成坐骑，因为它们情性固执而且喜欢咬人。

pairs.source: The most aggressive nether drakes were awarded those heroes who showed significant prowess and commitment in the gladiatorial arena.
pairs.text: 这些最具攻击性的虚空幼龙只会奖励给那些在角斗士竞技场中展现出过人实力和热情的英雄们。
复仇角斗士的虚空幼龙

pairs.source: Zhevras are rarely used as mounts in Azeroth due to their stubborn nature and tendency to bite.
pairs.text: 在艾泽拉斯，斑马很少被当成坐骑，因为它们情性固执而且喜欢咬人。

pairs.source: You can't remember exactly how you got this mount. Then again, you can't remember much of anything that happens at Brewfest.
pairs.text: 你记不清到底是怎么搞到这头坐骑的了。而且，你也记不太清楚美酒节发生的事情了。

pairs.source: Coren Direbrew won this prize after drinking a Tauren druid under the table - and the druid was in bear form. It was one of Direbrew's proudest moments.
pairs.text: 科林·烈酒曾在拼酒时将一位牛头人德鲁伊喝到了桌子底下，并因此赢得了这件奖品——那位德鲁伊当时还是熊形态。那是烈酒一生中最得意的时刻。

pairs.source: He's big, he's ready for battle, and he's a bear. What more could you want in a mount?
pairs.text: 他很大，他随时能投入战斗，他是一头熊。对于一头坐骑，你还能要求什么呢？
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: Dead or alive, you're coming with me.
pairs.text: 无论生死，你我一路同行。

pairs.source: Winged Steed of the Ebon Blade

pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r恐怖指挥官萨拉诺尔|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r东瘟疫之地|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: The frost vrykul believe that wearing a necklace of polar bear claws will grant them otherworldly strength.
pairs.text: 冰霜维库人相信，带着北极熊爪制成的项链能给他们带来超凡的力量。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r海德尼尔礼品|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r风暴峭壁

pairs.source: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.
pairs.text: 就算是亡灵，偶尔也需要飞行。

pairs.source: Difficult to build and to maintain, these hogs more than make up for their expense through sheer cool factor.
pairs.text: 虽然制造和保养都很困难，但这些路霸炫酷拉风的外形完全能够值回票价。

pairs.source: The most aggressive nether drakes were awarded those heroes who showed significant prowess and commitment in the gladiatorial arena.
pairs.text: 这些最具攻击性的虚空幼龙只会奖励给那些在角斗士竞技场中展现出过人实力和热情的英雄们。
野蛮角斗士的虚空幼龙

pairs.source: Whenever you ride this mount, you feel the urge to shout, "Cry havoc and let slip the murlocs of war!"
pairs.text: 每当你骑上这头坐骑时，你就会迫不及待地高喊：“为浩劫和鱼人战争造成的破坏哭泣吧！”

pairs.source: Always speak politely to an enraged dragon.
pairs.text: 跟愤怒的巨龙说话时，一定要保持礼貌。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r阿莱克丝塔萨的礼物|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r永恒之眼

pairs.source: Come not between the dragon and his wrath.
pairs.text: 千万别在巨龙发怒时去惹它。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r阿莱克丝塔萨的礼物|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r永恒之眼

pairs.source: Lost time is never found again. Oh, never mind I found it. -Chronormu
pairs.text: 时光一去不复返。噢，别在意，我能把它们找回来。——克罗诺姆
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r永恒腐蚀者|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r净化斯坦索姆

pairs.source: You should never listen to minstrels' fancies. A dragon would never hurt a soul, unless they tried to hurt him first.
pairs.text: 你真不该听信吟游诗人的鬼话：巨龙从不伤害生灵，除非别人先伤害它。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r希尔丝塔萨|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r龙骨荒野|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r龙眠联军 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: But the most important rule, the rule you can never forget, no matter how much he cries, no matter how much he begs, never feed him after midnight.
pairs.text: 最重要的是，千万不要忘记，无论它怎么叫唤哀求，千万不要在午夜之后喂它吃东西。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r萨塔里奥|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r黑曜石圣殿

pairs.source: The taunka use black polar bear pelts in their religious rites, usually at the funerals of those who hunt black polar bears.
pairs.text: 牦牛人会在宗教仪式中使用黑色北极熊毛皮，通常是用在那些狩猎黑色北极熊的猎人的葬礼上。

pairs.source: It never pays to leave a live dragon out of the equation.
pairs.text: 永远不要将一头活生生的龙排除在你的考虑范围之外。

pairs.source: Normally placid beasts, these intelligent animals form a strong bond with their riders, making them loyal and fearless in battle.
pairs.text: 这些聪明的动物平时性情温和，与骑手有着深厚的感情，因此在战斗中表现得忠诚而勇敢。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r骑士达米隆|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冬拥湖|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\PVPFRAME\PVPCurrency-Honor-Alliance.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Sure-footed and unflappable, these dark-furred mammoths are prized for their steady temperament going into battle.
pairs.text: 稳健而镇定，这些黑色的猛犸象因其战斗中沉稳的表现而格外难能可贵。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r石头守卫穆卡尔|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冬拥湖|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\PVPFRAME\PVPCurrency-Honor-Horde.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Directly descended from the original progenitor of the mammoth race, wooly mammoths are considered more feral and primal than their shorter-haired cousins.
pairs.text: 作为猛犸象先祖的直系后裔，人们认为这些长毛猛犸象比它们的短毛近亲更加狂野和原始。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r梅尔·弗兰希斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r晶歌森林|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r10000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: This wild variant of the mammoth is not bred for riding. Most wooly mammoths are captured in the wild and tamed by their riders, resulting in a fierce, cunning mount.
pairs.text: 这种狂野而充满活力的猛犸象本不是用来骑乘的。大部分长毛猛犸象都是从野外捕捉来，由骑手驯服后才变成了凶猛、狡诈的坐骑。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r梅尔·弗兰希斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r晶歌森林|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r10000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: The Sons of Hodir believe that riding an ice-white mammoth will protect the rider from frostbite and snow blindness.
pairs.text: 霍迪尔之子相信骑着雪白的猛犸象能保护骑手不受霜冻和雪盲的侵害。

pairs.source: Bred specifically to honor those heroes who showed exceptional resilience and fortitude facing the dangers in Northrend.
pairs.text: 为那些在面对诺森德的危险时表现得格外坚韧的英雄特别驯养，以此表彰其勇气。

pairs.source: The Storm Peaks! There we will find the beast strong enough to bear me into battle. -Skadi the Ruthless
pairs.text: 风暴峭壁！我们能在那里找到足够强壮，可以载着我上战场的野兽。——残忍的斯卡迪
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r残忍的斯卡迪|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r乌特加德之巅

pairs.source: The only reason for time is so that everything doesn't happen at once.
pairs.text: 时间存在的唯一好处就是不会让所有事情同时发生。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r迷时始祖幼龙|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r风暴峭壁

pairs.source: Bred specifically to honor those heroes who showed significant courage and persistence facing the dangers in Northrend.
pairs.text: 为那些在面对诺森德的危险时表现得格外坚韧的英雄特别驯养，以此表彰其勇气。

pairs.source: I cannot help but wonder if things would have turned out different if the titans had elevated even one more dragonflight. -Alexstrasza
pairs.text: 我总是忍不住会想，如果泰坦能多创造哪怕一个巨龙军团，这个世界的一切会不会有所不同。——阿莱克斯塔萨

pairs.text: 就连龙族同宗会的测试也无法证明白色幼龙是否与已知的某个巨龙军团有关。——布琳妮

pairs.source: This ursine mount's swiftness is enhanced by its heavy armor, imbued with magic from Kirin Tor magi.
pairs.text: 这种熊类坐骑的重型装甲提高了它的奔跑速度，因为肯瑞托的魔导师在上面灌注了魔力。

pairs.source: Your cries of "For the Horde!" will be much more menacing from atop a heavily armored bear that's barreling down on Alliance at top speed.
pairs.text: 当你骑着一头全速冲向联盟的重装巨熊时，你那“为了部落！”的战号听起来会更加威风。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r梅尔·弗兰希斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r晶歌森林|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r750|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Killing leaders of the Horde is its own reward, but this intimidating beast is an excellent memento.
pairs.text: 杀死部落的领袖本身就是一种奖赏，但这头吓人的野兽将是最好的纪念品。

pairs.source: This formidable mount is bought with the blood of Alliance leaders, but you would have killed them for free.
pairs.text: 这头强大的坐骑是用联盟领袖的鲜血换来的，但你可以随意杀死他们。

pairs.source: Merchants trust only this thundering, mountainous steed to protect them when venturing down Azeroth's most dangerous trade routes.
pairs.text: 商人们都相信，在行走艾泽拉斯最危险的商路时，只有这种吼声如雷，体型巨大的生物能保护他们。

pairs.source: A common sight on trade routes all across Azeroth, this calm, stalwart mount is the favorite of merchants traveling to exotic and distant markets.
pairs.text: 在艾泽拉斯的商路上非常常见，这种温顺、健壮的坐骑是商人前往遥远的异国市场的首选。

pairs.source: Sporting superb engineering craftsmanship, this chopper is one of the few personal vehicles on Azeroth built for two.
pairs.text: 作为完美的运动型工程学产品，这种摩托车是艾泽拉斯极少见的双座私人载具。

pairs.source: The nice thing is that when they attack, blood almost never stains their feathers. -Mei Francis
pairs.text: 最好的地方在于，当它们攻击时，鲜血从不会弄脏它们的羽毛。——梅尔·弗兰希斯

pairs.text: 它们并非原产于诺森德，但非常适应寒冷的气候。——梅尔·弗兰希斯

pairs.source: Standard features include a sturdy imbued frostweave frame and real iceweb spider silk threading.  Spare head pillow sold separately.
pairs.text: 标准配置包括一个结实的灌魔霜纹布框架和真正的冰网蛛丝布。备用枕头另售。

pairs.source: Ancient manuscripts depict merchants traveling across the frozen tundra with these colossal beasts, leading scholars to believe they are the first domesticated mounts.
pairs.text: 古代手稿描述了商人们如何驱使着这些巨兽穿越冰封的苔原。这使得学者们坚信它们是第一批被驯养的坐骑。

pairs.source: Riders and merchants alike trust only this strong and steadfast mammoth to carry them safely across the frigid tundra.
pairs.text: 骑士和商人都相信，只有这种强壮坚定的猛犸象能载着他们穿过严寒的苔原。

pairs.source: Hop aboard this flying carpet to see the shining, shimmering, and splendid world of Azeroth, wonder by wonder.
pairs.text: 快跳上这块飞毯，去探访辉煌灿烂，壮丽动人的艾泽拉斯世界中的无数奇迹吧。

pairs.source: Once used by giants to carry heavily armored warriors, these grand war mammoths can easily bear more than one rider of less-than-giant stature.
pairs.text: 这些巨型猛犸战象曾被巨人用来背负重甲战士，能够轻松驮动好几个体型小于巨人的骑手。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r首领掉落|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r阿尔卡冯的宝库

pairs.source: Rarely, a war mammoth is born stronger and more tractable than its peers. These mammoths are dubbed "grand" and carry more than one rider to the front lines.
pairs.text: 少数猛犸战象生来就比它的同类更加强壮和温顺。这些猛犸象会被冠以“重型”的名头并在前线背负不止一名骑手。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r首领掉落|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r阿尔卡冯的宝库

pairs.source: At home on the narrow, icy trails of the Storm Peaks, these mammoths are the only mounts the ice giants trust to carry large loads and multiple riders.
pairs.text: 在其家乡风暴峭壁狭窄、冰封的小径上，这些猛犸象是冰巨人们唯一信赖的坐骑。它们能够驮动大量物资以及数个骑手。

pairs.source: Although raised in Stormwind, this breed showed unusual aptitude for the cold weather in Icecrown.

pairs.text: 按照暗夜精灵的风俗，当他们的坐骑死去时，骑手要将刃豹的一根獠牙留下做纪念。

pairs.text: 埃索达雷象是受过沃洛斯祝福的雷象，这位纳鲁跟随维伦和他的追随者从德拉诺来到了艾泽拉斯。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r艾蕾希|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冰冠冰川|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r100|TINTERFACE\ICONS\Ability_Paladin_ArtofWar.blp:0|t

pairs.source: For a brief time, many orcs would declare themselves "hungry like an Orgrimmar wolf." Some blood elves still use the phrase ironically.
pairs.text: 有一段时间，许多兽人都会自称“饿得像奥格瑞玛战狼”一样。直到现在，有些血精灵还会用这句谚语来讽刺别人。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r弗蕾卡·血斧|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冰冠冰川|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r100|TINTERFACE\ICONS\Ability_Paladin_ArtofWar.blp:0|t

pairs.source: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Mulgore.
pairs.text: 作为兽群的头领，这头科多兽很好地代表了这种威震莫高雷的强大生物。

pairs.source: So I says I feel like chicken tonight. Next thing, I am flat out and that thing is trying to see what my eyes taste like. -Bozzle Blastbolt
pairs.text: 我只是说了我今晚想吃鸡而已。接着，我就被拍飞出去，那家伙还想尝尝我的眼珠是什么滋味。——波兹尔·布拉斯波
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r特雷利斯·晨日|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冰冠冰川|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r100|TINTERFACE\ICONS\Ability_Paladin_ArtofWar.blp:0|t

pairs.source: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.
pairs.text: 当死去的英雄们被复活为亡灵时，他们的战马也一起复活了。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r伊莉莎·基连|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r冰冠冰川|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r100|TINTERFACE\ICONS\Ability_Paladin_ArtofWar.blp:0|t

pairs.source: A token of titan craftsmanship hoarded by the Old God, Yogg-Saron. Currently the single largest mechanical gnome head in Azeroth.
pairs.text: 上古之神尤格-萨隆收藏的泰坦工艺代表作。也是目前艾泽拉斯最大的机械侏儒头部。

pairs.source: Argent Hippogryphs will partner with only the bravest and most battle-tested champions.
pairs.text: 银色角鹰兽只会听命于最勇敢且久经沙场的勇士。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r阵营军需官|n|cFFFFD200地区： |r银色锦标赛，冰冠冰川|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r150|TINTERFACE\ICONS\Ability_Paladin_ArtofWar.blp:0|t|n

pairs.source: His skin more hard than brass was found, that sword nor spear could pierce nor wound.
pairs.text: 他的皮肤比黄铜还要坚硬，长剑和铁矛也无法在上面留下伤痕。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r奥杜尔团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: Not as shiny as the other one, but it's still a great find lads. Brann Bronzebeard
pairs.text: 没有其他同类那么闪亮，但它依然是伟大的发现，伙计们。——布莱恩·铜须
|cFFFFD200成就：|r奥杜尔团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: A rare sight. Most disappeared once Baron Rivendare ruled in Stratholme.
pairs.text: 非常罕见，大部分都在瑞文戴尔男爵统治斯坦索姆时期消失了。

pairs.source: "The kodo is the backbone of our people. Wherever the Horde goes - in trade, settlement, or war - there you will find the mighty kodo." - Harb Clawhoof
pairs.text: “科多兽是我们人民的脊梁。无论部落走到哪里——不管因为生意、定居还是战争——你都能看到强大的科多兽。”——哈布·爪蹄
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r哈布·爪蹄|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r莫高雷|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Can howl loudly enough to be heard for miles.
pairs.text: 嗥叫声非常响亮，几里外都能听见。

pairs.source: You raised this thing from a scaly pup - Mor'vek would be so proud. But he'd still make you clean up the mess it made in the corner.
pairs.text: 你将它从一个长满鳞片的小宝宝养大——莫维克会很骄傲的。但他还是会让你打扫干净它在角落留下的垃圾。
|cFFFFD200任务：|r飞速成长|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r安戈洛环形山

pairs.source: Often caught by fishermen at a young age, these mounts are much more comfortable in the water than they are on land.
pairs.text: 这些坐骑通常都是在年幼时被渔夫捕来的，它们在水里会比在陆地上更加自在。

pairs.source: These reanimated vessels of destruction do not fear death; they dispense it.
pairs.text: 这些复生的毁灭使者并不害怕死亡，它们只会带来死亡。
致命角斗士的冰霜巨龙

pairs.source: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.
pairs.text: 被遗忘者们相信，如果没有明确的目标，就连驮兽都会因无法安息而痛苦。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r撒迦利亚·普斯特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r提瑞斯法林地|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Some of Azeroth's mightiest dragons have been summoned across the veil between life and death to serve new masters with undying loyalty.
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯一部分最强大的巨龙受到召唤，穿越了生与死的界限，以其无限的忠诚为新主人效劳。
狂怒角斗士的冰霜巨龙

pairs.source: Despite their name, Dark Phoenixes are known to have a warm and cheerful disposition.
pairs.text: 虽然有个阴暗的名字，但暗色凤凰的性情却是出了名的热情欢快。

pairs.source: Don't let the saddle fool you, he's wild, not a tame lion.
pairs.text: 别让那个鞍具骗了，它很狂野，可不是温顺的狮子。

pairs.source: The Tol'vir sorcerer Azj'Aqir was said to possess a scepter that would allow him to control a Qiraj battle tank outside of its Silithus home.
pairs.text: 据说托维尔巫师阿兹亚基有一根节杖，能让他在希利苏斯沙漠之外的地方控制其拉作战坦克。

pairs.source: Dark spirits flee before the radiance of its presence.

pairs.source: Sandstone Drakes were studied in great detail long ago by the famed alchemist Walleye Sprysprocket. It has even been said that Walleye developed potions to mimic the drakes' physiology.
pairs.text: 许多年前，著名的炼金师沃莱·喷箭就仔细研究过沙石幼龙。据说沃莱还发明了一种模仿其生理机能的药水。

pairs.source: I thought the thing was ill until it took to the air. It flies as true as any of my own. -Alexstrasza
pairs.text: 我本以为这个小家伙病了，直到它一飞冲天。它的飞行技巧和我本人一样好。——阿莱克斯塔萨
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾|n

pairs.source: Vicious in battle and surprisingly loyal, this battle scorpion serves only those who show true commitment to a powerful guild.
pairs.text: 这种战蝎在战斗时极其狡诈却格外忠诚，只会臣服于那些为强大的公会付出满腔热情的人。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r古拉姆|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r奥格瑞玛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1500|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: The purebred royal raptors of Zul'Gurub, these mounts have become a rare sight in Stranglethorn Vale. The Gurubashi have been known to fly into a rage at the sight of any non-troll riding one of their precious beasts.
pairs.text: 作为祖尔格拉布的纯种皇家迅猛龙，这些坐骑在荆棘谷已经很少见到了。如果让古拉巴什巨魔看到有非巨魔的骑手骑着他们的宝贝坐骑，他们一定会勃然大怒。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r血领主曼多基尔|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r祖尔格拉布

pairs.source: The jungle trolls have long coveted panther fangs, using them for rituals or as ingredients in mojos.
pairs.text: 猎豹的獠牙是丛林巨魔梦寐以求的宝物。他们会用这些獠牙来举行仪式或作为魔精的材料。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r高阶祭司基尔娜拉|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r祖尔格拉布

pairs.source: Dragonhawks liberated from troll enslavement are considered among the most loyal of all their kin.
pairs.text: 从巨魔的奴役中被解救出来的龙鹰被认为是龙鹰中最忠诚的品种。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: Flameward Hippogryphs revel in the defeat of Ragnaros, Lord of Fire.
pairs.text: 击败炎魔之王，拉格纳罗斯后，浴火角鹰兽就出现了。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r熔火前线的攻势|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r大地的裂变

pairs.source: Legends state that the Pureblood line may be traced back to the very creation of the Firelands.
pairs.text: 传说纯血火鹰的谱系能一直追溯到火焰之地诞生之时。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r拉格纳罗斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r火焰之地

pairs.source: Felfire is deadly to the touch.  Luckily, the hawk can suppress the flames, choosing not to incinerate its rider in an emerald effigy.
pairs.text: 魔能火焰对接触者是致命的。幸运的是，火鹰可以压制烈焰，选择不将它的骑手烧成翠绿色的雕像。

pairs.source: Millagazor was a fire hawk loyal to Ragnaros. At this time it is unknown how many of Millagazor's eggs were corrupted.
pairs.text: 米拉盖佐尔是一只忠于拉格纳罗斯的火鹰。不知道这次有多少米拉盖佐尔的卵被腐蚀了。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r火焰之地团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: One-time companion of Kanga the Primal, the fallen troll hero. The raptor's name is unknown, for Kanga only spoke to it in bear form.
pairs.text: 陨落的巨魔英雄，原生者康戈曾经的伙伴。这头迅猛龙的名字无人知晓，因为康戈只在熊形态下跟它说话。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾|n

pairs.source: The Amani trolls decorate these ferocious mounts in magic amulets and ceremonial masks as a way to venerate the bear god Nalorakk.
pairs.text: 阿曼尼巨魔用魔法护符和仪式面具装饰这些凶猛的坐骑，以此向熊神纳洛拉克表达崇敬之情。

pairs.source: "One has not truly lived until they have felt the tidal current rushing through their hair while atop a majestic seahorse," said no one.  Ever.
pairs.text: “只有当一个人骑着雄壮的海马，感受过洋流拂过发丝的感觉，你才算不虚此生。”——无名氏
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r波塞冬斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r瓦丝琪尔

pairs.source: Unearthed recently in an ancient tomb, this mighty winged lion may have once served one of the ancient Tol'vir princes.
pairs.text: 这种强大的有翼狮子最近刚从一座古代陵墓中被发掘出来，曾为一位古代托维尔亲王效力。

pairs.source: Armored to withstand collisions in battle.
pairs.text: 披着装甲，可抵御战斗中的冲撞。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r联盟精兵II|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r评级战场

pairs.source: At Warchief Hellscream's command, Horde trainers began raising wolves to thrive in the shock and ferocity of sustained combat.
pairs.text: 根据地狱咆哮酋长的命令，部落训练师们开始驯养能够适应残酷的长期战斗的座狼。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r部落精兵II|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r评级战场

pairs.source: Heroes who proved their might in the gladiatorial arenas during the Cataclysm were awarded the most exceptional of the twilight drake broods.
pairs.text: 只有在大灾变期间的角斗场中证明过自己力量的英雄们才能获得这种极其稀有的暮光幼龙。
残忍角斗士的暮光幼龙

pairs.source: As with their matriarch, Alysrazor, the fury and fervor of these elemental avians are unquenchable.
pairs.text: 和它们的主母奥利瑟拉佐尔一样，这些元素猛禽的怒火和高温是永不熄灭的。
奥利瑟拉佐尔的烈焰之爪
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r奥利瑟拉佐尔|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r火焰之地

pairs.source: A rarity amongst the tallstrider breeds of Kalimdor, but easily recognized by its pungent dead seaweed aroma.
pairs.text: 在卡利姆多的陆行鸟种群中非常罕见，但可以通过它身上浓烈的枯萎海草味道分辨出来。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

冷酷角斗士的暮光幼龙

pairs.source: This vibrant breed can only be found in the forests of Darkmoon Island.
pairs.text: 这个充满活力的品种只能在暗月岛的森林里找到。

pairs.source: The joys of Noblegarden are best when celebrated with this loyal, loving, and blandly-colored freak of nature.
pairs.text: 复活节最大的乐趣就是跟这种忠诚、可爱、色彩柔和、怪模怪样的坐骑一起庆祝节日。

pairs.text: 这是个悲伤的事实，即使是睿智威严的角鹰兽也会被腐化。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: These fearsome mounts have a habit of suddenly breaking out into dance amid battle, much to the annoyance of their riders.
pairs.text: 这些巨大的坐骑经常在战斗中突然翩翩起舞，让它们的骑手感到非常烦恼。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰拉|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暗月岛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r180|TINTERFACE\ICONS\INV_Misc_Ticket_Darkmoon_01.blp:0|t|n|n

pairs.source: Images of this breed are often found on kegs of watered-down dwarven brew.
pairs.text: 这种生物的形象常常出现在掺水的矮人啤酒的酒桶上。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r阿斯特丽德·长袜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r达纳苏斯|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Longs for the day it may return to its home in Gilneas.
pairs.text: 它一直期待着重返故乡吉尔尼斯的那一天。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r阿斯特丽德·长袜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r达纳苏斯|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r10|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: A symbol of justice throughout all known realms.
pairs.text: 全世界公认的正义象征。

pairs.source: When you said an old friend was coming back, this was not quite what I expected. -Bralla Cloudwing
pairs.text: 当你说有个老朋友要来时，我真没想到会是它。——布娜拉·云翼

pairs.source: How do you not fall right through that thing? -Maztha
pairs.text: 你怎么不会穿过它的身体掉下来呢？——玛奇萨

pairs.source: Blazing Drakes exhibit a boundless passion for life, and are considered by many to be among the most loyal mounts on Azeroth.
pairs.text: 炽炎幼龙展现出了对生活的无限热情，并被许多人认为是艾泽拉斯最忠诚的坐骑之一。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r源质碎片|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r巨龙之魂

pairs.source: Whatever dark magic once compelled the Twilight Harbinger is now broken... or is it?
pairs.text: 曾经驱使暮光先驱者的黑暗魔法已经被打破了……真的吗？

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Achievement: |rGlory of the Dragon Soul Raider|n|cFFFFD200Category: |rDungeons & Raids
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200成就：|r巨龙之魂团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: Alexstrasza, the former dragon Aspect of Life, is known to be a kind and patient mentor. Under her tutelage, only the most dedicated pupils acquire the title of "Life-Binder's Handmaiden."
pairs.text: 前生命守护巨龙阿莱克斯塔萨是一位以和蔼耐心著称的导师。在她的指导下，只有最专心的学生才能获得“生命缚誓者的仆从”的称号。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r源质碎片|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r巨龙之魂|n|n

pairs.source: Some believe Experiment 12-B is the result of a covert SI-7 initiative, others consider it the outcome of embyronic tinkering by goblin scientists. No matter the case, this much is certain: given its strength, speed and agility, Experiment 12-B was a success!
pairs.text: 有些人认为实验体12-B是由军情七处首创的，其他人则认为它是某个地精科学家的实验品。无论如何，有一点是肯定的：按照它的力量、速度和敏捷水平来看，实验体12-B非常成功！

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Lesser Cache of the Aspects|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Dragon Soul|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r守护巨龙的小型宝箱|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r巨龙之魂|n

pairs.source: You are Azeroth's true guardians and the future of this world is in your hands, for the dawning of the age of mortals has begun. - Alexstrasza
pairs.text: 你是艾泽拉斯真正的守护者，这个世界的未来就在你的手中，因为凡人的纪元已经开启了。——阿莱克斯塔萨

pairs.source: Fighting the Burning Legion millennia ago, this valiant drake fell to corruption after its body was infused with raw demonic magic.
pairs.text: 这头英勇的幼龙在数千年前曾与燃烧军团战斗过，但在被灌注了纯粹的恶魔魔力后被腐蚀了。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾

pairs.source: Jade Cloud Serpents are light and agile; quick and deadly.
pairs.text: 翠绿云端翔龙轻盈而灵巧，迅捷且致命。

pairs.source: "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?" -Nat Pagle
pairs.text: “虫子通常都是被当做鱼饵的，可当你看着它的眼睛，你又怎么能忍心呢？”——纳特·帕格
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r纳特·帕格|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r卡桑琅丛林|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r垂钓翁 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: This "mount," awarded by the Lorewalkers of Pandaria, is a reward to the hero of their organization.
pairs.text: 这头来自潘达利亚游学者的“坐骑”是奖励给他们组织中的英雄的。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r熊猫人特使|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r潘达利亚

pairs.source: Trade Prince Gallywix recently ordered dozens of these glittering jewel-encrusted mounts to roam the grounds of his pleasure palace.
pairs.text: 贸易大王加里维克斯最近订购了一大批这种珠光宝气的坐骑，并让它们在他的欢乐宫里奔跑。

pairs.source: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.
pairs.text: 由于强大的负重能力和稳健的步伐，这些健壮的野兽成为了大部分本地熊猫人的首选坐骑。

pairs.text: “配置全面升级；配备双雾灯，应急酒桶和超级舒适的太极皮革座椅。”——乌龟大师吴玳

pairs.source: Formed by Ragnaros himself as a gift for the daughter he never had.
pairs.text: 由拉格纳罗斯亲手制造的礼物，准备送给他并不存在的女儿。

pairs.source: When you can't run, you crawl, and when you can't crawl you find someone to carry you.
pairs.text: 在不能奔跑时，你可以爬，如果连爬都爬不动了，你还能让坐骑驮着你。

pairs.source: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.
pairs.text: 传说某位古代熊猫人皇帝在他的一个儿子病死之后，为他幸存的双胞胎兄弟打造了第一头宝石猎豹。

pairs.source: These beasts of burden are known to carry over five times their own weight and to be capable of lasting several days without food or water.
pairs.text: 这些驮兽以能够驮动相当于自身重量五倍的东西，且能在没有食物和水的情况下生存数天而著称。

pairs.text: 经过驯养，骑乘牦牛比它们的同类更加苗条和敏捷。

pairs.source: The Klaxxi ride massive scorpions into battle against their enemies.  A carapace hardened by amber provides superior protection while on the battlefield.
pairs.text: 卡拉克西螳螂妖会骑着这种巨型蝎子与敌人作战。经琥珀硬化的甲壳能在战场上提供超强的防御力。

pairs.source: Azure Cloud Serpents are believed by the Pandaren to be harbingers of good fortune.
pairs.text: 熊猫人相信碧蓝云端翔龙是好运的使者。

pairs.source: Golden Cloud Serpents are a treasure to be enjoyed by all who visit the continent of Pandaria.
pairs.text: 金色云端翔龙是所有拜访过潘达利亚大陆的人珍爱的宝贝。

pairs.source: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.
pairs.text: 从幼年时起，雷霆云端翔龙就非常迷恋暴风雨。它们因为会在漆黑翻滚的云层中追逐闪电，沐浴滂沱的大雨而著称。

pairs.source: Heroes who proved their might in the gladiatorial arenas during the Cataclysm were awarded the most exceptional of the twilight drake broods.
pairs.text: 只有在大灾变期间的角斗场中证明过自己力量的英雄们才能获得这种极其稀有的暮光幼龙。

pairs.source: Favorite pets of the ancient Mogu princes, Quilen make loyal and fearless companions and mounts.
pairs.text: 作为古代魔古亲王最钟爱的宠物，魁麟是忠诚无畏的伙伴和坐骑。

pairs.source: When Kyparite is depleted of its amber essence it becomes fairly resistant to the corrosion from rocket fuel.
pairs.text: 当凯帕铀的琥珀精华衰变时，它对火箭燃料的腐蚀性会有相当强的抵抗能力。

pairs.source: This rocket was originally designed to speed up the rotation of the world making for shorter nights.  Gnomes with insomnia can have lofty goals.
pairs.text: 这架火箭原本是用来加速世界旋转，使夜晚缩短的。有失眠症的侏儒也能有崇高的理想。

pairs.source: Onyx Cloud serpents are known to be more aggressive and daring than their cousins, the Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents.
pairs.text: 玛瑙云端翔龙以比其近亲——神圣玛瑙云端翔龙更大胆、更富有攻击性而著称。

pairs.source: Crimson Cloud Serpents are given to flights of fancy,"" striking out on a whim for seemingly random journeys, sometimes for days at a time."
pairs.text: 猩红云端翔龙总是沉溺于飞行的快乐，经常一时兴起就漫无目的地飞出去闲逛，有时一逛就是一整天。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r《熊猫人之谜》英雄的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents are born with violet scales covering the entirety of their body. Over time, these scales darken to the color of onyx.
pairs.text: 神圣玛瑙云端翔龙出生时，全身都覆盖着紫色的鳞片。随着时间的推移，这些鳞片会逐渐变成黑玛瑙般的颜色。

pairs.source: Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpents are considered to be among the noblest of dragons.
pairs.text: 神圣猩红云端翔龙被认为是最高贵的巨龙之一。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r潘达利亚团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: Warmth and hope emanate from this great creature, which glows like a sunrise over the mountains.
pairs.text: 这头威严的生物散发着温暖和希望，就像山巅的日出一样闪闪发光。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r织雾者顾严|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r永恒岛|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r皇帝少昊 - 崇拜

pairs.source: Warmth and wisdom emanate from this great creature, which glows like moonlight passing through the finest jade.
pairs.text: 这头威严的生物散发着温暖和智慧，就像照透最精美的碧玉的月光一样闪闪发光。

pairs.source: Warmth and serenity emanate from this great creature, which glows like the cloudless sky of a summer afternoon.
pairs.text: 这头威严的生物散发着温暖和宁静，就像夏日午后晴朗的天空。

pairs.source: It is believed that Astral Cloud Serpents possess answers to some of life's greatest mysteries. Pity they can't talk.
pairs.text: 据信，星光云端翔龙掌握着生命的最大秘密。可惜它们不能说话。

pairs.source: The majestic crane is a treasured friend of the pandaren.
pairs.text: 威严的仙鹤是熊猫人的宝贵朋友。

pairs.source: Trained from a young age, these massive kushan are taught to thunder into battle carrying a full saurok warband.
pairs.text: 这些穆山兽从小接受训练，能够载着一整支蜥蜴人战团冲向战场。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Galleon|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Valley of the Four Winds|n
This token of honor is a gift from the Lorewalkers of Pandaria. Flying manual seemingly not included, however.
pairs.text: 这个荣誉的象征是潘达利亚的游学者送出的礼物。但里面似乎没有飞行手册。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r熊猫人特使|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r潘达利亚

pairs.source: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.
pairs.text: 从幼年时起，雷霆云端翔龙就非常迷恋暴风雨。它们因为会在漆黑翻滚的云层中追逐闪电，沐浴滂沱的大雨而著称。

pairs.source: Both the name and color of this majestic phoenix are believed to symbolize rebirth.
pairs.text: 这头威严的凤凰的名字和色彩都被认为是浴火重生的象征。

pairs.source: The colors of this rare phoenix's plumage are said to bring great fortune.
pairs.text: 这是一头罕见的凤凰，它的羽毛颜色据说能带来好运。

pairs.source: The Violet Phoenix's plumage is said to symbolize a union of opposing forces.
pairs.text: 蓝紫凤凰的羽毛据说是与仇敌化干戈为玉帛的象征。

pairs.source: The residents of Pandaria salute your enthusiasm for wildlife preservation. They do have concerns about housing 150 animals per visit, though.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚的居民非常赞赏你保护野生动物的热情。但他们对你每次都带着150头动物一同出行的做法还是有些顾虑。

pairs.source: A glorious feat of engineering, the sky golem takes traditional shredder technology to a whole new level (and altitude!).
pairs.text: 作为工程学的辉煌成就，飞天魔像将切割机技术提升到了新的水平（还有高度！）。

pairs.source: One of Pandaria's most elusive creatures, said to bring good fortune to its rider.
pairs.text: 潘达利亚最神秘的生物之一，据说能给它的骑手带来好运。

pairs.source: This noble gryphon is as staunch a battle companion as any member of the Alliance could ask for.
pairs.text: 这头高贵的狮鹫是任何联盟成员梦寐以求的忠诚战友。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r特工马尔利|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r卡桑琅丛林|n|cFFFFD200声望：|r神盾守备军-崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: This ferocious beast, renowned among wyvern handlers, was one of the first mounts chosen to take part in the Horde's Dominance Offensive.
pairs.text: 这种凶猛的野兽在双足飞龙驯兽师中大名鼎鼎，是部落统御先锋军的首选坐骑。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r撕咬者古卡纳|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r卡桑琅丛林|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r统御先锋军 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r2000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Gryphons' keen eyesight allows them to see over vast distances and warn their riders of any dangers that lie ahead.
pairs.text: 狮鹫锐利的眼睛能让它们看清遥远的地方，并将前面的险情提前通报给它们的骑士。

pairs.source: Wyverns hail from some of the most inhospitable regions of Kalimdor, making them masters of adapting to any environment.
pairs.text: 双足飞龙产自卡利姆多环境最严酷的地区，这使它们能够适应任何环境。

pairs.source: Only those heroic souls who surmount every challenge the mogu tyrants place before them can proudly fly the skies on a war-prepared skyscreamer.
pairs.text: 只有那些战胜了魔古暴君摆在其面前的所有挑战的英勇灵魂，才能骑着无畏的啸天龙骄傲地翱翔于天际。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r雷电团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: When you see a hurricane coming, you get out of the way. Horridon would fight the hurricane and win.
pairs.text: 当看到飓风逼近时，你只需要让开路。赫利东会迎战飓风并赢得胜利的。

pairs.source: Not all of Medivh's victims are gone for good.
pairs.text: 并非麦迪文的所有受害者都得到了安息。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r兰德鲁·郎绍特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r藏宝海湾|n

pairs.source: "When ya fight alongside raptors, ya want a mount dey can't eat." -Unknown dinomancer
pairs.text: “在与迅猛龙并肩作战时，你需要一匹不会被它们吃掉的坐骑。”——某恐龙统领

pairs.source: There is an old Zandalari saying about wild direhorns: "Run!"
pairs.text: 有一句关于野生恐角龙的赞达拉谚语说的好：“快跑！”

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop: |rZandalari Warbringer|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rDread Wastes, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r赞达拉战争使者|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r恐惧废土、昆莱山、螳螂高原、四风谷

pairs.source: The masks aren't to control the direhorn; they are so no one sees your face when it turns on you.
pairs.text: 这些面具不是用来控制恐角龙的；它们是为了不让你在它转过来时看见你的脸。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop: |rZandalari Warbringer|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rDread Wastes, Krasarang Wilds, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r赞达拉战争使者|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r恐惧废土、卡桑琅丛林、昆莱山、螳螂高原、四风谷

pairs.source: The festive coloring belies deadly intent.
pairs.text: 喜庆的颜色掩盖了它致命的凶性。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop: |rZandalari Warbringer|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rDread Wastes, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r赞达拉战争使者|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r恐惧废土、昆莱山、螳螂高原、四风谷

pairs.source: "They are lethal at eight months, very lethal." -Hemet Nesingwary Jr.
pairs.text: “它们在8个月时会很危险，非常危险。”——赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Quest: |rA Mountain of Giant Dinosaur Bones|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rIsle of Giants
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200任务：|r堆积如山的巨型恐龙骨头|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r巨兽岛

pairs.source: Raptors have spread to nearly all of the lands of Azeroth. It is uncertain whether the trolls led them or followed them.
pairs.text: 迅猛龙几乎遍布整个艾泽拉斯大陆。只是不清楚究竟是巨魔带领了它们还是它们带领了巨魔。

pairs.source: Speed, cunning, and ferocity are the things trolls and raptors admire about each other.
pairs.text: 迅捷、狡诈和凶猛，这就是巨魔和迅猛龙彼此最为欣赏的品质。

pairs.source: "Raptors are as loyal as they are vicious. If you ain't friend, you are food." -Kijara
pairs.text: “迅猛龙虽然邪恶，但也非常忠诚。如果你不是它的朋友，那就是它的食物。”——基加拉

pairs.source: These cloud serpents have scales that... are the color of clouds, actually.
pairs.text: 这些云端翔龙的鳞片呈现出了……名符其实的、云朵般的色泽。

pairs.source: This is a descendant of the irascible Nalak. Lightning erupts from its scales and arcs over the saddle. Dare you sit?
pairs.text: 它是暴躁的纳拉克的子嗣。闪电从它的鳞片上喷薄而出，在鞍座上跳动。你敢坐吗？

pairs.source: Although Ji-Kun feasted on the failed creations of mogu flesh-shapers, her progeny is willing to eat more pedestrian carcasses.
pairs.text: 虽然季鹍以魔古血肉塑造者的失败造物为食，她的子嗣却喜欢吃更加普通的尸体。

pairs.source: This monstrous, flesh-eating bat is the undisputed ruler of the night skies.
pairs.text: 这头巨大的食肉蝙蝠是夜空下无可辩驳的统治者。

pairs.source: Sharp at both ends and crafty in the middle. Leave it to the trolls to think this was a good idea.
pairs.text: 牙尖爪利，性情狡诈。最好还是把它们留给巨魔们去琢磨吧。

pairs.source: Leave it to the blood elves to pick the red one.
pairs.text: 把红色的都留给血精灵吧。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r瓦萨林·赤晨|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r雷神岛|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r夺日者先锋军 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r3000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Each step echoes with the rage of your three opponents.
pairs.text: 每走一步都回响着你那三位对手的怒火。

pairs.source: This rare breed of dragonhawk is a mark of honor in the Horde, gifted by the blood elves. It reflects your tireless effort to amass a small army of mounts.
pairs.text: 这种稀有的龙鹰是部落荣耀的象征，由血精灵赠与。它体现了你召集一小支坐骑部队的不懈努力。

pairs.source: After you amassed a massive menagerie of 200 mounts, the animal authorities of the Alliance sent you a means to keep them in line (and out of their hair).
pairs.text: 在你收集满200头坐骑后，联盟的动物学权威们给你送来了管理这些动物（并使它们不受干扰）的好帮手。

pairs.source: For years pandaren believed these creatures to be untamable. Just ask the first pandaren to do so, Henshi "Limp Along" Homebrew.
pairs.text: 多年来，熊猫人一直认为这些动物是无法驯服的。你只要问问第一个这么做的熊猫人“跛子”恒石·家酿就知道了。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r保尔·诺斯|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r搏击竞技场|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1500|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: This majestic creature is Brightwing's older brother. He affirms that she was, in fact, adopted.
pairs.text: 这只威严的生物是光明之翼的哥哥。事实上，他断言她是收养来的。

pairs.source: Its ethereal spirit is barely contained by its iron shell. The penultimate creation of Salanar the Horseman, these powerful steeds were once thought to have all been destroyed.
pairs.text: 它的钢铁外壳几乎包裹不住它缥缈的灵魂。作为骑手萨拉纳尔的倒数第二代产品，人们原以为这些强大的战马已经全部被摧毁了。
|cFFFFD200世界事件：|r时空漫游|n|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r奥金|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r达拉然

pairs.source: The blades adorning this mount's armor are designed to both inspire fear and pre-slice meals for the warsaber.
pairs.text: 这头坐骑装甲上的利刃不仅能引发敌人的恐惧，还能帮作战刃豹把肉预先切好。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r通灵领主赛普|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风城|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\ICONS\ACHIEVEMENT_BG_KILL_ON_MOUNT.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Only rewarded to those who have bested their foes in battle.
pairs.text: 只奖励给那些在战斗中战胜敌人的勇士。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r亡灵卫兵奈萨里安|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r奥格瑞玛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\ICONS\ACHIEVEMENT_BG_KILL_ON_MOUNT.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: This formidable creature's lineage may be traced to Galakras, and yet further to Galakrond, one of the most infamous of all proto-dragons.
pairs.text: 这种强大生物的血统或许可以追溯到迦拉卡斯，甚至是迦拉克隆那头最为臭名昭著的始祖龙。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r奥格瑞玛破城者的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r地下城与团队

pairs.source: The Kor'kron use only the mightiest wolves for their mounts, bedecking them in armor that would break the backs of lesser creatures.
pairs.text: 库卡隆只挑选最强大的狼作为他们的坐骑，并给它们装上足以压垮软弱生物的装甲。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Achievement: |rAhead of the Curve: Garrosh Hellscream (10/25 player)|n|cFFFFD200Category: |rFeats of Strength
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200成就：|r引领潮流：加尔鲁什（10人/25人）|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r光辉事迹

pairs.source: The Kor'kron Juggernaut is a weapon of unbridled destruction, born from the mind of Garrosh Hellscream and made real by his engineers.
pairs.text: 库卡隆战蝎来自加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的创意，由他的工程师制造，是一种难以驾驭的毁灭武器。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r决战奥格瑞玛

pairs.source: Some people say that riding an ashhide mushan will result in favorable health and increased prosperity. These people are called "mount vendors."
pairs.text: 有人说骑上灰皮穆山兽能给你带来健康和财富。这些人被称为“坐骑商人”。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r发言人古兰|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r永恒岛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r500|TINTERFACE\ICONS\TimelessCoin-Bloody.blp:0|t

pairs.source: This ebony cloud serpent is a lightning-wreathed vision of such rarity as to have driven many mortals to madness.
pairs.text: 这种漆黑的云端翔龙浑身闪电环绕。它是如此稀有，足以让许多凡人为之疯狂。

pairs.source: These cloud serpents always look elegant and slim in classic black.
pairs.text: 这些经典的黑色云端祥龙看起来优雅而苗条。

pairs.source: These brilliantly colored cloud serpents have scales that are a mixture of ruby, gold, and nearly violet.
pairs.text: 这些色彩艳丽的云端翔龙的鳞片上混杂了鲜红、金黄和紫红三种颜色。

pairs.source: These brilliantly colored cloud serpents have scales that range from gold to pink. Or we could call it coral.
pairs.text: 这些色彩艳丽的云端翔龙的鳞片从金色一直过渡到粉红色。或许我们能称它为珊瑚色。

pairs.source: These majestic animals come in various colorings, but the emerald variety can only be tamed by the magic of friendship.
pairs.text: 这些威严的动物有许多颜色，但翠绿色的这种只能被友谊的魔力所驯服。

pairs.source: Iron Horde beastmasters bred this rylak for war and then girded it for battle in black steel and smoldering flame.
pairs.text: 钢铁部落的兽王将这头双头飞龙培养成战争机器，并用黑色钢铁和阴燃的烈焰武装了它。

pairs.source: A nightmarish steed of hardened steel and vengeful spirits, this companion will follow you to the depths of the Firelands and back without complaint.
pairs.text: 由淬火的钢铁和复仇的灵魂锻造成的梦魇兽，它能无怨无悔地陪伴你出入火焰之地。

pairs.source: The difference between a smile and a grin is the difference between a kiss and tasting.
pairs.text: 微笑和狞笑的差别类似于亲吻和品尝的差别。

pairs.source: Filled with the hatred of an ancient god, the dread raven are the Arakkoa's most trusted guardians.
pairs.text: 恐惧渡鸦的内心充满了一位上古神灵的恨意，它们是鸦人最信赖的守护者。

pairs.source: Can't fly, but can creep very quickly.
|cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Boldly, You Sought the Power of Ragnaros|n|cFFFFD200Category:|r Feats of Strength
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200成就：|r愚蠢地追寻拉格纳罗斯的力量|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r光辉事迹

pairs.source: Once "befriended", a gronnling will happily carry its rider to their death.
pairs.text: 只要“交上朋友”，小戈隆就会很乐意载着它的骑手冲向死亡。

pairs.source: Tiny notches cover the hooves of this variation of clefthoof, allowing it to safely scale mountainous regions in search of food.
pairs.text: 这种变种的裂蹄牛蹄子上布满细小的缺口，使它能够安全地翻山越岭寻找食物。

|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r商人阿兰达|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r坠落之月|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r20000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t|n|n|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r商人达拉克|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r霜寒晶壁|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r20000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: It wasn't until you owned this mount that you understood how much the world of Draenor would test you. Clefthoof hair gets in everything!
pairs.text: 在拥有这头坐骑后，你才明白了德拉诺世界对你的考验会有多么严酷。裂蹄牛的毛发简直无孔不入！

pairs.source: A translucent layer of down hair covers this breed's leathery hide, acting as the perfect insulation for cold environments.
pairs.text: 这种牛的外皮上覆盖着一层透明的绒毛，可以很好地隔绝寒冷的环境。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Tanaan Jungle|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r维金斯、德斯塔隆、泰罗菲斯特、杜姆罗勒|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r塔纳安丛林|n

pairs.source: Members of the Warsong clan have long hunted these clefthoof to use their crimson-hued skin for battle standards.
pairs.text: 战歌氏族的成员长年猎杀这些裂蹄牛，用它们猩红色的皮做成战旗。

pairs.source: Blackhand is said to have personally designed the fiery armaments used on the Iron Horde's clefthoof battle mounts.
pairs.text: 据说，钢铁部落的作战裂蹄牛身上那些喷火的装甲都是黑手亲自设计的。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r黑手|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r黑石铸造厂（史诗难度）

pairs.source: The elekk's long trunk allows it to sniff out sources of food, avoid danger, and steal snacks from your bags when you're not looking.
pairs.text: 雷象长长的鼻子可以让它嗅出食物的位置、躲避危险以及在你不注意时从你的背包里偷东西吃。

pairs.source: The draenei perfected elekk husbandry long ago, adorning the creatures with Light-infused crystals to make them more docile.
pairs.text: 德莱尼很久之前就完善了雷象的养殖方法。为这些生物戴上灌注了圣光的水晶可以让它们更加温顺。

pairs.source: Some legends say the draenei first befriended the elekk after one of the beasts saved an injured scout from a pack of vicious podlings.
pairs.text: 根据一些传说，有只雷象从一群邪恶的魔荚人手中救出了一位受伤的斥候。后来，德莱尼才跟这些生物成为了朋友。

pairs.source: Ever since acquiring this mount, you have been plagued by strange fever dreams of hippety-hoppety clippety-cloppety elekk on parade.
pairs.text: 自从获得这种坐骑后，你就经常做一个奇怪的梦，梦见一头蹦蹦跳跳的雷象在路上啪嗒啪嗒地走着。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Vindicator Nuurem|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Council of Exarchs - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Stormshield|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r守备官努瑞姆|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r主教议会 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风之盾|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: It is said an elekk never forgets. No wonder it despises the Iron Horde, considering the torment the orcs put the beast through.
pairs.text: 据说雷象过目不忘。考虑到那些兽人对这头野兽带来的折磨，难怪它那么讨厌钢铁部落。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r |n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Sha'tari Defense - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Garrison Trading Post|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Refuses to run unless its head is covered in heavy, spiked metal. It's an ego thing.
pairs.text: 这是一种骄傲的生物，除非用沉重且布满尖刺的金属头盔遮住它的脑袋，否则它是不会奔跑的。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Guild Glory of the Draenor Raider|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200成就：|r德拉诺公会团队的荣耀|n

pairs.source: It's not the metal helmet that attracts mates; it's the sweet mohawk.
pairs.text: 吸引配偶的不是那个金属头盔，而是它可爱的莫西干头。

|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r商人阿兰达|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r坠落之月|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r10000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t|n|n|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r商人达拉克|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r霜寒晶壁|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r10000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Subsists almost entirely on a diet of frozen berries. Though it finds slow off-worlders equally tasty.
pairs.text: 几乎完全以一种冰冻浆果为食。但它发现某些迟钝的异界人也同样美味。

pairs.source: Never... ever... EVER... let it smell bacon on you.
pairs.text: 绝对、绝对、绝对不要让它闻到你身上有培根的味道。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Tanaan Jungle|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r维金斯、德斯塔隆、泰罗菲斯特、杜姆罗勒|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r塔纳安丛林|n

pairs.source: If it didn't have the cool tusk ring, it would feel so silly in that outfit.
pairs.text: 它没有戴超酷的牙环，因为那样看起来很蠢。

pairs.source: If you want a gentle ride, go find a "tame happytusk" or something.
pairs.text: 如果你想要一头温顺的坐骑，就去找一头”家养乐牙猪“之类的东西吧。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r行者兹坦加|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r塔纳安丛林|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r刃牙追猎者 - 尊敬|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1000|TInterface\ICONS\INV_misc_blacksaberonfang.blp:0|t

pairs.source: "Domesticated" does not mean "friendly." Bring some treats.
pairs.text: “驯养”并不意味着“友善”。记得带点零食来。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Gazrix Gearlock / Mimi Wizzlebub|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Steamwheedle "Preservation" Society - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Stormshield / Warspear|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r加兹瑞克斯·轮锁/米米·响泡|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r热砂保护协会 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风之盾/战争之矛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t|n

pairs.source: Its snout is not just cold but wet. Not a pleasant way to wake up.
pairs.text: 它的长嘴不但冷，而且还潮湿，绝对不是什么叫人起床的好选择。

pairs.source: Sheds its tusks once a year. Is extremely shy until they grow back.
pairs.text: 它每年换一次牙。在长出新牙之前，它会非常羞于见人。

pairs.source: Thoroughly trained in how to snort, trot, and stomp on the faces of its enemies.
pairs.text: 经过严格的训练，知道怎么奔跑、践踏以及喷敌人一脸。

pairs.source: Riverwallows are one of the heartiest beasts on Draenor, resulting in their increased stamina and distinctive coloring.
pairs.text: 由于有着过人的耐力和巧妙的保护色，淡水兽是德拉诺最兴旺的族群之一。

pairs.source: This animal's color mimics the clear blue of Draenor's river shallows, making it almost invisible to aquatic predators.
pairs.text: 这种动物的颜色很像德拉诺浅蓝色的河湾，这使得水中的掠食者几乎看不见它。

pairs.source: Special webbing that grows on the soles of the mudback's feet gives them extra traction in mud and slick terrain.
pairs.text: 泥背淡水兽的脚底长着一层特殊的蹼，可以让它们在泥泞的环境中如履平地。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Garrison Mission:|r It's a Boat, It's a Plane, It's... Just a Riverbeast.|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200要塞任务：|r船，飞机……原来是淡水兽|n

pairs.source: Aggressive and territorial, the mosshide is known for hiding in river-shore scrub and ambushing unwary passersby.
pairs.text: 富有攻击性且领地观念极强的苔皮淡水兽会躲在河边的灌木丛中，伏击毫无准备的路人。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Dawn-Seeker Krek / Dawn-Seeker Alkset|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Stormshield / Warspear|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 50,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r觅晨者科雷克/觅晨者阿克赛特|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风之盾/战争之矛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r50,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: From the bowels of the nether is summoned a creature of pure hatred, bent on burning down any life in its way.
pairs.text: 从虚空深处召唤出的生物，纯粹的仇恨化身，力求焚毁其所到之处的一切生命。
|cFFFFD200掉落：|r古尔丹（史诗难度）|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暗夜要塞

pairs.source: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of the sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.
pairs.text: 看着这只神秘生物的眼睛，你就仿佛看见了太阳的中心。建议你在骑乘它时带上护目镜。

pairs.source: Draenei poets have likened this talbuk's coloring to shadows cast by moonlight in an ashen forest.
pairs.text: 德莱尼诗人喜欢把这种塔布羊的颜色比作月光照在灰色的森林上投下的阴影。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Ravenspeaker Skeega / Shadow-Sage Brakoss|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Arakkoa Outcasts - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Stormshield / Warspear|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r鸦语者斯奇加/暗影贤者巴考斯|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r鸦人流亡者 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风之盾/战争之矛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t|n

pairs.source: Draenei have relied on this mount, the swiftest of all talbuk, to relay messengers and their missives safely to their destinations.
pairs.text: 作为塔布羊中跑得最快的一种，德莱尼总是依靠这种坐骑将信使和信件安全送达目的地。

pairs.source: Prized for its intelligence, this breed of talbuk can be trained to execute defensive kicks and gorings in battle.
pairs.text: 这种塔布羊以智力高超而著称，经过训练后可以在战斗中用脚踢和角顶来保护主人。

pairs.source: These breezestriders' red coloration reflects their temperament: sanguine, fierce, and courageous.
pairs.text: 这些风蹄公羊鲜红的毛色反映了它们的性情：乐观、凶猛而且勇敢。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r达兹里安|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r沃金之矛 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r战争之矛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t|n

pairs.source: This talbuk subsists completely on a diet of thistles and thorns, making its insides as tough as its outside.
pairs.text: 这种塔布羊完全以荆棘和蓟草为食，使它的内在与外表一样坚强。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Crafticus Mindbender|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Wrynn's Vanguard - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Stormshield|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r克拉提库斯·曼比德尔|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r乌瑞恩先锋军 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风之盾|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Until it head-butts you below the belt, it has not truly accepted you as its rider.
pairs.text: 在一头撞中你的肚子之前，它是不会真正接受你这个骑手的。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r通灵领主赛普|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风城|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\ICONS\ACHIEVEMENT_BG_KILL_ON_MOUNT.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Because sharp teeth and claws weren't enough.
pairs.text: 因为尖牙和利爪还不够。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r亡灵卫兵奈萨里安|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r奥格瑞玛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r1|TINTERFACE\ICONS\ACHIEVEMENT_BG_KILL_ON_MOUNT.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: A trainer once tried to put decorative metal in his steelmaw wolf's mouth. He had to wait three days to get it back.
pairs.text: 一位训练师曾试图在他的钢喉狼嘴里装上装饰金属。结果他等了三天才拿回来。

pairs.source: Has a will of iron but is a sweetheart if you give it a clefthoof bone to chew on.
pairs.text: 有着钢铁般的意志，但只要给它一根裂蹄牛骨头，它就会死心塌地的跟着你了。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Tanaan Jungle|n
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200掉落：|r维金斯、德斯塔隆、泰罗菲斯特、杜姆罗勒|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r塔纳安丛林|n

pairs.source: It's trained to survive the harsh climate of Frostfire Ridge, so it snuggles as if its life depended on it.
pairs.text: 它训练有素，可以在霜火岭严酷的气候下生存。所以它会蜷缩起来，这是它生存的秘诀。

pairs.source: It has an armored spike on its tail. Scratch its belly at your own risk.
pairs.text: 它的尾巴上有装甲尖刺。给它挠肚皮的后果自负。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Kil'rip|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Laughing Skull - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Horde Garrison Trading Post|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r基尔里普|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r嘲颅兽人 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r部落要塞货栈|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Enormously cute as a puppy. Slightly less so now.
pairs.text: 小时候超级可爱。现在没那么可爱了。

pairs.source: Amidst the cold heights of Frostfire, the frostwolves hunt anything they can catch. The fastest among them eat well.
pairs.text: 在霜火岭寒冷的高原上，霜狼会捕猎它们能捉到的一切猎物。最迅捷的狼才能饱餐一顿。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Vendor:|r Beska Redtusk|n|cFFFFD200Faction:|r Frostwolf Orcs - Exalted|n|cFFFFD200Location:|r Warspear|n|cFFFFD200Cost:|r 5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t
pairs.text: |cFFFFD200商人出售：|r贝斯卡·赤牙|n|cFFFFD200阵营：|r霜狼兽人 - 崇拜|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r战争之矛|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r5,000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t + 5,000|Tinterface\icons\inv_apexis_draenor.blp:0|t

pairs.source: Believed to reside mostly in the north. Hates weddings.
pairs.text: 据说它们大部分居住在北方，最讨厌婚礼。

pairs.source: Cautious by direwolf standards, the dustmane can only be coaxed to ride with something it considers special.
pairs.text: 作为一种十分机警的恐狼，灰鬃恐狼只会让那些它认为特别的人骑上自己。

pairs.source: Often referred to as the "Goblin Lawn Mower", this growling behemoth treats enemies like they are made of grass... ready to be mown down.
pairs.text: 这头吼声震天的巨兽常被戏称为“地精割草机”。它能像割草一样碾压敌人……准备被它收割吧。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r督军的死亡之轮|n|cFFFFD200分类：|r光辉事迹

pairs.source: Forged by human, gnome, and dwarf, this armored masterpiece is designed to slice a tauren into a tri-tip dinner with a flick of the handlebars.
pairs.text: 这件装甲杰作由人类，侏儒和矮人精心打造而成，只要轻轻一转把手，它就能将牛头人切成三角牛排。
|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r保利|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r暴风城，旧城区|n|cFFFFD200价格：|r100000|TINTERFACE\MONEYFRAME\UI-GOLDICON.BLP:0|t

pairs.source: Thankfully they move fast and mostly leave the smell behind them.
pairs.text: 幸亏它们跑得够快，可以把自己的臭味甩在身后。

pairs.source: Loves the sun, hates everything else.
pairs.text: 喜欢太阳，讨厌其他一切事物。

pairs.source: These sleek foxes can prowl amongst newly-fallen leaves without making a sound, even at this size.
pairs.text: 即使体型如此庞大，这些体型优美矫健的狐狸仍然可以在新落下的树叶上悄无声息地跑过。
|cFFFFD200任务：|r狡猾的沃平|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r苏拉玛|n

pairs.source: The garn are the most fierce predators on Draenor, and always hunt in packs.
pairs.text: 铁颚狼是德拉诺最凶猛的掠食者，而且它们在狩猎时总是成群结队地行动。

pairs.source: Its long, serrated limbs drip with the blood of its enemies and/or mate.
pairs.text: 它那带着倒钩的修长节肢上，还滴着它的敌人以及配偶的鲜血。

pairs.source: "Is the emerald drake rare?  You have no idea.  If I had a silver for every time someone asked me about one, I could have retired years ago." --Mei Francis
pairs.text: “翡翠幼龙稀有吗？你信不信，如果我向每个问我这个问题的人收一个银币的话，我几年前就可以退休了。”——梅尔·弗兰希斯

pairs.source: Why drive yourself around when you can hire someone to do it for you?
pairs.text: 既然可以雇人，干嘛还要自己开车呢？
运输是一个高精尖的行业。
代驾型机械师的摩托车

pairs.source: Corrupted by the presence of the Dark Star in Draenor, the Voidtalons resisted being broken by the Shadowmoon Clan and were ultimately destroyed by Ner'zhul. Only a single egg remains, lost in the void.
pairs.text: 被德拉诺的黑暗之星腐蚀的灵爪飞鹰因为抵抗影月氏族的驯养而被耐奥祖彻底灭绝。只有一枚鸟蛋留存了下来，失落在虚空之中。

pairs.source: Infused with arcane power, the Mystic Runesaber has long been hidden by chaotic nether energies. Recently they have emerged from the shadows in search of ley lines to sate their thirst for magic.
pairs.text: 灌注了魔法能量的秘魔刃豹已在混沌的虚空能量下潜伏多年。最近，它们才从阴影中现身，搜索魔网以满足自己对魔力的渴望。

pairs.source: Forged deep within Hellfire Citadel by a mad blacksmith, the Felsteel Annihilator combines the metalworking knowledge of the Iron Horde with the chaotic fel energies of the Burning Legion into an unholy union of steel and flame.
pairs.text: 魔钢歼灭者由地狱火堡垒深处的疯狂铁匠打造，将钢铁部落的冶炼技术与燃烧军团的混沌邪能完美结合而产生的、铁与火的邪恶产物。

pairs.source: Bathed in the blood of demons, these corrupted Dread Ravens are significantly more aggressive, and will often kill one another if kept in confinement.
pairs.text: 这些沐浴过恶魔之血的堕落恐惧渡鸦极具攻击性，如果被关在一起的话，还经常会自相残杀。

pairs.source: The spiked ball on the tail is strong enough to crush through even the most reinforced Alliance defenses.
pairs.text: 尾巴上长满尖刺的球足以砸碎最坚固的联盟工事。

pairs.source: A mighty wolf of Draenor, touched by the fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan in Tanaan Jungle. It has not gone completely mad... yet.
pairs.text: 一头强大的德拉诺恶狼，在塔纳安丛林中被古尔丹释放出的邪能感染。它还没完全疯掉……暂时没有。

pairs.source: One of the gronnlings of Tanaan Jungle caught in the eruption of fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan, and now beholden to an unquenchable lust for chaos.
pairs.text: 生活在塔纳安丛林的一头小戈隆，遭遇古尔丹造成的邪能爆发，现在心中充满了对混沌无法遏制的渴望。

pairs.source: This little gronnling is well-known for smashing his way into garrison inns and making a mess of the pots and pans.
pairs.text: 这只小戈隆因为一路乱拳打入要塞旅店，将那里弄得杯盘狼藉而出名。

pairs.source: The Illidari have broken some lesser demons for use against their Legion masters.
pairs.text: 伊利达雷驯服了一些低级恶魔，用它们来对付他们的燃烧军团主子。

pairs.source: These magical companions are the wardens of peaceful, primordial groves within the Emerald Dream.
pairs.text: 这些魔法小伙伴是翡翠梦境内祥和的原始丛林中的守护者。
|cFFFFD200任务：|r黑暗之水|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r月光林地

pairs.source: The one and only source for the rare culinary ingredient: cursed bacon.
pairs.text: 它也是稀有烹饪原料诅咒培根的唯一来源。
