pairs.source: Redeemed by the Light. Devoted to your cause.
pairs.text: 无怨无悔的献身，必将得到圣光的救赎。

pairs.source: Veterans of the battle for Outland's Hellfire Penninsula are traumatized by thoughts of these beasts to this day.
pairs.text: 这些野兽至今仍是那些曾在外域经历过地狱火半岛之战的老兵们心中的噩梦。

pairs.source: No one quite knows when the legend of Grumpus began in Draenor, but his toys are just the worst.
pairs.text: 没有人确切知道格噜普斯的传说是何时出现在德拉诺的，但他的玩具永远是最糟糕的。

pairs.source: The extra-light equipment on this chromatic rylak allows it to swoop and glide through the clouds easily, free from the bounds of the land below.
pairs.text: 这头五彩缤纷的双头飞龙身上极其轻便的装备使它能够轻松地在云层中穿梭滑翔，不受大地的束缚。

pairs.source: The Grove Wardens of the Emerald Dream were some of the first to fall to the corrupting influence of the Nightmare.
pairs.text: 翡翠梦境的林地守护者最先在梦魇的腐化影响中堕落。
|cFFFFD200成就：|r《军团再临》团队的荣耀|n|cFFFFD200分类： |r地下城与团队

pairs.source: Armored to withstand collisions in battle.
pairs.text: 披着装甲，可抵御战斗中的冲撞。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Free For All, More For Me|n
Even the dead need a lift every now and then.
pairs.text: 就算是亡灵，偶尔也需要飞行。

pairs.source: Captured from the renegade blood elves at Eclipse Point, these purple dragonhawks were often sought after by Scryers posted to the Sanctum of the Stars.
pairs.text: 从日蚀岗哨的血精灵叛徒处缴获的紫色龙鹰很受驻扎在群星圣殿的占星者们的追捧。
|cFFFFD200世界事件：|r时空漫游|n|cFFFFD200商人出售：|r凯普丽|n|cFFFFD200地区：|r沙塔斯

pairs.source: The spirit of Huln Highmountain's pet moose.
pairs.text: 胡恩·高岭的驼鹿宠物之灵。

pairs.source: A special creation of Lord Illidan gifted to his most trusted demon hunters.
pairs.text: 伊利丹大人赠予他最信任的恶魔猎手的一份特殊礼物。

pairs.source: Fickle and savage, these drakes slip in and out of time until they find a worthy rider.
pairs.text: 这些喜怒无常、野性难驯的幼龙在时光的长河中来回穿梭，直到找到一位有能力的骑手为止。

pairs.source: At Warchief Hellscream's command, Horde trainers began raising wolves to thrive in the shock and ferocity of sustained combat.
pairs.text: 根据地狱咆哮酋长的命令，部落训练师们开始驯养能够适应残酷的长期战斗的座狼。

pairs.source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Free For All, More For Me|n
Redeemed by the Light. Devoted to your cause.
pairs.text: 无怨无悔的献身，必将得到圣光的救赎。

pairs.source: The Illidari were able to break one of these fiery beasts for use as an unstoppable, fearless mount against the Legion.
pairs.text: 伊利达雷能够驯服这种熊熊燃烧的野兽为自己所用，它们可以成为势不可挡，英勇无畏的坐骑，以对抗燃烧军团。

pairs.source: The sheer amount of raw red berries these fierce omnivors consume gives them their distinctive eye color.
pairs.text: 这种凶猛的草食动物需要食用大量鲜红的浆果，这也造就了它们独一无二的眼珠颜色。

pairs.source: The shimmering hides of these deceptively fierce and coordinated beasts is intended to confuse and disorient prey.
pairs.text: 这些狡诈的群居野兽闪闪发光的毛皮能够迷惑和误导猎物。

pairs.source: Capable of hiding in a fog bank until prey approaches, then slicing them open with one claw-raised jump.
pairs.text: 能够躲在雾气缭绕的河岸边直至猎物接近，然后跳起来将其一爪毙命。

pairs.source: Adept at blending into dense, magical forests, such as one may find around the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 擅长融入茂密的魔法森林，例如遍布破碎群岛的那种森林。

pairs.source: Only the sturdiest-forged chains can restrain this beast.
pairs.text: 只有最结实的铁链才能拴住这头野兽。

pairs.source: These elusive fish prefer to skulk in the deepest reaches of the Great Sea, searching the darkness for food.
pairs.text: 这些神出鬼没的鱼喜欢潜伏在无尽之海的最深处，在黑暗中觅食。

pairs.source: You are the only one that remembered.
Years of chain-chugging potions in Dalaran's sewer system have allowed him to grow large, agile, and shadow resistant.
pairs.text: 在达拉然的下水道中啜饮了多年的药水之后，它长得越来越大，跑得越来越快，对暗影的抗性也越来越高。

pairs.source: At daybreak, the noble Sunwalkers often perform rituals to bless their mounts, imbuing them with holy magic.
pairs.text: 在破晓时分，高贵的烈日行者们常常会举行仪式来祝福他们的坐骑，为它们注入神圣的魔力。

pairs.source: Only the most distinguished paladins are given the honor of riding this elekk. Its plated armor and purple adornments have been blessed by Prophet Velen himself.
pairs.text: 只有最杰出的圣骑士才能有幸骑上这头雷象。它的装甲和紫色的装饰受过先知维伦本人的祝福。

pairs.source: A loyal companion to any who would protect Silvermoon.
pairs.text: 银月城守护者们的忠实伙伴。

pairs.source: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.
pairs.text: 破碎群岛最英勇的战马之一，无论是野性还是力量在艾泽拉斯都无可匹敌。

pairs.text: 在无尽之海的饥渴裂口深处，成群的深海水母摇曳着，好似巨大的地毯漂浮在伸手不见五指的黑暗中。

pairs.source: Born, bred and battle tested in Gilneas.

pairs.text: 耶比托似乎有点用力过猛……

pairs.source: Ancient mounts of the Highborne, now left to run wild in the Broken Isles, they can rarely be found due to their latent magical powers.
pairs.text: 上层精灵的上古坐骑，如今在破碎群岛已经野化，因为它们潜藏的魔法力量，所以几乎无法被发现。

pairs.source: Once plentiful, only three seekers remain on Azeroth after generations of battling the corruption of the cosmos.
pairs.text: 在和宇宙中的腐蚀战斗了无数代之后，曾经在艾泽拉斯盛极一时的寻觅者现在只剩下三只了。

pairs.source: The child of Xuen, Ban-Lu has served each Grandmaster faithfully for many years.
pairs.text: 作为雪怒的后代，班禄已经忠心耿耿地为历代大宗师服务多年。

pairs.source: The spirit of the Great Hunter found you worthy, and now its children will answer your call forevermore.
pairs.text: 狩猎大师的灵魂认可了你的能力。现在，它的后裔将永远响应你的召唤。

pairs.source: A powerful red dragon raised in undeath by its own life energies, a true mockery of life.
pairs.text: 一头被自己的生命能量复活的强大红龙，这真是对生命的讽刺。

你还可以叫它“咬咬先生”。

pairs.source: The dwarves of Ironforge were originally composed of three clans: the Bronzebeards, the Wildhammers and the Dark Irons. As the result of a civil war, the Bronzebeards were left in control of the city of Ironforge while the Wildhammers eventually retreated to the Hinterlands and Twilight Highlands. The Dark Iron dwarves came to dwell in between the Redridge Mountains and the Burning Steppes, in the shadow of Blackrock Mountain.
pairs.text: 铁炉堡矮人最初由三个部族组成：铜须、蛮锤和黑铁。经过一次激烈的内战，铜须部族完全掌握了铁炉堡。蛮锤部族撤退到辛特兰和暮光高地。黑铁矮人定居于赤脊山和燃烧平原之间，黑石山的阴影中。

pairs.source: The earliest known trolls belonged to the Zandalar tribe, from which all other trolls are descended. The Zandalari were regarded as an overarching priest caste for all trolls and worked tirelessly to record and preserve troll society and traditions. Of the many tribes that split off from the Zandalari, the two most dominant were the Gurubashi and Amani.
pairs.text: 已知最早的巨魔来自于赞达拉部族，这个部族也是所有其他巨魔的起源。随着历史的推演，赞达拉巨魔成为超越于一切巨魔之上的牧师阶层，致力于记录和保存巨魔的社会和文化传统。在赞达拉分裂出来的许多部族中，最具权威的是古拉巴什和阿曼尼。

pairs.source: Fossils are the preserved remains of animals or plants from the ancient past. Typically the living tissues are replaced with minerals that preserve the form of the original organism.
pairs.text: 化石是远古时代动植物躯体存留至今的遗迹。在漫长的岁月中，生物的有机组织逐渐被矿物质取代，使得这些组织的外形结构能够得以保存。

pairs.source: The kaldorei are one of the most ancient races of Azeroth. One of the darkest moments in their history occurred when the quel'dorei, or Highborne - the highest caste of elven nobility - unleashed dangerous magic that brought the Burning Legion into the world and resulted in countless deaths.
pairs.text: 卡多雷是艾泽拉斯最古老的种族之一。在卡多雷历史中最黑暗的时刻，他们之中的奎尔多雷，也就是居于高位的上层精灵肆意滥用危险的魔法力量，导致燃烧军团进入这个世界。无数生命因此而毁灭。

pairs.text: 卡多雷是艾泽拉斯最古老的种族之一。在卡多雷历史中最黑暗的时刻，他们之中的奎尔多雷，也就是居于高位的上层精灵肆意滥用危险的魔法力量，导致燃烧军团进入这个世界。无数生命因此而毁灭。

pairs.source: Fossils are the preserved remains of animals or plants from the ancient past. Typically the living tissues are replaced with minerals that preserve the form of the original organism.
pairs.text: 化石是远古时代动植物躯体存留至今的遗迹。在漫长的岁月中，生物的有机组织逐渐被矿物质取代，使得这些组织的外形结构能够得以保存。

pairs.source: The dwarves of Ironforge were originally composed of three clans: the Bronzebeards, the Wildhammers and the Dark Irons. As the result of a civil war, the Bronzebeards were left in control of the city of Ironforge while the Wildhammers eventually retreated to the Hinterlands and Twilight Highlands. The Dark Iron dwarves came to dwell in between the Redridge Mountains and the Burning Steppes, in the shadow of Blackrock Mountain.
pairs.text: 铁炉堡矮人最初由三个部族组成：铜须、蛮锤和黑铁。经过一次激烈的内战，铜须部族完全掌握了铁炉堡。蛮锤部族撤退到辛特兰和暮光高地。黑铁矮人定居于赤脊山和燃烧平原之间，黑石山的阴影中。

pairs.source: The earliest known trolls belonged to the Zandalar tribe, from which all other trolls are descended. The Zandalari were regarded as an overarching priest caste for all trolls and worked tirelessly to record and preserve troll society and traditions. Of the many tribes that split off from the Zandalari, the two most dominant were the Gurubashi and Amani.
pairs.text: 已知最早的巨魔来自于赞达拉部族，这个部族也是所有其他巨魔的起源。随着历史的推演，赞达拉巨魔成为超越于一切巨魔之上的牧师阶层，致力于记录和保存巨魔的社会和文化传统。在赞达拉分裂出来的许多部族中，最具权威的是古拉巴什和阿曼尼。

pairs.source: While the glass has been shattered into a thousand fragments, the detailed work of the mirror's frame itself convinces you that this artifact was once highly magical, and might still be if every piece could be recovered. It is a large mirror, like a lady might have mounted in her dressing room.
pairs.text: 虽然这面镜子已经破碎成一千片，但镜框的精细结构让你确信，它曾经拥有强大的魔法力。如果你能将它的每一片都拼合完好，它的魔法力很可能会得到恢复。这是一面很大的镜子，很可能曾经被某位贵妇安放在她的更衣室中。

pairs.source: These are the remains of a pair of statues of precious metal. They do not seem carved or molded so much as grown, as if free from an artisan's touch. Both figures are night elves. The priest is apparently male and the druid female, which must carry some significance.
pairs.text: 这是用贵重金属制做成的一对雕像的残余部分。在它们上面，看不到丝毫雕凿或浇筑的痕迹，仿佛它们根本不是出自任何工匠之手。两个雕像表现的都是暗夜精灵。其中牧师是男性，德鲁伊是女性。它们一定有着某种特殊的代表意义。

pairs.source: You have found a few pieces of a mechanical construct of apparently high technology. It's possible these parts come from one of the mechanognomes of Northrend. Why dwarves would have relocated the parts here is a mystery. You wonder if you could get the gnome working again if you could recover all of its pieces.
pairs.text: 你找到了几块技术水准非常高的机械残片。它们可能来自于诺森德的某个机械侏儒。你不知道为什么矮人会把这些零件放在这里。但你猜想，如果能找到这个侏儒的所有部件，也许就能让它重新运转起来。

pairs.source: You can tell right away that this drinking cup holds far more significance than mere drinking (not that dwarves have any problem with mere drinking). The bit of runes you can make out suggest a ceremonial purpose.
pairs.text: 你立刻就能判断出来，这只酒杯存在的意义远大于一个用于喝酒的器皿（虽然喝酒本身对于矮人来说已经具有极为重要的意义了）。你能够从上面解读出的一点文字代表着某种庄严的仪式。

pairs.source: There is something unusual about these bronze tubes. You detect a hint of magic that still resides within. When placed near each other or even within your pack, the fragments of the tubes seem to move closer to each other.
pairs.text: 这些青铜细管很有些不同寻常的地方。你发现其中似乎还残留着一些魔法力。只要让它们相互之间足够靠近，比如在你的背包里，这些青铜管的残片仿佛就会慢慢聚拢在一起。

pairs.source: The rumors of the Highborne's poor fashion sense seem to be true.
pairs.text: 有传闻说上层精灵的审美品位相当糟糕。看来这个传闻是真的。

pairs.source: Fossils are the preserved remains of animals or plants from the ancient past. Typically the living tissues are replaced with minerals that preserve the form of the original organism.
pairs.text: 化石是远古时代动植物躯体存留至今的遗迹。在漫长的岁月中，生物的有机组织逐渐被矿物质取代，使得这些组织的外形结构能够得以保存。

pairs.source: There is something unsual about these raptor bones. Whenever you look away, they seem to move slightly on their own.
pairs.text: 这些迅猛龙的骨头颇有些不同寻常的地方。只要你不去看它们，它们似乎就会做出微小的移动。

pairs.source: The orcs of Azeroth originally inhabited the world of Draenor, the source of most of these ancient orcish artifacts. At first, orcs were a largely peaceful people, but they turned to outright barbarity under the influence of the Burning Legion. The orcs arrived in Azeroth through the Dark Portal and fought against the Alliance in two wars. Another may be on the horizon.
pairs.text: 艾泽拉斯的兽人原先居住在德拉诺世界。绝大多数兽人古物都来自于那里。兽人原本是爱好和平的种族，但在燃烧军团的影响下，他们变成了一群疯狂嗜血的战士。通过黑暗之门，兽人来到艾泽拉斯，与联盟进行了两场大战。而一场新的战争也许正在酝酿之中。

pairs.source: You have found some scraps of a cowl fashioned out of a wolf's head. And yet, for all its simplicity, you suspect that this item is old, important and powerful.
pairs.text: 你发现了一些头冠的碎片。看样子，这个头冠可能是模仿狼头制做的。虽然这顶头饰造型简单，但你仍然觉得这是一件重要的，有着久远历史的强大道具。

pairs.source: The draenei were originally eredar who fled from the Burning Legion and settled on the world of Draenor, where they came into contact with the orcs. When the blood elves arrived, many draenei fled again, this time coming to Azeroth, where they joined the Alliance.
pairs.text: 曾是艾瑞达的德莱尼人逃离燃烧军团的残害之后，在德拉诺定居下来，并和那里的兽人发生了接触。当血精灵到来时，德莱尼再次开始逃亡。这一次，他们来到艾泽拉斯，加入了联盟。

pairs.source: The naaru are a near god-like race of energy beings who are strongly aligned with the Light. The naaru first came into contact with the draenei when Prophet Velen prayed for help to escape the corruption of the Burning Legion. The naaru answered that call, helping Velen and his people escape. The name 'draenei' means 'exiled ones.'
pairs.text: 纳鲁是接近于神的能量体族群，与圣光有着密切的联系。当先知维伦祈求援助，希望能让族人免于受到燃烧军团腐蚀的时候，纳鲁第一次出现在德莱尼面前。他们回应了维伦的恳求，帮助他带领族人踏上逃亡之路。“德莱尼”这个名字的意思就是“流亡者”。

pairs.source: This is a simple draenei crystal that appears to be thousands of years old. You are fairly certain that it is not of this world.
pairs.text: 这是一块外形简单的德莱尼水晶。看上去，它应该已经有了千万年的历史。你确信，它肯定不是这个世界的产物。
阿古斯的最后一件圣物

pairs.source: The vrykul are a race of giant warriors native to the Howling Fjord in Northrend. They have a close affinity with the sea and with native proto-drakes. Many vrykul were absorbed into the vast armies of the Lich King.
pairs.text: 维库是一个巨人战士种族，聚居于诺森德的嚎风峡湾。他们与海洋和野生始祖龙都有着非常密切的关系。在巫妖王的大军中，能够看见许多凶残的维库人。

pairs.source: This axe's blade is asymmetrical, with a long cutting edge.  You suspect it might retain its magic if you could reassemble it.
pairs.text: 这把斧子的斧刃有一个向下延伸的长长弧曲，看起来很不对称。你觉得，如果能将它重新拼合起来，也许就会让它的魔法力得以恢复。

pairs.source: The nerubians are descended from an ancient race known as the aqir, roughly half of which migrated far to the north after continual warfare with the trolls. There they founded a gigantic city-state below Northrend, the legendary Azjol-Nerub. The arrival of the Lich King was brutally hard on the wicked nerubian race, with many of the spiderlike creatures converted to the Scourge and others driven deep into hiding.
pairs.text: 蛛魔是远古时代亚基虫族的后裔。经历过与巨魔的无数次战争之后，大约半数亚基虫族迁移到遥远的北方，在诺森德地下建立起宏伟而怪诞的巨型城市——传说中的艾卓-尼鲁布。而巫妖王的到来对凶残的蛛魔一族来说无异于一个巨大的灾难。经过和天灾军团的长期战争，许多这种蛛形怪物都投向了天灾军团，残存的反抗者则被驱赶到更深的地下，躲藏了起来。

pairs.text: 蛛魔是远古时代亚基虫族的后裔。经历过与巨魔的无数次战争之后，大约半数亚基虫族迁移到遥远的北方，在诺森德地下建立起宏伟而怪诞的巨型城市——传说中的艾卓-尼鲁布。而巫妖王的到来对凶残的蛛魔一族来说无异于一个巨大的灾难。经过和天灾军团的长期战争，许多这种蛛形怪物都投向了天灾军团，残存的反抗者则被驱赶到更深的地下，躲藏了起来。

pairs.source: The nerubians are descended from an ancient race known as the aqir, roughly half of which migrated far to the north after continual warfare with the trolls. There they founded a gigantic city-state below Northrend, the legendary Azjol-Nerub. The arrival of the Lich King was brutally hard on the wicked nerubian race, with many of the spiderlike creatures converted to the Scourge and others driven deep into hiding.

pairs.source: You have discovered a very bad thing. It hurts your mind to even look at fragments of this artifact and you worry that it might drive you insane were you to complete the final object.
pairs.text: 你发现了一件非常可怕的东西。即使只看一眼这件古物的残片，你也感觉到自己的意识受到了伤害。你有些害怕，如果将这件古物最终拼合完整，它也许会让你彻底陷入疯狂。

pairs.source: Each of the fragments of this artifact emits a nonsense whisper that blends into a maddening susurrus as you accumulate more objects. You hope that you know what you're doing.
pairs.text: 随着你将这件古物逐渐拼合完整，它的每一块残片都在不停地发出疯狂的耳语声。你只希望能明白自己在做什么。

pairs.source: The dwarves of Ironforge were originally composed of three clans: the Bronzebeards, the Wildhammers and the Dark Irons. As the result of a civil war, the Bronzebeards were left in control of the city of Ironforge while the Wildhammers eventually retreated to the Hinterlands and Twilight Highlands. The Dark Iron dwarves came to dwell in between the Redridge Mountains and the Burning Steppes, in the shadow of Blackrock Mountain.
pairs.text: 铁炉堡矮人最初由三个部族组成：铜须、蛮锤和黑铁。经过一次激烈的内战，铜须部族完全掌握了铁炉堡。蛮锤部族撤退到辛特兰和暮光高地。黑铁矮人定居于赤脊山和燃烧平原之间，黑石山的阴影中。

pairs.source: This small stone resembles a Hearthstone. It is warm to the touch and makes very faint giggling noises at inopportune moments.
pairs.text: 这块小石头在外形上和炉石一模一样。它摸起来很温暖，而且会在不恰当的时刻发出一阵阵低微的笑声。

pairs.source: The pieces of this staff still crackle with energy. Yet it also appears to have suffered extensive fire damage.
pairs.text: 这段残缺的法杖上仍然会不时响起能量爆发的“噼啪”声。看上去，它曾经承受过极度高温的火焰烧灼。

pairs.source: This is a simple night elven doll. The hands and feet are of porcelain, painted with flaking purple. The garments are fine but fraying. The doll's long tresses are the most remarkable and could possibly be real night elf hair.
pairs.text: 这是一个简单的暗夜精灵玩偶。它的手和脚是用瓷器做成的，上面覆盖着紫色的雪片釉彩。玩偶的衣服非常精致，但磨损得很厉害。最令人印象深刻的还是它长长的发辫。那有可能是用真正的暗夜精灵头发做成的。

pairs.source: These bones show a curious mixture of humanoid arms and serpentine tail, convincing you that they are probably from a naga. What is more interesting is that the skeleton has been articulated and posed as if it was once displayed in a museum.
pairs.text: 这堆骸骨相当怪异。它有着人类的手臂和蜿蜒卷曲的尾部。你认为这可能是纳迦的遗骨。真正让你感兴趣的是，它的骨架被固定成某种特别的姿态，似乎它曾经是某座博物馆的展品。

pairs.source: The kaldorei are one of the most ancient races of Azeroth. One of the darkest moments in their history occurred when the quel'dorei, or Highborne - the highest caste of elven nobility - unleashed dangerous magic that brought the Burning Legion into the world and resulted in countless deaths.
pairs.text: 卡多雷是艾泽拉斯最古老的种族之一。在卡多雷历史中最黑暗的时刻，他们之中的奎尔多雷，也就是居于高位的上层精灵肆意滥用危险的魔法力量，导致燃烧军团进入这个世界。无数生命因此而毁灭。

pairs.source: This beautiful amulet is formed of loops and angles of bright gold, framing a large tear-drop emerald.  Within the depths of the emerald you can see a small glowing sphere with a vaguely night elf face.  The sphere seems to move about within the emerald, not trapped exactly as much as flitting about like an insect.
pairs.text: 这个美丽的护身符上用闪亮的黄金制造出许多环形和棱角花纹，中间环绕着一颗泪滴形的硕大翡翠。在这块翡翠深处，你能看见一个发光的小球体，包裹着一张模糊的暗夜精灵面孔。发光球体似乎一直在翡翠内部不停地移动，却又不像被困住的飞虫那样来回乱窜。

pairs.source: The tol'vir were originally stone constructs created by the titans to safeguard the secrets of Uldum.  They possess feline lower bodies and heads as well as human torsos.  Like many other titan creations, the tol'vir succumbed to the curse of flesh.  Three tribes exist in the present day: Ramkahen, Orsis (nearly wiped out) and Neferset.  The latter tribe has allied with Deathwing in order to regain the tol'vir's stone form.
pairs.text: 托维尔本是泰坦们创造的岩石生物。他们被创造出来的目的是守卫奥丹姆的秘密。他们拥有猫一样的头部和下半身，以及人类的上半身。如同诸多泰坦造物一样，托维尔受到了血肉诅咒。现存的托维尔分为三个部族——拉穆卡恒、奥西斯（这个部族几乎已经彻底灭绝）和尼斐塞特。为了能恢复他们的岩石身躯，尼斐塞特和死亡之翼结成了同盟。

弗兰克罗恩·铸铁的烟斗

pairs.source: This appears as nothing more than the paw of a small primate. A closer inspection shows that the hand has been dried by centuries of exposure to the sands of Uldum. Still, you have no doubt that it is far more than meets the eye.
pairs.text: 看上去，这只不过是一个小型灵长目生物的爪子。经过仔细观察之后，你发现它已经被奥丹姆沙漠许多个世纪的猛烈阳光晒成了干硬的石块。可以确信的是，它绝对不止是看上去这么简单。

pairs.source: This is a long staff with a gold head piece. In the center of the head is a green gem of some unknown mineral that allows light to shine through. The staff is warm to the touch and if left too long in one place, plants turn to face it as if facing the sun.
pairs.text: 这是一根镶着黄金杖头的长手杖。在杖头的中心位置有一颗成分不明的绿色宝石。光线可以从这颗宝石中穿射而过。手杖摸起来是温热的，如果将它长时间放置在一个地方，周围的植物就都会转向它，就像它们转向太阳一样。

pairs.source: This is a heavy necklace, almost a piece of armor, covered with small scarabs of stone and bronze instead of chain links. The largest scarab is carved of lapis lazuli set in gold.
pairs.text: 这是一条沉重的项链，几乎能比得上一片铠甲了。但它并非由扣连在一起的链环组成，而是在上面覆满了石头和青铜的小圣甲虫。其中最大的一只圣甲虫是用镶嵌青金石的黄金雕成的。

pairs.source: This short baton is set with a clawed amethyst at the crown.  Your are fairly certain that the design is not tol'vir at all, but Qiraji.  Perhaps the proximity to the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj has somehow allowed this artifact into Uldum despite the barrier.
pairs.text: 这根短棒的头部镶嵌着一枚雕刻成利爪形状的紫晶。你相信，这种装饰风格并非出自于托维尔，而是来自其拉文明。也许靠近安其拉神殿的结果使这种宝物突破藩篱，进入了奥丹姆。

pairs.source: This scimitar is fashioned of bronze but inlaid with a great deal of gold. A warm wind seems to cling to it. The blade is sharply curved in the 'sickle sword' design called a khopesh by the tol'vir.
pairs.text: 这把弯刀由青铜铸成，上面有大量错镶黄金。它的周围似乎环绕着一股暖风。镰刀形的锋利曲刃就是托维尔语中著名的“珂珀释”。

pairs.source: This is a ring of gold featuring a scarab fashioned of polished turquoise. The ring itself is quite small and only fits on your fingers with some effort.
pairs.text: 这是一枚黄金戒指，上面镶嵌着一只用抛光绿松石雕刻的圣甲虫。戒指非常小，你要用些力气才能将它套在你的手指上。

pairs.source: Fossils are the preserved remains of animals or plants from the ancient past. Typically the living tissues are replaced with minerals that preserve the form of the original organism.
pairs.text: 化石是远古时代动植物躯体存留至今的遗迹。在漫长的岁月中，生物的有机组织逐渐被矿物质取代，使得这些组织的外形结构能够得以保存。

pairs.text: 化石是远古时代动植物躯体存留至今的遗迹。在漫长的岁月中，生物的有机组织逐渐被矿物质取代，使得这些组织的外形结构能够得以保存。

pairs.source: The earliest known trolls belonged to the Zandalar tribe, from which all other trolls are descended. The Zandalari were regarded as an overarching priest caste for all trolls and worked tirelessly to record and preserve troll society and traditions. Of the many tribes that split off from the Zandalari, the two most dominant were the Gurubashi and Amani.
pairs.text: 已知最早的巨魔来自于赞达拉部族，这个部族也是所有其他巨魔的起源。随着历史的推演，赞达拉巨魔成为超越于一切巨魔之上的牧师阶层，致力于记录和保存巨魔的社会和文化传统。在赞达拉分裂出来的许多部族中，最具权威的是古拉巴什和阿曼尼。

pairs.source: This turtle shell is supernaturally resilient. Perhaps if you collected all the fragments, you could assemble a powerful protective device.
pairs.text: 这个龟壳极为坚硬。也许你收集到所有碎片之后可以拼装成一件强大的防具。

pairs.source: What appears to be an ancient, elaborate troll war drum. The hide is of an unusual color and appears to have been tattooed rather than simply painted or dyed.
pairs.text: 看上去似乎是精致的远古巨魔战鼓。鼓面的色泽非常罕见，图案似乎是刺上去的，而非染成的。

pairs.source: A particularly large hunk of petrified tree resin containing what appears to be a small humanoid figure.
pairs.text: 一大块石化树脂，里面似乎还有一个小小的人型生物。

pairs.source: A large, sturdy, silver-chased and rune-carved horn.
pairs.text: 一个牢固的巨角，雕有银饰，还刻着符文。

pairs.source: Could this fossilized egg still be... alive?!
pairs.text: 这个化石蛋难道……是活的？

pairs.source: A medium-sized figurine of unusual complexity and troll manufacture.
pairs.text: 一个中型的雕像，异常精致，出自巨魔之手。

pairs.source: The Pandaren are an enigmatic race native to the long-hidden continent of Pandaria.  Honorable and filled with a love of good company and food, the Pandaren have been content to live in seclusion, allowing their culture to flourish and thrive away from the influence of the outside world.  While the Pandaren are predominantly a peace-loving race, their history is marked with turmoil and strife.
pairs.text: 在这片不为人知的潘达利亚大陆上，住着一个名叫熊猫人的神秘种族。可敬的熊猫人喜欢与友同乐，畅享美食，自得其乐地避世隐居，也正因为如此，他们的文化才得以繁荣发展，免受外部世界的影响。尽管熊猫人天生爱好和平，但却有着充满动乱与纷争的历史。

pairs.source: The seemingly delicate pieces of bamboo and paper are remarkably resillient.  They have clearly been imbued with magic that has made them last through time.
pairs.text: 尽管这把伞的竹制伞骨和伞纸看似纤弱，但却韧性十足。显然是被灌注了魔法，才能在时间的长河中留存下来。

pairs.source: The broken pieces of this spear radiate power.  Perhaps they can be reassembled into a usable weapon?
pairs.text: 这根长矛的残破碎片散发着力量。也许能把这些碎片重新拼成一把可用的武器？

pairs.source: The life-giving waters of the valley enabled a race of brutes to grow to enormous size, strength and intelligence.  These creatures were called the "Mogu".  Their culture was built on strength:  warrior despots ruling via iron fist.  Their monuments of stone, built to last, still stand to this day.
pairs.text: “山谷中的生命之水把一个凶残的种族变得体型庞大、力大无穷、智慧过人。这些生物被称作‘魔古族’。他们的文化建立在力量之上——勇士们凭借刚硬的铁拳打出统治地位。他们永存不朽的石质纪念碑直到今天仍旧屹立不倒。”

pairs.source: These are stone shards of what was once a statuette of some sort.  Oddly, they give the impression of pulsing with life.
pairs.text: 这些石头碎块应该是从某个雕像身上掉下来的。诡异的是，在石头里仿佛有生命之力在跃动。

pairs.source: Something about this anatomical dummy makes you think "malevolent", rather than "medical".
pairs.text: 这个解剖用假人莫名地令你感到“邪恶”，与“医学”无半点联系。

pairs.source: The mantid empire predates the arrival of the Titans. This ancient civilization of highly intelligent insectoids is ruled by the mantid Empress, and is organized by caste. Mantid society revolves around kypari trees and the amber produced from their sap.
pairs.text: 螳螂妖帝国的时代可以追溯到泰坦抵达潘达利亚之前。这个高智能昆虫的古老文明由螳螂妖女皇统治，上下等级极其森严。螳螂妖社会总是围绕着凯帕圣树以及其所产出的树脂而运转。

pairs.text: 螳螂妖帝国的时代可以追溯到泰坦抵达潘达利亚之前。这个高智能昆虫的古老文明由螳螂妖女皇统治，上下等级极其森严。螳螂妖社会总是围绕着凯帕圣树以及其所产出的树脂而运转。

pairs.source: A light, elegant blade. Perhaps you can find a way to put it back together.
pairs.text: 一把轻盈、优雅的武器。或许你可以设法把它重新拼起来。

pairs.source: A strange device, that looks to have to do with the generation of sound waves. Perhaps it can be assembled back to full function.
pairs.text: 一个奇怪的装置，看上去与音波的产生有关。你或许可以把它重新组装好并恢复运转。

pairs.source: In order to be granted full standing within the Frostwolf clan, each member must undertake a solo quest to befriend and bond with a wild Frostwolf. Not all clan members pass this trial, but those that do earn a lifelong companion.
pairs.text: 为了能在霜狼氏族内获得承认，每一位氏族成员都必须独自完成一个任务，那就是驯服一头野生霜狼并与之结下友谊。不是所有的氏族成员都能通过这项试炼，但成功的人都将获得一位终生的伙伴。

pairs.source: As part of the rite of passage into adulthood, a Frostwolf orc must slay a frostboar and carve their family genealogy as far back as will fit on the creature's largest tusk. Family history and tradition are of great importance to the Frostwolf clan, so the largest frostboars are hunted each season to preserve clan lineage.
pairs.text: 作为成年仪式的一部分，每个霜狼兽人都要杀死一头霜鬃野猪并将他们的族谱尽可能完整地刻在野猪最大的獠牙上。家族历史和传统对霜狼氏族非常重要，所以每一季他们都会猎取最大的霜鬃野猪，以记载氏族的谱系。

pairs.source: With the icy Frostfire drifts providing little vegetative nourishment, the Frostwolf depend on their hunters for sustenance. These snowshoes, constructed of wolf bones and pelts, help keep trackers from sinking into deep drifts while pursuing prey.
pairs.text: 在霜火岭苦寒的雪原上，植物几乎无法生长，霜狼兽人全靠狩猎为生。这些由狼骨和狼皮制成的雪鞋可以防止猎手在追击猎物时陷入松软的积雪之中。

pairs.source: Learning to speak with the elemental spirits of Draenor was a pivotal achievement in destiny the Orc clans. Many clans claim the mythical "First Shaman" arose from their ranks, but the truth is that no one is sure of his or her allegiance.
pairs.text: 在兽人氏族中，学会与德拉诺的元素之灵交流是一项极为重要的成就。许多氏族都宣称神秘的“第一萨满”来自他们的氏族，但事实是没人能确保他或者她的忠诚度。

pairs.source: Relying on shock and awe to overwhelm their enemies, the Warsong earned their name from their fearsome battle cries and thunderous drum marches. These macabre drums are constructed of Talbuk leather stretched tightly over what appear to be ogre skulls, celebrating the clan's freedom from the ogre empire.
pairs.text: 战歌氏族依靠震慑和威吓来战胜敌人，他们的氏族名就得名于他们可怕的战吼和行军过程中雷鸣般的战鼓声。这些骇人的战鼓由塔布羊皮蒙在疑似食人魔头骨的骨架上制成，以纪念氏族脱离食人魔帝国，获得自由的历史。

pairs.source: A bullroarer is an arm-length piece of rigid wood affixed to the end of a long rope and spun over the wielder's head to generate a droning noise capable of traveling long distances. This example was grooved by the Warsong to emit a high-pitched whistling noise rather than the low hum used by most other clans.
pairs.text: 吼板是一种一臂长的坚硬木板，它被固定在一根长绳末端，只要持有者将它甩过头顶不断旋转，它就会发出低沉的嗡嗡声，并传到很远的地方。这个样品上带有战歌氏族特有的凹槽，可发出高亢的声响，有别于其他大部分氏族制品低沉的嗡鸣声。

pairs.source: The riders of the Warsong clan are always on the move. In camp, a family's tent is marked with a long pike thrust into the ground - often adorned with the skulls of defeated enemies. This example is over a hundred years old and is branded with the names of several key battles.
pairs.text: 战歌氏族的骑手们总是在不停移动。在营地中，每个家庭的帐篷外都有一根插入地下的长矛作为标志——上面通常还会挂着主人所击败的敌人脑袋作为装饰。这个样品已经有超过一百年的历史，上面刻着好几场重大战役的名字。

pairs.source: Despite many dents and scratches, you can see the Blackrock clan iconography etched in to this once-proud hammer. The first of the Orc clans to master the art of shaping their namesake metal, the Blackrock prefer to wield blunt weaponry in battle to honor their ancestors.
pairs.text: 尽管有许多凹痕和擦痕，你还是可以分辨出这把曾经风光无限的锤子上蚀刻着黑石氏族的印记。黑石氏族是第一个掌握黑石熔炼技术的兽人氏族。这种矿石正是以他们的氏族名称命名的。因此，黑石兽人偏好在战斗中使用钝头武器，以纪念他们的祖先。

pairs.source: The Blackrock Clan originally used the naturally occurring elemental-fueled infernos of ancient Draenor to shape and harden their namesake ore. A Shaman could use these bellows to channel the power of a fire spirit directly to a blast furnace, allowing the Blackrock to set up forges anywhere.
pairs.text: 黑石氏族最早是使用古德拉诺自然形成的、以元素为燃料的地狱火来锻造和淬炼黑石原矿。一名萨满可以使用这些风箱将火元素之灵的力量引导到高炉内，以便黑石兽人随时随地设立熔炉。

pairs.source: Male orcs of the Blackrock Clan never cut their hair until they come of age, at which point their head is shaved and their role in this extremely regimented society is determined. This ancient switchblade is forged of blackrock and embellished with jewels, likely used by a prominent family for many generations of initiation.
pairs.text: 黑石氏族的男性兽人在成年前从不剃发，在成年礼上，他们才会剔去头发，在这个等级森严的社会中确立自己的地位。这把古老的折刀是用黑石铸造而成，上面还镶满了宝石，可能是某个显赫的家族代代相传的仪式器物。

pairs.source: Taking their namesake literally, warriors of the Shattered Hand clan will ritualistically smash their own hand before cutting it off. The stump is cauterized and replaced with one of many varieties of weaponry. This blade, which resembles a simple butcher's cleaver, is heavily weighted to assist in making a single clean cut at the wrist.
pairs.text: 人如其名，碎手氏族的战士会通过某种仪式砸碎自己的手，然后再将它砍下来。他们会用火烧灼残肢使其结疤，然后装上各种不同的武器。这把武器看似只是普通的屠夫砍刀，其实极其沉重，能够干脆利落地砍断你的手。

pairs.source: The Shattered Hand celebrate victory in battle with self-mutilation. Their most celebrated warriors are covered with scars and piercings, and it becomes increasingly difficult with age to tell which were inflicted by enemies or by the triumphant orc.
pairs.text: 碎手兽人会在战斗中通过自残来庆祝胜利。他们最勇猛的战士身上总是伤痕累累。随着年岁的增长，人们就更难分清这些疤痕到底是敌人留下的，还是获得胜利的兽人自己留下的。

pairs.source: This arm-length nest of barbs has less in common with a traditional fishing hook and more with an elaborate halberd. You can only imagine the size of the leviathan that could be pulled in by such a hook, and it's no surprise that most orcs prefer to hunt their prey from land.
pairs.text: 这个跟胳膊一样长的倒钩鱼钩和传统的鱼钩差别很大，更像是一根精美的战戟。你只能想象一下，这样的鱼钩拉上来的海怪会有多大。难怪大部分兽人更喜欢狩猎陆地上的猎物。

pairs.source: These bone needles are taken from the corpses of fallen enemies and meticulously sharpened. The mystics of the Shadowmoon often inscribe secret runes into their flesh to more clearly speak to their ancestors and the elemental spirits.
pairs.text: 这些骨针取自死亡的敌人尸体，并精心打磨成锋利的刺针。影月氏族的秘法师经常将秘传符文刺在自己的身体上，以便更清晰地与先祖和元素之灵交流。

pairs.source: An example of the Void worship once practiced but now banned by the Shadowmoon Clan elders, this idol is as dark as the night sky. Roughly and frantically chiseled from the tusk of what must have been a colossal Elekk, this idol was dyed and is inlaid with complex swirling and jagged patterns.
pairs.text: 这个如夜空一般黑暗的人偶是虚空崇拜的产物，这种信仰曾在影月氏族中盛行一时，后来又被长老们所禁止。它由一根巨大的雷象象牙胡乱凿刻而成，十分粗糙。人偶被染了色，上面还雕刻着复杂的漩涡和锯齿状图案。

pairs.source: Consultation with the spirits of previous generations is considered essential to Shadowmoon shamans whenever an important decision is to be made. Talismans and other relics that were important to an ancestor during life provide a more clear spiritual conduit for shamans to speak to them in the afterlife.
pairs.text: 影月氏族的萨满在做出重大决定时，一定会先向前代祖先的灵魂请教。先祖生前重要的护符和其他遗物可以让萨满与他们进行更清晰的精神沟通。

pairs.source: Sticky, smelly, and highly flammable, the substance in this small container is liberally applied to the swords and axes of the Burning Blade clan before battle. Though some warriors choose to ignite their weapons before battle, most let the inevitable contact of blades and armor spark the blazegrease for unpredictable intimidation.
pairs.text: 黏稠、难闻、极度易燃，战歌氏族在大战前会用这个小罐子里的物质涂满他们的长剑和战斧。虽然有些战士会在战斗前点燃他们的武器，大部分人还是会选择让战斗中无法避免的武器和盔甲碰撞擦出的火星来点燃火油，从而起到出其不意的效果。

pairs.source: The Thunderlords are the greatest big game hunters in all of Draenor. For centuries they have used riding beasts and coordinated assaults to slay game and gronn alike. Their clan draws their name from an ancient chieftain who single-handedly slew a powerful gronn at the pinnacle of Thunder Peak.
pairs.text: 雷神氏族是全德拉诺最厉害的猛兽猎人。几百年来，他们使用骑兽和协同作战捕杀猎物和戈隆。他们的氏族之名源自某位前代酋长的事迹。这位酋长曾在雷鸣峰上独自杀死了一头强大的戈隆。

pairs.source: This tablet speaks of the "end times." From what you can decipher, the crude scrawls of multiple authors speak of at least seven different and sometimes conflicting versions of a final reckoning for all of the inhabitants of Draenor. Eerily, the iconography of a flaming hammer is clearly depicted - is this the ancestral origin of the Twilight's Hammer clan?
pairs.text: 这块石板上提到了“末日”。从你能解读的部分来看，这些由不同人写成的潦草记载中至少描绘了七种不同版本，有时甚至是自相矛盾的德拉诺末日图景。诡异的是，上面清晰地描绘了一把熊熊燃烧的战锤——这就是暮光之锤氏族的最初起源吗？

pairs.source: Chieftains rule small bands of ogres with an iron fist, and are never short on challengers. The Stonemaul clan have notoriously high turnover rate in their leadership; judging from the layers of bloodstains this stone appears to have been instrumental in deposing multiple Stonemaul chieftans.
pairs.text: 每位食人魔酋长都用铁拳统治着少量食人魔，而他们也从不缺乏挑战者。石槌氏族的首领是出了名的更迭频繁；从这块石头上层层叠叠的血迹来看，它上面应该躺过不少石槌酋长了。

pairs.source: Rather than using clasps and locks, Ogres bind their slaves using unbroken stone circlets. Their centuries of manipulating earth elements lets them simply shrink the manacles tightly around the slave's ankles, wrists, or neck.
pairs.text: 相比环扣和枷锁，食人魔更喜欢用坚固的石环来锁住奴隶。数百年来操纵土元素的经验让他们可以轻松地将镣铐缩小，紧紧扣住奴隶的脚踝、手腕或脖子。

pairs.source: Expressing with sculpture what most ogres could struggle to explain in words, this statue summarizes the most important ogre physical attribute: size. The clefthoof held above the ogre's head displays strength, while the robust waistline symbolizes great wealth.
pairs.text: 这个雕像表达了大多数食人魔难以用语言表达的东西，它很好地总结了食人魔最重要的外形特征：体格。被食人魔高举过顶的裂蹄牛象征着力量，而粗壮的腰身象征着巨大的财富。

pairs.source: While the written word is mostly used as an instrument for the upper echelons of imperial ogre society, occasionally an ordinary ogre will try his hand at making a story immortal. This pictogram appears to tell the story of an especially distressing culinary experience.
pairs.text: 虽然书面文字主要是食人魔的大贵族阶层的专属，但偶尔也会有一些灵感大发的普通食人魔会尝试用双手将一个故事永久记载下来。这幅象形图画似乎记载了作者某次特别痛苦的烹饪体验。

pairs.source: Disagreements between ogres usually end in violence. During the early decades of the Age of Order, a sly chieftain decreed that disputes in his clan would be settled via proxy in one-on-one combat between slaves. The mortality rate amongst the ogres plummeted, leading to a golden age of expansion.
pairs.text: 食人魔之间的纠纷多半会诉诸武力。在秩序纪元的早期，有一个狡猾的酋长曾下令，他的氏族内所有的纷争必须通过双方选择的奴隶之间一对一的决斗来解决。这使得该氏族食人魔的死亡率直线下降，并创造出了一个氏族大发展的黄金时代。

pairs.source: Preferring to show off their physique, ogres eschew garments that cover too much skin. In order to look more fearsome to their enemies, they adorn their bodies with warpaints created in these grinding tools. This mortar and pestle set is stained yellow, indicating it was used by the Boulderfist clan.
pairs.text: 食人魔喜欢炫耀自己魁梧的体格，因此他们会尽量避免让衣物遮盖太多的皮肤。为了让自己在敌人眼中更加可怕，他们喜欢用这些研磨工具制作彩绘来装扮自己。这套研钵与研杵呈黄色，表明它曾属于石拳氏族。

pairs.source: While most ogres are born with two eyes, a handful in every generation regress and are born with a single eye. All but a few clans recognize these ogres are exceptional and destined for great things. An unlucky one-eyed ogre mage lost his eye in a duel and replaced it with this fist-sized stone, discovering it to have magical properties when he did so.
pairs.text: 尽管大部分食人魔生来就有两只眼睛，但每一代中总有一小撮食人魔会出现返祖现象，生来就只有一只眼睛。大部分氏族都认为这些食人魔拥有超凡的力量，注定会成为大人物。有一个倒霉的独眼食人魔法师在一次决斗中丢失了自己的眼睛，于是就将这块拳头大的石头代替它塞入眼眶，结果却发现它有着魔法属性。

pairs.source: Ogres are straightforward in combat and often suffer as much punishment as they dish out, relying on their strength and stamina to carry them to victory. These serrated-tooth dentures are proof that at least one ogre had all of his teeth knocked out and lived to fight another day.
pairs.text: 食人魔在战斗时总是勇往直前，因此常常会发生杀敌一千自损八百的情况。他们的胜利主要取决于他们的力量和耐力。这些锋利的假牙证明至少有一个食人魔曾被打断了所有的牙齿并活了下来。

pairs.source: A brilliant ogre once had a thought that riding a rylak would make travel much faster than using pack animals or walking. Roughly crafted from thick leather and utilizing an excessive number of knots, this seat could comfortably accommodate an ogre. However, it could only be saddled on a rylak the size of a small mountain which seems to explain why no one has ever seen ogres fly.
pairs.text: 曾有一个聪明的食人魔发现骑乘双头飞龙旅行会比使用驮兽或走路快得多。这个用厚皮和大量绳结草草制成的鞍座可以舒适地承载一个食人魔。但是，它只能装在小山那么大的双头飞龙身上，这或许也解释了为什么人们从没见过飞翔的食人魔。

pairs.source: Assembled fragments from this stone stele place it in Talador several hundred years before the draenei arrived. It marks an ogre imperial decree to raze several orc settlements in retaliation for a number of rebellious raids against Gorian slave trade caravans. The orders were likely carried out, since the towns no longer exist, and this stone was erected to memorialize the dark deed.
pairs.text: 在德莱尼到来之前，这块石碑的碎片已经在塔拉多躺了几百年。上面记载了食人魔皇室发布的捣毁数个兽人定居点的命令，以报复一些叛军突袭高里亚奴隶贸易车队的行为。这些命令应该得到了执行，因为那些城镇已经不复存在了，只有这块石碑静静诉说着那段黑暗的历史。

pairs.source: Imperial ogres jealously guard the secrets of magic in order to keep their status among the ruling class. The wealthiest among them adorn themselves with magically-enhanced jewelry and other wearable artifacts.
pairs.text: 食人魔皇室小心翼翼地保守着魔法的秘密，以确保自己在统治阶层中的地位。他们中间最富有的人会佩戴强化魔法的首饰和其他可佩戴的神器。

pairs.source: The first great technological innovation in ogre society was the concept of attaching a rock to the end of a very long stick to smash your enemies, rather than attempting to bash them with a rock held in your hand. The schism this innovation created amongst ogre society resolved itself only when the now-forgotten tribe broke in to the Warmaul and Boulderfist clans.
pairs.text: 食人魔社会中的首个重大技术创新就是摒弃了用手拿着石头砸人的方法，改为将石头绑在一根非常长的棍子顶端，并用它来击打敌人。这项创新在食人魔社会中引发了巨大的分歧，最终以这个早已被遗忘的部族分裂为战槌和石拳两个氏族而告终。

pairs.source: When Terokk returned from exile he was broken and flightless. Rumors of his cursed state swept like wildfire through the Arakkoa, giving rise to superstitious charms and cures. Dreamcatchers endure as one of the most clung-to icons of safety, for the Arakkoa believe the curse will entangle itself in the dreamcatcher and fade in the morning sunlight.
pairs.text: 当泰罗克结束流亡时，他已经遍体鳞伤，无法飞行。关于他被诅咒的流言像野火一样烧遍了整个鸦人族群，造成了迷信符咒和诅咒的盛行。捕梦网被认为是最保险的护符之一，因为鸦人相信诅咒会被捕梦网缠住，并在清晨的阳光照耀下消散。

pairs.source: In death all Arakkoa seek to join the Sun-God Rukhmar in the skies above Draenor, thus cremation is vastly preferred to burial. Some have their ashes scattered high in the skies, others are collected in ornate urns and placed in crypts.
pairs.text: 所有的鸦人在死后，都希望能升入德拉诺天空中的太阳神鲁克玛的神国。因此火葬就成为他们最偏好的葬礼形式。有些人会将他们的骨灰撒入高空，而其他人则选择用精美的骨灰坛将骨灰收集起来，放入墓穴。

pairs.source: The incomplete writings here seem to indicate a decree of a sort of martial law, and reminders to be vigilant for signs of the curse amongst neighbors and friends.
pairs.text: 上面不完整的文字似乎记载着某种戒严令之类的律令，并暗示人们警惕邻居和朋友中施行诅咒的迹象。

pairs.source: Central to High Arakkoan culture is reverence of Rukhmar and the sun. Hundreds of Solar Orbs are scattered around Skyreach, which cast a never-ending light so no Arakkoan need go without the sun's warmth, even on a cold and overcast day.
pairs.text: 高等鸦人的核心文化就是对鲁克玛和太阳的崇拜。通天峰中散落着数百颗太阳宝珠，它们能散发出无尽的光芒，让鸦人哪怕在阴暗寒冷的日子里也能永远沐浴着温暖的阳光。

pairs.source: This delicately-engraved instrument, when positioned correctly, acts as both a sundial and an arakkoa seasonal calendar. The base of the instrument is covered with callouts for celestial events, most of which are accompanied by grave warnings. Interestingly, the device seems to have cryptically predicted the arrival of the draenei a century before it happened.
pairs.text: 这件雕刻精美的器具只要被放到正确的位置，就能充当日晷和鸦人的历书。它的底座上刻满了各种天文现象的图案，大部分还伴随着严重的警告。有趣的是，这件仪器似乎早在一个世纪前，就模糊地预言了德莱尼的到来。

pairs.source: Believing they have been abandoned by the sun, cursed Arakkoa prefer to hide in the forests or beneath awnings during daylight hours. Talonpriests take this a step further and never show their faces to the sun, wearing ritual masks that act as a focus for their communes with Anzu.
pairs.text: 由于相信自己被太阳抛弃了，这些被诅咒的鸦人更喜欢白天时躲藏在森林里或者遮阳棚下。鸦爪祭司则更进一步，从不将自己的脸暴露在太阳之下。他们终日戴着仪式面具，以帮助他们集中精神与安苏沟通。

pairs.source: Outcast Arakkoa have repurposed the dreamcatcher not to ward off the Curse of Sethe, but to capture and harvest tiny amounts of essences from their lost gods. Rumors persist of an ever-growing mass of swirling energy buried deep beneath Skettis, whispering promises of power to any who will listen...
pairs.text: 鸦人流亡者改造了捕梦网，它不再抵挡塞泰的诅咒，而是捕捉和收集他们失落的诸神散逸出的微量精华。一直有流言称斯克提斯地底深处埋藏着一个不断增长的巨型能量漩涡，并对任何听从于它的人许以力量……

pairs.source: Scattered in the most ancient of ruins on Draenor are fragments and whispers of the Apexis civilization, who attained a height of power during the Age of Order and then abruptly vanished. The arrival of the Iron Horde has prompted a secret but urgent escalation in retrieving Apexis artifacts by the Adherents.
pairs.text: 这些水晶散落在德拉诺最古老的遗迹中，默默诉说着埃匹希斯文明的历史。这个文明在秩序纪元中达到巅峰，然后突然消失。钢铁部落的到来已经揭示了一些秘密，但他们却忙于收集信徒手中的埃匹希斯神器。

pairs.source: Brittle and ancient beyond measure, this stone tablet contains carvings that vaguely describe an engine of incredible power, claiming to harness the power of the sun.
pairs.text: 极度脆弱和古老，这块石板上刻着的文字模糊地描述了一个拥有惊人力量的引擎，并宣称它能驾驭太阳的力量。

pairs.source: This battered scroll case has corroded shut, and the scroll within is barely readable with very careful examination. These appear to be plans and measurements for a glorious "Temple in the Sky," written in an ancient hand. It's unclear whether such a splendid structure was ever built.
pairs.text: 这个破碎的卷轴筒已经锈住了，里面的卷轴只有经过仔细辨别后才能勉强解读。这似乎是一些某个辉煌的“天空神殿”的图纸和测量数据，记载年代非常久远。目前还不清楚这个伟大的建筑是否建成过。

pairs.source: Eschewing traditional Arakkoan weaponry, Terokk carried this cudgel as a symbol of his fall from king to outcast heretic. Rumors have persisted for centuries that rather than employing traditional wing-cutting as a punishment, Terokk simply shattered the beaks of those who dared to oppose him.
pairs.text: 因为不想使用鸦人的传统武器，泰罗克将这把大槌作为他失去王位，沦为被流放的异端的象征。数百年来，一直有传言称，泰罗克从不使用鸦人传统的折翅之刑，而是砸断那些敢于违逆他的鸦人的喙作为惩罚。

pairs.source: Harnessing the power of the sun as a never-ending power source, these constructs were originally built as caretakers for young Arakkoa. With the escalating conflict between the Adherents of Ruhkmar and the Outcasts, many have been repurposed as instruments of war.
pairs.text: 这些构装体使用永不枯竭的太阳能，原本是作为幼年鸦人的保姆使用的。随着鲁克玛信徒和流亡者的冲突逐渐白热化，许多巢穴守卫都被改装成了战争机器。

pairs.source: In life, no two creatures will share a stronger relationship than that of a Frostwolf orc and his or her companion wolf. The two eat, sleep, and fight side by side until one or both dies an honorable death. Even then, sometimes not even death itself can stop a frostwolf from coming to the aid of its beloved orc.
pairs.text: 活着的时候，没有任何生物之间的羁绊比霜狼兽人和他或她的霜狼伙伴更紧密。霜狼与兽人一起进食、睡觉和战斗，直到其中一方或双方都战死沙场。即使如此，有时候死亡也无法阻止霜狼协助它亲爱的兽人。

pairs.source: This well-preserved eye must have once belonged to a chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow clan. Upon ascension to ruler of the clan, each chieftain undertakes a shamanic vision quest in which they sacrifice their own eye to receive a vision of their own death. You can only imagine the grisly fate this clouded eye bore witness to.
pairs.text: 这颗保存完好的眼球一度曾属于血环氏族的某位酋长。当氏族的统治者行将就木时，历代酋长都必须完成一个萨满仪式，通过挖出自己眼球的方式来预见未来的死亡。你可以想象到这颗浑浊不清的眼球在被挖出时所见证到的可怕命运。

pairs.source: The Highborne's penchant for all things purple predates the War of the Ancients. Glass bowls were fairly common, and used to hold anything from grain to gold ingots.
pairs.text: 上层精灵对一切紫色物品的嗜好可以追溯到上古之战之前。玻璃碗是很常见的器具，从谷粒到金锭都可以用它来盛装。

pairs.source: Many Highborne superstitiously carried bits of leystone as a lucky charm. Such charms were typically worn by rural farmers, struggling academy students, or those sitting on the cusp between commonfolk and nobility.
pairs.text: 许多迷信的上层精灵会随身携带一些魔石碎片，当作幸运护身符。佩带这种咒符的一般是乡下的农夫，为功课烦恼的学生，或是那些夹在平民与贵族之间左右为难的官吏。

pairs.source: "Quietwine" was an ancient Highborne term that simply meant "poison". Ironically, after ten thousand years in the ground, the substance typically loses its lethality and becomes a mild intoxicant.
pairs.text: “鸩酒”是古代上层精灵所用的一种毒药。讽刺的是，在地下埋藏了一万年之后，这种酒已经失去了致命的毒性，变成了一种温和的麻醉品。

pairs.source: Tapestries woven before the time of Queen Azshara's pact with the demons typically display a unique "under-over-over" style of needlework that has not been seen since.
pairs.text: 在艾萨拉女王与恶魔勾结之前，那个时代出品的挂毯上经常会展现出独特的“回针”绣法，这种技法在战后已经销声匿迹。

pairs.source: As is always the case with letter openers, this is a completely useless tool, kept only as an excuse to have a murder weapon nearby in situations where it would be socially unwise to carry a dagger.
pairs.text: 和普通的拆信刀一样，这通常是一种毫无用处的工具，之所以将它带在身边，只是为了在一些不方便携带匕首的场合当作凶器使用。

pairs.source: Not all Highmountain tauren were hunters, but those that were typically commemorated their first kill with a ceremonial drum, stretched with the hide of their quarry. Most trailhead drums are made with rabbithide or foxhide. Hunters typically carried them for the rest of their lives.
pairs.text: 并非每一个至高岭牛头人都是猎人，但通常每位猎人都会用一面仪式战鼓来作为自己第一次杀死猎物的纪念，制作这面鼓用的皮子就是从那只猎物身上剥下来的。大多数启程之鼓是用兔皮或狐皮做成的。这面战鼓往往会伴随猎人度过他的一生。

pairs.source: Moosebone was, at the time, the most common material for fishhooks: solid enough carve a barb into, but pliable enough not to break off in the mouth of a large salmon. Many fishermen carved elaborate designs into their "lucky hooks".
pairs.text: 在当时，鹿骨是最常用来制作鱼钩的材料：足够坚固，可以刻出倒刺；同时又有足够的韧性，不会在巨大的鲑鱼嘴里被折断。许多渔民会在他们的“幸运鱼钩”上雕刻精心设计的图案。

pairs.source: It was customary for a widow, child, or grandchild to keep a pyrestone from the funeral pyre of an especially loved one. These stones were carried in a pocket and rubbed for courage, comfort, or in rememberance of a lost companionship.
pairs.text: 根据当地人的习俗，在心爱的人死去后，伴侣或子孙会保留一块火葬堆中烧过的石头。他们会把石头装在袋子里随身带着，时时拿出来擦拭，以获取勇气、寻求安慰、或是表达对逝者的思念。

pairs.source: While most drogbar appreciated the rough edges of a raw gemstone, others preferred a smoother, rounder jewel. Rather than using standard gemcutting tools, they used a hand-cranked stone device, which tumbled the gems over the course of several weeks. These were typically operated by servants, slaves, or disobedient youngsters.
pairs.text: 虽然大多数卓格巴尔都喜欢原始状态下宝石粗糙的棱角，但有些卓格巴尔更青睐光滑浑圆的珠宝。他们不会使用标准的宝石切割工具，而是把它们放到带手柄的石头容器里，翻滚上几个星期时间。操作这些工具的往往是仆人、奴隶或是不服管教的年轻人。

pairs.source: The limbs of the bow are carved from a rock-hard tree wood, which make it nearly impossible to draw. Archaeologists disagree as to whether the bow was originally so hard, or whether the wood simply petrified with age. Either way, the size and heft of the bow suggest that it was only used by the most practiced of tauren hunters.
pairs.text: 弓背是用一块岩石般坚硬的木材刻成的，几乎没法拉开。这把弓是从一开始就这么坚硬，还是因为随着时光的流逝石化了？考古学家们一直争论不休。无论如何，它的尺寸与重量都表明，只有最富有经验的牛头人猎人才能够使用它。

pairs.source: Imps have to drink too, and many prefer to bring their own cup with them. Some theorize that an ancient imp-like race revered their drinking vessels as something sacred, and a part of that ritual remained even after they were indoctrinated into the Burning Legion.
pairs.text: 小鬼也是要喝水的，许多小鬼会随身携带自己的水杯。有些人认为，古代那些像小鬼一样的恶魔族群会将它们喝水用的容器当作圣物来崇拜，直到它们被燃烧军团收编之后，这些水杯仍然作为仪式的一部分被保留了下来。

pairs.source: Different breeds of demon exhibit different behaviors between battles. Succubi, for example, have a tendency to keep detailed logs of their day-to-day activities. Their accounts are often lurid, almost always grotesque, and were typically written onto "paper" made from the skin of an enemy or a captive.
pairs.text: 在战斗的间隙，不同类型的恶魔会表现出不同的行为。比如说，魅魔喜欢详细地记下她们每天的作所作为。她们的描述总是耸人听闻，有时甚至荒诞不经。这些记载通常会写在用她们的敌人或俘虏的皮肤做成的“纸”上。

pairs.source: The ritual to summon an abyssal is complicated, and often fails. When a failure occurs, a small piece of the demon typically remains behind, seething with a combination of latent demonic rage and despair at its own dysfunction. Ancient battlegrounds are littered with such stones.
pairs.text: 召唤深渊魔的仪式非常复杂，而且经常失败。当仪式失败的时候，经常会留下一小块恶魔的碎片，恶魔的怒火及它对自己无能的绝望在碎片中翻腾着。古代的战场上到处都散布着这样的石头。

pairs.source: Chaos does not come easily to all demons - some struggle with the ways of the Burning Legion. Those that did often carried an enchanted orb that invoked the rage required of any good demon. It is not known how the orbs were made, or who made them.
pairs.text: 并非所有恶魔都能适应混乱，有些恶魔会反感燃烧军团的所作所为。这种恶魔往往会携带一颗魔法宝珠，用来激起一只优秀的恶魔所必不可少的怒火。没有人知道这些宝珠是怎样做成的，或是谁制作了它们。

pairs.source: A massive piece of "mail" chest armor, crafted entirely out of demonic hounds' teeth. The points of the teeth face upward and inward, making the armor impossible to remove once worn - that is, impossible to remove without tearing the flesh of the wearer.
pairs.text: 一套“链式”胸甲，全部由恶魔猎犬的牙齿连缀而成。牙齿的齿尖在胸甲的内侧，整齐地朝上排列着，只要一穿上就绝不可能脱下来——准确地说，不把穿它的人撕扯得血肉模糊，绝不可能脱下来。

pairs.source: This handheld device was used by star-augurs to focus immense amounts of starlight into a small, concentrated area.  The device was mainly used during festivals, star-worship rituals, or when the augur needed to reach something on a high shelf.
pairs.text: 占星师使用这个手持装置将大量星光聚焦在一小块区域。这个装置主要在节庆和拜星仪式期间使用，也会用于占星师拿不到书架顶部物品的时候。

pairs.source: The ruling princes and princesses in Suramar chose only to wear their crowns at the most formal events.  They were kept locked up at all other times, and were considered unstylish.
pairs.text: 苏拉玛当权的王子和公主喜欢只在出席最正式的场合时戴上王冠。其他时候这些王冠都被锁了起来，形态并不时髦。

pairs.source: Black Rook Hold was maintained and upkept by a small army of servants.  One such servant was named Kalyndras, who was responsible for overseeing the Hold's armory and munitions storage.  Like most of Ravencrest's servants, he fell to demons during the War of the Ancients.
pairs.text: 黑鸦堡垒由一批仆从驻守维护，其中一人名为卡林达斯，负责看管堡垒的军械辎重。和大多数拉文凯斯的追随者一样，他在上古之战中败给了恶魔大军。

pairs.source: This immensely powerful Highborne spell focus was shattered in a reckless archaeological expedition. Its shards are all that remain.
pairs.text: 这个无比强大的上层精灵法术核心在一次鲁莽的考古勘测中弄碎，现在只剩下这些碎片。

pairs.source: This key does not open any door.  Rather, it is a ceremonial gesture of invitation to the Academy, as a way of saying, "Our doors are open to you."
pairs.text: 这把钥匙无法打开任何一扇门，但它象征着学院的邀请，仿佛在说“我们的大门为你敞开。”

pairs.source: Revered by miners and blacksmiths, Rethu Ironhorn was one of the first tauren settlers in the Broken Isles.  His descendants carry on his tradition of metalworking at Ironhorn Enclave, near the peak of Highmountain.
pairs.text: 受到广大矿工和铁匠拥戴的瑞苏·铁角是第一批来到破碎群岛的牛头人拓荒者之一，他的后裔在至高岭顶峰附近的铁角飞地延续了他善于打磨金属的传统。

pairs.source: The drogbar have always been masters at jewelcrafting.  In particular, tribal shaman would wear heavy, three-stoned necklaces.  These necklaces were passed down from master to student.
pairs.text: 卓格巴尔向来是珠宝加工的大师。具体来说，原始部落的萨满祭司会佩戴由三颗石头制成的沉重项链，而这些项链由一代代师父传给他们的徒弟。

pairs.source: Eche'ro was the pet, mount, and battle companion of Huln Highmountain, legendary hero of the War of the Ancients.
pairs.text: 艾特洛是上古之战传奇英雄胡恩·高岭的宠物、坐骑和战斗伙伴。

pairs.source: The eye of a powerful demon, preserved in the cold, stony ground of Stormheim. Writings from the time of the War of the Ancients state that Undravius was a fel lord commander with designs on removing all life from Azeroth.
pairs.text: 强大恶魔的眼睛，保存在风暴峡湾的冰冷石头地面中。根据上古之战时期的文献记载，邪能领主统帅乌达维斯的目标是消灭艾泽拉斯所有的生命。

pairs.source: Under the guidance of uncooperative mo'arg engineers, demon hunters were able to create several of these portals to Mardum.  Unfortunately, they never quite caught on, as they usually let more demons out than in.
pairs.text: 在并不甘愿合作的莫尔葛工程师的指引下，恶魔猎手创造出了许多这样的传送门前往马顿。不幸的是，他们对这些传送门疏于管范，致使从传送门中前来的恶魔比过去的多得多。

pairs.source: Many a reckless adventurer has met her end by activating one of these devices without knowing its function.  It is often unclear as to whether its activation will summon a single imp or a legion of pit lords.
pairs.text: 许多鲁莽的冒险者在不知道这些装置有什么功能的情况下启动了它们，从而不幸被夺去性命。没有人清楚开启这些装置会召唤一只小鬼，还是一整支深渊领主军队。

pairs.source: It is unclear why any being - demonic or Azerothian - would choose to put themselves on Mannoroth's bad side by keeping some of his blood in a jar.
pairs.text: 时至今日人们仍然不明白，为什么有些生物，不管是恶魔还是艾泽拉斯的居民，会选择将玛诺洛斯的血放在罐子里来加入他的邪恶阵营。

pairs.source: In their haste, the draenei brought few artifacts with them as they left Argus.  This book is one of the few relics that has survived the trip to this day.
pairs.text: 匆忙中，德莱尼人离开阿古斯过程中只带走了少许几件神器。这本书籍是保存至今日的少数遗物之一。

pairs.source: Bring Brewmaster Bo to the Unga Ingoo Brewing Cauldron.
pairs.text: 护送珀酒仙去盎迦猴岛的酿酒大锅。

pairs.source: Bring 200 Unga Jungle Brew to the Brewing Cauldron.
pairs.text: 带上200桶盎迦丛林酒去酿酒大锅。
击败被腐蚀的影踪派高手。

pairs.source: Delve deeper into the crypt and search the bottom level.
pairs.text: 深度挖掘地穴并搜索地穴的底层。

pairs.source: Defeat the monsters attacking the Greenstone villagers.
pairs.text: 击败那些攻击绿石村民的怪物。

pairs.source: Find burgled brew barrels in the forest and return them to the village dojo.
pairs.text: 从森林里找回失窃的酒桶，并将它们送回村里的道场。

pairs.source: Defeat the Sha corrupted forces inside the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
pairs.text: 击败青龙寺内被煞能腐蚀的敌人。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces creating chaos within the Stormstout Brewery.
pairs.text: 击败在风暴烈酒酿造厂内制造混换的敌人。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces opposing you within the Shado-Pan Monastery.
pairs.text: 击败影踪禅院内和你作对的敌人。

pairs.source: Defeat the Mantid forces assaulting the Gate of the Setting Sun.
pairs.text: 击败攻击残阳关的螳螂妖军队。

pairs.source: Defeat the Mantid forces sieging the Niuzao Temple.
pairs.text: 击败围攻砮皂寺的螳螂妖军队。

pairs.source: Defeat the necromantic forces within Scholomance.
pairs.text: 击败通灵学院内的巫师军团。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of the Scarlet Crusade.
Travel to the Masons' Quarter and awaken the unconscious villagers.
pairs.text: 前往绿石工匠区并唤醒失去意识的村民。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of the Scarlet Crusade inside their monastery.
pairs.text: 击败修道院里的血色十字军。

pairs.source: Summon and defeat the mighty dragon turtle, Scar-Shell.
pairs.text: 召唤并击败强大的龙龟——刀疤壳。

pairs.source: Summon and defeat the grummle-eating, snow-stalking horror, Jol'Grum.
pairs.text: 召唤并击败土地精的梦魇、雪山的魔王——乔古鲁。

pairs.source: Summon and defeat the playful fire spirit, Liuyang.
pairs.text: 召唤并击败淘气的火灵——小流炀。

pairs.source: Summon and defeat the wandering yaungol warrior, Chagan Firehoof.
pairs.text: 召唤并击败流浪的野牛人战士——查干·焰蹄。

pairs.source: Summon and defeat the final challenger and then claim your reward from Wodin!
pairs.text: 召唤并击败最终的挑战者，然后向伍迪索要奖品！

pairs.source: Help Brewmaster Boof's assistants gather the ingredients for the Kun-Lai Kicker.
pairs.text: 帮酒仙布夫的助手收集昆莱劲酒的酿造材料。

pairs.source: Stop the Bataari invasion on Binan Village.
pairs.text: 阻止巴塔里野牛人对滨岸村的入侵。

pairs.source: Assist Blanche in brewing her famous Boomer's Brew.
pairs.text: 帮助布兰琪酿造她远近闻名的闪电佳酿。
护送布兰琪前往雷掌之路。

pairs.source: Defeat General Zhun, Herald of the Thunder King.
pairs.text: 击败雷电之王的传令官——烛桓将军。

pairs.source: Rescue the captured Golden Lotus expedition.
pairs.text: 营救被抓的金莲教远征队。
阻止游学者福云被处死。

pairs.source: Defeat the defenders of the four ancient Mogu artifacts.
pairs.text: 击败守护四个古代魔古神器的守护者。

pairs.source: Fight past the enemy into the heart of ruined Theramore.
pairs.text: 杀开一条血路，深入塞拉摩废墟的核心。

pairs.source: Slay Alliance captains and rig powder barrels on all ships.
pairs.text: 击败联盟队长并在全船安放炸药桶。

pairs.source: Inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse of your success.
pairs.text: 将你成功的消息告诉爆破大师光油。
杀死巴德拉克和他的狮鹫。

pairs.source: Destroy Big Bessa and sabotage any unmanned tanks.
pairs.text: 摧毁大贝莎，并破坏无人驾驶的坦克。

pairs.source: Slay Hedric Evencane and free Thalen Songweaver from Foothold Citadel.
pairs.text: 杀死赫德里克·伊文凯恩并释放囚禁在塞拉摩堡垒的萨伦·织歌者。

pairs.source: Destroy the siege engine at the west gate and recover the stolen standards.
pairs.text: 摧毁西边城门的攻城车，并找回失窃的旗帜。

pairs.source: Protect Jaina while she attunes to the Focusing Iris.
pairs.text: 在吉安娜调校聚焦之虹时保护她。

pairs.source: Defend the ship from oncoming Horde.
pairs.text: 保护船只免遭部落的侵袭。

pairs.source: Defeat the monsters attacking Greenstone's dojo.
pairs.text: 击败围攻绿石道场的怪物。

pairs.source: Defeat the Horde in the harbor.
pairs.text: 击败海港内的部落之敌。

pairs.source: Cleanse the Sha corruption from the Pool of Life.
pairs.text: 为生命之池消除煞能腐蚀。

pairs.source: Locate Jaina in the Mana Bomb crater.
pairs.text: 在法力炸弹的弹坑内找到吉安娜。

pairs.source: Find the entrance to the Saurok Cave.
pairs.text: 找到蜥蜴人洞穴的入口。

pairs.source: Defeat the Saurok guarding the cave.
pairs.text: 击败守卫洞穴的蜥蜴人。

pairs.source: Find the source of the Saurok.
Destroy the orbs of protection and make your way into the fortress.
pairs.text: 摧毁防御宝珠并进入堡垒。

pairs.source: Grab as much treasure as you can before the titan construct is released.
pairs.text: 在泰坦构造体出现前尽力攫取宝藏。

pairs.source: Launch an assault on the island of Zan'vess.
pairs.text: 对扎尼维斯岛发动袭击。

pairs.source: Destroy the Sonic Towers and deactivate the Zan'vess Defense Shield.
pairs.text: 摧毁声波塔并关闭扎尼维斯的防护盾。

pairs.source: Storm the beach and reach the Heart of Zan'vess.
pairs.text: 突袭海滩并抵达扎尼维斯之心。

pairs.source: Protect the Ship!  Defeat the Horde Boarding party.
pairs.text: 保护舰船！击退部落登船小队。

pairs.source: Plant explosives on the Horde Ship to destroy it!
pairs.text: 在部落舰船上安放炸药并将其摧毁！

pairs.source: Speak with Vol'jin to begin the search for the Saurok cave.
pairs.text: 与沃金交谈并开始搜索蜥蜴人洞穴。

pairs.source: Make your way deeper into the cave.
Defeat Commander Tel'vrak and retrieve the Mantid weapon cache.
pairs.text: 击败指挥官泰尔伏拉克并夺回螳螂妖武器库。

pairs.source: Assist the two groups of laborers in the construction of their defenses.
pairs.text: 协助两队劳工建造防御工事。

pairs.source: Avoid the guards and enter the Sanctuary of Shadows.
pairs.text: 躲开守卫，进入暗影圣殿。

pairs.source: Find the Council of the Black Harvest's trail.
pairs.text: 找到黑暗收割议会的踪迹。

pairs.source: Search for signs of the Council's Presence
Walk with Akama to the Shrine of Lost Souls.
pairs.text: 与阿卡玛一同前往失落灵魂神殿。

pairs.source: Follow Akama to the Shrine of Lost Souls
pairs.text: 跟随阿卡玛前往失落灵魂神殿。

pairs.source: Defeat Commander Scargash and reclaim the Temple of the Red Crane.
pairs.text: 击败指挥官斯卡戈什并夺回朱鹤寺。

pairs.source: Investigate the Shrine of Lost Souls.
Claim the soul crystal left behind by the Council of the Black Harvest.
pairs.text: 夺取黑暗收割议会留下的灵魂水晶。

pairs.source: Fight off the demons unleashed by the Reliquary and return to Akama in the Halls of Anguish.
pairs.text: 击退灵魂之匣施放出的恶魔并返回苦痛大厅找阿卡玛。

pairs.source: Escape the Shrine of Lost Souls
Grab as much treasure as you can before time runs out.
pairs.text: 在时间用完前尽可能多的夺取宝藏。

pairs.source: Plunder the Den of Mortal Delights
Take the Empowered Soulcore to the Temple Summit.
pairs.text: 获得充能的灵魂之核并前往神殿之巅。

pairs.source: Fight your way through the docks to Admiral Taylor.
pairs.text: 杀进码头，去找海军上将泰勒。

pairs.source: Defeat the Horde forces assaulting the keep.
pairs.text: 击败攻打要塞的部落部队。

pairs.source: Gather information from the SI:7 team.
pairs.text: 从军情七处队伍中收集情报。

pairs.source: Hold the keep against waves of Horde invaders and their commander.
pairs.text: 守住堡垒，击退部落入侵者及其指挥官。

pairs.source: Launch an assault on the island of Zan'vess.
pairs.text: 对扎尼维斯岛发动袭击。

pairs.source: Destroy the Sonic Towers and deactivate the Zan'vess Defense Shield.
pairs.text: 摧毁声波塔并关闭扎尼维斯的防护盾。

pairs.source: Storm the beach and reach the Heart of Zan'vess.
pairs.text: 突袭海滩并抵达扎尼维斯之心。

pairs.source: Defeat Commander Tel'vrak and retrieve the Mantid weapon cache.
pairs.text: 击败指挥官泰尔伏拉克并夺回螳螂妖武器库。

pairs.source: Locate High Marshal Twinbraid and help repel the Horde assault.
pairs.text: 找到大元帅双辫并帮忙击退部落的袭击。

pairs.source: Set up Sully's weapons and prepare to defend the keep!
pairs.text: 组装苏利的武器并准备守卫要塞！

pairs.source: Fight your way through the burning refinery to General Nazgrim.
pairs.text: 杀进着火的炼油厂，去找纳兹戈林将军。

pairs.source: Defeat the Alliance forces assaulting the keep.
pairs.text: 击败攻打要塞的联盟部队。

pairs.source: Locate Warlord Bloodhilt and help repel the Alliance assault.
pairs.text: 找到血柄督军并帮忙击退联盟的袭击。

pairs.source: Gather information about the Alliance and Horde forces.
pairs.text: 收集联盟和部落军队的情报。

pairs.source: Set up Rivett's weapons and prepare to defend the keep!
pairs.text: 组装利维特的武器并准备守卫要塞！

pairs.source: Hold the gate against waves of Alliance invaders and their commander.
pairs.text: 守住大门，击退联盟入侵者及其指挥官。

pairs.source: Ride Thunderwing to scout Stormsea Landing from the air.
pairs.text: 骑乘雷霆翼龙从空中侦察风暴之海码头。

pairs.source: Drop smoke bombs on sentry totems to deactivate them.
pairs.text: 对岗哨图腾投掷烟雾弹，使其瘫痪。

pairs.source: Knock Out the crew members marked by Taoshi and sneak to the siege weapons at the front of the ship.
pairs.text: 击倒被陶矢标记的船员，并溜到位于船只前方的攻城武器处。

pairs.source: Sneak across the shipyard and up the hill to reach Hu'seng the Gatekeeper.
pairs.text: 潜行穿过船坞并继续上山，直到找到守门人虎申。

pairs.source: Slay Hu'seng the Gatekeeper and recover his key.
pairs.text: 击败守门人虎申并获得他的钥匙。

pairs.source: Mount the Sunreaver Bloodhawk and fly with Scout Captain Elsia over the island.
pairs.text: 骑上夺日者血鹰，与斥候队长艾尔希娅一起飞过岛屿。
与斥候队长艾尔希娅会合

pairs.source: Kill Arcanital Tula'chek and his Spirit Mask
pairs.text: 击败魔术士图拉奇克和他的灵魂面具

pairs.source: The Zandalari have spotted you! Defeat your attackers!
pairs.text: 赞达拉巨魔发现你了！击败进攻者！

pairs.source: Horaki has knocked you from your mount! Defeat him!
pairs.text: 胡拉奇把你打下了坐骑！打败他！

pairs.source: Meet up with Taoshi, your Shado-Pan Contact.
pairs.text: 与你的影踪派联络人陶矢会面。

pairs.source: Cover Taoshi while she deactivates the lock on the mine door, and defeat Slavemaster Shiaxu.
pairs.text: 在陶矢解除矿脉门锁时掩护她，并击败奴隶主夏旭。

pairs.source: Work with your allies to assault Bloodied Crossing.
pairs.text: 与你的盟友一起突袭血腥岔路口。

pairs.source: Defeat Shan Bu's Mogu and Zandalari defenders.
pairs.text: 击败山怖麾下的魔古族和赞达拉防御者。

pairs.source: Defeat the Palace Gatekeepers to unlock the gates.
pairs.text: 击败宫殿守门人并且打开大门。

pairs.source: Light the fuse on the Heavy Explosives.
Light the fuse on the Heavy Explosives.
Speak to Elsia at the city wall.
pairs.text: 去城墙边和艾尔希娅交谈。

pairs.source: Speak with Vereesa at the city wall.
pairs.text: 去城墙边和温蕾萨交谈。

pairs.source: Assist Taran Zhu and Yalia in bringing down Shan Bu.
pairs.text: 协助祝踏岚和雅丽亚打倒山怖。

pairs.source: Head below decks and assassinate Captain Halu'kal.
pairs.text: 走下甲板并刺杀哈鲁卡尔船长。

pairs.source: Defend Wrathion while the Thunder Forge charges.
pairs.text: 在雷霆熔炉充能时保护拉希奥。

pairs.source: Defend the Celestial Blacksmith while it forges the Lightning Lance.
pairs.text: 在天界工匠锻铸闪电长枪时保护他。

pairs.source: Defeat the Sha Amalgamation assaulting the Thunder Forge.
pairs.text: 击败袭击雷霆熔炉的融合之煞。

pairs.source: Make your way to the mine's main door.

pairs.text: 你的矿洞就是我的矿洞！

pairs.source: Speak with Wrathion to figure out how to activate the Thunder Forge.
pairs.text: 与拉希奥交谈，找出激活雷霆熔炉的方法。

pairs.source: Place the Empowered Soulcore in the Demonic Soulwell, and defeat Kanrethad.
pairs.text: 将充能的灵魂之核放入恶魔灵魂井并击败坎雷萨德。

pairs.source: Pour the trillium into the molds and begin charging the Thunder Forge.
pairs.text: 将延极矿倒入模具并开始为雷霆熔炉充能。

pairs.source: Mount the Silver Covenant Hippogryph and fly with Ranger General Vereesa Windrunner over the island.
pairs.text: 骑上银色盟约角鹰兽，与游侠将军温蕾萨·风行者一起飞过岛屿。

pairs.source: Rendezvous with Ranger General Vereesa Windrunner
pairs.text: 与游侠将军温蕾萨·风行者会合
击败安基和驭兽师帕库特什

pairs.source: Kill Arcanital Mara'kah and his Spirit Mask
pairs.text: 击败魔术士玛拉卡和他的灵魂面具

pairs.source: Use the Gatekeeper's Orb to open the gate to the Bloodied Crossing.
pairs.text: 使用守门人的宝珠，打开通向血腥岔路口的大门。

pairs.source: You will only have a limited amount of time to gather as much treasure as you can.  Speak to Taoshi when you're ready to begin.
pairs.text: 你必须在有限的时间内尽可能多夺取一些宝藏。当你准备好开始后，就与陶矢谈一谈。

pairs.source: Talk to Wrathion to start the Thunder Forge
pairs.text: 与拉希奥交谈以启动雷霆熔炉

pairs.source: Grab as much treasure as you can and reach the exit before the timer expires.
pairs.text: 在倒计时结束前尽可能多夺取一些宝藏并抵达出口。

pairs.source: Breach the main chamber and stop the abductions.
pairs.text: 攻破主厅并阻止绑架犯。

pairs.source: Help Ticker build a device to open the next gate.
pairs.text: 帮助钟摆建造装置以打开下一道大门。

pairs.source: Defend the Gob Squad while Patch establishes an escape route.
pairs.text: 在补丁启动逃生装置时保护地精小队。

pairs.source: Destroy the greater elemental ravaging the Big Blossom Excavation site.
pairs.text: 消灭破坏繁盛挖掘场的大型元素生物。

pairs.source: Collect artifacts for Gearslip while his workers clear the mine entrance.
pairs.text: 在轮滑的手下们清理矿洞入口的同时帮他收集遗物。

pairs.source: Travel deep into the Big Blossom Mine and blast open the wall.
pairs.text: 深入繁盛矿洞并炸开洞壁。

pairs.source: Contact the Dark Iron Mountaineers atop Shimmer Ridge and find a way to stop the storm.
pairs.text: 到闪光岭上与黑铁巡山人联络并找出终止风暴的方法。

pairs.source: Free Scout Stonebeard from the trolls' roasting spit.
pairs.text: 救下巨魔烤肉架上的斥候石须。

pairs.source: Slay the trolls trying to cook Scout Boldbrew.
pairs.text: 消灭试图烹饪斥候粗酿的巨魔。

pairs.source: Slay the trolls about to sacrifice Scout Forgefellow.
pairs.text: 消灭打算献祭斥候炉匠的巨魔。

pairs.source: Slay the elemental spirit in the ice cave to end the snowstorm.
pairs.text: 杀死冰封洞穴中的元素之灵以终止暴风雪。

pairs.source: Join Moira's forces, slay the Zandalari leader, and capture the Frostmane village.
pairs.text: 加入茉艾拉的部队，击败赞达拉领袖并占领霜鬃村落。
从敌方爆破手处窃取炸药。

pairs.source: Speak to Rotun to begin a trial.
pairs.text: 与罗敦交谈以开启试炼。

pairs.source: Complete the Bonus Objective to receive bonus Valor.
pairs.text: 完成奖励目标，获得额外的勇气点数。

pairs.source: Complete the Bonus Objective to receive bonus Valor.
pairs.text: 完成獎勵目標以獲取額外的勇氣點數。

pairs.source: Protect the Ship!  Defeat the Alliance Boarding party.
pairs.text: 保护舰船！击退联盟登船小队。
从敌方爆破手处窃取炸药。

pairs.source: Plant explosives on the Alliance Ship to destroy it!
pairs.text: 在联盟舰船上安放炸药并将其摧毁！

pairs.text: 完成奖励目标以获取额外的勇气点数。

pairs.text: 完成獎勵目標以獲得額外的勇氣點數。

pairs.source: Complete all Bonus Objectives to receive bonus Valor.
pairs.text: 完成所有的奖励目标，额外获得勇气点数。

pairs.text: 完成奖励目标，获得额外的勇气点数。

pairs.text: 完成獎勵目標以獲得額外的勇氣點數。

pairs.source: The trial is about to begin.
Destroy the abomination that haunts the Black Ox Temple.
Defeat three champions of Pandaria in a pet battle.
pairs.text: 在一场宠物对战中击败三名潘达利亚勇士。

pairs.source: Defeat each of the Celestials in a pet battle.
pairs.text: 在宠物对战中分别击败四位至尊天神。

pairs.source: Seat and serve the customers as they show up. Don't let 5 patrons get away without being served.
pairs.text: 在客人出现后招呼他们落座并为其上菜。因受冷落而离开的客人不能超过5个。

pairs.source: Seat and serve the customers as they show up. Don't let 5 patrons get away without being served.
pairs.text: 讓登門的客人就座並送上餐點。別讓5名以上的客人還沒用餐就離開。

pairs.source: Learn how to run the noodle stand.
Seat and serve the customers as they show up. Don't let 5 patrons get away without being served.
pairs.text: 尽你所能招呼更多的客人。因受冷落而离开的客人不能超过5个。

pairs.source: Seat and serve the customers as they show up. Don't let 5 patrons get away without being served.
pairs.text: 招呼與服務上門的客人。別讓還沒用餐就離開的客人超過5名。

pairs.source: Get a score of at least 30,000
Get a score of at least 30,000

pairs.text: 消灭格罗玛尔的所有兽人。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of the Death's Head Quilboar inside their city of Razorfen Kraul.
pairs.text: 击败剃刀沼泽内的亡首野猪人大军。

pairs.source: Mine as much as you can before you run out of Steam Power!
pairs.text: 在失去蒸汽能力前尽可能多采集一些矿石！

pairs.source: Slay Goraluk Anvilcrack, High Machinist of the Naval Base.
pairs.text: 击败海军基地的高级技师古拉鲁克。
消灭斯通纳德里的守卫。

pairs.source: Stop the Bleeding Hollow Soul Shaman from reanimating the Fomor skeleton.
pairs.text: 阻止血环灵魂萨满复活匠灵的遗骸。

pairs.source: Defend Thrall until he breaches the inner chamber.
pairs.text: 保护萨尔攻入内部大厅。

pairs.source: Confront Kilrogg Deadeye and stop the dark ritual.
pairs.text: 击败基尔罗格·死眼并阻止黑暗仪式。

pairs.source: Clear the remaining orcs from the docks and slay Commander Vorka.
pairs.text: 肃清码头上的兽人残兵并击败指挥官沃尔卡。

pairs.source: Kill inhabitants of rooms to extinguish runes.
pairs.text: 消灭房间内的人以熄灭符文。
