pairs.text: 调查植物丛生的肯瑞托岗哨。

pairs.source: Investigate the overgrown Kirin Tor outpost.
pairs.text: 调查植物丛生的肯瑞托岗哨。

pairs.source: Use the artifact to eliminate your enemies.
pairs.text: 使用神器消灭你的敌人。

pairs.source: Defeat the incoming enemies using the power of the artifact.
pairs.text: 使用神器力量击败来犯的敌人。

pairs.source: Kill inhabitants of rooms to extinguish runes.
pairs.text: 消灭房间内的人以熄灭符文。

pairs.source: Defeat the Ironmarch forces occupying the halls of the Spire.
pairs.text: 击败占据了黑石塔大厅的铁军部队。

pairs.source: Defeat the bosses of Lower Blackrock Spires
pairs.text: 击败黑石塔下层的首领

pairs.source: Gazlowe and Thaelin have repaired an Iron Star that can take you to the harbor.
pairs.text: 加兹鲁维和塞林弄到了一台可以送你前往港口的钢铁之星。
击杀所有的角斗士对手

pairs.source: Take the elevator to the arena
pairs.text: 乘坐升降机前往竞技场

pairs.source: Defeat the Iron Horde scouting party.
pairs.text: 击败钢铁部落的斥候小队。

pairs.source: Kill inhabitants of rooms to extinguish runes.
pairs.text: 消灭房间内的人以熄灭符文。

pairs.source: Defeat the Ironmarch forces occupying the halls of the Spire.
pairs.text: 击败占据了黑石塔大厅的铁军部队。

pairs.source: Defeat the remaining Iron Horde forces.
pairs.text: 击败钢铁部落的残余部队。
击败影月氏族的残余部队。

pairs.source: Defeat the remaining Shadow Council forces
pairs.text: 击败暗影议会的残余部队。
击败高里亚帝国的残余部队。
击败鬣蜥人的残余部队。
击败雷神氏族的残余部队。
击败影月氏族的残余部队。

pairs.source: Destroy Jailer Zerus and save Highlord Tirion Fordring.
pairs.text: 消灭狱卒泽鲁斯并解救大领主提里奥·弗丁。

pairs.source: Find the Ashbringer within the Lost Temple.
pairs.text: 在失落的神庙中找到灰烬使者。

pairs.source: Lead the paladins of the Argent Crusade into battle.
pairs.text: 率领银色北伐军的圣骑士奔赴战场。

pairs.source: Destroy all demons and structures on the beach.
pairs.text: 消灭海滩上所有的恶魔，毁掉所有建筑。

pairs.source: Protect the Tidestone from the naga.
pairs.text: 保护潮汐之石不落入纳迦之手。
消灭玛乔图和深海领主哈沃布尼

pairs.source: Slay the nightfallen that are feeding on the Tidestone.
pairs.text: 消灭试图吸取潮汐之石力量的堕夜精灵。

pairs.source: Protect the Tidestone from the withered.
pairs.text: 保护潮汐之手不落入枯法者之手。

pairs.source: Destroy the demon portal to stop reinforcements.
pairs.text: 摧毁恶魔之门以阻挡援军。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at Gadgetzan.
pairs.text: 解除燃烧军团对加基森的威胁。

pairs.source: Use the Deck Guns to shoot down Forsaken Dreadwings
pairs.text: 使用甲板炮击落被遗忘者恐翼蝙蝠

pairs.source: Head below decks and use a Skyfire Parachute to board the Forsaken ships and defeat their captains.
pairs.text: 前往甲板下方，使用天火号降落伞登上被遗忘者的战舰，击败他们的舰长。

pairs.source: Remove Volatile Flares from Skyfire bomb bay.
pairs.text: 移除天火号弹药舱中的易爆炸弹。
找到瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。

pairs.source: Defeat Nathanos Blightcaller on the deck of the Skyfire.
pairs.text: 在天火号的甲板上击败纳萨诺斯·凋零者。

pairs.source: Quell the Infernal Uprising on Kirin Tor Shore.
pairs.text: 压制肯瑞托海滩的地狱火攻势。

pairs.source: Defend the research station from the Fel Lord.
pairs.text: 保卫研究站，抵抗邪能领主。
向希尔瓦娜斯·风行者报告

pairs.source: Ride with Nathanos to the Eternity and use a Forsaken Catapult to shoot down Skyfire Gryphon Riders.
pairs.text: 与纳萨诺斯一同前往永恒号，使用被遗忘者投石车击落天火号狮鹫骑士。

pairs.source: Ride with Nathanos to the Blightcaller and slay incoming 7th Legion forces.
pairs.text: 与纳萨诺斯一同前往凋零使徒号，消灭所有来袭的第七军团部队。

pairs.source: Ride with Nathanos to the Black Rose and rid the ship of worgen.
pairs.text: 与纳萨诺斯一同前往黑玫瑰号，清除船上的狼人。

pairs.source: Ride with Nathanos to the Skyfire and rig Volatile Flares to the ammunition stockpiles.
pairs.text: 与纳萨诺斯一同突袭天火号，在军火物资旁放置易爆炸弹。

pairs.source: Battle Genn Greymane on the deck of the Skyfire.
pairs.text: 在天火号的甲板上与吉恩·格雷迈恩交战。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at the Sentinel Hill.
pairs.text: 解除燃烧军团对哨兵岭的威胁。

pairs.source: The Lich King awaits your return to the citadel.
pairs.text: 巫妖王在等待着你返回冰冠堡垒。
在冰冠堡垒中收集碎片。

pairs.source: Use the Scourge Teleporter within the Spire.
pairs.text: 使用尖塔中的天灾传送器。

pairs.source: Reforge the fragments and form your weapon.
pairs.text: 将碎片重铸为你的武器。

pairs.source: Purge the blades of the malevolent souls within.
Defeat the Demon Lord commanding the invasion.
pairs.text: 击败指挥入侵的恶魔领主。

pairs.source: Destroy the wards protecting Varedis and absorb the souls of his minions.
pairs.text: 摧毁保护瓦雷迪斯的结界，并吸收他的爪牙的灵魂。

pairs.source: Find Magnar's resting place within the tomb.
pairs.text: 在墓穴中找到马格纳的安息之地。
保护胡尼尔不受马格纳的部队伤害。

pairs.source: The sword and shield are yours, claim them.
pairs.text: 剑和盾都是你的了，拿去吧。

pairs.source: Defeat Dargrul's legions and recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before Highmountain is destroyed.
pairs.text: 在至高岭被彻底毁灭前击败达古尔的军团，并夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。

pairs.source: You made it through the Portal
Steal food from the three storage locations and three Wyrmtogue Meatholders in the city below.
pairs.text: 进入下方的城市，从三处储藏室和三名虫语运肉者的身上偷取食物。

pairs.source: Head out to the back and place the bait.
Retrieve the Fangs and Return to Dalaran.
pairs.text: 夺取獠牙，并返回达拉然。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at Tarren Mill.
pairs.text: 在塔伦米尔抵抗燃烧军团的威胁。

pairs.source: Defeat the demon lord commanding the invasion at the Crossroads.
pairs.text: 击败指挥入侵十字路口的恶魔领主。

pairs.source: Enter the Eye of Azshara and stop the Wrath of Azshara from being unleashed upon the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 进入艾萨拉之眼，阻止艾萨拉之怒席卷整个破碎群岛。

pairs.source: Enter the Eye of Azshara and stop the Wrath of Azshara from being unleashed upon the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 进入艾萨拉之眼，阻止艾萨拉之怒席卷整个破碎群岛。
与胡尼尔一起寻找马格纳之墓。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 证明你的实力，并夺取阿格拉玛之盾

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 證明你的資格，並取得阿格拉瑪之盾。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 证明你的实力，并夺取阿格拉玛之盾

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 證明你的資格，並取得阿格拉瑪之盾。

pairs.source: A strange group of vrykul are here battling demons. They don't seem hostile. Approach them and learn their purpose.
pairs.text: 有一群奇怪的维库人再次与恶魔作战。他们看起来并非敌人。接近他们，弄清楚他们的意图。

pairs.source: Another group of demons is attacking, aid the warband in crushing these foes.
pairs.text: 又一群恶魔发动了进攻，帮助这支兵团碾碎这些敌人。

pairs.source: Demonic reinforcements approach with a large mo'arg. Defeat Bezzeredes and his allies.
pairs.text: 恶魔的援军过来了，其中还有一只巨大的莫尔葛。击败贝泽德斯和他的部队。

pairs.source: Malgalor, Lord of Butchery has arrived to kill everyone. Stand with what remains of the warband. Kill Malgalor or die trying.
pairs.text: 屠戮者马加洛来了，所有人都难逃一死。与兵团中剩下的成员共同进退，与马加洛决一死战。

pairs.source: Baron Sliver should have already arrived. Search for him.
pairs.text: 斯利文男爵应该已经到了。去找他。

pairs.source: Defeat Dargrul's legions and recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before Highmountain is destroyed.
pairs.text: 在至高岭被彻底毁灭前击败达古尔的军团，并夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。

pairs.source: The masters of the Peak of Serenity have gathered for a conclave.
pairs.text: 晴日峰的宗师们聚集在一起召开会议。

pairs.source: The village is shrouded in mists. Light the bonfire to clear it and provoke the Helarjar.
pairs.text: 这个村庄被迷雾包围了。点燃篝火以清除迷雾，向海拉加尔挑衅。

pairs.source: The kvaldir are enraged at the loss of the mists. Survive their assault until the commanding helarjar arrives, then kill him.
pairs.text: 迷雾的散去激怒了克瓦迪尔。抵挡住他们的攻势，直到他们的海拉加尔指挥官抵达，然后消灭他。

pairs.source: Vigfus continues to ignore your presence. Free his cargo of souls to draw him out.
pairs.text: 维格弗斯仍然没有理会你。把他关押的那些灵魂都放出来，引他出来。

pairs.source: With Master Crane's help, reach the west temple grounds
pairs.text: 在神鹤大师的帮助下，抵达寺院西边的广场。

pairs.source: Chen Stormstout was leading a children's class when the attack began. Rescue him and the children!
pairs.text: 袭击爆发时，陈·风暴烈酒正在给一群孩子上课。快去救他和那些孩子们！

pairs.source: Accompany Chen and the children back to the Temple.
pairs.text: 获送陈和孩子们返回寺院。

pairs.source: The Demon known as Jorvinax has opened a gigantic portal! You must close it before the Legion can turn the Peak of Serenity into a foothold.
pairs.text: 一个名叫乔维纳克斯的恶魔打开了一扇巨大的传送门！你必须关闭它，否则晴日峰将沦为军团的又一座桥头堡。

pairs.source: With Jorvinax dead the portal is left unguarded. Find a way to destroy it!
pairs.text: 乔维纳克斯已死，传送门已无人保护。想办法摧毁它！

pairs.source: Follow Geth'xun's trail of fel blood.
pairs.text: 追踪格斯逊洒下的魔血。

pairs.source: Follow Geth'xun's trail of fel blood.
pairs.text: 追踪格斯逊洒下的魔血。

pairs.source: Follow the trail to find Geth'xun.
Use the Doomhammer to destroy Geth'xun.
pairs.text: 使用毁灭之锤毁灭格斯逊。
帮助风暴召唤者米尔拉。

pairs.source: The Bladewind has made an appearance. Slay him!
The Bladewind is escaping into the shallows, find and kill him.
pairs.text: 刀风躲进了浅滩，找到并消灭他。

pairs.source: The Warswords of the Bladewind are yours. Take them.
pairs.text: 刀风的战剑是你的了，带走它们。

pairs.source: The servants of the Lich King have conjured walls of ice to block your path. Destroy them.
pairs.text: 巫妖王的奴仆们召唤了冰墙拦住你的去路。摧毁它们。

pairs.source: Survive the assault of the burning dead.

pairs.text: 烈焰之击是你的了。拿走吧。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate.
pairs.text: 在奥格瑞玛后门抵抗燃烧军团的威胁。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at Kharanos.
pairs.text: 在卡拉诺斯抵抗燃烧军团的威胁。

pairs.source: Cut through the demon hordes and destroy their portals.
pairs.text: 在恶魔大军中杀出一条血路，摧毁他们的传送门。

pairs.source: Use your demonic senses to pickup Caria's trail.
pairs.text: 使用幽灵视觉寻找凯丽娅的踪迹。
凯丽娅·邪魂的死期到了。

pairs.source: Vigfus and his souls are below, kill the mystics defending the path down and reach the docks.
pairs.text: 维格弗斯和他的那些灵魂就在下面，消灭把守道路的秘法师并抵达码头。

pairs.source: Enslave the jailer Beshtal to free yourself from his cage, then defeat him with Ritssyn's aid.
pairs.text: 奴役狱卒贝什塔尔，让他放你出去，然后在雷特森的帮助下击败他。

pairs.source: Gorgonnash has risen to stop your assault.
In the Darkness of the Pit
Rescue Jubeka Shadowbreaker, Zinnin Smythe, and Shinfel Blightsworn.
pairs.text: 救出裘碧卡·碎影、泽宁·斯米瑟和辛菲儿·疫誓。

pairs.source: Follow Calydus to the archives to uncover information about the artifacts Jagganoth hunts.
pairs.text: 跟随卡里杜斯前往档案馆，了解贾格诺斯所要寻找的神器的情报。

pairs.source: Follow Calydus to escape from Dreadscar Rift.
pairs.text: 跟随卡里杜斯逃离恐痕裂隙。

pairs.source: Meet with Calydus on the bridge past the fel flame barrier.
pairs.text: 在邪能烈焰屏障另一边的桥上与卡里杜斯会面。

pairs.source: Explore the sprawling depths of The Arcway.
pairs.text: 探索魔法回廊延展的深处。

pairs.source: Wuho should have located a good spot to start. Wait for his signal, then regroup at the landing site.
pairs.text: 乌霍找到了一处不错的起始地点。等待他的信号，然后在登陆点再次集合。

pairs.source: Kvaldir wards bar the way further into the swamp. Investigate Tideskorn Harbor to find a way through.
pairs.text: 克瓦迪尔的结界挡住了深入沼泽的道路。调查蔑潮港，寻找通过的方法。

pairs.source: The Mist Warders manage the wards. Use a Freezing Trap or slay them to steal their wardstones.
pairs.text: 迷雾守护者管理着那些结界，击杀他们或使用冰冻陷阱困住他们，偷走他们的结界石。

pairs.source: More wardstones will be needed to breach the wall. Collect more wardstones from the kvaldir in the harbor.
pairs.text: 我们需要更多的结界石才能打破这堵墙。从港口的克瓦迪尔身上夺取更多的结界石。

pairs.source: Apata and Wuho are out near the wards, find them and find a way to breach the wards.
pairs.text: 阿帕塔和乌霍去结界那边了，找到他们，并想办法破解结界。

pairs.source: Harpoons and runes in hand, the fog barrier can be breached. Use a harpoon to cross the wards.
pairs.text: 鱼叉和符文都到手了，你可以打破屏障了。使用鱼叉穿过结界吧。

pairs.source: Apata wants to get the lay of the land carefully, follow her around the swamp.
pairs.text: 阿帕塔希望能仔细勘察这片土地，跟随她走遍沼泽。

pairs.source: Dakarr is sending illusionary stalkers at you, defend yourself!
pairs.text: 达喀尔派出幻影来追捕你了，保护好自己！

pairs.source: Dakarr hides in deep mists, go into them and lay traps to catch him.
pairs.text: 达喀尔隐入了迷雾的深处。深入迷雾中布下陷阱，抓住它。

pairs.source: The beast has fled to another lair of mist, trap it again and avenge Wuho.
pairs.text: 那头野兽逃进了另一处迷雾巢穴，再次抓住它，为乌霍报仇。

pairs.source: Dakarr has fled to his true lair, but is too weak to hide behind fog. Finish him in his lair.
pairs.text: 达喀尔逃进了它真正的巢穴，这次它已经虚弱得无法躲进迷雾里了。在它的巢穴里了结它。

pairs.source: The foul beast is dead and the path to the Spear is open. Take up Talonclaw.
pairs.text: 那头凶残的野兽终于死了，没有人能阻止你获得雄鹰之爪了。把它拿起来吧。

pairs.source: Survey the rise ahead and eliminate Legion patrols.
pairs.text: 调查前方的高地，消灭军团的巡逻队。

pairs.source: Challenge and triumph over Sigurd the Giantslayer.
pairs.text: 赢得巨人屠夫希格德的挑战。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of Xavius at the base of Shaladrassil.
pairs.text: 在莎拉达希尔的根部击败萨维斯的部队。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of Xavius at the base of Shaladrassil.
pairs.text: 在莎拉达希尔的根部击败萨维斯的部队。

pairs.source: Earn a team victory with Rehgar.
pairs.text: 与雷加尔组队获得胜利。

pairs.source: Defeat the eredar summoners before they bring in more demons.
pairs.text: 击败艾瑞达召唤者，以免他们召唤出更多的恶魔。

pairs.source: Go deeper into Legion territory to locate Alleria and Orestes.
pairs.text: 深入军团的领地，找到奥蕾莉亚和俄瑞斯忒斯。

pairs.source: Slay Mistress Torvis and save Orestes.
pairs.text: 消灭托维斯夫人并解救俄瑞斯忒斯。

pairs.source: Follow Li Li and protect her from the dangers of Skywall.
pairs.text: 跟随丽丽，以免她在天空之墙中遭受危险。

pairs.source: Your foes are using the Stormtouched Orbs to empower themselves. Destroy the orbs and break through the Raging Winds.
pairs.text: 你的敌人使用风触之球强化了自身。摧毁这些球能让你穿过狂怒之风。

pairs.source: Typhinius has summoned his servants, survive the assault!
pairs.text: 泰菲缪斯召唤了他的奴仆，努力在战斗中活下来！

pairs.source: You've weakened the Storm Dragon. Leap upon the beast and use it to reach Typhinius.
pairs.text: 你削弱了风暴巨龙。跳上他的背，并前往泰菲缪斯的所在地。

pairs.source: The Fists of the Heavens are yours, take them.
pairs.text: 诸天之拳是你的了，拿走它吧。

pairs.source: Li Li has ran off ahead! Catch up with her.
pairs.text: 丽丽跑到前头去了！追上她！

pairs.source: Enter the cathedral and defeat Herald Xarbizuld.
pairs.text: 进入城堡，击败使徒扎比祖德。

pairs.source: Enter the cathedral and defeat Herald Xarbizuld.
pairs.text: 進入大教堂並擊敗信使薩比祖德。

pairs.source: Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 前往卡拉赞下方的黑暗骑士墓穴。

pairs.source: Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 進入卡拉贊地下墓穴追查黑騎兵的下落。

pairs.source: Find a way to cross Ariden's spirit barrier.
pairs.text: 想办法穿过埃瑞丁的灵魂屏障。

pairs.source: Defeat the guardian of the Dark Riders' vault.
pairs.text: 击败黑暗骑士宝库的守护者。

pairs.source: Find the Deadwind Harvester among the Dark Riders' artifacts.
pairs.text: 在黑暗骑士的神器中找到逆风收割者。

pairs.source: Follow Ariden into the depths of the Karazhan catacombs.
pairs.text: 跟随埃瑞丁深入卡拉赞墓穴。

pairs.source: Journey into the lair and locate the Claws of Ursoc.
pairs.text: 进入巢穴，找到乌索克之爪。

pairs.source: Lea Stonepaw has begun the ritual to remove the last barrier protecting the Claws of Ursoc. Guard her from the creatures of the Nightmare while she performs the ritual!
pairs.text: 莉娅·石爪开始了一个仪式，试图移除保护乌索克之爪的最后屏障。在仪式期间保护好她不受梦魇生物的伤害！

pairs.source: The cultists have entered a tomb complex at the bottom of the lake. The ritual must be happening in there.
pairs.text: 教徒们进入了湖底的一座墓穴中。他们一定是打算在那里举行仪式。

pairs.source: The cultists have breached the tomb of an ancient titan keeper! Slay the guards and open the way into the complex.
pairs.text: 邪教徒们攻占了一座古代泰坦守护者的墓穴！消灭那些卫兵，肃清通往墓穴的路。

pairs.source: A second wave of invaders are approaching!
A third wave of invaders are approaching!
The ritual is nearly complete! Protect Lea from a final wave of invaders.
pairs.text: 仪式快结束了！保护好莉娅，挡住最后一波入侵者。

pairs.source: The Lord of Nightmares has captured Ursoc and empowered his disciple with the Claws!
pairs.text: 梦魇之王俘虏了乌索克，并用乌索克之爪的力量强化了他的信徒！

pairs.source: The forces of the Nightmare have been defeated. The claws are now yours for the taking.
pairs.text: 梦魇大军被击退了，你可以去拿乌索克之爪了。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上纳格法尔号，并在海拉的国度中挑战她。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上奈格法號，在黑爾雅的地盤上對付她。

pairs.source: Meet with Archmage Khadgar inside Karazhan.
pairs.text: 进入卡拉赞与大法师卡德加会面。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上纳格法尔号，并在海拉的国度中挑战她。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上奈格法號，在黑爾雅的地盤上對付她。

pairs.source: Slaghammer knows the ritual is further inside. Enter the tomb room and deal with the cultists.
pairs.text: 熔锤知道，仪式位于更深处。进入墓室中解决邪教徒。

pairs.source: Learn the secrets of Karazhan's past.
pairs.text: 了解卡拉赞过去的秘密。

pairs.source: Assist Khadgar by deactivating the protective rune.
pairs.text: 协助卡德加关闭保护符文。

pairs.source: Steal the Wardstone now that the Warder is taken care of.
pairs.text: 守护者已经完蛋了，拿走结界石吧。
在恐痕裂隙击败贾格诺斯。

pairs.source: Collect the Heart of the Overlord.
Place the Heart of the Overlord above the altar in the Seat of the Overlord to take command of his armies.
pairs.text: 把大领主之心放到恐痕裂隙的大领主之座上，并接管他的军队。

pairs.source: Wield Thas'dorah, Legacy of the Windrunners.
pairs.text: 获得萨斯多拉，风行者的遗产

pairs.source: Defeat High Inquisitor Qormaladon and his guardian eyes.
pairs.text: 击败大审判官奎玛拉顿和他的守护之眼。

pairs.source: Assist Khadgar by weakening the guardians.
pairs.text: 削弱保护者以协助卡德加。

pairs.source: Not the Intruders You're Looking For
pairs.text: 我们不是你要找的入侵者

pairs.source: Equip and master the Weapons of the Storm.
Search the Vault of the Wardens for Cordana Felsong and defeat her.
pairs.text: 搜索守望者地窟，找到科达娜·邪歌，并将其击败。

pairs.source: Assist Khadgar by attuning the protectors to defend Karazhan.
pairs.text: 协助卡德加调试守护者，保护卡拉赞。

pairs.source: Read from the Guardian's Arcanum to escape to the library.
pairs.text: 阅读守护者的奥秘，设法从图书馆里逃脱。

pairs.source: Stop Gul'dan from summoning the Legion.
Cultists are dampening the holy wards of the tomb. Dispel their defenses and kill the ritualists to break the barrier.
pairs.text: 邪教徒正试图破解墓穴的神圣结界。清除他们的防御力量并消灭那些祭师以破坏屏障。

pairs.source: Listen to Khadgar's instructions regarding the tome.
pairs.text: 听从卡德加关于书籍的讲解。

pairs.source: The way is open to the prison. Continue down the unsealed passage to whatever waits below.
pairs.text: 通往监狱的道路敞开了。沿着解封的道路继续前进，迎接下面潜伏的危险。

pairs.source: Help Taran Zhu recover from his battle injuries.
Open the cages to free the captured Shado-Pan and defeat Hellwarden Xaphan.
pairs.text: 打开笼子，释放被关押的影踪派成员，然后击败地狱卫士萨潘。

pairs.source: The Twilight Deacon is trying to bring the killer of Tyr back to life! Stop him!
pairs.text: 暮光执事正试图复活那些杀死提尔的怪物们！阻止他！

pairs.source: Speak with each of the Shadow-Pan to coordinate your attack on the corrupted terrace.
pairs.text: 与每个影踪派成员交谈，安排对腐化的永春台的攻击。

pairs.source: Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 前往卡拉赞下方的黑暗骑士的墓穴。

pairs.source: Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 進入卡拉贊地下墓穴追查黑騎兵的下落。

pairs.source: Find a way to cross Ariden's spirit barrier.
pairs.text: 想办法穿过埃瑞丁的灵魂屏障。

pairs.source: Defeat the guardian of the Dark Riders' vault.
pairs.text: 击败黑暗骑士宝库的守护者。

pairs.source: Find the Scythe of Elune among the Dark Riders' artifacts.
pairs.text: 在黑暗骑士的神器中找到月神镰刀。

pairs.source: Follow Ariden into the depths of the Karazhan catacombs.
pairs.text: 跟随埃瑞丁深入卡拉赞墓穴。

pairs.source: With the Deacon dead the blade is now yours. Take it.
pairs.text: 暮光执事已死，黑暗帝国之刃是你的了。拿起它。

pairs.source: The Blade of the Black Empire
The C'Thraxxi general is still a threat. Use the Blade to kill it forever.
pairs.text: 这名克拉西斯将军依然具有威胁。使用匕首将它永远杀死。

pairs.source: Find the Dread Admiral Eliza in the Temple of a Thousand Lights.
pairs.text: 在千光神殿中找到亡灵舰长伊丽扎。

pairs.source: Defeat Aspersius with the help of the Shado-Pan.
pairs.text: 在影踪派的帮助下击败阿斯帕修斯。

pairs.source: Pursue the Dread Admiral Eliza into the temple depths.
pairs.text: 追踪亡灵舰长伊丽扎深入神殿。

pairs.source: A wall of flames blocks the path. Protect Baron Sliver while he disables the barrier.
pairs.text: 一堵火墙拦住了去路。在斯利文男爵解除它的期间保护他。

pairs.source: Follow Baron Sliver into Legion territory and search the camp.
pairs.text: 跟随斯利文男爵深入军团领土并搜索营地。

pairs.source: Hunt down Inquisitor Zalinor and obtain his keystone.
pairs.text: 追踪审判官扎里诺，并获取他的钥石。

pairs.source: With the keystone in hand release your ally.
pairs.text: 钥石在手，你可以解放你的盟友了。

pairs.source: Travel to the citadel and assist Baron Sliver as he disables its barrier.
pairs.text: 前往城堡，在斯利文男爵解除屏障期间保护他。

pairs.source: The way is open into the complex. Continue down into the structure and locate Margrave.
pairs.text: 通往设施的路已经敞开了。继续进入建筑的下方，找到玛格拉弗。

pairs.source: Gorelix has slain Margrave! Destroy the demon!
pairs.text: 高瑞里克斯处决了玛格拉弗！消灭那个恶魔！

pairs.source: With Gorelix dead his axe is now yours. Take it.
pairs.text: 高瑞里克斯已死，他的斧头是你的了。拿走它。

pairs.source: Defeat the Dread Admiral Eliza and claim the Dreadblades
pairs.text: 击败亡灵舰长伊丽扎并夺取恐惧之刃。

pairs.source: Ascend Black Rook Hold to track the risen Lord Ravencrest.
pairs.text: 攀登黑鸦堡垒，追踪被复生的拉文凯斯领主的踪迹。

pairs.source: Follow Baron Sliver up the rise ahead.
pairs.text: 跟上前方的斯利文男爵。

pairs.source: Slay all of the murlocs on the island.
Slay all of the murlocs on the island.
Acquire Sheilun, Staff of the Mists.
Acquire Sheilun, Staff of the Mists.
Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 前往卡拉赞下方的黑暗骑士的墓穴。

pairs.source: Make your way into the Dark Riders' catacombs beneath Karazhan.
pairs.text: 進入卡拉贊地下墓穴追查黑騎兵的下落。

pairs.source: Find a way to cross Ariden's spirit barrier.
pairs.text: 想办法穿过埃瑞丁的灵魂屏障。

pairs.source: Defeat the guardian of the Dark Riders' vault.
pairs.text: 击败黑暗骑士宝库的守护者。

pairs.source: Find Apocalypse among the Dark Riders' artifacts.
pairs.text: 在黑暗骑士的神器中找到天启。

pairs.source: Follow Ariden into the depths of the Karazhan catacombs.
pairs.text: 跟随埃瑞丁深入卡拉赞墓穴。

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: The ritual has been thwarted but void energy remains! Defeat it!
pairs.text: 仪式被打断了，但虚空能量依然存留着！击败它！

pairs.source: Help Meryl Felstorm battle the dreadlord Kathra'natir.
pairs.text: 帮助梅瑞尔·邪风对抗恐惧魔王卡萨纳提尔

pairs.source: Destroy the Siphoning Rifts that are draining the Forge of the Guardian of its power.
pairs.text: 摧毁正在吸取守护者熔炉之力的虹吸裂隙。

pairs.source: Activate the Forge of the Guardian.
Use the power granted by the Forge of the Guardian to defeat Kathra'natir.
pairs.text: 使用守护者熔炉的力量击败卡萨纳提尔。

pairs.source: Help Meryl Felstorm and Alodi to transport the Forge of the Guardian to a safe location.
pairs.text: 帮助梅瑞尔·邪风和阿洛迪将守护者熔炉转移到安全地带。

pairs.source: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
The Lich King await's news of your success. Use Baron Sliver's Death Gate to travel to Icecrown.
pairs.text: 巫妖王等待着你胜利的消息，使用斯利文男爵的黑锋之门回到冰冠堡垒。

pairs.source: The ghost of Thoradin is being tortured by the cultists. Slay the ritualists and free him.
pairs.text: 索拉丁的灵魂正受到教徒的折磨。消灭那些祭司并解救他。

pairs.source: The ghost has much information. Follow Thoradin and listen to his tale.
pairs.text: 这个灵魂知道许多的情报。跟随索拉丁，听听他的故事。

pairs.source: Use Torra's spear to bring down the felbat Falthus.
pairs.text: 使用托拉的矛击落魔蝠法尔瑟斯。

pairs.source: Activate the Maelstrom Pillar to defeat Geth'xun.
pairs.text: 激活漩涡之柱并击败格斯逊。

pairs.source: The broken seal beckons from the lake bottom. Enter the Tomb of Tyr.
pairs.text: 破碎的封印在湖底闪烁。进入提尔之墓。

pairs.source: The prison entrance is blocked with corruption. Cleanse the tomb of the corrupting void tendrils.
pairs.text: 监狱的入口由堕落力量封锁着。清除污染墓穴的虚空触须。

pairs.source: The corrupter has finally appeared. Slay Soth'ozz and complete the cleansing of the tomb.
pairs.text: 腐化者终于现身了。消灭索斯奥兹，完成对墓穴的净化。

pairs.source: The way below is uncovered, make your way to the prison of Zakajz.
pairs.text: 下方的道路已经敞开了，前往扎卡兹的监狱。

pairs.source: Zakajz is struggling to defend itself. Draw out the sword and perform the final blow!
pairs.text: 扎卡兹仍在垂死挣扎。将宝剑拔出来，给它最后一击！

pairs.source: Zakajz is awake but neither fully healed or fully in control of its mind. Fight it back into unconsciousness!
pairs.text: 扎卡兹醒来了，但他尚未恢复体力，也还无法控制自己的心智。重新把它打晕！

pairs.source: Zakajz has been defeated again, but it is not permanent. Take up Strom'kar and deal the final true blow.
pairs.text: 扎卡兹又一次被击败了，但这只是暂时的。举起斯多姆卡，给他致命一击。

pairs.source: The Twilight's Hammer has set up a temporary camp up here. Investigate the camp for clues.
pairs.text: 暮光之锤在这里建立了一处临时营地。调查营地中的线索。

pairs.source: The Blades are purged of the corruption. Claim them as your own.
pairs.text: 剑中的腐化已经被清除了。将它们据为己有。

pairs.source: A golden val'kyr named Danica has arrived to collect the souls of the worthy. Watch the ritual.
pairs.text: 一位名叫丹妮卡的金色瓦格里抵达了战场，并将英雄们的灵魂迎向英灵殿。见证这个仪式吧。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 证明你的实力，并夺取阿格拉玛之盾。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 證明你的資格，並取得阿格拉瑪之盾。

pairs.source: Repel the Legion's forces throughout Northern Barrens.
pairs.text: 击退军团对北贫瘠之地的进攻。

pairs.source: Twilight cultists are camped near the entrance. Investigate what they are doing here.
pairs.text: 暮光教徒在入口附近建设了营地。调查他们来此的目的。

pairs.source: Infiltrate the Court of Stars and confront Grand Magistrix Elisande.
pairs.text: 渗透进群星庭院，与大魔导师艾利桑德对峙。

pairs.source: Infiltrate the Court of Stars and confront Grand Magistrix Elisande.
pairs.text: 渗透进群星庭院，与大魔导师艾利桑德对峙。

pairs.source: Help Vereesa search the Inquisitor's overlook for Alleria.
pairs.text: 帮助温蕾萨搜索审判官的看台，寻找奥蕾莉亚的踪迹。

pairs.source: Defend against the Legion threat at the Crossroads.
pairs.text: 清除十字路口的军团威胁。

pairs.source: Something terrible has happened here - speak to Skylord Omnuron to get answers.
pairs.text: 这儿发生了什么？与啸天者欧穆隆交谈以获得答案。

pairs.source: Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and his allies' wounds require your aid.
pairs.text: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾和他的盟友们受伤了，他们需要你的援助。

pairs.source: Speak to Lyessa to begin the cleansing ritual.
pairs.text: 与莱莎交谈以开始净化仪式。

pairs.source: Protect Lyessa while she completes the ritual.
pairs.text: 在莱莎进行仪式的时候保护她。

pairs.source: Call upon the souls of the forest and eliminate Destromath.
pairs.text: 召唤森林之魂消灭迪托马斯。

pairs.source: Free Azuregos from the ethereals by defeating the Voidtouched Channelers binding him and restore his health.
pairs.text: 击败灵媒引导者，将艾索雷苟斯从虚灵的手中救出来，并恢复他的生命值。

pairs.source: Reach the Librarium to find a way into the Nexus Vault.
pairs.text: 抵达图书馆，想办法进入魔枢宝库。
擊敗奈薩斯王子彼列爾。
夺取圣光之怒的控制权。

pairs.source: Claim Light's Wrath and leave the Nexus Vault.
pairs.text: 获得圣光之怒并离开魔枢宝库。

pairs.source: Heal and recruit the beleaguered sea giant.
pairs.text: 治疗并招募被围攻的海巨人。

pairs.source: Find and free the missing shaman, Wavespeaker Adelee.
pairs.text: 找到并解救失踪的萨满，波涛语者安德莉。

pairs.source: Ascend to the upper level and lead your party through the waves.
pairs.text: 抵达上层，带领你的部队穿过波涛。

pairs.source: Speak with Grif and meet his vrykul guide, Prustaga.
pairs.text: 与格瑞夫交谈，并和他的维库向导普斯塔佳碰面。

pairs.source: Defeat the Legion Commander threatening the Crossroads.
pairs.text: 击败威胁十字路口的军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Scour Volund's Hoard for a sign of Titanstrike.
pairs.text: 在沃伦德的宝库搜索泰坦之击。

pairs.source: Two of Caria's lieutenants are performing a dark ritual. They must be stopped.
pairs.text: 凯丽娅的两名副官正在执行一个黑暗的仪式。必须阻止他们。

pairs.source: Find the entrance to the tomb of Warlord Volund inside the Tomb of Ancient Kings.
pairs.text: 在远古列王陵墓中找到督军沃伦德的墓穴入口。

pairs.source: Assist Prustaga in opening the door to Volund's tomb.
pairs.text: 帮助普斯塔佳打开通往沃伦德墓穴的大门。

pairs.source: Claim the Aldrachi Warblades as your own.
pairs.text: 将奥达奇战刃据为己有。

pairs.source: Learn how to use Blade of Justice.
pairs.text: 学习如何使用公正之剑。

pairs.source: Learn how to use Crusader Strike.
Learn how to use Divine Shield.
Learn how to use Flash of Light.
pairs.text: 学习如何使用圣光闪现。

pairs.source: Learn how to use Templar's Verdict.
pairs.text: 学习如何使用圣殿骑士的裁决。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Give the staff to Lyessa to complete the ritual.
pairs.text: 把法杖交给莱莎以开始仪式。

pairs.source: Creatures of the Nightmare are attacking the Spirit of Ursoc! Slay them!
pairs.text: 梦魇生物正在攻击乌索克之魂！消灭它们！

pairs.source: Engage Akaari Shadowgore while you have the element of surprise.
pairs.text: 对阿卡丽·影血展开突然袭击。

pairs.source: The Soulkeeper is in a deep trance. Obtain the key he has dangling from his belt.
pairs.text: 缚魂者目前心无旁骛，把他腰带上的钥匙摘下来。

pairs.source: Akaari has sent Inquisitor Xirus to stop you.
pairs.text: 阿卡丽派审判官瑟鲁斯来阻止你。

pairs.source: Find Akaari Shadowgore atop the citadel.
pairs.text: 找到位于城堡顶部的阿卡丽·影血。

pairs.source: Wield the Fangs of the Devourer.
Wield the Fangs of the Devourer.
Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: You're ready for the Assault!  Join up and bring justice to the Legion.
pairs.text: 你准备好开始突袭了！加入战斗，伸张正义，击败燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Defeat the Legion Commander threatening Sentinel Hill.
pairs.text: 击败威胁哨兵岭的军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 证明你的实力，并夺取阿格拉玛之盾。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 證明你的資格，並取得阿格拉瑪之盾。

pairs.source: You've arrived at Shield's Rest. Meet up with Orik and prepare to enter the tomb.
pairs.text: 你已经抵达了盾憩岛，与欧瑞克会面，并准备进入古墓。

pairs.source: Inside the tomb lies the Shrine of the Truthguard. Overcome any defenses and find the shrine.
pairs.text: 这座墓穴中沉睡着真理守护者的祭坛。克服一路上的试炼并找到那座祭坛。

pairs.source: The way is open and the shrine awaits. The shield is below somewhere. Find it.
pairs.text: 通往祭坛的道路敞开了。盾牌就在下面的某处，找到它。

pairs.source: Yrgrim, wielder of the Truthguard has challenged you to a trial by combat. Complete the trial to earn his respect.
pairs.text: 真理守护者的主人伊格瑞姆向你发出挑战。完成这一试炼以赢得他的尊重。

pairs.source: The trial is over. Take up the Truthguard.
pairs.text: 试炼结束了，拿起真理守护者。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: The Legion is attacking.  Defend the airship!
pairs.text: 军团正在发动攻击。保卫飞艇！

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
You've emerged upon a ship of the Burning Legion to find your allies have become seperated in battle. Help Vindicator Boros recover from his injuries.
pairs.text: 你出现在了一艘燃烧军团的飞船上，此处的战友们正在背水一战。快给守备官波鲁斯治疗伤势。

pairs.source: The door to the shrine is the first trial. Survive its test.
pairs.text: 通往祭坛的门是第一个试炼。在考验中存活下来。

pairs.source: You Won't Like Us When We're Mad...
pairs.text: 我们发怒的样子可不好看……

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: The Legion is attacking.  Defend the airship!
pairs.text: 军团正在发动攻击。保卫飞艇！
在军团的攻击下保卫飞艇

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
Open the cage to free the captured prisoner and defeat Captain Naranoth.
pairs.text: 打开牢笼解救被俘的囚犯，并击败纳拉诺斯队长。

pairs.source: Follow Vindicator Boros and assist Jace.
pairs.text: 跟随守备官波鲁斯，并帮助杰斯。

pairs.source: Warlord Volund seeks to stop you from claiming Titanstrike.
pairs.text: 督军沃伦德想要阻止你得到泰坦之击。

pairs.source: Use the teleportation pad to join Mimiron in Ulduar.
pairs.text: 使用传送台前往奥杜尔，与米米尔隆会面。

pairs.source: Defeat Lady Calindris with the help of your allies.
pairs.text: 在你的战友的帮助下击败卡琳迪丝夫人。

pairs.source: With Lady Calindris dead the staff is now yours. Take it and leave Niskara.
pairs.text: 卡琳迪丝夫人已死，法杖是你的了。带着它离开尼斯卡拉。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。
學習如何使用洶湧治療。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你所学，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: Assist your allies and escape the hold of the Burning Legion ship.
pairs.text: 帮助你的战友逃出燃烧军团的战舰。

pairs.source: Travard's team is set up in the abandoned Twilight camp. Meet up with him.
pairs.text: 塔瓦德的小队驻扎在了废弃的暮光营地了。去和他见面。

pairs.source: The skull should be within Felsoul Hold. Make your way down the path and search for it.
pairs.text: 颅骨应该在邪魂堡垒里。沿路下去找吧。

pairs.source: Enter the tomb complex with Travard and get to Tyr's crypt.
pairs.text: 与塔瓦德一同进入墓葬群，前往提尔的陵墓。

pairs.source: Repel the Legion's forces throughout Westfall.
pairs.text: 击退西部荒野的军团部队。

pairs.source: Tyr's crypt is overrun with crazed aberrations. Clear them out to begin the ritual.
pairs.text: 疯狂的怪物盘踞在提尔的陵墓里。清理他们以开始仪式。

pairs.source: Travard wants to begin the ritual. Aid him.
pairs.text: 塔瓦德想要开始仪式。协助他。

pairs.source: A critical part of the ritual was taken below. Retrieve the piece.
pairs.text: 完成仪式所需的一个重要成分丢失了。找回它。

pairs.source: Converse with Thorim and prepare for Prustaga's arrival.
pairs.text: 与托里姆交谈，准备应对普斯塔佳的到来。

pairs.source: The giant aberration has the piece. Slay it and retrieve the piece.
pairs.text: 碎片在那个巨型畸变怪身上，干掉它并夺回碎片。

pairs.source: Unstable void energies are gathering, follow Travard back up to the crypt before the area is consumed.
pairs.text: 不稳定的虚空能量正在聚集，赶在这个区域被吞噬前跟随塔瓦德回到陵墓中。

pairs.source: Some of the paladins are wounded or covered in void magic. Free them by cleansing and healing them.
pairs.text: 有几个圣骑士受伤了，也有人被虚空魔法所困。治疗或净化他们。

pairs.source: Everyone is out of the passage, but something large and malevolent is coming up from below. Run with Travard to the crypt.
pairs.text: 所有人都逃出通道了，但某种可怕的怪物出现在了下方。与塔瓦德一起逃往陵墓。

pairs.source: Travard must complete the ritual to unlock the hammer from the wards. Defend the crypt until he is finished!
pairs.text: 塔瓦德需要完成仪式才能从结界中取出战锤。在他完成仪式前保护他！

pairs.source: The Silver Hand is free. Claim it before Mordoth overwhelms the defenders!
pairs.text: 白银之手被解放了。在守卫者被莫多斯歼灭前取下它！
从虚灵手中救出艾索雷苟斯。

pairs.source: Reach the Librarium to find a way into the Nexus Vault.
pairs.text: 抵达图书馆，想办法进入魔枢宝库。
擊敗奈薩斯王子彼列爾。
获得艾露尼斯的控制权。

pairs.source: Claim Aluneth and leave the Nexus Vault.
pairs.text: 夺取艾露尼斯并离开魔枢宝库。

pairs.source: Now that you have the key, free yourself from the cage and reclaim your weapons.
pairs.text: 你已经有了钥匙，逃出牢笼并夺取你的武器。
抵挡普斯塔佳的维库大军。

pairs.source: Mephistroth has escaped with the skull. Find a way across his trap and chase after him!
pairs.text: 孟菲斯托斯带着颅骨逃走了。想办法绕过他的陷阱并追击他。

pairs.source: Mephistroth has sent his minions after you. Survive their assault until Lady Tyrana and Pain Mistress Nikta arrives, then kill them.
pairs.text: 孟菲斯托斯派他的爪牙来对付你。抵挡他们的攻击，直到提拉娜夫人和痛苦女妖妮塔登场，然后干掉她们。

pairs.source: Mephistroth is attempting to destroy the skull! Clear the way to his ritual site and stop him!
pairs.text: 孟菲斯托斯想要毁掉颅骨！前往他的仪式地点并阻止他！

pairs.source: Mephistroth has escaped but the skull is intact. Take it.
pairs.text: 孟菲斯托斯逃走了，所幸颅骨并未受损。带走它。

pairs.source: Prustaga is absorbing Titanstrike's power. She must be stopped!
pairs.text: 普斯塔佳正在吸取泰坦之击的能量。快阻止她！

pairs.source: Bind Hati's spirit to your own to save her life.
pairs.text: 将哈提的灵魂与你绑定以拯救她的生命。

pairs.source: You must wield Titanstrike so Hati's absorbed power can return to the legendary rifle.
pairs.text: 你必须带着泰坦之击，这样哈提所吸收的能量就能返还到这把传奇武器中。
与格瑞夫一起回达拉然。

pairs.source: Take A Big Swing At It
Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你所学，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: Defeat the Legion Commanders threatening Gadgetzan.
pairs.text: 击败威胁加基森的军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Repel the Legion's forces throughout Tanaris.
pairs.text: 击退塔纳利斯的军团部队。

pairs.source: Defeat the demon lord commanding the invasion at Gadgetzan.
pairs.text: 击败指挥入侵加基森的恶魔领主。

pairs.source: The skull is yours! Step through its portal to depart this place.
pairs.text: 颅骨是你的了！穿过传送门，离开这个地方。

pairs.source: There's a New Master in Town
You've come to the ruins of Falanaar in search of Verstok and the Fangs of Ashamane. Search for clues as to where Verstok has disappeared to.
pairs.text: 你来到了法兰纳尔的废墟，搜寻维斯托克和阿莎曼之牙。搜寻线索，找出维斯托克消失后，去了哪里。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你所学，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: Verstok's scent leads into the ruins, but the door is sealed shut. Find a way to open it.
pairs.text: 维斯托克的味道一路延伸到废墟之中，但门是紧紧关闭的。想办法打开它。

pairs.source: Where There's a Withered There's a Way
Meryl is here preparing for the assault. Speak with him and Alodi to begin preparations.
pairs.text: 梅瑞尔在这里，正在为突袭做准备。和他还有阿洛迪谈谈，开始准备工作。
把你的薄暮狂鱼交给纳特。

pairs.source: The Fel Dampening Wards must be placed at highly visible locations to be seen. Fight to the locations, setup the wards, and defend them.
pairs.text: 邪能抑制结界必须放在可见度很高的地点，让人能够看到。杀出一条路，前往指定地点，设置好结界，然后保护结界。

pairs.source: The wards are activated, it is time to begin the ritual. Go to the Altar of End Times and speak with Meryl Felstorm.
pairs.text: 结界激活，是时候开始仪式了。前往末世祭坛，和梅瑞尔·邪风谈谈。

pairs.source: Use the Ritual Focus whenever possible to complete the ritual.
pairs.text: 抓紧一切时机使用仪式焦镜，完成仪式。

pairs.source: Balaadur has swept you up into his realm. Slay the eredar lord.
pairs.text: 巴拉杜尔将你扔进他的世界。杀死这个艾瑞达领主。

pairs.source: Showdown in the Realm of Madness
Ebonchill lies near the fallen demon. Claim it for your own.
pairs.text: 黑檀之寒就在死去恶魔的旁边。自己去取得它。

pairs.source: Follow Verstok's trail into the temple depths.
pairs.text: 追寻维斯托克的足迹，进入神殿深处。

pairs.source: The power of the Fangs has driven Verstok insane. Subdue him.
pairs.text: 阿莎曼之牙的力量让维斯托克变得疯狂。制服他。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
Verstok has fled into a series of caves beneath the ruins, find him.
pairs.text: 维斯托克逃入了废墟下的洞穴中，找到他。

pairs.source: You've found Verstok caught in the web of a horrific creature. Slay it.
pairs.text: 你发现维斯托克被困在恐怖生物的网中。干掉它。

pairs.source: The Fangs of Ashamane are yours. Take them.
pairs.text: 阿莎曼之牙属于你了。带走它们。

pairs.source: Master Mathias Shaw awaits at the Stormwind gates.
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯·肖尔大师在暴风城大门等着你。

pairs.source: Meet with Elling Trias and obtain a smoke bomb.
pairs.text: 和埃林·提亚斯会面，获得一枚烟雾弹。

pairs.source: Use the smoke bomb to create a distraction in the Trader's Hall.
pairs.text: 用烟雾弹在交易者大厅分散人们的注意力。

pairs.source: Fish up what's been disturbing the frenzies.
Ride upon Ebonfang to return to the Dreamgrove.
pairs.text: 骑乘乌牙，回到梦境林地。

pairs.source: You have successfully pierced the holy barriers protecting the Black Temple. Confer with Altruis the Sufferer and prepare to confront Akama.
pairs.text: 你成功穿透了保护着黑暗神殿的神圣屏障。和受难者奥图里斯谈谈，准备和阿卡玛对峙。

pairs.source: Follow Caretaker G33-WH12 through the Antechamber.
pairs.text: 跟随G33-WH12号管理员穿过前厅。

pairs.source: Escape the chaos and meet Garona at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.
pairs.text: 逃离混乱，在旧城区的猪和哨声旅店与迦罗娜会面。

pairs.source: Enter the tavern and make Althea Ebonlocke tell you where her master lies.
pairs.text: 进入旅店，让阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克告诉你，她的师傅躺在哪里。

pairs.source: You must find the Herald in Stormwind Keep before he summons the Legion into the city!
pairs.text: 你必须在暴风要塞中找到传令官，否则他就会将军团召唤到暴风城里！

pairs.source: It's up to you to assassinate Melris and put and end to this once and for all.
pairs.text: 只能靠你去刺杀梅里斯了，一劳永逸地解决这件事吧。

pairs.source: Take up the Kingslayers as your own.
Mathias Shaw has kindly provided you with transportation to Dalaran.
pairs.text: 马迪亚斯·肖尔体贴地为你提供了前往达拉然的交通方式。

pairs.source: The gates to the Temple Summit proper are closed. Akama is on the other side. Have your Illidari force a way in.
pairs.text: 通往神殿之巅的大门完全关闭了。阿卡玛在门里面。让你的伊利达雷强行突入。

pairs.source: Enter the Temple Summit and confront Akama. Convince him to join you in taking the fight to the Burning Legion's worlds.
pairs.text: 进入神殿之巅，与阿卡玛对峙。说服他加入你的队伍，并肩抵抗燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Akama will not be persuaded by words. Perhaps force will do the trick. But, how to win and not lose in doing so?
pairs.text: 言辞无法说服阿卡玛。也许要用武力强迫才行。但是即使使用武力，又要怎样才能让他就范，而不会落得双输的局面呢？

pairs.source: If He Will Not Listen to Reason...
Akama is defeated. Speak with him and convince him to join you.
pairs.text: 阿卡玛被击败了。和他谈谈，说服他加入你。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你所学，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: You have successfully pierced the holy barriers protecting the Black Temple. Confer with Kayn Sunfury and prepare to confront Akama.
pairs.text: 你成功穿透了保护着黑暗神殿的神圣屏障。和凯恩·日怒谈谈，准备与阿卡玛对峙。

pairs.source: The gates to the Temple Summit proper are closed. Akama is on the other side. Have your Illidari force a way in.
pairs.text: 通往神殿之巅的大门完全关闭了。阿卡玛在门里面。让你的伊利达雷强行突入。

pairs.source: Enter the Temple Summit and confront Akama. Convince him to join you in taking the fight to the Burning Legion's worlds.
pairs.text: 进入神殿之巅，与阿卡玛对峙。说服他加入你的队伍，并肩抵抗燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Akama will not be persuaded by words. Perhaps force will do the trick. But, how to win and not lose in doing so?
pairs.text: 言辞无法说服阿卡玛。也许要用武力强迫才行。但是即使使用武力，又要怎样才能让他就范，而不会落得双输的局面呢？

pairs.source: If He Will Not Listen to Reason...
Akama is defeated. Speak with him and convince him to join you.
pairs.text: 阿卡玛被击败了。和他谈谈，说服他加入你。

pairs.source: Learn about Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost.
Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
Repel the legion invasion by closing their portals and sending them back to the twisting nether.
pairs.text: 关闭军团的传送门，并将它们送回扭曲虚空，从而击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Defeat the three legion magi imprisoning Archmage Vargoth.
pairs.text: 击败3个囚禁大法师瓦格斯的军团魔法师。

pairs.source: Find a way into the Nexus building
pairs.text: 找到进入魔枢建筑的路。

pairs.source: Find a way into the Nexus building
pairs.text: 設法進入奧核的建築內。

pairs.source: Defeat Kathra'natir by imprisoning him inside the Nightborne Soulstone
pairs.text: 击败卡萨纳提尔，将其囚禁在夜之子灵魂石中。

pairs.source: Speak to Khadgar when you are ready for him to begin channeling his essence into the arcance vessel.
pairs.text: 当你准备好后，和卡德加谈谈，开始将他的精华注入到奥术容器中。
从炼金房中救出库尔迪拉。

pairs.source: Watch over Archmage Khadgar as he channels his essence into the arcane vessel.
pairs.text: 在大法师卡德加引导精华注入到容器中时，照看他的四周。

pairs.source: Use your Flare to see if Hakkar has taken the bait.
pairs.text: 用照明弹查看哈卡是否上钩。

pairs.source: Use an arcane portal to travel to the center Band of Transmutation
pairs.text: 使用奥术传送门前往转化之环的中心处。

pairs.source: You've entered the temple grounds. Meet with The Monkey King and prepare to head deeper into the complex.
pairs.text: 你已经进入了寺庙的庭院中。和风涌大师谈谈，准备进入寺庙深处。

pairs.source: When One Dagger Just Isn't Enough
The Gift That Keeps On Giving
Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你所学，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你所学，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: Talk to Archmage Vargoth to teleport to ground level
pairs.text: 和大法师瓦格斯谈谈，传送到地面。

pairs.source: Seek out Prophet Velen in the Vault of Lights.
pairs.text: 在圣光穹顶中找到先知维伦

pairs.source: Rescue terrified citizens found throughout the Exodar and destroy Legion fel portals.
pairs.text: 救出埃索达中所发现的惊恐的平民，并摧毁军团的邪能传送门。

pairs.source: Return to Prophet Velen in the Vault of Lights.
pairs.text: 回到圣光穹顶中，找到先知维伦。

pairs.source: Let Prophet Velen examine the Mysterious Lightbound Object.
pairs.text: 让先知维伦检查这个神秘的缚光物体。

pairs.source: Call upon the power of the Ashbringer to break free from Balnazzar's control.
pairs.text: 召唤灰烬使者的力量，摆脱巴纳扎尔的控制。

pairs.source: Man the artillery console and use the Fel Hammer's batteries to lay waste to the Legion forces below.
pairs.text: 控制火炮的操作台，用邪能之槌号的舰炮摧毁下方燃烧军团的部队。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: The Legion is attacking.  Defend the airship!
pairs.text: 军团正在发动攻击。保卫飞艇！
在军团的攻击下保卫飞艇

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
Learn about Army of the Dead.

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
Summon the Flames of Azzinoth and eliminate your enemies from the sky.
pairs.text: 召唤埃辛诺斯之焰，从天空中毁灭你的敌人。

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Unleash the hatred of ten thousand years.
Defend Arluin while he opens the door to the Nightflow Conduit.
pairs.text: 在阿鲁因打开通往夜流水渠的门时保护他。

pairs.source: Place the Ephemeral Manastorm Projector in the Nightflow Conduit.
pairs.text: 将瞬灭法力风暴发射器放置在夜流水渠中。

pairs.source: Destroy all demons and structures on the beach.
pairs.text: 消灭海滩上所有的恶魔，毁掉所有建筑。
杀死邪能指挥官阿兹加洛。
找到希尔瓦娜斯和贝恩。

pairs.source: Destroy the demon portal to stop reinforcements.
pairs.text: 摧毁恶魔之门以阻挡援军。

pairs.source: Hold the ridge until the Alliance have stopped Gul'dan.
pairs.text: 守住山脊，直到联盟阻止古尔丹。

pairs.source: Reach the door to the Nightflow Conduit.
pairs.text: 到达通往夜流水渠的大门。

pairs.source: Reach the door to the Nightflow Conduit.
Explore the sprawling depths of The Arcway.
pairs.text: 探索魔法回廊延展的深处。

pairs.source: Repair the Deactivated Moon Guard Portal.
pairs.text: 修复关闭的月之守卫传送门。

pairs.source: Secure the rampart by defeating Xalian Felblaze.
pairs.text: 击败萨里安·邪焰，保卫城墙。

pairs.source: Enter the upper ramparts of the courtyard.
Activate the remaining Moon Guard portals.
pairs.text: 激活剩余的月之守卫传送门。

pairs.source: Destroy the Nihilam Portal and slay Balaadur to end the invasion.
pairs.text: 摧毁奈兰传送门并消灭巴拉杜尔以终结入侵。

pairs.source: Enter Raven's Glory and destroy the Colossal Siegebreaker.
pairs.text: 进入渡鸦之耀并摧毁巨型攻城地狱火。

pairs.source: Give Archmage Khadgar the signal to bring the fel barrier down.
pairs.text: 给大法师卡德加发信号，解除邪能屏障。

pairs.source: Ask Magni to open the door to the Celestial Planetarium.
pairs.text: 让麦格尼打开天文台的大门。

pairs.source: Depart the Frozen Throne by taking the Acherus Waygate.
pairs.text: 使用阿彻鲁斯传送门离开冰封王座。

pairs.source: Xylem is draining Azeroth's Ley lines. You must stop him!
pairs.text: 克希雷姆正在吸取艾泽拉斯的魔网能量。你必须阻止他！

pairs.source: The teleport failed and you are outside the Sanctum. Find a way in.
pairs.text: 传送失败了，你位于大殿外面。找到进去的路。

pairs.source: Kill the ritualists at each Mana Generator to take down the barrier.
pairs.text: 消灭每个法力发生器附近的祭仪师，消除屏障。

pairs.source: Armsmaster Dalion stands guard at the entrance. Slay him to proceed.
pairs.text: 武器大师达里昂守卫在入口。消灭他，继续前进。

pairs.source: Make your way deep into the Sanctum of Order and find the breach.
pairs.text: 深入秩序大殿，找到突破口。

pairs.source: Use Withered to Drain Andaris's shield.
pairs.text: 使用枯法者吸取安达丽斯的护盾。

pairs.source: The way is clear to the Nighthold. Secure the entrance.
pairs.text: 通向暗夜要塞的路已经打开了。肃清入口。

pairs.source: Andaris has fallen back to the breach. Slay her.
pairs.text: 安达丽斯退回到突破口了。干掉她。

pairs.source: A magical barrier bars the way. Find someway to break it.
pairs.text: 魔法屏障挡住了路。想办法破坏它。
学习如何成为一名猎人。

pairs.source: Use all your new abilities on the target dummy.
pairs.text: 在假人身上使用你所有的新技能。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat a solo opponent.
pairs.text: 用你学到的本领，击败一个单独的对手。

pairs.text: 學以致用，擊敗一名對手。

pairs.source: Use what you have learned to defeat two opponents at the same time.
pairs.text: 用你学到的本领，同时击败两个对手。

pairs.text: 學以致用，同時擊敗兩名對手。

pairs.source: The Legion is attacking.  Defend the airship!
pairs.text: 军团正在发动攻击。保卫飞艇！
在军团的攻击下保卫飞艇

pairs.source: Leave the airship and join the assault.
The High Tinker's forces are preparing for battle. They'll need your help to stop Themaplugg in time.
pairs.text: 大工匠的部队已经做好了战斗准备。要想及时阻止瑟玛普拉格，他们还需要你的帮助。

pairs.source: Stop Xylem from channeling on the Focusing Iris.
pairs.text: 阻止克希雷姆对聚焦之虹进行引导。

pairs.source: The shadows within Xylem have been let loose! Protect Xylem as he restores the ley energy to Azeroth.
pairs.text: 克希雷姆身体中的阴影就要释放出来了！在克希雷姆为艾泽拉斯恢复魔网能量时保护好他。

pairs.source: You must prevent Thermaplugg's missile from launching to the Broken Isles!
pairs.text: 必须阻止瑟玛普拉格向破碎群岛发射导弹！

pairs.source: It's time to put an end to Sicco Thermaplugg's reign of terror once and for all.
pairs.text: 是时候了，一举终结希科·瑟玛普拉格的恐怖统治吧。

pairs.source: Let High Tinker Mekkatorque know when you are ready.
pairs.text: 做好准备后告诉大工匠梅卡托克。

pairs.source: Repel the demons invading the Fel Hammer
pairs.text: 驱逐入侵邪能之槌号的恶魔

pairs.source: Disperse the disruptive elements in each disc.
pairs.text: 消散每个飞碟中的元素。

pairs.source: Deviate the deviate critters that are flourishing in the caverns.
pairs.text: 击败哀嚎洞穴中滋生的变异小动物。

pairs.source: The Son of Skum has awakened and blocks your way!
pairs.text: 斯卡姆之子醒来了，挡住了你的去路！

pairs.source: Battle the companions of the cavern's former druid inhabitants.
pairs.text: 与曾经居住在洞穴中的德鲁伊的伙伴战斗。

pairs.source: Serpentis' own pet waits for you ahead.
pairs.text: 瑟芬迪斯的宠物就在前面等你。

pairs.source: Deviate ectoplasm continues to grow within the cavern. Clear it out.
pairs.text: 变异细胞仍然在洞穴中繁殖。去清除它。

pairs.source: Someone else is here! Confront them!
pairs.text: 这里有其他人！战胜他们！

pairs.source: A spore of Verdan the Everliving is re-growing. Destroy it before it grows to full strength.
pairs.text: 永生者沃尔丹的孢子又开始生长了。在它恢复全部力量前摧毁它。

pairs.source: Detox diseased Brewers and recover 8 Barrels of Storm Brew.
pairs.text: 对中毒的酿酒师使用清创生血，并夺回8桶风暴蜜酒。

pairs.source: Break down to front doors to get outside.
Drink the Storm Brew. You won't explode. Unless you are secretly a demon...
pairs.text: 饮用风暴蜜酒。你不会爆炸的，除非你是伪装的恶魔……

pairs.source: Gain access to the ship's computer system.
pairs.text: 进入飞船的计算机系统

pairs.source: Close the legion portals to stop the attack on the brewery!
pairs.text: 关闭军团传送门，阻止对酿酒厂的攻击！

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Defend the Violet Hold against the Legion incursion.
pairs.text: 保卫紫罗兰监狱，击退军团的入侵。

pairs.source: Infiltrate the Court of Stars and confront Grand Magistrix Elisande.
pairs.text: 渗透进群星庭院，与大魔导师艾利桑德对峙。

pairs.source: Defeat the forces of Xavius at the base of Shaladrassil.
pairs.text: 在莎拉达希尔的根部击败萨维斯的部队。

pairs.source: Enter the Eye of Azshara and stop the Wrath of Azshara from being unleashed upon the Broken Isles.
pairs.text: 进入艾萨拉之眼，阻止艾萨拉之怒席卷整个破碎群岛。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 证明你的实力，并夺取阿格拉玛之盾。

pairs.source: Prove your worth and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
pairs.text: 證明你的資格，並取得阿格拉瑪之盾。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上纳格法尔号，在海拉的领域面对她。

pairs.source: Board the Naglfar and face Helya in her own domain.
pairs.text: 登上奈格法號，在黑爾雅的地盤上對付她。

pairs.source: Defeat Dargrul's legions and recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before Highmountain is destroyed.
pairs.text: 在至高岭被彻底毁灭前击败达古尔的军团，并夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。

pairs.source: Explore the sprawling depths of The Arcway.
pairs.text: 探索魔法回廊延展的深处。

pairs.source: Search the Vault of the Wardens for Cordana Felsong and defeat her.
pairs.text: 搜索守望者地窟，找到科达娜·邪歌，并将其击败。

pairs.source: You must destroy Kruul permanently in the Twisting Nether before he overruns your forces at the Broken Shore!
pairs.text: 你必须在库鲁尔毁灭你们在破碎海滩的部队前，在扭曲虚空中彻底消灭库鲁尔！

pairs.source: Defeat Sigryn and her fel council.
pairs.text: 击败希格林和她的邪能议会。

pairs.source: Aid Cenarius and his forces in defeating Crushfist.
pairs.text: 协助塞纳留斯和他的部队击败碾拳。

pairs.source: Destroy the barrier blocking the tower entrance.
pairs.text: 摧毁挡住塔楼入口的屏障。
消灭愤怒领主阿卡扎尔。

pairs.source: Rout the invasion by defeating the Legion Commander overseeing the attack.
pairs.text: 击败监督进攻的军团指挥官，击溃入侵者。

pairs.source: Tugar has gone to ground in the Cave of the Bloodtotem. It's time to put an end to him.
pairs.text: 图加进入了鲜血图腾洞穴。是时候了结他了。

pairs.source: Defeat Tugar Bloodtotem and Jormog the Behemoth.
pairs.text: 击败图加·鲜血图腾和“巨兽”乔莫格。

pairs.source: Locate the lost Titan vault near the Maelstrom.
pairs.text: 找到大漩涡附近失落的泰坦宝库。

pairs.source: Defend yourself against the vault's defense mechanisms.
pairs.text: 保护你自己不受保护防御系统的伤害。

pairs.source: Activate the console to power up the custodian.
pairs.text: 激活控制台，为管理员充能。

pairs.source: Choose 2 paladins to accompany you through Stratholme.
pairs.text: 选择两名圣骑士陪伴你穿过斯坦索姆。

pairs.source: Search Stratholme for stashes of holy water and the three missing paladins. Destroy any unholy abominations you come across.
pairs.text: 搜索斯坦索姆，寻找藏匿的圣水和三位失踪的圣骑士。消灭你遇到的一切邪恶怪物。

pairs.source: Speak with Cenarius to begin the assault.
pairs.text: 与塞纳留斯交谈以开始突袭。

pairs.source: Reach the top of the tower.
Ride the Dreamweavers' Hippogryphs up to the Legion Command Ship .
pairs.text: 骑乘织梦者的角鹰兽登上军团指挥舰。

pairs.source: Return to Grayson and give him the holy water.
pairs.text: 回到格雷森处并将圣水交给他。

pairs.source: Channel your holy power through your artifact weapon onto the barding.
pairs.text: 引导你的神圣能量，通过神器将其灌注给骑甲。

pairs.source: Find Baron Rivendare's remains in his crypt at the heart of Stratholme.
pairs.text: 在斯坦索姆中心的瑞文戴尔男爵的墓穴里找到他的遗体。

pairs.source: Close the portals and defeat Dread Commander Arganoth's forces
pairs.text: 关闭传送门并击败恐怖指挥官阿加诺斯的部队。

pairs.source: Gain entrance to Black Rook Hold through the landing.
pairs.text: 通过平台进入黑鸦堡垒。

pairs.source: Jump off the ship to escape.
Commander Thorn is inside Black Rook Hold. Follow Jarod Shadowsong into the depths of the hold to find your foe.
pairs.text: 指挥官索恩就在黑鸦堡垒里。跟随加洛德·影歌深入堡垒，找到敌人。

pairs.source: Use the Fel Cannons to clear the airspace around the tower.
pairs.text: 使用邪能火炮肃清塔楼周围的空域。

pairs.source: Inquisitor Variss stands in the way of Kruul. Destroy him!
pairs.text: 审判官瓦里斯保护着库鲁尔。消灭他！

pairs.source: Kruul has landed, now is your chance! Defeat him once and for all!
pairs.text: 库鲁尔着陆了，你的机会来了！彻底击败他吧！
再见了，有库鲁尔的世界

pairs.source: Your allies have been captured! Rescue them before their souls are corrupted!
pairs.text: 你的盟友被俘了！在他们的灵魂被腐蚀前救出他们！

pairs.source: Use the storm drakes to eliminate the Legion's ground forces.
pairs.text: 使用风暴幼龙消灭军团的地面部队。

pairs.source: Sabotage the Legion forces on board the ship.
pairs.text: 消灭战舰上的军团部队。

pairs.source: Use the Storm Drakes to extract.
Defeat Lord Commander Alexius and disable the ship's capabilities.
pairs.text: 击败总指挥官艾里克苏斯并破坏战舰的功能。

pairs.source: Challenge Damrul the Stronk to fight and defeat him.
pairs.text: 挑战强壮的丹鲁尔并击败他。

pairs.source: Challenge and Defeat Your First Opponent
pairs.text: 挑战并击败第一个对手

pairs.source: Challenge Omanawkwa Steelhoof to fight and defeat him.
pairs.text: 挑战奥马纳克瓦·钢蹄并击败他。

pairs.source: Challenge and Defeat Your Second Opponent
pairs.text: 挑战并击败第二个对手

pairs.source: Challenge Asrea Moonblade to fight and defeat her.
pairs.text: 挑战阿斯丽娅·月刃并击败她。

pairs.source: Challenge and Defeat Your Third Opponent
pairs.text: 挑战并击败第三个对手

pairs.source: Go to the designated area and defeat your final opponent.
pairs.text: 前往指定区域并击败最后一个对手。

pairs.source: Return to Karazhan and stop Viz'aduum the Watcher from opening portals to Legion worlds.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并阻止监视者维兹艾德姆打开通往军团世界的传送门。

pairs.source: Return to Karazhan and defeat the tower inhabitants.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并击败塔楼内的居民。
击败恐怖指挥官阿加诺斯

pairs.source: Take the Demonic Gateway to the base of the command ship.
pairs.text: 使用恶魔传送门前往指挥舰底层。

pairs.source: Defeat the Monster of a Troll
Seems some left over parts have become sentient!
pairs.text: 看来某些残留的零件有了自己的意识！

pairs.source: Clear the cave of cruel creatures.
pairs.text: 清除洞穴中的残忍生物。

pairs.source: Join the blue dragons in their assault against the Legion.
pairs.text: 与蓝龙一同攻击燃烧军团。

pairs.source: Reach the blue drakes to acquire transport to the Legion ship.
pairs.text: 找到幼年蓝龙并前往军团战舰。

pairs.source: Meet up with the Blue drakes
Reach Felweaver Axtris and defeat him.
pairs.text: 找到织邪者阿克特里斯并击败他。
消灭邪能领主瑟瑞塔斯。

pairs.source: Use the drakes to escape the Legion ship before it is destroyed.
pairs.text: 使用幼龙逃离即将被摧毁的军团战舰。

pairs.source: A tiny monkey guards the door.
Some of the critters have taken control of the cannons! Disable them quickly!
pairs.text: 有些小动物占据了炮台！快去解决掉它们！

pairs.source: Cookie's stew has been sitting out too long, and now it has a life of its own!
pairs.text: 曲奇的炖菜放得太久，它自己活过来了！

pairs.source: Your allies have gone mad! Save them from each other while stopping Erdris from raising an army of souls.
pairs.text: 你的盟友们发疯了！阻止他们自相残杀，并阻止艾德里斯复活幽灵大军。

pairs.source: The last remaining oaf in the Deadmines won't let you pass.
pairs.text: 死亡矿井最后一只巨怪还是不让你通过。

pairs.source: Someone else is here! Confront them!
pairs.text: 这里有其他人！战胜他们！

pairs.source: Your allies seem injured but will move on your command.
pairs.text: 你的盟友似乎受伤了，但还能听你指挥。

pairs.source: Defeat Arax'ath and enslave the Wrathsteed.
pairs.text: 击败阿拉萨斯并奴役愤怒战马。

pairs.source: Erdris has commanded his soldiers to Rise. Defeat them!
pairs.text: 艾德里斯复活了他的士兵。击败他们！

pairs.source: Fight with Lixahl until it submits to you.
pairs.text: 与丽克萨尔战斗，直到将其制伏。

pairs.source: Track Lixahl's blood until you find it. You can use your Spectral Sight to assist with the tracking.
pairs.text: 追踪丽克萨尔的血迹，直至找到它为止。你可以使用幽灵视觉协助追踪。

pairs.source: Once again, attempt to fight with Lixahl until it submits to you.
pairs.text: 再次与丽克萨尔战斗，直到将其制伏。

pairs.source: Continue to track the trail of blood Lixahl left behind. Remember that your Spectral Sight can be utililzed to help with this endeavor.
pairs.text: 继续追踪丽克萨尔留下的血迹。记住，你可以使用幽灵视觉协助追踪。

pairs.source: Finish subduing Lixahl until it submits.
Locate the legendary animal spirits and put them to rest.
pairs.text: 找到传说中的兽灵并让它们安息。

pairs.source: Put the spirits of the Wolf and Hawk to rest.
pairs.text: 让巨狼和巨鹰之灵安息。
与啸天者沙德格弗交谈

pairs.source: Secure the upper portion of Thunder Totem.
Rendezvous with Mayla in the lower portion of Thunder Totem.
pairs.text: 在雷霆图腾下层与梅拉汇合。

pairs.source: Defend the area from incoming enemy attacks.
pairs.text: 保卫阵地，挡住来袭的敌人。

pairs.source: Ride Lixahl back to the demon hunter camp.
pairs.text: 骑上丽克萨尔，返回恶魔猎手的营地。

pairs.source: Eliminate the lieutenant leading the assault.
Escort Mayla to meet up with Lasan outside of Thunder Totem.
pairs.text: 护送梅拉与雷霆图腾外的拉善汇合。

pairs.source: Use Lasan's War Eagles to reach the Legion Ship.
pairs.text: 使用拉善的作战雄鹰前往军团战舰。

pairs.source: Rescue the highmountain tauren captured by the Legion.
pairs.text: 救出被军团俘虏的至高岭牛头人。

pairs.source: Set explosives at key points throughout the ship.
pairs.text: 在战舰的关键位置安放炸药。

pairs.source: Assist Lasan in the fight against the Legion Commander.
pairs.text: 协助拉善战胜军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Use the eagles to get off the ship.
Return to the Shrine and investigate the screams
Return to Karazhan and stop Viz'aduum the Watcher from opening portals to Legion worlds.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并阻止监视者维兹艾德姆打开通往军团世界的传送门。

pairs.source: Return to Karazhan and stop Viz'aduum the Watcher from opening portals to Legion worlds.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并阻止监视者维兹艾德姆打开通往军团世界的传送门。

pairs.source: Return to Karazhan and defeat the tower inhabitants.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并击败塔楼内的居民。

pairs.source: Return to Karazhan and defeat the tower inhabitants.
pairs.text: 重返卡拉赞，并击败塔楼内的居民。

pairs.source: Reveal the traitor in the Shrine
Find out what's happening to Akazamzarak's rabbits.
pairs.text: 搞清楚阿卡扎曼扎拉克的兔子出了什么问题。

pairs.source: Kill the Voracious Wolf that's eating Akazamzarak's rabbits.
pairs.text: 击杀正在吃阿卡扎曼拉克兔子的贪吃的狼。
离开阿卡扎曼拉克的帽子。

pairs.source: Convince Rohash, Nezir and Anshal to swear allegiance to Thunderaan.
pairs.text: 说服洛哈西、尼希尔和安舍尔宣誓效忠桑德兰。
在鲁特凡峰附近找到希萨莉。

pairs.source: Prowl and follow Thisalee into the Legion encampment
pairs.text: 跟随希萨莉潜入军团营地。

pairs.source: Watch Infazzar and determine his plans
pairs.text: 监视伊法扎尔制定计划。

pairs.source: Fight off the attacking demons and fel harpies
pairs.text: 击退进攻的恶魔和邪能鹰身人
跟踪伊法扎尔前往他的战舰

pairs.source: Fight your way to Infazzar and retrieve the Idol of Aviana
pairs.text: 杀到伊法扎尔面前，夺回艾维娜雕像。

pairs.source: Take a whirlwind to the center platform.
pairs.text: 乘坐旋风前往中央平台。

pairs.source: When you're ready to leave, speak with Grayson and he'll see you returned to Light's Hope Chapel.
pairs.text: 你准备好离开后，就与格雷森谈一谈。他会将你送回圣光之愿礼拜堂。

pairs.source: Speak with Magni to hear Azeroth's warning.
pairs.text: 与麦格尼谈一谈，聆听艾泽拉斯的警告。

pairs.source: Place Arcane Bombs in Mephistroth's command ship.
pairs.text: 在孟菲斯托斯的指挥舰上放置奥术炸弹。

pairs.source: Defeat Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar within the top of the tomb before you are overrun by the Legion.
pairs.text: 击败孟菲斯托斯，并在军团占领这里前把阿格拉玛之盾放置在墓穴顶层。

pairs.source: Defeat Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar within the top of the tomb before you are overrun by the Legion.
pairs.text: 击败孟菲斯托斯，并在军团占领这里前把阿格拉玛之盾放置在墓穴顶层。

pairs.source: A number of invaders have appeared inside the facility, triggering its defenses. You will not be able to proceed without defeating them first.
pairs.text: 设施中出现了一大群入侵者，触发了防御机制。你必须击败他们才能继续前进。

pairs.source: The visions have overwhelmed the defenses. Reactivate the sentries and defeat any adversaries in order to proceed.
pairs.text: 幻象压制了防御机制。重新启动哨兵，击败敌人，继续前进。

pairs.source: Find the Frozen Span before feral undead overwhelm you.
pairs.text: 在被狂野的亡灵淹没之前找到冰封之桥。

pairs.source: Cross the span to Kyranastrasz' Rest.
pairs.text: 通过冰桥，前往吉拉纳斯塔兹之墓。

pairs.source: Slay undead to collect the red dragon's essence.
pairs.text: 击杀亡灵，收集红龙的精华。

pairs.source: Convert the life essence to unholy essence.
pairs.text: 将生命精华转化为邪恶精华。

pairs.source: Use the unholy essence to raise your dragon.
pairs.text: 使用邪恶精华复活你的巨龙。

pairs.source: Talk to the transmogrifiers and use the barber chairs to perfect your look. Don't forget to stick to the theme!
pairs.text: 与幻化师谈一谈，使用理发椅整理你的仪表。别忘了紧扣主题！

pairs.source: Return to Odyn and feast the night away.
pairs.text: 向奥丁复命并彻夜欢宴。

pairs.source: Vote for your favorite transmog. When you go on stage yourself, strike a pose and earn those votes!
pairs.text: 给你最喜欢的幻化投上一票。你自己登台时，也别忘了拗个造型，这样才能赚到更多的选票！

pairs.source: Defeat Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar within the top of the tomb before you are overrun by the Legion.
pairs.text: 击败孟菲斯托斯，并在军团占领这里前把阿格拉玛之盾放置在墓穴顶层。

pairs.source: Defeat Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar within the top of the tomb before you are overrun by the Legion.
pairs.text: 击败孟菲斯托斯，并在军团占领这里前把阿格拉玛之盾放置在墓穴顶层。

pairs.source: Jump and glide to your prey.
At last we breach the Tomb of Sargeras, but the Legion will not be caught off guard.
pairs.text: 我们终于攻破了萨格拉斯之墓，但燃烧军团肯定早有准备。

pairs.source: A sealed portion Temple of Elune has been breached by the Legion and has created unthinkable horrors.
pairs.text: 月神殿中被封印起来的区域，被燃烧军团攻破后已成为恐怖横行之地。

pairs.source: Deep within the the Tomb of Sargeras the Fallen Avatar has been awoken.
pairs.text: 萨格拉斯之墓深处的堕落的化身已经苏醒了。

pairs.source: The defenses are active, but one final nightmare has appeared to block your path. It must be defeated.
pairs.text: 防御机制激活，但还有最后一个梦魇挡路。你必须击败它。

pairs.source: Speak with Chromie and select her talents.
pairs.text: 与克罗米谈一谈，选择她的天赋。
阻止对克罗米的所有攻击。

pairs.source: Defeat the Void presence drawing the Shadowguard and Voidbroken to the Seat of the Triumvirate.
pairs.text: 击败将影卫虚灵和虚空破碎者引到执政团之座的虚空力量。

pairs.source: Defeat the Void presence drawing the Shadowguard and Voidbroken to the Seat of the Triumvirate.
pairs.text: 击败将影卫虚灵和虚空破碎者引到执政团之座的虚空力量。
再次见证克罗米的末日……

pairs.source: Speak with the four Dragonflight ambassadors to look for clues.
pairs.text: 与四位巨龙军团大使谈一谈，寻找线索。

pairs.source: Wait for the tournament to begin.

pairs.text: 消灭受孢子强化的军团部队。

pairs.source: Kill the Legion's commander on Sholoth.
pairs.text: 消灭舒洛兹的军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Stop the Legion from defiling the fire elemental.

pairs.text: 把凝固的烈焰交给普洛克斯。

pairs.source: Kill the Crazed Corruptors to force the Smoldering Rifts to collapse.
pairs.text: 消灭疯狂的腐蚀者以迫使阴燃裂隙坍缩。

pairs.source: Release frozen Illidari from their prisons.
pairs.text: 从囚笼中释放冻结的伊利达雷。

pairs.source: Kill the Legion's commander on Val.
pairs.text: 消灭瓦尔的军团指挥官。

pairs.source: Defeat any remaining denizens to ensure victory.
pairs.text: 击败残存的住民，确保胜利。

pairs.source: The Legion is sending reinforcements - repel them!
pairs.text: 军团正在派出增援，快击退他们！

pairs.source: Kill the Crazed Corruptors to force the Smoldering Rifts to collapse.
pairs.text: 消灭疯狂的腐蚀者以迫使阴燃裂隙坍缩。
击败深渊领主维尔姆斯。

pairs.source: Defeat the Void presence drawing the Shadowguard and Voidbroken to the Seat of the Triumvirate.
pairs.text: 击败将影卫虚灵和虚空破碎者引到执政团之座的虚空力量。

pairs.source: Defeat the Void presence drawing the Shadowguard and Voidbroken to the Seat of the Triumvirate.
pairs.text: 击败将影卫虚灵和虚空破碎者引到执政团之座的虚空力量。

pairs.source: Feed the caps of the nearby Spore Stalks to the Weakened Shamblers to restore their vitality.
pairs.text: 把附近的孢子茎杆的伞盖喂给虚弱的蹒跚者，令它们恢复活力。

pairs.source: The cave howls. The only way is forward.
pairs.text: 洞穴里回荡着呼啸声。你唯一的出路就是向前走。

pairs.source: The draenei house shimmers into existence. A figment of the imagination?
pairs.text: 眼前突然浮现出了一座德莱尼房屋。这是幻觉吗？

pairs.source: Echoes of the past, or a twist of emotion? There is no kindness here.
pairs.text: 这是往昔的回响，还是情感的扭曲？此地根本不存在善意。

pairs.source: The swamp stinks of malevolence and anguish.
pairs.text: 这片沼泽散发着怨毒与痛苦的恶臭。

pairs.source: Even in the most hopeless situations, there is respite.
pairs.text: 就算是在最绝望的情况下，也会有喘息之机。
或许慰藉是不存在的呢？

pairs.source: Perhaps retreating deeper is the only way to feel safe...
pairs.text: 或许只有躲得更深才能感到安全……

pairs.source: A distraction, that what must be what is needed.
pairs.text: 一次放松的机会，现在最需要的就是这个。

pairs.source: Enemies in every shadow! How can the darkness be stopped?
pairs.text: 每一片阴影中都有敌人存在！怎么可能阻止这样的黑暗？

pairs.source: The Legion musters its forces against the Light's incursion, defying those who dare besiege Antorus.
pairs.text: 燃烧军团召集兵力抵御圣光的进攻，消灭任何胆敢围攻安托鲁斯的人。

pairs.source: From deep within its stronghold, the immortal army advances upon countless worlds... and seeks to claim the Dark Titan's prize.
pairs.text: 不朽的军团从他们的要塞深处向着无数个世界进军……希望获得黑暗泰坦的奖赏。

pairs.source: Only the most devoted--or the most vile--may tread so close to the heart of the Legion's power.
pairs.text: 只有最狂热，或者最恶毒之辈，才能踏入燃烧军团的力量核心。

pairs.source: Forces that shape the cosmos. Sights too wondrous for mortal eyes. Come forth, heroes, and behold eternity's end.
pairs.text: 这是塑造了宇宙的力量，是凡人之眼无法承受的绝景。上前来吧，英雄们，亲眼目睹永恒的终结。

pairs.source: It is unfair! Nothing is ever what it seems!
Is the only way through this to remain hidden? Alone?
pairs.text: 只有隐藏起来才能熬过去吗？孓身一人？

pairs.source: This is a good place to hide. Safe. Secure. Away from everyone. Everything.
pairs.text: 这是不错的藏身所，安全、安心、远离尘世。

pairs.source: No. It won't stop. The only way is to soldier on. To defeat the fear, the frustration.
pairs.text: 不，它不会停止。唯一的办法就是勇往直前，击败恐惧，击败绝望。

pairs.source: Is there an easier way? Perhaps power is all that is needed... Strength. To become that fear.
pairs.text: 有没有更容易的方法？或许需要的只是能力...不，力量，让自身成为恐惧。

pairs.source: Kindness and courage are not the only truths. What of fear? What of frustration?
pairs.text: 所谓真相，不仅限于善良与勇气。恐惧和绝望难道就不是吗？

pairs.source: Is this where it all leads? To the very edge of obliteration?
pairs.text: 这就是一切的终点吗？直到湮灭的边缘？

pairs.source: Impossible! Purity. Abstinence. It is an offer that cannot be accepted.
pairs.text: 不可能！纯洁和自律，这样的条件我不能接受。
願永恆的太陽指引我們
与乌布里克和奥蕾莉亚同行。

pairs.source: Higher riding skill allows you to ride faster and more exotic beasts.
pairs.text: 高级的骑术令你可以骑乘更加快速和稀有的野兽。

pairs.source: Higher inscription skill allows you to learn more advanced inscriptions.  Inscriptions are acquired from learned scribes throughout the world.
pairs.text: 高级的铭文技能使你可以学习制作高级的铭文。你可以通过各种卷轴学习铭文。

pairs.source: Higher archaeology skill allows you to complete more valuable artifacts and collect more artifact fragments. Fragments can be found in ruins and dig sites.
pairs.text: 高级的考古学技能使你可以完成更有价值的神器，并收集到更多的神器碎片。你能在遗迹和挖掘场中找到神器碎片。

pairs.text: 帮助格罗姆高营地抵御巨魔的进攻！

pairs.text: 你收集的熔火之羽的数量。

pairs.text: 杀死古代灵魂以为裴智之杖充能，并打断仪式！

pairs.text: 显示死亡之翼背脊上左侧和右侧玩家的平衡。当死亡之翼感到所有玩家都在同一侧时，他会进行翻滚。

pairs.source: Keep the attackers off of Pei-Zhi while he conducts the ritual!
pairs.text: 在裴智进行仪式时保护他！

pairs.text: 猢狲聚会正在倾情上演！

pairs.source: Keep Aysa safe while she meditates.
pairs.text: 在艾莎冥想的时候保护她。

pairs.text: 抓紧鲨鱼！别让她把你甩下去！

pairs.text: 救出治疗者并保护他们，直至神真子的伤口被治愈。

pairs.text: 站在祥和之池中以控制你的仇恨！

pairs.source: You absorb the raw power of the Sha as you slaughter them.
pairs.text: 你在杀死煞魔后，可吸收原始煞能。

pairs.source: Collect brew from the pirate hozen inhabiting the island.
pairs.text: 从岛上的猢狲海盗身上收集丛林酒。

pairs.source: You struggle to retain control of your new form.  If willpower is exhausted, your consciousness will fade entirely....

pairs.source: Hit as hard as you can!

pairs.text: 消灭生命之池周围的煞魔！

pairs.text: 随着怒气的提升，战歌兽人会变得越来越危险。

投影（50点傲气值）。

压制（100点傲气值）。

pairs.text: 摆脱食人魔控制的奴隶数量。

pairs.text: 用来破坏岩石和墙体的能量。

pairs.text: 随着热量的增加，山脉之心会形成更多爆破。

pairs.source: Keep your peasants safe while they gather lumber.
pairs.text: 在你的农夫收集木材时保护他们的安全。

因远离自己的独眼魔双胞胎兄弟而愤怒。

WARNING: Use of this flamethrower unit will generate heat based on the duration that it is used. If this unit overheats, it must cool for at least 10 seconds before reuse.

NO REFUNDS!

pairs.source: Slay Bloodmaul Ogres and gather intelligence on their clan.
pairs.text: 消灭血槌食人魔，并从他们身上收集情报。
